title: Restaurant Manager
description: • Burger House is looking for a highly motivated, customer-focused, and experienced Restaurant Manager to oversee our daily operations. The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of experience in managing a fast-paced food service environment, strong leadership skills, and a passion for delivering excellent customer service. As the manager, you will be responsible for leading the team, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high food quality and cleanliness standards, and achieving business goals. Key Responsibilities: Team Management: Lead, motivate, and supervise kitchen and front-of-house staff. Train new employees and ensure staff performance meets company standards. Daily Operations: Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the restaurant, including opening and closing procedures, staff scheduling, inventory management, and quality control. Customer Service: Ensure a consistently high standard of customer service. Handle customer feedback, complaints, and special requests promptly and professionally. Staff Scheduling: Create and manage work schedules to ensure proper coverage during peak hours and manage labor costs effectively. Inventory & Supply: Monitor stock levels, place orders for supplies and ingredients, and manage inventory to reduce waste and control costs. Health & Safety Compliance: Maintain a clean and safe working environment. Ensure compliance with food safety regulations, hygiene standards, and company policies. Financial Oversight: Assist in daily sales reporting, cash handling, and managing budget targets including labor and food costs. Marketing & Promotions: Support in implementing local marketing strategies, social media campaigns, and promotional events to increase foot traffic and sales. Reporting: Generate and submit regular reports on sales performance, customer feedback, and operational issues to upper management. Qualifications and Requirements: Minimum 3 years of experience in a restaurant management or supervisory role. Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Management, or a related field (preferred). Strong leadership and people management skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work under pressure and handle busy shifts effectively. Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene standards, and customer service best practices. Basic computer skills (Excel, POS systems, and social media platforms). Fluent in Amharic; good spoken English is an advantage. Preferred Traits: Passion for food and customer satisfaction. Ability to take initiative and solve problems independently. Positive attitude and commitment to high standards. Flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and evening shifts. What We Offer: Competitive salary with performance-based incentives. Opportunities for growth and professional development. Supportive and energetic work environment. Staff meals and discounts. How to Apply: Interested applicants can send their CV and a short cover letter . Please include “Restaurant Manager Application – Burger House” in the subject line.

title: Assistant Chef
description: • We are seeking a reliable and motivated Assistant Chef with at least two years of experience in a fast-paced kitchen environment, preferably in a burger or casual dining restaurant. As an Assistant Chef, you will support the Head Chef in daily kitchen operations, ensuring food is prepared to high standards of quality, safety, and presentation. Key Responsibilities: Assist in the preparation and cooking of burgers, sides, sauces, and other menu items according to Burger House standards. Maintain cleanliness and organization of the kitchen and food prep areas at all times. Ensure all ingredients are properly stored, labeled, and rotated using the FIFO method. Support the Head Chef in managing kitchen staff, including training and delegating tasks when needed. Help monitor food stock levels and report shortages to the Head Chef or Kitchen Manager. Uphold all food hygiene and safety standards, following local health regulations. Assist in quality control, ensuring portion sizes and food presentation meet brand guidelines. Contribute to new recipe ideas and improvements in kitchen efficiency and workflow. Handle kitchen equipment safely and report any issues or breakdowns. Maintain a positive, team-oriented attitude and support colleagues during busy shifts. Requirements: Minimum 2 years of experience as a line cook, kitchen assistant, or assistant chef, preferably in a burger house or similar setting. Strong understanding of kitchen safety, sanitation, and food handling procedures. Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good communication and teamwork skills. Flexible with working hours, including weekends and holidays. Physically fit and able to stand for extended periods. Basic knife skills and experience working with grills, fryers, and prep stations. Preferred Skills: Familiarity with American-style or gourmet burgers. Basic knowledge of inventory control and kitchen operations. Willingness to learn and grow into a higher kitchen role. What We Offer: Competitive salary based on experience. Staff meals and employee discounts. Opportunities for career growth and training. Friendly, supportive working environment. How to Apply: Please send your resume and a brief cover letter .We look forward to meeting passionate individuals who love great food and want to be part of a growing team!

title: Architect
description: About FAMA FAMA is a leading Electro-Mechanical and Construction Contractor in Ethiopia, renowned for our commitment to quality, innovation, and timely project delivery. We specialize in executing complex and large-scale projects that shape the future of Ethiopia's infrastructure. Our integrated approach combines cutting-edge engineering with robust construction practices to deliver exceptional value to our clients. As we continue to grow and take on more ambitious projects, we are looking to expand our talented team. We believe that great projects start with great design, and we are searching for a passionate and skilled Architect to help us bring our clients' visions to life. -We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented, and technically proficient Architect with at least 3 years of professional experience to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for all phases of architectural work, from initial concept design and development through to construction administration and project completion. This role requires a deep understanding of both aesthetic design and the practicalities of construction. You will collaborate closely with our engineering, project management, and construction teams to ensure that designs are not only visionary but also feasible, compliant, and executed to the highest standards. If you are an adaptive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about creating impactful spaces, we encourage you to apply. Key Responsibilities · Design & Development: o Develop and prepare architectural designs and concepts for a variety of projects. o Create detailed drawings, specifications, and construction documents using industry-standard software (AutoCAD, Revit, etc.). o Produce high-quality 3D models, renderings, and visualizations to communicate design intent to clients and stakeholders. · Project Coordination & Collaboration: o Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams, including civil, structural, electrical, and mechanical engineers, to develop integrated and coordinated project designs. o Ensure designs comply with all building codes, zoning laws, safety regulations, and other relevant legal standards. o Review and coordinate contractor submittals, shop drawings, and material samples to ensure they align with design specifications. · Project Administration & Site Supervision: o Participate in project meetings with clients, contractors, and consultants. o Conduct regular site visits to monitor construction progress, ensure adherence to design plans, and resolve any on-site issues or discrepancies. o Manage project timelines and deliverables for the architectural scope of work, ensuring deadlines are met. · Creativity & Innovation: o Stay updated on the latest architectural trends, materials, and construction technologies. o Contribute innovative and sustainable design solutions that enhance project value and efficiency. Required Qualifications & Experience · Education: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture from a recognized university. · Experience: A minimum of 3 years of post-graduation professional experience in an architectural design or construction environment. · Portfolio: A strong and diverse portfolio showcasing a range of completed or in-progress projects is mandatory. Please provide a link or a PDF copy with your application. · Software Proficiency: Expert-level proficiency in the following software is essential: o CAD/BIM: AutoCAD and Revit o 3D Modeling: SketchUp, 3ds Max, or similar o Rendering: V-Ray, Lumion, or similar o Graphics: Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator) What We Offer · A competitive salary package appropriate with experience. · The opportunity to work on high-profile, landmark projects. · A collaborative, supportive, and professional work environment. · Opportunities for continuous learning, professional growth, and career advancement. · A dynamic role with a high degree of creative freedom and responsibility.

title: Engineering Manager
description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and management of solar energy projects. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful delivery of residential, commercial, and industrial solar projects, from initial design to final commissioning. This role requires a strong technical background in electrical engineering, solar energy technologies, and project management, as well as the ability to lead teams and mentor junior engineers. Key Responsibilities 1. Engineering and Design Design, optimize, and simulate solar power plants, including grid-connected and standalone systems, mini-grids, and energy storage solutions. Perform electrical calculations, component sizing, and system dimensioning to ensure optimal performance and efficiency. Prepare detailed schematics, bill of quantities, and technical drawings using tools such as AutoCAD or similar software. Analyze existing electrical systems and recommend improvements to enhance performance and reliability. 2. Project Management Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope definition, goals, schedules, and deliverables. Coordinate resources, including personnel, equipment, and materials, to ensure efficient project execution. Estimate project costs, prepare budgets, and monitor financial performance throughout the project lifecycle. Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and outcomes. 3. Owner’s Engineering Provide advisory services to institutional and private clients on project development, operation, and tender preparation. Review and evaluate technical and financial proposals from contractors, providing support during negotiations and grant disbursements. Ensure compliance with industry standards, health, safety, and environmental regulations throughout project implementation. 4. Project Proposal and Tender Doc Preparation Prepare high-quality technical proposals, including technical methodologies, bills of materials, budgets, and technical drawings. Ensure proposals align with client requirements and industry best practices. 5. Team Leadership and Training Lead and mentor project teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring stakeholder satisfaction. Supervise and support junior engineers, providing guidance and facilitating their professional growth. Develop and deliver training programs for new staff, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge. 6. Regulatory Compliance and Documentation Ensure all projects comply with relevant health, safety, and environmental regulations. Maintain accurate and comprehensive project documentation, including progress reports, quality assessments, and performance evaluations. 7. Additional Responsibilities Perform any other duties as assigned by your supervisor to support the company’s goals and objectives. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred. Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical engineering Proven track record of managing solar projects from design to commissioning Experience in preparing and submitting technical and financial proposal for tenders. Technical Skills: Proficiency in electrical design and simulation software (e.g., AutoCAD, PV syst, or similar). Strong understanding of solar energy technologies, energy storage systems, and electrical distribution networks. Knowledge of industry standards and regulations related to solar energy projects. Soft Skills: Excellent project management skills, Strong leadership and team management abilities along with Exceptional communication skill, with a focus on mentorship and professional development. ·       Familiarity with ERCA procedures, the National Bank’s foreign currency policies, and Ethiopian Customs Management systems.

·       Experience with Letters of Credit, customs declarations, and shipping documentation.

·       Strong knowledge of INCOTERMS and international trade regulations.

·       Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with ERP/logistics software.

·       Strong communication, organizational, and negotiation skills.

·       Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple shipments simultaneously.

. Experience in duty - free (preferable) or retail operation.

title: Level Man
description: Job Description We are looking for an analytical surveyor to conduct land surveys and perform mathematical calculations with a high level of accuracy. Your measurements and calculations will be used for various construction and engineering projects in order to aid the decision-making and design process. To be successful as a surveyor you must be able to undertake detailed research that involves examining historical property records and maps to determine the legal boundaries of a section of land or property. Responsibilities: · Travelling to sites, when necessary. · Taking measurements of distances and angles on a property or section of land in order to establish legal boundaries. · Employing specialized equipment, including distance measuring wheels, GPS, and geographic information system (GIS) devices to measure boundaries and contours. · Performing mathematical calculations to determine and confirm surveying measurements. · Marking and delineating boundaries and reference points on a property or section of land. · Researching and consulting historical maps and surveys, as well as legal documents, relating to the property or section of land they are measuring. · Analyzing data using plans, maps, charts, and software such as AutoCAD and GIS programs. · Presenting data to clients and preparing reports detailing legal boundaries and other relevant information. · Collaborating and working with project managers, construction crews, and government agencies, when necessary. Requirements: · Bachelor’s degree or College Diploma in surveying, Geomatics, or a related field. · At least 2 years of work experience · Experience using hand surveying tools (distance measuring wheels, plumb bobs, levels) and electronic surveying tools (transit levels, GPS equipment). · Working knowledge of software such as AutoCAD and GIS programs. · Analytical and problem-solving skills. · Ability to work independently and as part of a team. · Meticulous attention to detail. · Effective written and verbal communication skills. Interested applicants should submit in person or by mail their non-returnable application with CVs & relevant documents within ten working days from the date of this announcement, on first floor of Turkana Building at Lideta sub city woreda 08 Geja Sefer to Mola Maru road just next to CBE. E-mail Address: Vacancies@elmiconstruction.com

title: Senior Accountant
description: Alpha Steel Factory is seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Accountant to join our finance team. The Senior Accountant will be responsible for overseeing general accounting operations, preparing accurate financial reports, ensuring compliance with accounting principles and internal controls, and supporting strategic financial planning. Key Responsibilities: • Manage and oversee daily accounting operations including ledger maintenance, journal entries, and bank reconciliations. • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS/GAAP. • Coordinate and lead the month-end and year-end close process. • Reconcile account balances and maintain general ledger integrity. • Ensure timely reporting of all monthly financial information. • Monitor and analyze accounting data and produce financial reports or statements. • Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management. • Support internal and external audits, providing necessary documentation and explanations. • Supervise junior accountants and accounting staff, providing guidance and training. • Ensure compliance with local tax regulations and company policies. • Develop and document business processes and accounting policies to maintain and strengthen internal controls. Qualifications: • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (Master’s preferred). • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or equivalent qualification preferred. • Minimum 5 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a senior or supervisory role. • Solid knowledge of accounting principles, standards, and regulations (e.g., IFRS, GAAP). • Experience in ERP/accounting software (e.g., SAP, QuickBooks, Zoho Books, etc.). • Advanced MS Excel skills (VLOOKUP, PivotTables, etc.). • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills. • High attention to detail and accuracy. • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Preferred: • Experience in manufacturing, trading, or similar sectors. • Familiarity with Ethiopian tax laws and financial reporting standards (if based in Ethiopia). • Working knowledge of import/export accounting, cost accounting, or project accounting is a plus. title: Content Creator & Social Media Manager
description:
We are seeking a talented and highly motivated Content Creator and Social Media Manager to join our creative team. The ideal candidate is a multi-skilled storyteller and digital communicator who can craft compelling content across multiple platforms — including short-form videos, documentaries, TV adverts, website copy, and social media posts. If you are passionate about writing, creative ideation, and driving engagement through strategic content, we’d love to hear from you. Key Responsibilities:
  • Conceptualize and write scripts for short-form videos, documentaries, and advertisements. Develop and execute engaging content strategies for various platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, etc.). Write clear, persuasive, and original copy for:
  • Social media posts TV commercials and video scripts Website pages and blogs Marketing materials and promotional content Collaborate closely with creative, design, and video production teams to ensure brand consistency and narrative flow. Monitor trends, analyze performance metrics, and optimize content for reach and engagement. Present content ideas and campaign concepts internally and to clients in a compelling manner. Manage social media calendars, schedules, and post timely, branded content. Engage with audiences across channels, managing community interaction and responding to feedback. Qualifications:
  • Proven experience (2+ years) in content creation, copywriting, or social media management — preferably within media, advertising, or creative agencies. Strong creative writing and copyediting skills across tones and formats in English. Experience writing for different media: video, print, web, and social. A portfolio showcasing diverse content work — from campaign concepts to short video scripts and web content. Solid understanding of content trends, platform best practices, and audience behavior across social media. Ability to ideate and pitch fresh, innovative content ideas clearly and confidently. Basic knowledge of SEO, content planning tools, and analytics platforms is a plus. Comfortable working under tight deadlines and managing multiple projects simultaneously. Bonus Skills:
  • Experience with content strategy or digital marketing. Video editing basics or familiarity with visual storytelling tools. Background in advertising, journalism, or communications.
  • Please send your CV, portfolio, and a brief cover letter outlining why you’re the right fit to Job Address BIMER SHOPPING MALL

title: Account Manager
description:
• We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Account Manager to join our team. This role serves as the primary link between our agency and our diverse client base. The Account Manager will be responsible for managing client relationships, coordinating project timelines and deliverables, and ensuring that both client expectations and internal team capacities are effectively balanced. A successful candidate will also contribute to agency growth by identifying new business opportunities and leading client pitches.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Serve as the main point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring consistent and proactive communication. Understand client goals, brand tone, and project objectives to guide the internal team toward effective delivery. Manage multiple projects across departments (creative, production, digital, etc.) and ensure timely execution and quality output. Coordinate and lead regular check-ins with clients, providing updates, gathering feedback, and addressing concerns. Balance client demands with internal workload capacity to prevent burnout and maximize productivity. Develop project timelines, track milestones, and ensure deadlines are met across all deliverables. Foster long-term relationships with clients through exceptional service and attention to detail. Collaborate with the creative and strategy teams to develop proposals and campaign presentations. Identify and pursue opportunities for account growth and new client acquisition. Prepare and present pitches to potential clients, working with the team to tailor solutions to their needs. Manage budgets, invoicing, and reporting for client projects in collaboration with the finance team. Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field. 2+ years of experience in account management, preferably within an advertising, creative, or communications agency. Strong interpersonal and client-handling skills with an ability to build rapport and trust. Excellent project management skills and the ability to multitask under pressure. A proactive problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments. Skilled in presenting ideas and strategies clearly, both in writing and verbally. Ability to manage both creative processes and client expectations effectively. Understanding of creative production processes (digital, print, video, etc.) is a strong advantage.
What We Offer:
  • A collaborative and creative work environment Opportunities to work with leading brands and organizations Growth and learning opportunities within a passionate team Competitive salary and benefits

description:
We are looking for Chief Technology Officer (CTO) with the following qualifications.

Job Title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Location: Addis Ababa

Number of Positions: 1

Employment Type: Permanent

 

Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Technology Leadership:

1.1. Develop and implement a technology roadmap aligned with the company’s vision and business objectives.

1.2. Stay updated on emerging technologies, trends, and best practices in virtual environments, integrating them into the company's strategy.

1.3. Lead the design and development of virtual city platforms to ensure they are user-friendly, scalable, and feature-rich.

1.4. Drive innovation by incorporating advanced technologies such as AI, machine learning, and blockchain to enhance the virtual city experience.

2. Infrastructure Management:

2.1. Oversee the development and maintenance of the company’s IT infrastructure, ensuring its reliability, security, and efficiency.

2.2. Ensure the integration of robust cybersecurity measures to protect both company and client data.

3. Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement:

3.1. Work closely with the Chief Cities Officer (CCO) to receive updates on virtual city features, infrastructure, and operational requirements.

3.2. Implement system updates and technology solutions based on feedback from the CCO and other department heads.

3.3. Participate in executive decision-making meetings to align technology initiatives with company-wide strategies.

3.4. Collaborate with the Chief Marketing Officer and other executives to ensure that technology initiatives support business needs.

3.5. Act as a technical liaison with partners, investors, and stakeholders to communicate the company’s technological capabilities and goals.

4. Team Leadership and Development:

4.1. Build and manage a high-performing technology team, including software engineers, developers, and IT specialists.

4.2. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation within the technology department.

4.3. Plan and manage the technology budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources.

4.4. Evaluate and negotiate with technology vendors and service providers.

4.5. Ensure thorough testing and quality assurance processes for all technology solutions.

5. Administrative Actions:

5.1. Take appropriate administrative actions as needed to ensure efficiency, compliance, and smooth operation within the department.

5.2. Discuss contract terminations with the Legal and Administrative Services and the Chief Cities Officer.

Qualifications:

BA Degree and Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration or equivalent education or professional experience
3-5 years of relevant work experience in an IT company
Proven experience in technology leadership roles, ideally in software development or virtual technologies.
A strong track record of developing and implementing technology strategies that support business growth.
Expertise in virtual city platforms, cloud computing and emerging digital technologies.
Visionary leadership with a focus on innovation.
Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Extensive technical knowledge of programming languages, system architecture, and software development methodologies.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
Self-motivated and goal-oriented with a passion for sales and business development
Interested candidates who meet the requirements can send us their updated resume.

title: Teacher Trainer Secondary School Subjects
description:
Company Overview
  • GlobeDock is a pioneering EdTech company headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We are on a mission to redefine how Ethiopians learn by using innovative digital tools and interactive methods that make quality education accessible and impactful. Our programs empower students and educators across the country to unlock their full potential and thrive in a competitive world.
Role Overview:
  • We are seeking experienced and passionate Teacher Trainers to join GlobeDock Academy’s growing team. In this role, you will mentor and train subject teachers (Grades 7–12) to deliver engaging, curriculum-aligned lessons using modern pedagogical approaches and digital tools. You will play a key role in improving learning outcomes through high-impact, competency-based teacher development.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deliver training workshops, webinars, and coaching sessions for secondary school teachers (Grades 7–12). Train teachers on active learning methodologies, differentiated instruction, competency-based approaches, and student engagement strategies. Support teachers in applying digital tools, content delivery platforms, and data-driven teaching practices. Conduct needs assessments, observe lessons (virtually or on-site), and provide targeted feedback. Contribute to developing teacher training content, facilitator guides, and learning materials aligned with national curriculum. Monitor and report on teacher progress and learning outcomes post-training.
Subjects of Focus: We are recruiting trainers with expertise in the following subjects: Mathematics Physics Chemistry Biology English Social Studies Economics General Science Citizenship Geography Qualifications & Experience:
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Education or a relevant subject field (Master’s preferred). Minimum 3 years of teaching experience in Grades 7–12 (teacher training or instructional coaching experience is a strong advantage). Proven knowledge of student-centered teaching methods, curriculum alignment, and assessment techniques. Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Amharic (bilingual delivery is preferred). Comfortable using edtech platforms, mobile tools, or LMS for training delivery and lesson demonstrations. Strong facilitation, mentoring, and coaching skills. Adaptability, a growth mindset, and a passion for educational transformation.
What We Offer:
  • Opportunity to work with a purpose-driven, impact-oriented EdTech company. Flexible and hybrid work options (in-person training and/or online sessions). Competitive compensation based on experience and scope. Room for innovation, collaboration, and professional development. Job Address meskel flower

title: Building and Tenant Administrator
description:
Education: Bachelor’s Degree Experience Level: Intermediate About Us
  • Meraki PLC is seeking a proactive and organized individual to oversee the management of our apartment building in Bole Rwanda. This role involves handling tenant relations, tracking monthly payments, managing building operations, and liaising with government offices when necessary.
Job Overview
  • As a Building Administrator & Tenant Relations Officer, you will be responsible for ensuring smooth operations within the apartment building, maintaining tenant satisfaction, handling financial transactions, and addressing administrative matters efficiently. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple tasks while ensuring compliance with legal and operational requirements.
Key Responsibilities Tenant & Financial Management • Handle tenant relations, including lease agreements, move-ins, and move-outs. • Track and collect monthly rental payments, issue receipts, and update financial records. • Address tenant inquiries, complaints, and concerns efficiently. • Prepare and distribute official announcements and updates for tenants. Building Administration & Operations • Monitor and maintain the cleanliness, security, and functionality of the building. • Coordinate repairs, maintenance, and service requests with contractors. • Keep records of utility usage and service contracts. Regulatory & Compliance Duties • Visit the Ministry of Revenue and other government offices as needed to ensure compliance with tax and legal requirements. • Maintain proper documentation related to building regulations, contracts, and policies. • Ensure adherence to local housing laws and safety standards. Reporting & Communication • Prepare and submit daily reports on building operations, tenant status, and financial matters. • Manage and organize office documents, reports, and records related to building management. • Assist in budgeting and cost tracking for building expenses. Qualifications & Skills • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Real Estate, Accounting, or a related field. • Prior experience in property management, administration, or finance is preferred. • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with attention to detail. • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). • Ability to handle financial transactions and maintain accurate records. • Knowledge of government regulations regarding property management and taxation is a plus. • Quick learner, proactive, and able to work independently. Why Join Us? • Opportunity to grow within a fast-expanding company. • A collaborative and professional work environment. • Valuable experience in real estate and property management Job Address Bole

title: Senior Sales and Marketing Officer
description:
Company Overview: Green Scene Energy is a private limited company dedicated to providing affordable, high-quality solar energy solutions, PUE and E-cooking to Grid, off-grid and weak grid areas in Ethiopia. Our mission is to make sustainable energy accessible to all, contributing towards a cleaner and greener environment. Job Title:   Senior Sales and Marketing Officer
  • Job Description: Green Scene Energy PLC seeks a talented Senior Marketing and Sales Specialist to drive sales and marketing efforts for our solar PV systems (including inverters, batteries, and irrigation pumps) and E-Cooking appliances in Ethiopia's underserved weak-grid and off-grid areas. The ideal candidate possesses a strong marketing and sales background and a passion for sustainable energy solutions.
Responsibilities:
  • Develop and implement comprehensive sales and marketing strategies focused on solar PV systems and energy-efficient appliances.
  • Set and monitor sales targets to achieve revenue growth and expand market share.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities including corporate clients, retailers and distributors.
  • Generate new leads and maintain a strong sales pipeline.
  • Cultivate and manage relationships with existing and potential clients.
  • Provide in-depth product knowledge and technical expertise to support customer decision-making.
  • Conduct cost-benefit and needs analysis to tailor solutions to client requirements.
  • Lead and supervise sales and marketing teams, including digital marketing and field sales.
  • Mentor team members and ensure achievement of individual and team targets.
  • Prepare sales targets and sales plans for team implementation.
  • Design and execute marketing campaigns across various channels (digital, print, events).
  • Create and manage marketing materials including brochures, presentations, catalogs and tailored proposals.
  • Maintain consistent brand messaging across all platforms and materials.
  • Oversee digital marketing efforts such as social media, SEO/SEM, email campaigns and online advertising.
  • Produce online content targeted to customer segments to enhance visibility.
  • Conduct market research to understand trends, customer behavior, and competitor activity.
  • Monitor and analyze competitor strategies to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Track sales performance and marketing effectiveness using CRM and analytics tools.
  • Prepare and present regular performance reports to senior management.
  • Organize and represent the company at trade shows, exhibitions, and industry events.
  • Prepare and manage the sales and marketing budget efficiently.
  • Optimize pricing strategies to improve competitiveness and profitability.
  • Prepare proforma invoices and customized price quotations for clients.
  • Expand the company's market reach through strategic business development and partnerships.
  • Conduct Market Research and Analysis to understand emerging opportunity, gaps and industry trends.
Qualifications:
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Marketing management,  Business Administration, Economics, Engineering or a related field. A Master’s degree or relevant certifications is preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in sales and marketing roles, preferably within the renewable energy or sustainability sectors.
Skills Required Technical (Hard) Skills Sales Strategy Development Market Research & Analysis Digital Marketing Expertise Data Analytics & Reporting Sales Forecasting Ms Excel, word Google Drive Interpersonal (Soft) Skills Leadership & Team Management Effective Communication Relationship Building interested candidates who meet the above requirement apply through https://forms.gle/Biu7rY31Wh2uop3B9

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Summary
  • The Social Media Team is responsible for managing the company’s presence across social media platforms to engage audiences, build brand awareness, and drive business objectives. This team creates, curates, and manages content while analyzing performance to optimize strategies.
Skills and Qualifications
  • Active Social media engagement of content creation with 3+ years’ experience Strong understanding of major social media platforms and their best practices. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Creativity and ability to develop engaging content. Analytical skills to interpret data and adjust strategies accordingly. Familiarity with social media management and analytics tools. Strong organizational skills and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously Key Responsibilities
  • Content Creation and Curation Develop engaging, creative, and high-quality content tailored to each social media platform (e.g., Tik Tok, Telegram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn etc.). Curate relevant content that resonates with the target audience and aligns with the company’s brand voice. Platform Management Manage and maintain the company’s profiles on all relevant social media platforms (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.). Analytics and Reporting Monitor and analyze social media performance metrics (e.g., engagement rates, reach, impressions, and follower growth). Create reports to share insights, successes, and areas for improvement with management and other teams. Trend Monitoring and Innovation Stay updated on social media trends, platform updates, and emerging tools to keep strategies fresh and relevant. Experiment with new content types, features, and techniques to enhance audience engagement. Crisis Management Monitor brand mentions and address potential issues or negative comments professionally and promptly. Implement strategies to handle social media crises and safeguard the company’s reputation. Collaboration Across Teams Work closely with the Graphic Design, Marketing Strategy, and Content teams to ensure consistency in messaging and branding. Provide feedback and insights from social media analytics to inform broader marketing efforts.

we are looking for a motivated Junior Electrical Engineer to join our technical team and contribute to the smooth operation of our production facilities. Qualifications;
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • 1–2 years of relevant experience (industrial exposure in manufacturing environments preferred).
  • Basic knowledge of electrical wiring, motors, drives, and PLC systems.
  • Familiarity with AutoCAD, electrical schematics, and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
Preferred (but not required)
  • Experience in a cosmetics, chemical or perfume manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of industrial automation and instrumentation.
Duties and Responsibilities:
  • strong understanding of electrical circuits, motors and control systems .
  • ability to use tools and test equipment safely and effectively.
  • installation and maintenance of electrical systems used in automated perfume production lines.
  • testing, calibration, and repair of electrical instruments, control panels, and power supply systems.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, layouts, and wiring diagrams for machinery and control systems.
  • Assist in monitoring energy usage and recommending energy-saving improvements .

title: Office Engineer
description:
Position Overview
  • We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Office Engineer with a background in Civil Engineering or Construction Technology and Management. The ideal candidate will have at least three years of experience and will play a crucial role in the pre-construction and execution phases of our projects. This position is responsible for preparing accurate Bills of Quantities (BoQ), developing cost estimates, reviewing structural designs, and managing essential project documentation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Quantity Surveying & BoQ Preparation:
  • Develop, prepare, and review detailed Bills of Quantities (BoQ) for Civil, Sanitary, and Electrical works based on project drawings and specifications.
  • Perform accurate quantity take-offs for all materials, labor, and equipment required for the project.
  • Ensure BoQs are comprehensive and aligned with tender requirements and project scope.
Cost Estimation & Control:
  • Prepare detailed cost breakdown documents and comprehensive cost estimates for tender submissions and project budgeting.
  • Analyze project plans and specifications to identify all cost components.
  • Assist in tracking project costs and preparing variation orders and claims.
Technical & Design Support:
  • Review and interpret structural design drawings and specifications to ensure accuracy, feasibility, and compliance with standards.
  • Utilize your knowledge of structural designs to provide valuable input during the design review process.
  • Prepare and modify technical drawings, shop drawings, and as-built drawings using AutoCAD.
Documentation and Coordination:
  • Maintain and manage all project documentation, including drawings, technical submittals, RFIs (Request for Information), and correspondence.
  • Liaise effectively with Project Managers, Site Engineers, and the Procurement team to ensure a seamless flow of information and materials.
  • Assist in the preparation of tender documents, contracts, and technical reports.
Required Qualifications and Skills
  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Technology and Management (COTM).
  • Experience: A minimum of 3 years of proven experience as an Office Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, or a similar role within the construction industry.
Technical Skills:
  • BoQ & Costing: Demonstrated expertise in preparing Bills of Quantities for Civil, Sanitary, and Electrical works, along with creating detailed cost breakdown documents.
  • Structural Knowledge: Strong understanding of structural design principles and the ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings.
  • Software Proficiency: High proficiency in AutoCAD is essential. Strong skills in MS Office Suite (particularly MS Excel and MS Word) are required. Familiarity with MS Project is a plus.
Personal Attributes:
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a project team.
What We Offer
  • A competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • The chance to work on diverse and challenging electro-mechanical and construction projects.
How to Apply
  • Interested candidates who meet the above criteria are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience. Job Address Bambis, Afework Building 7th floor

title: Market Researcher for BYD Auto Spare Parts
description:
About the Role:
  • We are looking for a field-based Market Researcher in Addis Ababa to conduct focused research on electric vehicle (EV) spare parts, with a strong emphasis on BYD models and other popular EV brands in Ethiopia. You will be responsible for visiting auto garages, EV service centers, and spare part dealers to gather real-world data on the most in-demand spare parts, sourcing details, and supplier information.
Your Main Responsibilities:
  • Visit BYD-authorized centers, independent EV service providers, and local spare parts shops across Addis Ababa.
  • Identify and record the most frequently requested EV spare parts for:
  • BYD models (Seagull, Yuan Plus, Song Plus, Tang, Dolphin, etc.)
  • Other popular EV brands
  • Collect and document the following for each site visited:
Business Name & Location
  • Phone Number / WhatsApp Contact
  • Top EV Parts Requested (e.g., battery cells, inverters, BMS units, EV brake systems, infotainment screens, headlamps, door handles, windshield components, suspension systems, etc.)
  • Which model(s) does each part apply to Part availability issues / common stockouts Prices or price ranges (when available) Whether parts are genuine, aftermarket, or imported Interview technicians to understand which EV parts are hardest to find or most urgently needed.
  • Keep detailed notes of where the data came from (e.g., shop name, location, mechanic, or staff member).
  • Provide a comprehensive report of your findings, ideally in Excel or Google Sheets format, including photo evidence if possible.
Qualifications:
  • Reside in Addis Ababa and have excellent knowledge of the city’s auto and EV networks.
  • Able to move around easily (walking, ride-hailing, or personal motorbike/car).
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to track large volumes of real-world data accurately.
  • Strong communication skills – must be comfortable speaking with shop owners and technicians.
  • Familiarity with EV technology or auto parts is a strong plus, but training will be provided if needed.What
We Offer:
  • Attractive pay based on the number and quality of verified data points collected.
  • Bonus for identifying new or exclusive suppliers and high-demand items.
  • Opportunity for long-term projects in EV sourcing, parts import, or auto dealership support.

  3. Your resume and a brief cover letter.

title: OpenWRT Developer
description:
Job Opportunity: OpenWRT Developer Wanted!
  • We’re looking for a skilled OpenWRT developer to help us build powerful and secure embedded networking solutions.
  • If you're experienced in firmware development, networking, and Linux systems — and you're ready to fully dedicate yourself to one exciting project — this is your opportunity!
IMPORTANT NOTE: - We are hiring individual developers only. - Applicants who are currently employed (full-time or part-time) at any company will NOT be accepted. - We require full focus and dedication during the project.
  • Budget & Benefits Budget: 35,000
Responsibilities - Customize and build OpenWRT firmware for embedded routers/gateways - Configure networking: IP setup, wireless radios, VLANs, firewall rules - Integrate hardware modules (e.g., LTE/USB modems) - Automate system behavior using UCI, init scripts, ubus - Optimize system performance and reliability - Work closely with our team for testing and improvements Requirements - Strong experience with Linux systems and networking - Familiar with iptables, dnsmasq, netifd, luci, ubus - Skilled in Bash and C programming (Bonus): Knowledge of Python, Lua, or Go - Able to debug boot, system, and connectivity issues - Must be a freelancer (not employed elsewhere) - Reliable, communicative, and committed to the project timeline
  • Mini-Project (Mandatory)
  • Task: Build a minimal custom OpenWRT image to demonstrate your skills.
Your image must include: -Static IP configuration -Pre-installed packages: luci, htop, iptables, wireless-tools -LuCI web interface working on boot -One firewall rule (block outbound port 1234) -Init script that logs uptime every minute
  • Target: Any OpenWRT-supported router or x86 VM (e.g. VirtualBox)
Note:
  • To submit your project, upload any associated files along with a detailed README explaining your steps and logic to your GitHub repository. Include the GitHub link with your job application.
Tip:
  • We recommend you to use an x86 VM (e.g. VirtualBox) if you don't have access to a router
Application Forum:

title: Import Export Manager
description: Roles and Responsibilities: ·       Coordinate import and export shipments from origin to destination, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery. ·       Prepare and verify all required shipping and customs documentation (e.g., invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.). ·       Liaise with the Ethiopian Customs Commission (ERCA), the Ministry of Trade & Regional Integration, and other relevant authorities for clearance and permits. ·       Ensure compliance with national import/export regulations, including customs duties, tariffs, and NBE forex permit processes. ·       Handle opening, tracking, and settlement of Letters of Credit (LCs), advance payments, and other international payment methods in collaboration with banks. ·       Handle the application and approval process for import certificates related to controlled or restricted goods. ·       Ensure timely declaration and clearance of goods through customs, and coordinate inspections when necessary. ·       Maintain accurate records of imports and exports, including shipment history, supplier correspondence, and tax documents. ·       Monitor regulatory changes (e.g., tariffs, bans, foreign currency directives) and update internal procedures accordingly. ·       Coordinate with procurement, warehouse, and finance departments to ensure smooth inbound/outbound logistics. ·       Work with freight forwarders, shipping agents, and transporters to ensure optimized routes, rates, and reliability. ·       Track shipments in real-time, resolve customs or logistics delays, and ensure proper documentation is maintained for audits. ·       Ensure HS code classification, proper valuation, and accurate duty/tax calculations on all goods. ·       Prepare monthly and quarterly reports on import/export performance, cost analysis, and regulatory updates ·       Prepare and present regular reports on purchase activities, costs, and supplier performance to management. Requirements: ·    Bachelor’s degree in logistics, international trade, supply chain management, business administration, or a related field. ·       2+ years of experience in import/export operations, logistics, or freight forwarding—preferably in Ethiopia. ·       Familiarity with ERCA procedures, the National Bank’s foreign currency policies, and Ethiopian Customs Management systems. ·       Experience with letters of credit, customs declarations, and shipping documentation. ·      Stay updated on changes in trade laws, tariffs, and international logistics trends. ·       Strong communication, organizational, and negotiation skills. ·       Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple shipments simultaneously. ·       English proficiency is mandatory.

title: Senior ERP Implementer
description:
• The Senior ERP Implementer oversees the deployment and execution of ERP solutions, ensuring they align with client needs and organizational objectives. This role is responsible for managing project timelines, configuring ERP systems, and providing end-to-end support—serving as a key connection between clients, development teams, and stakeholders. Success in this position requires strong project management, technical capability, and excellent communication skills.
Key Responsibilities
  • Client Engagement
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during ERP implementation. Gather, document, and analyze business requirements, processes, and goals. Conduct gap analyses and define system requirements and workflows. Communicate project updates and progress reports to clients and stakeholders. System Configuration
  • Configure ERP modules to align with specific client needs. Customize workflows, forms, reports, and dashboards. Develop data templates and oversee the data migration process, including validation and cleanup. Collaboration with Development Team
  • Translate business and functional requirements into technical specifications. Coordinate with developers to ensure system integration and required customizations. Test developed features and provide structured feedback for improvements. Training and Support
  • Design and deliver training sessions for end-users and internal teams. Provide post-implementation support and guidance to users and new team members. Ensure effective product usage and adoption through clear instruction and documentation. Project Management
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and monitor project plans. Ensure deliverables are completed on time and within budget. Recommend strategies to optimize delivery, increase satisfaction, and reduce implementation risk. Issue Resolution
  • Identify and resolve technical or functional issues across ERP modules. Perform regular system audits and troubleshoot configuration or data-related problems. Implement corrective actions and continuous improvement strategies. Documentation and Reporting
  • Maintain detailed documentation including process designs, user manuals, and system configurations. Generate and present reports on project metrics and post-implementation performance. Continuous Improvement
  • Contribute to the standardization of ERP implementations across sectors. Identify and implement process enhancements and best practices. Stay informed on ERP product updates, new features, and industry trends.
About You Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Related Fields. 4–6 years of experience in software development and ERP implementation. Advanced understanding of ERP systems, including module interdependencies and integration. Proficiency in data migration, ETL design, and maintaining data integrity. Strong command of SQL, ERP reporting tools, and overall system architecture. Proven ability to identify functional gaps and design effective workarounds. Skilled in customizing ERP modules to meet unique and complex business scenarios.
Required Skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Excel, Access, Publisher, Outlook, PowerPoint Critical thinking and analytical skills Strong attention to detail Creative and structured problem-solving Job Address Sarbet, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, Elilita Building 3rd Floor

  የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ እንቅስቃሴ ያቅዳል፣ ያደራጃል፣ ይመራል፣ ይቆጣጠራል።   ድርጅቱ ትርፋማ እንዲሆን የሚያስችሉ ፖሊሲዎችንና ስትራቴጂዎችን ነድፎ ይሰራል።   የድርጅቱን የአጭርና የረዥም ጊዜ አላማ ከግብ ለማድረስ የድርጅቱ የሰው ሃይልና የሰው ሃይል በማቀድ፣ በማደራጀት፣ በመምራትና በመቆጣጠር ይሰራል።   LMS ፕላትፎርም የሚሆኑ ፕሮዳክሽን ስራ እንዲሰራ ያደርጋል   አዳዲስ ተቀጣሪዎች ምልመላ፣ ስልጠናና ቅጥር ማከናወን፡፡   እያንዳንዱ ስራ እና ንዑስ የስራ ሂደት በተገቢው ሁኔታ እየሄደ እንደሆነና የታለመለትን ግብ ሊያሳካ ስለመቻሉ ክትትል ማድረግ...   ሁሉንም የስራ ሂደቶች መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀት፡፡   የእያንዳንዱን የስራተኞች ስራ ክንውን መከተታተል ፡፡   የድርጅቱን የፋይናንስ ፣ የማርኬቲንግ እያንዳንዱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡   ከፋይናንስ እና አካውንቲንግ ጋር በተያያዘ ያለውን ስራ በእራስም ሆነ ከሚመለከተው ባለሙያ ጋር ሆኖ የየወቅቱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡   በጀት መመደብና ወጪ መቀነስ   ፖሊሲ ማርቀቅና እና አተገባበሩንም መተለም   የሰራተኞችን የስራ አቅምና ባህል እንዲጎለብት መርዳት   ሁሉም የፋይናንስ እንቅስቃሴዎች በታለመላቸው መልኩ እየሄዱ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ክትትል ማድረግ   የድርጅቱን ግብርና ቀረጥ መሰል ክፍያዎች በጊዜው መክፈል ወይም እንዲከፈል ማድረግ   የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን ጊዜውን ጠብቀው ማውጣት ደሞዝ፤ 13000 አድራሻ፡- ከመካኒሳ ወደጀርመን በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ

title: Videographer & Editor
description:
• Twinkle, a full-spectrum 360° media company, is looking for a Videographer & Editor with a sharp visual eye and a passion for storytelling. The ideal candidate can shoot high-quality video content and craft compelling edits that align with our brand and our clients’ goals. You should be able to work both in-studio and on-location, capturing everything from corporate profiles to social media content and high-impact commercials.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Plan, shoot, and edit video content for a variety of platforms Operate cameras, lighting, and audio equipment on set Edit footage into polished final products using industry-standard software Collaborate with creative teams to bring concepts to life Ensure content meets technical standards and brand aesthetics Qualifications:
  • Proven experience in videography and video editing Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve Strong sense of timing, pacing, and visual storytelling Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines Motion graphics or color grading skills are a big plus Job Address Century Executive Tower, Bole

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Description: Twinkle, a forward-thinking 360° media services company, is hiring a Social Media Manager to lead our digital voice and drive our online presence. The ideal candidate is a creative storyteller, trend-savvy, and analytics-driven. You’ll manage content calendars, grow our online community, and turn engagement into real-world impact for both Twinkle and our clients. Key Responsibilities:
  • Plan, create, and manage engaging content across all major social media platforms Develop and execute strategic campaigns aligned with brand goals Monitor performance metrics and adjust tactics for growth and engagement Stay ahead of trends, platform updates, and content strategies Collaborate with creative, marketing, and design teams to ensure brand consistency Qualifications:
  • Proven experience in social media management (minimum 2 years preferred) Strong understanding of content strategy, community management, and analytics Excellent communication skills and creative flair Familiarity with design tools (Canva, Adobe Suite) and scheduling tools (Hootsuite, Buffer, etc.) Ability to work independently and adapt to fast-paced environments Very good (fluent) conversational & writing skills in Amharic and English. French is a plus. Job Address Century Executive Tower, Bole

outings, brainstorming sessions, and social events to foster collaboration and creativity Job Address Summit, fiyel bet

title: Recruitment Intern
description:
• We are looking for a dedicated intern to help with the recruitment process. Responsibilities include screening resumes, conducting initial phone interviews, and collaborating with the recruitment team to improve the candidate experience. Tasks involve scheduling interviews, greeting candidates, and assisting with pre-employment assessments. The role also includes maintaining the candidate database and organizing recruitment documents.
Responsibilities :
  • Assist in screening candidate resumes and applications, conducting initial phone screens, and providing feedback to the recruitment team.
  • Collaborate with the recruitment team to ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
  • Assist in scheduling interviews with candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels.
  • Coordinate and communicate interview details, including interview locations, interviewers names, and any necessary instructions to candidates.
  • Provide support during interview days by greeting candidates, ensuring they have the necessary documentation, and guiding them through the interview process. Requirements:
  • Currently enrolled in a relevant degree program in Social fields.  Available to commit 24+hours per week.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
• We need someone who is used to working with an enormous amounts of data and can show us their previous working with big data - collecting, processing, storing, ingesting, and efficiently accessing the data.
  • Strong background in AI/Machine Learning
  • We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer to lead the ingestion, processing, storage, and efficient access of large-scale data. You will be responsible for designing and optimizing data pipelines, ensuring data integrity, and working with cross-functional teams to support business intelligence, machine learning, and analytical applications.
Key Responsibilities Data Ingestion & Processing: • Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for ingesting structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. • Optimize data workflows to handle real-time and batch processing efficiently. • Work with streaming data technologies like Kafka, Spark, or Flink to enable real-time data ingestion. Data Storage & Management: • Design and maintain data lakes, data warehouses, and databases to ensure structured data storage. • Ensure data governance, security, and compliance with industry standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA). • Implement best practices for data partitioning, indexing, and compression for optimal performance. Data Access & Integration: • Build APIs and data access layers for seamless integration with analytics, machine learning, and reporting tools. • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and business teams to ensure easy and secure data access. • Implement metadata management and data cataloging for better discoverability. Performance Optimization & Automation: • Optimize query performance and data retrieval speeds for large-scale datasets. • Automate monitoring and alerting systems to track data pipeline health and performance. • Use infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools (Terraform, CloudFormation) to manage cloud-based data environments. Required Qualifications • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software development, or related fields. • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Scala/Java. • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery). • Expertise in data modeling, warehouse design, and distributed computing. • Hands-on experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar). • Solid understanding of data security, compliance, and governance best practices. Preferred Qualifications • Familiarity with machine learning data pipelines. • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) for deploying data workloads.

• ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ/ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እና ማማከር ነው፡፡
  • Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMS ፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ ለዚሁ ስራ በቪዲዮ ከፕሪ እስከ ፖስት ድረስ መስራት የሚችል ማድረግ የሚችል ባለሙያ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት እና ልምድ ያለው ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት እየፈለግን ነው።
  • የደንበኞቻችን ፍላጎት ተከትሎ ቪዲዮ መቅረጽ፣ ማስተካከል (ኤዲት ማድረግ) የሚችል የቪዲዮግራፊ ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡ የቪዲዮግራፈሩ ሚና ለስራው የሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳቁሶች መሟላታቸውን መከታተል፣ የካሜራ ባለሙያዎችን መምራት፣ እና ቪዲዮዎችን ኤዲት ማድረግ የሚችል ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡
  • በቪዲዮ ግራፊ ሙያ ስኬታማ ለመሆን ባለሙያው የደንበኞችን ፍላጎት በጥሞና አዳምጦ የሚረዳና ፈጠራ የታከለበት ክህሎት አስተባብሮ የሚጠበቀውን ውጤት ማስረከብ የሚችል ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡ ጎበዝ የቪዲዮ ግራፊ ባለሙያ የስራውን ጥራት የሚጨምሩ ዘመኑ ያፈራቸውን ገበያው የሚፈልጋቸውን አዳዲስ አሰራሮች፣ አቀራረቦችን እየተከታተለ በየጊዜው ራሱን የሚበቃ ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡
የቪዲዮ ግራፈሩ ኃላፊነቶች * በተገቢው ቦታ የቪዲዮ እና የፎቶ ምስሎች መቅረጽ * በየጊዜው የስራ መሳሪያዎቹን ዝግጁነት መገምገምና ማሟላት * ከስራ ባልደረቦችና ከደንበኞች ጋር ሆኖ የስራ እቅድ ማርቀቅ * ከቀረጻ በኋላ የቪዲዮ ምስሎን ማረም (ቪዲዮ ኤዲቲንግ ማከናወን) * ተፈላጊው የቪዲዮ ምስል በተገቢ ሆኑታ እንዲቀረጽ ሌሎችን የቪዲዮግራፊ ባለሙያዎች ማስተባበር ተፈላጊ ልዩ ችሎታዎች * ከፍተኛ የሆነ የኮምፒውተር አጠቃቀም ችሎታ * የኦንላይን እና ኦፍለይን ሶፍትዎሮችን መጠቀም የሚችል * ከፍተኛ የሆነ የአዶቤ ፎቶሾፕ አጠቃቀም ችሎታ * አስደናቂ የካሜራ አጠቃቀም ችሎታ ደሞዝ 12,500 አድራሻ፡- ከመካኒሳ ወደጀርመን በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ Job Address German Adebabay

title: HR and Operations officer
description:
• Mary Joy Ethiopia is a non- profit development –oriented organization. MJE has been serving the community for the past 30+ years, dedicated to improving the lives of vulnerable communities by advancing and implementing integrated development programs focused on livelihood enhancement, education, and health with cross-cutting issues of children empowerment, environmental protection, Adolescent and Youth Sexual Reproductive Health and HIV/AIDS inclusiveness.
  • Human resource and operations officer
Responsibilities • Implement HR policies, procedures, and processes in line with organizational goals. • Provide consistent and efficient HR services to staff. • Manage the Human Resources and Administration team, overseeing people planning, need assessment, performance, and well-being. • Provide technical support capacity building need assessment, and capacity building to staffs, ensuring alignment with MJE policies. • Support talent acquisition, retention, and employee motivation strategies. • Assist in recruitment by developing job descriptions, sourcing candidates, and ensuring timely hiring. • Oversee onboarding and orientation for new hires, ensuring they are familiar with organizational processes. • Support the performance management system by assisting in setting objectives and conducting evaluations. • Provide guidance to staff and managers on HR best practices and performance issues. • Facilitate staff development programs, coaching, and career growth. • Coordinate with external networks to attract top candidates and implement best HR practices. • Prepare bimonthly and quarterly HR reports on key activities. • Assist with the implementation of new HR initiatives and strategies in line with the organization’s objectives. • Support compensation, benefits administration, and ensure compliance with labor laws. • Assist in contract administration, ensuring accuracy and compliance with policies. • Ensure timely and accurate payroll processing and pension contributions. • Manage exit processes, including conducting exit interviews and ensuring compliance with legal requirements. • Maintain HR system and assist with generating HR reports. • Promote gender diversity in all recruitment and HR practices. • Assist in developing and updating HR policies, procedures, and processes. • Handle employee grievances and support disciplinary actions as per local labor laws. • Perform other HR-related duties as required. • Oversee daily operations at Marry Joy Ethiopia’s clinic and Hospital. • Develop and implement operational and Human resource policies and procedures. • Coordinate with medical staff and department heads. • Properly Manage and conduct regular follow up for hospitals resource. • Ensure regulatory compliance and accreditation. • Lead operational and HR quality improvement initiatives. • Optimize patient flow processes by coordinating non-clinical staffs and communicating with medical director. • Follow the Maintenance of facility infrastructure and develop, implement a preventive Maintenance SOP. • Develop emergency response plans. • Foster relationships with external stakeholders. • Perform any responsibility given by manager Qualifications Educational Requirements: - • University Degree/College in Management, Business Administration, or related. Preferred experience & skills: • 2 years of relevant experience for postgraduates, 4 years of experience for degree holders. • Experience in facilitating and providing training/orientations is preferable. • Similar experience in Private or Government Hospital is preferable. • Able to perform in stressful situation • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. • Computer literate, especially in PowerPoint, MS Word and MS excel. • Excellent in English and Amharic both speaking & writing. submit your CV along with motivational letter: Job Address Addis ababa

title: Accountant
description:
• We are seeking a Senior Accountant to oversee financial operations, ensure compliance with accounting standards, and support strategic financial decision-making. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience in financial reporting.
#### Key Responsibilities: - Prepare and analyze financial statements, balance sheets, and profit & loss reports. - Monthly and annual report. - Manage tax payments and ensure compliance with financial regulations. - Conduct internal audits and identify discrepancies in financial records. - Develop and maintain budgets, forecasting costs and revenues. - Monitor financial transactions and ensure accurate bookkeeping. - Provide financial insights to management for strategic decision-making. - Ensure proper documentation and filing of financial records. #### Qualifications & Skills: - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. - Proven experience in accounting and financial management. - Strong knowledge of tax laws, financial regulations, and auditing procedures. - Proficiency in accounting software and financial reporting tools. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities. Core Responsibilities:
  • Record Keeping and Data Entry:
  • Accurately recording all financial transactions, including purchases, sales, receipts, and payments.
Financial Statement Preparation:
  • Creating and maintaining balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and other financial reports.
Account Reconciliation:
  • Comparing and verifying financial records with bank statements and other sources to identify and resolve discrepancies.
Tax Preparation and Compliance:
  • Ensuring accurate and timely tax filings and compliance with relevant tax laws and regulations.
Budgeting and Forecasting:
  • Assisting in the development of budgets and financial forecasts to guide financial planning and decision-making.
Auditing:
  • Participating in or conducting internal and external audits to verify the accuracy and integrity of financial records.
Financial Analysis:
  • Analyzing financial data to identify trends, patterns, and potential areas for improvement or risk.
Reporting:
  • Presenting financial information to management, stakeholders, and other relevant parties.
Key Skills and Qualifications:
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: Essential for identifying and resolving financial discrepancies and making informed decisions.
  • Attention to detail: Critical for ensuring the accuracy of financial records and reports.
  • Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel: Necessary for managing financial data and preparing reports.
  • Knowledge of accounting principles and regulations: Essential for ensuring compliance and accuracy.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills: Needed for collaborating with colleagues, presenting financial information, and interacting with stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related field: Often required, with some positions
Job Address kara kotebe

  • ልዩ ትምርታዊ ልምዶችን ስለማቅረብና ማካፈል ተግባር፣ ጠንካራና የሚታመን ፍላጎት ያላቸውን ምምህራን የበለጠ ተመራጭነት የሚኖራቸው ሲሆን፤ በተማሩት ትምርት(መስክ) ዙሪያ ጠንካራ የእውቀት መሠረት ያላቸውና የተማሪዎችን የተሳትፎ ደረጃ ከፍ ማድረግ የሚችሉ።
አስተማሪዎች ከሚያገኙት ጥቅሞች መካከል፡-
  •    ከፍተኛ የጥራት ደረጃ ያላቸው የ'ፕሮዳክሽን መገልገያዎች፣ እስቱዲዮ፣ እና ባለሙያዎች በመጠቀም የማስተማር ተግባርዎንና ሂደቱን በሚያሳልጡ መንገዶች የተዘጋጁትን የኛን መገልገያዎች ተጠቅመዉ በአመርቂ ሁኔታ ክህሎቶን ማውጣት ይችላሉ።

  •      ቀጣይነት ያለው(Passive Income) ገቢ የማግኘት ዕድል ይፈጥራሉ፡፡
  •        በቦታና ርቀት ሳይገደቡ ከአገር ውስጥ አልፎ በመላው ዓለም ለሚገኙ ሙያዉን ለሚፈልጉ ማደረስ የሚችሉበት ሁኔታዎችን መፍጠር፡፡

title: Recruiter
description:
Job Description
  • We are seeking a results-driven Recruiter to join our team and play a pivotal role in identifying, attracting, and onboarding top talent for our clients.
  • The recruiter will manage the full recruitment lifecycle to ensure a smooth, efficient hiring process for our clients. This role requires a proactive, sales-oriented individual with a keen eye for talent and a passion for building strong professional networks.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop and post job advertisements on various platforms to attract top talent.
  • Source and screen candidates, ensuring alignment with job requirements and company culture.
  • Conduct interviews, assess qualifications, and coordinate with hiring managers to make informed hiring decisions.
  • Maintain strong candidate relationships to ensure a positive experience throughout the hiring process.
  • Collaborate with hiring managers to understand staffing needs and develop tailored recruitment strategies.
  • Facilitate and document reference checks, offer negotiations, and onboarding processes.
  • Maintain recruitment records and ensure compliance with local labor laws and company policies.--
Qualifications:
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience: 0 to 2 years in recruitment or HR.
Skills:
  • Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Proactive and results-oriented approach.
  • Proven ability to source candidates using social media platforms and professional networks.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Amharic and English preferred.
  • Familiarity with recruitment tools and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
Why Join Us:
  • Be part of a team committed to excellence, innovation, and fostering inclusive workplaces.
  • Opportunity to work with international clients and industry leaders.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and career development opportunities.

title: ሱፐርቫይዘር
description:
• ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እና ማማከር ነው፡፡
  • Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMS ፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት ያለው ድርጅታችን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያለው እና ልምድ ያለው አጠቃላይ ተቆጣጣሪ/የዋና አስተዳዳሪ እየፈለግን ነው።
  • ሱፐር ቡስት አፕ የኢትዮጵያን ተቋማት፣ ቢዝነሶች፣ ግለሰቦች፣ ትምህርት ቤቶችን በዲጂታል መንገድ ለማብቃት እና በዲጂታል መንገድ እንዲያድጉ ለመርዳት የተቋቋመ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ ነው።
  • የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ - economic, marketing, Management, business Administration and other related field
  የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ እንቅስቃሴ ያቅዳል፣ ያደራጃል፣ ይመራል፣ ይቆጣጠራል።   ድርጅቱ ትርፋማ እንዲሆን የሚያስችሉ ፖሊሲዎችንና ስትራቴጂዎችን ነድፎ ይሰራል።   የድርጅቱን የአጭርና የረዥም ጊዜ አላማ ከግብ ለማድረስ የድርጅቱ የሰው ሃይልና የሰው ሃይል በማቀድ፣ በማደራጀት፣ በመምራትና በመቆጣጠር ይሰራል።   LMS ፕላትፎርም የሚሆኑ ፕሮዳክሽን ስራ እንዲሰራ ያደርጋል   አዳዲስ ተቀጣሪዎች ምልመላ፣ ስልጠናና ቅጥር ማከናወን፡፡   እያንዳንዱ ስራ እና ንዑስ የስራ ሂደት በተገቢው ሁኔታ እየሄደ እንደሆነና የታለመለትን ግብ ሊያሳካ ስለመቻሉ ክትትል ማድረግ...   ሁሉንም የስራ ሂደቶች መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀት፡፡   የእያንዳንዱን የስራተኞች ስራ ክንውን መከተታተል ፡፡   የድርጅቱን የፋይናንስ ፣ የማርኬቲንግ እያንዳንዱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡   ከፋይናንስ እና አካውንቲንግ ጋር በተያያዘ ያለውን ስራ በእራስም ሆነ ከሚመለከተው ባለሙያ ጋር ሆኖ የየወቅቱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡   በጀት መመደብና ወጪ መቀነስ   ፖሊሲ ማርቀቅና እና አተገባበሩንም መተለም   የሰራተኞችን የስራ አቅምና ባህል እንዲጎለብት መርዳት   ሁሉም የፋይናንስ እንቅስቃሴዎች በታለመላቸው መልኩ እየሄዱ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ክትትል ማድረግ   የድርጅቱን ግብርና ቀረጥ መሰል ክፍያዎች በጊዜው መክፈል ወይም እንዲከፈል ማድረግ   የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን ጊዜውን ጠብቀው ማውጣት ደሞዝ፤ 13000 አድራሻ፡- ከመካኒሳ ወደጀርመን በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ

title: Hotel manager
description: As the Hotel Manager, you will be responsible for the efficient and effective management of our hotel property and facilities. You will oversee various aspects of operations, including building maintenance, staff management, budgeting, and guest satisfaction.  Your role will be instrumental in maintaining high standards of service and ensuring the smooth functioning of all hotel operations. Responsibilities: Lead and manage the facilities and building operations, including maintenance, security, and cleanliness. Develop and implement strategies to optimize building performance and operational efficiency. Supervise a diverse team of staff members, providing guidance, training, and support as needed. Collaborate with various departments to ensure smooth coordination of activities and services. Coordinate with maintenance staff and contractors to ensure timely repairs and maintenance work. Conduct regular inspections to ensure the quality of services provided. Coordinate and oversee the safe and secure operations and maintenance of the facilities in a cost effective manner aimed at long-term preservation of the asset value of the building. Foster a positive work environment that encourages teamwork, communication, and professional growth among staff members. Monitor and manage hotel inventory, including supplies, equipment, and guest amenities. Identify key drivers of revenue and cost to the building and perform profitability analysis with the view to recommending ways of cost minimization and profit maximization. Analyze financial reports and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement strategies to maximize profitability. Negotiate contracts with vendors and suppliers to secure favorable terms and pricing. Maintain a high level of guest satisfaction by addressing guest concerns and resolving issues in a timely and professional manner. Qualifications: A bachelor's degree in any field of study. Proven experience in hotel management or a similar role, with a minimum of 5 years of  managerial experience. Strong leadership and interpersonal skills. Excellent communication and customer service skills. Proficiency in budgeting and financial management. Knowledge of building maintenance and safety regulations. Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed. Send your cv on telegram

title: Senior Vue + Ionic Mobile App Developer
description:
Job Overview
  • We are seeking a Senior Mobile App Developer to lead the transformation of an existing Vue.js web application into a high-quality, fully functional mobile app for both iOS and Android platforms. The ideal candidate has deep experience in Ionic Vue, Capacitor, and native mobile integrations, especially around push notifications, authentication, and native performance optimizations.
Key Responsibilities

Integrate push notification services (Firebase Cloud Messaging or OneSignal) with full support for token-based registration, user segmentation, and real-time delivery. Implement and test platform-specific features (camera, storage, offline support, etc.). Manage platform setup and configuration for both Android and iOS, including provisioning profiles, keystore management, and store submissions. Collaborate with UI/UX designers and backend developers to ensure seamless integration and consistency across platforms. Ensure app quality through automated testing, debugging, and performance optimization. Required Skills and Experience
  • 5+ years of professional development experience Proven expertise with Vue.js and Ionic Vue Strong experience with Capacitor and native plugins (iOS & Android) Hands-on experience integrating push notifications using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) or OneSignal Solid understanding of mobile security best practices, including secure storage, authentication flows, and permissions Experience deploying apps to the App Store and Google Play Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for mobile Excellent problem-solving and communication skills Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Messaging) or similar backend services Experience with native mobile languages (Swift, Kotlin) is a plus Knowledge of accessibility and responsive design for mobile platforms
