title: Digital Marketing Manager
description: Digital Marketing Manager Vacancy About Us Golden Sales and Marketing is one of Ethiopia’s leading institutions in training, consultancy, and outsourcing services for sales and marketing. We empower individuals and businesses to grow and thrive through practical, result-oriented strategies. Position Summary We are seeking a creative and results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to take full ownership of our digital presence. The ideal candidate will lead the development and execution of our digital marketing strategies and online campaigns. Strong graphic design skills are highly appreciated as we aim to maintain high visual standards across all our platforms. Key Responsibilities • Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across various channels. • Manage all company social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, etc.). • Design visually appealing graphics, promotional banners, and content using tools like Canva or Adobe Suite. • Oversee SEO, SEM, and paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads, etc.). • Analyze campaign performance and provide monthly reports with actionable insights. • Collaborate with in-house teams to align campaigns with training, consultancy, and outsourcing goals. • Stay current with the latest digital marketing tools, trends, and best practices. Required Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communication, or a related field. • Minimum 3 years of proven experience in digital marketing. • Strong knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, email marketing, and analytics tools. • Graphics design skills using tools like Canva, Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator are highly appreciated. • Experience with content creation, social media strategy, and video tools (CapCut, Premiere Pro) is a plus. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • A creative thinker with a keen eye for detail and branding. What We Offer • Attractive base salary with performance incentives. • Supportive and professional working environment. • Career advancement opportunities with training and development support. Job Address Bole Medhanyalem

description: Main Role and Responsibilities: * Serve as the licensed professional in charge of the pharmacy, ensuring compliance with all regulations from the Ethiopian Food and Drug Authority (EFDA). * Supervise the dispensing of medications with accuracy, safety, and provide proper patient counseling. * Oversee daily pharmacy operations, including inventory management, staff coordination, and reporting. * Ensure proper storage and handling of pharmaceuticals according to legal and safety standards. * Provide professional guidance and support to customers and respond to medication-related inquiries. * Collaborate with the pharmacy owner to support business growth while maintaining ethical and professional standards. * Maintain and renew all necessary legal documentation, including pharmacy license renewals and inspections. * Stay updated on medical guidelines and pharmaceutical best practices. title: Senior ERP Implementer
description:
• The Senior ERP Implementer oversees the deployment and execution of ERP solutions, ensuring they align with client needs and organizational objectives. This role is responsible for managing project timelines, configuring ERP systems, and providing end-to-end support—serving as a key connection between clients, development teams, and stakeholders. Success in this position requires strong project management, technical capability, and excellent communication skills.
Key Responsibilities
  • Client Engagement
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during ERP implementation. Gather, document, and analyze business requirements, processes, and goals. Conduct gap analyses and define system requirements and workflows. Communicate project updates and progress reports to clients and stakeholders.
System Configuration
  • Configure ERP modules to align with specific client needs.
  • Customize workflows, forms, reports, and dashboards.
  • Develop data templates and oversee the data migration process, including validation and cleanup.
  • Collaboration with Development Team
  • Translate business and functional requirements into technical specifications.
  • Coordinate with developers to ensure system integration and required customizations.
  • Test developed features and provide structured feedback for improvements.
Training and Support
  • Design and deliver training sessions for end-users and internal teams.
  • Provide post-implementation support and guidance to users and new team members.
  • Ensure effective product usage and adoption through clear instruction and documentation.
Project Management
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and monitor project plans.
  • Ensure deliverables are completed on time and within budget.
  • Recommend strategies to optimize delivery, increase satisfaction, and reduce implementation risk
.Issue Resolution
  • Identify and resolve technical or functional issues across ERP modules.
  • Perform regular system audits and troubleshoot configuration or data-related problems.
  • Implement corrective actions and continuous improvement strategies.
Documentation and Reporting
  • Maintain detailed documentation including process designs, user manuals, and system configurations.
  • Generate and present reports on project metrics and post-implementation performance.
Continuous Improvement
  • Contribute to the standardization of ERP implementations across sectors.
  • Identify and implement process enhancements and best practices.
  • Stay informed on ERP product updates, new features, and industry trends.About You
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Related Fields.
  • 4–6 years of experience in software development and ERP implementation.
  • Advanced understanding of ERP systems, including module interdependencies and integration.
  • Proficiency in data migration, ETL design, and maintaining data integrity.
  • Strong command of SQL, ERP reporting tools, and overall system architecture.
  • Proven ability to identify functional gaps and design effective workarounds.
  • Skilled in customizing ERP modules to meet unique and complex business scenarios.
Required Skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication
  • Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Excel, Access, Publisher, Outlook, PowerPoint
  • Critical thinking and analytical skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Creative and structured problem-solving Job Address Sarbet, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, Elilita Building 3rd Floor

Please explain your software experience and your certifications that make you an experienced solutions architect We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Solutions Architect to design and oversee the architecture of a scalable, secure, and high-performance money lending website. This role requires deep expertise in system design, cloud infrastructure, API integrations, and security best practices in fintech. You will work closely with engineering teams to define technical roadmaps, optimize system performance, and ensure compliance with industry regulations. Key Responsibilities: Design and develop the end-to-end architecture for a money lending platform, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability. Define technical strategies and best practices for frontend, backend, databases, and third-party integrations. Lead the selection and implementation of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and DevOps pipelines (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.). Establish and enforce security protocols to protect sensitive financial data, ensuring compliance with financial regulations (PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc.). Design robust API ecosystems, enabling seamless integration with payment gateways (Stripe, Plaid, PayPal), credit scoring systems, and identity verification services. Collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and business stakeholders to align technology solutions with business goals. Optimize system performance, ensuring fast transaction processing, high data integrity, and failover mechanisms. Oversee database architecture (SQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.), ensuring efficient data storage and retrieval. Stay updated with emerging fintech trends, AI-driven risk assessment, and blockchain-based lending models .Requirements:
  • 8+ years of experience in software architecture, system design, or solutions architecture. Proven experience designing financial, lending, or fintech applications with high-security requirements. Strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) and serverless architectures. Deep understanding of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and API management. Knowledge of data encryption, fraud prevention, identity verification (KYC/AML), and compliance frameworks. Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, or Go. Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). Familiarity with machine learning for risk analysis and fraud detection is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills, leadership abilities, and stakeholder communication.
Preferred Qualifications:

title: Market Researcher for BYD Auto Spare Parts
description:
About the Role:
  • We are looking for a field-based Market Researcher in Addis Ababa to conduct focused research on electric vehicle (EV) spare parts, with a strong emphasis on BYD models and other popular EV brands in Ethiopia. You will be responsible for visiting auto garages, EV service centers, and spare part dealers to gather real-world data on the most in-demand spare parts, sourcing details, and supplier information.
Your Main Responsibilities:
  • Visit BYD-authorized centers, independent EV service providers, and local spare parts shops across Addis Ababa. Identify and record the most frequently requested EV spare parts for:
  • BYD models (Seagull, Yuan Plus, Song Plus, Tang, Dolphin, etc.) Other popular EV brands Collect and document the following for each site visited:
  • Business Name & Location Phone Number / WhatsApp Contact Top EV Parts Requested (e.g., battery cells, inverters, BMS units, EV brake systems, infotainment screens, headlamps, door handles, windshield components, suspension systems, etc.) Which model(s) does each part apply to Part availability issues / common stockouts Prices or price ranges (when available) Whether parts are genuine, aftermarket, or imported Interview technicians to understand which EV parts are hardest to find or most urgently needed. Keep detailed notes of where the data came from (e.g., shop name, location, mechanic, or staff member). Provide a comprehensive report of your findings, ideally in Excel or Google Sheets format, including photo evidence if possible.
Qualifications:
  • Reside in Addis Ababa and have excellent knowledge of the city’s auto and EV networks. Able to move around easily (walking, ride-hailing, or personal motorbike/car). Organized, detail-oriented, and able to track large volumes of real-world data accurately. Strong communication skills – must be comfortable speaking with shop owners and technicians. Familiarity with EV technology or auto parts is a strong plus, but training will be provided if needed.
What We Offer:
  • Attractive pay based on the number and quality of verified data points collected. Bonus for identifying new or exclusive suppliers and high-demand items. Opportunity for long-term projects in EV sourcing, parts import, or auto dealership support.

title: Garment quality control
description:
ሸማቾችን ከመድረሱ በፊት ልብሶች የተገለጹትን መስፈርቶች የሚያሟሉ መሆናቸውን ለማረጋገጥ ስልታዊ ሂደት

የቁሳቁስ ቁጥጥር;

የጨርቅ ጉድለቶች, የቀለም ወጥነት እና የቁሳቁስ መመዘኛዎች መፈተሽ.

የስራ አፈጻጸም ግምገማ፡-

የስፌት ጥራት፣ የስፌት ግንባታ እና እንደ አዝራሮች እና ዚፐሮች ያሉ መለዋወጫዎችን በትክክል መያያዝን መገምገም።

የልኬት ትክክለኛነት፡

ልብሶች ከተወሰኑ መጠኖች እና መጠኖች ጋር እንደሚጣጣሙ ማረጋገጥ.

የመለያ ማረጋገጫ፡

መለያዎች ትክክለኛ፣ በትክክል የተያያዙ እና ሁሉንም ተዛማጅ ደንቦች የሚያሟሉ መሆናቸውን ማረጋገጥ።

የመጨረሻ ምርመራ፡-

የተጠናቀቀውን ልብስ ከማጓጓዣዎ በፊት ጉድለቶችን ወይም አለመጣጣሞችን በጥንቃቄ መመርመር.

በመሞከር ላይ፡

ጥንካሬን እና ደህንነትን ለማረጋገጥ እንደ የፍተሻ ሙከራዎች፣ የስፌት መንሸራተት ሙከራዎች እና የመርፌ ፈልጎ ማግኘትን የመሳሰሉ አካላዊ ሙከራዎችን ማድረግ።

title: Marketing manager
description:
Job Title: Social Media and Marketing Manager - Ride-Hailing Company Role Summary:
  • As the Social Media and Marketing Manager for our ride-hailing company, you will lead the development and execution of social media and marketing strategies to enhance brand awareness, engage customers, and drive user acquisition and retention. You will leverage various digital channels to promote our services, increase customer engagement, and establish our brand as a leader in the ride-hailing industry.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Social Media Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive social media strategies aligned with the company's marketing objectives, target audience demographics, and brand positioning in the ride-hailing sector.
  • Content Creation and Management: Oversee the creation, curation, and publishing of engaging content across social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok, to showcase our services, promotions, and brand values.
  • Campaign Planning and Execution: Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital channels, including social media, email marketing, influencer partnerships, and paid advertising, to drive user acquisition, increase app downloads, and promote rider loyalty programs.
  • Customer Engagement: Engage with customers and followers on social media platforms by responding to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely and professional manner, and fostering a positive and interactive online community.
  • Brand Awareness and Reputation Management: Monitor social media channels for brand mentions, customer feedback, and industry trends, and proactively address any issues or concerns to maintain a positive brand reputation and customer satisfaction.
  • Performance Analysis: Utilize social media analytics tools and marketing metrics to track, measure, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), such as engagement rate, reach, conversion rate, and return on ad spend (ROAS), and use insights to optimize campaigns and content strategies.
  • Partnership Development: Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships with local businesses, influencers, events, and community organizations to expand brand reach, drive user acquisition, and enhance brand visibility in key markets.
  • User-generated Content (UGC): Encourage and facilitate the creation of user-generated content, such as rider testimonials, photos, and videos, and leverage UGC to amplify brand messaging and enhance authenticity and credibility.
  • Rider Incentive Programs: Develop and execute creative promotional campaigns and rider incentive programs to incentivize usage, increase rider loyalty, and drive repeat business, collaborating closely with the operations team to ensure seamless execution.
  • Market Research and Trend Analysis: Stay informed about market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments in the ride-hailing and transportation sectors, and incorporate insights into marketing strategies and tactics to maintain a competitive edge.
Qualifications: Job Address Golagol

title: Accountant
description:
• We are seeking a Senior Accountant to oversee financial operations, ensure compliance with accounting standards, and support strategic financial decision-making. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience in financial reporting.
#### Key Responsibilities: - Prepare and analyze financial statements, balance sheets, and profit & loss reports. - Monthly and annual report. - Manage tax payments and ensure compliance with financial regulations. - Conduct internal audits and identify discrepancies in financial records. - Develop and maintain budgets, forecasting costs and revenues. - Monitor financial transactions and ensure accurate bookkeeping. - Provide financial insights to management for strategic decision-making. - Ensure proper documentation and filing of financial records. #### Qualifications & Skills: - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. - Proven experience in accounting and financial management. - Strong knowledge of tax laws, financial regulations, and auditing procedures. - Proficiency in accounting software and financial reporting tools. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities. Core Responsibilities: Record Keeping and Data Entry:
  • Accurately recording all financial transactions, including purchases, sales, receipts, and payments.
Financial Statement Preparation:
  • Creating and maintaining balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and other financial reports.
Account Reconciliation:
  • Comparing and verifying financial records with bank statements and other sources to identify and resolve discrepancies.
Tax Preparation and Compliance:
  • Ensuring accurate and timely tax filings and compliance with relevant tax laws and regulations.
Budgeting and Forecasting:
  • Assisting in the development of budgets and financial forecasts to guide financial planning and decision-making.
Auditing:
  • Participating in or conducting internal and external audits to verify the accuracy and integrity of financial records.
Financial Analysis:
  • Analyzing financial data to identify trends, patterns, and potential areas for improvement or risk.
Reporting:
  • Presenting financial information to management, stakeholders, and other relevant parties.
Key Skills and Qualifications:
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: Essential for identifying and resolving financial discrepancies and making informed decisions.
  • Attention to detail: Critical for ensuring the accuracy of financial records and reports.
  • Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel: Necessary for managing financial data and preparing reports.
  • Knowledge of accounting principles and regulations: Essential for ensuring compliance and accuracy.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills: Needed for collaborating with colleagues, presenting financial information, and interacting with stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related field: Often required, with some positions
Job Address kara kotebe

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
Position Summary:
  •  The Accounts Receivable Specialist is a critical role responsible for ensuring the timely collection of client payments, maintaining accurate financial records, and fostering positive client relationships through proactive communication and effective agreement management. This individual will be instrumental in maintaining healthy cash flow and supporting the financial stability of the company.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Client Payment Management & Follow-up:
  • Proactively monitor accounts to identify outstanding invoices and upcoming payment due dates. Initiate timely and professional communication with clients via email, phone, and other channels to follow up on overdue payments. Address client inquiries regarding invoices, payment terms, and account statuses. Resolve payment discrepancies and issues in a timely and courteous manner, coordinating with other departments (e.g., Sales, Operations) as needed. Implement and manage a systematic follow-up process to ensure consistent engagement with clients.
Payment Preparation & Processing:
  • Prepare and issue accurate invoices to clients in accordance with agreed-upon terms. Process incoming payments (e.g., bank transfers, checks, mobile money) and accurately apply them to client accounts. Perform daily reconciliation of accounts receivable to ensure all payments are recorded correctly. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly accounts receivable reports for management
Agreement Management & Compliance:
  • Understand and interpret payment terms and conditions outlined in client agreements/contracts. Ensure billing and payment processes align with contractual obligations. Track and manage agreement renewal dates or specific payment milestones where relevant. Assist in documenting and organizing client agreements related to payment schedules.
Reporting & Analysis:
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client payment records and aging reports. Identify and report on potential bad debts or high-risk accounts. Contribute to cash flow forecasting by providing accurate collection projections.
Customer Service & Relationship Building:
  • Act as a primary point of contact for client payment-related queries. Build and maintain positive, professional relationships with clients to facilitate smooth payment processes. Represent the company professionally and courteously in all client interactions.
Qualifications:
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. Relevant certifications are a plus.
Experience:
  • Minimum of [e.g., 2-3] years of experience in an Accounts Receivable, Billing, or Collections role. Proven experience in client communication and follow-up. Experience with agreement or contract management related to payment terms is a strong advantage.
Skills:
  • Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, SAP B1) and ERP systems. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (spreadsheets, formulas, data analysis). Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and persuasive demeanor. Fluency in English is a prerequisite for this role. Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. High level of integrity and confidentiality when handling financial information.Job Address Hayahulet, Around Adey Abeba Stadium

title: Senior Mobile App Developer Flutter, Firebase, Telebirr Integration
description:
Overview:
  • We are looking for a highly skilled and self-driven Senior Mobile App Developer to take full technical ownership of a new e-commerce mobile application being built for the Ethiopian market. You will be responsible for designing and developing the app from the ground up, including frontend, backend (Firebase), and integrations with payment platforms like Telebirr.
  • This is not a large team environment. We need someone who can lead development independently, make key architectural decisions, and quickly turn ideas into functional, polished features. If you have deep hands-on experience with Flutter, Firebase, and mobile payment integrations, this is your opportunity to lead the creation of a product with high local impact.
Responsibilities:
  • Lead the complete development lifecycle of a mobile e-commerce app from initial design to final deployment.
  • Design and build modern, intuitive, and responsive UI/UX using Flutter.
  • Set up and manage Firebase backend, including Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, and Notifications.
  • Integrate and manage Telebirr and other relevant local or global payment gateways.
  • Implement core e-commerce features: product catalog, shopping cart, checkout, order tracking, etc.
  • Ensure the app is optimized for performance, reliability, and scalability across Android and iOS devices.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Work closely with the project owner on defining requirements, priorities, and milestones.
  • Monitor user feedback and analytics to continuously improve the app experience.
  • Handle app store submission, updates, and ongoing technical support.
Required Skills & Experience:
  • 5+ years of hands-on mobile development experience.
  • 3+ years building apps with Flutter & Dart.
  • Proven experience using Firebase (Firestore, Functions, Auth, Messaging).
  • Experience integrating mobile payment systems, especially Telebirr.
  • Familiarity with mobile UI/UX best practices, including localization (e.g., Amharic support).
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, authentication flows, and secure data handling.
  • Ability to work independently, make architectural decisions, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and deployment to Play Store / App Store.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with React Native or hybrid app frameworks.
  • Background in e-commerce, fintech, or other transactional mobile apps.
  • Understanding of local market needs and user behavior in Ethiopia.
  • Familiarity with Cloud Functions for backend logic.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps.
What You Get:
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and performance Flexible remote work
  • Full autonomy and responsibility for your work
  • Opportunity to build and launch a major consumer app in Ethiopia
  • A fast-paced environment where your input directly shapes the product

description:
ክፍት የስራ ማስታወቂያ አጠቃላይ የእንጨት እና የብረት ሰራተኛ የስራው አይነት: - ቋሚ የስራው ቦታ: አዲስ አበባ, ኢትዮጵያ ደሞዝ/ክፍያ: ወርሃዊ የስራው መጠሪያ: አጠቃላይ የእንጨት እና የብረት ሰራተኛ የስራው ዘርፍ: #የእንጨት_ሥራ_እና_ብረት የልምድ ደረጃ: በቂ ልምድ ያለው የተፈላጊ ሰው ብዛት: 1 ስለ ኩባንያው ሰከላ ፋውንቴን እና አኳሪየም የስራው ዝርዝር: • ሁለገብ (Craft) የእንጨት ስራ፣ የብረት ስራ፣ የፋይበር ግላስ፤ የፓኔል፤ የአልሙኒየም የሚችል፣ እንዲሁም የእንጨት ስራ ማሽኖችን በብቃት መጠቀም የሚችል። • ከተለያዩ ጥሬ እቃዎች (እንጨት፣ ፌሮ፣ ኮንክሪት፣ ብረት፣ ፒቪሲ ወዘተ) ጋር መስራት የሚችል። • የተለያዩ ወጣ ያሉ ዲዛይኖች (Designs) መስራት የሚችል። • ዲዛይን (Design) ማንበብ እና በዲዛይን መሰረት መስራት የሚችል። • መሠረታዊ የኤሌክትሪክ ስርዓት ዝርጋታ (Basic Electrical Installation) ላይ ተግባብቶ መስራት የሚችል። • በእንጨት እና ብረት ስራ ላይ ጥሩ ልምድ ያለው። • በመሠረታዊ የሌክትሪክ ስርዓት ዝርጋታ ላይ ተግባብቶ መስራት የሚችል። • ተግባብቶ እና በቡድን መስራት የሚችል። • ለስራው ፍላጎት ያለው። • አዳዲስ ነገሮችን የማማር ፍላጎት ያለው። • ፈጣን እና መልካም ስነ-ምግባር ያለው። የማመልከቻ ሂደት:
  • አመልካቾች በዚህ የቴሌግራም ሊንክ ብቻ የስራ ልምድ እና ከዚህ በፊት የሰራችሁትን ስራ ፎቶ በማያያዝ መላክ ትችላላችሁ።

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Looking for a senior solutions architect for money lending website that will also become a money lending app.   Must have at least 8 years experience in software development to be considered   In your message explain why you be a good fit for this role. Please explain your software experience and your certifications that make you an experienced solutions architect  
  • We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Solutions Architect to design and oversee the architecture of a scalable, secure, and high-performance money lending website. This role requires deep expertise in system design, cloud infrastructure, API integrations, and security best practices in fintech. You will work closely with engineering teams to define technical roadmaps, optimize system performance, and ensure compliance with industry regulations.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and develop the end-to-end architecture for a money lending platform, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability. Define technical strategies and best practices for frontend, backend, databases, and third-party integrations. Lead the selection and implementation of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and DevOps pipelines (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.). Establish and enforce security protocols to protect sensitive financial data, ensuring compliance with financial regulations (PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc.). Design robust API ecosystems, enabling seamless integration with payment gateways (Stripe, Plaid, PayPal), credit scoring systems, and identity verification services. Collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and business stakeholders to align technology solutions with business goals. Optimize system performance, ensuring fast transaction processing, high data integrity, and failover mechanisms. Oversee database architecture (SQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.), ensuring efficient data storage and retrieval. Stay updated with emerging fintech trends, AI-driven risk assessment, and blockchain-based lending models.
Requirements:
  • 8+ years of experience in software architecture, system design, or solutions architecture. Proven experience designing financial, lending, or fintech applications with high-security requirements. Strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) and serverless architectures. Deep understanding of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and API management. Knowledge of data encryption, fraud prevention, identity verification (KYC/AML), and compliance frameworks. Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, or Go. Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). Familiarity with machine learning for risk analysis and fraud detection is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills, leadership abilities, and stakeholder communication.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience in financial services, lending platforms, or digital banking. Expertise in blockchain-based smart contracts for lending (optional). Background in AI-driven risk assessment and predictive modeling.
What We Offer:
  • Competitive salary & performance-based bonuses. Flexible work options (remote). Opportunity to work on an innovative fintech platform. Professional development & leadership growth opportunities.
How to Apply:
  • If you’re re a Senior Solutions Architect looking to shape the future of digital lending with cutting-edge technology, we’d love to hear from you!
  • Apply now with your resume and portfolio!

  • Design, develop, and train machine learning models in Python (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch) Build and maintain data pipelines for feature extraction and model training Optimize model performance, scalability, and inference speed Implement RESTful APIs (FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST Framework) to serve AI models Collaborate remotely with our product and engineering teams on requirements and integration ======================
Requirements

Command-Line Script: A Python script (predict.py) that takes a review text as input (e.g. python predict.py "I loved this movie!") and prints out “positive” or “negative” plus a confidence score.
README:

title: Workshop Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Workshop Manager to oversee our workshop operations specializing in furnitures mostly chairs and tables. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, leadership abilities, and a commitment to ensuring high-quality production while meeting project deadlines. Key Responsibilities 1. Workshop Operations Management
  • Oversee daily operations of the workshop, ensuring smooth and efficient workflow.
  • Plan, organize, and prioritize production schedules based on project requirements and deadlines.
  • Allocate tasks and manage resources (materials, tools, and personnel) effectively to optimize productivity.
  • Ensure adherence to quality standards for all products
2. Team Leadership and Supervision
  • Supervise a team of craftsmen, carpenters, designers, and other workshop staff.
  • Provide guidance, training, and mentoring to ensure staff development and skill enhancement.Conduct regular performance evaluations and address any team-related issues or conflicts.
3. Quality Control
  • Implement and maintain strict quality control processes to ensure all products meet company standards and client expectations.
  • Conduct regular inspections of materials, tools, and finished products to ensure durability and precision.
4. Inventory and Resource Management
  • Monitor inventory levels of raw materials (wood, upholstery, hardware, etc.) and tools to avoid shortages or delays.
  • Coordinate procurement of materials and equipment in collaboration with the purchasing department.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and clean workshop environment.
5. Budget and Cost Control
  • Prepare and manage the workshop budget, ensuring cost-efficiency without compromising quality.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction through improved processes, waste management, and resource utilization.
Qualifications and Requirements
  • Experience: Minimum of 6 years in furniture manufacturing, woodworking, or related industries, with at least 4 years in a managerial role.
  • Education: A degree or diploma in woodworking, furniture design, interior design, or a related technical field is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of furniture manufacturing techniques, materials, and tools.
  • Proven ability to manage a team and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Knowledge of health and safety regulations related to workshop environments.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with internal teams and clients.
Key Competencies
  • Leadership and team management.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Technical expertise in woodworking and furniture production.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Benefit
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment Job Address Kara (kotebe)

  • We are looking for a highly skilled and self-driven Senior Mobile App Developer to take full technical ownership of a new e-commerce mobile application being built for the Ethiopian market. Experience with version control (Git) and deployment to Play Store / App Store.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with React Native or hybrid app frameworks. Background in e-commerce, fintech, or other transactional mobile apps. Understanding of local market needs and user behavior in Ethiopia. Familiarity with Cloud Functions for backend logic. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps. What You Get:

title: Workshop Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Workshop Manager to oversee our workshop operations specializing in furnitures mostly chairs and tables. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, leadership abilities, and a commitment to ensuring high-quality production while meeting project deadlines. Key Responsibilities
  1.  Workshop Operations Management
  2. Oversee daily operations of the workshop, ensuring smooth and efficient workflow.
  3. Plan, organize, and prioritize production schedules based on project requirements and deadlines.
  4. Allocate tasks and manage resources (materials, tools, and personnel) effectively to optimize productivity.
  5. Ensure adherence to quality standards for all products
2. Team Leadership and Supervision
  • Supervise a team of craftsmen, carpenters, designers, and other workshop staff.
  • Provide guidance, training, and mentoring to ensure staff development and skill enhancement.
  • Conduct regular performance evaluations and address any team-related issues or conflicts.
3. Quality Control
  • Implement and maintain strict quality control processes to ensure all products meet company standards and client expectations.
  • Conduct regular inspections of materials, tools, and finished products to ensure durability and precision.
4. Inventory and Resource Management
  • Monitor inventory levels of raw materials (wood, upholstery, hardware, etc.) and tools to avoid shortages or delays.
  • Coordinate procurement of materials and equipment in collaboration with the purchasing department.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and clean workshop environment.
5. Budget and Cost Control
  • Prepare and manage the workshop budget, ensuring cost-efficiency without compromising quality.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction through improved processes, waste management, and resource utilization.
Qualifications and Requirements
  • Experience: Minimum of 6 years in furniture manufacturing, woodworking, or related industries, with at least 4 years in a managerial role.
  • Education: A degree or diploma in woodworking, furniture design, interior design, or a related technical field is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of furniture manufacturing techniques, materials, and tools.
  • Proven ability to manage a team and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Knowledge of health and safety regulations related to workshop environments.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with internal teams and clients.
Key Competencies
  • Leadership and team management.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Technical expertise in woodworking and furniture production.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Benefit
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment Job Address Kara (kotebe)

• We are looking for a proactive communicator who collaborates effectively across design, backend, and QA teams; someone who takes ownership of features from concept through release and maintenance; a curious problem-solver who stays up to date with Flutter best practices and emerging tools; an advocate for code quality who writes clear documentation and thorough tests; and a self-starter who can work independently while thriving in a supportive team environment.
About Us
  • We’re an established leader in the [industry/sector, e.g. “health-tech”, "agri-tech"] space, committed to delivering high-quality mobile solutions at scale. Our collaborative teams leverage proven processes and cutting-edge technologies to build apps that make a real impact. If you value stability, best practices, and continuous improvement, you’ll fit right in.
Key Responsibilities
  • Architect, develop, and maintain Flutter applications with a strong focus on scalable, testable code Integrate and consume GraphQL APIs, collaborating with backend engineers to design efficient queries and mutations
  • Apply Riverpod for state management, ensuring predictable and testable application flows Implement push notifications using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
  • Write unit and widget tests to uphold app quality and prevent regressions
  • Work closely with UI/UX designers to translate mockups into pixel-perfect, responsive screens
  • Participate in code reviews, mentor junior developers, and champion best practices
  • Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and optimize the app for speed and reliability
Required Qualifications
  • 2–3 years of professional experience in Flutter app development
  • Proficiency in Dart, Flutter framework, and native integration (Android/iOS)
  • Hands-on experience integrating GraphQL clients (e.g., graphql_flutter, ferry) and designing queries/schema interactions
  • Strong command of Riverpod for state management, including providers, futures, and dependency injection
  • Experience implementing Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for push notifications
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON parsing, and local persistence solutions (e.g., Hive, SQLite)
  • Solid understanding of Git workflows and agile development processes
  • Experience writing comprehensive unit, widget, and integration tests
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Nice to Have
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Codemagic, GitHub Actions)
  • Experience with additional Firebase services (Cloud Firestore, Analytics)
  • Contribution to open-source Flutter projects
To apply:
  • Send your resume & portfolio to with the subject: Mid-Level Flutter Developer (GraphQL & Riverpod) Role.

title: Media Sales Expert (Communication & Media Sector)
description:
• We are seeking a dynamic, results-driven Media Sales Expert to join our innovative team. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with a passion for the evolving media landscape and a proven talent for driving advertising revenue. As a key member of our sales force, you will be responsible for developing and nurturing a portfolio of clients within the communication and media industry. You will leverage a deep understanding of their unique marketing and advertising needs to craft and sell compelling, multi-platform media solutions
Major Duties and Responsibilities
  • Strategic Business Development: Proactively identify, prospect, and cultivate new business opportunities with key clients, brands, and advertising agencies operating within the communication and media ecosystem.
  • Consultative Client Relationships: Build and maintain robust, long-term relationships by acting as a trusted advisor to clients, deeply understanding their brand objectives, target audience, and advertising goals.
  • Solution-Oriented Sales: Prepare and deliver persuasive, high-impact sales presentations and proposals that showcase the value of our media properties and deliver customized advertising solutions.
  • Negotiation and Deal Closure: Expertly negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms with clients to successfully close sales and achieve mutually beneficial agreements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the client's advocate by collaborating closely with internal marketing, creative, and production teams to ensure proposed advertising solutions are effective and flawlessly executed.
  • Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor and analyze market trends, audience data, competitor activities, and client feedback to adapt and refine sales strategies for maximum effectiveness.
  • Revenue Target Attainment: Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales quotas through diligent pipeline management and strategic account planning.
  • Account Management and Growth: Manage client accounts post-sale to ensure high levels of satisfaction, campaign success, and repeat business, while identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Performance Reporting: Prepare and present regular, insightful sales reports and revenue forecasts for management review.
  • Industry Ambassadorship: Represent the company with professionalism at industry events, trade shows, and networking functions to enhance our brand visibility and build a strong professional network.
Work Experience
  • A minimum of 2 years of dedicated experience in media sales, advertising sales, or business development role is required.
  • Essential Sector Experience: Demonstrable experience working directly within or selling to the communication and media sector (e.g., for a broadcaster, publisher, digital media platform, or advertising agency).
  • Proven Sales Success: A strong, verifiable track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a competitive media environment.
  • Multi-Platform Sales Expertise: Hands-on experience selling a variety of media solutions is highly preferred, including digital media (e.g., programmatic, social media, content marketing), broadcast (TV/Radio), print, or out-of-home (OOH) advertising.
Educational Qualifications
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Media Studies, Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, or a closely related field is required.
  • Additional certifications in Digital Marketing, Media Planning, or Strategic Sales will be considered a significant advantage.
Other Important Requirements & Core Competencies
  • Exceptional Communication Skills: Superior verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to build rapport and credibility with clients.
  • Masterful Negotiation Skills: Strong and persuasive negotiator with the ability to navigate complex discussions and secure favorable outcomes.
  • Independent & Collaborative: A self-starter who can work autonomously while also thriving in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Organizational Prowess: Excellent organizational and time-management skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Digital Fluency: High proficiency in the MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and a strong grasp of modern CRM platforms.
  • Resilience and Professionalism: A proactive, can-do attitude with the ability to handle rejection gracefully and maintain a professional demeanor under pressure.
  • Mobility: Willingness to travel as needed for client meetings, industry conferences, and other business-related events. Job Address Bole

title: Freelance UK Immigration Account Manager
description: Job Title: Freelance UK Immigration Account Manager Location: Remote (Computer and Good Internet Connection Required) Company: Andrew Williams Solicitors Working Hours: Full-time; 9:00 am – 5:00 pm (UK time) Monday to Friday Payment: 50,000 Birr Per Month or US Dollar Equivalent Job Overview:  We are seeking a committed and motivated UK Immigration Account Manager to join our team. This role offers the opportunity to train and progress into a Senior UK Immigration Account Manager position. Our firm, based in Leeds, UK, prides itself on maintaining a high success rates for our private, fee-paying business and individual clients. The ideal candidate will thrive both as part of a busy professional team and working independently. Strong communication, analytical, and writing skills are essential, as is the confidence to engage with clients and professionals, including those from the UK Home Office. Initially, you will work and train alongside a small team of immigration specialists, with the goal of managing your own caseload of private business and personal immigration matters and providing expert guidance to our clients. You must have the ability to meet your monthly case completion targets all while maintaining excellent customer services. About Us:  We are a small but busy firm specializing in UK Immigration Law, regulated by the Law Society and the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA). Established over 18 years ago by our Principal Solicitor, we prepare and submit various UK Immigration matters on behalf of companies and individuals and assist business clients with managing their UK immigration compliance responsibilities. Additionally, we are also involved in other business activities including legal/business technology. Key Responsibilities:  • Provide legal and administrative support to clients, team members, and external providers. • Handle client inquiries and communications professionally. • Perform administrative, compliance, and case management tasks using our in-house system. • Manage your own caseload, offering professional advice and assistance on UK immigration matters. • Draft applications, witness statements, skeleton arguments, appeal bundles, and other key documents as and when required. • Maintain professional and efficient client management, working towards monthly set financial and or case targets and deadlines. • Keep digital files organized, ensuring timely and accurate recording of payments and other critical details. • Record all case-related activities, including attendance, file notes, and telephone calls, using our Ibiab case management system. Desirable Personal Specifications:  • Ability to work effectively with and motivate team members. • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral. Qualifications and Experience:  • Preferred: 2+ Years Experience (e.g., Business Administrator, Office Manager, Lawyer, Legal Assistant). • Education: Law degree or degree in any field. • Experience in business administration, marketing or legal work, strong client care and excellent written and spoken English is required. This role offers clear career progression to Senior Account Manager, Department Manager and then Head of Department.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Job Title: Marketing Manager Reports to: Commercial Manager Business: FMCG/Food Manufacturing & Distribution Role Overview: Lovegrass Agro-Processing plc is seeking a dynamic and strategic Marketing Manager to join its leadership team. Reporting directly to the Commercial Manager, the Marketing Manager will oversee the end-to-end execution of 360° marketing activities for the full range of Lovegrass products. This includes setting brand strategy, leading integrated marketing campaigns, managing digital and social media platforms, and driving brand visibility and commercial growth. The role works closely with cross-functional teams—including sales, finance, production, and export—to ensure alignment and impact across local and international markets.--- Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement comprehensive marketing strategies that align with the company’s mission to promote teff-based products, ensuring consistency in messaging, tone, and visual identity across all platforms in line with the brand book. Plan, budget, and execute full-funnel marketing campaigns, including advertising, public relations, trade events, and promotional activities. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams (sales, production, finance, CRM) and external partners to develop campaign assets, designs, POS materials, digital content, and branded merchandise. Lead digital marketing initiatives, managing the company’s online presence including social media, websites, and e-commerce channels, using tools like Meta Business Suite to analyze and enhance digital performance. Monitor and analyze marketing performance using KPIs and analytics dashboards to optimize campaigns and improve return on investment. Coordinate product launches and trade marketing efforts in collaboration with the sales team, including promotional calendars, in-market activations, and product sampling programs. Develop brand training materials and support commercial operations by equipping teams with product knowledge, tools, and customer-facing resources. Conduct competitor benchmarking and trend analysis to ensure the brand remains agile, relevant, and aligned with evolving FMCG market dynamics. Present strategic marketing insights and recommendations to senior leadership, using data-driven reports to inform business decisions and identify opportunities for innovation or new market entry. Perform other duties as assigned by the Commercial Manager. Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, or a related field with a Minimum of 3 (Three) years of marketing experience, ideally in an FMCG sector. Direct experience in FMCG product marketing is highly preferred. Professional Experience: - Proven track record in developing campaign strategies, achieving volume targets, managing digital platforms, and supporting sales efforts across both peak and off-season cycles.
  • Strong leadership capabilities with experience in managing cross-functional teams, coaching staff, and leading effective internal and external communications. Skilled in campaign execution, digital engagement, and cross-team collaboration to drive brand visibility and commercial performance within the Ethiopian FMCG market. Key Skills & Competencies:
  • Strategic Marketing, Digital Proficiency, Creative Orientation, Analytical Skills, Communication & Languages, and Interpersonal & Leadership skills. Duty Station: Primarily at Head Office - Addis Ababa and frequent business travel to Sululta, Factory.
  • Remuneration and Compensation: Negotiable based on Qualification
  • Deadline: 10 days from the date of this announcement. Early applications are encouraged, as shortlisting may begin before the deadline.
  • How to Apply: Qualified and interested candidates are invited to send their CV and cover  addressed to the Human Resource Department. Please clearly state “Marketing Manager” in the subject line.

title: Network Protocol Analyst & Backend Developer (Node.js or Go)
description:
• We are looking for a highly skilled Backend Developer with strong experience in network protocol analysis and backend system development using Node.js or Go (Golang).
  • The ideal candidate is confident analyzing undocumented or custom network communication protocols and building robust backend systems that interface with such protocols.
Responsibilities:
  • Perform in-depth network traffic analysis using advanced tools
  • Reverse engineer undocumented APIs or custom communication protocols (HTTP, TCP, WebSocket, or other)
  • Design and implement a scalable backend system using Node.js or Go
  • Set up supporting database structures (SQL or NoSQL)
  • Ensure secure, reliable, and maintainable backend operations
  • Provide technical documentation for the developed system
Required Skills & Tools:
  • Network Analysis & Reverse Engineering:
  • Wireshark
  • Fiddler, Burp Suite, Charles Proxy
  • TCPDump
  • Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg, or similar tools
  • dnSpy
Backend Development:
  • Expertise in Node.js (Express, NestJS, or similar) OR Go (Golang)
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, UDP, WebSocket)
  • Experience working with REST APIs, WebSocket, or custom protocols
  • Database experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar
  • Solid grasp of backend security best practices
Additional Knowledge:
  • Comfort working with binary data and custom protocol formats
  • Understanding of encrypted or obfuscated network traffic (preferred)
  • Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with gRPC, Protobuf, Thrift, or binary communication formats
  • Previous work reverse engineering undocumented systems or legacy apps
  • Familiarity with reverse engineering desktop applications (optional)
  • Flexible schedule with clear deliverables
  • Strict confidentiality required
To Apply: Please share:
  • Relevant project examples related to network analysis or protocol reverse engineering
  • Your experience with Node.js or Go backend development
  • Your preferred approach to working with undocumented systemsJob Address Kazanchis

title: Accountant
description:
We are seeking a Senior Accountant to oversee financial operations, ensure compliance with accounting standards, and support strategic financial decision-making. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience in financial reporting.

#### Key Responsibilities:

- Prepare and analyze financial statements, balance sheets, and profit & loss reports.

- Monthly and annual report.

- Manage tax payments and ensure compliance with financial regulations.

- Conduct internal audits and identify discrepancies in financial records.

- Develop and maintain budgets, forecasting costs and revenues.

- Monitor financial transactions and ensure accurate bookkeeping.

- Provide financial insights to management for strategic decision-making.

- Ensure proper documentation and filing of financial records.

#### Qualifications & Skills:

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

- Proven experience in accounting and financial management.

- Strong knowledge of tax laws, financial regulations, and auditing procedures.

- Proficiency in accounting software and financial reporting tools.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.

Core Responsibilities:

Record Keeping and Data Entry:

Accurately recording all financial transactions, including purchases, sales, receipts, and payments.

Financial Statement Preparation:

Creating and maintaining balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and other financial reports.

Account Reconciliation:

Comparing and verifying financial records with bank statements and other sources to identify and resolve discrepancies.

Tax Preparation and Compliance:

Ensuring accurate and timely tax filings and compliance with relevant tax laws and regulations.

Budgeting and Forecasting:

Assisting in the development of budgets and financial forecasts to guide financial planning and decision-making.

Auditing:

Participating in or conducting internal and external audits to verify the accuracy and integrity of financial records.

Financial Analysis:

Analyzing financial data to identify trends, patterns, and potential areas for improvement or risk.

Reporting:

Presenting financial information to management, stakeholders, and other relevant parties.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: Essential for identifying and resolving financial discrepancies and making informed decisions.

Attention to detail: Critical for ensuring the accuracy of financial records and reports.

Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel: Necessary for managing financial data and preparing reports.

Knowledge of accounting principles and regulations: Essential for ensuring compliance and accuracy.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills: Needed for collaborating with colleagues, presenting financial information, and interacting with stakeholders.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related field: Often required, with some positions

title: Unity Game Development Instructor
description:
We are seeking a passionate and skilled instructor with a strong focus on game development using Unity to lead training sessions, mentor students, and supervise creative projects for our startup. You will help learners grow from complete beginners to confident creators, guiding them through hands-on experience in building games and interactive content. Your primary role will be teaching game development theory, Unity programming, and supporting students in building their own games while contributing to ongoing studio projects.

Key Responsibilities:

-Teach game development theory and practical skills using Unity (C#)

-Prepare and maintain lesson slides, teaching materials, and course content

-Guide students through building full 2D/3D games in Unity

-Mentor and teach students during live sessions and through feedback

-Review student projects, give technical and creative feedback

-Lead Unity-based workshops, game jams, or mini challenges

-Help students create polished, portfolio-ready game projects

-Work collaboratively on studio-led game and tech projects as needed

-Attend and represent the studio at game development events, university workshops, and public tech sessions

Required Skills & Qualities:

-Strong teaching and communication skills, especially in game development

-Proficiency in Unity game engine and C# programming

-Solid understanding of creative or tech fields (e.g., design, animation, or programming)

-Ability to mentor and inspire students with no prior experience

-Strong project supervision and time management skills

-Familiar with tools/software for game and creative development

-Fluent in Amharic and English

To Apply:

Send us:

1 - A CV or short bio highlighting relevant teaching and Unity experience

2 - Project portfolio or collection of game projects in unity

3 - There will be online interview if selected

Job Address
Addis Ababa

title: ERP Functional and IT Support
description:
Description:
  • We are looking for a dynamic and hands-on IT Support & Business Intelligence Associate to join our team. This role is essential in supporting day-to-day operations by ensuring smooth use of devices, ERP systems (particularly Odoo), and internal networks. The ideal candidate will also actively contribute to business intelligence efforts through data analysis and report development.
Responsibilities:
  • Provide responsive technical support to employees across departments regarding device usage, software, ERP (Odoo), Call Center(Asterisk), functionalities, and general IT issues. Actively engage in business intelligence tasks such as creating reports, analyzing data, and solving data-related challenges across departments. Support and train Odoo users; identify user challenges and bridge communication between business needs and the software development team. Maintain and monitor the company’s IT infrastructure, including networks, routers, printers, and user devices and software. Collaborate with the software development team to convey operational requirements, test features, and ensure effective implementation of tech solutions. Create system documentation and training resources (written/video) to support staff understanding and onboarding. Assist with IT procurement decisions and liaise with external IT vendors and consultants when necessary. Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Work experience of 3 or more years with a similar set of responsibilities. Solid understanding of ERP(Recommended Odoo), business operations, and workflows. Prior experience or strong interest in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence. Hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting and network management. Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to translate technical topics for non-technical staff. Strong problem-solving skills, energy, and a proactive approach to learning and discovery. Patience, discipline, and professionalism when dealing with team members. Proficiency in English. If this opportunity aligns with your interests and qualifications, we invite you to submit your application via the following no later than Job Address Bole Medhanialem Abyssinia Plaza

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
Senior Backend Engineer Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Django or Go) Location: on-site Type: Full-Time We are searching for a highly skilled and self-motivated Backend Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will be the architect of the server-side of our web applications. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable, and high-performance backend systems using either the Django (Python) or a modern Go web framework. The ideal candidate is not just a coder but a craftsperson who takes pride in their work. You must have a strong portfolio of projects that you can point to and say, "I built that. Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code and APIs using either Django or a Go web framework (e.g., Gin, Chi, Echo).
  •  Develop and manage scalable database schemas and data models (we primarily use PostgreSQL).
  •  Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
  •  Implement security and data protection best practices.
  •  Write comprehensive unit and integration tests to ensure code quality and robustness.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality features.
  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs and devise elegant solutions to these problems.
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain a high standard of code quality across the team.
Required Qualifications & Who You Are
  • This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for a candidate with proven experience and a demonstrable track record.
  • Provable Experience: You have a strong background in backend development with a portfolio of work you can share.
  • Mandatory GitHub Profile: You must provide a link to your GitHub profile. Your profile should contain personal projects, contributions to open-source software, or other code that showcases your skills. Applications without a link to a GitHub profile or a demonstrable portfolio will not be considered.
  • Framework Mastery: Deep expertise in either Django (Python) or a popular Go web framework. You should be able to discuss the trade-offs and design patterns of your chosen framework in depth.
  • Database Proficiency: Strong command of SQL and experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or MySQL.
  • API Design: A solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and best practices. Experience with GraphQL is a plus.
  • Testing: A firm belief in the importance of testing. You have experience with unit testing frameworks (e.g., pytest for Python, Go's native testing package).
  • Problem Solver: You are a pragmatic and analytical thinker who is passionate about solving complex technical challenges.
Nice-to-Have Qualifications
  •   Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes.
  •  Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
  •   Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  •  Knowledge of caching strategies and tools (Redis, Memcached).
  •  * Contributions to open-source projects.
Job Address Addis Ababa around Gazebo roundabout

title: Project coordinator
description:

የስራ ልምድ                   ቢያንስ ሁለት አመት በማርኪቲንግ ወይም በአስተባባሪነት የሰራ
ተጠሪነቱ  ፡                   ለስራ አመራር ቦርድ
የስራ ቦታ፤                 ወሎ ሰፈር መስጊድ ጀርባ ፈቃደ ህንፃ አንደኛ ፎቅ
የስራ ዝርዝር
1. የልማት ስራዉ ላይ ጥብቅ ግንዛቤ በመያዝ የአካባቢዉን አልሚ ሆነ ባለድራሻ አካላት ቤት ለቤት በመሄድና በስልክ ግንዛቤ ስራ መስራት ፤፤ በዚህም አባላት በስራዉ ላይ እምነት እንዲያድርባቸዉ ማድረግ፤፤
2. መዋጮ በወቅቱ እንዲሰበሰብ ማድረግ
3. በተደጋጋሚ ቅስቀሳ መዋጮ ግዴታ ያልተወጣ አልሚ የሽንት ቤትና የዝናብ ፍሳሽ መስመር የማይገናኘለት መሆኑን የማስጠንቀቂያ ደብዳቤ አስፈርሞ መስጠት
4. ከላይ የተጠቀሱትን ሁሉ ተላልፎ የተገኘ የልማት ተባባሪ አለመሆን ስለሚቆጠር ይህንንም ለክ/ከተማዉ የስም ዝርዝር ማስተላለፍ፤፤
5. የተሰበሰበዉን /ያልተሰበሰበዉን/በግዜ ገደብ ቃል የተገባዉን/ ቃል ተገብቶ ግዴታ ያልፈጸመዉን  ስም ዝርዝርና የገንዘብ መጠን በየሳምንቱ ዝርዝር ሪፖርት ማድረግ፤፤
6. በባንክ የሚገኝ ገንዘብ መጠን መከታተል ወቅታዊ ሪፖርት ማድረስ፤፤ ክፍያዎች በሚኖሩበት ሰአት የክፍያ ሰነድ አዘጋጅቶ ፈራሚዎች እንዲፈሩሙ ማድረግና ክፍያ መፈፀም፤፤
7. በማህበሩ የሚሰበሰበዉን የገቢ ደረሰኝ መስጠት፤ ወጪ የሚደረገዉን የወጪ ደረሰኝ ማዘጋጀት እና ፋይል መያዝ፤
8. የማህበሩን ቃለ ጉባዬና የሂሳብ ሰነድ መያዝ ማደራጀትና መሰነድ
9. ማህበሩንና ኮሚቴዎችን ለዉይይትና ለዉሳኔ እንዳስፈላጊነቱ እንዲገኙ ማስተባበር፤፤ ዉሳኔዎች አስወስኖ በቃለ ጉባዬ መያዝ
10. ማህበሩን ወክሎ ከቂርቆስ ከ/ከተማ ፣ ከወረዳዉ፤ ከመንገዶች ባለስልጣን ከዉሀና ፍሳሽ ባለስልጣንና ከሌሎችም ባለድረሻ አካላት ጋር ጉዳይ ማስፈጸም
11. እንዳስፈላጊነቱ ፕሮጀክቱ የግንባታ ስራዎች በሚጀምርበት ሰአት ጨረታ ማጫረት ማህበሩን ወክሉ ጉዳዩን መከታተል፤፤

የማህበሩ ተወካይ (Liasion) ሆኖ ማንኛውንም ጉዳይ ማስፈፀም

description: Job Title: Freelance UK Immigration Account Manager Location: Remote (Computer and Good Internet Connection Required) Company: Andrew Williams Solicitors Working Hours: Full-time; 9:00 am – 5:00 pm (UK time) Monday to Friday Payment: 50,000 Birr Per Month or US Dollar Equivalent Job Overview:  We are seeking a committed and motivated UK Immigration Account Manager to join our team. This role offers the opportunity to train and progress into a Senior UK Immigration Account Manager position. Our firm, based in Leeds, UK, prides itself on maintaining a high success rates for our private, fee-paying business and individual clients. The ideal candidate will thrive both as part of a busy professional team and working independently. Strong communication, analytical, and writing skills are essential, as is the confidence to engage with clients and professionals, including those from the UK Home Office. Initially, you will work and train alongside a small team of immigration specialists, with the goal of managing your own caseload of private business and personal immigration matters and providing expert guidance to our clients. You must have the ability to meet your monthly case completion targets all while maintaining excellent customer services. Established over 18 years ago by our Principal Solicitor, we prepare and submit various UK Immigration matters on behalf of companies and individuals and assist business clients with managing their UK immigration compliance responsibilities. Additionally, we are also involved in other business activities including legal/business technology. Key Responsibilities:  • Provide legal and administrative support to clients, team members, and external providers. • Handle client inquiries and communications professionally. • Perform administrative, compliance, and case management tasks using our in-house system. • Manage your own caseload, offering professional advice and assistance on UK immigration matters. • Draft applications, witness statements, skeleton arguments, appeal bundles, and other key documents as and when required. • Maintain professional and efficient client management, working towards monthly set financial and or case targets and deadlines. • Keep digital files organized, ensuring timely and accurate recording of payments and other critical details. • Record all case-related activities, including attendance, file notes, and telephone calls, using our Ibiab case management system. Desirable Personal Specifications:  • Ability to work effectively with and motivate team members. • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral. Qualifications and Experience: • Preferred: 2+ Years Experience (e.g., Business Administrator, Office Manager, Lawyer, Legal Assistant). • Education: Law degree or degree in any field. • Experience in business administration, marketing or legal work, strong client care and excellent written and spoken English is required. This role offers clear career progression to Senior Account Manager, Department Manager and then Head of Department.

title: UI/UX Designer / Product Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer / Product Designer Experience Required: Minimum 2 years Employment Type: Full-time, permanent Position Overview
  • We are seeking a skilled designer who can turn business requirements into clear, user-friendly interfaces for mobile and web—especially in banking and fintech. You will work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to create intuitive experiences that build user trust and strengthen our brand.
Key Responsibilities
  • Create product designs: Produce wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and polished screens in Figma (or Sketch, Adobe XD, Illustrator, Photoshop as needed). Conduct research and testing: Plan and run user interviews, surveys, and usability sessions; translate findings into concrete design improvements. Design for all screens: Craft mobile-first and responsive layouts that load quickly and scale smoothly across devices. Iterate on feedback: Refine designs based on input from users, stakeholders, design critiques, and data insights.
  • Support development: Deliver clear specifications, assets, and interaction details; stay available to resolve questions through each development phase.
  • Maintain the design system: Extend and document our design system to ensure visual and functional consistency.
  • Monitor industry trends: Keep current with UI/UX best practices and fintech developments, sharing relevant insights with the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 2 + years of professional UI/UX or product design work, supported by a portfolio of mobile and web projects. Advanced proficiency in Figma; familiarity with other major design tools. Strong grasp of user-centered design, accessibility standards, and visual fundamentals (typography, color, layout, iconography). Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS and the software-development life cycle. Proven experience in user research and usability testing. Ability to work effectively in agile, cross-functional teams and communicate clearly with non-design stakeholders.
Additional Skills
  • Experience in fintech, banking, marketplaces, or other transaction-heavy products. Motion or micro-interaction skills (Framer, ProtoPie, Principle, etc.). Data-driven design using analytics or A/B testing. Hands-on work with scalable design systems.
  • Application Requirements (Mandatory)
To be considered, please submit both of the following:
  • Portfolio link showcasing recent, relevant work. Résumé/CV (PDF or accessible link). Applications missing either item will not be reviewed.

title: Photorealistic 3D Rendering Artist & Designer (Bathroom Products)
description:
Location: Remote Type: Freelance / Contract with a strong possibility of being full time Experience Level: Intermediate to Senior Overview:
  • We are looking for a highly skilled Photorealistic 3D Rendering Artist and Designer to join our team on bathroom product-focused projects. You’ll be creating ultra-photorealistic renderings and animations of bathroom scenes and standalone products, both in studio settings and fully designed room environments.
  • This is not a role for generalists or beginners. We are looking for someone who lives and breathes visual quality, understands materials and lighting deeply, and delivers work that can’t be distinguished from reality.
What You’ll Do:
  • Design, model, and render photorealistic bathroom product visuals and interior bathroom scenes
  • Work with provided CAD files, 3D models, or sketches to develop final renders and animations
  • Produce studio-style isolated product renders (white background)
  • Create full room environment renderings that showcase products within styled bathrooms
  • Develop short animations for product and scene visualization
  • Collaborate with creative direction, product teams, and designers to match desired look and feel
  • Work within deadlines and manage time effectively
Required Skills & Software:
  • Expertise in 3ds Max is strongly preferred
  • Proficiency in Autodesk Maya, Blender, or other high-end 3D software is acceptable if photorealism is achieved
  • V-Ray, Corona Renderer, Arnold, or similar high-end offline render engines
  • Strong skills in lighting, shading, and material realism
  • Deep understanding of camera composition, interior design principles, and render optimization
  • Knowledge of post-production using Photoshop or equivalent
Please Do Not Apply If:
  • You primarily use Lumion, D5 Render, Twinmotion, or other realtime rendering tools — these do not meet our standards
  • You cannot demonstrate photorealistic quality in your portfolio
  • You do not meet deadlines or require frequent reminders
  • You lack experience in lifestyle or product-based visualization
Nice to Have:
  • Background in architecture, industrial design, or interior design
  • Experience creating product animations and fly-throughs
  • Familiarity with PBR workflows and real-world material replication
  • Ability to model products from scratch if needed
Aplication Requirements:
  • A portfolio of your own photorealistic work (no group work, please specify your exact contribution)
  • isted applicants will be required to complete a paid test task to evaluate visualization and design skills
  • Resume or a brief summary of experience, especially in bathroom or product-focused work
We’re looking for someone who:
  • Delivers consistently, on time
  • Has a keen eye for detail and realism
  • Communicates professionally and meets expectations

title: Oncology Nurse
description:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Patient Assessment:

• Conduct comprehensive initial and ongoing assessments of oncology patients, including physical, psychosocial, and emotional status.

• Assess patients for signs and symptoms of cancer, treatment-related side effects, and complications.

• Evaluate patient response to treatment and interventions.

• Document patient assessments accurately and completely in the electronic medical record (EMR).

• Medication Administration:

• Administer chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and other medications according to established protocols and physician orders.

• Monitor patients for adverse reactions and complications during and after medication administration.

• Manage central venous catheters and other vascular access devices.

• Provide education to patients and families regarding medication administration and potential side effects.

• Symptom Management:

• Assess and manage cancer-related symptoms, such as pain, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, mucositis, and neutropenia.

• Implement appropriate nursing interventions to alleviate symptoms and improve patient comfort.

• Educate patients and families about symptom management strategies.

• Provide wound care according to established protocols and physician orders.

• Educate patients and families about wound care techniques.

• Patient Education:

• Provide comprehensive education to patients and families regarding cancer diagnosis, treatment options, side effects, and self-care strategies.

• Develop and implement patient education materials.

• Address patient questions and concerns in a clear and empathetic manner.

• Emotional Support:

• Provide emotional support and counseling to patients and families coping with cancer.

• Assess patients for signs of anxiety, depression, and other emotional distress.

• Refer patients to appropriate support services, such as social work, counseling, and support groups.

• Create a supportive and therapeutic environment for patients and families.

• Collaboration and Communication:

• Collaborate with physicians, pharmacists, dietitians, social workers, and other members of the healthcare team to develop and implement individualized patient care plans.

• Communicate effectively with patients, families, and other healthcare providers.

• Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings.

• Advocate for patients' needs and preferences.

• Infection Control:

• Adhere to strict infection control practices to prevent the spread of infection.

• Properly handle and dispose of hazardous waste materials, including chemotherapy drugs.

• Educate patients and families about infection prevention strategies.

• Documentation:

• Maintain accurate and complete patient records, documenting all assessments, interventions, and outcomes.

• Document medication administration, side effects, and patient responses.

• Ensure compliance with all documentation requirements.

• Professional Development:

• Maintain a current knowledge of oncology nursing practices through continuing updating.

title: እንጊሊዘኛ. ቻይንኛ.... ቋንቋ የኦንላይን አስተማሪስልጠና ሰጪ
description:
Use this link to APPLY (ለማመልከት ይህንን ሊንክ ይጠቀሙ)

https://forms.gle/NSJhckrXM8izckbV6

በBeleqet E-learning የኦንላይን ትምህርት ለመስጠት ፍላጎት ያላቸውን ብቁ አስተማሪዎች እንፈልጋለን። በተለይ በእንግሊዝኛ፣ ቻይንኛ፣ ግራፊክስ ዲዛይን፣ ዩቲዩብ፣ ፕሮግራሚንግ፣ ፎሬክስ/አክሲዮን/ክሪፕቶ ትሬዲንግ እና ሌሎች ተማሪዎች ገቢ ሊያስገኙ በሚችሉ ዘርፎች ልምድ ላላቸው ቅድሚያ እንሰጣለን።

የምንፈልጋቸው አስተማሪዎች:

የቪዲዮ ኮርስ አዘጋጅታችሁ ያላችሁ: ቀድሞውንም የተዘጋጀ የቪዲዮ ትምህርት (በማንዋል የታገዘ) ላላችሁ ቅድሚያ እንሰጣለን።
በእኛ ስቱዲዮ የሚሰሩ: የትምህርት ማንዋል ያላችሁ እና በእኛ ስቱዲዮ በመቅረጽ የኦንላይን ኮርስ ማዘጋጀት የምትችሉ ከሆናችሁ።
ወይም የትምህርት ማንዋል ያላችሁ እና የቪዲዮ ቀረጻና ኤዲቲንግ በራሳችሁ መስራት የምትችሉ ከሆናችሁ ቅድሚያ የምንሰጥ ይሆናል።
ከእኛ ጋር ሲሰሩ የሚያገኟቸው ጥቅሞች:

·       ዘመናዊ የፕሮዳክሽን ማቴሪያል፣ ስቱዲዮ እና ባለሙያዎች ስላለን ትምህርቶን በጥራት ለመቅረጽ እና ለማሰራጨት ልዩ የሆነ እድል ያገኛሉ፡፡

·       ፕሮፌሽናል የሆኑ እና ከፍተኛ ልምድ፣ እውቅና ያለቸው እስከ ፒ.ኤች.ዲ(Dr) ድረስ ያሉ አሰልጣኞች የተሰባሰቡበት በመሆኑ የእርሶን የማስተማር አቅምና ልምድ የሚጨምሩበት ነው፡፡
