title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
Are you a young, passionate person with the peculiar background in psychology and digital marketing, eager to make a real difference in mental health advocacy in Ethiopia? Do you believe in the power of stories and digital platforms to drive change and challenge stigma?

The Mental Health Service Users Association in Ethiopia (MHSUA) is seeking a dynamic and creative Social Media Content Creator to join our vibrant team! This mid-level, full-time position is perfect for someone who understands the nuances of mental health, is skilled in digital communication, and is committed to empowering individuals with lived experience.

About the Role:

As our Social Media Content Creator, you'll be responsible for developing and executing engaging digital content strategies across various platforms (Facebook, Telegram, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.). You'll translate complex mental health information and personal narratives into accessible, impactful messages for diverse audiences.

How to Apply:

If you are a driven young person with the required psychology background and a passion for mental health advocacy and digital technology, we encourage you to apply!

Please submit your CV, a cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate for this role, and your portfolio (can be in Amharic) to MentalServiceUsers@gmail.com  by July 15, 2025.

Qualified women and persons with lived experience of a mental health condition are encouraged to apply.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Key Responsibilities:

Content Creation: Design, write, and produce engaging text, image, and video content that raises awareness, combats stigma, and promotes mental well-being and rights.
Storytelling: Work closely with individuals with lived experience and caregivers to ethically capture and share their powerful stories of recovery, resilience, and advocacy.
Campaign Development: Support the development and implementation of social media campaigns for key awareness days, advocacy initiatives, and events.
Community Engagement: Monitor social media channels, respond to comments and messages, and foster a supportive online community.
Strategy & Analysis: Contribute to the overall social media strategy, analyze performance metrics, and adapt content based on insights.
Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the MHSUA team, volunteers, and external partners to ensure consistent and impactful messaging.
Who We're Looking For:

Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree in Psychology, certificate in digital marketing/graphic design
Experience: 2 years of experience in social media management, content creation, communications, or a related field. Experience with NGOs or advocacy organizations is a plus.
Digital Skills: Proven proficiency in using social media platforms, content creation tools (e.g., Canva, basic video editing software, etc.), and analytics.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Amharic and English. Ability to simplify complex information for public consumption.
Empathy & Sensitivity: Deep understanding of mental health issues, with a strong commitment to ethical storytelling, confidentiality, and safeguarding.
Creativity & Innovation: Ability to think outside the box and develop fresh, engaging content ideas.
Passion for Advocacy: A genuine passion for mental health advocacy, human rights, and empowering marginalized communities.
Self-Starter: Ability to work independently, proactive and as part of a small, dedicated team.

title: Sales Person
description:
Company Description
  • Sun Optical Technologies and Sun Optics Optometry Eye Clinic are pioneers and leading providers of eyewear products in Ethiopia. With state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and cutting-edge machinery sourced from the world’s top ophthalmic and precision optics manufacturers, the company has set a new benchmark in the industry. Over the past two decades, Sun Optical Technologies Plc has played a crucial role in shaping Ethiopia’s optical sector by offering an extensive range of high-quality lenses—something previously unseen in the country. By blending advanced eye care technology with exceptional service, the company continues to expand its impact, with even greater achievements on the horizon.
  • In addition to its manufacturing excellence, Sun Optics Optometry Eye Clinic is committed to delivering top-tier eye care services, ensuring that customers receive both high-quality eyewear and professional optometric care. The clinic and eyewear shops are strategically located for convenience, with branches at 22 Area Town Square Mall (Second Floor) and Ayer Tena, Dil Birhan Building, Select College Building (Second Floor). These locations offer a wide range of eyeglasses, contact lenses, and specialized eye care services, making high-quality vision solutions accessible to the community.
  • As Sun Optical Technologies continues to grow, it remains dedicated to innovation, customer satisfaction, and expanding its presence to serve even more people across Ethiopia
Company:
  • Sun Optics Optometry Eye Clinic
  • Location: Ayer Tena Branch (Taxi Terminal Dil Birhan Building, Select College Building, 2nd Floor)
  • Employment Type: Full-time (Immediate Start)
Job Summary:
  • Sun Optics Optometry Eye Clinic is seeking a dynamic and customer-focused Female Sales Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate is a professional with a degree in marketing, 1-2 years of sales experience, and a passion for delivering excellent customer service. The Sales Specialist will play a key role in promoting our high-quality eyewear products, assisting customers in selecting the right optical solutions, and driving sales growth.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Greet and assist customers in selecting eyewear products that best suit their needs.
  • Provide professional advice on frames, lenses, and optical accessories.
  • Effectively communicate product features, benefits, and promotions to customers.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to ensure repeat business.
  • Process sales transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Maintain an organized and visually appealing store layout.
  • Meet and exceed sales targets and contribute to the overall success of the branch.
  • Handle customer inquiries and complaints professionally, ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Stay updated on the latest eyewear trends and technologies.
Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field.
  • 1-2 years of sales experience, preferably in retail or the optical industry.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent customer service and sales abilities.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet sales targets.
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and able to start immediately.
  • What We Offer: Competitive salary with sales-based incentives.
  • Training and professional development opportunities.
  • A friendly and supportive work environment.
  • Opportunities for career growth within Sun Optics.
  • If you meet the qualifications and are ready to start immediately, we encourage you to apply and be part of our growing team!
  • To Apply: Submit your resume and cover letter to
Job Address Addis Ababa, Ayertena

title: Senior Accountant
description: Miseso Interior Design is hiring a talented and experienced Senior Accountant to strengthen their finance team. The role involves maintaining accurate and complete financial records, preparing and managing company budgets, ensuring timely and accurate tax compliance, performing bank reconciliations, and maintaining the Fixed Asset Register. The ideal Candidate will also oversee daily financial activities, including reviewing payments, vouchers, and other supporting documents, to ensure proper authorization and adherence to policy. Providing technical guidance to accountants and junior accountants will also be a key part of this position. Qualification BA/MA Degree in Accounting and Finance 5 years of relevant work experience in a Construction company. Special Training; IFRS, Peachtree Accounting. Key Responsibilities: Prepare financial statements and produce budget according to schedule. Ensure that general accounting operations are verified and controlled as per company policy and procedures and accepted accounting principles. Ensures that all transactions are properly backed up by adequate source documents; expenses are with in approved budget and are approved by properly authorized person. Undertakes cash flow forecasts and ensures that sufficient fund is available to meet the operational needs and financial obligations. Review transactions to ensure they are properly recorded and books of accounts are balanced, and authorize records of transactions and the opening of general and subsidiary ledger accounts. Monitor and review accounting and related system reports for accuracy and completeness. Resolve accounting discrepancies. Prepare aging report on accounts receivable on monthly basis. Prepares accurate and timely financial statements. Check & report revenue and expense trends against budget set and ensure expense control. Administers intercompany transfer of funds and maintain appropriate records in the books of accounts. Provides technical back up to accountants and junior accountants for undertaking effective and efficient financial management. Interact with internal and external auditors in completing audits. Ensures that fixed asset registers are properly maintained. Verify all financial documents, prepare journal entries in relation to the accounting function, and post to the ledger. Ensure that all types official financial documents and vouchers are properly registered and are available in sufficient quantity. Ensures that all required adjusting entries are posted in the books of account before closing and documents are readily available for timely auditing. Verify, allocate, post and reconcile accounts payable and receivables and Make sure that advances and payables are settled on time. Examine and perform proper entry for prepaid expenses, accruals, deferrals and other pending issues at the end of every month. Check the timely and accurate payment of VAT, withholding tax, payroll tax, pension payment, and other legal obligations. Prepare payment voucher and cheque for authorized payments after verifying the correctness of the relevant source documents Prepares regular financial reports for different internal and external users Prepare reconciliation of all bank/cash accounts Prepares payroll and reviews the document after payments and effected to ascertain whether deductions of income tax and Pension Contribution are paid to Government Authority. Receives and systematically keeps custody of all accounting records, documents and files. Analyses financial information and summarize financial status for submission to the top management. Review and recommend modifications to accounting systems and procedures, as it deems appropriate. Keep up to date on practices, accounting systems and procedures, internal control measures, and state and federal laws regarding business operations. Performs other duties assigned by the immediate supervisor. Job Address Hayahulet (22), Around Dinberua Hospital

title: Manager
description: Main Responsibilities Overview: The manager is responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations, managing staff, ensuring customer satisfaction, improving efficiency, and growing sales within the printing and advertisement business. They bridge creative, production, sales, and client service departments. 1. Operational Management Ensure all printing and advertising jobs are completed on time and meet quality standards. Oversee scheduling of print jobs, advertising campaigns, and deliveries. Coordinate across departments: design, print, finishing, and installation teams. Monitor inventory of materials (paper, ink, vinyl, etc.) and reorder when needed. Enforce health and safety protocols in the production environment. 2. Team Management Supervise and assign tasks to production workers, designers, sales, and support staff. Hire, train, and evaluate employees. Lead weekly staff meetings to discuss workflow, performance, and challenges. Solve interpersonal or work-related conflicts professionally. 3. Sales & Client Relations Build strong relationships with clients to encourage repeat business. Respond to client inquiries, complaints, and feedback quickly and professionally. Work with the sales team to close new deals and retain key accounts. Follow up on quotations and convert them into sales. 4. Marketing & Brand Management Support in marketing campaigns to attract more clients (social media, BTL, etc.). Maintain and grow the company’s public image and professional presence. Suggest new services (e.g., car wraps, large format printing, LED signboards). 5. Financial & Budget Oversight Prepare monthly budgets for material purchases, salaries, and operational costs. Track expenses and income; reduce waste and unnecessary costs. Approve purchase orders and negotiate with vendors for better prices. Report monthly performance to the owner. 6. Quality Control & Customer Satisfaction Double-check the final output (e.g., banners, flyers, signs) before delivery. Make sure all jobs are done as per client instructions and brand guidelines. Fix issues fast and communicate clearly with clients if delays occur. 7. Documentation & Reporting Keep records of all client orders, invoices, payments, and receipts. Track productivity and job completion reports weekly. Use management software (if available) to streamline processes. 8. Innovation & Improvement Research new printing technologies and advertising trends. Recommend new machines, techniques, or services to increase revenue. Suggest operational improvements for faster and better work. Required Skills: Strong leadership & communication Basic knowledge of printing machines & software (e.g., Adobe Suite, RIP software) Client relationship management Time & team management Problem-solving and decision-making Budgeting and cost control Optional but Valuable Experience: Previous work in printing, graphics, or signage industry Experience managing both creative and technical staff Familiar with design/production workflows (e.g., offset, digital, large format)

title: CNC Machine Opreator
description: Main Job Purpose: The CNC/Laser Machine Operator is responsible for preparing, operating, and maintaining CNC machines used for cutting, engraving, and shaping materials like acrylic, PVC, wood, aluminum, or foam boards for signage and advertising displays. Key Responsibilities: 1. Machine Operation & Setup Operate CNC router/laser/plasma cutting machines depending on company equipment. Load materials onto the CNC bed and secure them properly. Interpret and follow CNC design files (usually from CorelDRAW, AutoCAD, or Illustrator). Adjust machine settings (speed, depth, pressure) based on material type. 2. File Handling Receive and review cut files from the design team. Convert or adjust vector files as needed before sending them to the CNC. Ensure accuracy and alignment of designs before starting the job. 3. Material Handling Cut and prepare different materials: MDF, ACP (aluminum composite panel), acrylic, PVC, wood, etc. Measure and mark materials before and after cutting to ensure precision. Handle materials safely to avoid damage or injury. 4. Quality Control Inspect the finished pieces for defects, alignment, smooth edges, and accuracy. Make adjustments and recut if necessary. Perform basic finishing: sanding, edge polishing, or cleaning. 5. Maintenance & Safety Perform routine maintenance on CNC machines (lubrication, cleaning, calibration). Report any technical issues or needed repairs to the manager. Follow all safety procedures when using the CNC and handling materials. 6. Support Installation Team Coordinate with the installation team to prepare materials accurately. Occasionally assist with loading finished products for delivery or installation. Required Skills & Knowledge: Experience operating CNC/laser machines in signage or furniture industries. Ability to read technical drawings or CAD files. Basic knowledge of software like ArtCAM, Aspire, CorelDRAW, or AutoCAD. Mechanical and measurement skills. Good attention to detail. Physical fitness for lifting and moving materials. Education & Experience: Technical school certificate or vocational training in CNC operation or related fields. At least 1 year of experience operating CNC machines (or willingness to be trained). Bonus/Optional Skills: Experience with laser cutting, engraving, or 3D signs. Ability to assist in design modifications. Welding, polishing, or sign assembly experience.

title: Safety & Healthy Officer
description:
We are seeking a responsible Safety Officer to ensure compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) guidelines. Your primary role will be advising on measures to minimize hazards and maintain a safe working environment. Vigilance in identifying violations is crucial.

The ideal candidate is a dedicated individual who strictly adheres to OSH regulations. Your focus will be on preventive measures, requiring attentiveness and proactive thinking. Detail orientation is essential, especially during emergencies.

Your objective is to establish a workplace that meets legal safety standards and cultivates a culture of prioritizing health and safety.

If you are a conscientious professional with a strong commitment to safety, we invite you to apply. Join our team and contribute to creating a secure working environment for our employees.

Responsibilities

·     Support the development of OHS policies and programs

·         Advise and instruct on various safety-related topics (noise levels, use of machinery etc.)

·         Conduct risk assessment and enforce preventative measures

·         Review existing policies and measures and update according to legislation

·         Initiate and organize OHS training of employees and executives

·         Inspect premises and the work of personnel to identify issues or non-conformity (e.g. not using protective equipment)

·         Oversee installations, maintenance, disposal of substances etc.

·         Stop any unsafe acts or processes that seem dangerous or unhealthy

·         Record and investigate incidents to determine causes and handle worker’s compensation claims

·         Prepare reports on occurrences and provide statistical information to upper management

Requirements and skills

·         Proven experience as safety officer

·         Knowledge of potentially hazardous materials or practices

·         Experience in writing reports and policies for health and safety

·         Familiarity with conducting data analysis and reporting statistics

·         Proficient in MS Office; Working knowledge of safety management information systems is a plus

·         Outstanding organizational skills

·         Diligent with great attention to detail

·         Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and explain health and safety topics

·         BSc/BA in occupational health and safety or relevant field is preferred

description:

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
• We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Network Engineer with 3–5 years of experience, preferably with an academic background in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (with a focus on Communication Systems). The ideal candidate will lead the design, deployment, optimization, and maintenance of secure, scalable enterprise networks—including SD-WAN and hybrid infrastructure solutions.
Qualifications:  Education: BSc (required) or MSc (preferred) in Electrical and Engineering with a focus on Electronics Communication Systems.  Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in network engineering. Certifications (preferred but not mandatory):  Cisco (CCNP or higher), Fortinet NSE 4/5, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent.  Huawei (HCIP or HCIE)  Experience with SD-WAN platforms (Cisco Viptela, Meraki, Fortinet, Aruba, etc.).Proficiency in network protocols: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLAN, QoS.  Solid understanding of enterprise routing/switching and firewall technologies.  Familiarity with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Proficient in AutoCAD for drafting and reviewing technical/network infrastructure layouts.  Good knowledge and practical experience in data center configuration, surveillance and camera installation, including IP camera configuration and NVR/DVR systems.  Hands-on experience with RF, wireless, and optical communication technologies.  Experience with network design (LAN/WAN), industrial communication (e.g., Modbus, CAN), and IoT technologies.  Understanding of PCB design, EMI/EMC standards, and system integration.

title: Chief Finance Officer (CFO)
description:
Position Overview

The CFO is a strategic executive responsible for leading all financial aspects of OVID Real Estate. This includes shaping financial strategy, managing large-scale transactions, ensuring compliance, overseeing daily operations, and supporting investment initiatives. The CFO supervises two main areas:

• Financial Planning & Compliance – budgeting, forecasting, reporting, auditing, taxation, and legal compliance

• Finance Operations – day-to-day transactions, treasury, accounts, and project-level finance

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Planning

• Develop and execute short- and long-term financial strategies aligned with company goals

• Advise the CEO and executive team on finance, investment, and growth decisions

• Oversee financial planning, modeling, and strategic forecasting

Budgeting, Reporting & Analysis

• Lead budgeting processes, long-term planning, and monthly forecasts

• Provide accurate, timely financial reports to executives and stakeholders

• Monitor KPIs and implement controls to meet profitability targets

Operational Finance & Cash Flow

• Supervise daily finance operations: accounts payable/receivable, general ledger, payroll, tax, treasury

• Manage cash flow to ensure liquidity and business continuity

• Lead cost optimization across projects and departments

Compliance, Governance & Risk

• Ensure compliance with IFRS, tax laws, and internal policies

• Lead internal and external audits and address audit requirements

• Implement strong internal controls and governance systems

Capital Structure & Fundraising

• Oversee capital budgeting and project financing for developments

• Engage investors, banks, and financial institutions for funding

• Prepare financial documentation for due diligence, JVs, and asset acquisitions

Digital Transformation

• Promote use of ERP systems and financial automation tools

• Implement digital dashboards for real-time financial monitoring

Team Leadership

• Manage and coach senior finance staff

• Set performance goals and build a strong, accountable finance team

• Foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and collaboration

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Work closely with project, procurement, sales, legal, and construction teams

• Ensure financial controls align with operational needs and project timelines

• Represent finance in executive meetings and investment discussions

Stakeholder Engagement

• Serve as the key point of contact for investors, auditors, and regulatory bodies

• Ensure transparency and effective financial communication

Other Duties

• Perform other tasks as directed by the CEO or Board

Qualifications

• Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field

• CPA, ACCA, or CFA certification (mandatory)

• 12+ years of experience, including 5+ years in a senior finance role in real estate, construction, or investment sectors

• Experience in project financing, ERP systems, compliance, and audit

Key Skills for Success

• Strategic thinking and strong financial foresight

• Expertise in real estate finance and capital markets

• Leadership, negotiation, and team-building ability

• Strong communication with internal and external stakeholders

• Proficiency in digital financial systems and tools

• Ability to lead under pressure and across complex projects

Barriers to Success

• Failure to deliver timely and accurate financial insights

• Inability to lead or retain a high-performing finance team

• Weak compliance or risk management

• Resistance to technology or cross-functional collaboration

description:
Job Summary:
  • We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented IT Officer to join our Innovation & Technology department. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting the company’s IT infrastructure, web platforms, and hardware/software systems, while also playing a key role in supporting project-specific technological deployments. This includes configuring, testing, and maintaining IT and smart devices on construction and electro-mechanical project sites.
Key Responsibilities: 1. Routine IT Operations Administer and maintain office IT systems including network infrastructure, servers, computers, printers, and other peripheral devices. Provide technical support and troubleshooting for hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Ensure data security, backups, and compliance with IT policies. Manage user accounts, email configurations, and access controls. Develop and maintain the company’s website and platforms. Coordinate with vendors and service providers for IT purchases and services. 2. Project-Specific Responsibilities Configure, test, and deploy devices and systems used in field projects (e.g., IoT devices, smart sensors, tablets, surveillance systems, site monitoring tools). Collaborate with project engineers and site teams to ensure seamless integration of technology on-site. Assist in the rollout and support of project management and collaboration tools used on construction sites. Monitor and maintain remote connectivity to project-based systems and devices. Provide technical training and guidance to site personnel for deployed technologies. 3. Innovation & Digital Transformation Support Contribute to research and testing of new technologies applicable to construction and electromechanical workflows. Support in developing or customizing tools that improve efficiency, documentation, and automation of processes. Participate in technology pilot programs and prepare performance reports. Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 2–4 years of experience in IT support or system administration. Experience in construction, engineering, or industrial environments is an added advantage. Technical Skills: Proficiency in managing Windows and Linux systems. Networking knowledge (LAN/WAN, firewalls, VPNs, etc.). Familiarity with web development (WordPress, HTML/CSS/JavaScript). Experience with device configuration and basic scripting (Python, PowerShell or GUI) is a plus. Understanding of IoT or smart construction technology is a bonus. Key Competencies: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to multitask across office and field responsibilities. Good communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Willingness to learn and adapt to emerging technologies. Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team. Working Conditions: Office-based with frequent travel to project sites. May require working outside regular hours to support project timelines or remote systems. title: Sales and Marketing Manager
description:
Job overview
  • Winsky Global Logistics ESL branch is hiring a dynamic and results-oriented Sales and Marketing Manager to join our expanding team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in logistics, shipping, and freight forwarding, with a proven track record in international sales, particularly in managing shipments from and to China.
  • We are looking for a passionate and driven professional with deep knowledge of global trade routes, international freight solutions, and precise client acquisition strategies—someone who can lead business growth, expand our market reach, and deliver customized logistics services across global supply chains.
  • The compensation package includes a monthly base salary along with performance-based commissions tied to the achievement of key performance indicators (KPIs).
1.     Sales Strategy & Shipment Booking
  • Identify potential clients and generate qualified leads to secure shipment bookings for both air and sea freight services, ensuring consistent revenue growth and client satisfaction. Develop and execute precise sales strategies to grow the customer base and revenue. Manage end-to-end sales cycle: inquiry → quotation → booking → post-shipment follow-up. Maintain a pipeline of clients with consistent follow-up and conversion.
2. Customer Relationship Management
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients (importers/exporters, traders, agents). Understand client needs to offer tailored logistics solutions (FCL/LCL, consolidated cargo, etc.). Resolve client issues promptly related to bookings, documentation, delays, etc. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
3. Marketing and Promotion
  • Promote freight services through customer visits, digital marketing, email campaigns, and trade shows, etc. Position the company as a reliable logistics partner for various industries. Continuously evaluate market trends to monitor pricing and service strategies.
4. Pricing, Quotation & Negotiation
  • Prepare competitive freight quotations based on customer needs and carrier tariffs. Negotiate rates with shipping lines and transport vendors. Ensure pricing strategies are aligned with profit margins and market conditions.
5. Coordination with Operations Team
  • Work closely with the operations team to ensure smooth shipment execution after booking. Track shipments and keep clients informed of their cargo status. Coordinate documentation (BL, invoices, etc.) with internal and external stakeholders.
6. Reporting & Analysis
  • Track KPIs such as booking volume, conversion rate, client acquisition, and revenue. Submit weekly and monthly reports to management on sales performance and market trends. Analyze client feedback and identify areas for service improvement.
7. Team Management & Development
  • Lead and support sales persons and marketing staff. Set targets and conduct regular performance reviews. Provide service and market training to the team. Qualified and interested applicants are invited to submit their updated resumes to :
  • Sales@apollologcustoms.or

title: Go developer and P2P Systems Architect
description:
We only consider applicants who fill out the form listed above! We accept applicant on a first come first serve basis. Job description
  • We are seeking a visionary and hands-on P2P System Architect and Go Developer to lead the design and implementation of our core product. You will be responsible for building a peer-to-peer system that utilizes a distributed Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graph for large-scale similarity search.
  • This is a unique opportunity to shape the architecture of a system that combines cutting-edge concepts from distributed systems, P2P networking, and AI. If you are passionate about building complex, resilient, and truly decentralized systems, we want to hear from you.
Responsibilities
  • Architect and Design: Lead the high-level architectural design of a P2P network where each node participates in a distributed HNSW graph. Go Development: Write clean, high-performance, and concurrent Go code to implement the core logic of the system. P2P Networking: Implement the peer-to-peer communication layer, including node discovery, membership, and direct communication protocols. Gossip and Consistency: Develop and integrate a gossip protocol to manage network membership and ensure eventual consistency of the distributed graph state. Distributed HNSW: Implement the logic for constructing and maintaining the distributed HNSW graph, including handling node joins, departures, and dynamic connection management. Search and Traversal: Design and implement the distributed search algorithm that traverses the P2P graph to find approximate nearest neighbors with minimal network latency. Problem Solving: Tackle the inherent challenges of decentralized systems, including fault tolerance, network partitions, and finding efficient entry points into the graph (e.g., using DHTs). Collaboration: Work closely with the founding team to define the technical roadmap and drive the project forward.
Must-Have Qualifications
  • Strong proficiency in Go (Golang), with experience in building concurrent and networked applications. Proven experience designing and building distributed systems and P2P networks. Deep, practical understanding of gossip protocols for membership and state synchronization. Solid computer science fundamentals, especially in data structures and algorithms (graphs in particular). A pragmatic approach to engineering, with the ability to navigate the trade-offs between consistency, availability, and performance. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on novel challenges.

title: Admin Assistant
description:

  • The Admin Assistant will manage general office administration, team coordination, documentation, and operational support reporting directly to management. This role is ideal for a young, organized, and versatile candidate who can handle multiple tasks with energy and attention to detail.

  1. Manage day-to-day office operations.
  2. Assist with company documentation, data entry, and record-keeping.
  3. Help coordinate internal communications and team activities.
  4. Provide administrative support across departments as needed (HR, operations).

  4. Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive).
  5. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  6. A positive attitude and willingness to learn quickly.

title: Creative Videographer & Editor
description:

Creative, reliable, and able to manage projects independently.

title: production Supervisor
description: OSAKA Steel PLC Job Position: WPC Production Supervisor Reported to Production Manager Duty station: Addis Ababa Salary: Negotiable Quantity: one Job Description The ideal candidate will be responsible for engaging with producing engineered wooden doors, managing teams and production workers. title: Accountant & Admin
description:
• Are you a highly organized and detail-oriented professional with a passion for both numbers and people? Kalu Film Production is searching for a versatile Accounting and HR Officer to play a pivotal role in their organization.
Qualifications
  • Possessing basic knowledge of HR principles and practices is a must. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a closely related field. Minimum of 2 years of progressive experience in a combined Accounting and HR role. Proven experience in managing payroll and financial reporting. Proficiency in accounting software, particularly Peachtree Accounting. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft product. Strong understanding of Ethiopian tax laws and financial regulations. knowledge of Ethiopian labor laws and HR best practices. Solid grasp of accounting principles (IFRS or local GAAP). Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and ability to maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive information.
Duties and Responsibilities Accounting Duties
  • Manage payroll, including deductions and remittances. Accurately record financial transactions using Peachtree accounting software. Prepare monthly financial reports (balance sheets, income statements, cash flow). Monitor and manage company expenses and petty cash, including reconciliations. Perform bank reconciliations and maintain cash management records. Ensure compliance with Ethiopian tax laws and financial regulations. Maintain accurate records.
HR Responsibilities
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: from job ads and screening to interviews and offer letters. Maintain an accurate employee database. Monitor employee time and attendance, ensuring compliance with policies and labor laws. Manage employee leave requests. Serve as a primary contact for employee HR inquiries. Maintain accurate and confidential employee records. Facilitate employee engagement. Job Address Bole

title: ደረቅ እና ጣፋጭ የምግብ ምርቶች ማምረት እና ማሸግ
description:
የስራ መደቡ መጠሪያ –የዳቦ ፣ ኩኪስ ፣ ደረቅ  እና ጣፋጭ  የምግብ ምርቶችን ማቀነባበር, ማምረት እና ማሸግ

የምግብ አሰሩን በመከተል ማምረት ምርቶችን በጥንቃቄ እና ባማረ ሁኔታ ማሸግ

ማሳሰብያ: ስራው አስቀድሞ ስልጠና ስለሚኖረው አንድ አመት እና ከዚያ በላይ ለመስራት ፍቃደኛ ሆኖ ስምምነት መፈረም የሚችል።

ማሽኖችን በጥሩ ሁኔታ ለመያዝ ሃላፊነት የሚወስድ።

መስፈርቶች፡
የ ኬክ, ዳቦ ወይም ጣፋጭ ምግብ ስራዎች ላይ ስልጠና የወሰደች( ሰርተፊኬት ያላት) እና ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት እና አቅም ያላት

የመኖሪያ ቦታቸው ለ ሃይሌ ጋርመንት ቅርብ የሆነ

ደሞዝ 7,000 ብር  እና ኮሚሽን

ለስራው ለማመልከት የትምርት ማስረጃ እና መታወቂያ በ ቴሌግራም በ ይላኩልን

Job Address
Garment

title: Marketing Manager
description:
• Job Title: Social Media and Marketing Manager - Ride-Hailing Company
Role Summary:
  • As the Social Media and Marketing Manager for our ride-hailing company, you will lead the development and execution of social media and marketing strategies to enhance brand awareness, engage customers, and drive user acquisition and retention. You will leverage various digital channels to promote our services, increase customer engagement, and establish our brand as a leader in the ride-hailing industry.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Social Media Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive social media strategies aligned with the company's marketing objectives, target audience demographics, and brand positioning in the ride-hailing sector.
  • Content Creation and Management: Oversee the creation, curation, and publishing of engaging content across social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok, to showcase our services, promotions, and brand values.
  • Campaign Planning and Execution: Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital channels, including social media, email marketing, influencer partnerships, and paid advertising, to drive user acquisition, increase app downloads, and promote rider loyalty programs.
  • Customer Engagement: Engage with customers and followers on social media platforms by responding to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely and professional manner, and fostering a positive and interactive online community.
  • Brand Awareness and Reputation Management: Monitor social media channels for brand mentions, customer feedback, and industry trends, and proactively address any issues or concerns to maintain a positive brand reputation and customer satisfaction.
  • Performance Analysis: Utilize social media analytics tools and marketing metrics to track, measure, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), such as engagement rate, reach, conversion rate, and return on ad spend (ROAS), and use insights to optimize campaigns and content strategies.
  • Partnership Development: Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships with local businesses, influencers, events, and community organizations to expand brand reach, drive user acquisition, and enhance brand visibility in key markets.
  • User-generated Content (UGC): Encourage and facilitate the creation of user-generated content, such as rider testimonials, photos, and videos, and leverage UGC to amplify brand messaging and enhance authenticity and credibility.
  • Rider Incentive Programs: Develop and execute creative promotional campaigns and rider incentive programs to incentivize usage, increase rider loyalty, and drive repeat business, collaborating closely with the operations team to ensure seamless execution.
  • Market Research and Trend Analysis: Stay informed about market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments in the ride-hailing and transportation sectors, and incorporate insights into marketing strategies and tactics to maintain a competitive edge.
Qualifications:
  • Education: bachelor's degree in Marketing communication,business,Digital Media or related field.or relevant Certifications (e.g Digital Marketing,Social Media Management )is a plus.
Experience
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in social media management and digital marketing perferably in the transportation,tech,or consumer service industry Job Address 22 golagol

title: Senior Go Lang Developer
description:
About the Role:
  • We’re expanding our backend team and looking for experienced Go Lang developers to join our growing FinTech engineering unit. You’ll play a key role in developing high performance backend services, powering our core financial products with scalability and reliability in mind.
Responsibilities:
  • Develop robust backend services using Go Lang within microservices and event-driven architectures. Build and integrate asynchronous messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, gRPC) and webhooks for efficient real time data exchange. Ensure performance optimization for systems handling large-scale, low-latency transactions. Design and manage relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases with a focus on scalability and data integrity. Write clean, maintainable, and thoroughly tested code, contributing to continuous integration and deployment processes. Embed security best practices across services, including encrypted communication (SSL/TLS) and secure API design.
Required Qualifications:
  • Strong hands on experience with GoLang and modern backend engineering principles. Proficient in message driven architecture using Kafka, gRPC, and RabbitMQ. Deep understanding of database systems, including SQL and NoSQL structures. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD toolchains. Solid grasp of backend security, including encryption standards and authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT...)
Preferred Experience:
  • Familiarity with the Echo web framework and SQLC code generation. Previous experience working in FinTech, digital banking, or payment processing environments.
How to Apply: If you meet the qualifications, please send your CV and portfolio to samrawit@one.tap.et. Job Address Bole

description:
Job Opportunity: Experienced MERN Stack + PHP Developer Wanted!
  • We’re looking for a versatile and seasoned full-stack developer with strong skills in both the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and PHP to join our growing engineering team. If you can confidently switch between modern JavaScript frameworks and legacy PHP systems, enjoy building scalable web applications, and deliver high-quality code fast—we want to hear from you!
IMPORTANT NOTE:
  • This position is for experienced professionals. You should be comfortable jumping into existing codebases, improving architecture, and delivering production-ready features with minimal hand-holding.
Budget & Benefits * Compensation: 35k net * Contract Type: Full-time (or fixed-term contract) * Location: Remote or on-site **Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain web applications using the MERN stack and PHP * Build and consume RESTful APIs and third-party integrations * Translate UI/UX designs into responsive front-end interfaces * Write clean, modular, and well-documented code * Debug, refactor, and improve performance across both JavaScript and PHP codebases * Participate in code reviews and collaborate with product, QA, and DevOps teams * Maintain and upgrade legacy PHP systems while migrating selected components to Node.js/React Requirements * Proven experience (3+ years) working with MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) * Solid experience with PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, or custom PHP) * Strong grasp of JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and frontend best practices * Experience with relational and non-relational databases (MySQL, MongoDB) * Proficiency in writing and consuming REST APIs * Good understanding of authentication (JWT, OAuth) and security best practices * Familiarity with Git, CI/CD workflows, and deployment pipelines * Ability to independently read technical documentation and ship production-ready features * Bonus: Experience with GraphQL, TypeScript, or Next.js is a plus Mini-Project(Mandatory) ### Task: Demonstrate your core PHP skills by building a simple Task Manager API ## Project Overview Create a Task Management REST API using pure PHP (no frameworks like Laravel or Symfony). The API should allow basic task operations and be simple enough to run locally using Docker. Core Features API Endpoints * POST /tasks Create a new task * GET /tasks Retrieve all tasks * GET /tasks/{id} Retrieve a single task by ID * PUT /tasks/{id} Update a tasks ## Database Use SQLite* for simplicity * Each task should have: * id (auto-increment) * title (string) * description (text) * status (pending, in-progress, completed) * created_at, updated_at ## Tech Constraints Use vanilla PHP* (OOP style encouraged) Use PDO* for database interaction * Organize code with MVC-like separation: database/, controllers/, models/, routes/ ## Dockerize Provide a Dockerfile and optionally a docker-compose.yml to run the project locally with PHP + SQLite. ## Bonus Points * Add filtering: /tasks?status=completed * Add basic API test script (curl or Postman collection) * Add input validation and meaningful error responses ## Deliverables * Public GitHub/GitLab repository * Include a clean, well-formatted README.md explaining: * How to install dependencies * How to initialize and run the project (with or without Docker) * Sample API requests and responses * (Optional) API auth details if JWT is implemented ## Target The API should run locally in Docker* within a few minutes * Clean, well-documented, and modular code * Do not overengineer — simplicity and correctness are more important How to Apply https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScflzWHFB2ZtcYXhEC7O2N-piqDoq2lPujs54gz0gv9TJ2z8g/viewform?usp=header Job Address Addis ababa

title: Senior Accountant & Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Specialist
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Accountant & FP&A Specialist to join our finance team. This dual-role position combines strong technical accounting knowledge with forward-thinking financial planning and strategic analysis. You will ensure the integrity of financial reporting while driving insights that support executive decision-making and long-term growth.   Perfect English, masters degree in accounting, and 5+years of experience is required   Key Responsibilities: Accounting:
  • Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with GAAP. Manage general ledger activities, journal entries, reconciliations, and accruals. Coordinate audits and liaise with external auditors and tax professionals. Ensure compliance with all internal controls, policies, and regulatory requirements. Supervise or support AP/AR, payroll, and fixed asset accounting processes.
FP&A:
  • Develop, monitor, and maintain budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial plans. Conduct variance analysis and provide actionable insights on financial performance. Strong knowledge of US GAAP and financial reporting requirements. Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; experience with ERP and BI tools (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks, Power BI, or Tableau). Exceptional analytical, organizational, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Accountant
description:
• OLY Technologies is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Accountant to manage financial transactions, ensure accuracy in financial records, and support the company’s financial health. The ideal candidate will handle a variety of accounting tasks, from preparing financial reports to ensuring compliance with tax regulations.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare accurate financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports. Bookkeeping: Maintain accurate records of all financial transactions and ensure they are properly recorded in the accounting system. Accounts Management: Manage accounts payable and receivable, ensuring timely payments and collections. Reconciliation: Perform bank reconciliations and resolve discrepancies between financial records and bank statements. Budgeting & Forecasting: Assist in preparing budgets, financial forecasts, and variance analysis. Tax Compliance: Ensure compliance with local tax regulations, including preparing and filing tax returns. Internal Controls: Implement and maintain internal control procedures to safeguard company assets and ensure accuracy in financial reporting. Audit Support: Provide necessary documentation and support during internal and external audits. Collaboration: Work closely with other departments to ensure accurate financial reporting and support business decisions.
Required Qualifications:
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Experience: 2-3 years of professional experience in accounting or finance roles. Technical Skills: Proficiency in accounting software such as QuickBooks, ERP systems, and advanced knowledge of MS Excel. Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of financial regulations, tax laws, and accounting standards. Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze financial data and prepare meaningful reports. Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy in preparing financial statements and handling transactions. Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to explain financial data to non-financial stakeholders.
Working Conditions:
  • Work Environment: Office-based, with occasional off-site visits for audits or meetings with external stakeholders. Work Tools: Utilize OLY’s ERP system to manage financial records and provide regular updates. Work Hours: Full-time, standard office hours, with potential extended hours during financial reporting periods.
Benefits of Joining OLY Technologies:
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for professional advancement and leadership roles. Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary with performance-based incentives. Skill Enhancement: Access to training and certifications in advanced accounting and financial management. Supportive Environment: Work in a collaborative and team-oriented setting. Financial Impact: Direct involvement in critical financial decisions influencing the company’s success.
Application Process:
  • Interested candidates can apply by clicking the “Apply Now” button on our website oly.et/jobs. Please fill in the required information and submit your application for consideration. We will contact shortlisted candidates for interviews.
About OLY Technologies:
  • OLY Technologies is a multi-service company with a presence in Addis Ababa and Mekelle. We specialize in branding, printing, packaging, marketing, import/export, and software development. Our commitment to innovation drives us to deliver tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of our diverse clientele.Job Address Bole Gulf Aziz Building

title: Video Editors
description:
• Hey so i need 2 video editors / content creators for two different channels. One is motivational, the second is a religious channel.(well edited Protestant sermons will be uploaded here)
  • The candidates should have a good understanding about each topic. Understanding English is crucial.
  • Here’s what the workflow looks like.
  • Both editors will be sent links(an hour long interview or a sermon) they will have to listen to that interview or sermon and pick out the best bits.
  • The hook and intro should be no less than 1.50 minutes. The best bits of the entire video will be used as a hook and intro to keep the audience watching.
  • The videos will be 15 minutes long. Not less than that.
  • After picking out the best bits of the interview/sermon. The candidates will then edit the video in a cinematic style. Keeping the engagement rate higher is the editor’s responsibility. The videos should trigger emotion.
  • The editors will have to use multiple copyright free background music to keep the audience engaged. Anything that helps to keep them engaged and interested is considered as a plus, example: sound effects …

  • I expect 30 videos per month from the editors. That will be 15 videos each.
  • Regarding the payment, i will pay 1000 birr per video. The payment will be made on a monthly basis.
  • There’s zero tolerance for lazy editors. They should submit a video every 2 days. Compromising the quality of the video is not acceptable.
  • I need experienced editors with some works to show. Attach your YouTube links/works on the cv. No private groups or anything. Just links.
  • Dont write your cv with the help of AI. You should be able to express yourself with your own words. Any CV that consists AI written letters will automatically be disapproved.
  • If you’re selected as one of the potential candidates, you will be asked to edit a sample 1 minute video.
  • Dont apply if you dont have previous work experience to show.
  • Read the instructions carefully before applying.
  • Good luck.

title: Marketing manager
description:
Job description
  • A Marketing Manager for coffee export, focusing on both green and roasted coffee, will develop and execute international marketing strategies, manage relationships with buyers, and drive brand awareness. This role requires strong understanding of coffee, marketing, and international trade regulations.
Responsibilities: • Develop and implement international marketing strategies: This includes identifying new market opportunities, particularly in regions like Europe, the US, Asia, and the Middle East. • Build and maintain relationships: Cultivating strong connections with international buyers, roasters, and distributors is crucial for securing and expanding market share. • Manage pricing strategies: • Analyzing data from the Ethiopian Commodity Exchange (ECX) and global market trends to determine competitive pricing. • Coordinate export logistics: Working closely with export documentation and logistics teams to ensure timely and efficient delivery of coffee shipments. • Represent the company: Participating in trade shows and promotional events to showcase the company's coffee offerings and build brand recognition. • Monitor market conditions: Staying informed about competitor activities and market shifts to adapt sales strategies accordingly. • Customer engagement and satisfaction: Developing and implementing strategies to enhance customer experience and loyalty, especially in international markets. • Brand management: Ensuring consistent brand messaging and across all marketing channels. • Sales strategy development: Creating and executing strategies to acquire new customers and retain existing ones. • Market research: Conducting research to identify new customer segments and understand market demands. • Budget management: Managing marketing budgets effectively to maximize return on investment. • Team leadership: Leading and mentoring a marketing team, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment. Qualifications: • Education: A bachelor's degree in Marketing, International Business, Agribusiness, or a related field. • Experience: Significant experience in coffee export or agricultural commodities marketing, preferably with a focus on international markets. 3-4 year • Knowledge: Strong understanding of international trade regulations, INCOTERMS, and Letter of Credit (LC) procedures. • Skills: Excellent communication and negotiation skills, particularly in English (proficiency in other languages like French or Arabic is a plus). • Technical skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM systems. • Passion for coffee: A genuine interest in the coffee industry, including knowledge of coffee production processes and quality standards. • Analytical skills: Ability to analyze market data, identify trends, and develop data-driven strategies. • Leadership and communication skills: Strong leadership and interpersonal skills to effectively manage a team and build relationships with stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently and manage deadlines.

title: Coffee supply Chain Specialist
description:
Job Title: Coffee Supply Chain Specialist Location: Addis Ababa,Ethiopia Employment Type: Full-time About Us
  • Awo Trading PLC is a growing leader in the specialty coffee industry, dedicated to sourcing, roasting, and delivering exceptional coffee globally. We value innovation, sustainability, and teamwork. Join us to grow your career while shaping the future of coffee!
Job Description
  • We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Coffee Supply Chain Specialist to manage our green and roasted coffee export processes, with a focus on the Chinese market. The ideal candidate will possess deep coffee industry knowledge, cupping certification, and proven expertise in export documentation and compliance.
Key Responsibilities - Manage end-to-end export processes for green coffee and roasted coffee, ensuring compliance with international trade regulations. - Oversee quality control through professional coffee cupping (Q Grader/SCA certification required) and sensory analysis. - Prepare, review, and process export documentation (e.g., invoices, certificates of origin, phytosanitary certificates, customs declarations). - Navigate China-specific import regulations, tariffs, and customs clearance procedures. - Coordinate logistics with suppliers, freight forwarders, and distributors to ensure timely deliveries. - Maintain accurate records of inventory, shipments, and supplier contracts. - Collaborate with sourcing, roasting, and sales teams to optimize supply chain efficiency. - Support new market entry strategies, particularly within the Asia-Pacific region. - Cooperate with the team to complete the tasks assigned by company. Qualifications & Requirements - Education: Bachelor’s degree in Coffee Science, Agri-business, Supply Chain, or related field. - Certification: Q Grader or SCA Cupping Certification (mandatory). - Experience: - 2–3 years in coffee green bean sourcing, export operations, or quality control. - Proven track record in managing export documentation and customs procedures, especially for China. - Skills: - Fluency in English (written and spoken) for international communication. - Proficiency in export management software and Microsoft Office Suite. - Deep understanding of coffee processing, grading, and defects. - Personal Attributes: - Integrity, responsibility, and proactive work ethic. - Strong team player with problem-solving agility. - Passion for coffee and commitment to long-term career growth with the company. Why Join Us? - Competitive salary + performance bonuses. - Opportunities for professional development in a dynamic global coffee business. - Collaborative culture focused on innovation and sustainability. - Play a key role in expanding our footprint in Asia’s specialty coffee market. How to Apply Submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience to awosolution@163.com with the subject line: "Application: Coffee Supply Chain Specialist – [Your Name]". Include your salary expectations and earliest start date. Job Address Bole Atlas

ሃም አዲስ የጥርስ ህክምና ክሊኒክ ሁለት እንግዳ ተቀባይ (ሪሰፕሽኒስት) አወዳድሮ መቅጠር ይፈልጋል። ስለሆነም ማንኛውም ቀጥሎ የተመለከተውን መስፈርት የምታሟላ ሴት ተወዳዳሪ ማመልከትና መወዳደር ትችላለች።

2.  እንግዳ ተቀባይ (ሪሰፕሽኒስት) ተግባርና ኃላፊነት

· ወደ ክሊኒኩ የሚመጡ ታካሚዎችን በትህትና እና በመልካም የእንግዳ አቀባበል ስርዓት ተቀብሎ ማስተናገድ

  • በታማኝነት እና በብቃት ቤታችንን የምታስተዳድር እንዲሁም ልጃችንን በፍቅር የምትንከባከብ፣ ቁም ነገረኛ እና ሙያዊ የቤት ሰራተኛ እና ሞግዚት በአስቸኳይ እንፈልጋለን
የስራው ኃላፊነቶች
  • ጣፋጭና ጤናማ ምግቦችን በንጽህና ማዘጋጀት፣ የቤቱን አጠቃላይ ንጽህና መጠበቅ፣ ልብስ ማጠብ እና ማስተካከልን ጨምሮ የቤት ውስጥ ስራዎችን በብቃት መምራት አዲስ የተወለደችውን ልጃችንን ሙሉ ትኩረት በመስጠትና ደህንነቷን በመጠበቅ መንከባከብ፣ ንጽህናዋን መጠበቅ እንዲሁም በእድገቷ ላይ መሳተፍ
የምንፈልጋቸው መስፈርቶች:
  • ትምህርት: በምግብ ዝግጅት የሙያ ስልጠና ያጠናቀቀች ሆና በሞግዚትነት፣ በተንከባካቢነት ወይም በነርሲንግ ልምድ ያላት ዕድሜ: ከ25 - 40 ዓመት የሆናት ልምድ: በቤት ውስጥ ሥራ እና በሕፃናት እንክብካቤ ቢያንስ የ 2 ዓመት የተረጋገጠ ልምድ ያላት ቁርጠኝነት: ቢያንስ ለአንድ ዓመት ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ለመስራት ፍላጎት ያላት እና የቤተሰብን ደንብ የምታከብር ማረጋገጫ: አስተማማኝ ዋስ እና ከዚህ በፊት ከሰራችባቸው ቦታዎች የሥራ ልምድ ማረጋገጫ ማቅረብ የምትችል ባህሪ: ሐላፊነት የሚሰማት፣ ታማኝ፣ ተግባቢ እና ለቤተሰብ አባላት አክብሮት ያላት
የምናቀርባቸው ጥቅማጥቅሞች:
  • ደመወዝ:   በስራ ልምድና በብቃት ላይ ተመስርቶ ከ8,000 እስከ 13,000 ብር የሚደርስ በጣም ማራኪ ክፍያ የስራ ሁኔታ: የተረጋጋና ምቹ የስራ አካባቢ እንዲሁም ከቤተሰብ አባላት ጋር መልካም ግንኙነት ምግብ እና መኖሪያ: ስራው ከቤተሰብ ጋር መኖርን የሚጠይቅ (live-in) ስለሆነ፣ ለሰራተኛው ምግብ እና ምቹ መኖሪያ ሙሉ በሙሉ ይሸፈናል የእድገት ዕድል: ለረጅም ጊዜ አብሮን በመስራት ለወደፊት የሚጠቅም ጠንካራ የስራ ልምድ የማግኘት ዕድል
አስፈላጊ ማሳሰቢያ:
  • ይህ የስራ ቅጥር በህጋዊ የስራ ውል ስምምነት የሚፈጸም ሲሆን የሙከራ ጊዜ (probation) ይኖረዋል። ከመቅጠራችን በፊት ሙሉ የጀርባ ታሪክ ማጣራት (background check) እናደርጋለን። ይህ ሁሉ የምናደርገው እኛ እንደ ቀጣሪ ለዚህ ሂደት የምንሰጠውን ከፍተኛ ትኩረት እና ቁም ነገር ለማሳየት ነው ስለሆነም፣ ሙሉ ብቃት የሌላችሁ፣ ምንም አይነት የስራ ልምድ የሌላችሁ ወይም ለስራው ቁርጠኝነት የጎደላችሁ አመልካቾች ከማመልከት እንድትቆጠቡ በአክብሮት እናሳስባለን ይህ ማስታወቂያ ለግል አመልካቾች ብቻ ነው፤ በኤጀንሲ ወይም በደላላ በኩል የሚመጡ ጥያቄዎችንም ሆነ አመልካቾችን አንቀበልም ለማመልከት፡ ለዚህ ስራ ግምት ውስጥ ለመግባት ከታች የተዘረዘረውን የማመልከቻ ሂደት በትክክል እና ሙሉ በሙሉ መከተል የግድ አስፈላጊ ነው።
  • ለዚህ ስራ ለማመልከት፣ አጭር የራስ ቪዲዮ (Selfie Video) በመቅረጽ ከታች ወደተጠቀሰው የቴሌግራም አድራሻ ይላኩ።
  • ቪዲዮው የሚከተሉትን መረጃዎች በግልጽ መያዝ ይኖርበታል፦
  • ሙሉ ስምዎ ያለዎት አጠቃላይ የስራ ልምድ ለምን ለዚህ ስራ ተመራጭ እና ምርጥ እጩ እንደሆኑ የሚጠብቁትን የደመወዝ መጠን አስፈላጊ ማሳሰቢያ: ማመልከቻዎች ተቀባይነት የሚኖራቸው በተጠቀሰው የቴሌግራም አድራሻ እና በቪዲዮ መልዕክት ብቻ ነው። በሌላ መንገድ የሚቀርቡ ማመልከቻዎች ግምት ውስጥ አይገቡም።

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description
  • Ethio College Prep (ECP) equips Ethiopian students to secure world‑class education in the U.S. and Canada. Since 2019, we’ve guided hundreds to scholarships and admissions at top universities. As we scale our programs, we need a magnetic online presence to reach even more students.

  • Comfortable with Google Workspace, scheduling, and collaboration tools

Benefits

title: Content Creator and Copy Writer
description:
• Dream Space Realty, a property developer based in Ethiopia
Role Overview: 
  • We’re seeking a talented Content Writer/Copywriter to produce engaging, high-quality content that aligns with our brand voice and marketing goals. This role involves creating content for blogs, social media, marketing materials, and company documentation.

title: School Director
description:
Job Summary:
  • The school director is the chief administrator responsible for the overall management and leadership of the school. This includes overseeing academic programs, staff performance, student behaviour, and daily operations to ensure a high standard of education and a safe, nurturing environment. The Director works closely with teachers, parents, and the community to uphold the school’s mission, promote student success, and implement policies that support learning and development.
Key Responsibilities: • Provide strategic direction and long-term planning for the school. • Set clear goals and expectations for staff and students. • Lead staff meetings, training, and professional development initiatives. • Monitor and evaluate teaching standards, curriculum implementation, and student performance. • Support teachers in lesson planning, classroom management, and assessment practices. • Introduce innovative approaches to improve academic outcomes. • Recruit, manage, and evaluate teaching and non-teaching staff. • Foster a positive, collaborative staff culture. • Address performance issues and ensure accountability. • Promote a respectful, inclusive, and safe environment for all students. • Establish and enforce clear behavioural expectations. • Work with teachers and parents to address behavioural or emotional concerns. • Communicate regularly and transparently with parents. • Build strong relationships with families and local community stakeholders. • Organize school events, meetings, and outreach programs. title: Graphics & Motion Designer
description:
Job Summary
  • We are seeking a highly creative and detail-oriented Graphics Designer with premium capabilities in both static design and motion graphics. The ideal candidate will be responsible for conceptualizing, designing, and delivering high-quality visuals that align with our brand identity and marketing goals. This role requires strong technical expertise, artistic flair, and the ability to work under tight deadlines while maintaining exceptional quality standards.
Key Responsibilities
  • Conceptualize and design engaging visual content for digital, and multimedia platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animations for promotional videos, social media, advertising campaigns, and internal projects.
  • Develop creative concepts, and style frames in collaboration with the marketing and creative teams.
  • Ensure brand consistency across all designs and media formats.
  • Work closely with Production team, Sales persons, and other designers to execute campaigns effectively.
  • Adapt and localize content for different platforms and audiences.
  • Stay updated on design trends, motion graphics techniques, and emerging tools to keep our creative assets innovative.
  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.
  • Prepare and deliver final artwork in appropriate formats for production or publication.Qualifications & Requirements
Education & Experience
  • 1–2 years of professional experience in graphic design, including at least 2 years in motion graphics.
  • Proven and strong portfolio showcasing high-quality static and motion design work.
Required Skills:
  • Adobe Illustrator (Advanced)
  • Adobe Photoshop (Advanced)
  • Adobe After Effects (Advanced)
  • Adobe InDesign (Intermediate)
  • Premiere Pro (Intermediate)
Bonus Skills
  • Blender
  • DaVinci Resolve
  • Knowledge of 3D software is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of typography, color theory, and layout principles.
Soft Skills
  • Strong creative thinking and visual storytelling skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and high standards of quality.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to receive and implement feedback constructively.
  • Effective time management and organizational skills.
Application Requirements
  • Updated CV/Resume.
  • Portfolio link showcasing both static graphic design and motion graphics projects.Job Address Welosefer, Wengelawit Area

title: Senior Vue + Ionic Mobile App Developer
description:
Job Overview
  • We are seeking a Senior Mobile App Developer to lead the transformation of an existing Vue.js web application into a high-quality, fully functional mobile app for both iOS and Android platforms. The ideal candidate has deep experience in Ionic Vue, Capacitor, and native mobile integrations, especially around push notifications, authentication, and native performance optimizations.
Key Responsibilities
  • Architect and build a mobile application using Ionic Vue and Capacitor, leveraging the existing Vue.js web codebase.
  • Refactor and optimize UI components for mobile usability and performance.
  • Integrate push notification services (Firebase Cloud Messaging or OneSignal) with full support for token-based registration, user segmentation, and real-time delivery.
  • Implement and test platform-specific features (camera, storage, offline support, etc.).
  • Manage platform setup and configuration for both Android and iOS, including provisioning profiles, keystore management, and store submissions.
  • Collaborate with UI/UX designers and backend developers to ensure seamless integration and consistency across platforms.
  • Ensure app quality through automated testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 5+ years of professional development experience
  • Proven expertise with Vue.js and Ionic Vue
  • Strong experience with Capacitor and native plugins (iOS & Android)
  • Hands-on experience integrating push notifications using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) or OneSignal
  • Solid understanding of mobile security best practices, including secure storage, authentication flows, and permissions
  • Experience deploying apps to the App Store and Google Play
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for mobile
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Messaging) or similar backend services
  • Experience with native mobile languages (Swift, Kotlin) is a plus
  • Knowledge of accessibility and responsive design for mobile platforms

title: Chief Finance Officer (Hotel and Restaurant Sector)
description:
Summary
  • We are looking for a proactive Senior Finance Officer to oversee financial operations critical
  • to our restaurant’s success. This role will manage accounts payable, inventory costing,
  • revenue reporting, and compliance, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in a fast-paced
  • hospitality environment. The ideal candidate will drive cost-control initiatives and support
  • strategic financial decisions to enhance profitability
Responsibilities
  • Manage end-to-end accounts payable for suppliers (food, beverage, equipment).
  • Oversee daily revenue reconciliation (POS systems, cash handling).
  • Track inventory costs, waste, and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold).
  • Prepare financial reports (P&L, budgets, variance analysis) specific to F&B
  • operations.
  • Ensure compliance with tax regulations (VAT, sales tax) and restaurant policies.
  • Optimize cash flow management and payroll processing for hourly staff.
  • Collaborate with kitchen/operations teams on inventory audits and cost control.
Requirements
  • BA/BSc Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • 5+ years in finance roles, preferably in restaurants/hospitality.
  • Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, SAP) and POS systems (e.g.,
  • Toast, Square).
  • Advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, cost modeling).
  • Experience with inventory management and COGS analysis.
  • Excellent English communication skills (for vendor/team coordination).
  • Ability to start immediately in an onsite role.
Job Address Addis Ababa

title: Investor Relations & CRM Campaign Manager (GoHighLevel + LinkedIn + Clay)
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW:
  • Redeem Investments is a U.S.-based private equity firm raising capital for two real estate funds focused on converting undervalued commercial properties into medical and hospitality assets.
  • We are expanding our investor outreach team and are seeking a highly organized, tech-savvy virtual team member who can help us manage and automate investor communications.
POSITION OVERVIEW:
  • We are hiring a remote Investor Relations & CRM Campaign Manager to execute our lead outreach strategy using GoHighLevel, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Airtable.
  • This is not just a tech role
  • — we’re looking for someone who can build relationships, manage LP communication flows, and help convert cold investor leads into warm relationships.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: * Set up email automation workflows in GoHighLevel (GHL) using our templates * Track and segment LP leads using CRM stages (Cold → Warm → Hot → Booked) * Use Clay to enrich lead data from LinkedIn profiles * Export lead lists from LinkedIn Sales Navigator and filter by investor profiles * Send personalized messages through LinkedIn and GoHighLevel based on warm stages * Schedule investor calls using Calendly * Update the CRM in Airtable or Google Sheets with lead status and notes * Respond to basic LP inquiries with clear and professional English * Report on campaign performance weekly (opens, clicks, call bookings) QUALIFICATIONS: * 1+ year GoHighLevel experience required (building workflows, tagging, email automations) * Fluent written and spoken English (C1/C2 level) * Comfortable with LinkedIn lead sourcing and messaging * Experience using Clay.com or other enrichment tools (or fast learner) * Familiar with Google Sheets / Airtable for CRM tracking * Professional, organized, and reliable with great attention to detail * Bonus: Experience in investor relations, lead generation, or real estate/private equity WORK SETUP: * Fully remote * timezone alignment with US ,PST/EST * 10–15 hours/week to start, with potential to expand to full-time * 1–2 Zoom syncs per week with our Managing Partner or team lead

title: MERN Stack + PHP Developer
description: Job Opportunity: Experienced MERN Stack + PHP Developer Wanted! We’re looking for a versatile and seasoned full-stack developer with strong skills in both the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and PHP to join our growing engineering team. If you can confidently switch between modern JavaScript frameworks and legacy PHP systems, enjoy building scalable web applications, and deliver high-quality code fast—we want to hear from you! IMPORTANT NOTE: This position is for experienced professionals. You should be comfortable jumping into existing codebases, improving architecture, and delivering production-ready features with minimal hand-holding. Budget & Benefits * Compensation: 35k net * Contract Type: Full-time (or fixed-term contract) * Location: Remote or on-site **Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain web applications using the MERN stack and PHP * Build and consume RESTful APIs and third-party integrations * Translate UI/UX designs into responsive front-end interfaces * Write clean, modular, and well-documented code * Debug, refactor, and improve performance across both JavaScript and PHP codebases * Participate in code reviews and collaborate with product, QA, and DevOps teams * Maintain and upgrade legacy PHP systems while migrating selected components to Node.js/React Requirements * Proven experience (3+ years) working with MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) * Solid experience with PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, or custom PHP) * Strong grasp of JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and frontend best practices * Experience with relational and non-relational databases (MySQL, MongoDB) * Proficiency in writing and consuming REST APIs * Good understanding of authentication (JWT, OAuth) and security best practices * Familiarity with Git, CI/CD workflows, and deployment pipelines * Ability to independently read technical documentation and ship production-ready features * Bonus: Experience with GraphQL, TypeScript, or Next.js is a plus Mini-Project(Mandatory) ### Task: Demonstrate your core PHP skills by building a simple Task Manager API ## Project Overview Create a Task Management REST API using pure PHP (no frameworks like Laravel or Symfony). The API should allow basic task operations and be simple enough to run locally using Docker. Core Features API Endpoints * POST /tasks Create a new task * GET /tasks Retrieve all tasks * GET /tasks/{id} Retrieve a single task by ID * PUT /tasks/{id} Update a tasks ## Database Use SQLite* for simplicity * Each task should have: * id (auto-increment) * title (string) * description (text) * status (pending, in-progress, completed) * created_at, updated_at ## Tech Constraints Use vanilla PHP* (OOP style encouraged) Use PDO* for database interaction * Organize code with MVC-like separation: database/, controllers/, models/, routes/ ## Dockerize Provide a Dockerfile and optionally a docker-compose.yml to run the project locally with PHP + SQLite. ## Bonus Points * Add filtering: /tasks?status=completed * Add basic API test script (curl or Postman collection) * Add input validation and meaningful error responses ## Deliverables * Public GitHub/GitLab repository * Include a clean, well-formatted README.md explaining: * How to install dependencies * How to initialize and run the project (with or without Docker) * Sample API requests and responses * (Optional) API auth details if JWT is implemented ## Target The API should run locally in Docker* within a few minutes * Clean, well-documented, and modular code * Do not overengineer — simplicity and correctness are more important How to Apply https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScflzWHFB2ZtcYXhEC7O2N-piqDoq2lPujs54gz0gv9TJ2z8g/viewform?usp=header Job Address Addis ababa

title: Senior React Native Developer
description:
• We are seeking a Senior React Native Developer to join our team and build high-quality, performant mobile applications for iOS and Android.
  • The ideal candidate has significant experience in both React Native and traditional front-end web technologies.
  • You'll be responsible for the entire app development lifecycle, from concept to deployment, working closely with designers, product managers, and other engineers.
  • This role requires a confident, clear thinking individual who can drive technical decisions, mentor junior developers, and ensure the delivery of a great user experience.
What You'll Do
  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance, reusable, and reliable React Native code.
  • Translate designs and wireframes into high-quality code.
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation.
  • Work collaboratively with a cross-functional team to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to other team members.
  • Stay up to date with new technology trends and best practices in mobile development.

  • 5+ years of experience in front-end development, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience with React Native.
  • Deep understanding of React and its core principles, including React hooks and state management libraries like Redux or Zustand.
  • Strong proficiency in React and Next.JS.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, GraphQL, and offline storage.
  • Solid understanding of mobile UI/UX design principles and best practices.
  • Experience with version control tools, particularly Git.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically.
  • Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset. Job Address Around HayaHulet Adey Abeya Stadium, Addis Ababa
