title: Marketing Manager
description:
The Role We’re looking for a Marketing Genius — someone who:
  • Thinks like a creator, not a corporate robot.
  • Can make B2B feel like B2C (fun, human, shareable).
  • Knows how to turn heads and start conversations.
  • Can make Ethiopian businesses say “I need this app” without us begging.
What You’ll Do
  • Invent campaigns that don’t look like campaigns.
  • Hack attention — from Merkato to TikTok.
  • Collaborate with product to turn features into viral moments.
  • Experiment with unconventional channels (offline stunts, Tiktok virals, street activations, meme marketing).
  • Measure what matters — not just likes, but leads and love for the brand.
What We’re NOT Looking For
  • Someone who just copies what other SaaS companies do.
  • Someone who thinks “marketing” = “posting on Instagram twice a week”.
  • Someone who needs a 50-page strategy doc before trying something new.
What You’ll Bring
  • A portfolio of ideas (even if they’re weird).
  • Experience in digital marketing, content creation, or growth hacking.
  • Understanding of Ethiopian culture, humor, and businesses challenges.
  • Comfort with data (you know what’s working and what’s not).
  • Fearlessness — you’re not afraid to try something that might fail.
Bonus Points If You
  • Have made something go viral (even if it was a meme about injera).
  • Have run offline activations that people still talk about.
  • Can shoot, edit, and publish content yourself.
  • Have worked in startups or fast-moving teams.
Why Join Kubona?
  • You’ll be the first marketing hire — you set the tone.
  • You’ll have freedom to experiment (and budget to back it up).
  • You’ll work on a product that’s changing how Ethiopian businesses do business.
  • You’ll be part of a small, hungry, and slightly crazy team that wants to win.
How to Apply Send us:
  • Your CV (keep it short).
  • At least 1 marketing ideas you’d try for Kubona in the first 30 days. (We'll pay you for your idea if we like it, even if you don't get hired)
  • Links to any campaigns, content, or projects you’ve done.
Warning:
  •  If you’re looking for a safe, slow, “let’s just do what everyone else is doing” marketing job — this is NOT for you. If you want to make noise, break patterns, and own the Ethiopian market — welcome to Kubona.

title: Project Manager (Agribusiness Development)
description:
• The Project Manager will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and operational rollout of our agricultural business project. This includes managing pilot farms, coordinating with farmer cooperatives, overseeing agro-processing trials, and ensuring supply chain readiness. The role requires hands-on leadership, strong organizational skills, and the ability to translate the Founder’s vision into actionable, measurable outcomes.
Key Responsibilities 1. Project Planning & Execution Develop and maintain a detailed implementation plan for the agricultural business. Coordinate timelines, budgets, and deliverables across multiple operational areas (crop production, livestock, processing, logistics). Ensure all activities align with strategic goals and feasibility study outcomes. 2. Operations & Supply Chain Oversight Supervise the setup and operation of pilot farm sites (crop & livestock). Oversee procurement of seeds, feed, fertilizers, tools, and other farm inputs. Monitor supply chain efficiency from farm to processing to market. 3. Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement Build and maintain strong relationships with farmer cooperatives, private farmers, suppliers, government agencies, and NGOs. Negotiate agreements and contracts with service providers and partners. 4. Team Leadership Manage and supervise field staff and contractors engaged in farm and processing operations. Provide guidance, mentorship, and performance feedback to team members. 5. Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting Track project progress against KPIs (yields, costs, revenue targets, quality metrics). Prepare monthly and quarterly progress reports for the Founder and potential investors. Recommend adjustments to strategies based on results and market conditions. 6. Risk Management & Compliance Identify operational risks (climate, political, market, supply chain disruptions) and propose mitigation strategies. Ensure compliance with local agricultural, labor, and environmental regulations. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Project Management, or a related field. Minimum of 2 years of experience in agricultural project management, agribusiness operations, rural development, project management, and any relevant work experience. Strong track record of managing multi-stakeholder agricultural projects from inception to completion. Knowledge of Ethiopian agricultural sector, supply chains, and export requirements. Experience with agro-processing and value chain development is a plus. Skills & Attributes Strong leadership and interpersonal skills. Excellent organizational and time-management abilities. Problem-solving mindset with adaptability to changing environments. Strong communication skills (Amharic and English required). Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Performance Metrics Timely and cost-effective delivery of project milestones. Successful establishment of pilot farms and processing facilities. Achievement of initial yield and quality targets. title: CRM Representative (English + Amharic + Tigrigna)
description:
Role Overview:
  • The 'CRM Representative' is responsible for managing customer interactions and ensuring high levels of satisfaction across various communication channels. The role requires timely responses, effective issue resolution, and consistent, brand-aligned communication. As part of the responsibilities, the agent may be required to collaborate with remotely based teams and support customers across different regions.
Key Duties & Responsibilities: Customer Interaction & Support • Handle inbound and outbound communications (email, chat, phone, social media) with customers and clients in a timely, courteous, and professional manner. • Provide accurate product and service information, troubleshoot issues, and ensure prompt resolution. • Assist with online order management: status updates, delivery queries, returns, and refunds. CRM Database Management • Maintain accurate and updated records of all customer interactions in the CRM system. • Ensure data integrity and compliance with local data protection laws (Ethiopia). Customer Relationship Building • Foster positive relationships with customers through proactive engagement and personalized service. • Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling where appropriate. Reporting & Insights • Track and report on customer trends, recurring issues, and service bottlenecks. • Recommend process improvements based on customer feedback and CRM data. Collaboration • Liaise with the Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure a consistent customer experience. • Coordinate with logistics and fulfillment teams for issue resolution. REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS: • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Customer Service, or related fields with relevant experience. - Diploma/Certificate from Ethiopian Aviation Academy is a PLUS and ADVANTAGEOUS. Language Proficiency: • Fluent in ENGLISH (spoken and written) – proficient-standard required. • AMHARIC and TIGRIGNA proficiency is a mandatory, especially for Ethiopia-based customer support. Skills & Competencies: Technical Skills •  Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho). • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms and order management tools. • Competency in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace. Soft Skills • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities. • High attention to detail and accuracy in record keeping. • Empathy and patience in customer handling. • Ability to multitask and prioritize under pressure. • Team player with a proactive attitude. How to Apply:
  • Qualified and interested candidates are invited to send their CV and cover letter to samuel@thelovegrass.com addressed to the Human Resource Department. Please clearly state “CRM Representative” in the subject line. Job Address https://maps.app.goo.gl/1ZLiNGXQ67J48vmr8

title: Accountant & operation assistance
description:
Job Summary:
  •  We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Accountant and Operations Assistant to manage a variety of crucial responsibilities. The ideal candidate will be responsible for handling our accounting and government-related paperwork, as well as assisting with creative video shoots to help us educate and engage our patients. This role is perfect for someone who is organized, adaptable, and a quick learner.

Job Address Around Dembel

Your work will support learners preparing for English proficiency tests and those aiming to improve their overall English skills.

  • marketing targets and widen ECP’s marketing reach

Skills and qualifications
  • American standard English speaking skills

  • Experience with teaching English previously (preferred)

  • Outstanding copywriting, social media, or video production skills
  • Ability to work effectively without oversight
  • Confident written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities
Preferred qualifications
  • Significant experience creating high-quality marketing content
  • Capable of managing multiple competing priorities
  • Comprehensive understanding of impactful marketing tactics
  • Salary: 15,000

We would like to check your ability to create scripts that are engaging and educational as well as your presentation as the face of the video.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor Needed
  • We are looking for a creative and detail-orientated video editor to join our content production team. The ideal candidate has a strong sense of storytelling, understands pacing and flow, and can bring our brand’s vision to life through engaging, high-quality videos.
Responsibilities:
  • Edit raw video footage into polished, engaging content for social media, ads, and other platforms.

  • Work closely with the creative team to execute the project vision.
  • Ensure all edits are on-brand and optimised for specific platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, etc.).
  • Organise and manage media assets for easy access and future use.
  • Stay updated with editing trends, effects, and social media formats.
Requirements:
  • Proven experience in video editing (portfolio required).

  • Opportunity to work on diverse and creative projects.

How to Apply
  • Send your CV, portfolio, and sample work links to mamehussen7@gmail.com , with the subject line Video Editor Application.

description:

The role requires hands-on leadership, strong organizational skills, and the ability to translate the Founder’s vision into actionable, measurable outcomes.
Key Responsibilities 1. Project Planning & Execution Develop and maintain a detailed implementation plan for the agricultural business. Coordinate timelines, budgets, and deliverables across multiple operational areas (crop production, livestock, processing, logistics). Ensure all activities align with strategic goals and feasibility study outcomes. 2. Operations & Supply Chain Oversight Supervise the setup and operation of pilot farm sites (crop & livestock). Oversee procurement of seeds, feed, fertilizers, tools, and other farm inputs. Monitor supply chain efficiency from farm to processing to market. 3. Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement Build and maintain strong relationships with farmer cooperatives, private farmers, suppliers, government agencies, and NGOs. Negotiate agreements and contracts with service providers and partners. 4. Team Leadership Manage and supervise field staff and contractors engaged in farm and processing operations. Provide guidance, mentorship, and performance feedback to team members. 5. Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting Track project progress against KPIs (yields, costs, revenue targets, quality metrics). Prepare monthly and quarterly progress reports for the Founder and potential investors. Recommend adjustments to strategies based on results and market conditions. 6. Risk Management & Compliance Identify operational risks (climate, political, market, supply chain disruptions) and propose mitigation strategies. Ensure compliance with local agricultural, labor, and environmental regulations. Qualifications & Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Project Management, or a related field. Minimum of 2 years of experience in agricultural project management, agribusiness operations, rural development, project management, and any relevant work experience. Strong track record of managing multi-stakeholder agricultural projects from inception to completion. Knowledge of Ethiopian agricultural sector, supply chains, and export requirements. Experience with agro-processing and value chain development is a plus.
Skills & Attributes
  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills. Excellent organizational and time-management abilities. Problem-solving mindset with adaptability to changing environments. Strong communication skills (Amharic and English required). Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Performance Metrics
  • Timely and cost-effective delivery of project milestones. Successful establishment of pilot farms and processing facilities. Achievement of initial yield and quality targets. Strong partner relationships and supplier agreements secured. Job Address Addis Ababa

title: senior electromechanical engineer
description:
Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced senior electromechanical engineer to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will oversee the design, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of electromechanical systems across our projects. This role requires strong technical expertise, project management skills, and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality solutions on time and within budget. Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Oversight Lead and supervise the design, development, and implementation of electromechanical systems. Review and approve technical drawings, specifications, and project plans. Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations, and client requirements. Provide engineering solutions for complex technical challenges. Conduct feasibility studies and cost estimations for proposed projects. 2. Project Management Plan, coordinate, and monitor project execution from initiation to completion. Manage budgets, schedules, and resources effectively. Coordinate with clients, contractors, and suppliers to ensure smooth workflow. Prepare and present technical progress reports to management and stakeholders. 3. Team Leadership & Mentoring Supervise and mentor junior engineers and technical staff. Provide training and knowledge-sharing sessions to enhance team capabilities. Foster a collaborative and high-performance engineering culture. 4. Quality Assurance & Safety Implement quality control processes to ensure project deliverables meet standards. Enforce safety protocols and conduct risk assessments. Perform site inspections and commissioning tests to validate system performance. 5. Continuous Improvement
  • Stay updated with the latest technological advancements in electromechanical engineering. Recommend and implement process improvements for efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Support research and development initiatives for innovative engineering solutions.
Qualifications & Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electromechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering (Master’s preferred).
  • Minimum 7–10 years of proven experience in electromechanical project execution, preferably in industrial, construction, or energy sectors.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, automation, and control technologies.
  • Proficient in engineering design software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, SolidWorks) and project management tools.
  • Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Valid professional engineering license or certification is an advantage.
Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
  • Health insurance and other benefits as per company policy.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

title: Junior Electrical Engineer
description:
Job Summary
  • We are seeking a motivated Junior Electrical Engineer to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will assist in the design, installation, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems across various projects. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early-career engineer eager to learn, develop technical skills, and grow within the company.
Key Responsibilities
  • Technical Support
  • Assist in preparing electrical designs, layouts, and schematics under supervision.
  • Support in reviewing technical specifications and project drawings.
  • Participate in site inspections and testing of electrical installations.
  • Help identify and resolve basic technical issues during project execution.
Project Assistance
  • Work alongside senior engineers in planning and executing electrical works.
  • Assist in preparing material lists, project schedules, and progress reports.
  • Coordinate with procurement and installation teams to ensure timely delivery of materials.
Documentation & Reporting
  • Maintain project documentation, drawings, and inspection records.
  • Prepare daily/weekly reports for project supervisors.
Compliance & Safety
  • Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with electrical codes, standards, and safety regulations.
  • Report hazards and assist in implementing safety measures.
Qualifications & Skills
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • 0–2 years of relevant work experience (internship or project-based experience preferred).
  • Basic knowledge of electrical systems, wiring diagrams, and relevant software (e.g., AutoCAD).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Willingness to work on-site and travel as needed.
Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive entry-level salary.
  • Professional training and mentorship.
  • Career growth opportunities within the company.

የሥራ መደቡ ዝርዝር ተግባራትና ኃላፊነቶች:-

  •    የአቅራቢውን አፈጻጸም መቆጣጠር እና ጠንካራ የአቅራቢ ግንኙነቶችን መፍጠር፣
  •    የግዢ በጀቶችን ስራ ላይ ማዋል እና ወጪ ቆጣቢ እድሎችን ለይተው ጥቅም ላይ ማዋል፣.

title: Business Development and Marketing Manager
description:
Major Duties and Responsibilities

2.2.1 Managerial Responsibilities

 Participate in hiring, transfer, suspension, layoff, dismissal, or assignment of staff in the department.

 Mentor and develop staff through onboarding programs and personalized career development

opportunities.

 Create and sustain a team culture aligned with the company’s mission, vision, values, and strategic

objectives.

 Lead team performance management processes, setting clear goals and providing regular feedback and

recognition.

 Collaborate with HR for employee rewards, recognition, and disciplinary actions.

 Prepare department work plans, evaluate team performance, and submit periodic reports.

 Develop and maintain internal controls and feedback loops to enhance operational efficiency.

2.2.2 Functional Responsibilities

Market Research and Analysis

 Conduct in-depth market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and

growth opportunities.

 Analyze industry benchmarks, customer behavior, and emerging technologies to inform business and

marketing strategies.

 Develop actionable insights and share periodic market intelligence reports with senior management.

Market Development

 Identify and pursue new market segments, strategic partnerships, and geographical expansions.

 Initiate and manage go-to-market strategies for new services, digital products, and innovations.

 Create business development roadmaps that align with the company’s long-term goals.

Content and Digital Marketing Management

 Oversee the planning, creation, and distribution of compelling digital content across platforms (website,

email, social media, etc.).

 Manage the execution of digital marketing campaigns, SEO/SEM, PPC, social media, and email

marketing to drive engagement and conversions.

 Monitor campaign performance through analytics tools, optimizing based on KPIs and ROI.

Product and Production Marketing

 Develop product positioning, messaging, and branding in line with customer needs and competitive

positioning.

 Collaborate with production and tech teams to align marketing with product development and launches.

 Drive awareness and adoption of new and existing services/products through integrated marketing

plans.

Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

 Implement and oversee CRM strategies to improve client acquisition, engagement, retention, and

loyalty.

 Leverage CRM systems and customer data analytics to enhance service delivery and personalize

marketing efforts.

 Ensure continuous customer feedback loops and service improvement based on satisfaction metrics.

Branding and Communication

 Ensure consistent application of brand guidelines across all communication channels.

 Provide strategic input in executive and board-level communications, including monthly and quarterly

reports.

 Create persuasive marketing materials, proposals, presentations, and business documents to support

sales efforts.

Reporting and Performance Tracking

 Generate reports and dashboards to measure campaign effectiveness, brand health, and customer

satisfaction.

 Track competitor activities and assess risks and opportunities in the external marketing environment.

Strategic Collaboration

 Foster collaboration across departments including Sales, IT, Operations, and Finance to ensure

alignment and synergy.

 Lead initiatives for marketing process improvements and cross-functional coordination.

Other Duties

 Perform other related responsibilities as assigned by the General Manager to support business objectives.

Core Focal Areas;

 Proven experience in market research and analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive

positioning.

 Strong background in market development, including expansion strategies and customer segmentation.

 Demonstrated skills in content marketing management, with the ability to plan, create, and manage

compelling content across platforms.

 Hands-on experience in digital marketing, including SEO, SEM, social media, and email campaigns.

 Solid understanding of product marketing, including go-to-market strategy, positioning, and product

lifecycle management.

 Familiarity with production processes related to marketing materials and campaign execution.

 Proficient in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and strategies to drive customer engagement and retention

Job Address
Bole

title: SCRUM MASTER
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for guiding and coaching a development team in applying the Scrum framework. He /She will serve the team by helping them self-organize, fostering collaboration, and removing impediments that may hinder their progress. The goal is to create a productive and healthy environment where the team can deliver its best work.

Key Responsibilities

·        Facilitate Scrum Ceremonies: The Scrum Master leads and facilitates all key Scrum events, including:

o   Daily Standups (Daily Scrum): Ensuring the meeting is brief and focused on what the team will do to achieve the Sprint Goal.

o   Sprint Planning: Helping the team determine what work can be completed in the upcoming sprint and how to accomplish it.

o   Sprint Review: Working with the team and stakeholders to review the completed work and gather feedback.

o   Sprint Retrospective: Guiding the team in a reflective session to identify areas for improvement and create action items for the next sprint.

·        Remove Impediments: The Scrum Master acts as a shield, protecting the team from external distractions and removing any roadblocks or obstacles that prevent them from completing their work.

·        Coach and Mentor the Team: They continuously coach the team on Scrum principles and Agile methodologies, helping them to become more self-organizing and cross-functional. This includes guiding them on best practices for user stories, backlog refinement, and other techniques.

·        Serve the Product Owner: The Scrum Master supports the Product Owner in their role, such as helping them manage and refine the product backlog and ensuring clear communication between the Product Owner and the development team.

·        Foster a Collaborative Environment: The Scrum Master promotes a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement within the team. They help resolve conflicts and ensure that communication is effective.

·        Report on Progress: He/She often use tools like burndown charts and other metrics to analyze progress and performance, providing visibility to the team and stakeholders.

·        Champion Agile Practices: The Scrum Master advocates for Agile values and principles throughout the organization, helping other departments and stakeholders understand how to work effectively with the Scrum team.

Required Skills and Qualifications

·        Proficiency in Agile and Scrum: A strong understanding of the Scrum framework, its artifacts, events, and techniques is essential. Knowledge of other Agile frameworks like Kanban is also beneficial.

·        Servant Leadership: The ability to lead by serving and empowering the team, rather than giving orders.

·        Excellent Communication and Facilitation Skills: The Scrum Master must be a strong communicator and skilled facilitator to lead meetings and discussions effectively.

·        Problem-Solving and Conflict Resolution: The ability to identify and resolve impediments and conflicts within the team.

·        Coaching and Mentoring: A passion for helping others learn, grow, and improve their skills.

·        Adaptability: The flexibility to adjust to the changing needs of the team and the project.

·        Experience: Often requires prior experience in a Scrum Master role, or a related role in software development.

Place of Work: Merkato, Around Anuar Mosque, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Employment Contract: Full Time, Permanent

Salary: Negotiable

Job Address
Infront of Grand Anwar Mosque, Merkato

title: Cashier (ገንዘብ ያዥ)
description:
ዋና ተግባራትዎ

ትዕዛዞችን ከአስተናጋጆች እና በቀጥታ ከደንበኞች መቀበል እና ለምግብ ዝግጅት/ለኩሽና ማስተላለፍ።
ምግብ/መጠጡ ሲዘጋጅ የክፍያ መጠየቂያ (invoice) ማዘጋጀት።
ገንዘብ፣ የክሬዲት/ዴቢት ካርድ እና የሞባይል ክፍያዎችን በንቃትና በትክክል መቀበል።
ቴሌብር እና ሌሎች የኦን ላይን ክፍያዎችን (online payment systems) በአግባቡ ማስተዳደር።
የተመዘገቡት ትዕዛዞች፣ ዋጋዎች እና ጠቅላላ ድምር በትክክል መያዛቸውን ማረጋገጥ፤ ግልጽ ደረሰኞችንም መስጠት።
የሥራ ቦታውን እና የመመገቢያ ቦታውን ንጹህ እና የተደራጀ ማድረግ።
የደንበኞችን ጥያቄዎች በደስታ መመለስ፣ ልዩ ምግቦችንና ዕለታዊ ቅናሾችን መምከር።
ከኩሽና እና ከሌሎች የሬስቶራንቱ ሰራተኞች ጋር በቡድን መስራት።
ሁሉንም የደህንነት፣ የንጽህና እና የገንዘብ አያያዝ ሥርዓቶችን መከተል።
በሥራ እየገፉ ሲሄዱ፣ ስልጠናና ክትትል እየተሰጠዎት መሰረታዊ የሂሳብ ሥራዎችን መውሰድ።
ከእርስዎ የምንጠብቃቸው ነገሮች

ቀደም ሲል የገንዘብ ያዥነት ወይም የPOS ሲስተም ልምድ ያለው/ያላት ቢሆን ይመረጣል፤ ስልጠና ይሰጣል።
የቴሌብር እና ሌሎች የክፍያ ሥርዓቶችን የመጠቀም ልምድ።
ቴሌግራም ወይም ዋትስአፕን የመሳሰሉ ፋይል ማጋሪያ መተግበሪያዎችን (file sharing apps) የመጠቀም ችሎታ።
እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ የሂሳብ እና የኮምፒውተር ክህሎት፤ ለዝርዝር ጉዳዮች ትኩረት የመስጠት ብቃት።
ፈገግታ ያለው/ያላት፣ ታጋሽ እና ችግር ፈቺ የሆነ/የሆነች አመለካከት።
ተለዋዋጭ የሥራ ሰዓት፣ ቅዳሜና እሁድ እና በበዓላት ቀናት ውስጥ ጨምሮ፣ የመስራት ፍላጎት።

title: scrum master/ project manager
description:
• We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master / Project Manager with a strong programming foundation to join our team full-time in Addis Ababa. In this role, you will facilitate agile processes, manage project timelines, and ensure seamless delivery of software products. Your technical expertise will allow you to handle infrastructure and deployment tasks, and step into development work as required. This is an in-person position requiring presence at our Addis Ababa office.
Key Responsibilities - Lead stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and other Scrum ceremonies to keep teams aligned and productive. - Manage project scopes, timelines, budgets, and resources using agile methodologies, ensuring on-time delivery of high-quality software. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, designers, and stakeholders to define requirements and resolve blockers. - Oversee infrastructure setup, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes to maintain reliable and scalable systems. - Provide hands-on support in software development when needed, including coding, debugging, and code reviews. - Track project progress using tools like Jira, Trello, or similar, and report on key metrics to leadership. - Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying process inefficiencies and implementing best practices. - Ensure compliance with security, quality, and regulatory standards in all project phases. Qualifications and Skills - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). - Proven experience as a Scrum Master, Project Manager, or similar role in a software development environment (3+ years preferred). - Strong programming foundation with proficiency in languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar. - Hands-on experience with infrastructure management (e.g., AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes) and deployment tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions). - Familiarity with agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban) and project management tools. - Ability to contribute to development tasks, including full-stack or backend work, as needed. - Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills. - Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM) is a plus. - Must be based in Addis Ababa for full-time in-person work. What We Offer - Competitive salary of 30,000 ETB per month. - Full-time employment with opportunities for professional growth and skill development. - Collaborative work environment in our office. If you are a technically savvy leader passionate about agile project management and ready to make an impact, apply today by sending your resume and cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Assembly Technician (Electrical & Electromechanical Assembly)
description: Job Title: Assembly Technician Duty Station:  Assembly Facility, Kotebe 02, Addis Ababa Job Purpose We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Assembly Technician to join our production team in assembling CKD (Completely Knocked Down) electrical and electromechanical appliances, including induction stoves, solar energy systems, water pumps, and controllers. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and efficiency of our manufacturing operations by interpreting technical schematics, using hand and power tools, and maintaining strict adherence to safety and quality standards. This role requires strong technical aptitude, hands-on assembly experience, and a commitment to continuous improvement within a fast-paced production environment. Key Responsibilities 1. Assembly of Electrical & Electromechanical Products Assemble CKD components (e.g., induction stoves, solar products, and water pumps) per technical drawings, SOPs, and safety guidelines. Fit electrical components (wiring, circuits, PCBs) and mechanical parts (motors, pumps, housings) accurately. Perform functional tests (e.g., voltage checks, pressure tests) to verify product operability and safety. Report defects, missing parts, or assembly issues to supervisors promptly. 2. Quality Control & Testing Inspect components for defects before and after assembly. Conduct performance tests using multimeters, pressure gauges, or other diagnostic tools. Troubleshoot and rectify faults in assembled units (e.g., loose connections, misaligned parts). Document test results and maintain quality records. 3. Workshop & Production Support Maintain tools, equipment, and workstations in clean, safe, and organized conditions. Follow safety protocols (e.g., PPE, hazard handling). Assist in inventory management by tracking parts and requesting materials as needed. Support the packaging/labeling of finished goods for dispatch. 4. Documentation & Compliance Record daily production logs, tool usage, and defects. Participate in training, audits, and process improvement initiatives. Qualifications and Skills Education & Experience TVET Level III/Diploma or above in Electrical/ Electromechanical/ Electronics/ Mechatronics/  Mechanical  , or a related field. 1+ years of experience in electrical/electromechanical assembly, appliance repair, or manufacturing. Experience with CKD assembly, hand/power tools (e.g., soldering irons), and measuring instruments (AC tester, DC tester, and multimeters). Technical Competencies Ability to read assembly manuals, wiring diagrams, and engineering drawings. Basic knowledge of electrical circuits and metalworking. Familiarity with quality control and safety standards. Soft Skill Attention to detail and manual dexterity. Teamwork and communication skills. Job Address Assembly Facility, Kotebe 02, Addis Ababa

title: Assembly Lead (Electrical & Electromechanical Assembly)
description: Job Title: Assembly Lead(Electrical & Electromechanical Assembly) Duty Station:  Assembly Facility, Kotebe 02, Addis Ababa Job Purpose We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Production Supervisor to oversee the daily assembly operations of CKD electrical and electromechanical appliances, including induction stoves, solar products, water pumps, and controllers. The ideal candidate will play a key role in ensuring efficient production workflows, high-quality output, and optimal team performance. This position serves as a vital link between the assembly team and senior management, with responsibilities spanning production scheduling, safety compliance, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. A strong background in manufacturing processes, team leadership, and quality control is essential for success in this role. Key Responsibilities 1. Team Leadership & Workflow Management •   Supervise and mentor assembly technicians, assigning tasks based on skills and priorities. •   Monitor attendance, productivity, and adherence to SOPs; address performance gaps. •   Foster a collaborative and safety-conscious work environment. 2. Production Planning & Execution •   Develop and maintain daily/weekly production schedules to meet targets. •   Track output, downtime, and material usage; report variances to management. •   Optimize workflows to reduce bottlenecks (e.g., reassigning tasks, improving layouts). •   Coordinate with the warehouse/logistics team to ensure the timely availability of parts/tools. 3. Quality Control & Compliance •   Enforce quality standards for assembled products (e.g., electrical safety tests, functional checks). •   Conduct random inspections and collaborate with QC teams to resolve defects. •   Ensure 5S (Sort, Set, Shine, Standardize, Sustain) and lean manufacturing principles are followed. 4. Safety & Training •   Implement and monitor safety protocols (PPE, equipment handling, hazard reporting). •   Organize safety drills and corrective actions post-incidents. •   Train technicians on new assembly processes, tools, or products. 5. Reporting & Cross-Functional Coordination •   Prepare daily production reports (output, delays, resource utilization). •   Liaise with the Engineering Manager on team performance, skill gaps, and equipment needs. •   Support new hire onboarding and skill development programs. Qualifications and Skills Education & Experience •   BSc/Diploma in Industrial//Electrical/ Electromechanical/ Mechanical Engineering or related field. •   5 years of experience in manufacturing/assembly supervision, preferably in electromechanical products. •   Proven track record of meeting production targets and improving processes. Technical Competencies •   Strong knowledge of assembly line operations, CKD processes, and quality control. •   Familiarity with lean manufacturing, 5S, and safety standards. •   Basic proficiency in basic computer and Microsoft soft wares. Leadership & Soft Skills •   Decisive leadership with the ability to motivate teams under pressure. Additional Note Experience with electrical product assembly, solar products, or induction stoves is a plus. Job Address Assembly Facility, Kotebe 02, Addis Ababa

title: SCRUM MASTER
description:
Job Summary
  • Responsible for guiding and coaching a development team in applying the Scrum framework. He /She will serve the team by helping them self-organize, fostering collaboration, and removing impediments that may hinder their progress. The goal is to create a productive and healthy environment where the team can deliver its best work.
Key Responsibilities ·        Facilitate Scrum Ceremonies: The Scrum Master leads and facilitates all key Scrum events, including: o   Daily Standups (Daily Scrum): Ensuring the meeting is brief and focused on what the team will do to achieve the Sprint Goal. o   Sprint Planning: Helping the team determine what work can be completed in the upcoming sprint and how to accomplish it. o   Sprint Review: Working with the team and stakeholders to review the completed work and gather feedback. o   Sprint Retrospective: Guiding the team in a reflective session to identify areas for improvement and create action items for the next sprint. ·        Remove Impediments: The Scrum Master acts as a shield, protecting the team from external distractions and removing any roadblocks or obstacles that prevent them from completing their work. ·        Coach and Mentor the Team: They continuously coach the team on Scrum principles and Agile methodologies, helping them to become more self-organizing and cross-functional. This includes guiding them on best practices for user stories, backlog refinement, and other techniques. ·        Serve the Product Owner: The Scrum Master supports the Product Owner in their role, such as helping them manage and refine the product backlog and ensuring clear communication between the Product Owner and the development team. ·        Foster a Collaborative Environment: The Scrum Master promotes a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement within the team. They help resolve conflicts and ensure that communication is effective. ·        Report on Progress: He/She often use tools like burndown charts and other metrics to analyze progress and performance, providing visibility to the team and stakeholders. ·        Champion Agile Practices: The Scrum Master advocates for Agile values and principles throughout the organization, helping other departments and stakeholders understand how to work effectively with the Scrum team. Required Skills and Qualifications ·        Proficiency in Agile and Scrum: A strong understanding of the Scrum framework, its artifacts, events, and techniques is essential. Knowledge of other Agile frameworks like Kanban is also beneficial. ·        Servant Leadership: The ability to lead by serving and empowering the team, rather than giving orders. ·        Excellent Communication and Facilitation Skills: The Scrum Master must be a strong communicator and skilled facilitator to lead meetings and discussions effectively. ·        Problem-Solving and Conflict Resolution: The ability to identify and resolve impediments and conflicts within the team. ·        Coaching and Mentoring: A passion for helping others learn, grow, and improve their skills. ·        Adaptability: The flexibility to adjust to the changing needs of the team and the project. ·        Experience: Often requires prior experience in a Scrum Master role, or a related role in software development. Place of Work: Merkato, Around Anuar Mosque, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Employment Contract: Full Time, Permanent Salary: Negotiable Job Address Infront of Grand Anwar Mosque, Merkato

Alongside ELA TV, we’re developing multiple other digital products across different industries — giving our design team the chance to work on diverse, high-impact projects.

  • As our first UI/UX Designer, you’ll shape the user experience for ELA TV and other upcoming products. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to turn requirements and user stories into intuitive, visually engaging designs. We work primarily in Figma, so you’ll need to be highly skilled in using it for everything from wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes and design systems.

  • Conduct usability testing and iterate based on feedback.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
  • Build and manage scalable design systems in Figma for multiple products.

  • Proven UI/UX design experience with a strong, varied portfolio.
  • Expert-level Figma skills — from creating responsive layouts to managing shared component libraries and design systems.
  • Experience designing for both mobile and web (bonus for TV apps).
  • Strong understanding of user-centred design principles and accessibility.
  • Ability to work from detailed requirements and user stories, delivering practical solutions.
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects and adapting to shifting priorities.
  • Bonus: Experience in branding, motion design, or creating micro interactions.
Why Join Us Shape the visual identity of both ELA TV and other innovative products. Fully funded startup with a clear 6-month roadmap for our flagship platform. Opportunity to work on varied projects — streaming, ecommerce, and more. Collaborative, ambitious, and creative team culture. Clear career growth as our product portfolio expands. title: Junior Accountant & Casher
description:
Urgent Vacancy Announcement Job Title: Junior Accountant & Cashier Location: Addis Ababa Reports To: Finance & Admin About the Organization:
  • New Bright Community Development Center (NBCDC) is a charitable organization established in November 2016 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Its objective is to implement a critical integrated economic, social, and educational project that will have a greater impact on the holistic development of marginalized women, adolescents, and youth in poor communities of Addis Ababa and the Oromia region.
Job Summary:
  • We are currently seeking a motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our finance team as a Junior Accountant and Cashier. This role will involve accounting tasks and cashier duties, requiring strong organizational skills, accuracy, and a keen eye for detail.
Key Job Responsibilities:
  • As a Junior Accountant & Cashier, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:
  • Manage daily cash transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with financial policies.
  • Prepare and maintain records of all financial transactions, including receipts, invoices, and vouchers.
  • Support monthly and annual financial reporting processes.
  • Assist in preparing payroll and tax calculations.
  • Reconcile bank statements and cash accounts regularly.
  • Handle petty cash, ensuring proper documentation for all expenses.
  • Prepare payroll
  • Provide support during audits by ensuring all required financial documentation is readily available.
  • Adhere to cash handling and security procedures
  • Maintain confidentiality and security of financial records.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a similar role and sector.
  • Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • High level of integrity and attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Salary: Negotiable
How to Apply:
  • Interested candidates are encouraged to send their CV, cover letter, and other credentials to newbright2017@gmail.com by August 24, 2025. Please include the position title Junior Accountant & Cashier in the subject line of your email.
  • For more information, contact us at +251954411442 Job Address Sidist Kilo, Infront of "Etege Menen" Girls' Boarding school

title: Quality assurance
description:
• We are seeking a Junior Quality Assurance and Automation Tester to join our team and contribute to ensuring the quality and reliability of our applications.
  • This is an exciting opportunity to start your career in QA by working alongside experienced developers and QA engineers in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
  • You’ll be involved in testing activities from planning through execution, with opportunities to build automated test scripts and gain hands-on experience with modern QA tools and practices.
Key Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and senior QA engineers to understand product requirements and design test cases.
  • Execute manual and automated test cases to validate functionality, performance, and reliability.
  • Identify, document, and track bugs and inconsistencies using issue-tracking tools (e.g., gitlab,azure,trello).
  • Assist in writing and maintaining automated test scripts using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar.
  • Perform regression, smoke, and exploratory testing on web and/or mobile applications.
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of test plans, test data, and test documentation.
  • Continuously learn and stay up-to-date with QA tools, processes, and best practices

title: Web Designer
description:
• Job Description: Freelance Web Designer (Figma Specialist)
  • Company: Dynamic Design Location: Remote Position: Freelance / Project-Based
About Us
  • At Dynamic Design, we believe in the power of design to transform ideas into exceptional digital experiences. We're a creative agency dedicated to building beautiful, user-centric websites and applications that solve real-world problems for our clients. Our team is collaborative, passionate, and committed to excellence in everything we create.
  • Join us on a project basis and play a pivotal role in shaping the visual identity and user experience of diverse and exciting products.
The Role: What You'll Do We are looking for a talented and passionate freelance web designer with deep expertise in Figma to collaborate with us on various client projects. You will be responsible for the design process, from conceptualising ideas and crafting wireframes to delivering high-fidelity, interactive prototypes ready for development. Your key responsibilities will include: · Designing web applications, marketing sites, and other digital products using Figma as your primary tool. · Creating low and high-fidelity wireframes, user flows, and prototypes to effectively communicate interaction and design ideas. · Developing and maintaining design systems within Figma for projects, ensuring consistency and scalability. · Collaborating with our team to understand client requirements and translate them into elegant design solutions. · Preparing meticulous handoff documentation and specifications for developers within Figma (using auto-layout, variants, etc.). · Iterating on designs based on feedback from our team and clients. Who You Are (Requirements) Must-Haves: · Proven experience in web and product design. · An exceptional portfolio that demonstrates deep proficiency in Figma. We want to see your process: wireframes, component libraries, interactive prototypes, and final UI designs. · Mastery of Figma features, including Auto Layout, Components (and Variants), Styles, and Prototyping. · Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and responsive design. · Excellent visual design skills with a keen eye for typography, layout, color, and spacing. · Ability to manage time effectively across projects, meet deadlines, and incorporate feedback. · Professional communication skills for client-facing interactions (through our team). Nice-to-Haves: · Experience building or working with a design system. · Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS. · Experience in an agency environment working with multiple clients. Project Terms & Compensation · Contract Type: Freelance/Project-Based. · Compensation: Payment is negotiated per project based on scope and complexity. We welcome discussions to agree on a fair rate for both parties. · Payment Schedule: Payment is issued upon satisfactory completion and delivery of the final project assets. · Work Flexibility: This is a 100% remote position, allowing you to work from anywhere. How to Apply
  • Sound like the perfect fit? We’d love to see your work!
  • Please send your portfolio link and a brief introduction to mmarew@gmail.com with the subject line: "Freelance Figma Designer - [Your Name]".
  • In your application, please include:
1. Your portfolio link (essential). 2. Your hourly or project-based rate range. 3. A note about your availability. Dynamic Design is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all freelancers and clients. Important Considerations & Recommendations: · Clarity on Payment Terms: Stating "payment on finish of project" is common for freelancing but can be a red flag for designers if the project is large. To attract top talent, consider: · Milestone Payments: For larger projects, propose a structure (e.g., 30% upfront, 40% after mockups, 30% on final delivery). This protects both you and the designer. Marew Masresha, · Be Prepared to Discuss: Be ready to negotiate and discuss the project's scope in detail before agreeing on a price. · "Salary Negotiations Based on Project": I have rephrased this to "Payment is negotiated per project" which is the standard and clearer phrasing for freelance work. · Portfolio is Key: The most important thing you will evaluate is their Figma portfolio. Look for clean, modern design and an understanding of UX principles.

You will perform a range of photo manipulations in this practical position in accordance with project specifications and preexisting concepts. The technical delivery of flawless, realistic, and high quality visual composites will be your main priority.
  • Someone who is methodical, meticulous, and enjoys the process of transforming numerous photos into a polished final product would be perfect for this role.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop: You must have a strong working knowledge of Photoshop, including expertise in layers, masking, blending, and color correction.

  • Organizational skills: Strong file management habits and the ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Portfolio required: A portfolio showcasing your technical skills in photo manipulation and compositing is a must.
  • If you are a skilled Photoshop user who takes pride in the technical aspects of image manipulation, we encourage you to apply.

title: Finance Manager
description:
• On behalf of our client, Netsa Trading PLC, we are looking for a competent candidate to fill the position of Finance Manager.
Position Overview Job Title: Finance Manager Location: Megenagna , Addis Ababa Engagement: Permanent Reports To: General Manager Industry: Metal Works Job Summary
  • Netsa Trading PLC, a growing company engaged in the metal works sector, is seeking a ful-time Finance Manager.
  • This role will replace the current part-time finance manager and take over the leadership of two junior accountants.
  • The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in financial management, reporting, and compliance, and will play a crucial role in strengthening the company’s financial operations as it expands.
Key Responsibilities
  • Oversee and manage all financial operations of the company.
  • Supervise and mentor two junior accountants.
  • Prepare, review, and analyze financial statements and reports.
  • Ensure compliance with tax laws, proclamations, and financial regulations.
  • Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Support strategic planning and decision-making with financial insights.
  • Manage relationships with external auditors, banks, and tax authorities.
Qualifications & Requirements
  • BA degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (Master’s degree is an advantage).Minimum of 7 years’ relevant experience, with at least 3 years in a managerial role in a manufacturing company.

  • Proficiency in accounting software and MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).
  • Excellent analytical, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Integrity, discretion, and ability to work under pressure.
Work Location & Hours
  • Based in Megenagna, Addis Ababa at the company’s head office.
  • Regular business hours with occasional flexibility as required.
Salary & Benefits
  • 40,000 – 50,000 gross, might have a room for more based on negotiation
How to Apply
  • If you are up to the challenge and meet the requirements, please send your CV and a brief cover letter quoting the job title in the subject line (Finance Manager | Netsa Trading PLC) to info@ethiocv.com before August 25, 2025.
  • Kindly indicate your last salary and current location in your CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted Job Address Megenagna , Addis Ababa

title: IT EXPERT
description: Key Tasks and Responsibilities: A. Data Center & Infrastructure Management:  Design, implement, and maintain the company's data center infrastructure, including servers, storage systems, and network racks.  Manage and configure core network devices such as switches, routers, and firewalls to ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability.  Monitor and troubleshoot all network and server infrastructure to minimize downtime and resolve technical issues promptly. B. System Administration & Security:  Administer and maintain various operating systems, ensuring system health, security patching, and user access control.  Implement and manage security protocols and best practices to protect the network from unauthorized access, cyber threats, and data breaches.  Oversee the installation, configuration, and maintenance of security software, ensuring a robust defense posture.  Configure and manage firewalls and security appliances to enforce network security policies and traffic filtering. C. Technical Support & Operations:  Provide advanced technical support for all internal IT systems, including network connectivity, hardware, and software issues.  Collaborate with internal teams to understand their technical needs and propose scalable and efficient IT solutions.  Manage relationships with IT vendors and suppliers, ensuring the timely procurement of necessary equipment and software licenses.  Document all IT infrastructure configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge management. The qualities we are looking for are:  Strong expertise in data center management, including server, switch, router, and firewall administration.  In-depth knowledge of network security principles and practices.  Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.  High degree of self-direction and a proactive approach to system maintenance and security.  Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with both technical and non-technical staff.Detail-oriented with a meticulous approach to documentation and system configuration.  A growth mindset and the ability to stay updated with new technologies.Qualification:  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field. Experience:  At least 3-5 years of hands-on experience in a similar role, with a focus on data center and network infrastructure.  Proven experience in configuring and managing servers, switches, routers, and firewalls from major vendors (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Dell, HP).  Familiarity with various operating systems and security software.  A track record of successfully implementing and maintaining secure and reliable IT environments. Key Performance Indicators:  Network uptime and availability rates.  Timeliness of resolving IT support tickets.  Effectiveness of security measures in preventing breaches or unauthorized access.  Efficiency in managing IT infrastructure projects and procurements.  Overall user satisfaction with IT support and system performance. Job Address Bole Medhanialem

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
• Looking for a senior solutions architect for money lending website that will also become a money lending app.
  • Must have at least 8 years experience in software development to be considered
  • In your message explain why you be a good fit for this role. Please explain your software experience and your certifications that make you an experienced solutions architect
  • We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Solutions Architect to design and oversee the architecture of a scalable, secure, and high-performance money lending website.
  • This role requires deep expertise in system design, cloud infrastructure, API integrations, and security best practices in fintech.
  • You will work closely with engineering teams to define technical roadmaps, optimize system performance, and ensure compliance with industry regulations.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and develop the end-to-end architecture for a money lending platform, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
  • Define technical strategies and best practices for frontend, backend, databases, and third-party integrations.
  • Lead the selection and implementation of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and DevOps pipelines (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.).
  • Establish and enforce security protocols to protect sensitive financial data, ensuring compliance with financial regulations (PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc.).
  • Design robust API ecosystems, enabling seamless integration with payment gateways (Stripe, Plaid, PayPal), credit scoring systems, and identity verification services.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and business stakeholders to align technology solutions with business goals.
  • Optimize system performance, ensuring fast transaction processing, high data integrity, and failover mechanisms.
  • Oversee database architecture (SQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.), ensuring efficient data storage and retrieval.
  • Stay updated with emerging fintech trends, AI-driven risk assessment, and blockchain-based lending models.
Requirements:
  • 8+ years of experience in software architecture, system design, or solutions architecture.
  • Proven experience designing financial, lending, or fintech applications with high-security requirements.
  • Strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) and serverless architectures.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and API management.
  • Knowledge of data encryption, fraud prevention, identity verification (KYC/AML), and compliance frameworks.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, or Go.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Familiarity with machine learning for risk analysis and fraud detection is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, leadership abilities, and stakeholder communication.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience in financial services, lending platforms, or digital banking.
  • Expertise in blockchain-based smart contracts for lending (optional).
  • Background in AI-driven risk assessment and predictive modeling.
What We Offer:
  • Competitive salary & performance-based bonuses.
  • Flexible work options (remote).
  • Opportunity to work on an innovative fintech platform.
  • Professional development & leadership growth opportunities.
How to Apply:
  • If you’re re a Senior Solutions Architect looking to shape the future of digital lending with cutting-edge technology, we’d love to hear from you!
  • Apply now with your resume and portfolio!

title: Video Editor
description:
• Donkey tube is looking for a highly skilled Video Editor. The Video Editor's primary responsibility is to lead the post-production process after a video has been filmed.
  • The role involves transforming raw footage into high-quality, impactful content that adheres to the company’s mission of changing lives and bringing hope to many.
  • The editor is responsible for the entire workflow, from file management to final delivery, ensuring every video is produced to the highest standards.
 Key Responsibilities
  •  Manage post-production workflow: Receive, organize, and manage all video and audio files from various sources.
  • This includes collaborating with supervisors to properly transfer and store hard drives.
  • Edit and produce high-quality videos: Transform raw footage into finished content within deadlines, including creating rough and final cuts, and performing color correction and color grading.
  • Enhance and innovate content: Source high-quality sound and stock footage, proactively learn new editing techniques, and share knowledge with the team.
  • You'll also create video trailers, thumbnails, and subtitles as needed.
  • Ensure compliance and quality: Take preventive measures against copyright issues, add sponsor logos, and ensure videos are ready for upload at least 24 hours before release.
  • You'll also obtain final sign-off from the editing supervisor on all completed work.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 2 years Proven experience as a video editor with a strong portfolio.
  • Proficiency in professional video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro).
  • Experience in color correction and color grading.
  • Knowledge of video and audio file formats and best practices for file management.
  • A keen eye for detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of copyright laws related to video and audio content.Job Address Ayat

title: Senior civil engineer
description:
We are seeking a detail-focused, knowledgeable and professional Senior Civil Engineer to join our team! The ideal fit for the role will have a strong background in Civil Engineering and have prior experience in the full phase of private or public sector builds. The key focus of the position is to design, build and oversee building projects, ensuring cost efficiency and smooth running within budget and deadline. have a skill on bid document preparation

Ascertain the project goals, budgets, and overall key factors.
Design, develop and review technical building and infrastructure plans and drawings for the project.
Operate required equipment to assist with the overall build of the project.
Supervise the on-site team, ensuring the design and build concepts are being followed.
Ensure proper maintenance and servicing schedule is set out for the infrastructure.
Work with the project team to foresee and avoid, when possible, any obstacles that may present themselves during the construction or planning phase.
Work in line with health and safety guidelines at all times.
Provide project reports to executives.
Make suggestions on cost-reducing procedures for the project.fs.
bid document preparation

Strong analytical skills, with keen attention to detail

Able to work to agreed deadlines and timescales

Good problem-solving abilities
Ability to prioritize own time and workload

description:
Duty Station: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia   Position Summary
  • We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Tender Specialist (Office Engineer) to join our team.
  • The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading bid and tender applications, designing solar systems, preparing technical documentation, and supporting grant applications.
  • This position requires strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work within strict deadlines.
  • The successful candidate will play a crucial role in securing new projects and ensuring their successful implementation according to engineering and compliance standards.
Key Responsibilities :- Bid & Tender Management (60% of role)
  • Lead technical proposals for government, NGO, and private sector tenders
  • Complete 10+ quarterly bids (1.5M-50M ETB)
  • Conduct site assessments and develop technical specifications
  • Coordinate with suppliers for accurate quotations
  • Prepare bid defense presentations and ensure timely submissions
  • Deliver high-quality proposals with detailed methodologies and precise documentation
  • Ensure alignment with client requirements and industry standards
  • Track bid status, maintain bid database, and report on conversion rates
  Solar System Design
  • Design grid-tied, off-grid, and hybrid solar systems
  • Perform energy load calculations and system sizing
  • Design backup generator integration systems
  • Create electrical diagrams and system schematics
  • Ensure compliance with EPC standards
  • Conduct electrical calculations for optimal performance
  • Prepare technical drawings using AutoCAD
  • Analyze and improve existing electrical systems
  Technical Documentation
  • Prepare comprehensive specifications for solar systems
  • Develop operation and maintenance manuals
  • Create as-built documentation
  • Maintain detailed records of designs and documentation
Grant & Client Support (Business Development and Sales Department)
  • Provide technical inputs for grant applications
  • Develop technical components including specifications and impact assessments
  • Create budgets and timelines for grant-funded projects
  • Support grant reporting and compliance documentation
  • Assist Sales with technical presentations to customers
  • Provide advisory services on project development
  • Evaluate contractor proposals and support negotiations
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards throughout implementation
  • Project Implementation Support (Business Development and Sales Department)
  • Monitor technical aspects of project implementation
  • Prepare technical reports on implementation progress
  • Resolve technical issues that arise during installation
  Qualifications Education & Experience 
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering, or related field Minimum 3-5 years of experience in solar PV system design and implementation
  Required Skills
  • Strong knowledge of solar PV system design principles and standards
  • Proficiency in solar design software (PVsyst, HOMER, AutoCAD, or similar)
  • Understanding of electrical engineering principles and Ethiopian electrical codes
  • Experience with energy load calculations and system sizing
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet strict deadlines
  • Fluency in English required; knowledge of Amharic highly desirable
  Compensation Structure
  • Base Salary: 25,000-35000 ETB gross monthly
  • Performance Commission: Up to 10,000- 15000 ETB additional monthly based on achievement of targets outlined above
  • Bid Success Bonuses: Additional performance-based bonuses for successful bid applications and project completions as detailed above

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
• Donkey tube is looking for a highly skilled Video Editor. The Video Editor's primary responsibility is to lead the post-production process after a video has been filmed.
  • The role involves transforming raw footage into high-quality, impactful content that adheres to the company’s mission of changing lives and bringing hope to many.
  • The editor is responsible for the entire workflow, from file management to final delivery, ensuring every video is produced to the highest standards.
 Key Responsibilities
  • Manage post-production workflow: Receive, organize, and manage all video and audio files from various sources.
  • This includes collaborating with supervisors to properly transfer and store hard drives.
  • Edit and produce high-quality videos: Transform raw footage into finished content within deadlines, including creating rough and final cuts, and performing color correction and color grading.
  • Enhance and innovate content: Source high-quality sound and stock footage, proactively learn new editing techniques, and share knowledge with the team.
  • You'll also create video trailers, thumbnails, and subtitles as needed.
  • Ensure compliance and quality: Take preventive measures against copyright issues, add sponsor logos, and ensure videos are ready for upload at least 24 hours before release.
  • You'll also obtain final sign-off from the editing supervisor on all completed work.
  • Lead and Mentor a Team: Lead a team of video editors, providing constructive feedback and guidance to help them grow their skills.
  • You'll also manage project timelines and workflows for the team, ensuring all projects are completed on schedule and to a high standard
  • . You will also coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth project execution from start to finish.
Qualifications
  • 5 years Proven experience as a video editor with a strong portfolio.
  • Proficiency in professional video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro).
  • Experience in color correction and color grading.
  • Knowledge of video and audio file formats and best practices for file management.
  • A keen eye for detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of copyright laws related to video and audio content.
  • An applicant without a portfolio can not be considered. Job Address Ayat

title: Sales and Marketing Director
description:
Sales and Marketing Director For Tech Company
We are looking for a results-driven, visionary Sales and Marketing Director For our Tech company, with strong business acumen, deep knowledge of the Ethiopian market, and a proven track record in B2B technology sales. This role demands a highly strategic thinker who is also hands-on, able to negotiate at the highest levels, lead diverse teams, and drive revenue growth through well-designed and localized sales and marketing strategies.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with strategic management tools such as the Balanced Scorecard (BSC), OKRs, and performance dashboards to align business functions, measure success, and ensure sustainable growth.
Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Planning and Execution

· Develop and implement strategic sales and marketing plans aligned with company goals.

· Apply frameworks such as Balanced Scorecard (BSC) to link strategic objectives with performance indicators across customer, financial, internal process, and learning/growth perspectives.

· Analyze local and regional market trends, customer behaviors, and competitive landscape.

· Customize strategies to Ethiopia’s socio-economic, political, and cultural realities.

2. Team Leadership and Management

· Lead and mentor sales and marketing teams across ERP, custom software, and website builder verticals.

· Set clear KPIs and monitor team performance using strategic performance tools (BSC, KPIs, OKRs).

· Build a performance-based, collaborative, and learning-driven culture.

3. Sales Management

· Develop sales plans with clear targets and achievable milestones.

· Oversee major client negotiations, especially in high-value B2B opportunities.

· Expand geographic coverage in Ethiopia, including underserved regional and rural markets.

4. Marketing Management

· Design and oversee integrated marketing campaigns across traditional and digital platforms.

· Ensure culturally appropriate and impactful branding, PR, and content strategies.

· Leverage Ethiopian media (TV, radio, digital, roadshows) to build awareness and trust.

5. Customer Relationship & Market Expansion

· Strengthen client loyalty through consultative selling, after-sales service, and account management.

· Explore expansion opportunities in COMESA countries and regional markets.

· Lead efforts in customer satisfaction measurement and retention strategy.

6. Budgeting and Financial Oversight

· Prepare and manage annual sales and marketing budgets.

· Monitor campaign and project ROI to ensure cost-efficiency.

· Align budget planning with strategic objectives and resource availability.

7. Compliance and Governance

· Ensure adherence to all relevant laws and regulations in Ethiopia’s tech and commercial sectors.

· Implement transparent documentation, reporting, and review practices.

8. Digital Transformation and Innovation

· Champion adoption of CRM systems, marketing automation tools, and e-commerce platforms.

· Drive ERP integration within marketing and sales workflows.

· Ensure tech strategy is responsive to Ethiopia’s infrastructure limitations.

9. Cultural and Social Intelligence

· Adapt marketing strategies to Ethiopia’s multicultural and multilingual society.

· Respect religious seasons, cultural norms, and social sensitivities in all communications.

· Localize messaging across Amharic, Afaan Oromo, Tigrigna, and other key languages.

10. Reporting and Communication

· Report key metrics and strategic insights to the CEO and Board using structured frameworks like BSC dashboards.

· Represent the company at national and international business forums, exhibitions, and policy consultations.

Special Considerations for Ethiopia

· Economic Insight: Understanding of inflation, exchange rates, import/export challenges, and key regulators (ERCA, Ministry of Trade).

Job Address
Bole

title: Chief Marketing Officer
description:
About
  • TAMCON Software Solution is a dynamic and innovative IT company formed through a strategic joint venture between two industry leaders, Tamesol Communications and Convex ICT Technologies. TAMCON was established to address the specific needs of the Lottery Services in Ethiopia by creating a company that fully complies with gaming regulations while advancing lottery systems development.
  • TAMCON is dedicated to revolutionizing Ethiopia's lottery and digital gaming landscape by providing innovative, secure, and engaging solutions. With a mission to enhance customer experiences and contribute to social progress through responsible gaming practices.
  • TAMCON envisions becoming the leading provider of digital lottery and gaming solutions by continuously evolving offerings and embracing new technologies, and aim to promote responsible gaming while fostering community development and engagement.
Role Description
  • This is a full-time on-site role for a Chief Marketing Officer at TAMCON Software Solutions located in Bole, Addis Ababa. The Chief Marketing Officer will be responsible for market planning, market research, public relations, marketing management, and sales to drive the strategic marketing initiatives of the company.
Qualifications
  • Market Planning and Market Research skills
  • Public Relations and Marketing Management skills
  • Sales skills
  • Strong leadership and project management skills
  • Experience in developing and executing marketing strategies
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Minimum of 8 years of marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership role
  • Lead cross-channel marketing initiatives (digital, traditional, and events).
  • Set KPIs and measure ROI on all campaigns.
  • Manage departmental budgets and ensure cost-efficiency.
  • Represent the marketing department in executive meetings.
  • Carry out additional related tasks as assigned by immediate supervisor and senior managements
Job Requirements
  • Education & Background:
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field required
  • MBA or MSc in Marketing/Business is a plus
  • 8+ years of experience, preferably in tech, media or gaming sectors.
Technical Skills: 
  • Proven leadership in brand building and digital transformation.
  • Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads
  • SEO/SEM tools
  • Email automation (HubSpot)
  • Google Analytics (GA4), Mixpanel
  • Building performance dashboards
  • CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Media buying, ROI optimization
  • Google Workspace
Soft Skills
  • Ability to clearly articulate ideas, actively listen to others, and present information effectively.
  • Ability to work individually and as a team with a common objective of accomplishing the mission of the organization.
  • Ability to manage challenging priorities in fast-paced environments
  • Ability to analyze information objectively, evaluate arguments, and draw logical conclusions to solve complex problems
  • Responsive to feedback and committed to evolving ideas or approaches
  • Ability to maintain strong relationships with colleagues and address disagreements constructively to find mutually agreeable solutions.
  • Strong work ethic fosters professionalism, motivation, and can-do attitude
  • Taking responsibility for one's actions, decisions, and outcomes
What We Offer
  • Competitive salary and performance incentives
  • Creative freedom within a national brand
  • Work on high-visibility campaigns and products
  • Opportunities for skill development and training
  • Supportive, flexible team culture
