title: Expert Video Editor
description:
• Donkey tube is looking for a highly skilled Video Editor. The Video Editor's primary responsibility is to lead the post-production process after a video has been filmed.
  • The role involves transforming raw footage into high-quality, impactful content that adheres to the company’s mission of changing lives and bringing hope to many.
  • The editor is responsible for the entire workflow, from file management to final delivery, ensuring every video is produced to the highest standards.
 Key Responsibilities
  • Manage post-production workflow: Receive, organize, and manage all video and audio files from various sources.
  • This includes collaborating with supervisors to properly transfer and store hard drives.
  • Edit and produce high-quality videos: Transform raw footage into finished content within deadlines, including creating rough and final cuts, and performing color correction and color grading.
  • Enhance and innovate content: Source high-quality sound and stock footage, proactively learn new editing techniques, and share knowledge with the team. You'll also create video trailers, thumbnails, and subtitles as needed.
  • Ensure compliance and quality: Take preventive measures against copyright issues, add sponsor logos, and ensure videos are ready for upload at least 24 hours before release. You'll also obtain final sign-off from the editing supervisor on all completed work.
  • Lead and Mentor a Team: Lead a team of video editors, providing constructive feedback and guidance to help them grow their skills.
  • You'll also manage project timelines and workflows for the team, ensuring all projects are completed on schedule and to a high standard.
  • You will also coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth project execution from start to finish.
Qualifications
  • 5 years Proven experience as a video editor with a strong portfolio.
  • Proficiency in professional video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro).
  • Experience in color correction and color grading.
  • Knowledge of video and audio file formats and best practices for file management.
  • A keen eye for detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of copyright laws related to video and audio content.
  • An applicant without a portfolio can not be considered. Job Address Ayat

title: Anesthetist
description:

Assess, triage, and manage patients at the scene, prioritizing red-level emergencies.
Administer advanced airway management, including endotracheal intubation for patients with respiratory failure.

Manage surgical emergencies pre-transport and during ambulance transit.
Safely transport emergency patients to designated healthcare facilities.
Monitor and provide continuous care to patients during transit.
Communicate effectively with receiving medical teams, providing detailed patient reports, including medical history, condition, and treatment provided.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to help build, manage, and automate our infrastructure. In this role, you will be a critical link between our software development and IT operations teams. You'll be responsible for our CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and system monitoring. A key part of this position involves working directly with our on-premise physical servers and the virtualization layers that run on them. You are the ideal candidate if you have a deep understanding of how to provision, manage, and scale applications in a virtualized, bare-metal environment. You enjoy optimizing the entire lifecycle of our services—from inception and design, through deployment, operation, and refinement. Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain our CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable and efficient software releases.
  • Manage and automate our on-premise infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.
  • Administer and optimize our server virtualization environments, primarily using VMware vSphere, KVM, or Hyper-V. This includes provisioning virtual machines, managing resources, and ensuring high availability.
  • Develop and maintain robust monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to ensure system uptime and performance.
  • Write and maintain scripts (e.g., in Bash, Python, or Go) to automate operational tasks and processes.
  • Manage containerized applications using Docker and support their orchestration.
  • Collaborate closely with development teams to troubleshoot issues and improve application performance, stability, and security.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to production incidents.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, SRE, or Systems Administration role.
  • Strong, hands-on experience managing and automating virtualization platforms on physical servers (e.g., VMware ESXi/vCenter, KVM). You should be comfortable working from the hypervisor level up.
  • Proficiency with at least one scripting language such as Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, particularly Ansible or Terraform.
  • Strong understanding of Linux/Unix administration.
  • Experience with containerization technology (Docker).
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with container orchestration using Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or the ELK Stack.
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, firewalls).
  • Experience working with hybrid cloud environments (on-premise and public cloud like AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
What We Offer

title: Call Center Agent
description: Call Center(Dispatch) Agent History of a Company Who We Are: CABBY is changing the way people travel in Ethiopia. As a leading ride-sharing company, we combine state-of-the-art dispatching systems with an easy-to-use app to offer a ride-sharing experience that’s seamless, affordable, and tailored to local needs. Our goal is to make transportation more accessible and cost-effective for everyone. Why Join CABBY? At CABBY, we’re not just another ride-sharing company; we’re a team dedicated to transforming the transportation industry in Ethiopia. Here’s why you should consider joining us: Innovation at Heart: Be part of a company that’s always at the forefront of technology and innovation. Dynamic Work Environment: Work in a fast-paced, exciting environment where your ideas and contributions matter. Make an Impact: Your work will directly contribute to making transportation easier and more affordable for thousands of people. Growth Opportunities: As we grow, so will your career. We believe in promoting from within and providing opportunities for professional development. What We Value: Excellence: We strive for the highest standards in everything we do. Teamwork: Collaboration and mutual support are the keys to our success. Customer Focus: We are committed to delivering exceptional value and service to our users. Our Partner: CABBY is proud to partner with Bayshore Equity Partners, a leading investment firm based in California. Bayshore specializes in adapting innovative technologies to meet the unique needs of the African market. Their expertise in bringing tailored solutions to local challenges makes them an ideal partner in our mission to revolutionize transportation in Ethiopia. Join Us: If you’re passionate about innovation, dedicated to excellence, and eager to make a real difference in the Ethiopian market, CABBY is the place for you. Come join us and be a part of a team that’s changing the way people move We are looking for: Call center(Dispatch) Agent that will receive and answer customer calls, dispatching appropriate response teams and vehicles. They coordinate logistics between customers and drivers, ensuring efficient routing and response times. The Dispatcher manages the dispatch system, monitors driver logs, tracks routes, and keeps detailed records of activities. They address problems and provide solutions to ensure smooth operations. Roles and Responsibilities: 1. Communication and Coordination: Receive and dispatch ride requests. Prioritize ride requests based on urgency and importance. Dispatch vehicles using radio, phone, or computer systems. Monitor driver routes and status to coordinate and optimize schedules. Maintain communication with drivers to ensure timely pick-ups and drop-offs. Address problems and provide solutions to drivers and customers. 2. Data Management: Enter ride request data into the system and maintain logs and records. Manage a large volume of inbound and outbound calls. Follow company scripts and procedures for handling various call topics. 3. Customer Service: Identify customer needs, clarify information, research issues, and provide solutions. Inform customers about ride costs, estimated wait times, and other relevant details. Ensure drivers follow company guidelines and monitor their performance. 4. Training and Monitoring: Train newly hired dispatchers. Stay informed about events that may increase ride demand. Manage fleet readiness and ensure vehicles are safe and available for customer transport Qualification and Experience Working in RIde/Feres is a plus 12th Grade/Diploma Certificate Previous experience as a Technical Support, Call Center Operator or Customer Service General knowledge of the Addis Ababa landscape Proven Experience as a dispatcher or relevant position is a plus Good Knowledge of Computer usage Active Listener with excellent communication skills Sound Judgement and critical thinking skills Job Address Piassa

title: office manager
description:
Core Competencies
- Organizational Skills: They should be able to juggle calendars, meetings, supplies, and documents without breaking a sweat.
- Time Management: Prioritizing tasks and keeping the office running smoothly, even when things get hectic.
- Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and tactful—both written and verbal. They’ll often be the go-between for staff, vendors, and clients.
- Problem-Solving: Quick thinking and resourcefulness when unexpected issues pop up.

Technical & Administrative Skills
- Proficiency in Office Software: Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and possibly project management tools like Trello or Asana.
- Budgeting and Expense Tracking: Basic financial literacy to manage office budgets and vendor payments.
- Record Keeping: Accuracy and confidentiality in handling employee records, contracts, and other sensitive documents.

- Team Coordination: Ability to support and motivate staff, resolve conflicts, and foster a positive work environment.

- Discretion and Trustworthiness: They’ll often have access to sensitive information—integrity is non-negotiable.

- Adaptability: Offices evolve—your manager should be able to roll with changes.
- Initiative: Someone who doesn’t just wait for instructions but actively looks for ways to improve operations.
- Attention to Detail: From catching scheduling conflicts to proofreading documents, the little things matter.

description: Vacancy Announcement Position: Graduate Trainees – Finance and Accounts Company: Lovegrass Agro-Processing Plc Location: HQ, Addis Ababa or Sululta Plant premise Application Deadline: August 31 ROLE OVERVIEW: Lovegrass Agro-Processing Plc, a fast-growing FMCG company specializing in gluten-free teff-based products, is seeking highly motivated Graduate Trainees in Finance and Accounts. The role is designed to nurture and develop fresh graduates into future finance professionals who will contribute to the company’s growth and compliance with international and local financial standards. Trainees will undergo structured rotations within the Finance Department, gaining hands-on experience in financial reporting, accounting operations, cost management, and ERP systems. description:
• Donkey tube is looking for a highly skilled Video Editor. The Video Editor's primary responsibility is to lead the post-production process after a video has been filmed. You'll also manage project timelines and workflows for the team, ensuring all projects are completed on schedule and to a high standard. You will also coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth project execution from start to finish.
Qualifications

Experience in color correction and color grading. Knowledge of video and audio file formats and best practices for file management. A keen eye for detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. title: General Manager
description:
The General Manager at Yimaru Academy and Consultancy PLC is responsible for overseeing the overall goals and vision of the academy, ensuring smooth operations across all departments, and driving strategic initiatives for growth. This role requires a strong leader with excellent managerial, operational, and business development skills to guide Yimaru Academy’s expansion in English language training, e-learning, and consultancy services.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Management

Develop and execute Yimaru Academy’s strategic vision, ensuring alignment with short-term and long-term goals.
Establish and implement policies, systems, and structures to support the company’s mission and objectives.
Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and market demands to position Yimaru Academy as a leader in the education sector.
Provide regular updates and strategic reports to the Founders / Board of Directors.
Management of Departments

Oversee and coordinate all major departments, ensuring smooth collaboration and efficiency:

Production Team – Ensure high-quality content creation for YouTube, digital courses, and promotional materials.
Marketing Team – Supervise marketing strategies, branding efforts, and digital campaigns to increase visibility and student enrollment.
Administrative Team – Ensure proper office management, HR policies, and day-to-day operations.
Finance Team – Oversee budgeting, financial planning, and resource allocation to maintain financial sustainability.
Operational & Project Management

Supervise and optimize the academy’s day-to-day operations to ensure efficiency and productivity.
Oversee the planning, execution, and evaluation of key projects, such as the e-learning platform and English learning app.
Develop and enforce operational policies and workflows to enhance performance.
Ensure all projects meet deadlines, budgets, and quality standards.
Marketing & Business Growth

Work closely with the Marketing Manager to develop and execute promotional strategies.
Oversee branding, social media presence, and digital marketing campaigns.
Identify new revenue streams, partnerships, and sponsorship opportunities.
Develop relationships with key stakeholders, including government agencies, NGOs, and corporate partners.
Team Leadership & Development

Recruit, train, and mentor staff to build a high-performing team.
Foster a positive work culture and ensure employee engagement.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide professional development opportunities.
Ensure clear communication and collaboration across teams.
Quality Assurance & Customer Satisfaction

Maintain high standards for student experience and learning outcomes.
Address student and client feedback to improve services.
Ensure compliance with educational standards and regulatory requirements.
Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Education Management, Project Management, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a managerial or project management role, preferably in education, training, or e-learning.
Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in strategic planning, budgeting, and financial management.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Proficiency in digital tools, project management software, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Experience in marketing, branding, and business development is a plus.
Passion for education and a strong understanding of the learning industry.

Job Address
22, Town Square Mall

title: Mechanical / Electromechanical Product Designer
description: We are seeking skilled professionals to collaborate on the development of a handheld, motorized hair-weaving tool designed to efficiently attach hair wefts to cornrow braids. The tool will use a rotating curved needle and an internal thread system to improve speed, reduce strain, and create a more ergonomic user experience. Project Phases The work is structured into three phases. Applicants may apply for one phase or multiple phases depending on expertise. Phase 1 – Logic & Mechanism Development Define the mechanical and electro-mechanical logic of the tool. Plan the motion of the curved needle, thread-feeding system, motor integration, and safety features. Deliverable: Technical documentation and diagrams. Phase 2 – Design & Ergonomics Translate the logic into a practical and ergonomic design. Develop handle, motor housing, button placement, and thread spool layout. Ensure the design is user-friendly with a professional aesthetic. Deliverable: Final design drawings ready for CAD. Phase 3 – CAD Modeling & Rendering Build a complete 3D CAD model of the tool. Simulate moving parts for functionality and feasibility. Produce high-quality renders for presentation. Deliverable: CAD files and rendered images. Compensation $150 USD per phase. $150 USD final completion bonus upon delivery of all three phases. Maximum total: $600 USD. Timeline & Requirements Each phase is expected to take 2 weeks. Daily progress updates required. Open to: Mechanical Engineers Electromechanical Specialists Industrial / Product Designers Application Instructions Please send: Your portfolio or samples of previous work. A short summary of your experience and capabilities related to product development, CAD, or electromechanical design. We are looking for consistent, reliable, and detail-oriented professionals who can deliver high-quality results within deadlines.

Amaklo is a fast-growing SaaS B2B Business Directory platform dedicated to helping businesses connect, grow, and thrive in the digital marketplace. We are looking for a passionate and skilled Software Engineer to join our remote team and contribute to the ongoing success of our platform.

As a Software Engineer (Developer ) Team Leader & Manager, you will play a key role in Managing,developing, maintaining, Approved, Controling and supporting Amaklo’s SaaS based platform. You will work closely with our product, design, and operations teams to ensure smooth system performance, deliver new features, and provide technical support to clients when needed.

Key Responsibilities

Managing, Developing, maintaining, Approved, Controling and supporting scalable SaaS solutions for the Amaklo B2B platform.
Provide IT technical support to resolve platform related issues for clients and for better performance and security.
Collaborate with cross functional teams (Manage, design, product, and marketing) to deliver innovative solutions.
Monitor system health, troubleshoot bugs and implement fixes in a timely manner.
Ensure data security, system backups, and smooth integrations with third-party.
One should have knowledge of basic application SAAS, especially those related to the identified target market.
Manage client relationships throughout the entire sale process
Provide weekly reports
Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Software Engineering , Computer Science or related field.
Experience Level: Senior (3+ years of relevant experience).
Strong knowledge of web development technologies & Managing SAAS Experience
Familiarity with SaaS architecture
Good understanding of databases
Experience in troubleshooting, debugging, and providing IT technical support.
Ability to work independently onsite and in a remote environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong problem solving skills, attention to detail, and effective communication.
How to Apply Interested candidates should send their CV/Resume and a brief cover letter to:

info@amaklo.com the subject line: “Software Engineer (Developer ) Team Leader & Manager Amaklo”

Deadline: September 9, 2025

Job Address
Around Summit - Feyel BET

title: Business Analyst: Hospitality & Customer Experience
description:
Job Description:
  • We are looking for a dynamic Business Analyst to join our team, bringing strong expertise in business strategy, customer experience, and service industry analysis. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in hospitality, marketing, and branding, with the ability to translate business needs into actionable insights that drive growth and exceptional customer experiences.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Conduct in-depth business analysis to identify opportunities for product, service, and process improvement in the hospitality and service industry.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, define use cases, and design workflows that enhance customer journeys.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor strategies, and customer behaviors to support strategic decision-making.
  • Collaborate with marketing and branding teams to ensure product positioning and service design align with customer expectations.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications for product and tech teams.
  • Monitor and evaluate KPIs, ROI, and customer engagement metrics to measure business and product success.
  • Provide actionable insights to improve customer experience, loyalty programs, and merchant engagement on the Gursha platform.
  • Ensure business strategies align with regulatory and compliance standards in fintech and hospitality services.
Requirements:
  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst, preferably in hospitality, fintech, or service industries.
  • Strong understanding of customer experience design, loyalty systems, and merchant marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with business process modeling, data analysis, and strategy formulation.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into product features and operational workflows.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and product lifecycle management.
  • Proficiency with tools such as linear , Click Up, MS Excel or other analytics platforms.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Background in hospitality, service design, or digital customer experience platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of marketing, branding, and customer loyalty strategies.
  • Experience working with B2B SaaS platforms, merchant ecosystems, or digital marketplaces.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision-making, business strategy, and customer journey mapping.
How to Apply:

title: Junior Backend Developer
description:
We are seeking a motivated Junior Backend Developer to join our team. In this role, you will collaborate with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services and APIs, primarily using Go. Your responsibilities will include implementing new features, writing tests, and debugging services. If you have a passion for coding, a willingness to learn, and a knack for problem-solving, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities
  • Build and maintain backend services/APIs (mostly REST) under senior guidance. Implement new endpoints and small features using Go. Write and maintain unit/integration tests for your code. Run and debug services locally using Docker / Docker Compose. Fix bugs, respond to small incidents, and implement small performance or correctness improvements. Collaborate in code reviews, follow team conventions and keep documentation up to date. Work with a senior engineer to integrate simple caching (Redis) and basic authentication (JWT). Help set up and run local development environments and assist with CI (GitHub Actions) runs when needed.
Requirement
  • Bachelor degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or related fields. Go (Golang): Comfortable writing idiomatic Go for web services (functions, structs, interfaces, error handling). Gin or another Go web framework with ORM experience for Go(preferably GORM). REST APIs: Experience designing/consuming HTTP/JSON APIs. SQL / PostgreSQL: Read/write queries, basic schema design, migrations, and using a DB client (psql, pgx or similar). Docker & local development: Build images, run containers, use Docker Compose for local stacks. Git & GitHub: Branching, PRs, basic merge conflict resolution. Testing in Go: Writing unit tests and basic integration tests. Fundamentals of authentication/security: JWT basics and password hashing concepts (bcrypt or similar). Good troubleshooting & communication: Able to explain bugs, produce reproducible steps, work in a team.
Nice-to-have
  • Basic Redis usage: caching, simple pub/sub. Basic knowledge of messaging (RabbitMQ) or background jobs. Exposure to gRPC / Protocol Buffers (conceptual or small projects). Some familiarity with WebSockets or SSE (building simple real-time endpoints). Experience with CI (GitHub Actions) and writing simple pipeline steps. Familiarity with observability basics: Prometheus metrics, reading logs, or Sentry. Experience contributing to a team codebase and participating in code reviews.

• Vacancy No: 10 – Attractive and Urgent Nursing Position
About The Role
  • Nurse is Under the general direction and supervision of the respective Head Nurse, the Nurse will be responsible for providing direct patient care, utilising advanced assessment, intervention, and evaluation skills.
  • This role involves delivering high-quality treatment in an accurate and timely manner as ordered by a physician.
  • The Nurse will ensure compliance with all healthcare regulations, guidelines, and accreditation standards, while upholding ethical principles, maintaining patient confidentiality, and providing compassionate care.
Main Duties & Responsibilities
  • Perform appropriate treatments as ordered by a physician in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Provide triage information to physicians and staff referring patients to the clinic.
  • Oversee and monitor patient evaluation and treatment decisions.
  • Supervise the work of employees in supporting roles.
  • Participate in program development and implementation of operating policy and procedure.
  • Oversee and provide direct nursing evaluation and/or other related care and consultation to patients as required.
  • Perform therapeutic nursing interventions as established by the individualised plan of care for the patient.
  • Coordinate services with other patient care units as required.
  • Maintain confidentiality in matters related to patients, families, and client facility staff.
  • Conduct ongoing assessments as determined by the patient’s condition and reprioritize care accordingly.
  • Provide care in a non-judgmental, non-discriminatory manner that is sensitive to the patient’s and family’s diversity, preserving their autonomy, dignity, and rights.
  • Promote continuous improvement of workplace safety and environmental practices.
  • Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Qualification Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Professional Nursing / Clinical Nursing or related field. Work Experience: 1–4 years of related experience.
Remuneration & Benefits
  • Attractive Salary Package – competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience.
  • Overtime compensation for extra working hours.
  • Health and wellness benefits, including medical insurance.
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave.
  • Continuous professional development opportunities, including training and certification programs.
  • Supportive and collaborative working environment. Job Address Stadium, Addis Ababa , Ethiopia

title: Expert Video Editor
description:
• Donkey tube is looking for a highly skilled Video Editor.
  • The Video Editor's primary responsibility is to lead the post-production process after a video has been filmed. The role involves transforming raw footage into high-quality, impactful content that adheres to the company’s mission of changing lives and bringing hope to many.
  • The editor is responsible for the entire workflow, from file management to final delivery, ensuring every video is produced to the highest standards.
 Key Responsibilities
  • Manage post-production workflow: Receive, organize, and manage all video and audio files from various sources.
  • This includes collaborating with supervisors to properly transfer and store hard drives.
  • Edit and produce high-quality videos: Transform raw footage into finished content within deadlines, including creating rough and final cuts, and performing color correction and color grading.
  • Enhance and innovate content: Source high-quality sound and stock footage, proactively learn new editing techniques, and share knowledge with the team. You'll also create video trailers, thumbnails, and subtitles as needed.
  • Ensure compliance and quality: Take preventive measures against copyright issues, add sponsor logos, and ensure videos are ready for upload at least 24 hours before release. You'll also obtain final sign-off from the editing supervisor on all completed work.
  • Lead and Mentor a Team: Lead a team of video editors, providing constructive feedback and guidance to help them grow their skills.
  • You'll also manage project timelines and workflows for the team, ensuring all projects are completed on schedule and to a high standard.
  • You will also coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth project execution from start to finish.
Qualifications
  • 5 years Proven experience as a video editor with a strong portfolio.
  • Proficiency in professional video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro).
  • Experience in color correction and color grading.
  • Knowledge of video and audio file formats and best practices for file management.
  • A keen eye for detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of copyright laws related to video and audio content.
  • An applicant without a portfolio can not be considered. Job Address Ayat

title: Junior Structural Engineer
description:
• We seek a highly motivated and technically competent Junior Structural Engineer with a strong focus on concrete structural systems to join our growing engineering team. The ideal candidate will have at least three (3) years of relevant experience and demonstrate a solid understanding of structural analysis, design, detailing, and site supervision of reinforced concrete buildings and infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Participate in the structural design of concrete buildings, bridges, and infrastructure projects using appropriate design codes (e.g., ACI, Eurocode).
  • Conduct structural analysis and prepare design calculations, drawings, and technical reports.
  • Collaborate with architects, contractors, and other engineers to ensure safe and cost-effective design solutions.
  • Review and interpret architectural and structural drawings.
  • Perform site inspections and provide technical support during construction phases.
  • Ensure compliance with local and international structural design standards and safety codes.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university (required).
  • Master’s degree in Structural Engineering (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in structural design and supervision, specifically involving concrete structures.
  • Proficiency in structural design software (e.g., ETABS, SAFE, SAP2000, STAAD Pro, AutoCAD, Revit).
  • Strong knowledge of construction methods, materials, and site practices.
  • Ability to work independently and in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Mechanical / Electromechanical Product Designer
description:
We are seeking skilled professionals to collaborate on the development of a handheld, motorized hair-weaving tool designed to efficiently attach hair wefts to cornrow braids. The tool will use a rotating curved needle and an internal thread system to improve speed, reduce strain, and create a more ergonomic user experience.

Project Phases

The work is structured into three phases. Applicants may apply for one phase or multiple phases depending on expertise.

Phase 1 – Logic & Mechanism Development

Define the mechanical and electro-mechanical logic of the tool.
Plan the motion of the curved needle, thread-feeding system, motor integration, and safety features.
Deliverable: Technical documentation and diagrams.
Phase 2 – Design & Ergonomics

Translate the logic into a practical and ergonomic design.
Develop handle, motor housing, button placement, and thread spool layout.
Ensure the design is user-friendly with a professional aesthetic.
Deliverable: Final design drawings ready for CAD.
Phase 3 – CAD Modeling & Rendering

Build a complete 3D CAD model of the tool.
Simulate moving parts for functionality and feasibility.
Produce high-quality renders for presentation.
Deliverable: CAD files and rendered images.
Compensation

$150 USD per phase.
$150 USD final completion bonus upon delivery of all three phases.
Maximum total: $600 USD.
Timeline & Requirements

Each phase is expected to take 2 weeks.
Daily progress updates required.
Open to:

Mechanical Engineers
Electromechanical Specialists
Industrial / Product Designers
Application Instructions

Please send:

Your portfolio or samples of previous work.
A short summary of your experience and capabilities related to product development, CAD, or electromechanical design.
We are looking for consistent, reliable, and detail-oriented professionals who can deliver high-quality results within deadlines.

description:

https://forms.gle/JtpvHuS4M2C3nYzp8
መስፈርቶች፡-
ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እና ማማከር ነው፡፡
Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMSፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት ያለው ድርጅታችን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያለው እና ልምድ ያለው አጠቃላይ ተቆጣጣሪ/የዋና አስተዳዳሪ እየፈለግን ነው።

ሱፐር ቡስት አፕ የኢትዮጵያን ተቋማት፣ ቢዝነሶች፣ግለሰቦች፣ትምህርት ቤቶችን በዲጂታል መንገድ ለማብቃት እና በዲጂታል መንገድ እንዲያድጉ ለመርዳት የተቋቋመ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ ነው።

የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ - economic, marketing,Management, business Administration and other related field
  የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ እንቅስቃሴ ያቅዳል፣ ያደራጃል፣ ይመራል፣ ይቆጣጠራል።
  ድርጅቱ ትርፋማ እንዲሆን የሚያስችሉ ፖሊሲዎችንና ስትራቴጂዎችን ነድፎ ይሰራል።
  የድርጅቱን የአጭርና የረዥም ጊዜ አላማ ከግብ ለማድረስ የድርጅቱ የሰው ሃይልና የሰው ሃይል በማቀድ፣ በማደራጀት፣ በመምራትና በመቆጣጠር ይሰራል።
  LMS ፕላትፎርም የሚሆኑ ፕሮዳክሽን ስራ እንዲሰራ ያደርጋል
  አዳዲስ ተቀጣሪዎች ምልመላ፣ ስልጠናና ቅጥር ማከናወን፡፡
  እያንዳንዱ ስራ እና ንዑስ የስራ ሂደት በተገቢው ሁኔታ እየሄደ እንደሆነና የታለመለትን ግብ ሊያሳካ ስለመቻሉ ክትትል ማድረግ...
  ሁሉንም የስራ ሂደቶች መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀት፡፡
  የእያንዳንዱን የስራተኞች ስራ ክንውን መከተታተል ፡፡
  የድርጅቱን የፋይናንስ ፣ የማርኬቲንግ እያንዳንዱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡
  ከፋይናንስ እና አካውንቲንግ ጋር በተያያዘ ያለውን ስራ በእራስም ሆነ ከሚመለከተው ባለሙያ ጋር ሆኖ የየወቅቱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡
  በጀት መመደብና ወጪ መቀነስ
  ፖሊሲ ማርቀቅና እና አተገባበሩንም መተለም
  የሰራተኞችን የስራ አቅምና ባህል እንዲጎለብት መርዳት
  ሁሉም የፋይናንስ እንቅስቃሴዎች በታለመላቸው መልኩ እየሄዱ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ክትትል ማድረግ
  የድርጅቱን ግብርና ቀረጥ መሰል ክፍያዎች በጊዜው መክፈል ወይም እንዲከፈል ማድረግ

title: Full-Stack Mobile Developer
description: We are seeking Full-Stack Mobile Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of a fairly simple e-commerce mobile application from end to end. The ideal candidate has at least one year of hands-on experience building mobile applications and can showcase past work preferably in e-commerce or rental system domains. This role is initially project-based or monthly until project completion, with strong potential to grow into a permanent full-time position. If you enjoy working across both frontend and backend mobile stacks, integrating payment systems, and delivering polished mobile solutions, we would love to hear from you. NOTE: Our offer is 15,000 ETB net, but you may state a reasonable amount you prefer and explain why. We would be happy to consider it if we find it acceptable. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain cross-platform mobile applications (iOS/Android). Implement both frontend UI and backend services (APIs, authentication, databases). Collaborate with designers and stakeholders to deliver smooth user experiences. Develop features for e-commerce and rental workflows (catalog, cart, checkout, booking, etc.). Integrate third-party APIs and payment gateways. Ensure apps are performant, secure, and scalable. Troubleshoot and fix bugs, while ensuring maintainable code quality. Provide documentation and keep the project structure clean. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent hands-on experience. At least 1 year of professional or project experience in mobile application development. Demonstrated experience with at least one full-stack mobile app project. Strong foundation in frontend frameworks (React Native, Flutter) and backend technologies (Node.js, Django, Firebase, or others). Familiarity with databases (SQL or NoSQL). Basic knowledge of authentication and security in mobile apps. Experience working with REST APIs (and optionally GraphQL). Git & GitHub: comfortable with version control and collaborative workflows. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Portfolio or evidence of of app you have built preferably e-commerce or rental apps. Basic knowledge of cloud hosting (AWS, Firebase, or similar). Familiarity with push notifications and in-app messaging. Understanding of deployment to Play Store. Ongoing training to enhance your travel and customer service expertise.

title: Sales Agent
description:
Terms of Reference (ToR)

Position Title: Sales Agent

Organization: Empowered Global Educational Consultancy

Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Contract Type: Full-time

Duration: 1 year

1. Background

Empowered Global Educational Consultancy is committed to helping students access

world-class education opportunities abroad. We collaborate with international universities and

training institutions, guiding students and families through every stage of the study abroad

journey—from program selection to successful enrollment.

As part of our expansion, we are seeking a Sales Agent with a strong background in sales and

marketing to promote our services, recruit students, and strengthen our relationships with global partners.

2. Purpose of the Position

The Sales Agent will be responsible for promoting Empowered Global’s services, achieving

sales targets, and maintaining strong relationships with students, families, and international

institutions. The role requires a motivated professional with proven communication and client

management skills.

3. Key Responsibilities

Sales & Client Engagement

●Promote Empowered Global’s educational services to prospective students and parents.

●Conduct consultations to understand clients’ academic goals and recommend suitable

programs.

●Follow up with clients to ensure smooth applications and provide timely support.

Business Development

Develop and implement strategies to achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.

Build and maintain relationships with international universities and training partners.

Attend education fairs, events, and school visits to market Empowered Global’s services.

Reporting & Communication

●Prepare and present weekly sales reports to management.

●Maintain accurate records of client interactions, leads, and follow-ups.

4. Qualifications

Education:

●Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related

Experience:

●Proven track record in sales and marketing (preferably in education, consultancy, or

service sectors).

●Experience using digital marketing and CRM tools.

Skills & Competencies:

Strong English proficiency (spoken and written).

Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and digital marketing platforms.

Knowledge of Oromifa language is an added advantage.

Women are strongly encouraged to apply.5. What We Offer

Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

Training and professional development opportunities.

A supportive and inclusive work environment.

Career growth opportunities within the company.

6. Application Process

Interested candidates should submit the following:

●Updated CV

●Short cover letter outlining their suitability for the role

Applications should be sent to info@empowered-global.com with the subject line:

“Sales Agent Application – Empowered Global”

For updates or inquiries, applicants may also contact us via

empoweredconsultancyservice@gmail.com.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

Job Address
Jemo Medhanialem church

Basic knowledge of authentication and security in mobile apps. Experience working with REST APIs (and optionally GraphQL). Git & GitHub: comfortable with version control and collaborative workflows. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Portfolio or evidence of of app you have built preferably e-commerce or rental apps. Basic knowledge of cloud hosting (AWS, Firebase, or similar). Familiarity with push notifications and in-app messaging. Understanding of deployment to Play Store. Application Instructions Applicants are requested to: Share a Google Drive folder (or equivalent and remember to give access) with screenshots of past mobile projects and optional add cover letter in there as well. Briefly describe the preferred tech stack you would choose to build an e-commerce app. Highlight relevant project experiences, especially in e-commerce or rental systems. Qualifications: · Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or any related field from a recognized Ethiopian university is also acceptable. (Master’s degree is a plus). · 4+ years of proven experience in pre-sales, tendering, or bid/proposal management within ICT, telecom, or technology-related industries. Skills: · Tender & Proposal Management: Skilled in preparing compliant, competitive, and well-structured bids. · Technical & Commercial Understanding: Ability to translate customer requirements into tailored solutions. · Document Preparation: Strong writing, formatting, and presentation skills for professional proposals. · Market & Competitor Analysis: Skilled in analyzing industry trends and competitors to strengthen bids. · Negotiation & Communication: Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication for client and vendor engagement. · Project Coordination: Experienced in managing multiple tenders simultaneously and aligning with internal stakeholders. · Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to assess tender requirements, risks, and compliance gaps. · Time Management: Efficient in prioritizing tasks and meeting strict submission deadlines. · Software Proficiency: Advanced in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with CRM, ERP, or tender management platforms. · Team Collaboration & Leadership: Works well in cross-functional teams and able to mentor junior tender staff. title: Assembly Technician (Electrical & Electromechanical Assembly)
description: Job Title: Assembly Technician Duty Station:  Assembly Facility, Kotebe 02, Addis Ababa Job Purpose We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Assembly Technician to join our production team in assembling CKD (Completely Knocked Down) electrical and electromechanical appliances, including induction stoves, solar energy systems, water pumps, and controllers. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and efficiency of our manufacturing operations by interpreting technical schematics, using hand and power tools, and maintaining strict adherence to safety and quality standards. This role requires strong technical aptitude, hands-on assembly experience, and a commitment to continuous improvement within a fast-paced production environment. Key Responsibilities 1. Assembly of Electrical & Electromechanical Products Assemble CKD components (e.g., induction stoves, solar products, and water pumps) per technical drawings, SOPs, and safety guidelines. Fit electrical components (wiring, circuits, PCBs) and mechanical parts (motors, pumps, housings) accurately. Perform functional tests (e.g., voltage checks, pressure tests) to verify product operability and safety. Report defects, missing parts, or assembly issues to supervisors promptly. 2. Quality Control & Testing Inspect components for defects before and after assembly. Conduct performance tests using multimeters, pressure gauges, or other diagnostic tools. Troubleshoot and rectify faults in assembled units (e.g., loose connections, misaligned parts). Document test results and maintain quality records. 3. Workshop & Production Support Maintain tools, equipment, and workstations in clean, safe, and organized conditions. Follow safety protocols (e.g., PPE, hazard handling). Assist in inventory management by tracking parts and requesting materials as needed. Support the packaging/labeling of finished goods for dispatch. 4. Documentation & Compliance Record daily production logs, tool usage, and defects. Participate in training, audits, and process improvement initiatives. Qualifications and Skills Education & Experience TVET Level III/Diploma or above in Electrical/ Electromechanical/ Electronics/ Mechatronics/  Mechanical  , or a related field. 1+ years of experience in electrical/electromechanical assembly, appliance repair, or manufacturing. Experience with CKD assembly, hand/power tools (e.g., soldering irons), and measuring instruments (AC tester, DC tester, and multimeters). Technical Competencies Ability to read assembly manuals, wiring diagrams, and engineering drawings. Basic knowledge of electrical circuits and metalworking. Familiarity with quality control and safety standards. Soft Skill Attention to detail and manual dexterity. Teamwork and communication skills. title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
JOB PURPOSE

We are looking for Mechanical Engineer with certified experience of 5 years or more in the
metal industry (Metal Structures and Metal Carpentry)
KEY REPONSIBILITIES

Develop detailed designs of mechanical components like lifting lugs and or steel structure
components, ensuring they meet the required functionality, performance, and safety
standards.
Provide the fabrication and erection supervisors measurements information’s obtained from
the Company AutoCad Drawings.
Utilize CAD (Computer-Aided Design) software to create 2D and 3D models and final products. ActCad (AutoCad).
Provide all the final As-Build Project Drawing.
Provide fabrication / erection procedure under Site Manager guidelines.
Select appropriate materials and components for mechanical systems based on strength,
durability, and cost considerations. Maintain accurate records of work performed, including
maintenance records and reports on repairs and inspections.
Prepare technical documentation, including specifications, reports, and user manuals.
Ensure all designs and modifications are well-documented for compliance, traceability, and
future reference.
In collaboration with Planner and Cost Control Manager monitor and report the Project
advance, weekly and monthly report writing.
Costs Records and Costs Comparison between Budget and Actaul.
Comply with all safety guidelines and regulations, promoting a safety culture in the workplace.
QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical
Engineering
EXPERIENCE

5 years and More experience in
mechanical design or related
engineering roles.
SKILLS/COMPETENCIES

Proficiency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings and specifications.
Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
CAD (Computer-Aided Design)
Excell – PowerPoint – Microsoft

Koysha Hydroelectric Project

title: Logistics Staff
description: Company Overview: Lanniu Plywood Manufacturing PLC, a leading supplier of high-quality plywood, company dedicated to efficient and reliable operations. We are currently seeking a motivated Logistics Staff member to join our team and support our logistics and customs operations. Job Summary: The Logistics Staff will be responsible for handling logistics documentation, maintaining accurate records, and managing customs declaration processes. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with the Ethiopian Customs Declaration website and a solid understanding of customs procedures. Key Responsibilities: Prepare, manage, and file all logistics-related documentation. Handle customs declaration processes using the Ethiopian Customs Declaration website. Ensure compliance with customs regulations and company policies. Coordinate with internal departments and external stakeholders (customs offices, transport agents, etc.). Maintain organized records of shipments, invoices, and customs documentation. Provide support in monitoring and tracking shipments. Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor’s degree/diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Proven experience in logistics documentation and customs declaration. Practical knowledge of the Ethiopian Customs Declaration website. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Good communication skills in Amharic and English. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Benefits: Competitive salary based on experience. Opportunities for career growth and training. Supportive work environment. How to Apply: Interested candidates should send their CV and cover letter to huajianmarketing@gmail.com with the subject line “Application for Logistics Staff Position” or call directly to 0900626862. Job Address Addis Ababa

title: Field Work Officer (Agro-Processing)
description: We are looking for motivated juniors with a good understanding of agribusiness and animal farming who are eager to learn, grow, and contribute to agricultural development. The Agribusiness Assistant will support the planning, implementation, and daily operations of our agricultural projects. This is a hands-on, field-based role that offers valuable experience in crop and livestock management, working directly with farmer cooperatives, and helping to build sustainable agribusiness practices. As the projects are field-based, relocation may be required. Key Responsibilities Project Support & Implementation Assist in carrying out project plans for crop production, livestock farming, and basic processing activities. Provide field-level support to ensure tasks are completed effectively and on time. Farm & Operations Assistance Help set up and manage pilot farms (crop and animal). Support procurement and handling of seeds, feed, fertilizers, and farm tools. Monitor farming practices, yields, and quality standards. Stakeholder Engagement Work closely with farmer cooperatives, private farmers, and suppliers. Support coordination with local communities, government offices, and NGOs. Teamwork & Learning Collaborate with field staff and contractors. Learn directly from experienced team members and gradually take on more responsibility. Participate in training sessions to strengthen technical and professional skills. Monitoring & Reporting Collect and record data on farm activities, yields, and expenses. Assist in preparing progress updates for the management team. What We’re Looking For Confidence in your skills and interest in agribusiness and animal farming. Willingness to relocate and work in rural/field project areas (relocation may be required). Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and grow with the project. Good teamwork, adaptability, and communication skills. Ability to handle fieldwork and problem-solving with a positive attitude. What We Offer Hands-on training and mentorship in agribusiness development. Real experience in farm and agribusiness operations. Growth opportunities with potential for a permanent role. The chance to contribute to impactful projects that support farmers and rural communities.

title: የባህል ምግብ አብሳይ
description:
የሥራ መደብ፦ ከፍተኛ የባህል ምግብ አብሳይ (Senior Traditional Cook)

ድርጅት፦አዲስ ዴፖ ሆቴ

ስለ እኛ: አዲስ ዴፖ ሆቴል ለደንበኞቻችን ጥራት ያላቸውንና ጣዕማቸው የተጠበቀ የኢትዮጵያ ባህላዊ ምግቦችን በማቅረብ ይታወቃል። የሥራ ጥራትንና የደንበኞችን እርካታ ከፍ ለማድረግ በሚኖረን ቀጣይ ጥረት፣ ከፍተኛ ችሎታና ልምድ ያለው/ያላት የባህል ምግብ አብሳይ አወዳድሮ መቅጠር ይፈልጋል።

የሥራ ኃላፊነቶች:

የተለያዩ የኢትዮጵያ ባህላዊ ምግቦችን (የጾም እና የፍስክ) በከፍተኛ ጥራትና ደረጃ ማዘጋጀት።
የምግቦችን ጣዕም እና ጥራት ወጥነት እንዲኖረው ማድረግና መቆጣጠር።
የወጥ ቤቱን ንጽሕና እና የምግብ ደኅንነት ሥርዓቶችን በአግባቡ መተግበር።
ታች ያሉ የወጥ ቤት ሠራተኞችን ማስተባበር፣ ማሰልጠንና መምራት።
ለምግብ ዝግጅት የሚያስፈልጉ ግብዓቶችን ጥራትና መጠን መቆጣጠር።
ተፈላጊ ችሎታና የሥራ ልምድ:

በሙያው ቢያንስ የ 3 ዓመትና ከዚያ በላይ የሥራ ልምድ ያላት።
በተለይ በባህላዊ ምግብ ዝግጅት ላይ ሰፊ ልምድ እና ጥልቅ ዕውቀት ያላት።
ስለ ምግብ ንጽሕናና ደኅንነት አጠባበቅ ጠንካራ ግንዛቤ ያላት።
በቡድን የመሥራትና ቡድንን የመምራት ብቃት ያላት።
ፈጣንና በሥራ ጫና ውስጥ በብቃት መሥራት የምትችል።
እኛ የምናቀርበው:

ተወዳዳሪ ደመወዝና ሌሎች ጥቅማጥቅሞች።
ምቹ እና ዘመናዊ የሥራ አካባቢ ማደሪያን ጨምሮ።
የማመልከቻ ሂደት:

ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ቀን ጀምሮ ባሉት 15 ተከታታይ የሥራ ቀናት ውስጥ፣ የሥራ ልምድ ማስረጃችሁን ከማመልከቻ ደብዳቤ ጋር በማያያዝ ከታች በተጠቀሰው አድራሻ በአካል በመቅረብ ማመልከት የምትችሉ መሆኑን እንገልጻለን።

የሥራ ቦታ፦ አዲስ አበባ፣ ቅድስት ልደታ ለማርያም ቤተ ክርስቲያን አካባቢ፣ ከፖሊስ ሆስፒታል ጀርባ አዲስ ዴፖ ሆቴል

ለበለጠ መረጃ: በሚከተሉት ስልክ ቁጥሮች ይደውሉ።

title: Translator
description:
JOB PURPOSE

Our company is seeking a Translator to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong command of at least two languages Urdu and English, excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work independently. The role involves accurate translation and interpretation of documents, technical manuals, safety guidelines, correspondence, and verbal communication between local staff and international experts, ensuring smooth communication within the company’s metal and mechanical operations.

KEY REPONSIBILITIES

Translate technical documents, manuals, drawings, work instructions, contracts, policies, and reports from English to Pakistani and vice versa.
Provide consecutive and/or simultaneous interpretation during meetings, training sessions, inspections, workshops, and site visits.
Ensure translations are technically accurate, clear, and consistent with industry-specific terminology (metal, mechanical, hydro, welding, machining, fabrication, etc.).
Translate safety guidelines, operating procedures, and notices for workers to ensure compliance with company policies and safety standards.
Maintain confidentiality of company information and sensitive documents.
Assist expatriates and local employees with language support for daily communication.
Proofread and edit translated materials to maintain high quality and accuracy.
Support management with translation of employee contracts, disciplinary letters, and official communications when needed.
Develop and maintain a glossary of technical terms relevant to the company’s metal and mechanical operations.
Maintain confidentiality and protect the integrity of sensitive information.
QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field, such as translation, linguistics, or language studies.

EXPERIENCE
2+ years of experience in professional experience as a translator or interpreter.

SKILLS/COMPETENCIES
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, Urdu and Amharic languages
Strong research skills to ensure accurate translations of technical or industry-specific materials
Strong knowledge of translation software and tools
Capability to perform tasks autonomously and handle multiple responsibilities concurrently
Excellent organizational and time management skills
Strong focus on precision and a dedication to delivering excellent work

WORK CONDITIONS
Full-time position.
Office-based with some travel to supplier locations as needed.
Occasional overtime may be required to meet procurement deadlines.

Job Address

title: Fabric Designer/Clothing Designer
description:
Design Job Posting

Talari is seeking a forward-thinking designer who can blend Ethiopian and Western culture to create unique garment designs. Regardless of your background or education we would love to hear from you, the only thing we ask is please follow the instruction below. Only applicants who complete the Interview Requirement will be considered.

About Us

We produce and sell handwoven simena garments locally at our shop in Welo Sefer and internationally through export. For the past two years, we have operated with full in-house production. Talari provides a unique environment where designers can grow, gain international exposure, and earn above-market wages. We empower our team to design and create exceptional products that showcase the beauty of Ethiopia to the world. Our company also offers strong opportunities for growth, allowing you to expand your knowledge, build new skills, and advance your career.

Role Overview

We are looking for a designer who can create garments primarily using simena products, with minimal use of additional fabrics. A working knowledge of how a simena machine operates is key. The designer will also be responsible for:

Creating fabric patterns (tilet) and fabrics (including but not limited to pieces of clothings and accessories)
Tracing and cutting stencils for production
Sewing prototypes
Reviewing and giving feedback to production outputs
Other tasks as assigned
Key Requirements

Strong drawing and design skills, with the ability to sketch fabric or tilet patterns that can be mapped to a shema by a shemane
Ability to cut, sew, and refine prototypes multiple times a week
Ability to create production ready stencils, that will be used to for final production
Experience working with leather and fabric
Strong understanding of traditional Ethiopian weaving, fabrics, and patterns
Strong eye for detail with the ability to critique in a constructive way
Refined taste to merge modern and international styles with traditional Ethiopian designs using locally handmade fabrics
Formal design training or education preferred. Applicants with demonstrable, refined design skills gained through experience will also be considered
Salary

Up to 15,000 birr (negotiable)

Interview Requirement

Our process is interactive. Before being called for an interview, applicants must complete a design test. Using locally produced fabrics (commonly seen in habesha kemis, gabies, etc.), create an outfit that is modern, elegant, and luxurious. Show your creativity and vision, then send your submission via Telegram. Interviewees that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.

ክፍያ ፡- ወርሀዊ sሚ አበል ብር 2000(ሁለት ሺህ ብር) እና በሚያገኙት የስራ መጠንና ውጤት መሰረት ተደርጎ የሚከፈል ወርሀዊ ብር 300(ሦስት መቶ) ኮምሽን ክፍያ

የስራ ቦታዎች፡- መገናኛ ፣ ቦሌ፣ ቤተል፣ ሳርቤት፣ አዲሱ ገበያ፣ ፒያሳ፣ ጉርድ ሾላ፣ ወሰን፣ ጦር ሀይሎች፣ አለም ባንክ፣ ልደታ፣ ሀያት፣ ፍየል ቤት፣ አራት ኪሎ፣ ኡራኤል ፣ ቃሊቲ፣ ለቡ፣ አደይአበባ ፣ ገርጂ

ከዚህ ባላይ የተገለጹትን መስፈርቶች የሚያሟሉ አመልካቾች ይህ ማስታወቂያው ከወጣበት ቀን ጀምሮ ባሉት 10(አስር) ተከታታይ የሥራ ቀናት ውስጥ CV፣ ትምህርት ማስረጃ rediate.mekuria@gmail.com በመላክ መመዝገብ የሚችሉ መሆኑን እናሳውቃለን፡፡

title: Surgical Nurse
description: At least 2 years of relevant experience in a hospital's operating room or surgical ward.A Surgical Nurse's job involves caring for patients before, during, and after surgical procedures by preparing the operating room, assisting the surgical team with instruments and equipment, monitoring vital signs, administering medications, maintaining a sterile environment, educating patients and families, and documenting patient care. Key responsibilities include ensuring patient safety and a sterile environment, collaborating with the healthcare team, and adhering to strict infection control protocols. Responsibilities and Duties Pre-operative Care: Prepare patients for surgery by conducting assessments, administering pre-operative medications, and providing necessary instructions and emotional support. Prepare the operating room by ensuring all equipment and supplies are sterile and readily available. Intra-operative Care: Assist the surgical team by providing instruments, sutures, and other necessary items during the procedure. Monitor patients' vital signs and the surgical environment to maintain safety and a sterile field. Administer anesthesia and medications as directed by the surgical team. Post-operative Care: Provide post-operative care, including wound care and administering pain medications. Monitor patient condition and provide care for any complications that may arise. Educate patients and their families on post-operative care and recovery. Documentation and Communication: Maintain accurate patient records, including surgical reports and post-operative care documentation. Collaborate with other healthcare professionals, such as surgeons and anesthesiologists, to ensure comprehensive and coordinated patient care. Safety and Infection Control: Adhere to strict infection control protocols and safety standards to prevent contamination and ensure patient safety. Professional Development: Participate in continuous education and training to stay current with advancements in surgical practices and technologies. Key Skills Technical Skills:  Competence in administering medications, monitoring vital signs, operating medical equipment, and maintaining sterile fields. Communication:  Excellent communication skills to interact effectively with patients, families, and the surgical team. Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking: Strong ability to assess situations, evaluate information, and manage complications that may arise during or after surgery. Teamwork:  Ability to work collaboratively with a variety of healthcare professionals in a high-pressure environment. Organizational Skills:  Strong ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively in a dynamic surgical setting. Job Address LEBU

title: Midwife
description:
BSc in Midwifery

 

At least 2 years of experience in a labor, delivery, or maternity ward.

A Midwife Job Description (JD) includes providing antenatal, labor, delivery, and postnatal care for low-risk pregnancies and their newborns, managing high-risk cases and referring them to specialists, educating and counseling families, documenting care, and collaborating with other healthcare professionals to ensure optimal maternal and infant health. Key skills required are strong communication, patience, leadership, and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Pregnancy & Antenatal Care:

Conduct preconception care, physical exams, and screenings, and provide education and counseling on pregnancy and family planning.

Labor & Delivery:

Monitor the mother and fetus, assist during labor and delivery, manage pain, and provide emotional support.

Postnatal Care:

Care for both mother and newborn after birth, including breastfeeding support, newborn care, postpartum check-ups, and home visits.

Risk Management:

Monitor fetal development, identify potential complications, and manage or refer cases to obstetricians and other specialists when necessary.

Family & Community Support:

Provide health promotion advice, parenting skills education, and participate in public health programs.

Documentation:

Maintain accurate and detailed patient records.

Collaboration:

Work closely with obstetricians, pediatricians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to coordinate care.

Required Skills and Qualities

Clinical Skills:

Proficiency in performing physical exams, administering medications, and managing routine and emergency procedures.

Communication:

Excellent interpersonal skills, patience, and the ability to provide emotional and psychological support to patients and families.

Leadership and Teamwork:

Ability to work effectively as part of a healthcare team and take initiative.

Critical Thinking:

Strong analytical skills to assess patient needs, identify deviations from normal, and make appropriate decisions.

Calmness Under Pressure:

Ability to prioritize tasks and act confidently in high-pressure or stressful situations.

Technical Skills:

Competency in using and maintaining appropriate medical equipment.

Educational Requirements

Completion of an accredited midwifery or nurse-midwifery program.

Registration and licensure with the appropriate regulatory body.

title: Supervisor
description:
የስራ መደቡ፡-ሱፐርቫይዘር የፕሮዳክሽን ለዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ
መስፈርቶች፡-
ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እና ማማከር ነው፡፡
Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMSፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት ያለው ድርጅታችን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያለው እና ልምድ ያለው አጠቃላይ ተቆጣጣሪ/የዋና አስተዳዳሪ እየፈለግን ነው።

ሱፐር ቡስት አፕ የኢትዮጵያን ተቋማት፣ ቢዝነሶች፣ግለሰቦች፣ትምህርት ቤቶችን በዲጂታል መንገድ ለማብቃት እና በዲጂታል መንገድ እንዲያድጉ ለመርዳት የተቋቋመ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ ነው።

የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ - economic, marketing,Management, business Administration and other related field
  የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ እንቅስቃሴ ያቅዳል፣ ያደራጃል፣ ይመራል፣ ይቆጣጠራል።
  ድርጅቱ ትርፋማ እንዲሆን የሚያስችሉ ፖሊሲዎችንና ስትራቴጂዎችን ነድፎ ይሰራል።
  የድርጅቱን የአጭርና የረዥም ጊዜ አላማ ከግብ ለማድረስ የድርጅቱ የሰው ሃይልና የሰው ሃይል በማቀድ፣ በማደራጀት፣ በመምራትና በመቆጣጠር ይሰራል።
  LMS ፕላትፎርም የሚሆኑ ፕሮዳክሽን ስራ እንዲሰራ ያደርጋል
  አዳዲስ ተቀጣሪዎች ምልመላ፣ ስልጠናና ቅጥር ማከናወን፡፡
  እያንዳንዱ ስራ እና ንዑስ የስራ ሂደት በተገቢው ሁኔታ እየሄደ እንደሆነና የታለመለትን ግብ ሊያሳካ ስለመቻሉ ክትትል ማድረግ...
  ሁሉንም የስራ ሂደቶች መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀት፡፡
  የእያንዳንዱን የስራተኞች ስራ ክንውን መከተታተል ፡፡
  የድርጅቱን የፋይናንስ ፣ የማርኬቲንግ እያንዳንዱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡
  ከፋይናንስ እና አካውንቲንግ ጋር በተያያዘ ያለውን ስራ በእራስም ሆነ ከሚመለከተው ባለሙያ ጋር ሆኖ የየወቅቱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡
  በጀት መመደብና ወጪ መቀነስ
  ፖሊሲ ማርቀቅና እና አተገባበሩንም መተለም
  የሰራተኞችን የስራ አቅምና ባህል እንዲጎለብት መርዳት
  ሁሉም የፋይናንስ እንቅስቃሴዎች በታለመላቸው መልኩ እየሄዱ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ክትትል ማድረግ
  የድርጅቱን ግብርና ቀረጥ መሰል ክፍያዎች በጊዜው መክፈል ወይም እንዲከፈል ማድረግ
  የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን ጊዜውን ጠብቀው ማውጣት

description:

o እና ሌሎች ተማሪዎች ገቢ ሊያስገኙ በሚችሉ ዘርፎች ልምድ ላላቸው ቅድሚያ እንሰጣለን።

የምንፈልጋቸው አስተማሪዎች:

· የተዘጋጀ የቪዲዮ ኮርስ ያላችሁ: አስቀድሞ የተዘጋጀ የቪዲዮ ትምህርት (በማንዋል የታገዘ) ላላችሁ ቅድሚያ እንሰጣለን።

· በራሳችሁ ቀረጻ መስራት የምትችሉ: የትምህርት ማንዋል ያላችሁ እና የቪዲዮ ቀረጻና ኤዲቲንግ በራሳችሁ መስራት የምትችሉ ከሆናችሁ።

title: FMCG - Procurement Manager
description:
VACANCY ANOUNCEMENT
Position Title: FMCG - Procurement Manager
Company: Lovegrass Agro-Processing Plc
Location: HQ, Addis Ababa / Factory, Sululta

About Us:
Lovegrass Agro-Processing Plc is a fast-growing food processing and FMCG company dedicated to delivering healthy Teff products to local and international markets. We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced FMCG - Procurement Manager to lead and manage our sourcing, purchasing, and supplier relationship functions in line with FMCG standards.

Role Overview:
The Procurement Manager will be responsible for sourcing high-quality goods and services at competitive prices, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring timely and cost-effective purchasing to support business operations. The role also includes overseeing procurement policies and processes, managing contracts and negotiations, and ensuring compliance with company standards and relevant government regulations, including licenses and permits.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
• Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with company objectives.
• Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers for raw materials, packaging, and services.
• Ensure cost-effective purchasing without compromising quality and compliance standards.
• Manage supplier relationships, contracts, and performance.
• Coordinate procurement planning with production, operations, and finance departments.
• Monitor market trends, price changes, and risks affecting supply chains.
• Maintain proper records, reports, and procurement documentation.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, FMCG standards, and Ethiopian labor/procurement regulations.
• Lead and coach the procurement team for efficiency and growth.
Qualifications & Requirements:
• BA/BSc in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s is a plus).
• Minimum 8 - 10 years of progressive procurement experience, preferably in FMCG/Agro-processing industries.
• Strong knowledge of local and international procurement, import/export, and logistics procedures.
• Proven negotiation, contract management, and supplier evaluation skills.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and analytical skills.
• Proficiency in ERP systems and MS Office tools.
• Fluency in English and Amharic; knowledge of other local languages is an advantage.

Remuneration and Compensation: Negotiable based on Qualifications
Deadline: 10 days from the date of this announcement. Early applications are encouraged, as shortlisting may begin before the deadline.
_________________________

How to Apply: Qualified and interested candidates are invited to send their CV and cover letter to samuel@thelovegrass.com addressed to the Human Resource Department. Please clearly state “FMCG - Procurement Manager” in the subject line.

title: Backend Expert with Flutter Experience

Flutter Development

Adaptability & Resilience

Assist with trial sessions, contracts, and new student onboarding.

Monitor student progress (including IXL data) and prepare monthly progress reports.
Participate in quality assurance by observing live sessions and reporting findings.
Collaborate with tutors to address student needs and improve engagement.
Ensure timely and accurate submission of all required reports.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

Client retention and satisfaction.
Timeliness and accuracy of reports.
Responsiveness to communications.
Quality of session observations and feedback.
Consistency in IXL and invoice tracking.
Opportunity:

Internship role with training and mentorship.
Strong possibility of a permanent Admin position upon successful completion and performance.
Application Instructions:
Interested applicants must apply only via hr@aplusmentors.com by sending:

Their CV, and A 1–2-minute self-introduction voice recording in English.
Please note: Applications without the voice recording or not sent by email will not be considered.

title: የሽያጭ ሰራተኛ
description:
አድማስዎን ያስፉ፣ ገቢዎን ያሳድጉ!
የስራ መደቡ፡ ራሱን የቻለ ከፍተኛ የሽያጭ ባለሙያ (በኮሚሽን ላይ የተመሰረተ)
የሕልም ሥራዎ የሚጀምረው እዚህ ነው!
እርስዎ ገንዘብን በታታሪነትዎ እና ብልሃትዎ የመፍጠር ጥልቅ ፍላጎት አለዎት? በዲጂታል ዓለም ውስጥ ትልቅ አሻራ መጣል ይፈልጋሉ? ድርጅታችን ከ5 በላይ በሆኑ ዘመናዊ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ሰርቪሶች እና ምርቶች / አገልግሎቶች ላይ ተመስርቶ ያልተገደበ ገቢ የሚያስገኝልዎትን ዕድል ይዞ መጥቷል።
ይህ ተራ የሽያጭ ሥራ አይደለም—ይህ የራስዎ የገቢ ንግድ ነው።
ለምን ይህ ዕድል ለየት ያለ ነው?
1.  ያልተገደበ የኮሚሽን አቅም፡ በኩባንያችን ካሉት ከአምስት በላይ ትርፋማ ምርቶችና አገልግሎቶች የተነሳ፣ እያንዳንዱ ሽያጭዎ ትልቅ ኮሚሽን ይዞ ይመጣል! ገደብዎ የእርስዎ ጥረት ብቻ ነው!
2.  ሙሉ የራስ ገዝ አስተዳደር፡ እኛ “እንመራዎታለን” አንልም—እኛ እንተማመንብዎታለን። እርስዎ ነዎት የገበያ ጥናት የሚያደርጉት፣ ሊድስ (የደንበኛ መረጃ) የሚሰበስቡት እና ሽያጩን ከጅምሩ እስከ መጨረሻው በብቃት የሚዘጉት።
3.  በቴክኖሎጂ አፍላ ዘርፍ መሥራት፡ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት የወደፊቱ ዓለም ነው። በዚህ አስደሳችና ተፈላጊ ዘርፍ ውስጥ ቁልፍ ባለቤት ይሁኑ።

የእርስዎ ዋና ኃላፊነቶች (የእርስዎ የኃይል ማመንጫ)
እኛ የምንፈልገው በቂ ልምድ ያለው፣ ስልጠና የማይሻ እና ሥራውን በራሱ ተረድቶ በፍጥነት ሽያጭ የሚያስመዘግብ ባለሙያ ነው።
የራስዎን የደንበኛ መረጃ (ሊድስ)(Lead Generation): የመፈለጊያ ዘዴዎች በመጠቀም ሽያጮችን በፍጥነት ማመንጨት እና ማጠናቀቅ።
የምርት ሻምፒዮን መሆን፡ በተለይም የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) መድረካችንን ለደንበኞች በሚማርክ ሁኔታ መግለጽ እና መሸጥ።
oበቅርቡ ለምናደርገው የኦንላይን ትምህርት መድረክ ምረቃ የሽያጭ ቅድመ ዝግጅት መሪ መሆን።
oለፕሮጀክቱ ስኬት የሚያስፈልጉ ስፖንሰርሺፖችን መፈለግና ማምጣት።
የስኬት አስተዳደር፡ የዕለታዊ የሽያጭ ጥረቶችዎን እና የሥራ እንቅስቃሴዎን ግልጽ በሆነ ሁኔታ ሪፖርት ማድረግ።

መስፈርቶች (እርስዎ መሆን ያለብዎት)
በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ማኔጅመንት፣ ቢዝነስ አስተዳደር ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ የመጀመሪያ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ከዛ በላይ።
ስለ ዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ ጥልቅ እውቀት እና ሽያጭ በማምጣት የተረጋገጠ፣ ሰፊ የስራ ልምድ።
ስራዎችን በግልጽ እና በብቃት የመግለጽ ችሎታ።
ምርጥ የመግባባት፣ የግንኙነት መፍጠር እና የሪፖርት አቀራረብ ችሎታ።
በራሱ ተነሳሽነት የመስራት እና ለሽያጭ ግቦች ከፍተኛ ኃላፊነት የመውሰድ ብቃት።

ቀጣዩ እርምጃዎ (ሕይወትዎን ይቀይሩ)
ይህንን አስደናቂ የኮሚሽን ዕድል ለመጠቀም ዝግጁ ከሆኑ፡-
መስፈርቶቹን የምታሟሉ አመልካቾች የስራ ልምዳችሁን (CV) እና ተዛማጅ ሰነዶችን በሚከተለው አድራሻ እንድትልኩ እንጋብዛለን፡

title: ቪድዮ ፕሮዳክሽን
description: ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ/ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እና ማማከር ነው፡፡ Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMSፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ ለዚሁ ስራ በቪዲዮ ከፕሪ እስከ ፖስት ድረስ መስራት የሚችል ማድረግ የሚችል ባለሙያ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት እና ልምድ ያለው ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት እየፈለግን ነው። የደንበኞቻችን ፍላጎት ተከትሎ ቪዲዮ መቅረጽ፣ ማስተካከል (ኤዲት ማድረግ) የሚችል የቪዲዮግራፊ ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡ የቪዲዮግራፈሩ ሚና ለስራው የሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳቁሶች መሟላታቸውን መከታተል፣ የካሜራ ባለሙያዎችን መምራት፣ እና ቪዲዮዎችን ኤዲት ማድረግ የሚችል ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡ በቪዲዮ ግራፊ ሙያ ስኬታማ ለመሆን ባለሙያው የደንበኞችን ፍላጎት በጥሞና አዳምጦ የሚረዳና ፈጠራ የታከለበት ክህሎት አስተባብሮ የሚጠበቀውን ውጤት ማስረከብ የሚችል ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡ ጎበዝ የቪዲዮ ግራፊ ባለሙያ የስራውን ጥራት የሚጨምሩ ዘመኑ ያፈራቸውን ገበያው የሚፈልጋቸውን አዳዲስ አሰራሮች፣ አቀራረቦችን እየተከታተለ በየጊዜው ራሱን የሚበቃ ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡ የቪዲዮ ግራፈሩ ኃላፊነቶች * በተገቢው ቦታ የቪዲዮ እና የፎቶ ምስሎች መቅረጽ * በየጊዜው የስራ መሳሪያዎቹን ዝግጁነት መገምገምና ማሟላት * ከስራ ባልደረቦችና ከደንበኞች ጋር ሆኖ የስራ እቅድ ማርቀቅ * ከቀረጻ በኋላ የቪዲዮ ምስሎን ማረም (ቪዲዮ ኤዲቲንግ ማከናወን) * ተፈላጊው የቪዲዮ ምስል በተገቢ ሆኑታ እንዲቀረጽ ሌሎችን የቪዲዮግራፊ ባለሙያዎች ማስተባበር ተፈላጊ ልዩ ችሎታዎች * ከፍተኛ የሆነ የኮምፒውተር አጠቃቀም ችሎታ * የኦንላይን እና ኦፍለይን ሶፍትዎሮችን መጠቀም የሚችል * ከፍተኛ የሆነ የአዶቤ ፎቶሾፕ አጠቃቀም ችሎታ * አስደናቂ የካሜራ አጠቃቀም ችሎታ ከዚህ በላይ የተዘረዘሩትን መስፈርቶች የምታሟሉ አመልካቶች ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ 10 ተከታታይ የስራ ቀናት ውስጥ መመዝገብ ትችላላችሁ። ደሞዝ፤ በስምምነት አድራሻ፡- ከመካኒሳ ወደጀርመን በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ የኪራይ ቤቶች ህንጻ ላይ 2ኛ ፎቅ

title: Content Creator casting person
description: ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው ዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ/ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ኦንላይን (online) ስልጠና  እና ማማከር ነው፡፡ ለዚህም ድርጅታችን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት እንዲሁም ልምድ ያለው ኮንተት ክሬተርና casting person እንፈልጋለን። አስፈላጊ ችሎታዎችና ዝግጅት፦ •  የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ - communication, journalism or art •  ቢያንስ 1 ዓመት ልምድ ያላት •  ስለ ዲጂታል ማርኬት ላይ በቂ ልምድ  ያላት •  Online ትምህርት ጠንካራ እውቀት እና ግንዛቤ •  ለአጫጭር ስልጠና የሚሆኑ ኮርሶችን የትምህርት ማንዋል ማዘጋጀት በቂ ችሎታ ያላት •  ጥሩ የግንኙነትና የአመራር ችሎታ •  ውጤትና እቅድ ተኮር መሆን •  ጥሩ የሆነ የጊዜ አጠቃቀም •  በቂ የሆነ video editing skill ተመራጭ ነው፡፡ ኃላፊነቶች፦ •  የለተለያዩ የፈጠራ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦችን ማዳበር፣ ለምንሰጠው ስልጠናዎች ማንዋሎች  ማዘጋጀት፤ ለማስታወቂያ እን ለተለያዩ ግበአቶች የሚሆኑ ኮንቴነቶችን ማዘጋጀት፣ ቮይስ ኦቨር፣ ካስቲንግ መስራት፡፡ የሚከተሉትን ጨምሮ፡- •  ኮንቴንት ካላንደር ማዘጋጀት •  ኮንቴንት ለቀን፣ ለሳምንት፣ ለወር ማዘጋጀት •  ካስቲንግና፣  (ለቀረጻ አጠቃላይ ዝግጅቶችን ማድረግ እና ምርትን/ አገልግሎትን ለማስተዋወቅ መቀረጽ) •  video editing graphics  ስራዎች መስራት የምትችል/ሚችል ቢሆን ይመረጣል •  አስፈላጊ በሆነበት ሰዐትና ጊዜ ሁሉ ቮይስ ኦቨር መቀዳትና መቅረጽ •  ከሌሎች ክፍሎች ጋር በመተባበር የተሻለ አገልግሎት ለመስጠት ቁርጠኛና ዝግጁ መሆን •  አገልግሎቶችን ያለችግር ለማድረስ - -ከኢንዱስትሪ ጋር ወቅታዊ መረጃ ማግኘትና አዳዲስ የክሬቲቪቲ እድሎችን ለመለየት •  የገበያ ውድድርን ማጥናትና ተስማሚ ይዘት መፍጠር ደሞዝ፤  በስምምነት አድራሻ፡- ከመካኒሳ ወደጀርመን በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ

title: ሱፐር ቫይዘር
description: ሱፐር ቫይዘር የስራ መደቡ፡-ሱፐርቫይዘር የፕሮዳክሽን ለዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ መስፈርቶች፡- ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እና ማማከር ነው፡፡ Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMSፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት ያለው ድርጅታችን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያለው እና ልምድ ያለው አጠቃላይ ተቆጣጣሪ/የዋና አስተዳዳሪ እየፈለግን ነው። ሱፐር ቡስት አፕ የኢትዮጵያን ተቋማት፣ ቢዝነሶች፣ግለሰቦች፣ትምህርት ቤቶችን በዲጂታል መንገድ ለማብቃት እና በዲጂታል መንገድ እንዲያድጉ ለመርዳት የተቋቋመ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ ነው። የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ - economic, marketing,Management, business Administration and other related field   የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ እንቅስቃሴ ያቅዳል፣ ያደራጃል፣ ይመራል፣ ይቆጣጠራል።   ድርጅቱ ትርፋማ እንዲሆን የሚያስችሉ ፖሊሲዎችንና ስትራቴጂዎችን ነድፎ ይሰራል።   የድርጅቱን የአጭርና የረዥም ጊዜ አላማ ከግብ ለማድረስ የድርጅቱ የሰው ሃይልና የሰው ሃይል በማቀድ፣ በማደራጀት፣ በመምራትና በመቆጣጠር ይሰራል።   LMS ፕላትፎርም የሚሆኑ ፕሮዳክሽን ስራ እንዲሰራ ያደርጋል   አዳዲስ ተቀጣሪዎች ምልመላ፣ ስልጠናና ቅጥር ማከናወን፡፡   እያንዳንዱ ስራ እና ንዑስ የስራ ሂደት በተገቢው ሁኔታ እየሄደ እንደሆነና የታለመለትን ግብ ሊያሳካ ስለመቻሉ ክትትል ማድረግ...   ሁሉንም የስራ ሂደቶች መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀት፡፡   የእያንዳንዱን የስራተኞች ስራ ክንውን መከተታተል ፡፡   የድርጅቱን የፋይናንስ ፣ የማርኬቲንግ እያንዳንዱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡   ከፋይናንስ እና አካውንቲንግ ጋር በተያያዘ ያለውን ስራ በእራስም ሆነ ከሚመለከተው ባለሙያ ጋር ሆኖ የየወቅቱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡   በጀት መመደብና ወጪ መቀነስ   ፖሊሲ ማርቀቅና እና አተገባበሩንም መተለም   የሰራተኞችን የስራ አቅምና ባህል እንዲጎለብት መርዳት   ሁሉም የፋይናንስ እንቅስቃሴዎች በታለመላቸው መልኩ እየሄዱ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ክትትል ማድረግ   የድርጅቱን ግብርና ቀረጥ መሰል ክፍያዎች በጊዜው መክፈል ወይም እንዲከፈል ማድረግ   የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን ጊዜውን ጠብቀው ማውጣት ከዚህ በላይ የተዘረዘሩትን መስፈርቶች የምታሟሉ አመልካቾች ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ 10 ተከታታይ የስራ ቀናት ውስጥ መመዝገብ ትችላላችሁ። የስራ ሁኔታ፡ ሪሞት(freelance) ወይም ባሉበት ሆነው ደሞዝ :በስምምነት አድራሻ፡- ከመካኒሳ ወደጀርመን በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ የኪራይ ቤቶች ህንጻ ላይ 2ኛ ፎቅ

title: የሒሳብ ሰራተኛ

title: Personal Home Cook
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Personal Home Cook with proven restaurant-level experience to prepare daily meals in a private home setting. The ideal candidate will be skilled in both traditional Ethiopian cuisine and a variety of international dishes, with an emphasis on healthy, well-balanced meals.

Responsibilities include:

Preparing lunch and dinner meals daily (with flexibility for special occasions).
Planning weekly menus based on dietary preferences and nutritional balance.
Sourcing fresh, high-quality ingredients and managing kitchen supplies.
Maintaining excellent food hygiene and kitchen cleanliness at all times.
Introducing creative dishes while respecting traditional tastes.
Requirements:

At least 3 years of professional cooking experience in a restaurant, hotel, or catering service.
Strong knowledge of local and international cuisines.
Ability to work independently with attention to detail.
Trustworthy, punctual, and respectful of household privacy.
Flexibility to adjust to family needs and schedules.
Benefits:

Competitive salary (negotiable based on experience).
Supportive and respectful working environment.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Job Description
Are you a sales leader passionate about the wood-based finishing material and furniture industry?

Do you thrive on building relationships, driving growth, and leading a motivated team? If so, we want you to join our team!

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Sales Manager to spearhead our sales efforts and help us achieve the next level of success.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Sales Manager, you will be a key driver of our growth, responsible for leading and executing our sales vision:

Lead and Grow the Sales Team: Inspire, mentor, and manage our sales representatives to achieve and exceed targets.
Build Strategic Relationships: Cultivate and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers and industry partners (designers, architects, contractors).
Develop and Execute Sales Strategies: Create, implement, and analyze effective sales plans to expand market share and drive revenue growth.
Ensure Customer Excellence: Collaborate closely with our production and installation teams to guarantee seamless delivery and exceptional customer experiences from initial sale to final installation.
What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will bring a blend of leadership experience, industry knowledge, and a results-oriented approach:

Proven Sales Leadership Experience: Demonstrated success in a sales leadership role, with experience in the furniture, construction materials, or related finishing industries being a significant advantage.
Exceptional Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills that enable effective engagement with clients and team members.
A Results-Driven Mindset: A strong focus on meeting and surpassing sales goals, with a track record of driving revenue growth.
Inspirational Leadership: The ability to motivate, develop, and lead a high-performing sales team.
How to Apply

description:
Job Description
Are you a sales leader passionate about the wood-based finishing material and furniture industry?
