title: Senior Tender Specialist
description: Job Title: Senior Tender Specialist Department: Tender Sales Department Reports to: Tender Manager / Supervisor Job Overview: The Senior Tender Specialist is responsible for leading the preparation, coordination, and submission of tenders, ensuring compliance with client requirements and contributing to the company's growth and success. The role requires strong project management, analytical, technical and communication skills, as well as in-depth knowledge of the tendering process, products and solutions, and industry best practices. Responsibilities and Duties: 1.  Identify and qualify tender opportunities: -  Regularly monitor relevant online platforms, government portals, and industry-specific sources for new tender opportunities. -  Assess each tender opportunity for alignment with the company's capabilities and strategic goals, and verify the company's eligibility to participate. 2.  Analyze tender requirements and coordinate information gathering: -  Thoroughly review tender documents to understand the requirements, scope, evaluation criteria, and submission deadlines. -  Coordinate with other departments to gather required information, such as technical specifications, pricing, and legal requirements. 3.   Develop and manage project timelines: -  Create and maintain detailed project timelines for each tender, ensuring all tasks are assigned and deadlines are met. -  Communicate project timelines to relevant stakeholders and provide regular updates on progress. 4.  Bid proposal preparation: -  Develop a proposal outline based on the tender requirements and evaluation criteria. -  Work on or Assign proposal sections to appropriate team members and provide guidance and support throughout the writing process. -  Review and edit proposal sections to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to established templates and guidelines. 5.  Coordinate technical input and support: -  Collaborate with the technical team to integrate technical information and solutions into the proposal, ensuring compliance with tender requirements. -  Liaise with suppliers and manufacturers to obtain necessary technical documentation and support. 6.  Conduct internal proposal reviews and manage revisions: -  Organize and facilitate internal proposal review meetings to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with tender requirements. -   Incorporate necessary revisions based on internal review feedback and obtain final approvals from relevant stakeholders. 7.  Manage proposal submission and post-submission activities: -   Submit the final proposal to the client before the submission deadline, ensuring all submission guidelines are followed. -  Track the tender evaluation process, maintain communication with the client, and address any additional requests or clarifications. -  Inform the team and relevant stakeholders of the tender outcome and organize debrief sessions to identify areas for improvement. 8.  Maintain tender documentation and records: -  Ensure all tender-related documentation is organized, up-to-date, and stored securely in the company's document management system. 9.  Contribute to the continuous improvement of tender processes: -  Identify and implement best practices and process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the tender sales department. Qualifications and Skills: •  Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Technology or a related field. •  At least 5 years of experience in tender management, proposal writing, or a similar role, preferably in the IT or office machines industry. •  Strong project management, organization, and time management skills. • Familiarity with tender management software or platforms is a plus. How to Apply Submit your application letter and CV to apply@yes.et by October 15, 2025. Please include the position title in the subject line. Job Address kazanchis, Addis Ababa

title: EDITOR-IN-CHIEF
description:
INDEPENDENT NEWS & MEDIA PLC., is a publisher of the business weekly Fortune, reputable for its comprehensive coverage of business, investment, and economic issues across various platforms, including print, digital, video, and audio. Our commitment to delivering high-quality journalism is matched by our dedication to innovative design and compelling visual storytelling.

JOB PURPOSE:

The successful candidate shall be responsible for the weekly print edition production process and the content uploaded on its digital platforms.

S/he shall work with other editors and editorial team members to identify compelling stories and create editorial packages for online and print forms.

The candidate shall be working with the design team in marrying content to visual concepts and page designs and the digital team in coordinating print and online content.

The Editor-in-Chief shall be responsible for tailoring stories each week, supervising reporters and other editors, editing articles, running editorial meetings, providing support and guidance to the editorial staff, and approving final drafts.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Candidates must be fully fluent in English, be able to accomplish multiple tasks simultaneously and work in a fast-paced environment in constant communication with members of the editorial team. Applicants must have sample experience in content and production management, content and copy editing skills, and solid managerial experience. A skilled writer and analytical thinker with a canny ability to craft ground-breaking cover stories and help coordinate strategic special reports.

The right candidate for this high-level and high-profile position must have a solid understanding of the business sector.

How to Apply:

Applicants who meet the above criteria should apply through the Fortune Career website. https://careers.addisfortune.info/ or submit in person at Independent News & Media Plc., on Sierra Leone St., Tegene Bldg, 7th Floor, adjacent to Global Hotel, Beqilo Bet area. For further information, you may call 011-416-3020.

Female applicants are highly encouraged to apply. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted for an interview.

ሽያጭ እና እንግዳ ተቀባይ

ድርጅታችን አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ፤ በሽያጭ እና እንግዳ ተቀባይ ቀልጣፋ እና  ነቃ ያለች በጣም ተግባቢ ደንበኛን በደንብ የምታስተናግድ ተነሳሽነት ያላት የሽያጭ ሠራተኛ የኛን ድርጅት እንድትቀላቀል እንፈልጋለን፡፡  በመሆኑም ከዚህ በታች ያለውን መስፈርት የምታሟሉ ተወዳዳሪዎች መወዳደር ትችላላችሁ፡፡ አመልካቾች አፕሊኬሽን ሌተር ስትሞሉ 1. ስልካችሁን፣ 2. ሰፈራችሁን እና 3. የሥራ ልምዳችሁን 4. የሰራችሁበትን የሥራ ዘርፍ የሚገልጽ  ፕሮፋይል እንድታካትቱ፡፡ በሳሊተ ምሕረት፣ ገርጂ፣ ፊጋ ወይም ቅርብ አካባቢ ነዋሪ የሆኑ እጩዎች በጣም ተመራጭ ናቸው።

• ዋጋ ማውጣት የምትችልና ከደንበኞች ጋር ያላት የሥራ ጠንካራ የግንኙነት

title: Machine Learning & Full-Stack Web Developer (Price Analytics & Display Project)

Integrate web app with ML models and IVR systems for real-time updates.

Ensure performance, scalability, and security of the application.

Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch).

Experience with Node.js (backend) and at least one frontend framework (React, Angular, or Vue).

Solid knowledge of RESTful APIs, JSON, and database integration (SQL/NoSQL).

Exprience with real-time data pipelines, analytics, and visualization.

Familiarity with Git version control and deployment workflows.

Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

የሚፈለጉ መስፈርቶች :

1. የላቀ የአርትዖት ክህሎት:

በሰዋስው፣ ሥርዓተ-ነጥብ፣ ሆሄያት እና የቃላት አጠቃቀም ላይ ከፍተኛ የማረምና የማጥራት ልምድ ያለው/ያላት።
ጽሑፎችን ግልጽ፣ ወጥ እና ስህተት የሌለባቸው እንዲሆኑ የማድረግ ብቃት።
የጽሑፎችን ይዘት፣ አወቃቀር እና አመክንዮ የማሻሻል ችሎታ።
2. የሥራ ልምድ፡

በስነ-ጽሑፍ ወይም በአርትዖት ዘርፍ የረጅም ዓመታት የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ያላት።

በቋንቋ፣ በስነ-ጽሑፍ ወይም በተዛማጅ የትምህርት መስክ የትምህርት ማስረጃ ቢኖረው ይመረጣል።
ሆኖም ግን፣ የመደበኛ ትምህርት ሳይኖረው ቀርቶ፣ ተጨባጭ እና በቂ የአርትዖትና የጽሑፍ ልምድ ያላቸው ግለሰቦች ቀደም ሲል የሠሯቸውን ሥራዎች በማቅረብ ብቃታቸውን ማሳየት ይችላሉ።
4. ተጨማሪ መስፈርት

የመተርጎም ችሎታ: ሥራው ከእንግሊዝኛ ወደ አማርኛ የመተርጎም ችሎታንም ይጠይቃል።

title: Network security Engineer
description:
Job Description
Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Network Security Engineer to lead the evaluation, integration, migration, design, and deployment of secure and scalable network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in LAN, WAN, WLAN, and Software-Defined Networking (SDN) technologies, with a strong focus on security architecture and operational resilience.

Key Responsibilities:

Evaluate existing network architectures and identify security vulnerabilities and performance bottlenecks.
Design and deploy scalable LAN, WAN, WLAN, and SDN solutions tailored to enterprise needs.
Lead integration and migration projects for legacy systems to modern, secure network environments.
Implement and manage network security protocols, firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), and VPNs.
Monitor network performance and security posture, providing proactive solutions and incident response.
Document network configurations, policies, and procedures for compliance and audit readiness.
Stay current with emerging technologies and threat landscapes to continuously improve network defenses.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's in computer engineering , electrical engineering , or related field.
3+ years of experience in network engineering with a focus on security.
Proven experience in designing and deploying LAN/WAN/WLAN/SDN architectures.
Strong knowledge of network protocols, routing, switching, and security frameworks.
Certifications such as CCNP Security, CISSP, or equivalent is highly desirable.
Hands-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet, or similar platforms.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Preferred Skills:

Experience with cloud networking and hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Familiarity with automation tools (Ansible, Terraform) and network monitoring platforms.
Ability to mentor junior engineers and lead technical workshops. TO APPLY --HR@altacomputec.com  & hr2@altacomputec.com

Ability to Simplify Complex Ideas
Ability to See Other People's Point of View

title: Store keeper
description:
Hill Tech PLC is looking a full-time, organized, and experienced storekeeper capable of managing all stocks and inventory while ensuring store maintenance. Our ideal candidate should possess multitasking abilities, a learning aptitude, strong organizational skills, and great attention to detail, all while maintaining professionalism with customers. The storekeeper should be a customer-service oriented professional who can efficiently manage inventories, restock supplies, maintain inventory-related records, and report damaged inventories for record-keeping. Additionally, we expect our storekeeper to have hands-on experience using inventory management and material management software to perform all job-related tasks.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Receive, inspect, and verify incoming raw materials, hardware, and consumables.

• Prepare GRNs (Goods Receipt Notes) and update inventory records.

• Organize and store materials systematically to prevent damage, theft, or deterioration.

• Issue materials to production based on approved MRNs (Material Requisition Notes).

• Maintain accurate stock records in the system and physical registers.

• Conduct periodic stock counts and reconcile discrepancies.

• Ensure safe storage of flammable, hazardous, or sensitive items.

• Maintain cleanliness and orderliness of the store.

• Report low stock levels and initiate replenishment requests.

• Maintain records of finished goods entering and leaving the warehouse.

Required Qualifications and Experience

• Diploma/Degree in store management .

• At least two (02) years of progressively responsible professional experience in store management.

• Experience in using ERP system is desirable.

Required Skills and Competencies

• High ethics and a personal commitment to transparency and accountability

• Inventory Management proficiency .

• Excellent organizing and record keeping or documentation skills.

• Great attention to detail.

• Communication skills.

• Ability to collaborate with colleagues, and value team spirit.

• Have a learning attitude.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Capacity to work physical tasks or has to be physically fit (dexterity)

The company gives priority to male candidates as the job is highly related to physical fitness, and preferably age not more than 30.

Interested applicants can send their CV, not more than two pages, within 10 days via email: info@hilltechsolutions.com


Job Address
Near Paster square

title: Junior Accountant - ERP Specialist
description: Company: Nasir Haile Coffee Wholesale Location: Meti, Gambella Zone, Ethiopia Reports To: Finance Manager Job Type: Full-time We are seeking a highly motivated and exceptionally bright recent graduate to join our finance team as a Junior Accountant and ERP Specialist. This role is critical to the efficient operation of our coffee processing company's financial and inventory systems, focusing heavily on utilizing our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software. The ideal candidate will have an outstanding academic record and a strong foundational understanding of accounting principles. Key Responsibilities   ERP System Management: Serve as a key user for the finance and inventory modules of the company's ERP system (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or a specialized coffee ERP). Ensure accurate and timely data entry for all financial and operational transactions, including green coffee procurement, processing costs, sales, and inventory movements. Assist in maintaining and updating the ERP's master data, including product lists, vendors, customers, and chart of accounts. Accounting and Financial Operations: Process and record daily financial transactions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and journal entries. Assist in preparing bank reconciliations and other balance sheet reconciliations. Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes. Maintain accurate inventory records and reconcile physical counts with ERP records, paying close attention to coffee stock and cost of goods sold (COGS). Reporting and Analysis: Generate financial and operational reports from the ERP system for management review. Assist in variance analysis, identifying discrepancies between actual results and budget/standard costs, particularly related to coffee processing. Compliance and Improvement: Ensure compliance with local Ethiopian tax regulations and company policies. Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and accuracy of data processing within the ERP and overall accounting procedures. Qualifications and Requirements Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field from a recognized university. Academic Excellence: Must possess an outstanding academic record (e.g., Great Distinction in your graduating class). title: Sales and Marketing Manager
description:
https://forms.gle/taoDmnXZg1D2ncSz5

ZERGAW CLOUD is a leading cloud services provider in Ethiopia. It was established in 2019 by a team of experienced and passionate ICT experts with a deep understanding of cutting-edge cloud technologies and the unique needs of the local market.

Our services are designed and implemented to overcome three critical challenges of the local ICT industry: unaffordability, long procurement and deployment time, and system down with long maintenance time. Our services are affordable, easy to deploy and scale, and highly reliable and available, helping businesses operate in cost and time efficient manner. Please visit our website here to learn more about our company.

ZERGAW Cloud is looking for Sales and Marketing Manager for the following responsibilities.

I. Role Summary and Strategic Impact

The Sales and Marketing Manager is a critical, quota-carrying leadership role responsible for driving ZERGAW CLOUD's revenue growth, brand presence, and market share. The leader will design and execute an integrated 3-year commercial strategy to transition ZERGAW CLOUD from a local player to the region's most trusted and reliable cloud provider.

II. Core Responsibilities

A. Sales & Revenue Generation

• Target Enterprise Accounts: Develop and execute an aggressive B2B sales strategy focused on high-value, high-margin enterprise clients that require reliable, high-uptime cloud solutions.

• Pipeline Management & Forecasting: Own the entire sales lifecycle from lead generation to contract negotiation and closing. Maintain accurate sales forecasts and regularly report on pipeline health and revenue metrics to the CEO and Board.

• Pricing Strategy: Develop and enforce value-based pricing and subscription models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) that optimize profitability while maintaining a competitive regional position.

• Negotiation: Lead and close complex, multi-year, multi-million dollar contracts, particularly those tied to the Disaster Recovery (DR) and high-availability solutions.

• Localization: Ensure all service offerings, pricing structures, and sales materials are localized

B. Integrated Marketing & Brand Authority

• Brand Positioning: Solidify ZERGAW CLOUD's brand as the "Localized, affordable, Compliant, and Highly-Available" cloud leader, emphasizing the 99.95% uptime guarantee.

• Lead Generation: Oversee the creation and execution of digital marketing campaigns (SEO, content, social media), webinars, and industry events to generate high-quality, sales-qualified leads (SQLs) for infrastructure and software services.

• Content & Education: Direct the development of technical marketing content (e.g., white papers, case studies, technical blogs) that educates the market on the benefits of local cloud adoption over traditional IT or hyper-scale foreign providers.

III. Essential Skills and Qualifications

A. Experience and Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree (minimum) in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related technical field. An MBA is highly desirable.

• Experience: 3+ years of progressive sales leadership and management experience, with a proven track record of selling Cloud (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) or complex B2B IT infrastructure solutions.

B. Hard Skills (Technical & Tools)

• Cloud Fluency

• CRM Mastery

• Data Analytics

• Consultative Selling

C. Soft Skills (Leadership & Behavioral)

• Leadership

• Strategic Vision

• Executive Communication

• Adaptability

• Teamwork

Interested applicants are required to complete this online form until October 14, 2025. The data collected will exclusively be used for employment purposes and will be kept confidential. Thank you in advance for your interest and for taking the time to complete the form.

description: Senior Graphics and UI/UX Designer We are a dynamic young company based in Addis Ababa with a key partner in Berlin, Germany, specializing in digital strategy consulting and solution engineering. We work on a wide range of global projects, spanning custom software development, AI, and blockchain technologies. Our team consists of carefully selected experts from around the world who are passionate about delivering high-quality, impactful solutions. About the Role We are seeking a mature and highly experienced Senior UX/UI Designer to join our team. In this role, you will be the creative force behind our digital products, taking client inputs and transforming them into beautiful, intuitive, and highly functional designs. This is not just about creating static mockups; it’s about crafting real-world, usable solutions that can be seamlessly translated into web and mobile applications. The ideal candidate is a senior with a proven portfolio of professional designs that have been successfully brought to life. You will be expected to work independently, manage your own workload, and collaborate effectively with our development and project management teams to ensure a smooth transition from design to final product. Key Responsibilities Lead the design process from discovery and requirements gathering to final handoff. Transform client inputs into clear, beautiful, and user-centered UI/UX designs. Create detailed wireframes, mockups, user flows, and interactive prototypes using industry-standard design tools. Collaborate directly with clients and internal stakeholders to present and justify design decisions. Work closely with developers to ensure the design vision is accurately and efficiently implemented. Maintain and evolve our design system, ensuring consistency across all platforms and projects. Iterate on designs based on user feedback, data, and business goals. Qualifications & Skills Proven professional experience as a UX/UI or Product Designer with deep expertise in at least one professional design tool (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD). A professional portfolio showcasing completed projects that have been developed and deployed. This is a crucial requirement. Deep understanding of UX principles, UI best practices, and responsive design for web and mobile. Experience in professional graphic design and proficiency with tools like Adobe Photoshop. Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate design concepts and manage client expectations. Demonstrated maturity and initiative, with the ability to work independently and manage project deadlines. A strong team player who can collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment. Familiarity with front-end development basics is a plus. What We Offer The opportunity to work on innovative, impactful projects for global clients. A high degree of autonomy and the chance to directly influence project outcomes. A competitive salary and benefits package. Career growth, mentorship, and professional development. A collaborative and supportive work culture focused on quality and professionalism. How to Apply Please submit the following documents via email to hr@enkoy.tech  with “Senior Graphics and UI/UX Designer” in the subject line: Your CV Your Portfolio Scan copies of your highest academic degrees/certificates, grades, and transcripts (if any) Your earliest possible start date Your expected salary range

title: CCTV Operator
description:
Position Overview

The CCTV Room Personnel are responsible for continuous monitoring of the compound’s surveillance systems to ensure the safety and security of residents, visitors, and property. They will maintain strict vigilance, report suspicious activities, and coordinate with on-ground security staff to prevent and respond to incidents in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor live feeds from all CCTV cameras across the property on a rotational basis.

• Detect and immediately report suspicious activities, unauthorized access, or security breaches.

• Maintain accurate logs of daily surveillance activities, incidents, and responses.

• Coordinate with on-site security guards to respond quickly to emergencies or unusual activity.

• Ensure that all CCTV equipment is functioning properly; promptly report technical issues.

• Safeguard the confidentiality of all video footage and security-related information.

• Review and retrieve recorded footage when required for investigations or management requests.

• Follow established security protocols, emergency procedures, and communication channels.

• Assist in preparing incident reports for the Security Supervisor/Property Manager.

• Maintain discipline, punctuality, and professionalism while on duty.

Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent; additional security-related training is a plus.

• Previous experience in CCTV monitoring, security, or related field preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to stay alert for long periods.

• Basic technical knowledge of CCTV systems and equipment troubleshooting.

• Good communication skills in Amharic and basic English (preferred).

• High sense of responsibility, integrity, and confidentiality.

• Ability to remain calm and act quickly under pressure.

• Willingness to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Work Schedule

• Two personnel working in shifts to ensure 24/7 monitoring coverage.
• Shift rotation (e.g., 12-hour or 8-hour shifts, depending on management setup).

Lebu Tracon Real Estate(must live around Lebu)

title: Senior IT Architect
description: Senior IT Architect We are a dynamic young company based in Addis Ababa with a key partner in Berlin, Germany. We specialize in digital strategy consulting and solution engineering for a wide range of global projects, from custom software development to AI and blockchain technologies. Our team consists of carefully selected experts from around the world who are passionate about delivering high-quality, impactful solutions About the Role We are looking for a mature and highly experienced Senior IT Architect to join our team. The ideal candidate will be a self-sufficient professional with deep knowledge of both front-end and back-end technologies, capable of designing and documenting clean, scalable, and maintainable architectural solutions. This is a crucial, high-impact role where you will work closely with our CTO and development teams to define the technical vision for our projects and ensure their successful implementation. This role requires someone who is not only a technical expert but also a good team player. You will be expected to lead architectural discussions, help to make critical technical decisions, and document your work to a professional standard, ensuring clarity and consistency across all projects. Key Responsibilities Lead architectural design and solutioning for software projects, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and maintainable. Lead technical discussions with the CTO and development team to define architectural blueprints and make critical technology stack decisions. Document complete architectural designs and key architectural decisions using professional formats like arc42. Serve as a bridge between high-level business requirements and low-level technical implementation. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural principles. Evaluate and recommend new technologies and tools to improve development efficiency and product quality. Ensure architectural designs align with best practices, including security, performance, and reliability standards. Qualifications & Skills Proven professional experience as an IT Architect or in a similar senior-level technical role. Deep understanding of both front-end and back-end technologies. Expertise in designing and implementing clean architecture solutions. Strong knowledge of modern software development methodologies and principles. Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated maturity and initiative, with the ability to work independently and manage project deadlines. A strong team player who can collaborate effectively and lead by example. Experience with Flutter is a plus. Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) is a plus. What We Offer The opportunity to define the technical direction of innovative, impactful projects for global clients. A high degree of autonomy and the chance to directly influence project outcomes. A competitive salary and benefits package. Focus on career growth, mentorship, and professional development. A collaborative and supportive work culture focused on quality and professionalism. How to Apply Please submit the following documents via email to hr@enkoy.tech  with “Senior IT Architect” in the subject line: Your CV A portfolio or project list demonstrating your architectural design experience Scan copies of your highest academic degrees/certificates, grades, and transcripts ( if any) Your earliest possible start date Your expected salary range

title: Production Manager
description:
The Production Manager is responsible for planning, organizing, and overseeing all production operations within the manufacturing facility. The role ensures efficient use of manpower, machinery, and materials to achieve production targets while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and cost control. The Production Manager will lead a team of technicians and engineers to implement process improvements, reduce downtime, and optimize productivity in alignment with company objectives.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

Plan, schedule, and manage daily production activities to meet output and delivery targets.
Supervise and coordinate the work of production staff, including machine operators, technicians, and maintenance teams.
Monitor production processes and make adjustments as needed to ensure product quality and efficiency.
Analyze production data to identify areas for improvement and implement process optimization strategies.
Collaborate with the engineering, quality assurance, and maintenance departments to resolve technical issues.
Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all production processes.
Ensure all machines and equipment are maintained properly and operate safely.
Manage inventory of raw materials and finished goods to avoid shortages or overstocking.
Enforce safety regulations and ensure a safe working environment for all staff.
Conduct regular performance reviews and training for production personnel.
Prepare and present production reports to senior management, including efficiency, costs, and production trends.
Participate in new product development and testing to ensure manufacturability and cost-effectiveness.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives using lean manufacturing and quality control principles.
Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in manufacturing or production management.
Strong technical knowledge of mechanical systems, industrial machines, and production technologies.
Proven leadership and team management skills.
Familiarity with quality management systems (ISO standards) and lean manufacturing practices.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
Excellent communication, planning, and organizational skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and production management software (ERP or similar).
Perso:

nal AttributesStrong leadership and people management abilities.

Results-oriented with a focus on quality and efficiency.
High integrity, reliability, and professionalism.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Commitment to workplace safety and continuous improvement.

title: አፓልስተሪ ሰራተኛ
description:
ከቅርብ ኃላፊው ጋር በመነጋገር የተለያዩ ወንበሮችን እንዲመረቱ ዕቅድ ማዘጋጀትና ግብዓቶችንም በወቅቱ እንዲዘጋጁ ማድረግ፤
ለምርት ሂደቱ አስፈላጊ የሚሆኑ ጥሬ ዕቃዎችንና ግብዓቶችን ከንብረት ክፍል በተገቢው ሰነድ መረከብ፡፡
በክፍሉ የተመረቱ ምርቶች ጥራታቸውን ጠብቀው የተመረቱ መሆናቸውን በማረጋገጥ በተገቢው ሰነድ ወደ ንብረት ክፍል ገቢ ማድረግ፡፡
የጥሬ ዕቃ ብክነት እንዲሁም የምርት ግድፈት እንዳይኖር እያንዳንዱን የምርት ሂደት መከታተል፡፡
በመልካም የሥራ እንቅስቃሴና ባህሪ እንዲሁም ሰዓት በማክበር አርዓያ መሆን፡፡
ክፍሉ የሚያመርተውን የምርት መጠን ለማሳደግ የተለያዩ አዳዲስ የምርት ሂደት አሰራሮችን ማመንጨትና (ሃሳብ ማቅረብ) ሲፈቀዱ ተግባራዊ ማድረግ፡፡
የምርት ክፍል ሠራተኞች የሚሰሩትን ማንኛውንም ስራ መስራትና ሌሎችም እንዲሰሩ ማበረታታት፣ ማስተማር መከታተል፤
ለሚመረቱ ወንበሮች የሚያስፈልጉ ጥሬ እቃዎች በቅድሚያ ቆጠራ በማድረግ እጥረት የሚያሳዩትን ዕቃዎች ቀድሞ በማሳወቅ እንዲሟሉ ማድረግ
አገር ውስጥ የሚመረቱና ለምርት የሚያስፈልጉ ግብዓቶችን የሥራውን ሂደት በመገምገም በቅድሚያ እንዲገዙና በዕቃ ግምጃ ቤት እንዲያዙ ማድረግ
ክፍሉ የሚጠቀምባቸውን የተለያዩ የዕቃ መጠየቂያና የገቢ ሰነዶችን በጥንቃቄ ፋይል በማድረግ መያዝ፡፡

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Role Overview:

As Marketing Manager, you will craft and execute the marketing strategy for Easymaz, initially focusing on the airport and expanding to multiple locations. This is a hands-on role, combining strategic planning and execution, with an emphasis on local awareness, customer engagement, and brand growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop & Execute Marketing Strategy:

Design and implement marketing strategies starting at the airport, with plans for future expansion.
Lead digital marketing efforts (SEO, SEM, social media, content, email marketing) to drive awareness and traffic.
Create offline campaigns (billboards, flyers, airport partnerships) and adapt for future growth.
Brand Development & Positioning:

Establish Easymaz as the go-to dining experience at Bole International Airport.
Ensure consistent brand messaging across all channels as Easymaz expands regionally and internationally.
Customer Acquisition & Engagement:

Use paid and organic campaigns to drive traffic from travelers and local food lovers.
Develop loyalty programs, referral campaigns, and manage promotions to increase brand loyalty.
Community & Influencer Marketing:

Build relationships with local influencers, media, and travel bloggers to create buzz.
Manage influencer campaigns targeting both local and international audiences.
Organize community events and partnerships to enhance Easymaz’s presence.
Campaign Analytics & Reporting:

Analyze the effectiveness of campaigns and provide regular performance reports.
Use data to optimize campaigns and adjust strategies based on customer insights.
Future Expansion Strategy:

Work with leadership to expand marketing efforts beyond the airport, identifying new locations (malls, other airports, retail outlets).
Develop strategies for regional and international markets as Easymaz grows.
Qualifications & Experience:

Proven Marketing Experience: At least 3-5 years in marketing, with a focus on hospitality, food & beverage, or travel. Experience with airports or consumer-facing brands is a plus.
Versatile Marketing Skills: Expertise in digital marketing (SEO, SEM, Google Ads, social media) and offline marketing (print, radio, events).
Growth-Oriented: Ability to build marketing strategies at the airport and scale them for future growth in new locations.
Creative & Data-Driven: Strong content creation skills with a focus on creative marketing, plus experience using analytics tools (Google Analytics, Facebook Insights, etc.).
Local Market Knowledge: In-depth understanding of Addis Ababa’s consumer behavior and Ethiopian food culture.
Leadership & Collaboration: Ability to lead teams, work cross-functionally with product and design, and communicate effectively.
Languages: Fluency in Amharic and English is required.
Preferred Skills:

Airport Marketing Experience: Understanding the nuances of airport marketing and catering to transient travelers.
Event Management: Experience organizing events and pop-ups to drive foot traffic in high-traffic areas like airports.
Tech-Savvy: Comfortable using digital platforms for managing campaigns and tracking KPIs.
How to Apply:

Send your resume, portfolio (if applicable), and a cover letter to info@easymaz.com with the subject line: "Marketing Manager Application – Easymaz." In your cover letter, explain why you’re excited about this role and how you can help Easymaz grow at the airport and beyond.

description:
ተቋማችን ብቃት ያለው የስነ ፅሁፍ ባለሞያ መቅጠር ይፈልጋል። አመልካቹ በአማርኛ ቋንቋ የላቀ የአርትዖት ችሎታ እና በሙያው የረጅም አመት ልምድ ሊኖረው ይገባል።

የሚፈለጉ መስፈርቶች :

1. የላቀ የአርትዖት ክህሎት:

በሰዋስው፣ ሥርዓተ-ነጥብ፣ ሆሄያት እና የቃላት አጠቃቀም ላይ ከፍተኛ የማረምና የማጥራት ልምድ ያለው/ያላት።
ጽሑፎችን ግልጽ፣ ወጥ እና ስህተት የሌለባቸው እንዲሆኑ የማድረግ ብቃት።
የጽሑፎችን ይዘት፣ አወቃቀር እና አመክንዮ የማሻሻል ችሎታ።
2. የሥራ ልምድ፡

በስነ-ጽሑፍ ወይም በአርትዖት ዘርፍ የረጅም ዓመታት የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ያላት።
3. የትምህርት ዝግጅት፡

በቋንቋ፣ በስነ-ጽሑፍ ወይም በተዛማጅ የትምህርት መስክ የትምህርት ማስረጃ ቢኖረው ይመረጣል።
ሆኖም ግን፣ የመደበኛ ትምህርት ሳይኖረው ቀርቶ፣ ተጨባጭ እና በቂ የአርትዖትና የጽሑፍ ልምድ ያላቸው ግለሰቦች ቀደም ሲል የሠሯቸውን ሥራዎች በማቅረብ ብቃታቸውን ማሳየት ይችላሉ።
4. ተጨማሪ መስፈርት

የመተርጎም ችሎታ: ሥራው ከእንግሊዝኛ ወደ አማርኛ የመተርጎም ችሎታንም ይጠይቃል።

title: Machine Learning & Full-Stack Web Developer (Price Analytics & Display Project)
description:
Job description:

We are looking for a versatile professional who can combine machine learning expertise with full-stack web development skills to build a real-time commodity price analysis and display system. The role involves developing predictive ML models, integrating them into a web interface, and ensuring seamless data visualization and user experience.

 

Key Responsibilities

Machine Learning / Data Science

Design, develop, and optimize ML models for commodity price forecasting.

Clean, process, and manage large datasets for predictive analytics.

Evaluate, test, and fine-tune ML models to improve accuracy.

Generate reports, dashboards, and visual insights for business use.

Web Development

Build responsive frontend interfaces using React, Angular, or Vue.

Develop backend APIs (Node.js) to serve dynamic price and ML outputs.

Integrate web app with ML models and IVR systems for real-time updates.

Ensure performance, scalability, and security of the application.

Collaborate with ML, IVR, and data teams to deliver seamless user experience.

Requirements

Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch).

Experience with Node.js (backend) and at least one frontend framework (React, Angular, or Vue).

Solid knowledge of RESTful APIs, JSON, and database integration (SQL/NoSQL).

Exprience with real-time data pipelines, analytics, and visualization.

Familiarity with Git version control and deployment workflows.

Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

Apply email info@Kanenustechnologies.com

title: Senior Pharmacist
description:
Job Title: Senior Pharmacist – Pharmaceutical Market Assessment Lead

Position Summary:

The Senior Pharmacist – Pharmaceutical Market Assessment Lead will spearhead the design, implementation, and analysis of pharmaceutical market assessments to inform strategic decision-making, policy development, and supply chain optimization. This role requires a seasoned professional with deep knowledge of pharmaceutical systems, market dynamics, and regulatory frameworks, particularly in low- and middle-income country contexts.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead comprehensive pharmaceutical market assessments, including demand forecasting, pricing analysis, supply chain mapping, and stakeholder engagement.
Design and implement data collection tools and methodologies for market intelligence.
Analyze market trends, product availability, affordability, and accessibility across public and private sectors.
Collaborate with regulatory authorities, manufacturers, distributors, and healthcare providers to gather insights and validate findings.
Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, and technical briefs for internal and external stakeholders.
Provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams on pharmaceutical market dynamics.
Support the projects in evidence-based planning and procurement strategies.
Ensure compliance with national and international pharmaceutical regulations and ethical standards.
Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy; Master’s degree Pharmacoepidemiology , pharmacy administration, public health or related field preferred.
Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical supply chain, market analysis, or regulatory affairs.
Proven experience conducting market assessments particularly in pharmaceutical sector studies.
Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, STATA, Power BI etc…).
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Familiarity with the private and public health sector in Ethiopia.
Preferred Skills:

Knowledge of national drug policies and procurement systems.
Experience working with LMIS, DHIS2, or other health information systems.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
Fluency in English; knowledge of local languages is a plus.
How to Apply

·       Interested and qualified applicants fulfilling the above criteria are invited to send their CV and copies of relevant documents along with application letter through email address alekdagi@gmail.com.

Job Address
Addis Ababa

description: ሱፐር ቫይዘር ለማመልከት እባክዎ ይህንን ሊንክ ይጠቀሙ (Use this link to APPLY) የስራ መደቡ፡-ሱፐርቫይዘር የፕሮዳክሽን ለዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ መስፈርቶች፡- ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እና ማማከር ነው፡፡ Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMSፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት ያለው ድርጅታችን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያለው እና ልምድ ያለው አጠቃላይ ተቆጣጣሪ/የዋና አስተዳዳሪ እየፈለግን ነው። ሱፐር ቡስት አፕ የኢትዮጵያን ተቋማት፣ ቢዝነሶች፣ግለሰቦች፣ትምህርት ቤቶችን በዲጂታል መንገድ ለማብቃት እና በዲጂታል መንገድ እንዲያድጉ ለመርዳት የተቋቋመ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ ነው። የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ - economic, marketing,Management, business Administration and other related field   የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ እንቅስቃሴ ያቅዳል፣ ያደራጃል፣ ይመራል፣ ይቆጣጠራል።   ድርጅቱ ትርፋማ እንዲሆን የሚያስችሉ ፖሊሲዎችንና ስትራቴጂዎችን ነድፎ ይሰራል።   የድርጅቱን የአጭርና የረዥም ጊዜ አላማ ከግብ ለማድረስ የድርጅቱ የሰው ሃይልና የሰው ሃይል በማቀድ፣ በማደራጀት፣ በመምራትና በመቆጣጠር ይሰራል።   LMS ፕላትፎርም የሚሆኑ ፕሮዳክሽን ስራ እንዲሰራ ያደርጋል   አዳዲስ ተቀጣሪዎች ምልመላ፣ ስልጠናና ቅጥር ማከናወን፡፡   እያንዳንዱ ስራ እና ንዑስ የስራ ሂደት በተገቢው ሁኔታ እየሄደ እንደሆነና የታለመለትን ግብ ሊያሳካ ስለመቻሉ ክትትል ማድረግ...   ሁሉንም የስራ ሂደቶች መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀት፡፡   የእያንዳንዱን የስራተኞች ስራ ክንውን መከተታተል ፡፡   የድርጅቱን የፋይናንስ ፣ የማርኬቲንግ እያንዳንዱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡   ከፋይናንስ እና አካውንቲንግ ጋር በተያያዘ ያለውን ስራ በእራስም ሆነ ከሚመለከተው ባለሙያ ጋር ሆኖ የየወቅቱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡   በጀት መመደብና ወጪ መቀነስ   ፖሊሲ ማርቀቅና እና አተገባበሩንም መተለም   የሰራተኞችን የስራ አቅምና ባህል እንዲጎለብት መርዳት   ሁሉም የፋይናንስ እንቅስቃሴዎች በታለመላቸው መልኩ እየሄዱ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ክትትል ማድረግ   የድርጅቱን ግብርና ቀረጥ መሰል ክፍያዎች በጊዜው መክፈል ወይም እንዲከፈል ማድረግ   የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን ጊዜውን ጠብቀው ማውጣት ከዚህ በላይ የተዘረዘሩትን መስፈርቶች የምታሟሉ አመልካቾች ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ 10 ተከታታይ የስራ ቀናት ውስጥ መመዝገብ ትችላላችሁ። የስራ ሁኔታ፡ ሪሞት(freelance) ወይም ባሉበት ሆነው ደሞዝ :በስምምነት

title: Sales supervisor
description: Sales supervisor መስፈርቶች፡- ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ/ሶሻል ሚዲያማርኬቲንግ፣ የኦንላይን ስልጠና እና ማማከር ነው፡፡ ድርጅታችን ሽያጭ ቡድናችንን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያለው እና ልምድ ያለው የሽያጭ ተቆጣጣሪ እየፈለግን ነው። የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ - marketing,economic, Management, business Administration  and other related field •  በሽያጭ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት ልምድ ያለው - ስለ ዲጂታል ማርኬት ላይ በቂ ልምድ ያላት/ው LMS ጠንካራ እውቀት እና ግንዛቤ - ጥሩ የግንኙነት፣ ድርድር እና የአመራር ችሎታ •  cold calling እና face to face ሽያጭ ለይ ልምድ ያለው/ላት •  የሽያጭ ግቦችን ማሳካት እና የገቢ ዕድገትን በማስመዝገብ የተረጋገጠ ሪከርድ - የሽያጭ ተወካዮችን በብቃት የመምራት እና የማሰልጠን •  ችሎታ ኃላፊነቶች፡ - የሽያጭ ዒላማዎችን ለማሳካት የሽያጭ ተወካዮችን ቡድን መምራት እና ማስተዳደር - ውጤታማ የሽያጭ ስትራቴጂዎችን እና እቅዶችን ማዘጋጀት እና መተግበር - መመሪያ እና ድጋፍ መስጠት ስልጠና እና ምክርን ጨምሮ ለሽያጭ ቡድኑ - ከዋና ዋና ደንበኞች እና አጋሮች ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ማዳበር እና ማቆየት •  መደበኛ የአፈፃፀም ግምገማዎችን ማካሄድ እና ገንቢ አስተያየት መስጠት - •  ከሌሎች ክፍሎች ጋር በመተባበር ምርቶች እና አገልግሎቶችን ያለችግር ለማድረስ - ከኢንዱስትሪ ጋር ወቅታዊ መረጃ ያግኙ አዳዲስ የሽያጭ እድሎችን ለመለየት አዝማሚያዎች እና እድገቶች - የገበያ ውድድርን መቆጣጠር ማስታወሻ፡- ለስራው የምንፈልገው ዋናው በኮሚሽን ላይ በደንብ እምነት ያለው/ላት እንዲሆን ነው፡፡ ምክንያቱም ኮሚሽን ሌላ ቦታ ካለው በጣም ከፍተኛ ያደረግንበት ምክንየት ጥሩ የሽያጭ ክንውን በማስመዘገብ ለሁለቱም ወገን ተጠቃሚ ለማድረግ ነው፡፡ ደሞዝ :7000 ብር 6% ኮሚሽን

description: Content Creator casting person ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው ዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ/ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ኦንላይን (online) ስልጠና  እና ማማከር ነው፡፡ ለዚህም ድርጅታችን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት እንዲሁም ልምድ ያለው ኮንተት ክሬተርና casting person እንፈልጋለን። አስፈላጊ ችሎታዎችና ዝግጅት፦ •  የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ - communication, journalism or art •  ቢያንስ 1 ዓመት ልምድ ያላት •  ስለ ዲጂታል ማርኬት ላይ በቂ ልምድ  ያላት •  Online ትምህርት ጠንካራ እውቀት እና ግንዛቤ •  ለአጫጭር ስልጠና የሚሆኑ ኮርሶችን የትምህርት ማንዋል ማዘጋጀት በቂ ችሎታ ያላት •  ጥሩ የግንኙነትና የአመራር ችሎታ •  ውጤትና እቅድ ተኮር መሆን •  ጥሩ የሆነ የጊዜ አጠቃቀም •  በቂ የሆነ video editing skill ተመራጭ ነው፡፡ ኃላፊነቶች፦ •  የለተለያዩ የፈጠራ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦችን ማዳበር፣ ለምንሰጠው ስልጠናዎች ማንዋሎች  ማዘጋጀት፤ ለማስታወቂያ እን ለተለያዩ ግበአቶች የሚሆኑ ኮንቴነቶችን ማዘጋጀት፣ ቮይስ ኦቨር፣ ካስቲንግ መስራት፡፡ የሚከተሉትን ጨምሮ፡- •  ኮንቴንት ካላንደር ማዘጋጀት •  ኮንቴንት ለቀን፣ ለሳምንት፣ ለወር ማዘጋጀት •  ካስቲንግና፣  (ለቀረጻ አጠቃላይ ዝግጅቶችን ማድረግ እና ምርትን/ አገልግሎትን ለማስተዋወቅ መቀረጽ) •  video editing graphics  ስራዎች መስራት የምትችል/ሚችል ቢሆን ይመረጣል •  አስፈላጊ በሆነበት ሰዐትና ጊዜ ሁሉ ቮይስ ኦቨር መቀዳትና መቅረጽ •  ከሌሎች ክፍሎች ጋር በመተባበር የተሻለ አገልግሎት ለመስጠት ቁርጠኛና ዝግጁ መሆን •  አገልግሎቶችን ያለችግር ለማድረስ - -ከኢንዱስትሪ ጋር ወቅታዊ መረጃ ማግኘትና አዳዲስ የክሬቲቪቲ እድሎችን ለመለየት •  የገበያ ውድድርን ማጥናትና ተስማሚ ይዘት መፍጠር ደሞዝ: 10,000 ብር

Experience managing CI/CD pipelines, AWS / cloud infrastructure, and Dockerized environments.
Proven record in API design, scalability, and integration.
Solid understanding of Git workflows, Agile environments, and team collaboration tools.

Preferred Skills

Strong communication and team-management skills.
Ability to translate business goals into technical execution.
Experience mentoring junior developers and managing sprints.
Hands-on debugging and performance optimization ability.
Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience.
Fast-growing, mission-driven tech environment.
Opportunity to lead innovation in one of Ethiopia’s leading e-commerce ecosystems.
Direct collaboration with CTO and core management team.

ተፈላጊ ልዩ ችሎታዎች

Accounts & Transactions

Stay updated on National Bank of Ethiopia fintech guidelines and interoperability standards .

Manage payroll through digital payroll systems with automated statutory deductions.

Ensure multi-channel settlement (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr) is tracked, reconciled, and secured.

Audit & Internal Controls

Coordinate audits with external auditors and regulators, ensuring fintech compliance.

Implement fraud prevention and digital transaction monitoring systems.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Operations and HR to align payment flows with organizational goals.

Communicate with banks, fintech providers, and vendors through digital platforms.

Policy Development & Innovation

title: Product Prototyping Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking a Product Prototyping Engineer with a builder’s mindset and an eye for rapid product development. This role is perfect for someone who loves turning ideas into functional prototypes and thrives in fast-paced, early-stage environments. You’ll work across tools like Lovable, Base44, and Supabase to help bring concepts to life quickly and efficiently.

 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, test, and iterate on product prototypes using Lovable, Base44, or Supabase.
Collaborate with founders and product managers to define MVP scope and roadmap.
Translate product ideas into tangible interfaces and workflows.
Integrate Supabase for backend functionality, authentication, and database management.
Deliver high-quality prototypes that can evolve into production-ready products.
Document build processes and maintain prototype consistency for future scaling.
Required Experience (1 Year Each Preferred)

Lovable — hands-on experience building or shipping projects.
Base44 — practical understanding of rapid prototyping workflows.
Supabase — familiarity with backend setup, database design, and API integration.
Prototyping — proven ability to create functional, testable MVPs.
Preferred Skills

Experience with front-end frameworks (React, Next.js, or Flutter Flow).
Familiarity with Vibe Coders or similar low/no-code prototyping tools.
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with design and backend teams.
Strong product sense and ability to balance speed with quality.
About You

You’re a maker at heart — someone who loves experimenting, building, and iterating. You’re comfortable in ambiguity, quick to learn new tools, and passionate about turning early concepts into real, testable products.

Job Address
Remote

title: DevOps Engineer
description: About the Role * We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to collaborate with us on a project basis whenever DevOps expertise is required. You will help bridge the gap between development and operations by building, automating, and maintaining infrastructure that enables reliable software delivery and smooth system performance. *This is not a full-time or part-time position, but rather a role where you will be engaged as needed for different projects. It’s ideal for someone who has solid DevOps experience and is eager to contribute to diverse projects while continuing to learn and grow. Responsibilities - Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines for faster, more reliable deployments. - Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or similar. - Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP). - Collaborate with development teams to ensure smooth release processes. Maintain high system availability, performance, and security. - Automate operational tasks to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. - Contribute to observability (logging, monitoring, alerting) for proactive issue detection. Requirements - 2–5 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or related roles. - Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). - Hands-on experience with at least one cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure). - Experience with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred). - Knowledge of IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or similar). Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.). - Good scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar). - Strong problem-solving mindset, collaborative, and eager to learn. Nice-to-Haves - Background in security best practices and compliance. - Exposure to serverless technologies. What We Offer - A collaborative environment where learning and growth are encouraged. - Opportunities to work with modern tools and scalable architectures. - Competitive compensation on a project-by-project basis. - Flexibility in working arrangements with engagement only when DevOps expertise is needed.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Bahmni/OpenMRS Specialist) Development of an Integrated Digital Health System for a Clinic Network Salary:- 25000Birr -30000Birr Location: Remote (with potential for on-site deployment support in Ethiopia) Engagement:Contract / Project-based (3-4 month initial phase with potential for long-term support) About the Project: We are building a modern,robust digital health solution to power a network of primary healthcare clinics. The system will be critical in managing electronic medical records (EMR), tracking revenue, and managing clinic inventory, all integrated into a single, seamless platform. Our mission is to enhance patient care and operational efficiency through technology. The solution will be built upon the open-source Bahmni platform. We are looking for a skilled and passionate developer to lead the technical implementation, customization, and deployment of this system. Key Responsibilities: · Lead the customization and configuration of the Bahmni platform to meet specific clinical workflows (including Patient Registration, Consultation, Lab, Pharmacy, and Billing). · Design, develop, and integrate core modules: EMR, Revenue Management, and Stock Management. · Implement a hybrid data architecture, configuring on-premises servers for daily operations and automated, encrypted cloud backups for disaster recovery. · Work closely with stakeholders to understand requirements, hardcode service pricing into the system, and ensure the platform meets all operational needs. · Develop and execute test plans (Unit, Integration, UAT) to ensure system reliability and data security. · Potentially support the deployment and installation of the system at clinic locations, including basic network setup guidance. · Create technical documentation and provide training to end-users and "Super Users." Required Skills & Qualifications: · Must-Have Experience: · Proven, hands-on experience with the Bahmni platform or its core components (OpenMRS and OpenELIS). · Strong full-stack development skills (Java, Spring, Hibernate for backend; JavaScript, HTML, CSS for frontend). · Experience in designing and integrating modules for financial/ revenue tracking and inventory/stock management. · Proficiency with RESTful APIs and system integration. · Experience with database design and management (MySQL/PostgreSQL). · Familiarity with implementing data security best practices and data encryption. · Highly Desirable Skills: · Experience deploying systems in low-infrastructure or clinic settings. · Knowledge of implementing hybrid/on-premises server architectures with cloud backup solutions (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage). · Understanding of healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) is a significant plus. · Previous experience in the digital health domain, especially in developing countries. · Personal Attributes: · Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently. · Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with a non-technical team. · Proactive and committed to delivering high-quality, reliable software. Project Timeline: We are targeting a rapid deployment with a11-13 week timeline from project kick-off to full roll-out across multiple clinics. To Apply: Please submit your application,including: 1. Your CV/Resume, highlighting specific experience with Bahmni, OpenMRS, or other healthcare information systems. 2. A brief cover letter or portfolio note explaining your relevant experience, especially with revenue/financial modules or inventory systems. 3. Links to any relevant projects or code repositories (if available).

title: Marketing Representative
description: We’re looking for a dynamic and thoughtful Marketing Representative to support brand positioning and campaign execution across a diverse group of companies in sectors ranging from real estate to finance, education, hospitality, and engineering. This role connects business development and storytelling, helping teams reach their audiences with clarity and impact. What You’ll Do: Serve as the link between internal teams and the centralized creative unit, translating business insights into compelling campaign briefs. Contribute to campaign planning, audience segmentation, and message development. Track performance data and report on campaign outcomes to inform ongoing strategies. Manage marketing materials, company profiles, and digital presence across platforms. Ensure alignment between sales, brand strategy, and customer-facing communications. Participate in internal meetings and convert key updates into marketing insights. What We’re Looking For: Great experience in marketing, communications, branding, or content strategy. Comfortable working with multiple brands and adapting voice, tone, and message. Strong communication skills (Both English and Amharic) and ability to work across departments. Analytical mindset with familiarity in campaign tracking and audience insights. Interest in blending creative and business thinking to shape messaging. Bonus If You Have: Experience translating technical or B2B products into accessible campaigns. Understanding of the Ethiopian or East African business and cultural landscape. To Apply: Please submit your CV and a brief portfolio or sample of past work (campaigns, writing samples, brand messaging, or marketing assets you've contributed to). We're more interested in the quality of your thinking and execution than in how long you've been doing it.

title: Social Media Manager
description: We’re seeking a creative and organized Social Media Manager to run digital channels across a variety of brands in sectors such as hospitality, education, real estate, and finance. This role is perfect for someone who loves creating engaging content, understands digital audiences, and knows how to build consistency across multiple brand identities. What You’ll Do: Manage daily posting, engagement, and community interaction across multiple platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.). Collaborate with internal teams to align content with ongoing campaigns and events. Track analytics and KPIs, providing insights for performance improvement. Maintain a consistent brand voice while adapting tone to suit each venture. Work closely with graphic designers and video leads to publish high-quality content. What We’re Looking For: Great experience managing brand or agency social media accounts. Understanding of content planning, scheduling, and performance tracking. Strong written and visual communication skills. Ability to juggle multiple brands without losing quality or voice alignment. Collaborative mindset with an eye for what resonates with audiences. To Apply: Please share your CV, along with samples of social media pages you’ve managed, content you’ve created, or analytics reports that show your impact. We're looking for thoughtful execution, not just flashy metrics.

title: Head of Finance
description: On behalf of our parent company, Sintayehu Nasibu Plc. Established in 1997 EC, operates across multiple sectors, including transport services, building rentals, quarry material supply, and trading. As the company continues to grow, it is expanding its finance department to enhance financial management and strengthen operational excellence across all its business divisions. We are looking for a Senior Accountant to support the Head of Finance by managing daily financial operations, preparing accurate financial reports, ensuring compliance with tax regulations, and assisting in audit preparations. Key Responsibilities: Develop and manage budgets, allocate resources, and make financial decisions in line with company policies. Supervise and mentor finance and accounting staff. Maintain accurate financial records and prepare financial statements. Ensure compliance with regulations, tax laws, and accounting standards. Provide financial advice and analysis to the General Manager. Monitor financial performance, including monthly and yearly statements, forecasting, and variance analysis. Analyze financial data and prepare reports, presentations, schedules, and forecasts. Update property records and monitor financial health for profitability. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting & Finance. Minimum 8 years of experience in finance or accounting. Strong understanding of financial concepts, planning, and analysis. Proven experience in budgeting, cost control, and financial reporting. Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills. Interested candidates who meet the above requirements can submit their application letter, updated CV, and copies of relevant credentials to addisuaregaw@gmail.com or deliver in person at the company’s head office: Address: Addis Ababa, Wollo Sefer, around Gorgories Roundabout, Martreza Building, 1st Floor.

title: የሹፌር ባለሙያ
description: አስቸኳይ የሥራ ማስታወቂያ አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ የሹፌር ባለሙያ ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ ፡-   አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን ቀልጣፋ፣ ብቃት ፣ አስተማማኝና የስራ ልምድ ያለው ሹፌር እንፈልጋለን፡፡ ድርጅታችን የሚያስረክበውን የደንበኞች ንብረት በተሰጠው ጊዜ በሰዓቱ  በጥንቃቄ  በኃላፊነት በማጓጓዝ የስራ ቁሳቁሶችን እና መሳሪያዎችን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ የሚያደርስ፡፡ ቁልፍ ተግባራት እና ኃላፊነቶች፡-   • በተመደበው  መሰረት ሰዎችን  ሆነ እቃዎችን ለማጓጓዝ የድርጅቱን ተሽከርካሪዎችን መንዳት። • ተሽከርካሪው ንጹህ፣ በጥሩ ሁኔታ መያዝ እና ለመንገድ ዝግጁ ማድረግ። • የትራፊክ እና የደህንነት ደንቦችን በማንኛውም ጊዜ መከተል። • ማንኛውንም ሜካኒካል ጉዳዮችን ወይም አደጋዎችን ወዲያውኑ ሪፖርት ማድረግ። • በሚያስፈልግበት ጊዜ የመጫኛ እና የማራገፊያ ቁሳቁሶችን መርዳት። • ትክክለኛ የጉዞ እና የነዳጅ መዝገቦችን መጠበቅ። ·   ማንዋልም ሆነ አውቶማቲክ የመኪና ማርሽ  በሚገባ መንዳት የሚችል፡፡ መስፈርቶች፡ -የታደሰ /የሚሰራ/ መንጃ ፍቃድ ያለው። - ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት  እና ከዚያ በላይ የከተማ መንገዶችን የማሽከርከር ልምድ ያለው። -  የትራፊክ ህጎች እና የከተማ መንገዶች እውቀት ያለው። -  ከሰው ጋር ጥሩ መግባባትና  የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ችሎታ ያለው። -  ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው በራሱ የሚተማመን -  ታማኝ፣ የድርጅቱን ሰዓት የሚያከብር። -  አመልካች ሰፈሩ ሳሊተ ምህረት ወይም ገርጂ አካባቢ የሆነ የሥራ ዓይነት:- የሙሉ ጊዜ ደመወዝ:-  ወርሃዊ እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል፡- ·      አመልካቾች  የት/ት ማስረጃ፣ የሥራ ልምድ እና የታደሰ መንጃ ፈቃድ ኮፒውን በአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን በአካል ም ሆነ በቴሌግራም ማቅረብም ሆነ መላክ ይችላሉ፡፡ ·      አመልካቾች  ቅጥር ስትፈጽሙ በቂ ዋስ ማቅረብ የሚችል እና ከመንግስት መስራያ ቤት ዋስ/ተያዥ ማቅረብ  የምትችል / ሌላ አማራጭ ካለ… የስራ አድራሻ፡- • አዲስ አበባ አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  በትራፊክ መብራት  አካባቢ፣  ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ ላይ እንገኛለን፡፡  ስ/ቁ 09-62-11-06-32 ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከቅዳሜ ቀን  08/02/2018 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ እስከ 10/02/2018 ሰኞ ድረስ የምንቀበል ይሆናል፡፡

የስቶር ዳታ ተቆጣጣሪ

title: Recruitment specialist
description:
About Ihaco

Ihaco is a dynamic and forward-thinking company dedicated to connecting top talent with great opportunities. We pride ourselves on our meticulous approach to recruitment, ensuring every candidate and job application is evaluated with precision and care. Our commitment to quality and industry insight drives our success, and we are looking for a Recruitment Specialist who shares these values.

Job Overview

As a Recruitment Specialist at Ihaco, you will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment process, with a primary focus on reviewing resumes, analyzing job applications, and expertly matching candidates to the right roles. Your keen attention to detail, thorough understanding of industry trends, and ability to work effectively in the Eastern Time Zone will be crucial to your success. This role requires a strategic thinker who can enhance our talent acquisition processes while maintaining a high standard of quality.

Key Responsibilities

Resume and Application Analysis:

• Review, evaluate, and interpret resumes, cover letters, and job applications with a meticulous eye for detail.

• Conduct thorough assessments of candidate qualifications, ensuring alignment with job requirements and industry trends.

Talent Matching and Candidate Sourcing:

• Utilize innovative sourcing strategies and industry insights to identify high-potential candidates.

• Match candidate profiles with job openings using data-driven approaches and strong market intelligence.

Process Management:

• Manage the full recruitment life cycle from initial candidate engagement to offer negotiation and onboarding coordination.

• Ensure all documentation and candidate records are maintained accurately according to company standards.

Stakeholder Collaboration:

• Work closely with hiring managers and department heads to understand staffing needs and strategic workforce plans.

• Provide regular updates and insights on recruitment metrics, trends, and market dynamics to leadership.

Industry Research and Trend Analysis:

• Stay current on industry trends, best practices, and competitive hiring strategies.

• Leverage this knowledge to continuously improve recruitment strategies and application analysis processes.

Administrative Excellence:

• Maintain excellent records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and ensure timely communication with all candidates.

• Schedule interviews and manage candidate follow-ups in a manner that respects both candidate experience and hiring timelines.

Qualifications and Skills

Attention to Detail:

• Demonstrable ability to meticulously review applications, ensuring accuracy and adherence to details in a fast-paced environment.

Eastern Time Zone Availability:

• Must be able to work effectively and reliably within the Eastern Time Zone, accommodating meetings, candidate interviews, and collaboration with team members across this region.

Analytical Skills:

• Strong ability to analyze resumes, job applications, and candidate data, utilizing metrics to drive decisions.

• Familiarity with various ATS systems and recruitment analytics tools is preferred.

Industry Insight:

• A deep understanding of current industry trends and market challenges in recruitment.

• Ability to translate industry data into actionable insights that inform talent acquisition strategies.

Communication:

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to engage both candidates and hiring managers professionally.

Interpersonal Skills:

• Proven track record of building strong relationships with internal stakeholders and candidates.

• Collaborative mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Experience:

• No prior experience needed, Write the word panda and send it to our company email for direct interview. employment@ihateapplying.com

Technical Proficiency:

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and other common recruitment platforms.

• Ability to quickly learn new recruitment technologies as needed.

Remote

title: Part-Time Finance Officer
description: Vacancy Announcement: Part-Time Finance Officer Organization: Media Smart Youth Ethiopia (MeSY) Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Position Type: Part-Time Duration: 6 months with possibility of extension Application Deadline: Oct. 27, 2025 About MeSY The Media Smart Youth Ethiopia (MeSY-E) is a consortium of non-governmental, nonpolitical, non-religious and non-partisan youth serving organization. It was established in November 2020 by leaders of eight youth serving organizations with strong conviction on young people’s resilience despite the widespread media malpractice. Its ultimate goal is to empower youth people with skill to access critically analyze and evaluate media and enable them to be more responsible in creating and sharing media messages. Position Summary Media Smart Youth Ethiopia (MeSY) is looking for a qualified and motivated Part-Time Finance Officer to support financial management, reporting, and compliance activities. The Finance Officer will work closely with the Program Manager and Managing Director to ensure transparent and accountable financial operations. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day financial transactions, including payments, vouchers, and petty cash. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports in line with donor and organizational requirements. Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all supporting documentation is properly filed. Monitor project budgets and support budget preparation and revisions. Ensure compliance with Ethiopian tax regulations and donor financial policies. Assist in audit preparation and respond to auditor queries.  Provide administrative and procurement support when required. Qualifications & Skills BA degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field. Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in NGO or project-based financial management. Sound knowledge of Peachtree Accounting and Microsoft Excel. Strong understanding of Ethiopian tax and financial reporting regulations. Excellent attention to detail, integrity, and time management skills. Strong communication and teamwork abilities. What We Offer Competitive part-time compensation. Flexible working hours. A creative and collaborative environment committed to youth empowerment and digital innovation. How to Apply Interested applicants are invited to submit: A cover letter (max 1 page) Updated CV (max 3 pages) Contact information of at least one referee  Previous Experience Send your application to: msyethiopia@gmail.com Subject line: Application – Part-Time Finance Officer Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች

• በቆዳ እንክብካቤ ዘርፍ ያሉ ወቅታዊ አዝማሚያዎችን (Trends)፣ የደንበኞችን ፍላጎት እና የብራንድ መልዕክቶችን የሚያገናኝ ስትራቴጂያዊ ይዘት መፍጠር።

2. የይዘት ፈጠራ እና ምርት

• የቪዲዮ ይዘት: ለምርት ማስተዋወቂያ፣ ለትምህርታዊ ዓላማ (How-to videos) እና ለመዝናኛ (Engaging) የሚሆኑ አጫጭርና ጥራት ያላቸው ቪዲዮዎችን መቅረፅና ማረም።

• የፎቶ ይዘት: ለብራንዱ የሚሆኑ ማራኪ እና ሙያዊ ፎቶግራፎችን ማንሳት፣ ማስተካከል እና ዲዛይን ማዘጋጀት።

title: inventory and sales software developer
description:
I hope this message finds you well. Thank you for taking the time to work with me on developing an inventory management solution. To help you better understand my needs, I’ve outlined the key features and functions I would like the software to include:

Product Management – Ability to add, edit, and categorize products with details such as item name, SKU, supplier, cost, selling price, and quantity.

Stock Tracking – Real-time updates on stock levels, low-stock alerts, and the ability to record incoming and outgoing inventory.

Sales & Order Management – Record sales transactions, link them to inventory changes, and generate invoices/receipts.

Supplier Management – Keep track of supplier details and purchase orders.

Reporting & Analytics – Generate reports on sales, stock movement, fast- and slow-moving items, and overall performance.

User Access – Multiple user roles with permissions (e.g., admin, staff) to maintain security and accountability.

Ease of Use – A simple, intuitive interface that can be used without advanced technical skills.

Scalability – Ability to grow with my business and handle an expanding product catalog in the future.

If possible, I would also like the system to support barcode scanning for quick check-in/check-out and an export/import feature for Excel or CSV files.

የቅድሚያ ትእዛዝ እና ግዢ ቁጥጥር — መጠን ማስተካከል፣ አቅርቦት ማረጋገጥ፣ ዋጋ መነጋገር እና የPO ሂደት መከታተል.

መቀበያ እና መረጃ ማረጋገጫ — የተቀበሉት ንብረቶች ከPO/ደረሰኝ ጋር እንዲዛመዱ መለያየት፣ ጥራት ምርመራ ማድረግ.

እቃ ዝርዝር እና መጠን ቁጥጥር — FIFO/FEFO መከተል፣ የወር መለያ እና የቀን ቆጠራ ማድረግ፣ ኪሳራ መቆጣጠር.
(FIFO/FEFO, stock counts, waste control)
የዋጋ ቁጥጥር — የዕቃ ወጪ ሂሳብ (COGS) መከታተል
የመመሪያ ሰነድ ማስጠበቅ — መደበኛ ሥርዓቶች (SOPs) ማዘመን እና ማስኬድ.
(Maintain and enforce SOPs)
ማስታወቂያ እና ሪፖርት — የዕቃ ልዩነት፣ ኪሳራ፣ የሽያጭ-ወጪ ግንኙነት ሪፖርቶች ማቅረብ.
(Variance, waste, sales-to-cost reporting)
መጀመሪያ እና መጨረሻ ቁጥጥር — የቀን/ሳምንት መዝገቦች መዝጋት፣ ቁጥር ማረጋገጥ

ምርት መጠን እና ስታንዳርድ ሬሲፒ — የሬሲፒ መመዘኛ መጠን መጠበቅ፣ ፖርሽን መቆጣጠር.

title: GPS Installer Technician
description: At ATN Technology, we specialise in advanced fleet-tracking and telematics solutions through our flagship platform “ATNgps” — a speed-limiter & fleet tracking/management system used by companies, public divisions and individuals around the world. As part of our growing field team, you will help deliver best-in-class vehicle installations, ensuring our clients (from small fleets to large enterprises) benefit from reliable, accurate GPS tracking and telematics solutions.   Role Overview: We are seeking a skilled and driven GPS Installer Technician who will be responsible for the professional installation, configuration, and maintenance of GPS tracking devices and telematics equipment in a variety of vehicles (light, medium, heavy duty). This is a hands-on role, requiring strong vehicle electrical knowledge, excellent customer service, and the ability to work independently in the field.   Key Responsibilities: -Install GPS tracking and telematics hardware (wiring, antennas, modules, power supply) in vehicles according to company standards and client requirements. -Test and verify all installations: ensure device communicates correctly, GPS signal is optimal, speed-limiter (if applicable) is configured, and data flows to back-office systems. -Diagnose and troubleshoot installation issues (electrical faults, wiring errors, connectivity issues, device malfunctions). -Maintain accurate records of installations, service calls, and parts usage. -Communicate effectively with customers onsite: explain device operation, answer questions, provide basic user orientation. -Maintain tools and vehicle in clean, professional condition. -Adhere to company safety protocols, vehicle electrical wiring standards, and fleet policies. -Work collaboratively with dispatch/field-coordinator to schedule installations efficiently, meet daily quotas, write service reports. -Occasionally perform removal or upgrade of installed units, support retrofit installations. -Travel to client sites (local/regional), may include nights or weekends depending on client schedules.   Qualifications & Skills: -High school diploma or equivalent; technical training in automotive electronics, telematics or related field preferred. -Proven experience installing vehicle tracking devices, telematics units or GPS hardware in a fleet or installation environment. -Strong knowledge of vehicle electrical systems (12 V/24 V), wiring, fuses, relays, power distribution. -Comfort with reading wiring diagrams, using voltmeters/multimeters, diagnosing wiring faults. -Ability to work independently in a vehicle setting, climbing in/out of engine bays, under dashboards, mounting hardware. -Excellent attention to detail and documentation skills. -Good customer service skills: ability to interact professionally with clients onsite. -Valid driver’s license, good driving record; some travel required. -Ability to lift and maneuver installation hardware (up to ~50 lbs occasionally), work in varied weather and vehicle environments. -Preferably, experience with fleet telematics, speed-limiter systems, or asset-tracking solutions is a plus.   What We Offer: -Competitive salary / hourly pay (commensurate with experience) plus potential for performance bonuses. -Company-provided installation vehicle, tools, and uniform. -Comprehensive training on ATN’s GPS/telematics platform and hardware. -Opportunity to grow within a technology-focused, rapidly expanding fleet solutions company. -Benefits package [health, paid time off, retirement plan – adjust as appropriate]. -Supportive team culture with emphasis on quality workmanship, customer satisfaction, and professional growth. Job Address Sarbet

title: Deputy Production Manager (Natural Fiber Processing)
description: Position: Deputy Production Manager – Natural Fiber Processing Company: Addis Lab Type: 6 month - 1 year Full-Time Contract (with potential for permanent role based on performance) Location: Addis Ababa Compensation: Competitive based on experience ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY Addis Lab is building the next generation of sustainable manufacturing in Ethiopia — transforming plant-based agricultural by-products into valuable fibers for textiles, beauty, and home goods. This pioneering initiative blends R&D and pilot production. We are transitioning from an early hands-on experimentation phase to a structured small-scale factory capable of consistent, replicable output. ABOUT THE ROLE We are hiring a Deputy Production Manager to bridge product development and operationalization — converting early-stage, DIY-style formulations into standardized, scalable systems. This is not a routine factory position. You will work at the intersection of chemistry, craft, and production design — transforming trial methods into safe, repeatable processes suited for small industrial equipment. Your mission is to establish, refine, and stabilize the full production cycle: fiber preparation, treatment, softening, drying, and finishing. You’ll oversee equipment setup, define SOPs, train a small team, and build the documentation and quality systems needed for future scale-up. The ideal candidate has a hands-on, experimental mindset and thrives on solving challenges in evolving, resource-limited environments. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Phase 1 – Systemization & Setup (First 90 Days) Translate small-batch formulations into controlled pilot-scale procedures. Design and implement chemical treatment protocols (degumming, softening, dyeing). Establish clear SOPs for washing, treating, drying, and finishing fibers. Source, install, and calibrate equipment for a 200m² pilot facility. Hire, train, and manage a team of 5–6 production operators. Implement basic safety, waste management, and environmental standards. Phase 2 – Stabilization & Scale-Up Optimize production workflows and resolve process inconsistencies. Maintain detailed process documentation and quality control logs. Manage material and supplier coordination. Ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations. Prepare documentation for future certification and scale-up. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience 5+ years in manufacturing, product development, or process engineering. Proven record in setting up or improving production systems from scratch. Background in agricultural, natural, or fiber-based material processing preferred. Technical Competencies Knowledge of chemical treatment and pH/temperature control. Ability to design and document standardized SOPs. Basic mechanical skills for equipment setup and maintenance. Strong understanding of quality and safety systems. Soft Skills Fluent in Amharic and English. Hands-on, adaptable, and proactive problem solver. Strong leadership and team training ability. Detail-oriented, organized, and process-driven. Preferred Background in textiles, cosmetics, or food processing. Training in lean manufacturing or process optimization. Familiarity with Ethiopian suppliers and regulatory systems. WHAT WE OFFER Build a first-of-its-kind production facility. Competitive pay with performance-based bonuses. Potential for permanent employment as operations expand. Opportunity to shape the future of sustainable manufacturing in Ethiopia. APPLICATION PROCESS To Apply, Submit: *Must Submit CV/Resume *Must Fill out this application:https://docs.google.com/forms OUR SELECTION PROCESS Initial screening and shortlisting Technical assessment (practical problem-solving exercise) Final interview with Addis Futures Lab venture leadership Application Deadline: November 15th, 2025 Start Date: Immediately

title: Door to Door Sales Agent
description:
Job Title: Door-to-Door Sales Agent

Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Employment Type: Full-Time, On-Site

Company Overview

Phoenix Ethiopia is a leading distribution company specializing in telecommunications, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), and pharmaceuticals. With a strong footprint across Addis Ababa, Oromia, Sidama, SNNP, and Amhara regions, we deliver comprehensive route-to-market solutions that empower partner brands to thrive in Ethiopia’s dynamic market. Our success is driven by technology-enabled distribution, superior local expertise, and a commitment to guarantee sales growth and market coverage for our partner brands.

Role Summary

The Door-to-Door Sales Agent will play a key role in driving direct sales by engaging with retailers and wholesalers in assigned territories, demonstrating product value, and ensuring strong market visibility for the company’s brands. The agent will act as the face of Phoenix Ethiopia, providing excellent customer service, collecting valuable feedback, and contributing to overall sales performance.

Key Responsibilities

• Actively manage assigned territories to promote and sell the company’s products directly to retailers.

• Deliver engaging and informative product presentations to potential retailers and consumers.

• Build and maintain strong customer relationships with customer outlets.

• Collect customer feedback and share insights with the sales supervisor for continuous improvement.

• Must meet assigned daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.

• Ensure accurate completion of sales documentation and transaction reports.

• Maintain in-depth knowledge of product features, benefits, and pricing.

• Represent the company professionally and uphold its brand reputation during all sales interactions.

• Collaborate with other team members to optimize sales coverage and market penetration.

• Participate in product and sales training sessions as required.

Qualifications and Skills

• At least two years of experience in door to door sales on FMCG products.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and persuade customers.

• Experience in sales management or training is an added advantage.

• Knowledge of the FMCG industries preferred.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets.

• Strong customer service orientation and problem-solving ability.

• Minimum requirement: BA degree in Business, Sales and Marketing, or related field is a plus.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Sales Target Achievement: % of sales quota achieved monthly/quarterly.

• Customer Conversion Rate: Ratio of prospects converted to sales.

• Customer Retention: Rate of repeat purchases or customer loyalty.

• Territory Coverage: Number of retailers and wholesalers visited.

• Customer Satisfaction: Quality of feedback received and complaint resolution rate.

Apply here:@PhoenixHR

Job Address
Addis Ababa
