አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

የስራ መደቡ፡     የግራፊክስ ዲዛይነር  ባለሙያ- ማስታወቂያ

ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ

የአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ቡድናችንን ለመቀላቀል ፈጠራ እና ዝርዝር ተኮር ዲዛይነር እየፈለግን ነው።

ድርጅታችን  ለደንበኞች የለያዩ የማስታወቂያ ዓይነት ሥራዎችን፣  ለህትመት የማስታወቂያ ቁሳቁሶች ዓይን የሚስቡ ንድፎችን የመፍጠር ሃላፊነት መወጣት የሚችል።  ጠንካራ የንድፍ ክህሎትን፣ በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ የመስራት ችሎታ ያለው።  (በማስታወቂያ ቤት የሰራ) ተያያዥነት የሥራ ልምድ ማቅረብ የሚችል፡፡

ዋና ኃላፊነቶች፡-

• እንደ LED ምልክት፣ ኤምዲኤፍ ማሳያዎች፣ ቢልቦርዶች፣ ባነሮች፣ ፖስተሮች እና ዲጂታል ግራፊክስ ያሉ ዲዛይን እና የምርት ማስታዎቂያ ቁሳቁሶች።

• ዲዛይኖች የደንበኛ ፍላጎቶችን  መሠረት በማድረግ ዕውቀታቸውንና  የዲዛይን  መመሪያዎችን  በመጠቀም የሚያሟሉ  መሆን አለባቸው፡፡

• የመጨረሻ ዲዛይኖች ምስላዊ ማራኪ ትክክለኛ እና ለህትመት ወይም ለዲጂታል ህትመት ዝግጁ አድርጎ ማቅረብ የሚችል።።

• በንድፍ አዝማሚያዎች፣ በማስታወቂያ ቴክኒኮች እና በአዲስ የሶፍትዌር መሳሪያዎች ከጊዜ ጋር በአግባቡ መጠቀም የሚችሉ።

• የጊዜ ገደቦችን በሚያሟሉበት ጊዜ በርካታ ፕሮጀክቶችን ማስተናገድ ብቃት ያላቸው።

ብቃት፡

• ሰርቲፊኬት፣ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ዲግሪ በግራፊክስ ዲዛይን፣ በሥነ ጥበባት፣ ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ ወረቀት ያለው።

• የንድፍ ሶፍትዌር ብቃት (Adobe Illustrator፣ Photoshop፣ Core/DRAW፣ ወዘተ) ተጨማሪ መስራት የሚችል ነው።

• ጠንካራ የፈጠራ ችሎታያለው።።

• የማተሚያ ሂደቶችን እና የማስታወቂያ ቁሳቁሶችን (LED, MDF, Banners, ወዘተ) ተጨማሪ እውቀት ያላቸው፡፡

· የቀለማት ልዩነት መረዳት የሚችል፣ ጥሩ ግንዛቤ  ያለው። ጥሩ የሐሳብ ልውውጥ እና የቡድን ሥራ ችሎታዎች ያላቸው።

• ብዙ ፕሮጀክቶችን በአንድ ጊዜ የማስተናገድ ችሎታ ያለው።

የሥራ ዓይነት:- የሙሉ ጊዜ

ደመወዝ:-  ወርሃዊ

የስራ አድራሻ:-

• አዲስ አበባ አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  በትራፊክ መብራት  አካባቢ፣  ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ ላይ ይገኛል፡፡


Job Address

title: ERPNext Business Logic & Training Specialist
description: ERPNext Business Logic & Training Specialist (Afaan Oromo Fluent) Position Summary We are seeking a highly experienced ERPNext Implementation Expert focused primarily on business process analysis, system configuration (business logic), and end-user training. This role is crucial for ensuring our ERPNext platform accurately reflects our operational needs and that our teams achieve maximum proficiency. Fluency in Afaan Oromo is a mandatory requirement, as this specialist will lead training and documentation efforts for our Afaan Oromo-speaking operational hubs. Key Responsibilities 1. Business Process Analysis & Configuration (Business Logic Focus): Conduct detailed requirements gathering sessions (workshops, interviews) with stakeholders across finance, inventory, manufacturing, sales, and HR. Map current business processes (AS-IS) and design optimized future processes (TO-BE) within the ERPNext framework. Perform all necessary system configurations, defining essential business logic including: Creating and customizing workflows, approval hierarchies, and user permissions. Setting up chart of accounts, tax rules, costing methods, and item templates. Defining inventory management rules, stock settings, and warehouse structures. Manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, ensuring configured system logic meets business requirements and delivering sign-off. Develop clear, comprehensive documentation (e.g., Functional Design Documents, Standard Operating Procedures). 2. Training and Change Management: Design and develop customized training curricula and materials tailored to various user roles (power users, departmental staff, executives). Deliver expert-level training sessions, both in English and fluently in Afaan Oromo, ensuring complete comprehension and high user adoption within regional teams. Provide post-go-live support and mentorship, troubleshooting user issues related to business workflow and configured system behavior. Act as the primary bridge between technical teams and business users, translating technical capabilities into understandable business outcomes. 3. Project Management Support: Collaborate with the ERP Project Manager to define project scope, timelines, and deliverables for the business logic and training workstreams. Identify and mitigate risks related to system adoption and process integration. Required Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of demonstrable experience implementing and configuring ERPNext (or similar ERP systems) across multiple business domains (e.g., accounting, manufacturing, distribution). ERPNext Expertise: Deep, practical knowledge of ERPNext configuration, customization of core modules, and understanding of standard system limitations and best practices. Business Acumen: Exceptional ability to read, understand, and document complex financial and operational processes. Language Fluency (Mandatory): Fluent in written and spoken Afaan Oromo (Oromiffa), with professional experience delivering complex instruction in the language. Soft Skills: Proven track record in training large and diverse user groups, excellent presentation skills, and the ability to inspire confidence and manage change. Preferred Qualifications Certification in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP) or Project Management (e.g., PMP). Experience in the Government sector. How to Apply Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your specific experience with ERPNext implementation, your business analysis methodology, and your fluency level in Afaan Oromo to this post.

title: Sales
Digital Accounting and Finance Officer
description:
Digital Accounting and Finance Officer

Gross Monthly Salary: Based on the organization’s scale

Job Summary:

The Digital Accounting and Finance Officer is responsible for managing and optimizing the organization’s financial operations using advanced digital tools and systems. This role blends traditional accounting functions with modern digital finance practices, including automation, data analytics, ERP integration, and fintech transaction management. The officer will oversee electronic payment channels such as Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, and other wallet services, ensuring seamless, secure, and compliant transaction flows. This position is critical to Haset IT’s operations, as it safeguards financial compliance with Ethiopian laws while driving efficiency, innovation, and transparency in digital financial processes.

Responsibilities:Digital Financial Operations

Maintain and manage financial data in ERP/accounting systems.

Oversee integrations with fintech platforms (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, banks’ digital wallets).

Automate routine accounting tasks and digital reconciliation processes.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Generate real-time dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI/Excel.

Analyze transaction volumes from electronic channels and provide insights for decision-making.

Monitor KPIs for digital payment adoption, processing costs, and error/fraud detection.

Accounts & Transactions

Manage digital accounts payable/receivable workflows.

Reconcile multi-gateway transactions (mobile money, online payments, wallets, and bank transfers).

Ensure secure settlement and timely collection from digital platforms.

Tax & Compliance

Prepare and file e-tax reports (VAT, WHT, income tax, pensions) electronically.

Ensure compliance with ERCA’s digital tax systems and fintech regulatory directives.

Stay updated on National Bank of Ethiopia fintech guidelines and interoperability standards .

Cash Flow, Payroll & Digital Gateways

Monitor online banking and mobile money cash flows daily.

Manage payroll through digital payroll systems with automated statutory deductions.

Ensure multi-channel settlement (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr) is tracked, reconciled, and secured.

Audit & Internal Controls

Maintain digital audit trails for fintech and ERP transactions.

Coordinate audits with external auditors and regulators, ensuring fintech compliance.

Implement fraud prevention and digital transaction monitoring systems.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Work with IT teams to ensure payment API integrations are secure and efficient.

Partner with Operations and HR to align payment flows with organizational goals.

Communicate with banks, fintech providers, and vendors through digital platforms.

Policy Development & Innovation

Develop digital finance policies for transaction security, reconciliation, and fraud prevention.

Contribute to Haset IT’s digital economy transformation by adopting fintech best practices.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

3–5 years of professional experience in accounting/finance (preferably in fintech, transportation, or tech).

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Peachtree/QuickBooks, and digital accounting systems.

Strong detail orientation and accuracy in digital record-keeping.

Preferred Qualifications (Optional):

Training or degree in Computer Science, IT, or Data Analytics.

Experience with ERP, mobile money reconciliation, or fintech platforms.

Exposure to digital tax filing and cloud-based financial systems.

Key Skills Required:

Expertise in fintech payment systems (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, bank APIs)

Strong communication and stakeholder management

Analytical and data-driven mindset

Digital literacy and adaptability

Attention to detail and accuracy

Teamwork and cross-functional collaboration

title: Deputy Production Manager (Natural Fiber Processing)
description:
Position: Deputy Production Manager – Natural Fiber Processing

Company: Addis Lab

Type: 6 month - 1 year Full-Time Contract (with potential for permanent role based on performance)

Location: Addis Ababa

Compensation: Competitive based on experience

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Addis Lab is building the next generation of sustainable manufacturing in Ethiopia — transforming plant-based agricultural by-products into valuable fibers for textiles, beauty, and home goods. This pioneering initiative blends R&D and pilot production. We are transitioning from an early hands-on experimentation phase to a structured small-scale factory capable of consistent, replicable output.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Deputy Production Manager to bridge product development and operationalization — converting early-stage, DIY-style formulations into standardized, scalable systems.

This is not a routine factory position. You will work at the intersection of chemistry, craft, and production design — transforming trial methods into safe, repeatable processes suited for small industrial equipment.

Your mission is to establish, refine, and stabilize the full production cycle: fiber preparation, treatment, softening, drying, and finishing. You’ll oversee equipment setup, define SOPs, train a small team, and build the documentation and quality systems needed for future scale-up.

The ideal candidate has a hands-on, experimental mindset and thrives on solving challenges in evolving, resource-limited environments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Phase 1 – Systemization & Setup (First 90 Days)

Translate small-batch formulations into controlled pilot-scale procedures.

Design and implement chemical treatment protocols (degumming, softening, dyeing).

Establish clear SOPs for washing, treating, drying, and finishing fibers.

Source, install, and calibrate equipment for a 200m² pilot facility.

Hire, train, and manage a team of 5–6 production operators.

Implement basic safety, waste management, and environmental standards.

Phase 2 – Stabilization & Scale-Up

Optimize production workflows and resolve process inconsistencies.

Maintain detailed process documentation and quality control logs.

Manage material and supplier coordination.

Ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations.

Prepare documentation for future certification and scale-up.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

5+ years in manufacturing, product development, or process engineering.

Proven record in setting up or improving production systems from scratch.

Background in agricultural, natural, or fiber-based material processing preferred.

Technical Competencies

Knowledge of chemical treatment and pH/temperature control.

Ability to design and document standardized SOPs.

Basic mechanical skills for equipment setup and maintenance.

Strong understanding of quality and safety systems.

Soft Skills

Fluent in Amharic and English.

Hands-on, adaptable, and proactive problem solver.

Strong leadership and team training ability.

Detail-oriented, organized, and process-driven.

Preferred

Background in textiles, cosmetics, or food processing.

Training in lean manufacturing or process optimization.

Familiarity with Ethiopian suppliers and regulatory systems.

WHAT WE OFFER

Build a first-of-its-kind production facility.

Competitive pay with performance-based bonuses.

Potential for permanent employment as operations expand.

Opportunity to shape the future of sustainable manufacturing in Ethiopia.

APPLICATION PROCESS

To Apply, Submit:

*Must Submit CV/Resume

*Must Fill out this application:https://docs.google.com/forms

OUR SELECTION PROCESS

Initial screening and shortlisting

Technical assessment (practical problem-solving exercise)

Final interview with Addis Futures Lab venture leadership

Application Deadline: November 15th, 2025

Start Date: Immediately

title: Guidance & Counseling Officer
description:
Vacancy Announcement

Position Title: Guidance & Counseling Officer

Employment Type: Fixed-Term (1 Year), with Possibility of Extension

Duty Station: Kofele Town, West Arsi Zone, Ethiopia

Application Deadline: November 15,2025.

Organizational Background

Charity & Development Association is committed to promoting holistic education and the well-being of students through the provision of professional guidance and counseling services. We aim to create a supportive environment where students can thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. To support this mission, we are seeking a qualified and motivated female candidate for the position of Guidance & Counseling Officer for a one-year fixed-term contract, with the potential for renewal based on performance and availability of funding.

Job Summary

The Guidance & Counseling Officer will be responsible for providing individual and group counseling services, psychosocial support, and career guidance to students. The role involves identifying students' social, emotional, and academic needs and supporting their personal and educational development.

Key Responsibilities

·         Provide individual and group counseling sessions to address academic, emotional, behavioral, and social challenges.

·         Design and implement programs and workshops on life skills, conflict resolution, peer pressure, mental health awareness, and other relevant topics.

·         Collaborate with teachers, parents, and administrators to support students’ overall well-being and academic success.

·         Conduct assessments to identify students at risk and provide appropriate interventions or referrals.

 

Qualifications and Experience

·         Bachelor’s degree or higher in Counseling Psychology, Educational Psychology, Social Work, or a related field from a recognized institution.

·         Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in guidance and counseling, preferably in an educational or youth-focused setting.

·         Proven skills in psychosocial support, child protection, or case management is an added advantage.

·         Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with children, adolescents, and adults.

·         Fluent in Afan Oromo and English (both written and spoken); knowledge of additional local languages is a plus.

·         Computer literacy (Microsoft Office applications).

·         Commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, and child safeguarding principles.

Contract Duration

One (1) year fixed-term, with a possibility of extension subject to performance and availability of funding.

How to Apply

Interested application that full fill the above requirement shall send their non- returnable application, CV, copies of diplomas, student transcripts and work experience testimonials within 15 days of first announcement through the following address: -

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1U_S3ZR-OriwWbKePX-aAgSR1S4MnOxluOJOSs0vxXKo/edit

Tel-+251-114-71 65 59/ +251-114-71 65 85

Note

This position is open exclusively to female applicants.

title: Account Manager
description: Companies: Andrew Williams Solicitors & Ibiab Systems Ltd Role Overview We are seeking an organised, proactive, and tech-driven Account Manager to oversee client relationships and system performance across Andrew Williams Solicitors and Ibiab Systems Ltd. This role focuses on managing client accounts for two in-house systems developed by Ibiab Systems Ltd, ensuring seamless implementation, user satisfaction, and ongoing optimization. You will also maintain service and compliance standards at Andrew Williams Solicitors, a leading immigration law firm. The successful candidate will coordinate client communications, system support, and compliance monitoring, using the Ibiab Law CRM and other internal tools to track workflows, manage user feedback, and uphold performance standards across both organizations. Key Responsibilities by Company At Andrew Williams Solicitors Account & Client Relationship Management Act as the primary point of contact for client communications and non-legal service updates. Oversee client onboarding for new legal matters and ensure ongoing client engagement. Track client satisfaction through the CRM and ensure timely responses to client queries or delays. Collaborate with solicitors and support staff to ensure a smooth client experience. Compliance & Process Oversight Use the Ibiab CRM to monitor case-related tasks, deadlines, and communication logs. Identify overdue workflows or compliance risks and escalate them to management. Assist with internal audits, SRA compliance tracking, and documentation for reviews. Support the development of compliance procedures using insights from system data. At Ibiab Systems Ltd System Account Management Manage client accounts for Ibiab’s developed systems, ensuring smooth onboarding, configuration, and adoption. Provide first-line support to business users, responding to inquiries and guiding them through product features. Gather user feedback to inform system improvements and escalate technical issues to the development team. Track usage patterns and performance metrics to maintain high system engagement and satisfaction. Operational & Compliance Oversight Manage internal task tracking for product updates, client onboarding, and support requests. Monitor SLA compliance, user satisfaction scores, and support ticket resolution times. Maintain up-to-date internal documentation on workflows, updates, and process improvements. Coordinate with the technical team to ensure timely delivery of new features or fixes. Cross-Company Responsibilities Maintain shared dashboards and reports for client accounts, compliance tracking, and workflow progress. Produce weekly summaries highlighting key updates, overdue actions, and client or system performance metrics. Schedule regular check-ins with management to review client feedback and operational KPIs. Promote accountability across both teams by ensuring task follow-ups and closure through the CRM. Ensure consistent, professional, and high-quality communication across both legal and software clients. Skills & Attributes Strong account management and relationship-building skills. Excellent organizational and communication abilities. Capable of managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. Comfortable navigating between legal service and technology environments. Tech-savvy and confident in learning CRM systems (training on Ibiab Law provided). Analytical mindset with attention to accuracy, process improvement, and service quality. Reliable, discreet, and proactive with a collaborative approach. Requirements Previous experience in account management, client success, or operations roles (SaaS or professional services preferred). Strong computer literacy and ability to quickly learn new platforms. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A structured and detail-oriented approach to workflow management. No legal background required, but familiarity with professional service environments is advantageous. Required Equipment: A personal computer or laptop capable of running multiple browser-based systems. A mobile phone for client communication and authentication purposes. A stable and reliable internet connection suitable for video meetings and remote collaboration. Working Hours & Compensation Hours of Work: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST Remuneration: 50,000 ETB Monthly

title: Accountant
description:
We’re expanding our finance team and looking for detail-oriented, English-speaking professionals with ~2 years’ experience. You’ll join a supportive team of accountants and help keep daily finance and cash operations running smoothly. Based on experience, you may focus more on Junior Accounting with Cashier Operations—we’ll match you to the best fit.

What you’ll do (core responsibilities)

• Record daily transactions and maintain accurate documents and files.

• Reconcile cash/POS and prepare daily/weekly bank deposits.

• Support accounts payable/receivable, invoicing, and receipt issuance.

• Maintain petty cash and prepare cash counts & reconciliation sheets.

• Communicate in English with teammates, vendors, and customers.

• Collaborate with the accounting team on reports and audits.

• Uphold high standards of integrity, accuracy, and customer service.

Placement based on fit

• Junior Accountant track: journal entries, AP/AR aging, supplier reconciliations, posting and reconciliations in Peachtree (Sage 50) and/or Tally, assisting with tax packs and month-end close (accruals, prepaids, schedules).

• Cashier / Cash Operations track: till opening/closing, POS variance checks, float management, customer payments/receipts, daily cash drops and documentation; basic posting of daily sales/cash into Peachtree/Tally (training provided if needed).

What you’ll need (must-haves)

• ~2 years’ experience in bookkeeping, cash handling, or a similar finance/operations role.

• Strong English (spoken and written) and clear, professional communication.

• Solid numeracy, accuracy, and confidentiality; high integrity.

• Working knowledge of Excel/Sheets (basic formulas; pivots are a plus).

• Comfortable with POS systems and daily cash reconciliation.

• Accounting software: hands-on experience with Peachtree (Sage 50) and/or Tally (both strongly preferred for the Junior Accountant track).

• Team player with a can-do attitude; reliable and organized.

Nice to have

• Bachelor’s in Accounting/Finance (or related).

• Experience with other accounting systems/ERPs (e.g., QuickBooks).

• Exposure to local tax compliance and filing processes.

• Customer service experience in retail/hospitality.

Why join us

• Learn from an experienced team of accountants.

• Clear growth pathways in either Accounting or Cash Operations.

Job Address
Welo Sefer

title: Account Manager
description:
Companies: Andrew Williams Solicitors & Ibiab Systems Ltd

Role Overview

We are seeking an organised, proactive, and tech-driven Account Manager to oversee client relationships and system performance across Andrew Williams Solicitors and Ibiab Systems Ltd.

This role focuses on managing client accounts for two in-house systems developed by Ibiab Systems Ltd, ensuring seamless implementation, user satisfaction, and ongoing optimization. You will also maintain service and compliance standards at Andrew Williams Solicitors, a leading immigration law firm.

The successful candidate will coordinate client communications, system support, and compliance monitoring, using the Ibiab Law CRM and other internal tools to track workflows, manage user feedback, and uphold performance standards across both organizations.

Key Responsibilities by Company

At Andrew Williams Solicitors

Account & Client Relationship Management

Act as the primary point of contact for client communications and non-legal service updates.

Oversee client onboarding for new legal matters and ensure ongoing client engagement.

Track client satisfaction through the CRM and ensure timely responses to client queries or delays.

Collaborate with solicitors and support staff to ensure a smooth client experience.

Compliance & Process Oversight

Use the Ibiab CRM to monitor case-related tasks, deadlines, and communication logs.

Identify overdue workflows or compliance risks and escalate them to management.

Assist with internal audits, SRA compliance tracking, and documentation for reviews.

Support the development of compliance procedures using insights from system data.

At Ibiab Systems Ltd

System Account Management

Manage client accounts for Ibiab’s developed systems, ensuring smooth onboarding, configuration, and adoption.

Provide first-line support to business users, responding to inquiries and guiding them through product features.

Gather user feedback to inform system improvements and escalate technical issues to the development team.

Track usage patterns and performance metrics to maintain high system engagement and satisfaction.

Operational & Compliance Oversight

Manage internal task tracking for product updates, client onboarding, and support requests.

Monitor SLA compliance, user satisfaction scores, and support ticket resolution times.

Maintain up-to-date internal documentation on workflows, updates, and process improvements.

Coordinate with the technical team to ensure timely delivery of new features or fixes.

Cross-Company Responsibilities

Maintain shared dashboards and reports for client accounts, compliance tracking, and workflow progress.

Produce weekly summaries highlighting key updates, overdue actions, and client or system performance metrics.

Schedule regular check-ins with management to review client feedback and operational KPIs.

Promote accountability across both teams by ensuring task follow-ups and closure through the CRM.

Ensure consistent, professional, and high-quality communication across both legal and software clients.

Skills & Attributes

Strong account management and relationship-building skills.

Excellent organizational and communication abilities.

Capable of managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Comfortable navigating between legal service and technology environments.

Tech-savvy and confident in learning CRM systems (training on Ibiab Law provided).

Analytical mindset with attention to accuracy, process improvement, and service quality.

Reliable, discreet, and proactive with a collaborative approach.

Requirements

Previous experience in account management, client success, or operations roles (SaaS or professional services preferred).

Strong computer literacy and ability to quickly learn new platforms.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

A structured and detail-oriented approach to workflow management.

No legal background required, but familiarity with professional service environments is advantageous.

Required Equipment:

A personal computer or laptop capable of running multiple browser-based systems.

A mobile phone for client communication and authentication purposes.

A stable and reliable internet connection suitable for video meetings and remote collaboration.

Working Hours & Compensation

title: Cashier
description:
Job Title: - Cashier

Cashier responsibilities include processing all cash and credit sales transactions, receiving payments and issuing receipts, providing excellent customer service, and maintaining an organized workspace in a retail shop.  Ultimately, a cashier ensures all sales transactions run smoothly and plays a vital role in maximizing customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

·        Handle cash and credit transactions accurately and efficiently. Collect payments whether in automatic debits, cash or credit

·       Provide outstanding customer service. Greet customers, address inquiries, resolve complaints, answer questions or direct them to the concerned staff or management and ensure a positive shopping experience.

·       Operate cash registers, scanners, and POS systems accurately

·       Issue receipts, refunds, or exchanges according to company policies

·       Maintain a balanced cash drawer and perform regular cash counts and reconciling discrepancies promptly.

·       Adhere to company policies regarding cash handling and security measures to prevent losses.

·       Provide information on policies or procedures of the company

·       Compile non-monetary records and reports

·       Provide daily and monthly z reports and detailed sales transaction reports

·       Work closely with the team to meet the sales goals

·       Stay up to date on merchandise promotions, advertisements and product information

·       Maintain a neat, clean, as well as safe and secured checkout or work areas.

·       Manage transactions with customers using cash registers

 

Qualification and Skill Requirements

Ø  Level IV Diploma or BA Degree in Accounting and finance with 4 years or 2 years of experience

Ø  Previous experience in a cashier or customer service role is often preferred

Ø  Strong basic mathematics skills and attention to detail to maintain accurate transaction records

Ø  Strong communication, customer service and time management skills

Ø   Reliability and honesty in handling money

Ø  Strong interpersonal skills

Ø  In-depth knowledge of operating cash register (POS) machine

Ø  Skilled in Microsoft office (MS-EXCEL, MS-Word, and MS-Outlook)

Job Address
Addis Ababa, in front of Kasanchis Urael Church Romel Building 3rd Floor

title: Senior Enterprise Network Deployment Engineer
description: Job Purpose: The Enterprise Network Deployment Engineer is integral part of END team responsible for design, deployment, and integration of multiple Network Infrastructure Systems and collaboration solutions, guiding and monitoring of entire END group and responsible for motivating teammates as well as inspiring positive communication specializing on Collaboration, Network and Wireless Solutions, with the direction from Infrastructure service manager and END Team Lead. Participates in the analysis and composition of requirements, design of network architecture, design and implementation of networks, preparation of test plan and documentation of final integrated solution Deep understanding of routing, switching, segmentation, and network security principles. Install, configure, and support network equipment, including routers, switches, firewalls, and proxy servers. Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure reliability. Conduct network performance analysis and optimization. Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise-grade wired and wireless network and Collaboration infrastructure. Implement and manage network security solutions and policies. Perform advanced Layer 2 and Layer 3 troubleshooting and provide 3rd line technical support Design and deploy SD WAN, ACI and SD access solutions Troubleshoot policy misconfigurations, endpoint reachability, and fabric discovery issues for SD WAN, ACI and SD Access. Conduct wired and wireless site surveys and drive network and Wi-Fi optimization efforts and Generating site survey reports and site preparation guides based on survey. Secure Network environments using industry-standard authentication and encryption methods. Collaborate cross-functionally on projects and incident resolution. Maintain accurate and up-to-date network documentation and diagrams. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and vendors to manage network operations and projects Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical network and security infrastructure Preparing and evaluate Low level, high-level and as-built documents for project implementation Requirements 2+ years of experience in network engineering roles and Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience. Strong knowledge of routing protocols (OSPF, BGP static route…) and switching technologies Experience with Cisco, Fortinet, Aruba, ruckus, Check Point (Juniper and Palo Alto – a plus) Proficiency in tools such as Network monitoring tools and ITSM (such us Zabbix, SolarWinds, ManageEngine, PRTG) , Wireshark Solid understanding of IOS OS, Nexus OS, Cisco ISE, WLC, 802.1x authentication, ruckus and Aruba wireless, Fortigate, fortimanager Hands-on experience with firewalls, VPNs, LAN/WAN/WLAN troubleshooting Experience providing 3rd line customer support Good English communication skills (written and spoken) Certification a.    CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Data Center b.    Data Center ACI Implementation (DCACI) c.     Enterprise SD-WAN Implementation (ENSDWI or NSE6) d.    Enterprise Wireless (ENWLSI) Job Address Addis Ababa

title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer
description:
Job Title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer

Gross Monthly Salary: Based on the organization’s scale

Job Summary:The Digital Accounting and Finance Officer is responsible for managing and optimizing the organization’s financial operations using advanced digital tools and systems. This role blends traditional accounting functions with modern digital finance practices, including automation, data analytics, ERP integration, and fintech transaction management. The officer will oversee electronic payment channels such as Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, and other wallet services, ensuring seamless, secure, and compliant transaction flows. This position is critical to Haset IT’s operations, as it safeguards financial compliance with Ethiopian laws while driving efficiency, innovation, and transparency in digital financial processes.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Financial Operations

Maintain and manage financial data in ERP/accounting systems.

Oversee integrations with fintech platforms (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, banks’ digital wallets).

Automate routine accounting tasks and digital reconciliation processes.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Generate real-time dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI/Excel.

Analyze transaction volumes from electronic channels and provide insights for decision-making.

Monitor KPIs for digital payment adoption, processing costs, and error/fraud detection.

Accounts & Transactions

Manage digital accounts payable/receivable workflows.

Reconcile multi-gateway transactions (mobile money, online payments, wallets, and bank transfers).

Ensure secure settlement and timely collection from digital platforms.

Tax & Compliance

Prepare and file e-tax reports (VAT, WHT, income tax, pensions) electronically.

Ensure compliance with ERCA’s digital tax systems and fintech regulatory directives.

Stay updated on National Bank of Ethiopia fintech guidelines and interoperability standards .

Cash Flow, Payroll & Digital Gateways

Monitor online banking and mobile money cash flows daily.

Manage payroll through digital payroll systems with automated statutory deductions.

Ensure multi-channel settlement (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr) is tracked, reconciled, and secured.

Audit & Internal Controls

Maintain digital audit trails for fintech and ERP transactions.

Coordinate audits with external auditors and regulators, ensuring fintech compliance.

Implement fraud prevention and digital transaction monitoring systems.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Work with IT teams to ensure payment API integrations are secure and efficient.

Partner with Operations and HR to align payment flows with organizational goals.

Communicate with banks, fintech providers, and vendors through digital platforms.

Policy Development & Innovation

Develop digital finance policies for transaction security, reconciliation, and fraud prevention.

Contribute to Haset IT’s digital economy transformation by adopting fintech best practices.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

3–5 years of professional experience in accounting/finance (preferably in fintech, transportation, or tech).

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Peachtree/QuickBooks, and digital accounting systems.

Strong detail orientation and accuracy in digital record-keeping.

Preferred Qualifications (Optional):

Training or degree in Computer Science, IT, or Data Analytics.

Experience with ERP, mobile money reconciliation, or fintech platforms.

Exposure to digital tax filing and cloud-based financial systems.

Key Skills Required:

Expertise in fintech payment systems (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, bank APIs)

Strong communication and stakeholder management

Analytical and data-driven mindset

Digital literacy and adaptability

Attention to detail and accuracy

Teamwork and cross-functional collaboration

Risk management & fraud detection skills

Job Address
22 New Road, in front of Tages Butcher

title: GPS Installer Technician
description: At ATN Technology, we specialise in advanced fleet-tracking and telematics solutions through our flagship platform “ATNgps” — a speed-limiter & fleet tracking/management system used by companies, public divisions and individuals around the world. As part of our growing field team, you will help deliver best-in-class vehicle installations, ensuring our clients (from small fleets to large enterprises) benefit from reliable, accurate GPS tracking and telematics solutions.   Role Overview: We are seeking a skilled and driven GPS Installer Technician who will be responsible for the professional installation, configuration, and maintenance of GPS tracking devices and telematics equipment in a variety of vehicles (light, medium, heavy duty). This is a hands-on role, requiring strong vehicle electrical knowledge, excellent customer service, and the ability to work independently in the field.   Key Responsibilities: -Install GPS tracking and telematics hardware (wiring, antennas, modules, power supply) in vehicles according to company standards and client requirements. -Test and verify all installations: ensure device communicates correctly, GPS signal is optimal, speed-limiter (if applicable) is configured, and data flows to back-office systems. -Diagnose and troubleshoot installation issues (electrical faults, wiring errors, connectivity issues, device malfunctions). -Maintain accurate records of installations, service calls, and parts usage. -Communicate effectively with customers onsite: explain device operation, answer questions, provide basic user orientation. -Maintain tools and vehicle in clean, professional condition. -Adhere to company safety protocols, vehicle electrical wiring standards, and fleet policies. -Work collaboratively with dispatch/field-coordinator to schedule installations efficiently, meet daily quotas, write service reports. -Occasionally perform removal or upgrade of installed units, support retrofit installations. -Travel to client sites (local/regional), may include nights or weekends depending on client schedules.   Qualifications & Skills: -High school diploma or equivalent; technical training in automotive electronics, telematics or related field preferred. -Proven experience installing vehicle tracking devices, telematics units or GPS hardware in a fleet or installation environment. -Strong knowledge of vehicle electrical systems (12 V/24 V), wiring, fuses, relays, power distribution. -Comfort with reading wiring diagrams, using voltmeters/multimeters, diagnosing wiring faults. -Ability to work independently in a vehicle setting, climbing in/out of engine bays, under dashboards, mounting hardware. -Excellent attention to detail and documentation skills. -Good customer service skills: ability to interact professionally with clients onsite. -Preferably, experience with fleet telematics, speed-limiter systems, or asset-tracking solutions is a plus. What We Offer: -Competitive salary + 120 birr/device installations -Company-provided installation tools and uniform. -Comprehensive training on ATN’s GPS/telematics platform and hardware. -Opportunity to grow within a technology-focused, rapidly expanding fleet solutions company. -Supportive team culture with emphasis on quality workmanship, customer satisfaction, and professional growth. Job Address Sarbet, JFK Building, office# GA12

title: Guidance & Counseling Officer
description:
Vacancy Announcement

Position Title: Guidance & Counseling Officer

Employment Type: Fixed-Term (1 Year), with Possibility of Extension

Duty Station: Kofele Town, West Arsi Zone, Ethiopia

Application Deadline: November 15,2025.

Organizational Background

Charity & Development Association is committed to promoting holistic education and the well-being of students through the provision of professional guidance and counseling services. We aim to create a supportive environment where students can thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. To support this mission, we are seeking a qualified and motivated female candidate for the position of Guidance & Counseling Officer for a one-year fixed-term contract, with the potential for renewal based on performance and availability of funding.

Job Summary

The Guidance & Counseling Officer will be responsible for providing individual and group counseling services, psychosocial support, and career guidance to students. The role involves identifying students' social, emotional, and academic needs and supporting their personal and educational development.

Key Responsibilities

·         Provide individual and group counseling sessions to address academic, emotional, behavioral, and social challenges.

·         Design and implement programs and workshops on life skills, conflict resolution, peer pressure, mental health awareness, and other relevant topics.

·         Collaborate with teachers, parents, and administrators to support students’ overall well-being and academic success.

·         Conduct assessments to identify students at risk and provide appropriate interventions or referrals.

 

Qualifications and Experience

·         Bachelor’s degree or higher in Counseling Psychology, Educational Psychology, Social Work, or a related field from a recognized institution.

·         Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in guidance and counseling, preferably in an educational or youth-focused setting.

·         Proven skills in psychosocial support, child protection, or case management is an added advantage.

·         Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with children, adolescents, and adults.

·         Fluent in Afan Oromo and English (both written and spoken); knowledge of additional local languages is a plus.

·         Computer literacy (Microsoft Office applications).

·         Commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, and child safeguarding principles.

Contract Duration

One (1) year fixed-term, with a possibility of extension subject to performance and availability of funding.

How to Apply

Interested application that full fill the above requirement shall send their non- returnable application, CV, copies of diplomas, student transcripts and work experience testimonials within 15 days of first announcement through the following address: -

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1U_S3ZR-OriwWbKePX-aAgSR1S4MnOxluOJOSs0vxXKo/edit

Tel-+251-114-71 65 59/ +251-114-71 65 85

Note

This position is open exclusively to female applicants.

Kofele, west Arsi Zone

title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer
description:
Job Title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer

Gross Monthly Salary: Based on the organization’s scale

Job Summary:The Digital Accounting and Finance Officer is responsible for managing and optimizing the organization’s financial operations using advanced digital tools and systems. This role blends traditional accounting functions with modern digital finance practices, including automation, data analytics, ERP integration, and fintech transaction management. The officer will oversee electronic payment channels such as Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, and other wallet services, ensuring seamless, secure, and compliant transaction flows. This position is critical to Haset IT’s operations, as it safeguards financial compliance with Ethiopian laws while driving efficiency, innovation, and transparency in digital financial processes.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Financial Operations

Maintain and manage financial data in ERP/accounting systems.

Oversee integrations with fintech platforms (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, banks’ digital wallets).

Automate routine accounting tasks and digital reconciliation processes.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Generate real-time dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI/Excel.

Analyze transaction volumes from electronic channels and provide insights for decision-making.

Monitor KPIs for digital payment adoption, processing costs, and error/fraud detection.

Accounts & Transactions

Manage digital accounts payable/receivable workflows.

Reconcile multi-gateway transactions (mobile money, online payments, wallets, and bank transfers).

Ensure secure settlement and timely collection from digital platforms.

Tax & Compliance

Prepare and file e-tax reports (VAT, WHT, income tax, pensions) electronically.

Ensure compliance with ERCA’s digital tax systems and fintech regulatory directives.

Stay updated on National Bank of Ethiopia fintech guidelines and interoperability standards .

Cash Flow, Payroll & Digital Gateways

Monitor online banking and mobile money cash flows daily.

Manage payroll through digital payroll systems with automated statutory deductions.

Ensure multi-channel settlement (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr) is tracked, reconciled, and secured.

Audit & Internal Controls

Maintain digital audit trails for fintech and ERP transactions.

Coordinate audits with external auditors and regulators, ensuring fintech compliance.

Implement fraud prevention and digital transaction monitoring systems.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Work with IT teams to ensure payment API integrations are secure and efficient.

Partner with Operations and HR to align payment flows with organizational goals.

Communicate with banks, fintech providers, and vendors through digital platforms.

Policy Development & Innovation

Develop digital finance policies for transaction security, reconciliation, and fraud prevention.

Contribute to Haset IT’s digital economy transformation by adopting fintech best practices.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

3–5 years of professional experience in accounting/finance (preferably in fintech, transportation, or tech).

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Peachtree/QuickBooks, and digital accounting systems.

Strong detail orientation and accuracy in digital record-keeping.

Preferred Qualifications (Optional):

Training or degree in Computer Science, IT, or Data Analytics.

Experience with ERP, mobile money reconciliation, or fintech platforms.

Exposure to digital tax filing and cloud-based financial systems.

Key Skills Required:

Expertise in fintech payment systems (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, bank APIs)

Strong communication and stakeholder management

Analytical and data-driven mindset

Digital literacy and adaptability

Attention to detail and accuracy

Teamwork and cross-functional collaboration

Risk management & fraud detection skills

Job Address
22 New Road, in front of Tages Butcher

• Meet or exceed assigned sales targets and KPIs. Skills and Competencies

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Developer

Are you a passionate and aspiring developer looking to kickstart your career in web development? We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Full Stack Developer to join our remote distributed team.

Role Summary

As a Full Stack Developer, you will be contributing to the design and implementation of web applications using FAST, Django, React and other high-level web frameworks. Developers with Fintech experience preferred.

Responsibilities

-              Collaborate with the development team to create and maintain web and mobile applications.

-              Assist in the design and implementation of new features and functionalities.

-              Write efficient, reusable, and clean code following best practices.

-              Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.

-              Troubleshoot and debug issues to ensure optimal performance and user experience.

-              Stay updated on the latest industry trends and technologies to suggest innovative solutions.

Qualifications & Requirements

-              Excellent work ethic, can do attitude and being able to deliver results.

-              A solid understanding of Python programming language, React, object-oriented programming concepts, and three year's worth of experience in Python.

-              Experience with Fintech applications is preferred.

-              Familiarity with Django web framework and its core principles.

-              Knowledge of front-end technologies such as React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

-              Experience in working with relational databases and SQL queries (PostgreSQL is preferred).

-              Experience with Git version control system.

-              Experience with AWS cloud services.

-              Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

-              Excellent communication skills and a strong willingness to learn and grow as a developer.

 

 

How to Apply

If you are enthusiastic about web development and eager to enhance your career as a full stack developer, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application to this email: info@northpoint-ai.com . Include the following in your application:

-              A link to your LinkedIn and Github account.

-              A link to one of your Python projects on Github

-              Your updated resume

-              A one-page cover letter including answers to these questions:

1.      What excites you the most about working as a developer, and how do you envision contributing to our team's success?

2.    Can you describe a coding challenge or problem you faced recently and how you tackled it? What did you learn from that experience?

3.     Our team values collaboration and open communication. How do you ensure effective communication within a development team, especially when working on a group project?

title: Admin & Production Coordinator
description:
The Admin and Production Coordinator manages the day-to-day operations of the workshop and ensures smooth coordination between all departments, including weaving, spinning, finishing, and sales. This position combines administrative work, human resource duties, and production control. The person in this role helps create structure and discipline while keeping clear records of attendance, materials, and production flow.

The workshop currently includes six weavers, three spinners, and a finishing team that handles sewing, ironing, and fringe finishing. As the workshop grows, the Coordinator ensures that every person’s work is tracked accurately, materials are used responsibly, and payments are based on verified results.

Main Purpose

The role exists to bring order and accountability to daily operations. The Coordinator manages attendance, monitors raw material usage, tracks each worker’s output, and prevents unnecessary wastage. They also maintain good communication between departments and support management in building a respectful and efficient work environment.

Key Responsibilities

Attendance and Discipline:
Record daily attendance and punctuality for all workers. Track absences, lateness, and leave requests. Encourage discipline and keep the workshop organized and clean.

Production Tracking:
Assign and record weaving and finishing tasks. Keep logs of each worker’s production, including fabric type, meters completed, and dates. Check quality before moving items to the next stage.

Material and Inventory Control:
Distribute threads, yarns, and fabrics to workers while recording quantities. Track material usage and wastage, and prepare simple weekly summaries to help management understand resource flow.

Payment and Performance:
Verify completed work before payment calculations. Keep a fair record of production results and share reports for approval. Identify skilled and consistent workers for future training or responsibilities.

Communication and Coordination:
Act as a link between management and workshop teams. Deliver instructions clearly, follow up on work progress, and organize short meetings when needed.

Administrative and HR Support:
Maintain employee files, including pay rates and hire dates. Support recruitment and orientation of new hires. Manage petty cash and small operational expenses.

Qualifications and Qualities

The ideal person has experience in administration or production coordination, preferably in a small manufacturing or craft environment. A diploma or degree in management or business administration is useful. They should be organized, responsible, and able to use simple computer tools like Excel or Google Sheets. A calm but firm personality is important, as the person will manage skilled workers while maintaining fairness and order.

Expected Results

When the role functions well, the workshop operates with better structure and clarity. Attendance, production, and material use become measurable. Payments are fair, wastage decreases, and communication improves. The Admin and Production Coordinator helps the workshop run smoothly, allowing artisans to focus on their craft while management can make informed decisions with confidence and accurate information

Core responsibilities

·         Tender identification: Research and identify relevant tender opportunities through various channels.

·         Coordination: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as sales, finance, and technical departments, to gather information and ensure timely delivery.

·         Compliance: Ensure all submissions meet the strict formatting, completeness, and compliance guidelines of the tender.

·         Submission: Manage the final submission process, adhering to all deadlines and guidelines.

·         Follow-up: Monitor the status of submitted tenders and respond to any client queries.

·         Reporting: Prepare reports on tender performance and market analysis for management.

Key skills and qualifications

title: Admin & Production Coordinator
description:
The Admin and Production Coordinator manages the day-to-day operations of the workshop and ensures smooth coordination between all departments, including weaving, spinning, finishing, and sales. This position combines administrative work, human resource duties, and production control. The person in this role helps create structure and discipline while keeping clear records of attendance, materials, and production flow.

The workshop currently includes six weavers, three spinners, and a finishing team that handles sewing, ironing, and fringe finishing. As the workshop grows, the Coordinator ensures that every person’s work is tracked accurately, materials are used responsibly, and payments are based on verified results.

Main Purpose

The role exists to bring order and accountability to daily operations. The Coordinator manages attendance, monitors raw material usage, tracks each worker’s output, and prevents unnecessary wastage. They also maintain good communication between departments and support management in building a respectful and efficient work environment.

Key Responsibilities

Attendance and Discipline:
Record daily attendance and punctuality for all workers. Track absences, lateness, and leave requests. Encourage discipline and keep the workshop organized and clean.

Production Tracking:
Assign and record weaving and finishing tasks. Keep logs of each worker’s production, including fabric type, meters completed, and dates. Check quality before moving items to the next stage.

Material and Inventory Control:
Distribute threads, yarns, and fabrics to workers while recording quantities. Track material usage and wastage, and prepare simple weekly summaries to help management understand resource flow.

Payment and Performance:
Verify completed work before payment calculations. Keep a fair record of production results and share reports for approval. Identify skilled and consistent workers for future training or responsibilities.

Communication and Coordination:
Act as a link between management and workshop teams. Deliver instructions clearly, follow up on work progress, and organize short meetings when needed.

Administrative and HR Support:
Maintain employee files, including pay rates and hire dates. Support recruitment and orientation of new hires. Manage petty cash and small operational expenses.

Qualifications and Qualities

The ideal person has experience in administration or production coordination, preferably in a small manufacturing or craft environment. A diploma or degree in management or business administration is useful. They should be organized, responsible, and able to use simple computer tools like Excel or Google Sheets. A calm but firm personality is important, as the person will manage skilled workers while maintaining fairness and order.

Expected Results

When the role functions well, the workshop operates with better structure and clarity. Attendance, production, and material use become measurable. Payments are fair, wastage decreases, and communication improves. The Admin and Production Coordinator helps the workshop run smoothly, allowing artisans to focus on their craft while management can make informed decisions with confidence and accurate information

title: Translation (English to Amharic)
description:
Freelance English to Amharic Spiritual Text Translator

We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Freelance English to Amharic Translator to work on a specialized spiritual text. This is a per-page contract, demanding a unique blend of linguistic expertise and deep religious understanding.

Main Role and Responsibilities

The primary responsibility is to produce a high-quality, spiritually accurate, and culturally resonant Amharic translation of an English spiritual text.

Accurate Translation: Translate the source material from English to Amharic, maintaining the theological accuracy and intended spiritual tone of the original text.

Contextual Nuance: Ensure the Amharic translation effectively captures the nuances of biblical and spiritual concepts, using appropriate, well-established Amharic terminology found in religious contexts.

Clarity and Readability: Produce a translation that is clear, neat, and highly readable for the Amharic-speaking audience, paying attention to varied content density (dense text and pages with images).

Punctual Delivery: Adhere strictly to agreed-upon deadlines for all translated pages, demonstrating excellent punctuality and reliability.

Quality Control: Self-review and proofread all translated work to ensure grammatical correctness, consistency, and a final product free from errors.

Strict Adherence to Policy: No use of Machine Translation (MT) or AI tools is recommended. If you use it, please proof read and edit very carefully, no senseless sentences, please.
Preferred Qualifications
The ideal candidate will possess the following skills and background:
Exceptional Bilingual Proficiency: Native-level proficiency in Amharic and full professional fluency in English.

Biblical/Spiritual Knowledge: A strong, demonstrable background and understanding of Christian theology and the Bible, as the text is spiritual in nature. Familiarity with traditional Amharic biblical terminology is crucial.

Proven Translation Experience: Prior experience in translating complex, nuanced, or specialized texts, preferably religious or academic materials.

Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to work, with a commitment to neatness and clarity in formatting and language.

Self-Management: A reliable and disciplined work ethic to meet strict deadlines and manage workload effectively as a freelancer.

Payment, Perks, and Benefits

Competitive Per-Page Rate: Payment is set at 50 ETB (Ethiopian Birr) per translated page.

Flexible Schedule: The flexibility to work remotely and set your own hours, provided you meet the established delivery schedule.

Meaningful Work: The opportunity to contribute significantly to a spiritual project with potential for wide distribution and impact.

Continuous Work Potential: Successful completion of this project may lead to opportunities for future translation assignments.

የስራ አይነት: ጠቅላላ አገልግሎት ኦፊሰር

የትምህርት ደረጃ እና የስራ ልምድ

የትምህርት ደረጃ፦ 12ኛ ያጠናቀቀ እና ከዛ በላይ
2 አመት እና ከዛ በላይ በተመሳሳይ የስራ ዘርፍ ላይ የስራ ልምድ ያለው

ስራ መዘርዝር

መሰረታዊ የኮምፒውተር እውቀት ያለው
የመንግስት እና የግል መስሪያ ቤቶች ጋር ጉዳይ ተከታትሎ የማስፈጸም ችሎታ የለው
ሰነዶችን ከተለያዩ መስሪያ ቤቶች መቀበል እና መውሰድ
ህጋዊ ሂደቶችን እና ሰነዶችን የመረዳት ችሎታ ያለው
ከውስጥ እና ከውጭ አካላት ጋር የሚኖሩትን ግንኙነቶች የሚያጠክር እና አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ሰነዶችን ማቅረብ የሚችል
ሰነዶችን፤ ደብዳቤዎችን፤ ከባንክ ጋር የተያያዙ ጉዳዮችን እና ማንኛውም አስፈላጊ ነገሮችን ማምጣት እና ማድረስ
ግዢ መፈፀም እና ድርድቱ እንደአስፈላጊነቱ የሚወክላቸውን ስራዎች በአግባቡ መወጣት የምችል
ጉዳይ ለማስፈጸም የሚሆን የመባባት ችሎታ የንግግር ክህሎት ያለው
ሰዓት የሚያከብር እና ምንም አይነት የዲስፕሊን ችግር የሌለበት
ድርጅቱ የሚሰጠውን ኃላፊነት በታማኝነት የሚወጣ

የስራ አይነት: ጠቅላላ አገልግሎት ኦፊሰር

የትምህርት ደረጃ እና የስራ ልምድ

የትምህርት ደረጃ፦ 12ኛ ያጠናቀቀ እና ከዛ በላይ

2 አመት እና ከዛ በላይ በተመሳሳይ የስራ ዘርፍ ላይ የስራ ልምድ ያለው

የስራ መዘርዝር

መሰረታዊ የኮምፒውተር እውቀት ያለው

የመንግስት እና የግል መስሪያ ቤቶች ጋር ጉዳይ ተከታትሎ የማስፈጸም ችሎታ የለው

ሰነዶችን ከተለያዩ መስሪያ ቤቶች መቀበል እና መውሰድ

ህጋዊ ሂደቶችን እና ሰነዶችን የመረዳት ችሎታ ያለው

ከውስጥ እና ከውጭ አካላት ጋር የሚኖሩትን ግንኙነቶች የሚያጠክር እና አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ሰነዶችን ማቅረብ የሚችል

ሰነዶችን፤ ደብዳቤዎችን፤ ከባንክ ጋር የተያያዙ ጉዳዮችን እና ማንኛውም አስፈላጊ ነገሮችን ማምጣት እና ማድረስ

ግዢ መፈፀም እና ድርድቱ እንደአስፈላጊነቱ የሚወክላቸውን ስራዎች በአግባቡ መወጣት የምችል

ጉዳይ ለማስፈጸም የሚሆን የመባባት ችሎታ የንግግር ክህሎት ያለው

ሰዓት የሚያከብር እና ምንም አይነት የዲስፕሊን ችግር የሌለበት

ድርጅቱ የሚሰጠውን ኃላፊነት በታማኝነት የሚወጣ

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
Job Title:

Remote Video Editor for Faceless Health YouTube Channel

Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Video Editor to produce engaging, attention-grabbing health content for a faceless YouTube channel with a global audience. The ideal candidate will be an expert in CapCut and have a strong understanding of techniques that maximize viewer retention and engagement for long-form videos. This is a remote, part-time position for someone passionate about creating visually compelling content without on-camera presence.

Workflow for the Job:

You will receive voice-over audio, AI-generated images, and a script for reference.
Convert images to video using AI, and incorporate short video clips (stock footage).
Add captions, effects, transitions, and filters.
Compile, edit, and synchronize all visuals with the audio.
Apply hooks and attention-grabbing techniques in the first 30 seconds to maximize retention.
Ensure videos are optimized for YouTube algorithm (pacing, retention strategies).
Responsibilities:

Video Editing & Optimization:

Edit 3 long-form YouTube videos per week (20+ minutes each) with dynamic pacing, smooth transitions, and professional polish.
Add captions/subtitles for accessibility and engagement.
Incorporate stock footage, animations, and motion graphics to maintain viewer interest.
Content Enhancement:

Use color grading, sound design, and background music to elevate production quality.
Sync voiceovers seamlessly and maintain clarity in audio.
Add text overlays, call-to-actions, and engaging visual cues to keep viewers engaged.
Required Skills:

Technical Skills:

Expert in CapCut (primary tool).
Proficiency in other editing tools like Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (bonus).
Ability to create motion graphics, transitions, and dynamic text animations.
Knowledge of audio editing and sound balancing.
Creative & Strategic Skills:

Strong understanding of YouTube audience psychology and retention strategies.
Ability to craft compelling hooks and maintain engagement throughout long videos.
Familiarity with faceless content trends and storytelling without on-camera presence.
Soft Skills:

Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and able to work independently.
Excellent communication for remote collaboration.
Preferred Skills:

Experience with social media trends and content repurposing for multiple platforms.
Basic knowledge of health topics (bonus but not mandatory).
Work Schedule & Compensation:

Remote, Part-Time with flexible hours.
Deliverables: 3 weekly long-form videos (20+ minutes each).
Salary: Negotiable based on experience and output.
How to Apply:

Submit via [Google Form link]:

Portfolio: Links to previous YouTube videos or similar work.
Your rate per 20+ minute video.

Administration and Finance Officer
description:
1. Project Summary

The Intelligence, Resilience, Innovative Farming (IRIF) project is an 18-month, donor-funded initiative led by Farm Africa and implemented by Birrama and other partners.

2. Core Purpose of the Role

The Administration and Finance Officer is responsible for managing all day-to-day financial, accounting, and administrative functions for Birrama’s component of the IRIF project. This role ensures strict compliance with Birrama's policies, Farm Africa policies and donor (WRI/P4G) regulations, providing timely financial reports and maintaining the organizational effectiveness required to support the technical team's successful execution of project activities.

3. Key Responsibilities

A. Financial Management and Accounting

Manage the project's financial books of accounts, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded, coded, and posted in the accounting system in compliance with international standards and Birrama policies.
Prepare, process, and track all project-related payments, including vendor invoices, staff expense claims, and partner fund transfers.
Conduct monthly bank and cash reconciliations and prepare trial balances and financial statements for internal review.
Lead the preparation of timely and accurate quarterly financial reports for submission to the Project Manager and the lead implementing partner, Farm Africa, ensuring adherence to the required donor format.
Track project expenditure against the approved budget, highlighting any variances and potential financial risks to the Project Manager.
B. Administrative and Compliance Support

Oversee and maintain comprehensive project records, files, and documentation (both physical and digital) for audit purposes, including procurement files, HR records, and contracts.
Manage the procurement process for project assets and services (e.g., IRIF Capsules, field transportation, workshop services) in line with transparency and competitive bidding requirements.
Ensure all administrative and human resource activities (e.g., staff onboarding, leave tracking, timesheets) for project-hired staff are managed efficiently and correctly.
Serve as the custodian of project assets, maintaining an up-to-date asset register and ensuring all assets are properly insured and secured.
C. Budget and Audit Support

Assist the Project Manager in the annual/semi-annual budget planning, forecasting, and revision processes for the IRIF project.
Coordinate and facilitate all internal and external audits of the project's financial records, ensuring all necessary documentation is readily available and questions are addressed promptly.
Ensure full compliance with all relevant Ethiopian tax laws, labor laws, and donor financial regulations.
4. Required Qualifications and Experience

A. Education and Technical Skills

A minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Proven proficiency in using computerized accounting software (e.g., Peachtree, QuickBooks) and advanced skills in Microsoft Excel for financial analysis and reporting.
Strong knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) and experience with donor-funded project financial management and reporting.
B. Professional Experience

Minimum of 2 years of progressive experience in finance and administration, preferably working on projects funded by international donors.
Demonstrated experience in managing the complete cycle of a project's finances, including budgeting, disbursement, financial reporting, and audit preparation.
Proven experience managing procurement and administrative logistics.
C. Language and Competencies

Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential for donor reporting and coordination.
Professional working proficiency in Amharic is highly required for administrative liaison within the project area.
Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining a high level of confidentiality and integrity.
Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks effectively, and adhere to strict deadlines.
Compensation

•Gross 17,000 ETB

title: Head of Business Development & Strategic Partnerships
description:
About Mizan Institute of Technology (MiT)

Mizan Institute of Technology is on a mission to forge Ethiopia’s next generation of tech leaders. As the nation's premier technology bootcamp, we bridge the gap between ambition and opportunity, offering cutting-edge training instructed by an elite faculty of industry experts, Masters, and PhD holders. We have built a powerful educational engine. Now, we need a visionary leader to connect that engine to the global ecosystem of opportunity.

We are seeking a strategic, resourceful, and relentless Head of Business Development & Strategic Partnerships to architect our next phase of growth—transforming MiT from a top training institute into an indispensable technology partner for organizations across Africa.

The Mission

Your mission is to architect and execute Mizan’s entire B2B and institutional growth strategy. You will be the driving force that diversifies our revenue streams beyond student tuition by hunting, winning, and managing high-value partnerships, grants, and enterprise contracts.

What You Will Achieve

1. Strategic Partnerships & Grant Acquisition:

Secure major grants by identifying, pursuing, and winning proposals from international foundations, development banks, and institutional donors.
Forge high-impact alliances with embassies, INGOs, government ministries, and corporations to deliver large-scale corporate training, digital literacy programs, and workforce development projects.
Position MiT as a thought leader by representing the institute at key national and international conferences, forums, and high-level meetings.
2. Enterprise Technology Solutions Sales:

Drive the full sales cycle for MiT's suite of technology solutions.
Build a robust sales pipeline by identifying client needs, crafting compelling value propositions, and closing deals with corporate and institutional clients.
Develop sales playbooks, proposal templates, and pricing strategies to create a scalable and repeatable sales process.
3. Leadership & Strategy Execution:

Build and mentor a high-performing business development team from the ground up as the division scales.
Design and implement a go-to-market strategy that aligns with MiT's long-term vision and technical capabilities.
The Ideal Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications & Experience:

A minimum of 5-7 years of proven experience in Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Enterprise Sales, or Grant Management, preferably in the technology, education, or development sectors.
A demonstrable track record of closing complex, six-figure deals, securing major grants, or building successful, revenue-generating partnerships from scratch.
Deep knowledge of Ethiopia's corporate, NGO, and public sector landscapes, with a strong understanding of procurement cycles and decision-making processes.
Key Attributes & Competencies:

A Strategic Architect: You can see the big picture, connect disparate dots, and build a clear, actionable plan to get from vision to execution.
An Exceptional Communicator: You possess the executive presence to confidently engage with CEOs, ambassadors, foundation directors, and government ministers.
A Master Relationship Builder: You have a strong professional network or have the proven ability to build one rapidly.
How to Apply

To be considered for this role, please submit the following to apply@mizantechinstitute.com with the Subject line: "Application: Head of Business Development & Strategic Partnerships – [Your Name]".

Your CV.
A Cover Letter that addresses the following three points:

Briefly describe the most significant deal, partnership, or grant you have ever closed and the key steps you took to make it happen.
Identify the first three organizations (e.g., one corporate, one NGO, one foundation) you would target for a partnership with MiT, and explain why.
Outline your high-level vision for scaling MiT’s revenue

title: የልብስ ማጠቢያ ሠራተኛ (Laundry Attendant)
description:
ኒውሊፍ ሜዲካል ፕላዛ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ የላቀ የህክምና አገልግሎቶችን በአንድ ጣራ ሥር ያሰባሰበ፣ ቀዳሚ እና ዘመናዊ የህክምና ማዕከል ለመሆን ነው። ይህ ማዕከል እጅግ በጣም የላቁ የህክምና ቴክኖሎጂዎችን፣ ዘመናዊ መገልገያዎችን እና ከፍተኛ ልምድ ያላቸው ባለሙያዎችን በማጣመር፣ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ፣ አስተማማኝ እና ታካሚን ያማከለ የጤና አገልግሎት ለመስጠት ታስቦ የተቋቋመ የልህቀት ማዕከል ሲሆን በቅርቡ አገልግሎት መስጠት ይጀምራል።

የስራ መደቡ ኃላፊነቶችና ግዴታዎች (ዋና ዋናዎቹ):

የልብስ አሰባሰብና ምደባ፡ ከተለያዩ ክፍሎች (አልጋዎች፣ ላብራቶሪዎች፣ የጽዳት ክፍሎች) የሚመጡ ቆሻሻ ልብሶችን በደረጃቸውና በዓይነታቸው መሠረት መለየትና በአግባቡ መሰብሰብ።
ማጠብና ማድረቅ፡ የህክምና መስፈርቶችንና የንጽህና አጠባበቅ ደረጃዎችን ተከትሎ ልብሶችን በኃላፊነት ስሜት ማጠብ፣ ማድረቅ እና በፀረ-ተባይ መድኃኒት መበከል (Disinfection)።
ተኩሶ ማዘጋጀት፡ የታጠቡ ልብሶችንና ጨርቆችን በሚፈለገው ጥራት ብረት መተኮስ፣ ማጠፍ እና ለአገልግሎት በሚመች መልኩ ማደራጀት።
የእቃ ቁጥጥር፡ የልብስ ማጠቢያ ቁሳቁሶች (ሳሙና፣ ፀረ-ተባይ መድኃኒት፣ ወዘተ) ሁልጊዜም በበቂ ሁኔታ መኖራቸውን መከታተል።
የማሽን ንፅህና፡ የልብስ ማጠቢያ ማሽኖችንና ሌሎች መሳሪያዎችን በአግባቡ መንከባከብ እና የልብስ ማጠቢያ ክፍሉን ንጹህና ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እንዲሆን ማድረግ።
ተፈላጊ የትምህርት ዝግጅትና ልምድ:

የትምህርት ደረጃ፡ 10ኛ ክፍል ወይም ከዛ በላይ የትምህርት ደረጃ ያለው/ያላት።
ልምድ፡ በሆስፒታል፣ በጤና ተቋም ወይም በትልቅ ሆቴል ውስጥ በልብስ ማጠብ (Laundry) ሥራ ላይ ቢያንስ አንድ (1) ዓመት የሰራ/ች።
ተጨማሪ ችሎታ፡ የልብስ ማጠቢያ ማሽንና የብረት መምቻ መሳሪያዎችን በአግባቡ የመጠቀም ችሎታ ያለው/ያላት። የንጽህናና የደህንነት አጠባበቅ ደንቦችን የመረዳትና የመተግበር ፍላጎት።
የቅጥር ሁኔታ:

ደመወዝ፡ በፕላዛው የደመወዝ ስኬል መሠረት።
የሥራ ቦታ፡ ኒውሊፍ ሜዲካል ፕላዛ፣ አዲስ አበባ ለቡ አካባቢ።
ማመልከቻ የሚቀርብበት መንገድ፡

አመልካቾች የትምህርትና የሥራ ልምድ ማስረጃዎቻችሁን በማያያዝ ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ቀን ጀምሮ ባሉት አምስት (15) ተከታታይ ቀናት ውስጥ ብስራት ገብራአል ሳን ህንጻ M ወለል ቫንትጅ የጉዞ ወኪል ቢሮ በአካል ቀርባችሁ ወይም +251 911 816 225 / +251 91 125 8907 ማመልከት ትችላላችሁ።

title: Accountant/finance
description:
ድርጅታችንን በታማኝነትና በብቃት የሚያገለግል፣ የተሟላ ልምድና ጠንካራ የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር ያለው/ያላት የፋይናንስና አስተዳደር ኃላፊ/አካውንታንት አወዳድሮ መቅጠር ይፈልጋል።

​ ዋና ዋና የሥራ ኃላፊነቶች፡-

​ የድርጅቱን ገቢና ወጪ መያዝ ሪፖርት ማድረግ፡- የየዕለት ገቢዎችንና ወጪዎችን በትክክል መመዝገብ፣ ማጠናቀርና ወቅታዊ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት።

​የየቀን ሽያጭ መመዝገብ ፣ መቆጣጠር፡- ዕለታዊ የሽያጭ እንቅስቃሴዎችን በትክክል መመዝገብ፣ የገንዘብ አሰባሰብን መቆጣጠርና የሽያጭ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት።
​ዶክሜንት መያዝ፡- ያልተከፈሉ (Accounts Receivable) እና የተከፈሉ (Accounts Payable) ሂሳቦችን በግልጽ በመለየት፣ በጥንቃቄ መዝግቦ መያዝና ክትትል ማድረግ።
​ ሪፖርት ማድረግ እና ማሳደስ፡- ወርሃዊ፣ ሩብ ዓመት እና አመታዊ የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን በወቅቱ ማዘጋጀትና ማቅረብ፤ የድርጅቱን ፍቃዶች እና ሌሎች ህጋዊ ሰነዶችን የማሳደስ ሥራዎችን መከታተልና ማስጨረስ።
​ውክልና እና አስተዳደር፡- የድርጅቱን ውክልና በመያዝ ሁሉንም ህጋዊና አስተዳደራዊ ጉዳዮች በትክክልና በፍጥነት ማስጨረስ።
​ ህግን ማወቅ እና መራመድ፡- አዳዲስ የሚወጡ የፋይናንስ፣ የግብርና የንግድ ህጎችን አውቆ፣ የድርጅቱን ሥራ ከእነዚህ ህጎች ጋር በማጣጣም መምራት።
​ሁሉንም ኃላፊነት መወጣት፡- በአጠቃላይ በፋይናንስና አስተዳደር ዙሪያ በአመራሩ የሚሰጡ ሌሎች ተግባራትን በኃላፊነትና በብቃት መወጣት።
​ የሥራው መስፈርቶች (ብቃት)፡-

​በአካውንቲንግ (Accounting)፣ በፋይናንስ (Finance) ወይም በተመሳሳይ የትምህርት ዘርፍ እውቅና ካለው ዩኒቨርሲቲ ዲግሪ ያለው/ያላት።
​በተመሳሳይ የሥራ መስክ ቢያንስ [የሚፈለገውን የዓመት ብዛት ያስገቡ] የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ያላት።
​የሂሳብ አያያዝ ሶፍትዌሮችን (ለምሳሌ፡ Peachtree/QuickBooks/ሌሎች) በጥሩ ሁኔታ የመጠቀም ችሎታ።
​ከፍተኛ የሆነ የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር፣ ታማኝነትና ሚስጥር የመጠበቅ ብቃት።
​ጥሩ የኮሙዩኒኬሽንና የሪፖርት አቀራረብ ችሎታ ያለው/ያላት።

title: Accountant/finance
description:
ድርጅታችንን በታማኝነትና በብቃት የሚያገለግል፣ የተሟላ ልምድና ጠንካራ የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር ያለው/ያላት የፋይናንስና አስተዳደር ኃላፊ/አካውንታንት አወዳድሮ መቅጠር ይፈልጋል።

​ ዋና ዋና የሥራ ኃላፊነቶች፡-

​ የድርጅቱን ገቢና ወጪ መያዝ ሪፖርት ማድረግ፡- የየዕለት ገቢዎችንና ወጪዎችን በትክክል መመዝገብ፣ ማጠናቀርና ወቅታዊ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት።

​የየቀን ሽያጭ መመዝገብ ፣ መቆጣጠር፡- ዕለታዊ የሽያጭ እንቅስቃሴዎችን በትክክል መመዝገብ፣ የገንዘብ አሰባሰብን መቆጣጠርና የሽያጭ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት።
​ዶክሜንት መያዝ፡- ያልተከፈሉ (Accounts Receivable) እና የተከፈሉ (Accounts Payable) ሂሳቦችን በግልጽ በመለየት፣ በጥንቃቄ መዝግቦ መያዝና ክትትል ማድረግ።
​ ሪፖርት ማድረግ እና ማሳደስ፡- ወርሃዊ፣ ሩብ ዓመት እና አመታዊ የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን በወቅቱ ማዘጋጀትና ማቅረብ፤ የድርጅቱን ፍቃዶች እና ሌሎች ህጋዊ ሰነዶችን የማሳደስ ሥራዎችን መከታተልና ማስጨረስ።
​ውክልና እና አስተዳደር፡- የድርጅቱን ውክልና በመያዝ ሁሉንም ህጋዊና አስተዳደራዊ ጉዳዮች በትክክልና በፍጥነት ማስጨረስ።
​ ህግን ማወቅ እና መራመድ፡- አዳዲስ የሚወጡ የፋይናንስ፣ የግብርና የንግድ ህጎችን አውቆ፣ የድርጅቱን ሥራ ከእነዚህ ህጎች ጋር በማጣጣም መምራት።
​ሁሉንም ኃላፊነት መወጣት፡- በአጠቃላይ በፋይናንስና አስተዳደር ዙሪያ በአመራሩ የሚሰጡ ሌሎች ተግባራትን በኃላፊነትና በብቃት መወጣት።
​ የሥራው መስፈርቶች (ብቃት)፡-

​በአካውንቲንግ (Accounting)፣ በፋይናንስ (Finance) ወይም በተመሳሳይ የትምህርት ዘርፍ እውቅና ካለው ዩኒቨርሲቲ ዲግሪ ያለው/ያላት።
​በተመሳሳይ የሥራ መስክ ቢያንስ [የሚፈለገውን የዓመት ብዛት ያስገቡ] የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ያላት።
​የሂሳብ አያያዝ ሶፍትዌሮችን (ለምሳሌ፡ Peachtree/QuickBooks/ሌሎች) በጥሩ ሁኔታ የመጠቀም ችሎታ።
​ከፍተኛ የሆነ የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር፣ ታማኝነትና ሚስጥር የመጠበቅ ብቃት።
​ጥሩ የኮሙዩኒኬሽንና የሪፖርት አቀራረብ ችሎታ ያለው/ያላት።
