title: Python and Data Science Trainer
description:
Job Description

Mizan Institute of Technology invites an experienced and passionate Python and Data Science Trainer to join our team as a full-time hybrid member. This role focuses on delivering comprehensive Python programming and Data Science training from beginner to advanced levels, empowering students with practical skills and industry-relevant expertise.

Major Responsibilities and Roles:

Python Programming Trainer:

Deliver engaging, hands-on Python programming training sessions covering fundamentals to advanced concepts including OOP, data structures, algorithms, and best practices.
Teach Python frameworks and libraries including Django, Flask, FastAPI, and automation tools.
Develop and update course materials, coding exercises, projects, and assessments aligned with industry standards.
Guide students in building practical Python applications, scripts, and automation projects.
Data Science Trainer:

Instruct comprehensive Data Science curriculum covering data analysis, visualization, statistical analysis, machine learning, and deep learning.
Teach essential data science libraries and frameworks: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras.
Cover the complete data science pipeline: data collection, cleaning, exploration, feature engineering, model building, evaluation, and deployment.
Provide hands-on training in SQL, database management, and big data tools (Apache Spark, Hadoop basics).
Teach machine learning algorithms (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning) and deep learning architectures (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers).
Guide students through real-world data science projects and Kaggle-style competitions.
Provide expert mentoring in portfolio development, helping students create industry-ready data science projects.
Skills and Qualifications Needed:

Technical Skills:

Expert-level proficiency in Python programming (beginner to advanced).
Deep understanding of Python frameworks: Django, Flask, FastAPI, and web scraping tools (BeautifulSoup, Scrapy).
Strong expertise in data science libraries: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, and Scipy.
Extensive knowledge of machine learning frameworks: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM.
Proficiency in deep learning frameworks: TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch.
Solid understanding of statistics, probability, linear algebra, and calculus for data science.
Experience with SQL, database management (PostgreSQL, MySQL), and NoSQL databases (MongoDB).
Knowledge of big data tools (Spark, Hadoop) and cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
Familiarity with MLOps, model deployment, and production pipelines.

Practical Experience:

Minimum 3-5 years of solid hands-on experience in Python programming and Data Science.
Proven track record of completed data science projects spanning various domains (finance, healthcare, e-commerce, etc.).
Experience with real-world datasets and end-to-end project implementation.
Soft Skills:

Excellent communication, presentation, and teaching abilities with the capacity to simplify complex concepts.
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

Preferred Qualifications:

Proven track record in teaching, training, or corporate coaching in Python and Data Science.
Distinct portfolio showcasing data science projects, Kaggle contributions, or research publications.
Master's degree or Ph.D. in AI, Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
Industry certifications (Google Data Analytics, AWS Machine Learning, TensorFlow Developer) are a plus.
Experience with AI technologies, including generative AI and large language models (LLMs).

Qualified and interested candidates can send their resume, portfolio (GitHub profile, Kaggle profile, data science projects, research papers, and case studies), and a brief cover letter to:

@MizanInstituteOfTechnologyEthio

title: Operations Manager
description:
Addis Basketball Academy (ABA) is an elite sports organization focused on recruiting, training and developing high performace athletes. ABA prides itself in being a leading facilitator of successful sporting events organizing camps and tournaments at various levels accessible to all youth in the Ethiopian Community.

The Operations Manager is the senior leader responsible for managing ABA’s daily operations, staff, and external relationships. This person ensures that all programs run smoothly, coaches and admin perform at high standards, and ABA builds strong, lasting partnerships with schools, embassies, and sponsors.

They act as the right-hand leader to the CEO — bridging internal structure with external growth to keep ABA both organized and expanding.

■ Core Responsibilities

Operations & Program Oversight
- Oversee all ABA training locations, schedules, and staff performance.
- Supervise the Admin & Registration Manager and ensure accurate attendance, payments, and reporting.
- Manage coaches’ schedules, training consistency, and program quality across all sites.
- Coordinate logistics for camps, leagues, and special events.
- Handle facility partnerships, rentals, and venue relations.
- Ensure weekend sessions run smoothly and issues are quickly resolved.
Strategic Partnerships & Sponsorships
- Develop and manage partnerships with schools, embassies, and private brands.
- Design and pitch sponsorship packages for ABA programs and events.
- Negotiate and sign partnership agreements and MOUs.
- Maintain long-term sponsor relationships through reports, updates, and visibility deliverables. - Collaborate with the ABA Foundation (U.S.) on grants and international funding opportunities. - Represent ABA in high-level meetings, conferences, and events.
Business Development & External Affairs
- Build ABA’s reputation as a national leader in youth sports and education.
- Identify collaboration opportunities with ministries, federations, and NGOs.
- Work with the Marketing team to align sponsorship visibility, PR, and brand storytelling. - Act as a public representative for ABA in community and media engagements.
Reporting & Leadership
- Submit weekly and monthly reports on operations, partnerships, and revenue progress. - Manage team accountability and ensure deliverables are met on time.
- Lead internal meetings with Admin, Marketing, and Coaches to align on priorities.
- Recommend new systems or strategies to improve efficiency and growth.

Ideal Candidate Traits
- Female professional preferred — confident, articulate, and polished in both corporate and community settings.
- Proven background in business operations, partnerships, or NGO coordination.
- Strong English & Amharic communication skills (verbal and written) Oromic is a plus.

- Mature and organized, with leadership presence and independence.
- Balances structure (operations) with relationship-building (partnerships).
- Passionate about youth development, sports, and social impact.
- Can represent ABA’s mission with warmth, professionalism, and credibility.
- Prior experience working at a school or something similar working closely with youth and parents.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Miseso Interior Design is hiring a talented and experienced Senior Accountant to strengthen their finance team. The role involves maintaining accurate and complete financial records, preparing and managing company budgets, ensuring timely and accurate tax compliance, performing bank reconciliations, and maintaining the Fixed Asset Register. The ideal Candidate will also oversee daily financial activities, including reviewing payments, vouchers, and other supporting documents, to ensure proper authorization and adherence to policy. Providing technical guidance to accountants and junior accountants will also be a key part of this position.

Qualification

BA/MA Degree in Accounting and Finance
5 years of relevant work experience in a Construction company.
Special Training; IFRS, Peachtree Accounting.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare financial statements and produce budget according to schedule.
Ensure that general accounting operations are verified and controlled as per company policy and procedures and accepted accounting principles.
Ensures that all transactions are properly backed up by adequate source documents; expenses are with in approved budget and are approved by properly authorized person.
Undertakes cash flow forecasts and ensures that sufficient fund is available to meet the operational needs and financial obligations.
Review transactions to ensure they are properly recorded and books of accounts are balanced, and authorize records of transactions and the opening of general and subsidiary ledger accounts.
Monitor and review accounting and related system reports for accuracy and completeness. Resolve accounting discrepancies.
Prepare aging report on accounts receivable on monthly basis.
Prepares accurate and timely financial statements. Check & report revenue and expense trends against budget set and ensure expense control.
Administers intercompany transfer of funds and maintain appropriate records in the books of accounts.
Provides technical back up to accountants and junior accountants for undertaking effective and efficient financial management. Interact with internal and external auditors in completing audits.
Ensures that fixed asset registers are properly maintained.
Verify all financial documents, prepare journal entries in relation to the accounting function, and post to the ledger.
Ensure that all types official financial documents and vouchers are properly registered and are available in sufficient quantity.
Ensures that all required adjusting entries are posted in the books of account before closing and documents are readily available for timely auditing.
Verify, allocate, post and reconcile accounts payable and receivables and Make sure that advances and payables are settled on time.
Examine and perform proper entry for prepaid expenses, accruals, deferrals and other pending issues at the end of every month.
Check the timely and accurate payment of VAT, withholding tax, payroll tax, pension payment, and other legal obligations.
Prepare payment voucher and cheque for authorized payments after verifying the correctness of the relevant source documents
Prepares regular financial reports for different internal and external users
Prepare reconciliation of all bank/cash accounts
Prepares payroll and reviews the document after payments and effected to ascertain whether deductions of income tax and Pension Contribution are paid to Government Authority.
Receives and systematically keeps custody of all accounting records, documents and files.
Analyses financial information and summarize financial status for submission to the top management.
Review and recommend modifications to accounting systems and procedures, as it deems appropriate.
Keep up to date on practices, accounting systems and procedures, internal control measures, and state and federal laws regarding business operations.
Performs other duties assigned by the immediate supervisor.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
AG Grace Business Center, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Job Description
We are seeking a highly driven Qualified Lead Generation Specialist to serve as the critical first point of contact for our client acquisition strategy in high-value international markets. The core mission of this role is to identify and secure highly qualified leads—existing owners and professionals in high-value service sectors—who are actively looking for an expert operational solution. The ideal candidate must have direct, proven experience generating leads from foreign markets, expertise in rigorous qualification, and impeccable English communication skills to hand off Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) to our internal Closers team.

Main Role and Responsibilities

This On-site, Full-time role is critical for acquiring new clients in high-value international markets. The focus is strictly on rigorous lead qualification and hand-off, not sales closing.

Pipeline Generation: Proactively research and identify potential B2B clients and high-value service owners in target international markets (e.g., developed economies).
Outreach Execution: Develop and execute personalized, multi-channel outreach (email, social media, etc.) targeting decision-makers and high-volume owners.
Client Qualification (Core Duty): Conduct in-depth qualification interviews to determine pain points, operational health, and motivation, ensuring the lead strictly meets the SQL (Sales Qualified Lead) criteria.
CRM Management: Manage all lead progression within a CRM system, meticulously tracking and transitioning MQLs to SQLs.
Hand-off & Scheduling: Schedule and coordinate immediate handover meetings between qualified SQLs and the internal Operations/Sales Manager for final contract negotiation.
Reporting: Provide weekly pipeline reports and detailed analysis on lead quality and conversion rates.
Equipment: Must be prepared to utilize your own computer/laptop.

Required Skills (Mandatory)

We require a results-oriented candidate with a proven track record in generating qualified leads from foreign markets.

Exceptional English Fluency proficiency in written and verbal English is mandatory.
Foreign Lead Generation Experience: 1+ years of proven success in Lead Generation and/or Sales, with a heavy emphasis on generating leads from developed foreign markets.
Rigorous Qualification: Demonstrable ability to rigorously qualify leads using defined criteria to ensure high conversion rates.
CRM Expertise: Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., HubSpot, Pipedrive) and advanced data sourcing techniques.
Scheduling Alignment: High degree of self-motivation to manage an on-site schedule .
Perks and Benefits

Competitive Salary: Compensation is competitive and commensurate with your experience level.
Significant Incentives: Access to substantial performance-based incentives and bonuses based on lead quality and successful SQL hand-off, as well as client acquisition after hand-off.
On-site Position: Work from our dedicated office location at AG Grace Building, Stadium Area, Addis Ababa.
Career Growth: Opportunity for professional advancement within a company focused on rapid international growth..

Department: Printing & Packaging

Printing Operations

Execute printing jobs using offset, digital, and large-format machines for business cards, brochures, posters, and packaging.

Quality & Troubleshooting

Production Support

Ability to operate and troubleshoot printing equipment.
High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
High school diploma required; technical certification is a plus.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Working Conditions

Hands-on work with printing machines and materials, with occasional field tasks.
Use of printing equipment and ERP systems for task tracking.
Full-time schedule; occasional overtime or weekends based on workload.

Opportunities for professional growth and technical skill development.
Access to continuous training on modern printing technologies.
Supportive and collaborative work environment.
Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and benefits.
Safe and well-maintained workplace.

title: Finance Clerk
description:
Job Title: Finance Clerk

Reports to: Finance Manager

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

Under the supervision of the Finance Manager, the Finance Clerk is responsible for supporting the day-to-day financial operations of EtCare SACCO. The role involves proper documentation, recording, scanning, and filing of all financial transactions and records. The Finance Clerk ensures accuracy, completeness, and compliance with the SACCO’s financial policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities

1. Documentation and Record Management

Prepare, scan, and file all financial documents according to EtCare SACCO’s documentation and labeling procedures.

Ensure that all vouchers, receipts, and supporting documents are properly verified and organized.

Maintain an efficient filing system (both digital and hard copy) for easy retrieval of financial records.

Support the Finance Manager in identifying and addressing missing or incomplete documents.

Facilitate document access for internal and external auditors.

2. Petty Cash Management

Handle day-to-day cash transactions and ensure proper recording and reconciliation.

Maintain accurate petty cash records and ensure all disbursements are properly approved.

Update the daily cash transaction journal and share it with the Finance team for posting.

Keep cash securely stored and ensure timely replenishment when balance reaches the minimum threshold.

Prepare and process statutory deductions such as income tax, pension, and withholding tax.

3. Bank and Payment Activities

Support in preparing payment instructions and assist in bank transfers and deposits.

Ensure payments are made according to approved financial procedures.

Issue and record withholding tax receipts where applicable.

Assist in managing staff provident fund payments and settlements.

4. Tax and Regulatory Compliance

Maintain and file withholding tax and other statutory deductions accurately and on time.

Support in preparing and submitting reports to relevant authorities such as ERCA.

Ensure all financial practices comply with SACCO policies and government regulations.

5. Additional Responsibilities

Assist the finance team in any other accounting or administrative tasks assigned by the Finance Manager.

Participate in periodic financial reviews and reporting activities.

Qualifications and Skills

Education: Diploma or BA degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Management.

Experience: Minimum of 1 years of experience in accounting or finance-related roles (preferably in financial institutions or SACCOs).

Technical Skills:

Basic knowledge of accounting software and MS Office (Excel, Word).

Familiarity with Ethiopian tax laws and financial procedures.

Other Skills:

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Good communication skills in English and Amharic.

Integrity, confidentiality, and a strong sense of responsibility.

How to Apply

Interested and qualified applicants can send their CV and cover letter to saccosetcare051@gmail.com or alemnehmeseret@gmail.com or submit in person at EtCare SACCO Head Office Hayahulet golagul square.

title: ቪዲዮግራፈር እና ሲኒማ አውቶግራፈር
description:
ቪዲዮግራፈር እና ሲኒማ አውቶግራፈር

ለማመልከት እባክዎ ይህንን ሊንክ ይጠቀሙ (Use this link to APPLY)
https://forms.gle/mVst5MLwKoUG7mkq9

ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ/ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እና ማማከር ነው፡
Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMSፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ ለዚሁ ስራ በቪዲዮ ከፕሪ እስከ ፖስት ድረስ መስራት የሚችል ማድረግ የሚችል ባለሙያ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት እና ልምድ ያለው ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት እየፈለግን ነው።

የደንበኞቻችን ፍላጎት ተከትሎ ቪዲዮ መቅረጽ፣ ማስተካከል (ኤዲት ማድረግ) የሚችል የቪዲዮግራፊ ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡ የቪዲዮግራፈሩ ሚና ለስራው የሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳቁሶች መሟላታቸውን መከታተል፣ የካሜራ ባለሙያዎችን መምራት፣ እና ቪዲዮዎችን ኤዲት ማድረግ የሚችል ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡

በቪዲዮ ግራፊ ሙያ ስኬታማ ለመሆን ባለሙያው የደንበኞችን ፍላጎት በጥሞና አዳምጦ የሚረዳና ፈጠራ የታከለበት ክህሎት አስተባብሮ የሚጠበቀውን ውጤት ማስረከብ የሚችል ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡ ጎበዝ የቪዲዮ ግራፊ ባለሙያ የስራውን ጥራት የሚጨምሩ ዘመኑ ያፈራቸውን ገበያው የሚፈልጋቸውን አዳዲስ አሰራሮች፣ አቀራረቦችን እየተከታተለ በየጊዜው ራሱን የሚበቃ ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡

የቪዲዮ ግራፈሩ ኃላፊነቶች

* በተገቢው ቦታ የቪዲዮ እና የፎቶ ምስሎች መቅረጽ

* በየጊዜው የስራ መሳሪያዎቹን ዝግጁነት መገምገምና ማሟላት

* ከስራ ባልደረቦችና ከደንበኞች ጋር ሆኖ የስራ እቅድ ማርቀቅ

* ከቀረጻ በኋላ የቪዲዮ ምስሎን ማረም (ቪዲዮ ኤዲቲንግ ማከናወን)

* ተፈላጊው የቪዲዮ ምስል በተገቢ ሆኑታ እንዲቀረጽ ሌሎችን የቪዲዮግራፊ ባለሙያዎች ማስተባበር

ተፈላጊ ልዩ ችሎታዎች

* ከፍተኛ የሆነ የኮምፒውተር አጠቃቀም ችሎታ

* የኦንላይን እና ኦፍለይን ሶፍትዎሮችን መጠቀም የሚችል

* ከፍተኛ የሆነ የአዶቤ ፎቶሾፕ አጠቃቀም ችሎታ

* አስደናቂ የካሜራ አጠቃቀም ችሎታ

ከዚህ በላይ የተዘረዘሩትን መስፈርቶች የምታሟሉ አመልካቾች የስራ ልምድዎን እና ማንኛውም ተዛማጅ ደጋፊ ሰነዶችን በቴሌግራም ይላኩ ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ 10 ተከታታይ የስራ ቀናት ውስጥ መመዝገብ ትችላላችሁ።

ደሞዝ፤ 12000

ከፕሪ እስከ ፖስት ፕሮዳክሽን መስራት የሚችል/ምትችል፡፡

description:

የስራ መደቡ፡-ሱፐርቫይዘር የፕሮዳክሽን ለዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ

መስፈርቶች፡-
ድርጅታችን የሚሰራው በዲጂታል ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እና ማማከር ነው፡፡
Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMSፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት ያለው ድርጅታችን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያለው እና ልምድ ያለው አጠቃላይ ተቆጣጣሪ/የዋና አስተዳዳሪ እየፈለግን ነው።

ሱፐር ቡስት አፕ የኢትዮጵያን ተቋማት፣ ቢዝነሶች፣ግለሰቦች፣ትምህርት ቤቶችን በዲጂታል መንገድ ለማብቃት እና በዲጂታል መንገድ እንዲያድጉ ለመርዳት የተቋቋመ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ ነው።

የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ - economic, marketing,Management, business Administration and other related field
  የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ እንቅስቃሴ ያቅዳል፣ ያደራጃል፣ ይመራል፣ ይቆጣጠራል።
  ድርጅቱ ትርፋማ እንዲሆን የሚያስችሉ ፖሊሲዎችንና ስትራቴጂዎችን ነድፎ ይሰራል።
  የድርጅቱን የአጭርና የረዥም ጊዜ አላማ ከግብ ለማድረስ የድርጅቱ የሰው ሃይልና የሰው ሃይል በማቀድ፣ በማደራጀት፣ በመምራትና በመቆጣጠር ይሰራል።
  LMS ፕላትፎርም የሚሆኑ ፕሮዳክሽን ስራ እንዲሰራ ያደርጋል
  አዳዲስ ተቀጣሪዎች ምልመላ፣ ስልጠናና ቅጥር ማከናወን፡፡
  እያንዳንዱ ስራ እና ንዑስ የስራ ሂደት በተገቢው ሁኔታ እየሄደ እንደሆነና የታለመለትን ግብ ሊያሳካ ስለመቻሉ ክትትል ማድረግ...
  ሁሉንም የስራ ሂደቶች መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀት፡፡
  የእያንዳንዱን የስራተኞች ስራ ክንውን መከተታተል ፡፡
  የድርጅቱን የፋይናንስ ፣ የማርኬቲንግ እያንዳንዱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡
  ከፋይናንስ እና አካውንቲንግ ጋር በተያያዘ ያለውን ስራ በእራስም ሆነ ከሚመለከተው ባለሙያ ጋር ሆኖ የየወቅቱን እንዲሰራ ማድረግ፡፡

  ፖሊሲ ማርቀቅና እና አተገባበሩንም መተለም

title: የምግብ ሥራ ባለሙያ
description:

description:

በአዲሰ አበባ በየትኛውም አካባቢ ለምትኖሩ በተለይ በጎሮ፣ በቱሊዲምቱ፣በወርገኖ፣በቃሊቲ እና በአቃቂ  ለምትኖሩ ስራ ፈላጊዎች በሙሉ

title: የልብስ ማጠቢያ ሠራተኛ (Laundry Attendant)
description:
ኒውሊፍ ሜዲካል ፕላዛ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ የላቀ የህክምና አገልግሎቶችን በአንድ ጣራ ሥር ያሰባሰበ፣ ቀዳሚ እና ዘመናዊ የህክምና ማዕከል ለመሆን ነው። ይህ ማዕከል እጅግ በጣም የላቁ የህክምና ቴክኖሎጂዎችን፣ ዘመናዊ መገልገያዎችን እና ከፍተኛ ልምድ ያላቸው ባለሙያዎችን በማጣመር፣ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ፣ አስተማማኝ እና ታካሚን ያማከለ የጤና አገልግሎት ለመስጠት ታስቦ የተቋቋመ የልህቀት ማዕከል ሲሆን በቅርቡ አገልግሎት መስጠት ይጀምራል።

የስራ መደቡ ኃላፊነቶችና ግዴታዎች (ዋና ዋናዎቹ):

የልብስ አሰባሰብና ምደባ፡ ከተለያዩ ክፍሎች (አልጋዎች፣ ላብራቶሪዎች፣ የጽዳት ክፍሎች) የሚመጡ ቆሻሻ ልብሶችን በደረጃቸውና በዓይነታቸው መሠረት መለየትና በአግባቡ መሰብሰብ።
ማጠብና ማድረቅ፡ የህክምና መስፈርቶችንና የንጽህና አጠባበቅ ደረጃዎችን ተከትሎ ልብሶችን በኃላፊነት ስሜት ማጠብ፣ ማድረቅ እና በፀረ-ተባይ መድኃኒት መበከል (Disinfection)።
ተኩሶ ማዘጋጀት፡ የታጠቡ ልብሶችንና ጨርቆችን በሚፈለገው ጥራት ብረት መተኮስ፣ ማጠፍ እና ለአገልግሎት በሚመች መልኩ ማደራጀት።
የእቃ ቁጥጥር፡ የልብስ ማጠቢያ ቁሳቁሶች (ሳሙና፣ ፀረ-ተባይ መድኃኒት፣ ወዘተ) ሁልጊዜም በበቂ ሁኔታ መኖራቸውን መከታተል።
የማሽን ንፅህና፡ የልብስ ማጠቢያ ማሽኖችንና ሌሎች መሳሪያዎችን በአግባቡ መንከባከብ እና የልብስ ማጠቢያ ክፍሉን ንጹህና ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እንዲሆን ማድረግ።
ተፈላጊ የትምህርት ዝግጅትና ልምድ:

የትምህርት ደረጃ፡ 10ኛ ክፍል ወይም ከዛ በላይ የትምህርት ደረጃ ያለው/ያላት።
ልምድ፡ በሆስፒታል፣ በጤና ተቋም ወይም በትልቅ ሆቴል ውስጥ በልብስ ማጠብ (Laundry) ሥራ ላይ ቢያንስ አንድ (1) ዓመት የሰራ/ች።
ተጨማሪ ችሎታ፡ የልብስ ማጠቢያ ማሽንና የብረት መምቻ መሳሪያዎችን በአግባቡ የመጠቀም ችሎታ ያለው/ያላት። የንጽህናና የደህንነት አጠባበቅ ደንቦችን የመረዳትና የመተግበር ፍላጎት።
የቅጥር ሁኔታ:

ደመወዝ፡ በፕላዛው የደመወዝ ስኬል መሠረት።
የሥራ ቦታ፡ ኒውሊፍ ሜዲካል ፕላዛ፣ አዲስ አበባ ለቡ አካባቢ።
ማመልከቻ የሚቀርብበት መንገድ፡

አመልካቾች የትምህርትና የሥራ ልምድ ማስረጃዎቻችሁን በማያያዝ ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ቀን ጀምሮ ባሉት አምስት (15) ተከታታይ ቀናት ውስጥ ብስራት ገብራአል ሳን ህንጻ M ወለል ቫንትጅ የጉዞ ወኪል ቢሮ በአካል ቀርባችሁ ወይም +251 911 816 225 / +251 91 125 8907 ማመልከት ትችላላችሁ።

title: Animal nutritionist
description: Company Overview: Agar agro industry is a well-established dairy farm dedicated to producing high-quality dairy products in a sustainable and efficient manner. Our farm is committed to animal welfare, sustainable farming practices, and maintaining the highest standards of product quality. We are currently seeking a skilled and motivated ANIMAL NUTRITIONIST to oversee day-to-day operations and ensure smooth and effective farm management. Position Summary: The Animal Nutritionist will be responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing nutrition programs for various animal species. This position requires a deep understanding of animal dietary needs, digestive systems, and the impact of nutrition on animal health and productivity. You will work closely with veterinarians, animal caregivers, and product development teams to ensure that all animals in our care receive optimal nutrition. Key Responsibilities: Develop customized nutrition plans for a variety of animal species, including livestock, companion animals, and exotic species. Analyze and recommend improvements to animal diets, supplements, and feeds based on scientific research and practical applications. Work with the research and development team to formulate new feed products and supplements that meet nutritional requirements. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of nutrition programs in improving animal health, growth, and reproduction. Stay current with industry trends, research, and regulatory standards related to animal nutrition. Educate clients and staff on proper animal nutrition practices, feeding protocols, and new advancements in animal health nutrition. Collaborate with veterinary professionals to address nutritional concerns and improve overall animal wellness. Conduct on-site visits to assess animal health and nutrition status. Provide technical support and recommendations for animal nutrition products to external clients. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Animal Science, Animal Nutrition, Animal production, or a related field 0 years of experience but a strong knowledge in animal nutrition and feed formulation. Strong knowledge of animal physiology, digestion, and the effects of various nutrients on animal health. Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards for animal feed and nutrition. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to educate both internal teams and external clients. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess and interpret scientific data. Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Job Overview:  This position is responsible for the execution and optimization of overall digital marketing activities in the Ethiopian market, with a focus on promoting online brand communication, social media operations, and digital advertising to enhance brand awareness and influence in the local market and support sales growth and brand building goals. Main job responsibilities: - Digital Marketing Execution ·       Based on the brand's annual marketing strategy, assist the DM manager in developing and executing online marketing (including social media, content marketing, online promotional activities, KOL collaborations, etc.). ·       Responsible for online campaign execution ( Meta Ads , Google Ads, etc.), and regularly monitoring campaign performance and proposing optimization solutions. ·       Support the Digital Marketing Manager in developing and implementing online marketing strategies based on the brand’s annual plan. ·       Execute digital campaigns across platforms (e.g., Meta Ads, Google Ads) and monitor performance regularly, providing optimization recommendations Content and Creative Management Create locally relevant digital content (videos, short films, images, text, challenges) that reflects brand positioning and Ethiopian culture. Collaborate with designers, photographers, and production teams to ensure content aligns with brand tone and has viral potential. KOLs and Media Collaboration Plan and manage partnerships with local Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and content creators. Build relationships with local media and digital platforms to expand brand reach. Oversee budgets, contracts, and settlement processes for collaborations. Teamwork and Brand Consistency Coordinate with marketing, retail, and channel teams to align digital efforts with sales goals. Ensure all marketing activities reflect brand image and global communication strategy. Support the digital promotion of offline events such as product launches and retail campaigns. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Media, Advertising, or related fields. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in digital marketing (experience in consumer electronics, mobile phones, or FMCG is preferred). Proficient in managing and advertising on platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Google, and YouTube. Strong skills in data analysis and report writing. Fluent in English. Creative thinker with strong execution skills and the ability to coordinate cross-functional resources effectively. How to Apply ·       Interested and qualified applicants fulfilling the above criteria are invited to send their CV and copies of relevant documents along with application letter through email address transsionmanufacturing@gmail.com

title: Senior Finance Clerk
description:
Job Title: Senior Finance Clerk

Reports to: Finance Manager

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

Under the supervision of the Finance Manager, the Senior Finance Clerk is responsible for supporting the day-to-day financial operations of EtCare SACCO. The role involves proper documentation, recording, scanning, and filing of all financial transactions and records. The Senior Finance Clerk ensures accuracy, completeness, and compliance with the SACCO’s financial policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities

1. Documentation and Record Management

Prepare, scan, and file all financial documents according to EtCare SACCO’s documentation and labeling procedures.

Ensure that all vouchers, receipts, and supporting documents are properly verified and organized.

Maintain an efficient filing system (both digital and hard copy) for easy retrieval of financial records.

Support the Finance Manager in identifying and addressing missing or incomplete documents.

Facilitate document access for internal and external auditors.

2. Petty Cash Management

Handle day-to-day cash transactions and ensure proper recording and reconciliation.

Maintain accurate petty cash records and ensure all disbursements are properly approved.

Update the daily cash transaction journal and share it with the Finance team for posting.

Keep cash securely stored and ensure timely replenishment when balance reaches the minimum threshold.

Prepare and process statutory deductions such as income tax, pension, and withholding tax.

 

 

3. Bank and Payment Activities

Support in preparing payment instructions and assist in bank transfers and deposits.

Ensure payments are made according to approved financial procedures.

Issue and record withholding tax receipts where applicable.

Assist in managing staff provident fund payments and settlements.

4. Tax and Regulatory Compliance

Maintain and file withholding tax and other statutory deductions accurately and on time.

Support in preparing and submitting reports to relevant authorities such as ERCA.

Ensure all financial practices comply with SACCO policies and government regulations.

5. Additional Responsibilities

Assist the finance team in any other accounting or administrative tasks assigned by the Finance Manager.

Participate in periodic financial reviews and reporting activities.

Qualifications and Skills

Education: Diploma or BA degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Management.

Experience: Minimum of 4 years of experience in accounting or finance-related roles (preferably in financial institutions or SACCOs).

Technical Skills:

Basic knowledge of accounting software and MS Office (Excel, Word).

Familiarity with Ethiopian tax laws and financial procedures.

Other Skills:

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Good communication skills in English and Amharic.

Integrity, confidentiality, and a strong sense of responsibility.

How to Apply

Interested and qualified applicants can send their CV and cover letter to saccosetcare051@gmail.com or alemnehmeseret@gmail.com or submit in person at EtCare SACCO Head Office Hayahulet golagul square.

title: GIS Data Collection Coordinator
description:
The GIS Data Collection Coordinator serves as the central link between field teams and GIS back-office staff. This role supports the technical side of field data collection ensuring that all captured data adheres to the Spatial Energy Management System (SEMS) data schema, validation rules, and quality standards. The Coordinator monitors data collection progress, resolves GIS issues, oversees device readiness, and ensures consistency across regions.

Key Responsibilities

GIS & Data Quality Oversight
Ensure field teams follow the approved SEMS data schema, domains, coded lists, and validation rules.
Conduct daily or weekly checks on geometry quality, required fields completeness, metadata accuracy, photo evidence compliance
Workflow Coordination
Serve as the first-line technical support for field technicians using ArcGIS Field Maps and Survey123.
Coordinate with the QA/QC Lead, GIS Lead, and Regional Data Managers to close data issues.
Support configuration and troubleshooting of Offline map areas, Mobile forms, Device sync and conflict resolution
Device & Application Management
Ensure all devices are properly configured with Field Maps, Survey123, Approved offline map areas
Verify that all devices meet MDM, passcode, and storage requirements.
Assist teams in resolving sync conflicts according to SEMS workflow rules.
Reporting & Monitoring
Generate daily/weekly status summaries on asset coverage, quality metrics, number of features collected, audit findings, unresolved issues
Track attribute completeness and spatial accuracy KPIs.
Occasional Field Support
Conduct targeted field visits during audits, troubleshooting, onboarding of new regional teams
Provide refresher training when recurring errors are detected.

6. Coordination with focal officers

Work with focal officers to confirm access to substations and generation facilities, validation workflows, action items for weekly review meetings
Required Qualifications

Education

Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geomatics, Surveying, Geography, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience

Minimum 3 years of experience in GIS field data collection or spatial data workflows.
Demonstrated experience using ArcGIS mobile tools (Field Maps, Survey123).
Familiarity with enterprise GIS environments (ArcGIS Enterprise/Portal).
Technical Skills

Strong understanding of:

spatial data accuracy standards
metadata requirements
coordinate systems (WGS84, projected systems)
GNSS accuracy and field capture methods
Ability to perform basic QA/QC checks on attribute and geometric data.
Ability to troubleshoot forms, layers, and mobile workflows.
Soft Skills

Strong communication and coordination capabilities.
Ability to train and coach field teams.
Highly organized, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Additional Requirements

Ability to travel occasionally for audits or troubleshooting.
Willingness to work in fast-paced, multi-region environments.
Familiarity with safety protocols for fieldwork and substations.
Ability to work extended hours during peak data collection periods.
What We Offer

Competitive project-based compensation
Full training on SEMS workflow, schemas, and quality standards
Opportunities to work with a national-scale GIS modernization program
Supportive, multidisciplinary team environment
All field-related expenses and equipment provided for travel days
How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

-Updated CV

-Cover Letter describing relevant experience

-Copies of certifications or credentials

Email Applications To:

alazar.shimelis@environiqa.net

Subject: Application – GIS Data Collection Coordinator

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until positions are filled.

Akilo is seeking a driven and dedicated Regional Manager to head up our operations in Addis Ababa. As we continue to grow in the tech sector, we need a hands-on leader to manage our local office, drive business performance, and foster a high-performance culture among the team. You will be the primary representative of our brand in the region, responsible for translating our corporate vision into local success.

A critical component of this role is the ability to navigate the local regulatory landscape. We are looking for someone who knows their way around government administration units and can effectively manage relationships with public sector stakeholders. You will be responsible for ensuring full compliance, handling administrative processes, and smoothing out any bureaucratic hurdles to keep our operations running efficiently.

The ideal candidate holds a Bachelor’s degree in Management or Marketing and has 3+ years of experience leading an organization or department, preferably within the technology industry. Beyond your qualifications, you must possess exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both government officials and technical teams.

title: English teacher
description: We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic English Teacher to join our academic team. The ideal candidate will possess strong subject knowledge, a passion for language and literature, and the ability to inspire students to develop their reading, writing, and communication skills. This role involves planning and delivering engaging lessons, assessing student progress, and contributing to a positive and supportive learning environment. Key Responsibilities Plan, prepare, and deliver high-quality English lessons aligned with the curriculum. Teach reading, writing, grammar, vocabulary, speaking, and literature at the appropriate grade level. Create a classroom environment that supports active learning and student engagement. Develop and administer assessments to evaluate student learning and progress. Provide timely and constructive feedback to students and parents. Differentiate instruction to meet diverse learning needs. Integrate technology and multimedia tools to enhance instruction. Maintain accurate and complete student records. Participate in staff meetings, professional development, and school events. Foster a positive, inclusive, and respectful classroom culture. Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in English, Education, or a related field. Teaching certification or licensure (as required by local regulations). Strong command of the English language. Effective classroom management skills. Preferred: Master’s degree in English or Education. Prior teaching experience. Familiarity with modern teaching methodologies and educational technology. Skills and Competencies Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and time-management abilities. Creativity in lesson planning and curriculum delivery. Ability to motivate and inspire students. Patience, empathy, and a positive attitude. Collaborative mindset and willingness to work with colleagues and parents. .

ዝርዝር ኃላፊነቶችና ግዴታዎች
3.1    ደሊቨሪ በፍጥነት እና በጥራት ማከናወን፣

3.6    ደንበኞች ጋር ያደረሱትን እቃ በደንበኛው ፍላጐት መሠረት በትክክል ገጥሞ፣ የእቃ ማስፈረሚያ ሰነድ ( Delivery Note ) አስፈርሞ ማስረከብ፣

3.7    የገጠማ ስራው እንደተጠናቀቀ የደንበኛ አስተያየት መስጫ እንደተሞላ ማረጋገጥ

title: Anesthetist
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Anesthetist to join our healthcare team. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing high-quality anesthesia and emergency medical care in pre-hospital settings.

Key Responsibilities:

Respond to emergency calls and radio transmissions promptly and efficiently.
Assess, triage, and manage patients at the scene, prioritizing red-level emergencies.
Administer advanced airway management, including endotracheal intubation for patients with respiratory failure.
Interpret ECG rhythms and manage cardiac dysrhythmias in accordance with ACLS protocols.
Provide emergency medical treatment, including intravenous medication administration and perfusion as required.
Manage surgical emergencies pre-transport and during ambulance transit.
Safely transport emergency patients to designated healthcare facilities.
Monitor and provide continuous care to patients during transit.
Communicate effectively with receiving medical teams, providing detailed patient reports, including medical history, condition, and treatment provided.
Prepare and submit accurate incident and patient care reports in compliance with medical standards.
Qualifications & Requirements:

BSc degree in Anesthesia from a recognized government university/college.
Minimum 2 years of experience in anesthesia or emergency care.
Valid and up-to-date certifications in BLS and CPD.
Proficiency in:

Mechanical ventilator and advanced airway management
Basic Emergency Care
National Integrated Emergency Medicine (NIEM)
Emergency Pediatrics & Gynecology/Obstetrics (GYN/OBS)
Strong decision-making skills in high-pressure emergency situations.

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን ቀልጣፋ፣ የሥራ ተነሳሽነት ያለውና በጥንቃቄ  በኃላፊነት በማጓጓዝ የስራ ቁሳቁሶችን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ የሚያደርስ ብቁ የሹፌር ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡

መስፈርቶች፡

=> ሕጋዊ የሆነ እና የታደሰ /የሚሰራ/ መንጃ ፍቃድ ያለው።

=> መንጃ ፈቃዱ ከታደሰ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት  ያለው ከዚያ በላይ የሆነ፡፡

=> አዲስ አበባን እና አካቢዎቿን በሚገባ መንገድ የሚያውቅ  መሆን አለበት፡፡

=> የትራፊክ ህጎች እና የከተማ መንገዶች የማሽከርከር እውቀት ያለው።

=> ጥንቃቄ በተሞላበት በተሰጠው የመንገድ ህገ ደንብ የመንገድ ፍጥነት መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

=> ከሰው ጋር ጥሩ መግባባትና  የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ችሎታ ያለው።

=> ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው በራሱ የሚተማመን ፣ ደህንነቱን የጠበቀ አነዳድ የሚከተል፡፡

=> ታማኝ፣ የድርጅቱን ሰዓት የሚያከብር።

=> አመልካች ሰፈሩ  ጉርድ ሾላ፣ ገርጂ  አቅራቢያ ወይም ያልራቀ ቢሆን ይመረጣል፡፡

=> እድሜው ከ25-30 ክልል ውስጥ የሆነ፡፡

=> ማስታወቂያ ቤት የሰራ / የማስታወቂያ ሥራ በቂ ዕውቀት ያለው መሆን አለት፡፡

=> አውቶማቲክ ሆነ ማንዋልም  የመኪና /ማርሽ/  በሚገባ መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

የሥራ ዓይነት:- የሙሉ ጊዜ

ደመወዝ:-  ወርሃዊ

እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል፡-

·      አመልካቾች የት/ት ማስረጃ፣ የሥራ ልምድ እና የታደሰ መንጃ ፈቃድ ኮፒውን በአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን በአካል ም ሆነ በቴሌግራም ማቅረብም ሆነ መላክ ይችላሉ፡፡

·      እንዲሁም  ቅጥር  ሲፈፀም  በቂ የዋስ አይነት ማቅረብ የምትችሉ እና ከመንግስት መስራያ ቤት ዋስ/ተያዥ ማቅረብ  እችላለሁ የምትሉ  ብቻ   በዚህ ማስታወቂያ ማመልከት ትችላላችሁ፡የስራ አድራሻ፡-

• አዲስ አበባ አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ጉርድ ሾላ - ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  በትራፊክ መብራት  አካባቢ፣  ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ ላይ እንገኛለን፡፡  ለዚህ ማስታወቂያ ከረቡዕ ቀን  10/03/2018 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ እስከ ቅዳሜ 13/03/2018 ድረስ የምንቀበል ይሆናል፡፡

title: የፈርኒቸር ገጣጣሚ ІІ
description:
አጠቃላይ ተግባርና ኃላፊነት
ተፈላጊ መስፈርት

በቴክኒክና ሙያ /TVET/ የትምህርት ዘርፍ በእንጨት ስራ በደረጃ 3 ወይንም/10+3/10+4/ ሰርተፊኬት ያለው 2 ዓመትና ከዚያ በላይ በሙያው የሰራ

በመገጣጠሚያ ክፍል ውስጥ የሚከናወኑ ማንኛውም የገጠማ ስራዎችን ቅልጥፍናን ባማከለ መልኩ ማከናወን፡፡

ዝርዝር ኃላፊነቶችና ግዴታዎች
3.1    ደሊቨሪ በፍጥነት እና በጥራት ማከናወን፣

3.2    ለሚቀጥለው ቀን የተሸጡ እቃዎችን በንዑስ ክፍል ኃላፊና ትዕዛዝ መሠረት እቃዎችን ማዘጋጀት፣

3.3    የተሸጡ እቃዎችን በኢንቮይሱ መሠረት የእቃ ማስረከቢያ ሰነድ (Delivery Note /Do) መሰረት ማፅደቅ፣ የደንበኛውን አድራሻ መቀበልና እቃው ከመጫኑ እንዲሁም ከግቢ ከመውጣቱ በፊት ደንበኞች ጋር ደውሎ ማሳወቅ፣

3.4    በእቃ ማስረከቢያ ሰነድ (Delivery Note /Do) መሠረት የሚጫኑት እቃዎች ትክክል፣ ንፁህና የተሟሉ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጦ መጫንና አብረው ያሉትን የፈርኒቸር መገጣጠሚያ ረዳቶች በማስተባበር ማዘጋጀት፣

3.5    እቃው የሚሄድበት ቦታ (ደንበኛው) ቢሮ/ቤት እንደተደረሰ ከደንበኛው ጋር ግንኙነት በማድረግ ከፈርኒቸር መገጣጠሚያ ቡድን መሪዎችና ረዳቶች ጋር በመተባበር ማውረድና ለገጠማ ዝግጁ ማድረግ፣

3.6    ደንበኞች ጋር ያደረሱትን እቃ በደንበኛው ፍላጐት መሠረት በትክክል ገጥሞ፣ የእቃ ማስፈረሚያ ሰነድ ( Delivery Note ) አስፈርሞ ማስረከብ፣

3.7    የገጠማ ስራው እንደተጠናቀቀ የደንበኛ አስተያየት መስጫ እንደተሞላ ማረጋገጥ ፣

title: Production Start-Up Coordinator
description:
Peanut Butter Production Start-Up Coordinator

About the Role

Hubana Peanut Butter is launching a modern peanut butter production line featuring multiple infused flavors and high-quality standards. We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Production Start-Up Coordinator who can set up, manage, and streamline all processes from pre-production to full operational launch.

This role is ideal for someone experienced in food production start-ups, small-scale manufacturing, or factory setup.

Key Responsibilities

1. Pre-Production Setup

Source, compare, and negotiate suppliers for raw peanuts, jars, labels, ingredients, and packaging materials.
Assist in purchasing essential equipment and tools.
Prepare production room layout (workflow, zones, hygiene standards).
Coordinate installation of machines (grinder, roaster, mixer, filler, etc.).
Ensure compliance with Ethiopian food safety regulations.
2. Documentation & System Development

Help finalize SOPs, production manuals, and batch record templates.
Create inventory tracking systems for raw materials, packaging, and finished goods.
Develop daily production checklists for staff.
Prepare QC (Quality Control) procedures:

Raw material inspection
Process checks
Packaging inspection
Safety & hygiene tracking
3. Production Launch & Training

Train production staff on SOPs, hygiene, safety, and machine handling.
Guide small test batches and refine formulations where needed.
Establish standard batch sizes (1 kg test → 10 kg production → 50 kg scale-up).
Monitor first production cycles and correct any bottlenecks.
4. Operational Management

Plan weekly production schedules based on demand.
Maintain stock levels and purchasing calendar.
Manage waste control and cleaning protocols.
Coordinate label printing and packaging workflow.
5. Quality & Continuous Improvement

Ensure every batch meets Hubana’s quality and consistency standards.
Track product shelf-life and storage conditions.
Report issues and suggest improvements regularly.
Required Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related field.
2+ years experience in food manufacturing, FMCG production, or food processing setup.
Experience working with production machinery (mixers, grinders, roasters, fillers).
Strong understanding of hygiene, GMP, and food safety standards (HACCP is a plus).
Experience creating or managing SOPs, checklists, or documentation.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage timelines.
Ability to train small teams effectively.
Problem-solving, practical thinking, and ability to adapt quickly.
Preferred Skills

Experience in a start-up food factory or small manufacturing environment.
Ability to coordinate with technicians, suppliers, and regulatory offices.
Knowledge of Ethiopian manufacturing standards and permits.
Basic computer skills (Excel, documentation, inventory tools).

title: Account Payable Head
description:
Skills & Expertise

Accounts Payable & Invoice Management
Vendor Relations & Payment Processing
Fixed Asset Management & Depreciation Control
Cash & Petty Cash Oversight
Team Leadership & Staff Development
Reporting, Compliance & Internal Controls
A. Main Role and Responsibilities:

Lead and supervise the accounts payable team, including Payment Accountants, Cashiers, and Check Processing staff.
Ensure all team members follow company policies and accounting procedures.
Review, approve, and post accounts payable transactions accurately and timely into the accounting system.
Receive and verify invoices from suppliers and vendors, matching them against purchase orders and receiving documents to confirm quantity, price, and terms before payment.
Schedule and prioritize payments to ensure timely disbursement, including leveraging early payment discounts.
Reconcile vendor statements with the supermarket's accounts payable ledger to resolve discrepancies and maintain positive vendor relationships.
Serve as the primary point of contact for vendor inquiries regarding payments, discrepancies, and account status.
Support the monthly financial closing process by ensuring all payables are accurately recorded, reconciled, and reported, including generating accounts payable aging reports.
Implement and monitor internal controls to prevent fraudulent or unauthorized payments.
Fixed Asset Management:

Maintain the fixed asset register, updating details on acquisitions, transfers, disposals, and depreciation.
Record new fixed asset purchases, ensuring proper classification and capitalization in accordance with company policy and accounting standards (IFRS).
Calculate and record monthly depreciation expenses for all fixed assets.
Manage disposal or transfer of fixed assets with proper documentation.
Conduct regular physical verification of assets and reconcile with the fixed asset register.
Provide documentation and support to internal and external auditors regarding fixed assets.
Cash Management:

Oversee purchase fund and petty cash management, ensuring proper handling and recording.
Monitor cash flow related to accounts payable and implement cost-saving measures where possible.
Reporting & Compliance:

Generate accounts payable reports, reconcile discrepancies, and provide updates to the Bank Reconciliation Head and management.
Ensure compliance with tax regulations, company policies, and internal controls.
Assist in internal and external audits related to accounts payable and fixed assets.
Training & Development:

Provide training and mentorship for the accounts payable team.
Ensure team members are up-to-date with best practices and industry standards.
B. Required Skills:

Strong leadership and organizational skills to manage a team effectively.
Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
Attention to detail for accurate invoice processing, reconciliation, and reporting.
Knowledge of fixed asset accounting and depreciation procedures.
Ability to implement internal controls and ensure compliance with policies and tax regulations.
C. Preferred Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in accounts payable or accounting, including at least 2 years in a supervisory role.
Prior experience managing vendor relations and fixed assets.
Familiarity with ERP systems and retail or supermarket financial operations.
D. Perks and Benefits:

Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
Professional development and on-the-job training opportunities.
Safe and organized working environment with modern accounting systems.

title: Video Editor
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a talented and experienced female Video Editor to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have 5 years of professional video editing experience and a strong portfolio showcasing their skills. You will be responsible for editing high-quality video content for various platforms, including social media, websites, and promotional materials.

Key Responsibilities:

• Edit and assemble recorded raw material into a suitable, finished product ready for broadcasting.

• Collaborate with producers and other team members to understand project requirements and objectives.

• Review and select footage, ensuring it aligns with the desired narrative and style.

• Add music, sound effects, graphics, and special effects as needed.

• Ensure all edits are completed on time and meet quality standards.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and editing software.

 

Requirements:

• 5 years of professional video editing experience.

• Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.

• Strong understanding of video production processes and post-production techniques.

• Excellent attention to detail and a creative mindset.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Strong communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with motion graphics and animation is a plus.

• Familiarity with color grading and audio mixing.

• Knowledge of social media platforms and their video requirements.

How to Apply:

If you are passionate about video editing and meet the qualifications listed above, Please submit your resume, a cover letter, and a link to your portfolio or reel to Telegram account @Tsi_Nat

A proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: ጽዳት
description:
ኃላፊነቶች:

የስራ ሰዓት ከ ቀኑ 10፡00 እስከ ምሽቱ 6:30

የቢሮ ፣ የመጸዳጃቤት እና ሌሎች ድርጅቱ ለስራ የሚጠቀምባቸውን ክፍሎች እና አቃዎች ማጽዳት።

ወለሎችን፣ ጠረጴዛዎችን፣ መስኮቶችን እና ንጣፎችን ጨምሮ የቢሮ ቦታዎችን ማጽዳት።

የጋራ ቦታዎች (መታጠቢያ ቤት፣ የመሰብሰቢያ ክፍሎች) ቀኑን ሙሉ በንጽህና እና በጥሩ ሁኔታ መያዛቸውን ማረጋገጥ።

አስፈላጊ የጽዳት ግብአቶች የተሟሉ መሆናቸውን ማረጋገጥ እንዲሁም መቆጣጠር ።

ከጽዳት በኋላ የጽዳት እቃወችን (መወልወያ፣ፎጣ ወዘተ) ንጹህ አድርጎ ለቀጣይ ፈረቃ ማስረከብ።

የበላይ ሃላፊን ትዕዛዝ በንቃት ተቀብሎ መከወን።

መስፈርቶች:

1 አመት እና ከዛ በላይ የስራ ልምድ ያላት /ቢሆን ይመረጣል።

እምነት የሚጣልበት፣ በሰዓቱ የሚኖር እና ፈጣን በሆነ አካባቢ ውስጥ ብዙ ተግባራትን ማከናወን የሚችል።

ማንበብ እና መጻፍ የምትችል

ዋስ ማቅረብ የምትችል

Online መተግበሪያን በማጎልበት እና ድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎችን ጨምሮ ሰፊ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን በ LMSፕላትፎረም ትምህርቶችን ኮርሶችን ይሰጣል፡፡ ስለዚህ ለዚሁ ስራ በቪዲዮ ከፕሪ እስከ ፖስት ድረስ መስራት የሚችል ማድረግ የሚችል ባለሙያ በዚህ ላይ በቂ እውቀት እና ልምድ ያለው ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት እየፈለግን ነው።

የደንበኞቻችን ፍላጎት ተከትሎ ቪዲዮ መቅረጽ፣ ማስተካከል (ኤዲት ማድረግ) የሚችል የቪዲዮግራፊ ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡ የቪዲዮግራፈሩ ሚና ለስራው የሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳቁሶች መሟላታቸውን መከታተል፣ የካሜራ ባለሙያዎችን መምራት፣ እና ቪዲዮዎችን ኤዲት ማድረግ የሚችል ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡

በቪዲዮ ግራፊ ሙያ ስኬታማ ለመሆን ባለሙያው የደንበኞችን ፍላጎት በጥሞና አዳምጦ የሚረዳና ፈጠራ የታከለበት ክህሎት አስተባብሮ የሚጠበቀውን ውጤት ማስረከብ የሚችል ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡ ጎበዝ የቪዲዮ ግራፊ ባለሙያ የስራውን ጥራት የሚጨምሩ ዘመኑ ያፈራቸውን ገበያው የሚፈልጋቸውን አዳዲስ አሰራሮች፣ አቀራረቦችን እየተከታተለ በየጊዜው ራሱን የሚበቃ ሊሆን ይገባዋል፡፡

የቪዲዮ ግራፈሩ ኃላፊነቶች

* በተገቢው ቦታ የቪዲዮ እና የፎቶ ምስሎች መቅረጽ

* በየጊዜው የስራ መሳሪያዎቹን ዝግጁነት መገምገምና ማሟላት

* ከስራ ባልደረቦችና ከደንበኞች ጋር ሆኖ የስራ እቅድ ማርቀቅ

* ከቀረጻ በኋላ የቪዲዮ ምስሎን ማረም (ቪዲዮ ኤዲቲንግ ማከናወን)

* ተፈላጊው የቪዲዮ ምስል በተገቢ ሆኑታ እንዲቀረጽ ሌሎችን የቪዲዮግራፊ ባለሙያዎች ማስተባበር

ተፈላጊ ልዩ ችሎታዎች

* ከፍተኛ የሆነ የኮምፒውተር አጠቃቀም ችሎታ

* የኦንላይን እና ኦፍለይን ሶፍትዎሮችን መጠቀም የሚችል

* ከፍተኛ የሆነ የአዶቤ ፎቶሾፕ አጠቃቀም ችሎታ

* አስደናቂ የካሜራ አጠቃቀም ችሎታ

title: Hotel/Restaurant Experienced Senior Finance Officer
description: Job Summary Note: This position is strictly for candidates with experience in the hospitality industry (hotels/restaurants). Applications from other sectors will not be considered. The role involves managing daily financial operations, ensuring accurate reporting, and providing timely insights to support management decisions. Responsibilities: Prepare and deliver detailed daily sales, cost, and expense reports for all restaurant or hotel outlets. Prepare and present accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to senior management and stakeholders, ensuring compliance with accounting and regulatory standards. Oversee and verify general sales records and reports for accuracy and adherence to financial policies. Manage month-end and year-end closing processes efficiently. Reconcile shareholders’ account balances and ensure timely tracking of all related transactions. Requirements: BSc or MSc in Accounting, Finance, or related field. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in finance or accounting within hotels or restaurants — hospitality experience is mandatory. Strong knowledge of financial statements, general ledger management, and reconciliations. Proficiency in Peachtree, SAP, or Oracle, and advanced Excel (pivot tables, formulas, financial modeling). Familiarity with inventory management and POS system integration in a restaurant or hotel setting. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

title: HR Manager
description:
Position Summary

AKOYA Properties is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior HR Manager with strong leadership capabilities and proven expertise in the real estate sector. The ideal candidate will manage the full spectrum of HR operations, support organizational growth, and ensure that the company attracts, develops, and retains top talent. This role requires a proactive leader who understands the fast-paced nature of real estate sales, projects, operations, and workforce management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic HR Leadership

Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the company’s business objectives.
Act as a key advisor to senior management on organizational structure, workforce planning, and talent development.
Lead HR initiatives that support rapid growth and departmental expansion.
2. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

Lead end-to-end recruitment for sales teams, project staff, engineers, marketing, and administrative positions.
Design recruitment strategies tailored to the real estate industry’s needs.
Build a strong talent pipeline and maintain relationships with external recruitment partners.
3. Performance & Productivity Management

Establish real estate–aligned KPIs and performance evaluation systems.
Guide department heads in implementing performance improvement plans.
Create incentive structures for sales teams in coordination with management.
4. Employee Relations & Workplace Culture

Handle complex employee relations issues with fairness and professionalism.
Promote a positive, disciplined, and productive work environment.
Resolve disputes and ensure compliance with company culture and conduct.
5. Compensation, Benefits & Payroll Coordination

Review and update salary scales, commission structures, and benefit packages.
Ensure fair and competitive compensation aligned with industry standards.
Oversee attendance management, leave tracking, and payroll coordination.
6. Training & Staff Development

Design training programs for sales techniques, customer handling, project management, and compliance.
Identify skills gaps and organize targeted learning programs.
Develop leadership training for supervisors and managers.
7. HR Policy, Compliance & Documentation

Create, update, and enforce HR policies in line with Ethiopian labor laws.
Ensure proper documentation for contracts, warnings, evaluations, and terminations.
Manage disciplinary actions professionally and lawfully.
Qualifications & Experience Required

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in HR Management, Business Administration, Management, or related field.
Minimum 7–10 years of HR experience, at least 4 years in a managerial or senior HR role, preferably in real estate, construction, or property development.
Strong understanding of sales-driven organizational structures and commission-based roles.
Excellent knowledge of Ethiopian labor laws and HR compliance.
Proven experience handling high-volume recruitment, employee relations, and performance management.
Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
Proficiency in HR software, MS Office, and HR analytics.
Preferred Competencies

Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.
High emotional intelligence and integrity.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Strategic mindset with hands-on operational capability.
Real estate industry experience is highly preferred.

title: የሹፌር ባለሙያ
description:
በድጋሚ የወጣ የሥራ ማስታወቂያ

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ ፡-

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን ቀልጣፋ፣ የሥራ ተነሳሽነት ያለውና በጥንቃቄ  በኃላፊነት በማጓጓዝ የስራ ቁሳቁሶችን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ የሚያደርስ ብቁ የሹፌር ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡

መስፈርቶች፡

=> ሕጋዊ የሆነ እና የታደሰ /የሚሰራ/ መንጃ ፍቃድ ያለው።

=> መንጃ ፈቃዱ ከታደሰ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት  ያለው ከዚያ በላይ የሆነ፡፡

=> አዲስ አበባን እና አካቢዎቿን በሚገባ መንገድ የሚያውቅ  መሆን አለበት፡፡

=> የትራፊክ ህጎች እና የከተማ መንገዶች የማሽከርከር እውቀት ያለው።

=> ጥንቃቄ በተሞላበት በተሰጠው የመንገድ ህገ ደንብ የመንገድ ፍጥነት መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

=> ከሰው ጋር ጥሩ መግባባትና  የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ችሎታ ያለው።

=> ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው በራሱ የሚተማመን ፣ ደህንነቱን የጠበቀ አነዳድ የሚከተል፡፡

=> ታማኝ፣ የድርጅቱን ሰዓት የሚያከብር።

=> አመልካች ሰፈሩ  ጉርድ ሾላ፣ ገርጂ  አቅራቢያ ወይም ያልራቀ ቢሆን ይመረጣል፡፡

=> እድሜው ከ25-30 ክልል ውስጥ የሆነ፡፡

=> ማስታወቂያ ቤት የሰራ / የማስታወቂያ ሥራ በቂ ዕውቀት ያለው መሆን አለት፡፡

=> አውቶማቲክ ሆነ ማንዋልም  የመኪና /ማርሽ/  በሚገባ መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

የሥራ ዓይነት:- የሙሉ ጊዜ

ደመወዝ:-  ወርሃዊ

እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል፡-

·      አመልካቾች የት/ት ማስረጃ፣ የሥራ ልምድ እና የታደሰ መንጃ ፈቃድ ኮፒውን በአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን በአካል ም ሆነ በቴሌግራም ማቅረብም ሆነ መላክ ይችላሉ፡፡

·      እንዲሁም  ቅጥር  ሲፈፀም  በቂ የዋስ አይነት ማቅረብ የምትችሉ እና ከመንግስት መስራያ ቤት ዋስ/ተያዥ ማቅረብ  እችላለሁ የምትሉ  ብቻ   በዚህ ማስታወቂያ ማመልከት ትችላላችሁ፡የስራ አድራሻ፡-

• አዲስ አበባ አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ጉርድ ሾላ - ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  በትራፊክ መብራት  አካባቢ፣  ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ ላይ እንገኛለን፡፡  ለዚህ ማስታወቂያ ከረቡዕ ቀን  10/03/2018 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ እስከ ቅዳሜ 13/03/2018 ድረስ የምንቀበል ይሆናል፡፡

title: iOS Developer
description:
Job Title: iOS Developer (Intermediate to Senior)

Company: Fusion X

Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: Negotiable

About the Company

Fusion X is an innovative technology company committed to building high-quality, scalable, and

user-centered digital solutions. We are expanding our mobile development team and are looking

for a skilled iOS Developer who is passionate about delivering exceptional mobile experiences

using the latest Apple technologies.

Role Overview

The iOS Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining iOS

applications from concept to deployment. You will collaborate closely with designers, backend

engineers, and product teams to build robust, efficient, and visually engaging applications.

Key Responsibilities

● Design and build advanced applications for the iOS platform.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.

● Ensure performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.

● Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs to improve application performance.

● Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximize

development efficiency.

● Participate in code reviews, maintain coding standards, and contribute to knowledge

sharing.

Required Qualifications

● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

● 3+ years of professional experience in iOS application development.

● Strong proficiency in Swift and good understanding of Objective-C.

● Solid understanding of iOS frameworks such as UIKit, SwiftUI, Core Data, and Combine.

● Experience with modern architecture patterns such as MVVM, VIPER, or Clean

Architecture.

● Familiarity with RESTful APIs and JSON for data integration.

● Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.

● Knowledge of dependency management tools such as Swift Package Manager or

CocoaPods.

● Familiarity with Xcode, Instruments, and debugging tools.

● Understanding of Apple’s design principles and Human Interface Guidelines.

● Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Bitrise

Preferred Skills

● Experience with SwiftUI for declarative UI development.

● Knowledge of GraphQL APIs.

● Experience publishing and maintaining apps on the App Store.

● Familiarity with cloud services (Firebase, AWS, or similar).

● Experience with unit testing and UI testing frameworks (XCTest, Quick/Nimble).

What We Offer

● Competitive and negotiable salary based on experience.

● Opportunity to work with the latest Apple technologies.

● Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.

● Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their CV and portfolio (if available) to

kirubeltolla@gmail.com with the subject line “iOS Developer – Fusion X”.

Application Deadline: Open until filled

title: Analyst, Operational Risk and Compliance
description:
The role is part of a group-wide organization focused on identifying, coordinating, and managing risks and compliance weaknesses (1st Line of Defense). This position is required to support the Manager, Operational Risk and Compliance, to prevent significant reputational, financial, or other losses to the company and its clients.

2. Key Outputs and Responsibilities

Client/Compliance Focus

Monitor and report on compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements.
Assist in identifying, analyzing, and prioritizing regulatory requirements.
Support the implementation and monitor the execution of compliance procedures and controls.
Assist with ad hoc critical/significant risk investigations/projects.
Monitor and review risk incidents, breaches, and findings for reporting.
Review and monitor all frameworks, policies, standards, processes, and procedures.
People/Culture Focus

Embed company's culture, organizational values, and expected behaviors.
Develop strong relationships with key functions (Internal Audit, Risk, IT, etc.).
Support the Manager, Compliance, by driving awareness and knowledge growth.
Risk and Process Focus

Support the Manager with the execution of fit-for-purpose Risk and Compliance Management best practices.
Perform and coordinate assessments using the established risk management framework.
Proactively review and validate the adequacy and effectiveness of controls.
Support the execution of independent root-cause analysis on material incidents.
Support Business Resilience capability (Business Continuity Plan/BCP).
Financial Management

Ensure the documented Business Continuity Plan (BCP) is complete and comprehensive.
Monitor and review periodic BCP tests and report on business line continuity health.
Identify improvement opportunities to increase revenue or reduce operating costs.
Be cost-conscious while keeping company’s best interests at heart.
3. Skills and Competencies

The role requires a strong focus on:

Providing Insights (on impacts to the organization).
Checking Details (accuracy, thoroughness).
Upholding Standards (high quality, strong work ethic).
Purposeful Collaboration (leveraging dependencies, building cross-functional teams).
Risk/Reward Thinking (considering risks, rewards, and cost of controls).
Risk Identification, Operational Planning, and Evaluating Compliance Risk Management Effectiveness.
4. Experience, Knowledge, and Qualifications

Education (Minimum Required)

BA degree in Law, Business Administration, or related fields.
Professional qualifications in risk, compliance, and/or business resilience (CISA/CISM/CRISC) are advantageous.
Experience (Minimum Required)

Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in the business industry, preferably including the financial and payment services industry.
Preferred focus on the development or implementation of risk management programs.
Meeting the competence and experience requirements for registration as a Compliance Officer with the Financial Sector Conduct Authority is highly advantageous.
Compliance experience within a call center environment is advantageous.
Core Abilities

Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work with minimal supervision, exercise good judgment, and prioritize work in a changeable environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).

title: Head, Market Development Division
description:
Job summary

The Head, Market Development, under the overall leadership of the Department Manager, is responsible for the overall planning, leadership, management and supervision of the Market Development functions. Also, he/she assists same in the maintenance of appropriate Market Research and Development records and preparation of Market Research and Development reports.

Roles and Responsibilities

1.     Plan, manage and evaluate marketing research and development operations in the company liaising the internal users of marketing research.

2.     Prepares and implements best practice marketing research and development principles, policies and process in the company.

3.     Identifies and defines the objective of an assigned marketing research project; determines the best methods to use to meet those objectives.

4.     Drafts questionnaires, polls, surveys, and other data collection resources.

5.     Researches and compiles data related to current product market, customer demographics and interest, and factors influencing product demand; analyzes results to identify ways of maximizing sales and market penetration of current products.

6.     Compiles data related to competitors products such as pricing, sales, and marketing or distribution methodology.

7.     Summarizes and analyzes data; makes recommendations related to research findings.

8.     Reports findings, complete with graphs illustrating data and written text explaining complex findings.

9.     Identifies potential new products or markets through research.

10.  Forecasts and tracks industry marketing and sales trends based on collected data.

11.  Delivers reports and presentations of findings to management.

Position Requirement

2.1  Academic requirement: MA/MSC/BSC/BA in Marketing/Management/ Economics or related fields.

2.2  Work experience: 6/8 years’ experience in designing and processing effective Market Research and Development system in large business entities with trading, agricultural, and transport sector involvement is advantageous. Extensive knowledge and experience in preparing Market Research and Development manuals, systems, policies and standards is a benefit.

Desirable training: Market Research and Development tools like Market Research Management, Market development strategies, SPSS, ERP, MS Office, etc.

Qualified applicants are invited to submit their application letter, curriculum vitae with names and contact address of three references and copy of non-returnable supporting documents within 10(Ten) consecutive working days work place ADDIS ABABA office address Bole Sure Construction Floor 12 email address  hr@tekhaftrading.com or  careers@tekhaftrading.com telephone +251-930-29-49-23

title: Head, Sales Division
description:
Job summary

The Head, Sales Division, under the overall leadership of the Manager, is responsible for the overall planning, leadership, management and supervision of the Sales & Distribution functions throughout the company. Also, he/she assists same in the maintenance of appropriate Sales & Distribution records and preparation of Sales & Distribution reports.

Roles and Responsibilities

1.       Plans, organizes, leads, directs and controls all the local sales operations of the company.

2.       Develops specific sales and customer service plans, and controls its implementations to ensure that the profit maximization goal of company is met.

3.       Formulates and implements all sales policies, practices and procedures.

4.       Accurately forecasts annual, quarterly and monthly revenue streams.

5.       Plans, coordinates, and monitors the sales targets of the company.

6.       Interprets short- and long-term effects on sales strategies in operating profit.

7.       Holds regular meeting with sales & customer service staff and strongly works for their motivation.

8.       Undertakes marketing audits to monitor sales performance.

9.       Supervises all sales branches and offices.

10.    Manages sales contracts.

11.    Develops customer relationships strategies to attract and retain customers.

12.    Evaluates the performances of the staffs in the various sales units according to company’s policy.

13.    Implements the company’s after sales services policies and procedures.

14.    Assigns, supervises, and motivates sales & distribution staff of the company for better sales performance

15.    Ensures proper collection of sales receipts from customers

16.    Builds/maintains strong distribution network through close relationship with wholesalers and retailers

17.    helps in identifying potential markets and new demand in existing markets

18.    Implements customer relationships tools to attract and retain customers.

19.    Generates periodic reports about its division & presents to the department director.

Position Requirement

1.1  Academic requirement: MA/MSC/ BSC/BA in Marketing Management or related fields.

1.2  Work experience: 6/8 years’ experience in designing and processing effective domestic sales and product distribution system in large corporate entities with trading, agricultural, and transport sector involvement is advantageous. Extensive knowledge and experience in preparing sales and product distribution manuals, systems, policies and standards is a benefit.

1.3   Desirable training: Sales and distribution management tools like Personal selling, Sales process, ERP, MS Office, etc.

Qualified applicants are invited to submit their application letter, curriculum vitae with names and contact address of three references and copy of non-returnable supporting documents within 10(Ten) consecutive working days work place ADDIS ABABA office address Bole Sure Construction Floor 12 email address  hr@tekhaftrading.com or  careers@tekhaftrading.com telephone +251-930-29-49-23

Dynamic work environment within a fast-growing renewable energy company.

title: Junior Showroom Assistant
description:
Junior Showroom Assistant

Department: Sales & Marketing

Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Type of Employment: Full-Time

Reports to: Direct Sales Team Lead

About Dodai:

 

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making urban e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025.

Purpose of the Position:

We are looking for a friendly and professional Junior Showroom Assistant  to join our team and be the first point of contact for our valued customers. You will play a vital role in creating a welcoming and informative environment for visitors, while providing administrative support to ensure the showroom runs smoothly.

Responsibilities:

Professional Visitor Engagement and Management:

Welcome all visitors with professionalism and warmth, ensuring a positive first impression of the showroom.
Understand the needs of each visitor to accurately direct them to the appropriate salesperson or department, optimizing the customer journey and efficiency.
Communication Handling:

Answer and manage incoming calls with courtesy, directing queries and messages accurately to ensure smooth communication and operations.
Stay informed about current campaigns, volume discounts, and promotional conditions to accurately respond to customer inquiries about products, providing accurate information to assist their buying decisions.
Continuously update and maintain comprehensive knowledge of all products, including details, specifications, and benefits.
Showroom Maintenance:

Ensure the reception and showroom areas are clean, organized, and visually appealing, maintaining an environment that reflects the brand’s standards.
Keep promotional materials and brochures well-stocked and accessible to visitors, supporting marketing efforts.
Follow up with different payments that need to be made regarding the showroom
Administrative and Sales Support:

Schedule appointments and manage the showroom calendar to optimize the time of sales personnel, enhancing operational flow.
Assist in the processing of essential documentation, such as agreements and customer information forms, ensuring accuracy and compliance with procedures.
Support the sales team with various administrative tasks, including data entry and preparation of sales documentation, to enhance the efficiency of sales operations.
Gain a thorough understanding of the sales process to better support sales activities and customer engagement.
Based on request and direction form line manager visit different offices to run errands and complete necessary tasks
Financial Transactions:

Handle transactions using the cash register, ensuring accuracy in the receipt and processing of payments.
Handle monthly showroom petty cashes according to petty cash policy
Digital Record Keeping:

Diligently record all customer engagements on the internal digital platform, ensuring that data is accurate and up-to-date for seamless follow-up and analysis.
Managerial Direction:

Perform additional tasks and responsibilities as directed by the manager to meet evolving business needs and support showroom operations.
Qualifications:

Degree in any field.
Minimum of 6 months -1 year of experience in a customer service or reception role IS MUST (retail experience a plus).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with people from diverse backgrounds.
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and multitask effectively.
Able to operate a cash register machine
Proficient in computer use (Word, Excel, Google applications).
A positive and professional demeanor with a focus on exceeding customer expectations.

title: የፅዳት እና የቢሮ ረዳት ሰራተኛ
description:

ቦታ: አዲስ አበባ,CMC Michael

ትምህርት: ዲፕሎማ ቢያንስ

እድሜ ተሞክሮ: 1 ዓመት የሚመረጥ

 

ንፁህነት ባለሙያና የቢሮ ረዳት ቢሮውን ንፁህ፣ ተደራሽ እና ደስተኛ ሁኔታ ለመጠበቅ እንዲሁም ቀላል ስራዎችና የውጭ ተግባራትን ለመፈጸም ይመደባል።

 

ዋና የስራ ተግባሮች

* ቢሮውን እና አጠቃላይ ቦታዎችን ማጽዳትና መጠበቅ

* ዕለታዊ መቆረጥ፣ መታጠብ፣ መንጻት፣ ቆሻሻ መውሰድ

* የደረሰኞችን፣ የቢሮ ዕቃዎችን እና የስብሰባ ክፍሎችን ተደራሽ መጠበቅ

* ለሰራተኞችና ለእንግዶች ቡና፣ ሻይ እና ውሃ ማቅረብ

* ወደ ባንክ መሄድ እና ቀላል የውጭ ተግባራት መፈጸም

* መሰረታዊ የኮምፒውተር ችሎታዎች (ትይፒንግ፣ ፕሪንቲንግ፣ ስካኒንግ፣ ፋይል ማደራጀት)

* የጥገና ችግር በቅድሚያ ለሰራተኛ መሪ ወይም ለሀላፊ ማሳወቅ

* የቢሮ እቃዎችን ማስተካከልና የሰነዶች ማዘጋጀት ላይ ማገዝ የምትችል

 

ስልጣናት & ችሎታዎች

* የንፁህነትና የጤና መደበኛ መርሀ ግብር

* ጊዜ አስተዳደርና ታማኝነት

* በቡድን ወይም ብቻ መስራት የሚችል

* ከሰራተኞችና ከእንግዶች ጋር ተስማሚ ባህሪ

* ቀላል የኮምፒውተር ችሎታዎች
