title: Junior Assembly Technician
description:
Junior Assembly Technician

Type of Employment:

Location: Addis Ababa

Reports to: Manufacturing Supervisor

About Dodai

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2024. It’s thus looking to engage dynamic Ethiopian talent to ensure the achievement of its goals.

Purpose of the Position

The Junior Assembly Technician for Dodai will be part of the manufacturing team and will be responsible for the assembly of electric two wheelers (E2W) in an efficient manner.

S/he will be responsible to construct the small parts and components that make up the E2W to create a new product according to the specifications provided by the Factory Operations Manager.

Key Responsibilities

Perform complex and advanced assembly of products according to established specifications and instructions.
Perform high precision calibration and advanced adjustments using testing instruments.
Develop assembly and test procedures to promote production of quality products.
Ensure optimal performance and longevity of assembly equipment by conducting regular maintenance and servicing, while closely monitoring all equipment functionality and promptly reporting any issues or substandard conditions to the supervisor.
Ensure all registration documents of E2W are maintained according to standard operating procedures.
Perform equipment assembly according to engineering drawings.
Perform cleaning of all parts as per established cleaning procedures.
Provide support for material handling and material movement activities with the warehouse team.
Work together with the quality assurance team to detect and resolve any product defects or issues during the assembly process, conduct testing on products for performance evaluation, and document the outcomes.
Perform final checks and adjustments for any defects to ensure high quality products.
Perform installation, rework, inspection, reassembly, replacing, refitting, and adjusting products as required.
Receive, unload, unpack and transfer materials to different work stations.
Assist supervisor during emergency situations such as fire, natural disasters etc.
Support the implementation of health and safety initiatives in the manufacturing facility to maintain a safe working environment for all employees.
Provide input and feedback on product design and assembly procedures to improve overall product quality and customer satisfaction.
Participate in continuous training and development programs to enhance technical skills and knowledge related to electric two-wheeler assembly
Assist in the development and implementation of new assembly processes and techniques to improve efficiency and productivity.
Requirement

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or closely related fields or TVET graduate in relevant field
6 months to 1 year experience working in a factory setting with similar products (E2W, E3W etc.),
Sound knowledge of industry-specific factory equipment.
Preferably proficient in basic Microsoft Office applications.
The ability to multitask.
Outstanding time management skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication skills.

title: Cashier
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Financial Cashier & Accounting Support Specialist to manage all front-line financial transactions while providing essential support to our Accounting Department. This role requires a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting and a minimum of one (1) year of professional experience. The ideal candidate will combine exceptional cash-handling accuracy with a strong knowledge of fundamental accounting principles, internal controls, and financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Cash Handling & Transaction Management:

Accurately process all customer financial transactions (cash, credit/debit cards, checks, vouchers) using the Point of Sale (POS) system.
Execute complex transactions including refunds, exchanges, discounts, and voids with strict adherence to company policy.
Maintain an organized and secure cash drawer, ensuring proper change limits and minimizing shrinkage.
Financial Reconciliation & Reporting (Accounting Focus):

Perform comprehensive daily cash reconciliations, comparing POS receipts to actual cash on hand and preparing detailed reports of daily sales.
Identify, investigate, and document all discrepancies (overages and shortages), escalating significant issues to the Accounting Manager immediately.
Assist the Accounting Department with end-of-day/end-of-month financial closing procedures and data compilation.
Ensure strict compliance with all internal financial controls and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Customer Service & Operations:

Provide prompt, friendly, and professional customer service during the checkout process.
Address and resolve customer inquiries related to payments, billing, and transaction details.
Maintain the cleanliness, organization, and efficient operation of the checkout area.
Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance is MANDATORY.
Experience: Minimum of one (1) year of proven professional experience in a Cashier, Financial Clerk, or similar role requiring cash reconciliation duties.
Technical Proficiency:

Expertise in Point of Sale (POS) system operation.
Intermediate to advanced skill level in Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, formulas) for data compilation and reporting.
Familiarity with standard accounting software
Applicants should submit proof of education, CV, cover letter and other required documents within the application period.

Application Time: 5–10 days (only

Job Location: Wello Sefer , Addis Ababa

title: ብየዳ ቴክኒሽያን (Welding Technician)
description:
ድርጅታችን በአስቸኳይ አራት (4) ልምድ ያላቸውን የብየዳ ቴክኒሽያን በቋሚነት መቅጠር ይፈልጋል። ተቀጣሪዎች የተለያዩ የብረታ ብረት ዓይነቶችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን በመጠቀም ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው ብየዳ ሥራ የማከናወን ሃላፊነት አለባቸው።

የሥራ ኃላፊነቶች

በተሰጠው የምህንድስና ስዕል (Blueprints/Schematics) እና መስፈርት መሠረት የተለያዩ የብየዳ ሥራዎችን (እንደ Arc፣ MIG፣ TIG ወይም Spot Welding) ማከናወን።
ብየዳ ከመጀመሩ በፊት የብረት ክፍሎችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን በትክክል መቁረጥ፣ ማዘጋጀት እና ማስተካከል (fitting)።
የብየዳ መሳሪያዎችን ደህንነታቸውን እና ብቃታቸውን በመጠበቅ መሥራት፣ አዘውትሮ ማፅዳትና መፈተሽ።
የተጠናቀቁትን ብየዳዎች ጥራት እና ጥንካሬ ማረጋገጥ።
የሥራ ቦታ ደህንነት ደንቦችን እና የአሠራር ሥርዓቶችን በጥብቅ መከተል።
የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች

ልምድ: በብየዳ ቴክኒሽያንነት ወይም በተመሳሳይ ሙያ ቢያንስ አንድ (1) ዓመት የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ያላት።
ትምህርት: በብየዳ፣ በብረታ ብረት ሥራ (Metal Fabrication) ወይም በተመሳሳይ መስክ ዲፕሎማ ወይም የሙያ ብቃት ማረጋገጫ (COC) ያለው/ያላት።
ክህሎት:

የተለያዩ የብየዳ ዓይነቶችን (MIG, TIG, Arc) የመሥራት ብቃት።
የምህንድስና ስዕሎችን (Blueprints) የማንበብ እና የመተርጎም ችሎታ።
ትኩረት ሰጥቶ እና በንፅህና የመሥራት ልምድ።
አመልካቾች የትምህርት ማስረጃቸውን፣ ሙሉ የሥራ ልምድ ማኅደር (CV)፣ የአብሮ ማመልከቻ ደብዳቤ (Cover Letter) እና ሌሎች አስፈላጊ ሰነዶችን በተጠቀሰው የማመልከቻ ጊዜ ውስጥ ማቅረብ አለባቸው።

የማመልከቻ ጊዜ: ከ 5 እስከ 10 ቀናት
የሥራ ቦታ: ወሎ ሰፈር፣ አዲስ አበባ

title: Analyst, Operational Risk and Compliance
description:
The role is part of a group-wide organization focused on identifying, coordinating, and managing risks and compliance weaknesses (1st Line of Defense). This position is required to support the Manager, Operational Risk and Compliance, to prevent significant reputational, financial, or other losses to the company and its clients.

2. Key Outputs and Responsibilities

Client/Compliance Focus

Monitor and report on compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements.
Assist in identifying, analyzing, and prioritizing regulatory requirements.
Support the implementation and monitor the execution of compliance procedures and controls.
Assist with ad hoc critical/significant risk investigations/projects.
Monitor and review risk incidents, breaches, and findings for reporting.
Review and monitor all frameworks, policies, standards, processes, and procedures.
People/Culture Focus

Embed company's culture, organizational values, and expected behaviors.
Develop strong relationships with key functions (Internal Audit, Risk, IT, etc.).
Support the Manager, Compliance, by driving awareness and knowledge growth.
Risk and Process Focus

Support the Manager with the execution of fit-for-purpose Risk and Compliance Management best practices.
Perform and coordinate assessments using the established risk management framework.
Proactively review and validate the adequacy and effectiveness of controls.
Support the execution of independent root-cause analysis on material incidents.
Support Business Resilience capability (Business Continuity Plan/BCP).
Financial Management

Ensure the documented Business Continuity Plan (BCP) is complete and comprehensive.
Monitor and review periodic BCP tests and report on business line continuity health.
Identify improvement opportunities to increase revenue or reduce operating costs.
Be cost-conscious while keeping company’s best interests at heart.
3. Skills and Competencies

The role requires a strong focus on:

Providing Insights (on impacts to the organization).
Checking Details (accuracy, thoroughness).
Upholding Standards (high quality, strong work ethic).
Purposeful Collaboration (leveraging dependencies, building cross-functional teams).
Risk/Reward Thinking (considering risks, rewards, and cost of controls).
Risk Identification, Operational Planning, and Evaluating Compliance Risk Management Effectiveness.
4. Experience, Knowledge, and Qualifications

Education (Minimum Required)

BA degree in Law, Business Administration, or related fields.
Professional qualifications in risk, compliance, and/or business resilience (CISA/CISM/CRISC) are advantageous.
Experience (Minimum Required)

Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in the business industry, preferably including the financial and payment services industry.
Preferred focus on the development or implementation of risk management programs.
Meeting the competence and experience requirements for registration as a Compliance Officer with the Financial Sector Conduct Authority is highly advantageous.
Compliance experience within a call center environment is advantageous.
Core Abilities

Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work with minimal supervision, exercise good judgment, and prioritize work in a changeable environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Accounts Officer is responsible for managing the financial operations of the retail shop, ensuring accurate accounting records, preparing financial reports, and supporting management with timely financial insights for decision-making

Key Responsibilities

1. Cash Collection:

Receiving payments from customers or clients for services or goods rendered.

Methods of cash collection may include cash, check, or digital payments (e.g. via online banking, mobile apps).

Tracking the status of payments, ensuring amounts are correct, and documenting the receipts.

2. Receivables:

The amounts of money owed by customers or clients for goods or services provided on credit.

It involves managing and tracking outstanding invoices, ensuring timely collection, and addressing overdue payments.

Sometimes includes the use of aging reports, follow-up strategies, and coordination with collection teams.

3. Bank Reconciliation:

The process of comparing the company’s financial records (e.g., cash book) with the bank’s records (bank statements) to ensure accuracy.

It helps identify any discrepancies, such as unrecorded bank fees, errors in the company’s books, or pending transactions.

The goal is to reconcile the company’s bank account to match the correct balance by the end of the reconciliation period.

Oversee daily accounting activities (sales, purchases, expenses, cash, and bank).

Prepare monthly financial statements (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow).

Monitor accounts receivable and accounts payable.

Ensure accurate posting of transactions into the accounting system.

Reconcile Bank statements and cash accounts.

Review and verify invoices, receipts, and payment vouchers.

Manage payroll preparation and statutory payments.

Ensure compliance with tax laws (VAT, TIN, Withholding Tax, etc.).

Assist in budgeting, forecasting, and cost analysis.

Supervise junior accountants and provide guidance.

Conduct periodic inventory audits with the store team.

Support external audits and prepare necessary documentation.

 

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

4–6 years of accounting experience, preferably in retail.

Strong understanding of accounting principles and tax regulations.

Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., Peachtree, ERP systems).

Excellent analytical and reporting skills.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

title: የልብስ ማጠቢያ ሠራተኛ (Laundry Attendant)
description:
ኒውሊፍ ሜዲካል ፕላዛ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ የላቀ የህክምና አገልግሎቶችን በአንድ ጣራ ሥር ያሰባሰበ፣ ቀዳሚ እና ዘመናዊ የህክምና ማዕከል ለመሆን ነው። ይህ ማዕከል እጅግ በጣም የላቁ የህክምና ቴክኖሎጂዎችን፣ ዘመናዊ መገልገያዎችን እና ከፍተኛ ልምድ ያላቸው ባለሙያዎችን በማጣመር፣ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ፣ አስተማማኝ እና ታካሚን ያማከለ የጤና አገልግሎት ለመስጠት ታስቦ የተቋቋመ የልህቀት ማዕከል ሲሆን በቅርቡ አገልግሎት መስጠት ይጀምራል።

የስራ መደቡ ኃላፊነቶችና ግዴታዎች (ዋና ዋናዎቹ):

የልብስ አሰባሰብና ምደባ፡ ከተለያዩ ክፍሎች (አልጋዎች፣ ላብራቶሪዎች፣ የጽዳት ክፍሎች) የሚመጡ ቆሻሻ ልብሶችን በደረጃቸውና በዓይነታቸው መሠረት መለየትና በአግባቡ መሰብሰብ።
ማጠብና ማድረቅ፡ የህክምና መስፈርቶችንና የንጽህና አጠባበቅ ደረጃዎችን ተከትሎ ልብሶችን በኃላፊነት ስሜት ማጠብ፣ ማድረቅ እና በፀረ-ተባይ መድኃኒት መበከል (Disinfection)።
ተኩሶ ማዘጋጀት፡ የታጠቡ ልብሶችንና ጨርቆችን በሚፈለገው ጥራት ብረት መተኮስ፣ ማጠፍ እና ለአገልግሎት በሚመች መልኩ ማደራጀት።
የእቃ ቁጥጥር፡ የልብስ ማጠቢያ ቁሳቁሶች (ሳሙና፣ ፀረ-ተባይ መድኃኒት፣ ወዘተ) ሁልጊዜም በበቂ ሁኔታ መኖራቸውን መከታተል።
የማሽን ንፅህና፡ የልብስ ማጠቢያ ማሽኖችንና ሌሎች መሳሪያዎችን በአግባቡ መንከባከብ እና የልብስ ማጠቢያ ክፍሉን ንጹህና ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እንዲሆን ማድረግ።
ተፈላጊ የትምህርት ዝግጅትና ልምድ:

የትምህርት ደረጃ፡ 10ኛ ክፍል ወይም ከዛ በላይ የትምህርት ደረጃ ያለው/ያላት።
ልምድ፡ በሆስፒታል፣ በጤና ተቋም ወይም በትልቅ ሆቴል ውስጥ በልብስ ማጠብ (Laundry) ሥራ ላይ ቢያንስ አንድ (1) ዓመት የሰራ/ች።
ተጨማሪ ችሎታ፡ የልብስ ማጠቢያ ማሽንና የብረት መምቻ መሳሪያዎችን በአግባቡ የመጠቀም ችሎታ ያለው/ያላት። የንጽህናና የደህንነት አጠባበቅ ደንቦችን የመረዳትና የመተግበር ፍላጎት።
የቅጥር ሁኔታ:

ደመወዝ፡ በፕላዛው የደመወዝ ስኬል መሠረት።
የሥራ ቦታ፡ ኒውሊፍ ሜዲካል ፕላዛ፣ አዲስ አበባ ለቡ አካባቢ።
ማመልከቻ የሚቀርብበት መንገድ፡

title: HR Officer
description:
About Evtopia Hub

Evtopia Hub is Ethiopia’s emerging leader in electric vehicle (EV) innovation, smart mobility services, and advanced automotive maintenance. As we continue to expand our operations and build the nation’s smartest EV + ICE repair and maintenance ecosystem, we are looking for a dedicated and proactive HR Officer to join our growing team.

 

Key Responsibilities

The HR Officer will play a vital role in building a strong team and supporting a professional, productive work environment. Core duties include:

• Recruit, shortlist, and onboard new employees.

• Maintain accurate HR records, contracts, and documentation.

• Manage attendance, leave, and ensure compliance with labor laws.

• Support performance evaluations and handle employee concerns professionally.

• Coordinate training and development programs.

• Act as a link between employees and management to ensure clear communication, timely issue resolution, and smooth workflow across the hub.

• Support operational efficiency by managing staff schedules and ensuring each department has the manpower needed for daily operations.

• Promote a positive workplace culture and support disciplinary processes when necessary.

• Prepare HR reports and maintain updated HR databases.

 

Required Qualifications

• BA degree in Human Resource Management, Management, Business Administration, or related field

• Minimum 3 years of experience as an HR Officer or related role

• Strong knowledge of Ethiopian labor law

• Good communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

• Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism

 

Preferred Skills

• Experience working in automotive, service, or tech sectors is an advantage

• Ability to multitask and work under pressure

• Strong problem-solving and people-management abilities

• Attention to detail and proactive work ethic

 

How to Apply

Interested and qualified candidates are invited to send their CV, cover letter, and relevant documents to:

info@evtopia.co

Please use the subject line: “HR Officer – Evtopia Hub”

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Digital Marketing Officer
description:
Vacancy: Digital Marketing Officer

Sinopia operates across various sectors, establishing itself as one of the most respected players in Ethiopia and beyond. We provide water and power-related solutions, office solutions, and Construction lab solutions to our clients across all sectors while exporting high-quality Ethiopian Arabica Coffee to markets around the globe. Our commitment to quality and excellence drives us to build lasting relationships with our clients and partners.

Sinopia is looking for a self-driven digital marketer who can support our departments with consistent, effective marketing work, primarily digital marketing. You must be able to take initiative, plan, execute planned content, and react quickly when new needs come up.

What you will handle:

- Writing clear blog posts and social media content based on our marketing plan.

- Running ad-hoc campaigns whenever required.

- Creating both online and offline collateral for events and promotions.

- Coordinating with different departments to deliver timely, quality marketing output.

What we expect:

- Strong writing and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently without waiting for step-by-step guidance.

- Practical experience with social media, digital tools, and basic design.

- High sense of responsibility and ownership.

If you’re proactive and ready to contribute across the company, apply at https://sinopiaimpex.com/apply on or before 30 November. Only complete applications will be considered.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Job Title: Finance Manager

Job Summary

The Finance Manager oversees the financial health of the organization by managing financial planning, budgeting, reporting, and analysis. This role ensures compliance with financial regulations, supports strategic decision-making, and leads the finance team to maintain accurate and timely financial operations.

---

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis

Prepare annual budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial plans.

Analyze financial performance, variances, and trends to provide insights and recommendations.

Support strategic initiatives through financial modeling and scenario analysis.

Financial Reporting

Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

Ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting standards (GAAP/IFRS).

Present reports and insights to senior management.

Accounting & Operations

Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger functions.

Monitor cash flow, banking relationships, and liquidity management.

Ensure timely closing of financial periods.

Compliance & Controls

Maintain internal controls and ensure adherence to company policies.

Coordinate external and internal audits.

Ensure compliance with tax laws, regulatory requirements, and financial standards.

Leadership & Team Management

Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team.

Collaborate with cross-functional departments to support business operations.

Drive process improvements and automation within the finance function.

title: ብየዳ ቴክኒሽያን (Welding Technician)
description:
ድርጅታችን በአስቸኳይ አራት (4) ልምድ ያላቸውን የብየዳ ቴክኒሽያን በቋሚነት መቅጠር ይፈልጋል። ተቀጣሪዎች የተለያዩ የብረታ ብረት ዓይነቶችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን በመጠቀም ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው ብየዳ ሥራ የማከናወን ሃላፊነት አለባቸው።

የሥራ ኃላፊነቶች

በተሰጠው የምህንድስና ስዕል (Blueprints/Schematics) እና መስፈርት መሠረት የተለያዩ የብየዳ ሥራዎችን (እንደ Arc፣ MIG፣ TIG ወይም Spot Welding) ማከናወን።
ብየዳ ከመጀመሩ በፊት የብረት ክፍሎችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን በትክክል መቁረጥ፣ ማዘጋጀት እና ማስተካከል (fitting)።
የብየዳ መሳሪያዎችን ደህንነታቸውን እና ብቃታቸውን በመጠበቅ መሥራት፣ አዘውትሮ ማፅዳትና መፈተሽ።
የተጠናቀቁትን ብየዳዎች ጥራት እና ጥንካሬ ማረጋገጥ።
የሥራ ቦታ ደህንነት ደንቦችን እና የአሠራር ሥርዓቶችን በጥብቅ መከተል።
የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች

ልምድ: በብየዳ ቴክኒሽያንነት ወይም በተመሳሳይ ሙያ ቢያንስ አንድ (1) ዓመት የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ያላት።
ትምህርት: በብየዳ፣ በብረታ ብረት ሥራ (Metal Fabrication) ወይም በተመሳሳይ መስክ ዲፕሎማ ወይም የሙያ ብቃት ማረጋገጫ (COC) ያለው/ያላት።
ክህሎት:

የተለያዩ የብየዳ ዓይነቶችን (MIG, TIG, Arc) የመሥራት ብቃት።
የምህንድስና ስዕሎችን (Blueprints) የማንበብ እና የመተርጎም ችሎታ።
ትኩረት ሰጥቶ እና በንፅህና የመሥራት ልምድ።
አመልካቾች የትምህርት ማስረጃቸውን፣ ሙሉ የሥራ ልምድ ማኅደር (CV)፣ የአብሮ ማመልከቻ ደብዳቤ (Cover Letter) እና ሌሎች አስፈላጊ ሰነዶችን በተጠቀሰው የማመልከቻ ጊዜ ውስጥ ማቅረብ አለባቸው።

የማመልከቻ ጊዜ: ከ 5 እስከ 10 ቀናት
የሥራ ቦታ: ወሎ ሰፈር፣ አዲስ አበባ

title: Digital Marketing & Client Acquisition Manager
description:
About Revo Solutions

Revo Solutions is a full-service creative agency working with international and local clients to deliver high-quality digital solutions and creative production. We are looking for a dynamic leader who can elevate our digital presence and bring in high-value clients.

Website- revosolutionplc.com

Job Summary

The Digital Marketing & Client Acquisition Manager will be responsible for driving business growth by identifying target clients, executing outreach strategies, and converting leads into paying customers. The role requires strong leadership in digital marketing—especially TikTok—while managing and guiding the content and creative teams. This person will play a key role in shaping the marketing direction of Revo Solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Client Acquisition & Business Growth

Identify and segment potential clients (local & international) who need creative and digital solutions.
Create and execute client acquisition strategies via social media, email marketing, and direct outreach.
Build lead funnels and manage a structured client conversion pipeline.
Represent Revo Solutions professionally when communicating with potential clients.
Digital Marketing Leadership (TikTok-First Strategy)

Lead a TikTok-first marketing strategy for Revo Solutions’ brand.
Oversee creation of short-form video content that showcases the agency’s services, projects, and expertise.
Manage growth across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
Track analytics and optimize campaigns for reach, engagement, and conversions.
Creative Direction & Team Management

Supervise content creators, designers, and social media staff.
Ensure all marketing materials reflect Revo Solutions’ brand identity and quality.
Collaborate with the creative team to produce client acquisition campaigns.
Train the team on latest digital marketing trends and tools.
Marketing Strategy & Operations

Develop integrated marketing strategies for brand visibility and lead generation.
Oversee paid campaigns (Meta Ads, Google Ads).
Manage email marketing, SEO efforts, and website updates.
Prepare monthly reports showing lead growth, conversions, and ROI.
Required Qualifications

2–5 years digital marketing experience in an agency or service-based business.
Proven record of client acquisition or converting leads to paying customers.
Strong experience with TikTok content, trends, and advertising.
Excellent communication and sales skills.
Ability to lead and coordinate creative teams.
Experience with tools like Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, CRM software, etc.
Preferred Skills

Experience working with international clients.
Familiarity with creative agency workflows.
Understanding of design or video editing workflows (bonus).
Experience in B2B marketing.

title: Driver
description:
We are looking for a reliable Driver to join our team. The Driver will be responsible for delivering goods and transporting passengers to various destinations. The candidate must have a valid driver's license, excellent driving skills, and a good knowledge of traffic laws and safety regulations. In this position, the Driver will also be responsible for the upkeep and maintenance of vehicles in their care.

Responsibilities

·        Perform regular safety checks on vehicles to ensure they are in good working condition before and after each trip.

·        Transport goods and passengers to designated locations safely and on time.

·        Plan and follow the best route to ensure timely delivery of goods and passengers.

·        Ensure that all necessary paperwork and documentation are in order before transporting goods and passengers.

·        Adhere to traffic laws and safety regulations to avoid accidents or incidents.

·        Ensure the cleanliness and proper maintenance of vehicles under their care.

·        Handle customer grievances and other issues professionally and timely.

·        Report any incidents or accidents to the management immediately.

·        Participate in training and courses to stay abreast of developments in the transport industry.

Requirements

·        Proven work experience as a Driver or relevant role

·        Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

·        Good knowledge of traffic laws, safety regulations, and city routes

·        Ability to operate a range of vehicles, from small delivery vans to large trucks

·        Excellent driving skills and the ability to navigate unknown routes fluently

·        Excellent customer service skills

·        Good verbal and written communication skills

·        Attention to detail and ability to work independently and under pressure

·        Excellent time-management skills

·        Flexibility in working hours - the ability to work during weekends and evenings

·        Physical fitness to lift heavy goods when necessary

This position requires a candidate with a strong work ethic and a commitment to safety and professionalism. The Driver will be an essential part of our team, responsible for ensuring that goods and passengers are delivered to their destinations safely and efficiently. If you meet the above qualifications, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to join our team.

title: Laravel API Developer - AWS Expert
description:
We are seeking a Laravel and AWS Expert to architect, develop, and optimize high-performance backend systems.

 

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize scalable backend applications using Laravel and modern PHP best practices.
Architect and manage AWS cloud infrastructure, including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFormation, and CloudWatch.
Develop robust, high-performance APIs, implementing RESTful and microservices architectures.
Implement advanced authentication & authorization mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT, API tokens, role-based access control).
Enhance system security and performance, leveraging AWS security best practices, rate limiting, caching (Redis, Memcached), and logging strategies.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud-based applications, ensuring uptime, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
Lead infrastructure automation and CI/CD deployments, using AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, or Terraform.
Optimize database performance, ensuring efficient indexing, query performance tuning, and data security.
Develop and maintain API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including frontend, DevOps, and product teams, to deliver seamless solutions.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to developers, enforcing coding standards and architectural best practices.
Stay up to date with emerging AWS technologies and Laravel advancements, recommending improvements to existing infrastructure.
Requirements

5+ years of experience with Laravel and modern PHP frameworks.
Expert-level knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, and IAM.
Strong experience in scalable API development, microservices architecture, and API security best practices.
Proficiency in AWS networking, security groups, and IAM roles for managing secure access.
Experience with serverless architectures, AWS Lambda, and event-driven workflows.
Strong knowledge of caching strategies (Redis, Memcached) and API rate limiting.
Experience with database optimization, indexing, and query performance tuning.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, Terraform, or CloudFormation).
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex AWS infrastructure and backend issues.
Excellent communication skills and ability to lead projects and mentor junior developers.
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerized deployments.
Knowledge of GraphQL and WebSockets.
Familiarity with monitoring tools like New Relic, AWS CloudWatch, or Datadog.
Why Join Us?

Competitive salary & benefits.
Exciting opportunity to lead and shape AWS and Laravel infrastructure.
Collaborative and forward-thinking work environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.

title: Secretary & Receptionist (Female Applicants Only)
description:
Job Title: Secretary & Receptionist
Gross Monthly Salary: Based on the organization’s scale
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary: -We are looking for a dedicated and professional Secretary & Receptionist to support our office’s administrative, operational, and front-desk functions. This role requires strong communication, time management, and organizational skills to ensure the efficient day-to-day running of our office.

The successful candidate will be the first point of contact for visitors and clients, while also playing a key role in internal operations, document handling, and office coordination.

 

Responsibilities

Administrative & Operational Support

Manage calendars, appointments, and meeting schedules for staff and management.
Prepare, draft, and format official letters, reports, and internal documents.
Develop and maintain an organized filing and document management system (digital and physical).
Handle internal communications, such as distributing memos and company updates.
Assist with printing, scanning, photocopying, and basic office logistics.
Reception & Client Interaction

Greet and assist visitors and clients in a courteous and professional manner.
Answer, screen, and direct incoming phone calls appropriately.
Take and deliver accurate messages to relevant team members.
Maintain a tidy, welcoming, and professional reception area.
Data Entry & Records Management

Input and update data accurately into databases and filing systems.
Maintain up-to-date and accessible records for both administrative and operational use.
Assist in tracking and compiling data reports as needed.
Required Qualifications & Skills

Diploma or degree in Office Management, Business Administration, Secretarial Science, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in a secretarial or receptionist role.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and general computer use.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
Friendly, professional, and service-oriented attitude.
Ability to multitask and manage time efficiently.

title: 2D Motion Graphics Designer
description: Job Description 2D Motion Graphics Designer / Animated Video Content Creator We are looking for a talented, creative 2D Motion Graphics Designer & Animator specializing in short-form animated content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook. Your main responsibility will be to create: Primarily 2D flat motion graphics with a modern, minimalist aesthetic Simple yet highly expressive animations featuring our brand mascot (a cute, playful Fox character) Clean, centred, and uncluttered compositions – no unnecessary elements, strong focus on negative space and visual clarity Fast-paced yet smooth timing, perfect for short-form Bold typography, dynamic text reveals, and on-screen text animations that reinforce the message Trendy transitions, subtle particle effects, and satisfying micro-animations Content will be a mix of promotional, educational, entertaining, and viral-style videos for our brand. Skills & Requirements: Proven experience creating the exact flat 2D motion graphics style (mandatory – please include portfolio links or files) Expert in After Effects (must), familiar with Premiere Pro, Illustrator, and Photoshop Strong illustration skills – especially character animation (our Fox mascot must feel alive and expressive) Mastery of animation principles: timing, easing, anticipation, squash & stretch, even in minimalist style Ability to create smooth, professional animations at 60fps optimized for mobile viewing Excellent sense of typography, colour theory, and modern design trends Fast turnaround: able to produce 3–7 high-quality animated shorts per week English proficiency Strong communication skills and the ability to receive feedback positively Reliable workstation (we provide additional tools if needed)

description: ድርጅታችን በአስቸኳይ አራት (4) ልምድ ያላቸውን የብየዳ ቴክኒሽያን በቋሚነት መቅጠር ይፈልጋል። ተቀጣሪዎች የተለያዩ የብረታ ብረት ዓይነቶችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን በመጠቀም ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው ብየዳ ሥራ የማከናወን ሃላፊነት አለባቸው። የሥራ ኃላፊነቶች በተሰጠው የምህንድስና ስዕል (Blueprints/Schematics) እና መስፈርት መሠረት የተለያዩ የብየዳ ሥራዎችን (እንደ Arc፣ MIG፣ TIG ወይም Spot Welding) ማከናወን። ብየዳ ከመጀመሩ በፊት የብረት ክፍሎችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን በትክክል መቁረጥ፣ ማዘጋጀት እና ማስተካከል (fitting)። የብየዳ መሳሪያዎችን ደህንነታቸውን እና ብቃታቸውን በመጠበቅ መሥራት፣ አዘውትሮ ማፅዳትና መፈተሽ። የተጠናቀቁትን ብየዳዎች ጥራት እና ጥንካሬ ማረጋገጥ። የሥራ ቦታ ደህንነት ደንቦችን እና የአሠራር ሥርዓቶችን በጥብቅ መከተል። የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች ልምድ: በብየዳ ቴክኒሽያንነት ወይም በተመሳሳይ ሙያ ቢያንስ አንድ (1) ዓመት የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ያላት። ትምህርት: በብየዳ፣ በብረታ ብረት ሥራ (Metal Fabrication) ወይም በተመሳሳይ መስክ ዲፕሎማ ወይም የሙያ ብቃት ማረጋገጫ (COC) ያለው/ያላት። ክህሎት: የተለያዩ የብየዳ ዓይነቶችን (MIG, TIG, Arc) የመሥራት ብቃት። የምህንድስና ስዕሎችን (Blueprints) የማንበብ እና የመተርጎም ችሎታ። ትኩረት ሰጥቶ እና በንፅህና የመሥራት ልምድ። አመልካቾች የትምህርት ማስረጃቸውን፣ ሙሉ የሥራ ልምድ ማኅደር (CV)፣ የአብሮ ማመልከቻ ደብዳቤ (Cover Letter) እና ሌሎች አስፈላጊ ሰነዶችን በተጠቀሰው የማመልከቻ ጊዜ ውስጥ ማቅረብ አለባቸው። የማመልከቻ ጊዜ: ከ 5 እስከ 10 ቀናት የሥራ ቦታ: ወሎ ሰፈር፣ አዲስ አበባ

title: ሹፌር
description:
ድርጅታችን ደረቅ የድሮ 3ተኛ መንጃ ፈቃድ እና ቢያንስ የአንድ አመት የስራ ልምድ ያለው ሹፌር አወዳድሮ መቅጠር ይፍልጋል።

የሚያስፈልጉ ብቃቶች እና ክህሎቶች

ለተመደበው ተሽከርካሪ አይነት ተስማሚ የሆነ ህጋዊ የመንጃ ፍቃድ (ደረቅ 3) ያለው

የመጓጓዣ መንገዶችን በብቃት የመለየት እና የመጓዝ ችሎታ
መሰረታዊ የንባብ፣ የመፃፍ እና የመዝገብ አያያዝ ክህሎቶች
ሐቀኛ፣ በሰዓቱ አክባሪ እና ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው ባህሪ
የመርካቶ የሎጂስቲክስ ሁኔታዎችን የሚያውቅ
ዋና ኃላፊነቶች

የትራፊክ ደንቦችን እና ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ የመንዳት ልምዶችን ማክበር
በተሽከርካሪው ላይ ያሉ ችግሮችን ሪፖርት ማድረግ እና የጥገና መርሃ ግብሮችን መከታተል

Answer incoming phone calls and respond to customer inquiries in a professional manner.
Provide accurate information about products, services, or policies.
Resolve customer complaints or direct them to the appropriate department.
Record customer information and interactions accurately in the system.
Follow up on customer cases when necessary.
Maintain a high level of professionalism and empathy in every conversation.
Work closely with other departments to ensure smooth customer service.
Qualifications and Skills

· Excellent verbal communication skills in Amharic, Tigirgna, English, and Afan Oromo.

· Strong listening and problem-solving abilities.

· Ability to stay calm under pressure and handle difficult callers professionally.

· Basic computer skills (typing, email, data entry).

· Previous customer service or call center experience is a plus.

· Bachelor’s degree or background in Education.

Contract Period

title: Digital Marketing & Client Acquisition Manager
description:
About Revo Solutions

Revo Solutions is a full-service creative agency working with international and local clients to deliver high-quality digital solutions and creative production. We are looking for a dynamic leader who can elevate our digital presence and bring in high-value clients.

Website- revosolutionplc.com

Job Summary

The Digital Marketing & Client Acquisition Manager will be responsible for driving business growth by identifying target clients, executing outreach strategies, and converting leads into paying customers. The role requires strong leadership in digital marketing—especially TikTok—while managing and guiding the content and creative teams. This person will play a key role in shaping the marketing direction of Revo Solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Client Acquisition & Business Growth

Identify and segment potential clients (local & international) who need creative and digital solutions.
Create and execute client acquisition strategies via social media, email marketing, and direct outreach.
Build lead funnels and manage a structured client conversion pipeline.
Represent Revo Solutions professionally when communicating with potential clients.
Digital Marketing Leadership (TikTok-First Strategy)

Lead a TikTok-first marketing strategy for Revo Solutions’ brand.
Oversee creation of short-form video content that showcases the agency’s services, projects, and expertise.
Manage growth across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
Track analytics and optimize campaigns for reach, engagement, and conversions.
Creative Direction & Team Management

Supervise content creators, designers, and social media staff.
Ensure all marketing materials reflect Revo Solutions’ brand identity and quality.
Collaborate with the creative team to produce client acquisition campaigns.
Train the team on latest digital marketing trends and tools.
Marketing Strategy & Operations

Develop integrated marketing strategies for brand visibility and lead generation.
Oversee paid campaigns (Meta Ads, Google Ads).
Manage email marketing, SEO efforts, and website updates.
Prepare monthly reports showing lead growth, conversions, and ROI.
Required Qualifications

2–5 years digital marketing experience in an agency or service-based business.
Proven record of client acquisition or converting leads to paying customers.
Strong experience with TikTok content, trends, and advertising.
Excellent communication and sales skills.
Ability to lead and coordinate creative teams.
Experience with tools like Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, CRM software, etc.
Preferred Skills

Experience working with international clients.
Familiarity with creative agency workflows.
Understanding of design or video editing workflows (bonus).
Experience in B2B marketing.

title: የፅዳት እና የቢሮ ረዳት ሰራተኛ
description:
የስራ መግለጫ: የፅዳት እና የቢሮ ረዳት ሰራተኛ

ቦታ: አዲስ አበባ,CMC Michael

ትምህርት: ዲፕሎማ ቢያንስ

እድሜ ተሞክሮ: 1 ዓመት የሚመረጥ

ንፁህነት ባለሙያና የቢሮ ረዳት ቢሮውን ንፁህ፣ ተደራሽ እና ደስተኛ ሁኔታ ለመጠበቅ እንዲሁም ቀላል ስራዎችና የውጭ ተግባራትን ለመፈጸም ይመደባል።

ዋና የስራ ተግባሮች

* ቢሮውን እና አጠቃላይ ቦታዎችን ማጽዳትና መጠበቅ

* ዕለታዊ መቆረጥ፣ መታጠብ፣ መንጻት፣ ቆሻሻ መውሰድ

* የደረሰኞችን፣ የቢሮ ዕቃዎችን እና የስብሰባ ክፍሎችን ተደራሽ መጠበቅ

* ለሰራተኞችና ለእንግዶች ቡና፣ ሻይ እና ውሃ ማቅረብ

* ወደ ባንክ መሄድ እና ቀላል የውጭ ተግባራት መፈጸም

* መሰረታዊ የኮምፒውተር ችሎታዎች (ትይፒንግ፣ ፕሪንቲንግ፣ ስካኒንግ፣ ፋይል ማደራጀት)

* የጥገና ችግር በቅድሚያ ለሰራተኛ መሪ ወይም ለሀላፊ ማሳወቅ

* የቢሮ እቃዎችን ማስተካከልና የሰነዶች ማዘጋጀት ላይ ማገዝ የምትችል

ስልጣናት & ችሎታዎች

* የንፁህነትና የጤና መደበኛ መርሀ ግብር

* ጊዜ አስተዳደርና ታማኝነት

* በቡድን ወይም ብቻ መስራት የሚችል

* ከሰራተኞችና ከእንግዶች ጋር ተስማሚ ባህሪ

* ቀላል የኮምፒውተር ችሎታዎች

title: Production Planning & Warehouse Controller
description:
Vacancy Announcement

Position: Production Planning & Warehouse Controller

Location: Sheger City, Sululta

Company: Lovegrass Agro Processing PLC

Employment Type: Full-time

 

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Production Planning & Warehouse Controller to join our factory operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for

coordinating production schedules, monitoring raw material availability, maintaining accurate inventory levels, and ensuring smooth warehouse operations. This role is essential to guaranteeing efficient production flow and timely order fulfilment.

 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

Production Planning

• Develop and manage daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules in coordination with the production manager.

• Ensure availability of raw materials, packaging, and other inputs according to production requirements.

• Monitor actual production performance against plans and adjust schedules when necessary.

• Coordinate with procurement and quality departments to minimize delays and ensure efficient production flow.

Warehouse & Inventory Control

• Maintain accurate records of raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods.

• Oversee proper storage, handling, and issuing of materials based on FIFO and company standards.

• Conduct regular stock counts and reconcile inventory discrepancies.

• Ensure warehouse cleanliness, safety, and compliance with company policies.

• Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory and warehouse activity reports.

Coordination & Reporting

• Work closely with procurement, production, quality, and logistics teams.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities:

• Talent Acquisition & Onboarding:

• Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies to attract, screen, and hire qualified candidates for a wide range of positions, from production line workers to management.

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including job postings, candidate sourcing, interviews, and offer letters.

• Oversee the new hire onboarding process to ensure a smooth and effective transition for new employees.

• Employee Relations & Engagement:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for employee questions, concerns, and grievances.

• Promote a positive and inclusive company culture through various initiatives and communication channels.

• Conduct investigations into employee relations issues, such as harassment or misconduct, and recommend appropriate resolutions.

• Manage and resolve employee conflicts and disciplinary actions in accordance with company policy and legal requirements.

• Performance Management:

• Administer and support the company's performance review and goal-setting processes.

• Coach and train managers on effective performance management techniques, including providing feedback and conducting performance discussions.

• Develop and implement performance improvement plans (PIPs) as needed.

• Compensation & Benefits:

• Administer and manage the company's compensation and benefits programs, including payroll, retirement plans, and paid time off.

• Conduct market research to ensure competitive compensation and benefits packages.

• Advise management on salary adjustments, promotions, and bonus programs.

• Training & Development:

• Identify training needs for employees and management.

• Develop, implement, and facilitate training programs on topics such as safety, leadership, technical skills, and compliance.

• Manage employee development initiatives, including career pathing and succession planning.

• Safety & Compliance:

• Ensure the company's compliance with all federal, state, and local labor laws and regulations

• Collaborate with the EHS (Environmental, Health, and Safety) team to promote a safe working environment and ensure compliance with safety protocols.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR files.

• HR Strategy & Administration:

• Develop and maintain HR policies and procedures in alignment with company goals.

• Manage the HR budget and departmental resources.

• Generate and analyze HR reports and metrics (e.g., turnover rates, time-to-hire) to inform strategic decisions.

• Stay current on HR best practices and trends, particularly within the manufacturing sector.

 

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree or HR certification

• Experience: 4+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 1 year in a management or leadership role within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

• Skills:

• Deep knowledge of federal and state employment laws and regulations.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with employees at all levels.

• Excellent problem-solving, conflict resolution, and decision-making abilities.

የጽዳት ሠራተኛው/ዋ በሆስፒታሉ ውስጥ ያሉ ሁሉም ክፍሎች፣ ቢሮዎች፣ የሕሙማን ክፍሎች፣ ላብራቶሪዎች እና የሕዝብ ቦታዎች ንጹህ፣ ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ እና የኢንፌክሽን መከላከል መስፈርቶችን የሚያሟሉ መሆናቸውን የማረጋገጥ ቁልፍ ኃላፊነት አለበት/ባት። የጤና ተቋሙን የንጽህና ደረጃዎች ጠብቆ ማቆየት የዚህ ስራ ዋነኛ ተግባር ነው።

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች

የአካባቢ ጽዳት፡- ወለሎችን፣ ግድግዳዎችን፣ መስኮቶችን እና ሁሉንም ንጣፎችን በየጊዜው እና በተቀመጠው ፕሮግራም መሰረት ማጽዳትና ማጠብ።
የኢንፌክሽን መከላከል፡- እንደ ቀዶ ጥገና ክፍሎች፣ አይ.ሲ.ዩ (ICU) እና የላብራቶሪ ክፍሎች ያሉ የጸዳ መሆን የሚገባቸውን አካባቢዎች (Sterile Areas) በተለየ ጥንቃቄ እና በተፈቀደ ኬሚካል ማጽዳት።
ቆሻሻ አወጋገድ፡- የህክምና ቆሻሻን (Medical Waste) ጨምሮ ሁሉንም የሆስፒታል ቆሻሻዎች እንደየአይነታቸው (በቀለም ኮድ) በመለየት፣ በንጽህና አውጥቶ ማስወገድ (መቆጣጠር)።
መሳሪያዎችን መንከባከብ፡- ለጽዳት የሚያገለግሉ ቁሳቁሶችን እና መሳሪያዎችን በንጽህና መያዝና በአግባቡ መጠቀም።
ደህንነት፡- ስራዎችን በምንሰራበት ጊዜ ሁሉ የሆስፒታሉን የደህንነት (Safety) እና የንጽህና አጠባበቅ ደንቦችን በጥብቅ መከተል።
የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች

የትምህርት ደረጃ፡- መሰረታዊ ማንበብና መጻፍ የሚችል/ምትችል ወይም ቢያንስ የ[8ኛ/10ኛ] ክፍል ያጠናቀቀ/ች።
የሥራ ልምድ፡- በተመሳሳይ የጽዳት ስራ በተለይም በሆስፒታል፣ በጤና ጣቢያ ወይም በተመሳሳይ የጤና ተቋም ውስጥ የሰራ/ች ቢሆን ይመረጣል።
አመለካከት፡- ለሥራ ታማኝ፣ ታታሪ እና ለዝርዝር ጉዳዮች ትኩረት የሚሰጥ/ት፣ እንዲሁም በቡድን የመሥራት ችሎታ ያለው/ላት መሆን ይገባል።
ጤንነት፡- በጤና ተቋም ውስጥ ለመስራት የሚያስችል የአካል ብቃት ያለው/ላት መሆን አለበት/ባት።
ማመልከቻ ለማስገባት
0911816225 ለበለጠ መረጃ

title: Junior accountant
description:
financial professional who handles routine accounting tasks such as data entry, invoice processing, and account reconciliation under the supervision of senior.

Record keeping: Posting journal entries, managing financial data and verifying source documents.

Accounts payable and receivable: Processing vendor invoices, issuing customer invoices, and monitoring payments.

Financial reporting: Assisting with the preparation of financial statements, reports, and general ledger entries.

Reconciliation: Reconciling bank statements and other accounts to ensure accuracy.

Payroll and expenses: Assisting with payroll processing, reviewing expense reports, and handling petty cash.

Auditing and compliance: Supporting internal and external financial audits and ensuring compliance with financial regulations.

Required skills and qualifications

A bachelor's degree in accounting and finance,

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and accounting software like peachtree

Good communication and teamwork skills.

Ability to work under supervision and meet deadlines

title: Sanitary / Civil Engineer
description:
Looking for a skilled Sanitary / Civil Engineer to join our team and work on design, planning, and execution of civil and sanitary engineering projects.

Key Responsibilities

Develop sanitary designs in line with project requirements and codes.
Prepare technical drawings, calculations, and construction documents.
Coordinate with architects, consultants, and contractors.
Conduct site inspections and supervise construction works.
Ensure compliance with building codes, health, and safety standards.
Support project planning, scheduling, and cost estimation.
Qualification

Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Sanitary Engineering
3–4 years of experience in civil/sanitary engineering, preferably in construction projects
Experience in site supervision
Proficient in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, or similar design software
Skills

Strong knowledge of civil, structural, and sanitary engineering standards
Site supervision and project management
Problem-solving and critical-thinking
Team collaboration and communication
Attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines
Candidates living in or near Sarbet / Mekanissa are highly desirable.

title: Client acquisition officer
description:
Role & responsibilities

Drive a medical Homecare’s growth by identifying and nurturing referral relationships and converting qualified enquiries into timely homecare placements. Build and maintain partnerships with clinics, physicians, pharmacies, community groups, NGOs and family networks; qualify referrals.

Required skills

Strong interpersonal and verbal communication; relationship-building and networking; organized follow-up and basic CRM/spreadsheet tracking; ability to present and negotiate professionally; target-driven mindset; comfortable working in clinical environments; competent with WhatsApp, email and basic office tools.

Qualifications (minimum)

Diploma or degree (any field; health, business or social sciences preferred). Proven experience in sales, community outreach, business development, or healthcare liaison roles.

Preferred

-Clinical background (nursing, public health, social work, pharmacy)

-prior homecare/clinic/insurance experience; existing professional network in Addis Ababa;

-experience running small community events or trainings;

-demonstrable record of meeting targets and converting partnerships into referrals.

Compensation

This role offers a base salary plus performance-based commission, structured to reward consistent outreach, active partnerships, and successful referral conversions.

title: ለ 1ኛ ደረጃ ተማሪዎች የተለያዩ ዎርክሺት ማዘጋጀት
description:
ስራው ከ ኬጂ እስከ 5ኛ ክፍል ያሉትን ተማሪዎች፡ የመንግስት መማርያ መጽሀፋቸው መሰረት በማድረግ የተለያዩ ሳመራይዝድ ኖቶች ( summerized Notes) እና የተመረጡ ጥያቄዎች ከነመልሳቸው ማዘጋጀት።

የተቀጣሪ ሚና

ከ ኬጂ ጀምሮ እስከ 5ኛ ክፍል ያሉትን 6 የትምህርት አይነቶች ማለትም ሒሳብ፡ እንግሊዝኛ፡ አከባቢ ሳይንስ፡ አማርኛ፡ ግብረ ገብ እና የጥበባት ትምህርት የተለያዩ ሳመራይዝድ ኖቶች ( summerized Notes) እና የተመረጡ ጥያቄዎች ከነመልሳቸው ማዘጋጀት።

አስፈላጊ ችሎታዎች

በማንኛውም የትምህርት አይነት ዲግሪ እና ከዛ በላያ ያለው እንዲሁም ይሄ የ 1ኛ ደረጃ የመንግስት መማርያ መጽሀፍቶች በደምብ ተረድቶ በሚችለው እና በሚቀለው የትምህርት አይነት የተለያዩ ሳመራይዝድ ኖቶች ( summerized Notes) እና የተመረጡ ጥያቄዎች ከነመልሳቸው ማዘጋጀት የሚችል።

 

ክፍያ

ክፍያ በስምምነት ሆኖ ፕሮጄክቱ ሲጠናቀቅ የተስማማንበት ።ክፍያ ይፈጸማል

title: Architect
description:

Lead architectural design and project development from concept to completion.

Prepare technical drawings and construction documents (AutoCAD).
Coordinate with engineers, consultants, and contractors.
Ensure designs meet codes, standards, and client requirements.
Conduct site visits to monitor construction progress.

2–3 years professional experience in architecture.
Proficient in Revit, Lumion / 3ds Max / D5 Render, AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite.
Site supervision experience required.
Experience in large-scale projects is an advantage.
Required Skills

Knowledge of construction and building codes.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Team-oriented with strong coordination abilities.
Problem-solving and critical thinking.
Candidates living in or near the Sarbet/Mekanissa area are highly desirable.

title: Childcare/household nanny
description:
Job Position: Nanny

Qualified and interested candidates can contact us on telegram on 0979019994

Position Overview: We are sincerely seeking a responsible and caring live-in nanny/housekeeper to provide household support and childcare services for our family. The ideal candidate should be responsible for maintaining the cleanliness and tidiness of the home environment while ensuring the health and safety of our 2-year-old son. This position works six days a week (Monday to Sunday), with Half-day off on Sunday.

Main job responsibilities: Care for and accompany our 2-year-old son attentively, ensure his safety, and guide him in age-appropriate activities. Responsible for daily household cleaning tasks, including sweeping, tidying up, and maintaining a clean and orderly home environment. Clean and organize children's clothing and supplies. (Optional based on candidate's skills) Prepare simple and healthy meals and snacks for children. Create a caring and growth-conducive environment for children. Assist with other minor household chores as needed.

Working Hours: Works from Monday to Sunday (live-in). 15 days paid time off once a year Job Requirements: Preference will be given to those with childcare experience and those who can communicate in English without barriers. Have a basic understanding of knowledge about early childhood development and activities suitable for young children. Can efficiently complete household cleaning tasks. Strong sense of responsibility, patience, and a genuine love for children. Has good communication skills and a positive work attitude. Non-smokers, free of infectious diseases.

Salary and Benefits: Offers competitive salary (15,000 Birr/month)，

Application Method: If you are interested in this position, please submit your resume along with a brief self-introduction. We look forward to your joining!

title: ሞባይል ገጣጣሚ (Mobile Assembler)
description:
ክፍት የስራ ቦታ ማስታወቂያ

 

በአዲሰ አበባ በየትኛውም አካባቢ ለምትኖሩ በተለይ በጎሮ፣ በቱሊዲምቱ፣በወርገኖ፣በቃሊቲ እና በአቃቂ  ለምትኖሩ ስራ ፈላጊዎች በሙሉ

ደርጅታችን ትራንሽን ማኑፋክቸሪንግ ኃ/የተ/የግ/ማ (ቴክኖ ሞባይል) ከታች ለተገለጸው የስራ መደብ አመልካቾችን አወዳደሮ መቅጠር ይፈልጋል::

የስራ መደቡ መጠሪያ፡- ሞባይል ገጣጣሚ (Mobile Assembler)

የት/ት ደረጃ፡- 10ኛ/12ኛ ክፍል ያጠናቀቀች

የስራ ልምድ፡- አይጠይቅም

ጾታ፡-ሴት/ወንድ

ብዛት፡ሴት-150

እድሜ፡ 18-26 ዓመት

- Core competencies: Proficiency in one or more foreign languages, ability to independently interact with clients, supervisors, and construction teams; understanding of international engineering bidding processes, and the ability to communicate across cultures and coordinate projects.

- Qualification Certificates: Possession of relevant professional qualification certificates such as Registered Electrical Engineer, Registered Professional Engineer for Public Utilities (Water Supply/HVAC), or preference given to those with certifications like LEED AP or BREEAM.

- Other requirements: Ability to adapt to short-term overseas assignments or on-site work, strong stress tolerance; understanding of overseas engineering compliance requirements (such as local labor laws, environmental standards), and the ability to anticipate risks and resolve technical issues.8

title: Electrical Infrastructure construction team leader
description:
Electrical Infrastructure Construction Team Leader:

 

Job Requirements

- Educational Background and Specialization: A degree from an institution of higher learning or above, with a focus on fields such as electrical engineering, building infrastructure for telecommunications, and network engineering is preferred.

- Work Experience: At least 3 years of experience leading teams in the installation of non-electrical systems, with a thorough understanding of the processes involved in installing cable conduits and cable trays, integrated wiring systems, security monitoring, access control intercom systems, and network communication systems for government office buildings.

- Professional Skills: Ability to understand drawings related to low-voltage electrical installations, proficiency in the installation, testing, and troubleshooting of low-voltage electrical equipment, and knowledge of relevant European and American standards.

- Management capabilities: Possesses the ability to manage team personnel, control construction progress, oversee quality and safety, and effectively distribute tasks and manage construction milestones.

- Core competencies: Proficiency in English, strong communication and coordination skills. Ability to liaise with the client, the supervisor, and the design team to resolve technical issues on-site; strong sense of responsibility, strict adherence to construction safety regulations, and the capability to handle emergencies.

- Other requirements: Preference given to individuals holding relevant certifications such as an electrician's license and certification as a weak-electricity engineer; ability to adapt to project-based on-site work, strong stress tolerance, and willingness to comply with project scheduling arrangements. Ability to handle high-intensity work and willingness to work overtime during holidays.

title: MARKETING MANAGER
description:
Position: Marketing Manager

Company:

Vantage Travel & Tour Services
Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Vantage Travel & Tour Services—Ethiopia’s leading travel agency—invites qualified and dynamic professionals to apply for the position of Marketing Manager. We are seeking an innovative, strategy-driven leader to accelerate our growth, strengthen our brand, and drive customer loyalty in an increasingly competitive travel market.

Key Purpose of the Role

To lead and manage the company’s overall marketing strategy with a strong focus on market penetration, customer retention, brand promotion, and positioning of new services.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies to increase market share and grow the customer base across corporate, leisure, labour, and digital segments.
Lead market penetration initiatives by identifying new customer segments, geographic opportunities, and competitive positioning.
Strengthen customer retention through loyalty programs, CRM strategies, targeted campaigns, and personalized service communications.
Oversee branding and promotional activities—both online and offline—to enhance Vantage Travel & Tour’s visibility and value proposition.
Lead the introduction, marketing, and positioning of new services and 24/7 service innovations.
Conduct market research to understand customer needs, industry trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities.
Plan, execute, and evaluate advertising campaigns, media planning, digital marketing, and content strategies.
Build strong partnerships with airlines, hotels, corporate clients, influencers, and digital platforms.
Ensure marketing activities align with sales targets and operational realities.
Track KPIs and prepare periodic reports to management on marketing ROI, campaign performance, and customer engagement.
Manage and guide the marketing team to ensure timely and high-quality delivery of tasks.
Required Qualifications & Competencies

Education & Training

BA or MA Degree in Marketing Management, Business Administration, Tourism Management, or related fields.
Experience

Minimum 5 years proven experience in marketing, preferably in travel, hospitality, aviation, or service industries.
Experience with digital marketing, social media strategy, and brand management.
Exposure to digital booking systems, or e-commerce marketing is an added advantage.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies

Strong understanding of travel industry dynamics, customer behavior, and competitive landscape.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Ability to design and implement marketing campaigns end-to-end.
Strong analytical skills with competence in using marketing analytics tools.
Creative mindset with the ability to generate innovative promotional ideas.
Leadership capability and ability to coordinate cross-functional teams.
Salary:

Negotiable and attractive based on candidate’s experience & qualification.

Duty Station

Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

How to Apply

Interested and qualified applicants are invited to send their CV and application letter to:
[anineja25@gmail.com]
Application Deadline: [December 9, 2025]

title: Store keeper/ የሽያጭ ሰራተኛ
description: ​እኛ ፈጣን ዕድገት ላይ ያለን ድርጅት ሲሆን፣ በቡድናችን ውስጥ ውጤታማ እና ትጉህ የሆኑ የመጋዘን/ሱቅ ኃላፊ (Store Keeper) ሰራተኛ መቅጠር እንፈልጋለን። ይህ ዕድል በተለይ ለሥራ ዓለም አዲስ ለሆናችሁ ከፍተኛ የትምህርት ደረጃ (12ኛ ክፍል) ያጠናቀቃችሁ፣ ዕድሜያቸው 24 እና በታች የሆኑ እንዲሁም ለመማር ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ላላችሁ የተዘጋጀ ነው። ​የሥራው ኃላፊነቶች (Key Responsibilities): ​ትእዛዝ ማዘጋጀት እና ማስተናገድ: ከደንበኞች የሚመጡ ትዕዛዞችን በቅደም ተከተል እና በትክክል ማዘጋጀት እና ማስተናገድ። ​ደረሰኝ መስጠት: ለእያንዳንዱ ሽያጭ ትክክለኛ የሽያጭ ደረሰኝ (receipt) መስጠት። ​የአትክልትና ፍራፍሬ አያያዝ: የአትክልትና ፍራፍሬ ምርቶችን በአግባቡ ለመንከባከብ፣ ትኩስነታቸውን ለመጠበቅ እና እንዳይበላሹ ለመከላከል ስልጠና ወስዶ መስራት። ​የሽያጭ ግብይት (Sales Transaction) መመዝገብ: ሁሉንም የሽያጭ ግብይቶች በትክክል መመዝገብ እና የሽያጭ መረጃን ማስተናገድ። ​የእቃ ዝርዝር እና ቁጥጥር: በመጋዘን/ሱቅ ውስጥ ያሉ ዕቃዎችን በመመዝገብ እና በመቆጣጠር ላይ መርዳት። ​ብቃት እና መስፈርቶች (Qualifications): ​የትምህርት ደረጃ: 12ኛ ክፍል ያጠናቀቀ/ያጠናቀቀች። ​ዕድሜ: 24 ዓመት እና በታች። ​የሥራ ልምድ: የሥራ ልምድ አይጠበቅም። ​ዝግጁነት: ስለ አትክልትና ፍራፍሬ አያያዝ እንዲሁም ስለ ሽያጭ ግብይት ሂደቶች ዕውቀት ያለው/ያላት ወይም ይህን ዕውቀት በፍጥነት ለመማር እና ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ ዝግጁ የሆነ/የሆነች። ​በቡድን የመሥራት እና ጥሩ የሰዎች ግንኙነት ክህሎት ያለው/ያላት። ​ታማኝ፣ ታታሪ እና ለዝርዝር ትኩረት የሚሰጥ/የምትሰጥ።

title: Store keeper/ የሽያጭ ሰራተኛ
description:
​እኛ ፈጣን ዕድገት ላይ ያለን ድርጅት ሲሆን፣ በቡድናችን ውስጥ ውጤታማ እና ትጉህ የሆኑ የመጋዘን/ሱቅ ኃላፊ (Store Keeper) ሰራተኛ መቅጠር እንፈልጋለን። ይህ ዕድል በተለይ ለሥራ ዓለም አዲስ ለሆናችሁ ከፍተኛ የትምህርት ደረጃ (12ኛ ክፍል) ያጠናቀቃችሁ፣ ዕድሜያቸው 24 እና በታች የሆኑ እንዲሁም ለመማር ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ላላችሁ የተዘጋጀ ነው።

​የሥራው ኃላፊነቶች (Key Responsibilities):

​ትእዛዝ ማዘጋጀት እና ማስተናገድ: ከደንበኞች የሚመጡ ትዕዛዞችን በቅደም ተከተል እና በትክክል ማዘጋጀት እና ማስተናገድ።
​ደረሰኝ መስጠት: ለእያንዳንዱ ሽያጭ ትክክለኛ የሽያጭ ደረሰኝ (receipt) መስጠት።
​የአትክልትና ፍራፍሬ አያያዝ: የአትክልትና ፍራፍሬ ምርቶችን በአግባቡ ለመንከባከብ፣ ትኩስነታቸውን ለመጠበቅ እና እንዳይበላሹ ለመከላከል ስልጠና ወስዶ መስራት።
​የሽያጭ ግብይት (Sales Transaction) መመዝገብ: ሁሉንም የሽያጭ ግብይቶች በትክክል መመዝገብ እና የሽያጭ መረጃን ማስተናገድ።
​የእቃ ዝርዝር እና ቁጥጥር: በመጋዘን/ሱቅ ውስጥ ያሉ ዕቃዎችን በመመዝገብ እና በመቆጣጠር ላይ መርዳት።
​ብቃት እና መስፈርቶች (Qualifications):

​የትምህርት ደረጃ: 12ኛ ክፍል ያጠናቀቀ/ያጠናቀቀች።
​ዕድሜ: 24 ዓመት እና በታች።
​የሥራ ልምድ: የሥራ ልምድ አይጠበቅም።
​ዝግጁነት: ስለ አትክልትና ፍራፍሬ አያያዝ እንዲሁም ስለ ሽያጭ ግብይት ሂደቶች ዕውቀት ያለው/ያላት ወይም ይህን ዕውቀት በፍጥነት ለመማር እና ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ ዝግጁ የሆነ/የሆነች።
​በቡድን የመሥራት እና ጥሩ የሰዎች ግንኙነት ክህሎት ያለው/ያላት።
​ታማኝ፣ ታታሪ እና ለዝርዝር ትኩረት የሚሰጥ/የምትሰጥ።

title: Fashion Designer (Bag designer)
description:
About Us
NIA Garment Co. is a fast-growing Ethiopian manufacturing company specializing in apparel, bags, and accessories. Through our in-house brands NURU and LULA, we create modern, practical, and stylish products for a wide range of customers. We are expanding our team and looking for a talented Bag Designer who is passionate about fashion, functionality, and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Conceptualize, sketch, and design a wide range of bags (backpacks, handbags, tote bags, laptop bags, and accessories) aligned with brand aesthetics.
Develop prototypes and technical drawings for production.
Select materials, colors, trims, and finishes to meet design and quality standards.
Work closely with the production team to ensure designs are feasible and cost-effective.
Conduct trend research to keep collections fresh, innovative, and competitive.
Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure designs align with consumer preferences.
Maintain consistency with brand identity while exploring creative ideas.
Qualifications & Skills

Diploma or Degree in Fashion Design, Industrial Design, or related field.
Strong knowledge of design basics and principles.
Proven experience in bag or accessory design (portfolio required).
Experience working in a factory or production environment.
Familiarity with bag construction techniques, fabrics, leather, and hardware.
Ability to create detailed technical sketches (by hand or digital).
Proficiency in design software, including:

Adobe Illustrator
Adobe Photoshop
3D design softwares
Creativity with attention to detail and functionality.
Strong communication and teamwork skills.
What We Offer

A dynamic and creative work environment.
Opportunities to grow with a fast-expanding company.
Competitive salary based on experience.
Chance to design for leading Ethiopian brands with regional growth ambitions.

title: Boiler Operator / Utility Operator
description: Roles & Responsibilities Operate and monitor utility machineries such as boiler, chiller, air compressor, Generator and water treatment safety as a prime consideration. Operate the plant in most efficient way to reduce losses and maximize production yield. Any adjustment on process setting could be made with the consult of the utility engineer Ensuring always utilities supplies in quantities and qualities wise Boiler monitor feed water quality and temperature. Generator monitor fuel level and oil level Chiller inspect the operating gas pressure and chilled water circulation level. Air compressor monitor working pressure and temperature. Inspection of all operational equipment’s frequently, not less than once in two hours. Monitoring, recording operational process parameters and utility consumption and report to utility engineer Monitor operational parameters and report if there any deviation Diagnoses and correct utility problems when possible: Notifying utility engineer for any equipment needing addition attention or repair Continuously improve the operational skills, to reduce energy cost and Constantly explore and improve. safety consciousness at work. Study safety knowledge and technology, improve safety skills. Periodical and continuous cleaning and to keep the machines “like new” status Conduct routine maintenance check and performs preventive maintenance on utility equipment’s Assess risk areas on regular basis and report to EHS Head and production head Support the EHS person and the staff association to ensure the working environment is conducive and free of any hazard. Performs other related duties as assigned. Qualifications •        Minimum of Level-II in General Mechanic/industrial/electrical or any other Technical related fields •        Minimum 3-years’ experience in an FMCG industry.

description: About the Role We are looking for an exceptional Chief Marketing Manager to provide strong leadership, strategic direction, and operational excellence across all marketing functions. This role demands a visionary marketer who can blend creativity, analytics, market insight, and team leadership to drive brand growth and business expansion. The ideal candidate has 7+ years of progressive marketing experience, including leadership roles, and a proven track record of driving measurable results through innovative strategies and high-performance teams.   Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Leadership & Growth Direction Develop and oversee the company’s full marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Lead market analysis and insights to identify opportunities, customer needs, and competitive positioning. Define long-term brand vision and marketing roadmap. Advise the CEO and executive team on marketing performance, industry trends, and growth strategies. 2. Brand Management & Positioning Strengthen and evolve the company brand in the market. Ensure consistent messaging, tone, and visual identity across all platforms and campaigns. Lead PR initiatives, media engagements, and brand partnerships. 3. Marketing Campaign Leadership Plan and execute large-scale, high-impact campaigns across digital and traditional channels. Lead product marketing strategies, go-to-market execution, and promotional activities. Oversee creative direction, campaign architecture, messaging, and storytelling. Ensure all campaigns are ROI-driven and performance-optimized. 4. Digital Marketing Excellence Lead digital strategy: SEO, SEM, social media, ads, content, email, and growth marketing. Improve online visibility, traffic, conversions, and customer retention. Use analytics tools to track performance and optimize campaigns based on insights. 5. Team Leadership & Collaboration Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing marketing team. Create a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and excellence. Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, IT, and Operations to ensure unified objectives. Manage relationships with agencies, influencers, and media partners. 6. Performance Measurement & Reporting Set marketing KPIs and monitor performance across all channels. Present monthly and quarterly marketing performance reports to executive leadership. Optimize budgets, resources, and campaign spending for maximum efficiency. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field. 7+ years of marketing experience with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role. Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns and marketing teams. Strong understanding of digital marketing, analytics, and customer acquisition. Excellent communication, presentation, and strategic decision-making skills. Ability to lead large projects and deliver under tight deadlines. Preferred Experience in EdTech, Technology, SaaS, or digital product environments. Strong business acumen with experience working closely with executive teams. Master’s degree is an added advantage. Core Competencies Strategic leadership and business mindset Strong creative and analytical balance Powerful storytelling and communication abilities Data-driven decision-making High emotional intelligence and team leadership skills Ability to manage complex projects and multiple stakeholders Why Join Us? Lead the entire marketing direction of an innovative, growing organization Work directly with top leadership to shape the future of the company. Opportunity to build and develop a high-performing marketing team. Attractive compensation and clear career progression. How to Apply: send your CV, and a short cover letter explaining why you’re the right fit for this role.

title: Chief Marketing Officer
description: About the Role We are looking for an exceptional Chief Marketing Manager to provide strong leadership, strategic direction, and operational excellence across all marketing functions. This role demands a visionary marketer who can blend creativity, analytics, market insight, and team leadership to drive brand growth and business expansion. The ideal candidate has 7+ years of progressive marketing experience, including leadership roles, and a proven track record of driving measurable results through innovative strategies and high-performance teams. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Leadership & Growth Direction Develop and oversee the company’s full marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Lead market analysis and insights to identify opportunities, customer needs, and competitive positioning. Define long-term brand vision and marketing roadmap. Advise the CEO and executive team on marketing performance, industry trends, and growth strategies. 2. Brand Management & Positioning Strengthen and evolve the company brand in the market. Ensure consistent messaging, tone, and visual identity across all platforms and campaigns. Lead PR initiatives, media engagements, and brand partnerships. 3. Marketing Campaign Leadership Plan and execute large-scale, high-impact campaigns across digital and traditional channels. Lead product marketing strategies, go-to-market execution, and promotional activities. Oversee creative direction, campaign architecture, messaging, and storytelling. Ensure all campaigns are ROI-driven and performance-optimized. 4. Digital Marketing Excellence Lead digital strategy: SEO, SEM, social media, ads, content, email, and growth marketing. Improve online visibility, traffic, conversions, and customer retention. Use analytics tools to track performance and optimize campaigns based on insights. 5. Team Leadership & Collaboration Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing marketing team. Create a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and excellence. Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, IT, and Operations to ensure unified objectives. Manage relationships with agencies, influencers, and media partners. 6. Performance Measurement & Reporting Set marketing KPIs and monitor performance across all channels. Present monthly and quarterly marketing performance reports to executive leadership. Optimize budgets, resources, and campaign spending for maximum efficiency. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field. 7+ years of marketing experience with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role. Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns and marketing teams. Strong understanding of digital marketing, analytics, and customer acquisition. Excellent communication, presentation, and strategic decision-making skills. Ability to lead large projects and deliver under tight deadlines. Preferred Experience in EdTech, Technology, SaaS, or digital product environments. Strong business acumen with experience working closely with executive teams. Master’s degree is an added advantage. Core Competencies Strategic leadership and business mindset Strong creative and analytical balance Powerful storytelling and communication abilities Data-driven decision-making High emotional intelligence and team leadership skills Ability to manage complex projects and multiple stakeholders Why Join Us? Lead the entire marketing direction of an innovative, growing organization Work directly with top leadership to shape the future of the company. Opportunity to build and develop a high-performing marketing team. Attractive compensation and clear career progression. How to Apply: send your CV, and a short cover letter explaining why you’re the right fit for this role.

title: Field Sales Agent / Brand Representative
description:
About beU Delivery

At beU Delivery, we're breaking down barriers. Our mission is to make food delivery affordable and accessible for everyone in Addis Ababa, changing the perception that it's a luxury service only for the few. We are a dynamic, fast-growing company dedicated to bringing convenience to our community.

The Role: Join us as a Field Sales Agent / Brand Representative

As the face of beU in your community, you will be the key driver of our growth. You'll be responsible for introducing new users to our app, educating them on how to use it, and directly contributing to making delivery a daily habit for everyone. Your work on the ground will directly shape our service and reach.

What You'll Do:

Actively promote the beU Delivery app to potential new customers across Addis Ababa.

Educate and assist new users with the onboarding and ordering process.

Collect valuable customer feedback through questionnaires and reports.

Represent the beU brand with energy and professionalism at all times.

Attend two in-person team meetings per week: Mondays for weekly planning and briefing, and Fridays for reflection and review.

Who We're Looking For:

Must be 18 years of age or older.

Minimum education: Grade 10 completion or TVET Level I/II/III.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

A positive, can-do attitude and a strong desire to succeed in sales.

Eager to learn, approach new people, and onboard users.

Reliable and able to manage your own schedule effectively.

Why You'll Love Working at beU:

Ultimate Flexibility: Manage your own schedule! As long as you complete your daily tasks, you have the freedom to structure your day.

Work-Life Balance: Enjoy a standard Monday-to-Friday workweek. Your weekends are always free for yourself, your family, and your hobbies.

Weekly Pay: Get paid every week. No more waiting for the end of the month—see your earnings quickly.

Make a Real Impact: Play a crucial role in a company that is changing how Addis Ababa eats and shops.

title: Business Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Business Analyst with experience Startups, or SaaS, or a self-driven, open-minded individual eager to learn and grow. You will bridge business needs and technical solutions, ensuring smooth execution of digital banking, payments, and marketplace projects.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Engage with internal teams, banks, merchants, and partners to understand business needs.

• Conduct workshops, interviews, and requirement analysis sessions.

• Identify gaps, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and constraints.

• Translate business requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications.

• Prepare BRD, FRD, SRS, user stories with acceptance criteria, use-case diagrams, workflow diagrams, API specifications, data mapping sheets, integration documents, change requests (CR), UAT test cases, and release notes.

• Maintain clear versioned documentation for developers, QA, and clients.

• Collaborate with developers and QA to clarify requirements and ensure alignment with business needs.

• Break down requirements into sprint-ready user stories.

• Track tasks and progress in Jira/ClickUp.

• Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

• Act as the main point of contact for banks, merchants, and partners regarding requirements.

• Prepare requirement confirmation letters, weekly status reports, and progress updates.

• Support the CEO in client presentations, demos, and solution discussions.

• Prepare and validate UAT test cases aligned with business requirements.

• Support QA teams during testing cycles with clarifications.

• Coordinate UAT sessions with clients and partners.

• Analyze customer feedback, business metrics, and system performance to recommend improvements.

• Conduct competitor research (banks, fintechs, wallets, marketplaces).

• Propose enhancements for usability, compliance, and performance.

• Prepare meeting notes, internal documentation, and follow-up reports.

• Track pending deliverables, approvals, and documents from partners.

Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in Tech, Startups, SaaS, or strong belief in your potential.

• Open-minded, self-driven, and eager to learn.

• Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ownership mindset, detail-oriented, and results-driven.

 

Why Join Us

• Work on cutting-edge digital banking & fintech platforms.

• Contribute to national-level, multi-channel financial solutions.

• Collaborate with a talented, fast-growing team.

• Competitive salary and professional growth.

Key skill : - . Administrative & Reporting Tasks , Product Analysis & Improvement ,Quality Assurance & UAT Support,Client & Partner Communication, Project & Product Coordination,Documentation & Specification,Requirement Gathering & Analysis

How to Apply:

We are seeking applicants with a young, open-minded, multi-talented, and self-driven mindset who can grow with us. If you meet the aforementioned qualifications, kindly send your resume to info@onetap.et.

title: Full Stack Next.js Developer & Tester
description:
Overview:

We are looking for a skilled Fullstack Next.js Developer & Tester to maintain and enhance our existing ERP system. The ideal candidate will work closely with users to implement feedback, develop new features, ensure system reliability through thorough testing, and leverage the Vercel AI SDK to structure unstructured data effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

·         Maintain, optimize, and enhance an existing ERP system based on user and business feedback.

·         Design and implement new features with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.

·         Debug, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across the stack (frontend, backend, and integrations).

·         Write and execute automated and manual tests for UI components, API endpoints, and business logic.

·         Utilize Vercel AI SDK to process and transform unstructured data into structured formats using schemas.

·         Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality delivery and continuous improvement.

·         Apply best practices in code quality, testing, and version control.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

·         Strong hands-on experience with Next.js (App Router) and React.
