·         Proficiency in Material UI, Tailwind, React Hook Form, and Zod for building and validating UI forms.

·         Strong TypeScript and Node.js development skills.

·         Proven experience in writing and running tests for UI, API, and business logic using modern testing frameworks.

·         Experience maintaining and debugging production systems.

·         Practical experience using the Vercel AI SDK for schema-based structured data handling.

·         Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

·         Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

·         Experience working on ERP or large-scale business systems.

·         Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment (Vercel, AWS, Nginx etc.).

·         Knowledge of RESTful APIs and microservice architecture.

·         Python programming language

Location:  On-site

Employment Type: Full-time

title: Growth Lead and Content Strategist
description:
Job Description

About the role

We seek our Growth Lead. You will start by creating content that converts (chief content creator), then build a strategy to find more highly-converting content efficiently (content strategist), and then lastly build processes and lead teams to scale this (content engine architect).

Job Duties

Content strategy architect

Analyse our/competitor/market performance
Lead experimentation and iterate on our content
Develop a scalable, systematic framework for testing content, including identifying leading indicators of virality (e.g., trending noises with 10k+ uses)
Content engine scaling

Build processes to create + scale winning formats and strategies
Document learnings and communicate knowledge across the team effectively
Collaborate with the team to produce better content, e.g., changing the UI/UX of our app to increase virality
Hire, mentor, and manage a team
Hands-on content creation/social media management

Film and edit converting video content fast, incl. jumping on trends last minute
Manage our social media accounts to keep them warm
Building community through replies, direct messages, and engaging with others
Job Qualifications

Communication: Strong written and spoken English. Clear documentation. As communication is a two-way street, you are constantly learning to adapt with the communicatee.
Analytical skills: Experience using quantitative and qualitative analysis to strategise.* Ideal candidates likely already have viral sense.
Operational skills: Experience in operationalising and scaling (human) processes/systems, and especially factoring in the EQ/human element.*
Entrepreneurial & ambitious: You take ownership and initiative. Nothing is below you. You like to win.
Collaborative spirit: You like working with and building teams.
Ideal to have, but not required

Content creation chops: You must be camera native and able to edit videos quickly.
We offer

A role with a huge and direct impact
Remote work, autonomy and independence, and a competitive salary
Interesting work where no two days are the same

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Marketing Specialist

Type of Employment: Full Time

Location: Addis Ababa

Reports to: Marketing Manager

About Dodai

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated company originating from Delaware, USA that wishes to resolve the issue of lack of access to efficient and affordable mobility for gig workers in Ethiopia. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa. We are seeking a talented and creative Marketing Specialist to join our growing team. This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact in a fast-paced environment.

Purpose of the Position

As a Marketing Specialist, you will play a key role in executing marketing strategies to promote our brand, products, and services. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive marketing initiatives, increase brand awareness, generate leads, and support overall business objectives. This position requires a combination of strategic thinking, creativity, strong communication skills, and a solid understanding of digital marketing channels.

Key Responsibilities:

Implement comprehensive marketing plans to support business goals, including brand positioning, lead generation, and customer acquisition.
Create and execute targeted campaigns across various channels, including digital, social media, email marketing, content marketing, and events.
Conduct market research and analyze industry trends to identify market opportunities, competitive landscape, and customer insights.
Create engaging and persuasive marketing collateral, such as brochures, presentations, website content, and sales materials.
Manage and optimize digital marketing campaigns, including search engine marketing (SEM), search engine optimization (SEO), pay-per-click (PPC) advertising, and social media advertising.
Plan and coordinate launch and marketing events, trade shows, and conferences
Monitor and analyze marketing campaign performance, generate reports, and provide actionable insights to drive continuous improvement.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product development and others to ensure consistent messaging and alignment of marketing efforts.
Maintain brand consistency and ensure adherence to brand guidelines across all marketing initiatives.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in marketing, and make recommendations for incorporating them into the company's marketing strategies.
Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
2-5 years of proven experience in marketing, preferably in a similar role within a fast paced industry
Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques, tools, and platforms, including SEO, SEM, social media marketing, email marketing, and content marketing.
Proficient in using marketing automation software, CRM systems, and analytics tools to track campaign performance and measure ROI.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling marketing content and present ideas effectively.
Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a keen eye for detail.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Familiarity with market research methodologies and tools.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive results.

title: IE Officer /Industrial engineering officer
description:

Support line-level IE activities by collecting production data, conducting time studies, and maintaining accurate SMV, capacity, and efficiency records. The IE Officer ensures continuous monitoring and reporting of key operational parameters.

Conduct capacity studies using bar charts and frequency sheets.

Monitor line balancing, absenteeism, and manpower allocation.

Perform time & motion studies for each operation and update SMV data.

Support QCO (Quick Change Over) monitoring and record changeover times.

Monitor and report downtime reasons daily and recommend improvements.

Update and manage the IE database (SMVs, CMS, style-wise data).

Prepare daily/weekly performance reports and share with Team Leader.

Participate in 6S audits and sustain continuous improvement.

Monitoring Tools:

Stopwatch/time study, Bar chart, Line balance sheet, QCO sheet, Skill matrix.

Reports To: IE Team Leader

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Garment Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 1-2 years of experience in industrial engineering within the apparel sector, preferably, strong knowledge operation breakdowns, SMV calculation), and layout planning and QCO

This is not simple reading.

We are building two full VO teams.

• 4 Female voice actors
• 4 Male voice actors

Amharic Voice Actor (Drama)
Remote work
Long-term monthly work
Assigned character roles

• Speak clear, natural Amharic
• Act with emotion, tone, and character personality
• Follow strict script instructions: anger, crying, fear, soft tone, panic, whisper, etc
• Produce clean audio (NO background noise)
• Use iPhone(newer), or an external lav mic

• Read scenes without mistakes
• Can work under a schedule

• You are given a script with timestamps
• You will see each character name, emotion, tone, and instructions

• You rename files correctly:
Example: Scene_03_Character_Mother.m4a
• You act the lines, not read them flat
• You submit all scenes clean and organized

• Strong emotional acting
• Clean audio
• File per scene (not one long file)
• Follow timing so the editor can sync easily
• Consistent voice tone across all scenes
• Fast response to messages
• Zero laziness or excuses

Ideal For
• Voice actors with previous experience
• People who have done narration, drama, podcasts, TikTok acting, or character roles
• Actors who understand emotion, timing, and scene performance
• Serious freelancers who can handle long movies
• Talented drama performers

NOT ideal for beginners.
NOT ideal for people who want to “read” only.
NOT ideal for busy people who disappear.

Payment
You will be paid per recorded minute.
Rate is based on your test acting quality.
We pay fairly, but we expect professional results.

How to Apply
Send:

Full name
Age and gender
A 20–40 second emotional acting sample
Your recording device (iPhone or mic model)
Telegram username
Your weekly availability
Whether you work better alone or in a team

description:

title: Senior Electrician (Building)
description:
Senior Electrician (Building)

Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrician to handle electrical installations, maintenance, and repairs across our rental buildings. The role includes supervising junior electricians, ensuring all electrical work meets safety standards, and supporting smooth building operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Install, maintain, and repair electrical systems, wiring, lighting, and related components.
Inspect electrical panels, transformers, circuit breakers, and perform corrective maintenance.
Troubleshoot and diagnose electrical issues using proper tools and testing devices.
Review electrical plans, prepare work schedules, and support budgeting for electrical works.
Ensure proper connection of building electrical systems to main power sources.
Read and interpret technical diagrams, blueprints, and perform routine electrical maintenance.
Maintain documentation of all repairs, services, and ensure availability of required materials.
Coordinate with building management, tenants, vendors, and other professionals.
Train and guide junior electricians on installation and safety procedures.
Perform any other duties assigned by the manager.

Extensive knowledge of electrical systems and wiring;
Ability to read electrical blue prints, use hand tools and power tools;
Proficient in the use of test meters and other diagnostic equipment;
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills;
Physically able to conduct field work.
Years of experience: 3+ years and experience, in building residential construction is advantageous

title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer

Gross Monthly Salary: Based on the organization’s scale

Job Summary: The Digital Accounting and Finance Officer is responsible for managing and optimizing the organization’s financial operations using advanced digital tools and systems. This role blends traditional accounting functions with modern digital finance practices, including automation, data analytics, ERP integration, and fintech transaction management. The officer will oversee electronic payment channels such as Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, and other wallet services, ensuring seamless, secure, and compliant transaction flows. This position is critical to Haset IT’s operations, as it safeguards financial compliance with Ethiopian laws while driving efficiency, innovation, and transparency in digital financial processes.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Financial Operations

Maintain and manage financial data in ERP/accounting systems.

Oversee integrations with fintech platforms (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, banks’ digital wallets).

Automate routine accounting tasks and digital reconciliation processes.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Generate real-time dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI/Excel.

Analyze transaction volumes from electronic channels and provide insights for decision-making.

Monitor KPIs for digital payment adoption, processing costs, and error/fraud detection.

Accounts & Transactions

Manage digital accounts payable/receivable workflows.

Reconcile multi-gateway transactions (mobile money, online payments, wallets, and bank transfers).

Ensure secure settlement and timely collection from digital platforms.

Tax & Compliance

Prepare and file e-tax reports (VAT, WHT, income tax, pensions) electronically.

Ensure compliance with ERCA’s digital tax systems and fintech regulatory directives.

Stay updated on National Bank of Ethiopia fintech guidelines and interoperability standards.

Cash Flow, Payroll & Digital Gateways

Monitor online banking and mobile money cash flows daily.

Manage payroll through digital payroll systems with automated statutory deductions.

Ensure multi-channel settlement (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr) is tracked, reconciled, and secured.

Audit & Internal Controls

Maintain digital audit trails for fintech and ERP transactions.

Coordinate audits with external auditors and regulators, ensuring fintech compliance.

Implement fraud prevention and digital transaction monitoring systems.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Work with IT teams to ensure payment API integrations are secure and efficient.

Partner with Operations and HR to align payment flows with organizational goals.

Communicate with banks, fintech providers, and vendors through digital platforms.

Policy Development & Innovation

Develop digital finance policies for transaction security, reconciliation, and fraud prevention.

Contribute to Haset IT’s digital economy transformation by adopting fintech best practices.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

3–5 years of professional experience in accounting/finance (preferably in fintech, transportation, or tech).

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Peachtree/QuickBooks, and digital accounting systems.

Strong detail orientation and accuracy in digital record-keeping.

Preferred Qualifications (Optional):

Training or degree in Computer Science, IT, or Data Analytics.

Experience with ERP, mobile money reconciliation, or fintech platforms.

Exposure to digital tax filing and cloud-based financial systems.

Key Skills Required:

Expertise in fintech payment systems (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, bank APIs)

Strong communication and stakeholder management

Analytical and data-driven mindset

Digital literacy and adaptability

Attention to detail and accuracy

Teamwork and cross-functional collaboration

Risk management & fraud detection skills

title: Packer
description:
VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT

Company: Pave Logistics

Position: Packer

Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Employment Type: Full-time

Department: Warehouse / Logistics Operations

About Pave Logistics

Pave Logistics is a leading logistics service provider in Addis Ababa. We are committed to fast, safe, and reliable delivery services. We are currently looking for hardworking and organized individuals to join our warehouse team as Packers.

Position Summary

As a Packer, you will be responsible for preparing goods for shipment. Your main goal is to ensure that items are packed securely, labeled correctly, and ready for safe transport to our customers. This is a hands-on role that requires attention to detail and physical energy.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

• Packing Goods: Securely pack items into boxes, crates, or containers using appropriate packing materials (bubble wrap, foam, tape) to prevent damage during transit.

• Labeling: Accurately label packages with shipping information, including weight, destination, and product codes.

• Inspection: Check items for any defects or damages before packing and report issues to the supervisor immediately.

• Loading & Unloading: Assist in moving packed boxes to the loading area and help load trucks when necessary.

• Inventory Support: Assist in counting stock and keeping track of inventory levels.

• Cleanliness: Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area at all times.

Job Requirements

• Education: High School Diploma (10th or 12th grade complete) or Certificate in a related field.

• Experience: Previous experience in a warehouse, factory, or packing role is an advantage (but not mandatory; training will be provided).

• Skills:

o Good physical condition (ability to stand for long periods and lift moderate weights).

o Basic reading and math skills (to understand labels and count inventory).

o Strong attention to detail.

o Ability to work well in a team environment.

o Willingness to work flexible hours if needed.

How to Apply

Interested applicants who meet the above requirements are invited to submit their Application Letter and CV via email.

Application Deadline: 5 days from the date of this announcement.

Submit your application to: Email: pavehr@pave-logistics.com

Note: Please use the subject line "Application for Packer Position" when sending your email.

title: Senior System Administrator
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior System Administrator to join our IT Administration Section. This role is vital for ensuring business continuity, system reliability, and the secure operation of our IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will manage and optimize the company’s systems, servers, and domain environment while supporting the continuous improvement of IT services across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Configure, maintain, and optimize networked computer systems, servers, virtualization platforms, and enterprise applications.

• Administer and manage Active Directory, including user accounts, security groups, and access permissions.

• Monitor system performance, resource usage, and adherence to domain policies.

• Implement and maintain backup solutions, disaster recovery plans, and data protection mechanisms.

• Lead system upgrades, patching cycles, and deployment of new technologies.

• Test and validate new software deployments, GPO configurations, and security changes in a controlled test environment.

• Troubleshoot and resolve advanced system, hardware, and network issues.

• Design and implement system improvements, contributing to long-term IT infrastructure planning.

• Enforce system-level security best practices and safeguard critical IT assets.

• Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and support to junior IT staff.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, BIS, MIS, or a related field.

• Minimum 4 years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or advanced system administration role.

• Professional certifications are highly desirable (e.g., Microsoft Certified Windows Server Hybrid Administrator, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, VMware, CCNA/CCNP).

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise with Windows Server, Linux, and virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox).

• Good knowledge of cloud and security technologies, including Azure, identity management, and pfSense.

• Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise network protocols.

• Advanced experience with Active Directory, Azure AD, and GPO management.

• Strong background in system security, patch management, and disaster recovery planning.

• Ability to test, verify, and validate deployments before production release. Soft Skills

• Strong decision-making and analytical abilities.

• Excellent communication skills, especially when interacting with non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Excellent problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.

• Ability to align IT initiatives with organizational goals and priorities.

title: Compensation and Benefits Specialist
description: Job summary The Compensation and Benefits Specialist is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the organization’s compensation and benefits programs. This role requires strategic planning, market analysis, and collaboration with HR and leadership to ensure competitive and fair compensate. Main Duties and Responsibilities Collaborate with HR Analysts and leadership to define and implement the organization's compensation philosophy and strategy. Implement guidelines for salary ranges, pay scales, bonuses, and performance-based incentives, considering market data, internal evaluations, and budget constraints. Partner with HR Analysts to evaluate jobs based on market data and internal structures. Conduct market analysis to understand industry benchmarks, salary trends, and competitive practices. Finalize job grading structures and review salary structures with input from leadership, ensuring internal equity, market competitiveness, and alignment with organizational goals. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of salary structures, recommending adjustments as needed. Communicate new salary structures to employees, managers, and stakeholders, providing training and guidance on implementation. Explain and communicate benefits and incentives policies and programs to all employees. Manage the administration of benefits programs, including enrollment, eligibility verification, claims processing, and legal/regulatory compliance. Assess the organization's current benefits offerings, gather employee feedback, and identify areas for improvement. Collaborate with HR leadership to monitor the effectiveness of the benefits package through data analysis and feedback. Design incentive structures, variable pay models, and performance-based bonuses to motivate employees towards high performance. Communicate performance-based compensation programs to employees, explaining how metrics are tied to compensation outcomes and providing guidance. Analyze market data, industry trends, and internal structures to determine appropriate salary adjustments and promotions based on performance and market trends. Collaborate with HR Coordinators to review performance evaluations, market data, and employee feedback to determine salary adjustments and promotions. Communicate salary adjustments, promotions, or review outcomes to HR Coordinators, department heads, supervisors, and employees, ensuring transparency. Coordinate the implementation of salary adjustments, promotions, or reviews, updating employee records and documentation. Partner with HR Coordinators to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of salary administration processes, gathering feedback and proposing improvements. Communicate changes in HR policies, procedures, and compensation and benefits directly to employees. Conduct regular reviews of compensation and benefits programs to ensure they meet objectives and make adjustments based on feedback and analysis. Review compensation and benefits practices for compliance with relevant regulations. Collaborate with the HR Manager to implement programs that enhance employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention. Design competitive compensation packages and rewards systems to attract and retain top talent. Job Requirement BA/MBA in Management or a related field with a minimum of 7/5 years of experience of which 2 years is focused on compensation and benefits. Strong understanding of compensation strategy, benefits administration, and regulatory compliance. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to think strategically and implement effective compensation and benefits solutions. Proficiency in using HR software and systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Competency and Skills Strategic planning and organizational skills. Advanced knowledge of employment laws and regulations. Strong analytical and data interpretation abilities. Effective communication and negotiation skills. High level of confidentiality and ethical standards.

title: Facebook Ads Specialist
description:
Paid Ads Specialist (Meta Lead Generation AND Basic Google Ads) — Remote

Effortless Help LLC

Location: Remote
Schedule: Part-Time (10–20 hours/week)
Type: Part-Time / Long-Term
Compensation: Competitive — based on experience
Start Date: ASAP

About Us

Effortless Help LLC is a fast-growing U.S.-based Virtual Assistant and BPO agency that supports service businesses such as:

Appliance repair companies
Plumbers
Contractors
Landscapers
Home improvement businesses
Junk removal and gutter repair companies
These clients rely heavily on consistent local leads. We are seeking a part-time Paid Ads Specialist who can generate calls, form submissions, and booked jobs primarily using Meta Ads, with additional support in basic Google Search Ads.

Position Overview

This is a part-time, long-term role for someone skilled in:

Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) lead generation
Basic Google Search Ads (or willing to learn)
Ideal for someone who wants consistent weekly hours without full-time commitments.

Responsibilities

Meta Ads (Primary Duty)

Create and manage local lead generation campaigns
Build and optimize Meta lead forms
Test creatives, audiences, targeting, and hooks
Write clear, effective English ad copy
Optimize CPL and improve lead quality
Set up pixel tracking and conversion events
Provide weekly performance summaries and insights
Google Ads (Secondary Duty)

(Not expert-level; basic knowledge or willingness to learn is acceptable.)

Manage simple Google Search campaigns
Create call-only or location-based intent campaigns
Track conversions using UTMs and goal tracking
Optimize keywords and budgets
General

Analyze campaign data and adjust strategies
Conduct A/B tests for creatives and copy
Communicate clearly with the team
Work independently with minimal supervision
Ideal Candidate

Must-Have Qualifications

Proven experience running Meta Ads for local lead generation
Strong English communication skills
Experience generating leads for service-based industries (preferred)
Understanding of CPL, CTR, CPM, ROAS, and optimization strategies
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
Reliable, high-speed internet access
Nice to Have (Not Required)

Basic Google Search Ads experience
GoHighLevel or simple funnel-building experience
TikTok Ads knowledge
Basic creative editing (Canva or CapCut)
Experience working with appliance repair, plumbing, or contractor niches
Benefits

Part-time, flexible schedule
Long-term, consistent workload
Opportunity to grow within the company
Supportive and professional work environment
Performance-based bonuses
Work across multiple U.S. service businesses
How to Apply

Please send the following:

Resume
Portfolio or screenshots of past ad results
A short 1–2 minute voice or video introduction
Your part-time availability (hours per week)
Your hourly or monthly part-time rate
Email: nathan@effortlesshelp.com
Subject Line: Part-Time Paid Ads Specialist – [Your Name]

title: Senior Field Sales Representative
description:
AIT Technology is seeking a Field Sales Representative to introduce our edtech products to schools, training centers, and educational institutions across your assigned territory. This role focuses on territory management, client engagement, product demonstrations, and driving adoption of our educational solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Management: Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve targets and grow market share within your assigned region.
Client Engagement: Prospect, approach, and nurture relationships with decision-makers in schools, colleges, tutoring centers, corporate training departments, and other education-focused organizations.
Product Demonstrations: Present and demonstrate our edtech solutions (software, platforms, devices, or learning materials) to show value, ease-of-use, and learning outcomes.
Needs Assessment & Customization: Understand clients’ educational needs and constraints; work with internal teams to recommend tailored product configurations, packages, or pilot programs.
Onboarding Support: Coordinate product trials, onboarding, and initial training sessions with clients to ensure successful implementation and adoption.
Account Management: Maintain regular face-to-face visits, follow-ups, and relationship-building to drive renewals, upsells, and referrals.
Reporting: Maintain accurate CRM records, prepare sales reports, and share market and customer feedback to inform product improvements and strategy.
Targets & KPIs: Meet or exceed monthly/quarterly sales targets and key performance indicators.
Qualifications

Experience: Minimum 1 years proven success in field sales, preferably with exposure to B2B sales or selling to educational institutions.
Sector Fit: Experience or strong interest in the education sector and edtech solutions is highly desirable.
Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Results-Oriented: Demonstrated track record of achieving sales targets and delivering measurable outcomes.

title: junior Finance Clerk
description:
Job Title: Finance Clerk

Reports to: Finance Manager

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

Under the supervision of the Finance Manager, the Finance Clerk is responsible for supporting the day-to-day financial operations of EtCare SACCO. The role involves proper documentation, recording, scanning, and filing of all financial transactions and records. The Finance Clerk ensures accuracy, completeness, and compliance with the SACCO’s financial policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities

1. Documentation and Record Management

Prepare, scan, and file all financial documents according to EtCare SACCO’s documentation and labeling procedures.

Ensure that all vouchers, receipts, and supporting documents are properly verified and organized.

Maintain an efficient filing system (both digital and hard copy) for easy retrieval of financial records.

Support the Finance Manager in identifying and addressing missing or incomplete documents.

Facilitate document access for internal and external auditors.

2. Petty Cash Management

Handle day-to-day cash transactions and ensure proper recording and reconciliation.

Maintain accurate petty cash records and ensure all disbursements are properly approved.

Update the daily cash transaction journal and share it with the Finance team for posting.

Keep cash securely stored and ensure timely replenishment when balance reaches the minimum threshold.

Prepare and process statutory deductions such as income tax, pension, and withholding tax.

 

3. Bank and Payment Activities

Support in preparing payment instructions and assist in bank transfers and deposits.

Ensure payments are made according to approved financial procedures.

Issue and record withholding tax receipts where applicable.

Assist in managing staff provident fund payments and settlements.

4. Tax and Regulatory Compliance

Maintain and file withholding tax and other statutory deductions accurately and on time.

Support in preparing and submitting reports to relevant authorities such as ERCA.

Ensure all financial practices comply with SACCO policies and government regulations.

5. Additional Responsibilities

Assist the finance team in any other accounting or administrative tasks assigned by the Finance Manager.

Participate in periodic financial reviews and reporting activities.

Qualifications and Skills

Education: Diploma or BA degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Management.

Experience: fresh graduate.

Technical Skills:

Basic knowledge of accounting software and MS Office (Excel, Word).

Familiarity with Ethiopian tax laws and financial procedures.

Other Skills:

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Good communication skills in English and Amharic.

Integrity, confidentiality, and a strong sense of responsibility.

How to Apply

Interested and qualified applicants can send their CV and cover letter to saccosetcare051@gmail.com or alemnehmeseret@gmail.com or submit in person at EtCare SACCO Head Office Hayahulet golagul square.

title: M&E Officer
description:
Job Vacancy Announcement

Position Title: Monitoring & Evaluation Officer
Duty Station: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
Reports To: MEAL Coordinator

Employment Type: Full-time

Basic Salary: 23,000.00 & 10% transportation allowance and other Benefit packages
Number of Position(s): One
Closing Date: December 10, 2025.

Charity and Development Association (CDA) is a non‑governmental organization established in 1992 as a local NGO.CDA is a humanitarian organization that aims at socio-economic empowerment of the disadvantaged people through integrated development approach. CDA is working in various regions of Ethiopia Oromia, SNNPR, Somali, Afar, Addis Ababa City and others. As part of our commitment to internal growth and development, we are pleased to invite qualified External candidates to apply for MEAL Officer Position.

Job Summary

We are looking for experienced MEAL Officer. The Planning, Monitoring, Evaluation, officer manages information and reporting processes, develops appropriate methodologies and tools for evaluation, knowledge management and learning in program design and implementation. S/he will be responsible for the entire project cycle, from initial planning and setting up M&E systems to data collection, analysis, reporting, and learning. They ensure projects are on track, effective, and achieving their intended impact, and also contribute to capacity building in these areas.

ü  Formulate Annual Plans and Five Year Strategic Plan of the organization

ü  Prepare organizational plan and submit to concerned bodies of the organization;

ü  Prepare organizational annual calendar

ü  Inspects physical and financial progress of projects and communicate with concerned bodies for solution

ü  Monitoring and review of the implementation of annual Plan Schemes.

ü  Routine monitoring and field data collection

ü  Reporting quality & timeliness

ü  Beneficiary feedback and accountability systems

ü  Learning and documentation of project results

 

 

 

 

Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree (required) or Master’s degree (desirable) in fields like economics, development studies, public administration, social sciences, statistics, business, or related fields.

Excellent English & Amharic communication is mandatory; other local languages often preferred.
Working with international NGOs and understanding their specific requirements, reporting procedures and best practices is a significant advantage.

title: Customer Acquisition Officer
description:
We are looking for a full-time Customer Acquisition Officer to join our growing team! The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in similar positions and a strong understanding of customer acquisition strategies. Experience working in tech or fintech companies is a major advantage. Key Responsibilities:
  • Identify and acquire new customers to achieve growth targets
  • Research potential markets and customer segments to generate leads
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with potential and existing clients
  • Understand client needs and provide tailored solutions to drive acquisition
  • Collaborate with marketing and product teams to optimize acquisition strategies
  • Conduct presentations, product demos, and negotiate deals with prospects
  • Monitor, analyze, and report on customer acquisition performance and KPIs
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, client interactions, and sales progress
  • Participate in strategy planning, sales meetings, and process improvement initiatives
  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitors, and best practices to enhance acquisition efforts
Requirements:
  • 1–3 years of proven experience in customer acquisition or related roles
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • Experience in tech/fintech is highly desirable
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

title: Senior Accountant
description: Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Reporting & Records Management Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Maintain accurate general ledger accounts and ensure proper reconciliations. Monitor all accounting transactions and ensure they comply with company policies and IFRS. Handle accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and adjustments. 2. Accounts Payable & Receivable Review supplier invoices, payments, and expense records for accuracy and completeness. Monitor customer accounts and aging reports; follow up for timely collections. Ensure proper documentation for all cash and bank transactions. 3. Tax & Compliance Prepare and file monthly tax declarations including VAT, withholding tax, income tax, and pension contributions. Ensure compliance with ERCA requirements and prepare documents for audits. Support external auditors during annual audits. 4. Budgeting & Analysis Assist in preparing annual budgets and forecasts. Analyze variances between budgeted and actual financial performance. Provide financial insights to management for decision-making. 5. Cash Flow Management Monitor company cash flow, bank balances, and daily financial transactions. Prepare cash flow projections and report potential shortages or surpluses. 6. Payroll Support Review payroll calculations and ensure accurate posting to the accounting system. Ensure compliance with tax and pension deductions. 7. Leadership & Supervision Supervise and mentor junior accountants and cashier staff. Review accounting entries posted by team members for accuracy. Provide training to improve staff skills and ensure proper accounting procedures.

title: ፈርኒቸር ዲዛይን እና ኤስቲሜተር
description:
የሥራ መግለጫ

ክፍት የስራ ቦታ ማስታወቂያ፡ 3D ፈርኒቸር ዲዛይነር እና ኤስቲሜተር

ድርጅታችን የፈርኒቸር ዲዛይን እና ዋጋ ተመን (Estimation) ላይ በብቃት የሚሰራ ባለሙያ አወዳድሮ መቅጠር ይፈልጋል።

ዋና ዋና የሥራ ሀላፊነቶች፡

ከደንበኞች፣ ከድርጅቱ ወይም ከኢንተርኔት የሚገኙ የፈርኒቸር ዲዛይን ሀሳቦችን በSketchUp (ስኬች-አፕ) ሶፍትዌር ወደ 3D ዲዛይን መቀየር።
የድርጅቱን ሲስተም በመጠቀም ለዲዛይኖች ትክክለኛ ዋጋ ማውጣት (Cost Estimation)።
የተሰሩ ምርቶችን እና ዲዛይኖችን በድርጅቱ ፕላትፎርም ላይ መለጠፍ/ፖስት ማድረግ።
ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች፡

በቂ የኮምፒውተር እውቀት እና የኢንተርኔት አጠቃቀም ክህሎት ያለው/ላት።
SketchUp ወይም መሰል የ3D ሞዴሊንግ ሶፍትዌሮችን በመጠቀም መሰረታዊ እውቀት ያለው/ላት።
ተመራጭ (ግዴታ ባይሆንም ቅድሚያ የሚያሰጡ)፡

የግል ላፕቶፕ/ኮምፒውተር ያለው/ላት (አማራጭ የሪሞት/ከቤት የመስራት እድል ስላለን)።
የመኖሪያ አድራሻው በቦሌ ቡልቡላ አካባቢ ወይም ለስራ ቦታው ቅርብ የሆነ/ች።
ክፍያ እና ጥቅማጥቅም፡

ደመወዝ፡ 3,000 - 5,000 ብር (እንደ ብቃት ይወሰናል) + እና ኮሚሽን፡ ከሽያጭ ወይም ከስራው ውጤት 1% እስከ 5% ተጨማሪ ኮሚሽን።
የስራ ቦታ፡ ቡልቡላ ማሪያም ማዞሪያ

ማመልከቻ፡ ብቃት እና ፍላጎት ያላችሁ ተወዳዳሪዎች፡

ሙሉ ስም
የትምህርት ደረጃ እና የስራ ልምድ
የሰሯቸው የ3D ሞዴሎች ናሙና (Portfolio)
የመኖሪያ አድራሻ፣ ፆታ፣ እድሜ እና ስልክ ቁጥር
በቴሌግራም 0909832222@kingswoodsys ላይ በመላክ መመዝገብ ትችላላችሁ።

title: Head of Furniture Design Department
description:

Maintain documentation, quality standards, and design guidelines.

Present design concepts to management and key clients.

3–5 years of experience in furniture design, with 2+ years in a leadership role.

Strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, technical ability, and product design experience.

Solid understanding of furniture production methods, materials, ergonomics, and sustainability.

Proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Maxcut, Lumion (equivalent rendering) and Adobe Creative Suite.

Strong leadership, communication, and project management skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects under deadlines.

Strong experience with WordPress themes, plugins, and customization. Knowledge of eCommerce platforms, payment gateways, and API integrations. Familiarity with AI tools and technologies for web development. Access to a Windows-based computer. Proven ability to manage web projects effectively and meet deadlines. Experience in creating workflows, documentation, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Skills and Qualifications: Positive attitude with a collaborative mindset. Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage complex requirements and deliver effective results.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

Type of Employment: Full Time

Location: Addis Ababa

Reports to: Finance Manager

About Dodai

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025.

Purpose of the Position

The Senior Accountant will be responsible for overseeing financial operations, preparing financial statements, conducting analysis, and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our financial records. This role requires a deep understanding of manufacturing cost accounting, inventory management, applicable tax laws and financial reporting standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Reporting:

Ensure compliance with accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, GAAP).
Cost Accounting & Inventory Management:

Oversee cost accounting processes, including job costing and variance analysis.
Track inventory levels, cost of goods sold (COGS), and prepare cost build worksheets  for imports
Conduct periodic inventory audits and support inventory reconciliation.
Ensure physical stock movement and  balance aligned with system recordings
Budgeting & Forecasting:

Collaborate with the finance team to prepare annual cash forecasts.
Analyze budget variances and provide actionable insights to the finance management team.
General Ledger & Month-End Close:

Manage the month-end and year-end closing processes, including journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations.
Maintain the accuracy and completeness of the general ledger.
Tax Compliance:

Ensure compliance with tax regulations and prepare tax returns (e.g., VAT, corporate income tax).
Coordinate with external auditors and tax authorities as required.
Internal Controls & Compliance:

Maintain and improve internal control systems to prevent errors and fraud.
Ensure adherence to company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
Financial Analysis:

Conduct financial analysis to evaluate business performance, operational efficiency, and cost-saving opportunities.
Assist with ad hoc financial projects and reports as needed.
Additional Duties: Undertake any other tasks as directed by your manager to support the overall financial health and strategic goals of the company.
Qualifications & Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
2-3 years of experience in accounting, preferably in the manufacturing sector.
Strong knowledge of cost accounting, inventory management, and financial reporting.
Proficiency in accounting software & Microsoft Excel.
Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

title: Junior Battery Swapper
description:
Junior Battery Swapper

Type of Employment: Permanent

Location: Addis Ababa

Reports to: Battery Swapper team lead

About Dodai

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making urban e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025. It’s thus looking to engage dynamic Ethiopian talent to ensure the achievement of its goals.

Job Summary:

We are seeking enthusiastic and reliable Junior Battery Swappers to join our growing operations team in Addis Ababa. As a Junior Battery Swapper, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our electric two-wheeler riders have seamless access to fully charged batteries. Utilizing our user-friendly mobile application, you will support customers in need of a battery swap and efficiently exchange their depleted battery for a fully charged one. This role requires excellent time management, attention to detail, and a commitment to providing exceptional customer service.

Responsibilities:

Perform Battery Swaps: Execute battery swaps within 2 minutes per transaction, using the Dodai mobile app to record and verify each exchange.
Customer Support at Station: Greet every rider warmly and make them feel valued. Provide clear instructions, assist with any questions, and troubleshoot basic issues such as app errors or incorrect battery insertion. Your goal is to ensure every rider leaves with a positive impression of Dodai’s service and proudly recommends our brand to others.
Inventory Tracking: Monitor and record the number of charged, depleted, or faulty batteries at your station. Flag shortages or overstock to your supervisor.
Battery Charging & Handling: Place depleted batteries on the charging rack according to safety procedures. Disconnect and store fully charged batteries in their designated slots.
Daily Equipment Check: Inspect chargers, tools, and the battery rack for functionality. Immediately report any malfunctions or damage.
Safety Compliance: Wear gloves and follow safety procedures at all times. Ensure the station is clean and hazard-free.
Reporting: Log issues such as damaged batteries, misbehaving app functions, or customer complaints and share with your supervisor daily.
Flexible Tasks: Assist in minor repairs, restocking, or setting up new swapping stations as needed.
Other Duties as Assigned:
Carry out any additional tasks or responsibilities as instructed by your supervisor or manager to support smooth station operations.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (2025 Graduate only).
Proven ability to use mobile applications confidently and accurately in a work environment (e.g., for deliveries, ride-hailing, or logistics). This is a critical skill for operating the battery swapping system.
Must have android smart phone
Willing to work from 8 AM to 5 PM or 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Sunday, with one day off on a shifting schedule
Excellent time management and organizational skills.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
Ability to work independently and efficiently.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
A positive attitude and a customer-centric approach.
Ability to lift and carry batteries weighing up to 32 kilos (weight may vary).
Familiarity with electric vehicles or battery technology is a plus.
Other duties assigned by supervisor

title: ፈርኒቸር ዲዛይን እና ኤስቲሜተር
description:
የሥራ መግለጫ

ክፍት የስራ ቦታ ማስታወቂያ፡ 3D ፈርኒቸር ዲዛይነር እና ኤስቲሜተር

ድርጅታችን የፈርኒቸር ዲዛይን እና ዋጋ ተመን (Estimation) ላይ በብቃት የሚሰራ ባለሙያ አወዳድሮ መቅጠር ይፈልጋል።

ዋና ዋና የሥራ ሀላፊነቶች፡

ከደንበኞች፣ ከድርጅቱ ወይም ከኢንተርኔት የሚገኙ የፈርኒቸር ዲዛይን ሀሳቦችን በSketchUp (ስኬች-አፕ) ሶፍትዌር ወደ 3D ዲዛይን መቀየር።
የድርጅቱን ሲስተም በመጠቀም ለዲዛይኖች ትክክለኛ ዋጋ ማውጣት (Cost Estimation)።
የተሰሩ ምርቶችን እና ዲዛይኖችን በድርጅቱ ፕላትፎርም ላይ መለጠፍ/ፖስት ማድረግ።
ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች፡

በቂ የኮምፒውተር እውቀት እና የኢንተርኔት አጠቃቀም ክህሎት ያለው/ላት።
SketchUp ወይም መሰል የ3D ሞዴሊንግ ሶፍትዌሮችን በመጠቀም መሰረታዊ እውቀት ያለው/ላት።
ተመራጭ (ግዴታ ባይሆንም ቅድሚያ የሚያሰጡ)፡

የግል ላፕቶፕ/ኮምፒውተር ያለው/ላት (አማራጭ የሪሞት/ከቤት የመስራት እድል ስላለን)።
የመኖሪያ አድራሻው በቦሌ ቡልቡላ አካባቢ ወይም ለስራ ቦታው ቅርብ የሆነ/ች።
ክፍያ እና ጥቅማጥቅም፡

ደመወዝ፡ 3,000 - 5,000 ብር (እንደ ብቃት ይወሰናል) + እና ኮሚሽን፡ ከሽያጭ ወይም ከስራው ውጤት 1% እስከ 5% ተጨማሪ ኮሚሽን።
የስራ ቦታ፡ ቡልቡላ ማሪያም ማዞሪያ

ማመልከቻ፡ ብቃት እና ፍላጎት ያላችሁ ተወዳዳሪዎች፡

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Job Title: Regional Sales Manager Job Type: Full-time – On-site Workplace: Adama, Modjo, Arsi Experience Level: Senior Salary: Gross 25,341 + Target commission + Incentives Application Deadline: Very Urgent Company Overview
  • Phoenix Ethiopia is a leading distribution company specializing in telecommunications, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), and pharmaceuticals. With a strong footprint across Addis Ababa, Oromia, Sidama, SNNP, and Amhara regions, we deliver comprehensive route-to-market solutions that empower partner brands to thrive in Ethiopia’s dynamic market. Our success is driven by technology-enabled distribution, superior local expertise, and a commitment to guarantee sales growth and market coverage for our partner brands.
Job Summary
  • We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Regional Sales Manager to lead and oversee sales operations across Adama, Modjo, and Arsi. The RSM will manage Area Sales Managers, Shop Managers, and field teams to ensure strong market execution, high performance, and growth in the assigned territories.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead, coach, and supervise Area Sales Managers and Shop Managers under the assigned clusters.
  • Support and supervise Area Sales Managers and Shop Managers to ensure smooth operations.
  • Plan and execute regional sales strategies to meet monthly and quarterly targets.
  • Communicate operational updates, challenges, and solutions promptly to management.
  • Oversee the hiring process for Area Sales Supervisors and other field positions under the assigned clusters, in line with company HR procedures.
  • Analyze market trends, identify new business opportunities, and act strategically to expand regional coverage.
  • Monitor market performance and competitor activities across the cluster.
  • Ensure effective route planning, product availability, and market visibility.
  • Strengthen relationships with distributors, retailers, and partners.
  • Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, operational standards, and reporting guidelines.
Requirements
  • Degree in Marketing, Business, Management, or related field.
  • Must be a resident of Arsi, Modjo, Adama, Batu, Shashemene, or Bishoftu.
  • Experience as Shop Manager, TDR, or TAR at Safaricom is highly preferred.
  • Experience as Sales Manager, Cluster Lead, or Area Supervisor in FMCG companies (Beer, water, packed foods, edible oil, snack…e.t.c companies) is a strong advantage.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and reporting skills.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and analytical abilities.
  • Ability to work under pressure and deliver consistent results.
  • Speaking Oromiffa is mandatory

title: Junior Biomedical Engineer
description:
Job Title: Biomedical Engineer Personnel-Fresh level

Reports to: Technical Manager / Service Manager /
Department: Biomedical Engineering / Technical Services

Job Summary:

The Biomedical Engineer Personnel is responsible for the sales, installation, calibration, maintenance, and repair of medical equipment, ensuring compliance with safety and performance standards. The role also supports training of healthcare professionals, provides technical guidance during procurement and tender processes, and contributes to innovation and quality improvement in medical device management.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Equipment Sales,Installation & Commissioning

Install and set up medical devices and systems at hospitals, clinics, and partner facilities.
Conduct performance tests and ensure equipment is functioning according to manufacturer specifications.
Provide on-site demonstrations and technical support.
2. Maintenance & Repair

Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance of biomedical equipment.
Diagnose faults and troubleshoot hardware/software issues.
Ensure timely repair to minimize equipment downtime.
3. Calibration & Quality Assurance

Perform calibration of medical devices to ensure accuracy and safety.
Maintain records of service history, calibration certificates, and technical reports.
Ensure compliance with ISO standards, manufacturer guidelines, and national regulations.
4. Technical Support & Training

Provide training to healthcare staff on proper use and care of medical equipment.
Offer technical advice during product demonstrations and tender evaluations.
Support sales and customer service teams with technical knowledge.
5. Documentation & Reporting

Prepare service reports, maintenance logs, and technical documentation.
Maintain inventory of spare parts, tools, and consumables.
Assist in preparing technical specifications for procurement.
6. Compliance & Safety

Ensure all biomedical equipment complies with regulatory and safety standards.
Adhere to company policies, occupational safety, and environmental regulations.
Participate in audits and inspections when required.
Qualifications & Skills:

Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering
Minimum 0 years of experience in biomedical equipment sales,installation, service, or maintenance
Knowledge of medical equipment (diagnostic, surgical, laboratory, or imaging devices).
Proficiency in using biomedical testing tools and calibration devices.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Good communication and training abilities.
Willingness to travel for site visits and installations.
High integrity, attention to detail, and teamwork spirit.
Salary

·       Attractive

·       We will review and contact eligible candidates for more interview

·       Application deadline: In 10 days after posted

title: Chief Marketing Officer
description: We are looking for an exceptional Chief Marketing Officer to provide strong leadership, strategic direction, and operational excellence across all marketing functions. This role demands a visionary marketer who can blend creativity, analytics, market insight, and team leadership to drive brand growth and business expansion. The ideal candidate has 3–5 years of progressive marketing experience, including leadership responsibilities, and a proven track record of driving measurable results through innovative strategies and high-performance teams. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Leadership & Growth Direction Develop and oversee the company’s full marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Lead market analysis and insights to identify opportunities, customer needs, and competitive positioning. Define long-term brand vision and marketing roadmap. Advise the CEO and executive team on marketing performance, industry trends, and growth strategies. 2. Brand Management & Positioning Strengthen and evolve the company brand in the market. Ensure consistent messaging, tone, and visual identity across all platforms and campaigns. Lead PR initiatives, media engagements, and brand partnerships. 3. Marketing Campaign Leadership Plan and execute large-scale, high-impact campaigns across digital and traditional channels. Lead product marketing strategies, go-to-market execution, and promotional activities. Oversee creative direction, campaign architecture, messaging, and storytelling. Ensure all campaigns are ROI-driven and performance-optimized. 4. Digital Marketing Excellence Lead digital strategy: SEO, SEM, social media, ads, content, email, and growth marketing. Improve online visibility, traffic, conversions, and customer retention. Use analytics tools to track performance and optimize campaigns based on insights. 5. Team Leadership & Collaboration Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing marketing team. Create a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and excellence. Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, IT, and Operations to ensure unified objectives. Manage relationships with agencies, influencers, and media partners. 6. Performance Measurement & Reporting Set marketing KPIs and monitor performance across all channels. Present monthly and quarterly marketing performance reports to executive leadership. Optimize budgets, resources, and campaign spending for maximum efficiency. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field. 3–5 years of marketing experience, with leadership responsibilities included. Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns and marketing teams. Strong understanding of digital marketing, analytics, and customer acquisition. Excellent communication, presentation, and strategic decision-making skills. Ability to lead large projects and deliver under tight deadlines. Preferred Experience in EdTech, Technology, SaaS, or digital product environments. Strong business acumen with experience working closely with executive teams. Master’s degree is an added advantage. Core Competencies Strategic leadership and business mindset Strong creative and analytical balance Powerful storytelling and communication abilities Data-driven decision-making High emotional intelligence and team leadership skills Ability to manage complex projects and multiple stakeholders Why Join Us? Lead the entire marketing direction of an innovative, growing organization Work directly with top leadership to shape the future of the company Opportunity to build and develop a high-performing marketing team Attractive compensation and clear career progression How to Apply: Send your CV and a short cover letter explaining why you’re the right fit for this role.

title: Office Lawyer
description:
Position Summary

The Office Lawyer will manage the legal affairs of Adil Corporate Group (ACG), ensuring all operations and contracts comply with national laws and company policies. The position involves drafting and reviewing legal documents, providing legal advice, representing the company when necessary, and safeguarding the organization’s legal interests.

Main Responsibilities

Draft, review, and update contracts, agreements, and legal documents.
Advise management on legal rights, obligations, and risk mitigation.
Ensure compliance with Ethiopian laws and regulations related to corporate and labor matters.
Represent the company in court or before legal authorities when required.
Maintain organized legal records, permits, and licenses.
Liaise with external lawyers, government offices, and regulatory bodies.
Support the development and enforcement of company policies and procedures.
Qualifications & Requirements

Education

Bachelor’s Degree (LL.B) in Law from a recognized university.

Experience
Minimum of 2 years of experience as an office lawyer or in court practice.

Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of Ethiopian commercial, labor, and contract law
Excellent communication and drafting skills
Analytical, detail-oriented, and organized
High level of integrity and confidentiality
Fluent in Amharic and English.
Key Attributes

Reliable and ethical professional.
Proactive and solution-focused mindset.
Strong negotiation and advisory skills.
Able to work independently and handle multiple priorities.
Compensation and Benefits

Competitive salary and benefits commensurate with experience, with room for professional growth and advancement.
How to Apply: Send your CV and a short cover letter explaining why you’re the right fit for this role.

title: Junior Import Operation Officer
description:
Junior Import Operation Officer

Type of Employment: Full Time

Location: Addis Ababa

Reports to: Import Operations Supervisor

About Dodai

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making urban e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025. It’s thus looking to engage dynamic Ethiopian talent to ensure the achievement of its goals.

Purpose of the Position

AS a Junior Import Operation Officer will assist the Dodai team in managing international trade, logistics, and customs clearance processes. In addition, Junior Import Operation Officer will handle documentation, coordinate shipments, and ensure compliance with import regulations, supporting the seamless and efficient movement of goods.

Key Responsibilities

Organize and review import documents to ensure compliance with customs requirements.
Track incoming shipments, update reports, and liaise with suppliers and freight forwarders.
Assist in clearance processes and help resolve customs issues.
Maintain accurate import records and assist in preparing shipment and cost reports.
Take initiative in communication and gain practical experience in customs regulations, international trade, and the full import process.
Collaborate with internal teams to address their requirements and ensure timely communication of key updates.
Stay updated on new customs regulations, directives and international trade developments that may impact Dodai’s operations.
Monitor social media and news from authorities regarding local and international trade, including potential issues affecting Dodai.
Track and analyze changes in inland and sea freight rates, sea routes and other cost related data for import operations.
Maintain and update KPIs and raw data used for import operation decision making and performance analysis.
Assist with all departmental tasks and follow instructions from your supervisor as needed.
Requirement

Bachelor's degree in International Business / Trade, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics or a related field.
0 to 1 year experience.
Keen interest in import/export operations and international trade.
Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
Attention to detail with a focus on precision.
Strong communication skills in both English and Amharic.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team and adapt to a fast-paced environment.

title: Accountant / Finance Manager
description:
Companies:

Leeds Legal Solutions Ltd

Ibiab Systems Ltd

DIY UK Immigration Services (Non-trading)

Ibiab Property and Investments Ltd (Non-trading)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled, organised, and proactive Accountant / Finance Manager to oversee the full financial operations of our group of companies. The role involves managing multiple entities, ensuring compliance with financial regulations, preparing accurate reporting, and supporting strategic business decisions.

A key part of this position also involves assisting with funding applications, including preparing financial projections, supporting documentation, and helping to secure grants, loans, and investment opportunities.

This is a full-time, fully remote position requiring a dependable, detail-oriented professional who can work independently and uphold strict confidentiality. The successful candidate must be available during 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management Across All Companies

- Manage end-to-end finance operations for all active and non-trading companies in the group.

- Maintain accurate and separate financial records for each entity.

- Provide consolidated financial insights when required.

- Financial Reporting & Compliance

- Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

Generate management accounts, business performance analysis, and director-level reports.

- Ensure compliance with UK tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory filing requirements.

- Support annual audits and external financial reviews.

Accounting Operations

- Oversee accounts payable and receivable functions.-

- Manage payroll processing and ensure accuracy in statutory deductions.

- Perform bank reconciliations and maintain updated financial ledgers.

- Track and manage cashflow across all group companies.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Strategic Support

- Prepare annual budgets and monitor performance against targets.

- Develop financial forecasting models to support business growth and planning.

- Identify financial risks, opportunities, and efficiency improvements.

Funding Applications

- Assist in preparing and submitting funding applications for:

-Grants, Business loans, Government support schemes, Investment proposals

- Produce financial projections, cashflow forecasts, and required supporting documentation.

- Research available funding opportunities and advise directors.

- Financial Controls & Systems

- Strengthen and maintain internal financial processes, controls, and procedures.

- Optimise and manage accounting software and financial systems.

- Provide strategic financial guidance to company directors.

- Maintain secure, compliant handling of all financial data.

Required Qualifications & Experience

- 3–5+ years of professional experience in accounting or finance management.

- Experience supporting funding applications is an advantage.

- Strong understanding of UK accounting standards, compliance, and reporting.

- Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., Xero, QuickBooks, Sage) and advanced Excel skills.

- Excellent analytical, organisational, and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently in a full-time remote environment.

- Must have a reliable computer and stable internet connection.

-High standards of confidentiality, accuracy, and attention to detail.

What We Offer

- ETB 40,000 net monthly salary

- Fully remote work arrangement

- Fixed working hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST

- Opportunity to work across multiple growing companies

- Supportive leadership and potential for long-term career development

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

Type of Employment: Full Time

Location: Addis Ababa

Reports to: Finance Manager

About Dodai

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025.

Purpose of the Position

The Senior Accountant will be responsible for overseeing financial operations, preparing financial statements, conducting analysis, and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our financial records. This role requires a deep understanding of manufacturing cost accounting, inventory management, applicable tax laws and financial reporting standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Reporting:

Ensure compliance with accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, GAAP).
Cost Accounting & Inventory Management:

Oversee cost accounting processes, including job costing and variance analysis.
Track inventory levels, cost of goods sold (COGS), and prepare cost build worksheets  for imports
Conduct periodic inventory audits and support inventory reconciliation.
Ensure physical stock movement and  balance aligned with system recordings
Budgeting & Forecasting:

Collaborate with the finance team to prepare annual cash forecasts.
Analyze budget variances and provide actionable insights to the finance management team.
General Ledger & Month-End Close:

Manage the month-end and year-end closing processes, including journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations.
Maintain the accuracy and completeness of the general ledger.
Tax Compliance:

Ensure compliance with tax regulations and prepare tax returns (e.g., VAT, corporate income tax).
Coordinate with external auditors and tax authorities as required.
Internal Controls & Compliance:

Maintain and improve internal control systems to prevent errors and fraud.
Ensure adherence to company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
Financial Analysis:

Conduct financial analysis to evaluate business performance, operational efficiency, and cost-saving opportunities.
Assist with ad hoc financial projects and reports as needed.
Additional Duties: Undertake any other tasks as directed by your manager to support the overall financial health and strategic goals of the company.
Qualifications & Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
2-3 years of experience in accounting, preferably in the manufacturing sector.
Strong knowledge of cost accounting, inventory management, and financial reporting.
Proficiency in accounting software & Microsoft Excel.
Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

title: Senior Accountant
description: On behalf of our client, Raval Steel Manufacturing PLC, we are looking for a qualified and motivated candidate for the following position: Position: Senior Accountant Location: Head Office, Addis Ababa Reports to: Finance Manager Number of Positions: 2 Salary: Negotiable (based on current salary and company scale) Application Deadline: December 7, 2025 About Raval Steel Manufacturing PLC Raval Steel Manufacturing PLC, located in the Bahir Dar Industrial Zone, is the largest steel factory in the Amhara Region and one of Ethiopia’s leading producers in the steel manufacturing sector. The company is known for its high-quality products and commitment to supporting major construction and infrastructure projects nationwide. About the Role Raval Steel Manufacturing PLC is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Accountant to join its Finance Department. The Senior Accountant will be responsible for financial reporting, document verification, bank reconciliation, journal entries, tax-related processes, and other core accounting functions. The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, and capable of handling multiple accounting tasks with accuracy and timeliness. Key Responsibilities Prepare financial reports to support the assessment of company assets, liabilities, profit/loss, and tax obligations. Perform journal voucher postings to general and subsidiary ledgers, including payroll-related entries. Process financial information related to credit sales, loans, and other financial assistance while assessing associated risks. Collect, organize, and follow up on financial documents from departments and monitor financial obligations. Handle miscellaneous payments, tax documentation, budgeting, asset management, and other accounting tasks. Reconcile bank accounts as soon as statements are received and submit reports to the Finance Manager. Journalize transactions such as bank advices, insurance-related entries, supplier invoices, and accruals. Verify the accuracy of daily cash deposit reports, sales invoices, and other financial documents. Review petty cash reports, invoices, petty cash requests, and perform periodic summaries. Ensure proper documentation and timely closure of goods-in-transit and import-related financial activities. Confirm sequential recording of cash receipts and cash sales invoices. Perform regular posting, summarizing, and reporting of periodic accounting tasks. Verify payroll calculations and ensure proper recording of payables (taxes, pension, etc.). Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and submit them to the Finance Manager. Perform other related duties assigned by the immediate supervisor. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related fields Six years of demonstrated experience in accounting roles (senior-level experience preferred). Strong knowledge of financial reporting, bank reconciliation, and journal entries. Familiarity with tax laws, asset management, and import-related accounting (goods in transit). Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills. Ability to meet strict deadlines and work under minimal supervision. Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills. Female candidates are preferred and encouraged to apply How to Apply Interested and qualified applicants are invited to send their CV, cover letter, and relevant documents to: info@ethiocv.com  Please use “Senior Accountant – Raval Steel” as the email subject line. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
