title: Junior Multimedia Designer Job Description
description:
Junior Multimedia Designer Job Description

Job Title: Junior Multimedia Designer

Department: Commercial

Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Type of Employment: Full-Time

Reports To: Marketing Specialist

About Dodai:

 

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two-wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025. It’s thus looking to engage dynamic Ethiopian talent to ensure the achievement of its goals.

Purpose of the Position:

The Junior Multimedia Designer at Dodai supports the marketing team by creating engaging visual and multimedia content that strengthens the Dodai brand and boosts lead generation. This role contributes to the production of high-quality graphics, videos, animations, and digital assets that enhance brand visibility and support marketing campaigns. The Junior Multimedia Designer also collaborates with other departments to ensure consistent and impactful communication across all platforms, helping the company achieve its overall mission.

Responsibilities:

Assist in designing marketing materials, including posters, banners, social media posts, and  promotional assets.
Create and edit short-form videos, animations, and motion graphics for campaigns.
Support photo and video shoots, including setup, lighting assistance, and basic editing.
Help maintain brand consistency across all creative outputs.
Prepare production-ready files for print and digital use.
Collaborate with the marketing team to develop creative concepts and campaign visuals.
Update and adapt existing designs based on feedback.
Organize and manage multimedia files, assets, and project folders.
Research current design trends and bring new ideas to the team.
Design digital and print graphics including posters, banners, flyers, social media posts, and promotional materials.
Create visually appealing layouts, illustrations, and marketing graphics that align with the Dodai brand.
Assist in designing UI elements or simple product mockups when needed
Carry out any additional tasks or responsibilities as instructed by your supervisor or manager to support smooth operations.
Qualifications:

6 months - 1 year experience  in Multimedia Design, Graphic Design, Communication Design, or a related field.
Basic skills in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects).
Experience using Canva for quick design tasks and template-based content creation.
Familiarity with AI-powered design tools
Understanding of typography, layout, and visual composition.
Basic knowledge of video production and editing.
Ability to take feedback and work collaboratively in a team environment.
Strong attention to detail and time management skills.
English proficiency is a plus
A portfolio showcasing design or multimedia work (student projects acceptable).
Familiarity with motion graphics and simple animations.
Knowledge of photography or videography.
Experience creating content for social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).

title: Operations Coordinator
description: Job Description Ethio College Prep is an educational consultancy that provides the tools, knowledge, and resources for Ethiopian students to get world-class education abroad. Our mission is to help our students become better equipped for real life through exceptional education. If you’re someone who can take charge, inspire accountability, and build systems that scale efficiently, we want you on our team. This isn’t about just managing operations; it’s about transforming the way we work and preparing the company for growth. What We Need We need an Operations Coordinator who’s a natural leader. Someone who doesn’t shy away from responsibility but actively takes ownership. Someone who thrives when the pressure is on, who can see inefficiencies, and immediately knows how to fix them. Step into Leadership: We need you to step in immediately, take full control of our daily operations, and make sure things run smoothly. Improve Systems: Our systems are good, but they’re not robust enough to handle large scale. You’ll be expected to refine, overhaul, or rebuild systems to increase efficiency and ensure we’re ready for the challenges of a growing company. Create Accountability: We need someone who can set clear expectations and ensure discipline across the board. We want you to be the hands-on leader the team needs. Drive Results: We need someone who can increase team output and ensure performance stays high. You'll be responsible for setting higher standards, ensuring that tasks are completed on time, and ensuring the entire operation is more efficient. Bring New Ideas: You’re not just someone who can put out fires—you’ll be a catalyst for new ideas. What You’ll Do Oversee Daily Operations: You’ll fully take charge of the day-to-day, managing people, resources, and processes to keep things running smoothly. Systematize and Improve: Identify inefficiencies, fix broken processes, and ensure we have scalable systems to meet our growth targets. Keep Everyone Accountable: Create a culture of accountability and high performance by setting clear expectations and holding the team to them. Provide Leadership: Be the leader that others can rely on. You’ll set the tone, enforce standards, and make sure things are moving forward with intention and discipline. Scale with Us: As we grow, you’ll be responsible for making sure that systems and operations can scale with us. You’ll need to anticipate the challenges of scaling and ensure we’re prepared. Who You Are You take ownership of everything you do. When something breaks, you fix it—and you’re never afraid of a challenge. You lead by example and you understand that accountability starts with you. You’ll be the role model for your team. You’re systematic, a problem solver, and you see the bigger picture. Complex operational challenges don’t overwhelm you; you break them down and get to work. You are hands-on and know that leadership isn’t just about strategy—it’s about execution. You’re in the trenches and making things happen every day. Why You’ll Love This Role Autonomy: You’ll own your role and make the decisions. As we scale, you’ll have the freedom to shape operations and systems from the ground up. Growth Opportunity: As we grow, so will you. There’s plenty of room for growth in the role, and you’ll have the chance to make a lasting impact. Real Impact: You’ll be directly responsible for helping us scale and improve. Your decisions will drive results and shape the future of the company. What We Expect Proven experience leading operations in a fast-growing company. A leadership style that drives accountability and raises team performance. Ability to take ownership, work autonomously, and overcommunicate about progress and decisions. title: Phlebotomist
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking five (5) skilled, diligent, and compassionate Licensed Phlebotomists to join our dynamic laboratory team. The successful candidates will be responsible for collecting blood samples from patients with precision and care, ensuring the integrity of specimens, and providing excellent patient service. This role is critical to the accurate diagnosis and treatment of our patients.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

•  Perform venipuncture and capillary punctures on patients of all ages using correct techniques and standard precautions.

•  Properly identify patients and label specimens accurately to prevent errors.

•  Ensure patient comfort and safety before, during, and after the procedure.

•  Prepare specimens for laboratory testing, processing, and transportation.

•  Maintain and manage phlebotomy supplies and equipment, ensuring cleanliness and sterility.

•  Adhere strictly to infection control, biohazard safety, and hospital protocols.

•  Collaborate effectively with laboratory staff, nurses, and physicians.

•  Perform other related duties as assigned by the Laboratory In-Charge or supervisor.

Job Requirements:

•  Educational Qualification: Diploma or Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology.

•  Experience: Minimum of 2-3 years of proven practical experience as a Phlebotomist in a hospital or clinical setting.

•  License: A valid professional license from the relevant Ethiopian health professional regulatory body (e.g., Ethiopian Medical Laboratory Association, Ethiopian Nurses Association) is MANDATORY.

•  Skills & Competencies:

o  Excellent proficiency in venipuncture and specimen handling techniques.

o  Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a compassionate bedside manner.

o  Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

o  High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

o  Basic knowledge of laboratory information systems is an advantage.

o  Good physical stamina to stand for extended periods.

Gender: Both Male and Female applicants are encouraged to apply.

title: የሹፌር ባለሙያ
description:
በድጋሚ የወጣ የሥራ ማስታወቂያ

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ ፡-

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን ቀልጣፋ፣ የሥራ ተነሳሽነት ያለውና በጥንቃቄ  በኃላፊነት በማጓጓዝ የስራ ቁሳቁሶችን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ የሚያደርስ ብቁ የሹፌር ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡

መስፈርቶች፡

• ሕጋዊ የሆነ እና የታደሰ /የሚሰራ/ መንጃ ፍቃድ ያለው።

•  መንጃ ፈቃዱ ከታደሰ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት  ያለው ከዚያ በላይ የሆነ፡፡

• አዲስ አበባን እና አካቢዎቿን በሚገባ መንገድ የሚያውቅ  መሆን አለበት፡፡

• የትራፊክ ህጎች እና የከተማ መንገዶች የማሽከርከር እውቀት ያለው።

• ጥንቃቄ በተሞላበት በተሰጠው የመንገድ ህገ ደንብ የመንገድ ፍጥነት መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

• ከሰው ጋር ጥሩ መግባባትና  የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ችሎታ ያለው።

• ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው በራሱ የሚተማመን ፣ ደህንነቱን የጠበቀ አነዳድ የሚከተል፡፡

• ታማኝ፣ የድርጅቱን ሰዓት የሚያከብር።

• አመልካች ሰፈሩ  ጉርድ ሾላ፣ ገርጂ  አቅራቢያ ወይም ያልራቀ ቢሆን ይመረጣል፡፡

• እድሜው ከ25-30 ክልል ውስጥ የሆነ፡፡

• ማስታወቂያ ቤት የሰራ / የማስታወቂያ ሥራ በቂ ዕውቀት ያለው መሆን አለት፡፡

•  አውቶማቲክ ሆነ ማንዋልም  የመኪና /ማርሽ/  በሚገባ መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

የሥራ ዓይነት:- የሙሉ ጊዜ

ደመወዝ:-  ወርሃዊ

እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል፡-

Auditing financial information

Perform related duties as assigned by the company manager

Fluent in Peachtree accounting software.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field.

Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a team.

ደመወዝ:-  ወርሃዊ

እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል፡-

·      አመልካቾች የት/ት ማስረጃ፣ የሥራ ልምድ እና የታደሰ መንጃ ፈቃድ ኮፒውን በአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን በአካል ም ሆነ በቴሌግራም ማቅረብም ሆነ መላክ ይችላሉ፡፡

title: Website Developer- LMS
description:
Website Developer – Leaning Management System

Job Title: Website Developer- LMS

Location: (Ethiopia - Remote or Hybrid Options Available)

Remuneration:

Deadline for application: 19/12/25

Contract type: Part-time/ Contract

Purpose of the Post:

We are looking for an experienced and creative Website Developer & Graphic Designer to join our

growing team. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated professional who can combine

strong technical web development skills with outstanding design capabilities and the ability to

leverage modern AI tools to enhance digital content creation and to develop a Learning

Management System.

About the Role

The successful candidate will lead the development, maintenance, and optimisation of multiple

WordPress-based websites. You will be responsible for designing visually appealing graphics,

improving user experience, and ensuring all digital platforms reflect our brand identity and strategic

objectives. You will also play a key role in producing AI-enhanced content for our websites, social

media channels, and digital campaigns.

Experience in creating or adapting educational content, particularly for platforms such as Tutor

LMS will be a significant advantage, as we continue to expand our digital learning offerings.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and update WordPress websites, including theme customisation, plugin

management, and site optimisation.

• Create high-quality graphic assets for websites, social media, presentations, and marketing

campaigns.

• Use AI tools to generate and refine website content, social media posts, visuals, and digital

assets.

• Ensure websites are responsive, secure, and aligned with best UX/UI practices.

• Collaborate with internal teams to translate project goals into effective digital outputs.

• Support the development of digital learning resources and online course materials (e.g., via

Tutor LMS).

• Monitor website performance and analytics to drive ongoing improvements.

1Required Skills and Qualifications

• Strong proficiency in WordPress development, including customisation and troubleshooting.

• Excellent design skills with a strong portfolio (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva or

similar).

• Demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly) for content and

design.

• Solid understanding of website performance, SEO fundamentals, and user experience

design.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently to deadlines.

• Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

Preferred (Bonus) Skills

• Experience creating or managing online learning content (e.g., Tutor LMS, LearnDash,

Moodle).

• Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

• Experience with branding and marketing campaigns.

• Ability to develop graphics or animations for educational content.

Confidentiality

Due to the sensitive nature of some projects, all candidates must be prepared to handle company

and client information with the utmost confidentiality and discretion. Upon acceptance of the

position, the selected candidate will be required to sign a Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure

Agreement. Breach of confidentiality will be treated as a serious offence and may lead to

disciplinary or legal action.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and performance-based incentives

• Opportunity to work with a global team on impactful projects

• Flexible working hours and remote work options

• Professional development and training support

• Inclusive and collaborative work culture

Application Process

1. Send a link showcasing your previous work and an up-to-date CV demonstrating your

competencies in the above areas to the following email address:

ethiopia@bridgedimpact.com

title: Angular Frontend Developer
description: Job Description  We are seeking a passionate Angular Frontend Developer who will craft intuitive, high-performing, and visually appealing web interfaces that bring complex business logic to life through elegant design and user experience. The ideal candidate will demonstrate deep technical expertise in Angular, a keen eye for UI/UX detail, and a commitment to clean, maintainable code. The role involves close collaboration with backend engineers, UX/UI designers, and product managers to deliver responsive, accessible, and scalable web applications. You will contribute to code reviews, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning in helping foster a culture of technical excellence and teamwork. What You Will Do  Develop and maintain responsive web applications using Angular, TypeScript, and RxJS, ensuring exceptional performance, scalability, and accessibility. Implement clean, maintainable, and reusable UI components using modern Angular architecture patterns (modules, services, directives, pipes). Collaborate with UX/UI designers to transform wireframes and prototypes into elegant, user-friendly interfaces while ensuring design consistency and usability across browsers and devices. Integrate with RESTful APIs and microservices, ensuring data flow and application state are efficiently managed (NgRx or equivalent). Participate in code reviews and pair programming, providing constructive feedback, enforcing code standards, and mentoring junior developers. Ensure quality through testing, including unit testing with Jasmine/Karma and end-to-end testing with Cypress or Playwright. Contribute to design system and component library development, maintaining consistency and reusability across projects. Document and maintain technical specifications, UI guidelines, and best practices to support continuous team learning and onboarding. Stay current with emerging front-end trends, tools, and techniques, and help drive UI/UX and performance improvements across the platform. Collaborate cross-functionally with backend engineers, DevOps, QA, and product teams during sprints and releases to ensure smooth delivery. Required Experience and Qualifications  3+ years of hands-on experience in frontend development using Angular (v17+). Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field. Proficiency in Angular, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript (ES6+). Solid understanding of RxJS, NgRx (or other state management libraries), and Angular reactive forms. Strong grasp of HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS, with attention to responsive design and accessibility (WCAG). Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working closely with backend services. Knowledge of UI/UX principles, including layout design, typography, and visual hierarchy. Familiarity with Tailwind CSS or other UI component libraries. Experience with frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite, or Angular CLI). Familiarity with testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, or Jest). Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). Understanding containerization (Docker) and basic DevOps workflows. Exposure to micro-frontend architecture or monorepo tools (Nx) is an advantage. Behavioral Competencies  Passionate about user experience, demonstrating attention to detail and empathy for end-users. Continuously learning and growing, keeping up with the latest front-end trends, tools, and frameworks. Collaborative and team-oriented, communicating effectively with technical and non-technical peers. Proactive problem solver, capable of identifying and addressing issues before they escalate. Ethical and accountable, ensuring reliability, trust, and professionalism in all interactions. Adaptable and resilient, remaining focused and positive in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

title: Faceless Content Creator (Video Editor)
description:
About the role

We are looking for Faceless Content Creators to join our team. As the first hires for our growth team, you will be responsible for filming faceless content, sourcing raw clips, and quickly and precisely editing videos quickly content, managing our accounts, and fostering a vibrant community across our social media channels.

The ideal candidate is a tasteful and efficient video editor and an enthusiastic team player, who is excited to help experiment and scale our growth channels. Great candidates will have the opportunity to grow into leadership positions in our growth team.

 

Please note: while faceless content creators are not expected to film content with their face, they will still need to film content without their face, e.g., holding up a post-it note in front of a screen, or filming themselves using a phone. If you're not camera-shy, check out our Content Creator.

Job duties

Create content

Collaborate with our Head of Growth to film and edit multiple variations of content fast
Identify and jump on big trends immediately, to create content in a short time period
Analyse performance and iterate on content to improve our marketing strategy
Manage social media accounts

Warm up each account to train the algorithm
Represent our brand and build community through comment replies, direct messages, and engaging with the wider creator team online
Job Qualifications

Great communication skills: Strong written and spoken English to communicate with the team and our audience.
“Faceless video sense”:  You should have a sense of what content will perform well for a youthful (20s-30s), “Western” audience. You must know what memes and videos are performing well and trending, so that you can source raw clips to edit into these videos.
Video editing skills: Experience with (or willingness to learn) CapCut that enables you to quickly edit videos, and especially create fast variations of videos.
Nice to have, but not required

Viral sense: A deep understanding of social media trends and how to replicate content that appeals is key. If you do not have this skill, a willingness to learn is more than enough.
We offer

Remote work, autonomy and independence, and a competitive salary
Growth opportunities with a large impact to define the trajectory of a fast-growing startup
A dynamic role with a huge variety of exposure from tech to product to finance
P.S. Since we’re a global team, all communication is in English.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
We are looking for a proactive and communicative Administrative Assistant to support our energy storage and renewable energy business expansion in Ethiopia. This role involves external liaison, internal administrative tasks, and coordination of meetings. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills and experience working with local authorities or in a cross-cultural environment.

Key Responsibilities:

1. External Communication:

- Liaise with local government bodies and financial institutions, including EIC, Customs, Immigration, Transport Authorities, and banks.

- Assist in handling permits, visas, logistics, customs clearance, and other official procedures.

2. Internal Administrative Support:

- Maintain proper filing and management of company documents, contracts, and correspondence.

- Assist in office administration, procurement, and vendor coordination.

- Support the Vice-General Manager with scheduling, travel arrangements, and expenses.

3. Meeting & Event Coordination:

- Organize and coordinate internal and external meetings, including logistics and documentation.

- Assist in planning company events, visits, and training sessions.

4. Additional Interfaces (as needed):

- Monitor local regulations related to energy and investment.

- Provide light translation support (Amharic/English).

- Assist with project documentation and HR-related administrative tasks.

 

Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in any field.

- At least 2 years of experience in administration, assistant, or external liaison roles. Experience with government/ institutional coordination is a plus.

- Fluency in English and Amharic, Oromigna(both written and verbal).

- Proficient in MS Office and familiar with document management.

- Strong communication, multitasking, and organizational skills.

- Responsible, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.

- Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

title: የሹፌር ባለሙያ
description:
በድጋሚ የወጣ የሥራ ማስታወቂያ

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ ፡-

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን ቀልጣፋ፣ የሥራ ተነሳሽነት ያለውና በጥንቃቄ  በኃላፊነት በማጓጓዝ የስራ ቁሳቁሶችን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ የሚያደርስ ብቁ የሹፌር ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡

መስፈርቶች፡

• ሕጋዊ የሆነ እና የታደሰ /የሚሰራ/ መንጃ ፍቃድ ያለው።

•  መንጃ ፈቃዱ ከታደሰ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት  ያለው ከዚያ በላይ የሆነ፡፡

• አዲስ አበባን እና አካቢዎቿን በሚገባ መንገድ የሚያውቅ  መሆን አለበት፡፡

• የትራፊክ ህጎች እና የከተማ መንገዶች የማሽከርከር እውቀት ያለው።

• ጥንቃቄ በተሞላበት በተሰጠው የመንገድ ህገ ደንብ የመንገድ ፍጥነት መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

• ከሰው ጋር ጥሩ መግባባትና  የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ችሎታ ያለው።

• ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው በራሱ የሚተማመን ፣ ደህንነቱን የጠበቀ አነዳድ የሚከተል፡፡

• ታማኝ፣ የድርጅቱን ሰዓት የሚያከብር።

• አመልካች ሰፈሩ  ጉርድ ሾላ፣ ገርጂ  አቅራቢያ ወይም ያልራቀ ቢሆን ይመረጣል፡፡

• እድሜው ከ25-30 ክልል ውስጥ የሆነ፡፡

• ማስታወቂያ ቤት የሰራ / የማስታወቂያ ሥራ በቂ ዕውቀት ያለው መሆን አለት፡፡

•  አውቶማቲክ ሆነ ማንዋልም  የመኪና /ማርሽ/  በሚገባ መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

 

 

የሥራ ዓይነት:- የሙሉ ጊዜ

ደመወዝ:-  ወርሃዊ

 

እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል፡-

·      አመልካቾች የት/ት ማስረጃ፣ የሥራ ልምድ እና የታደሰ መንጃ ፈቃድ ኮፒውን በአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን በአካል ም ሆነ በቴሌግራም ማቅረብም ሆነ መላክ ይችላሉ፡፡

·      እንዲሁም  ቅጥር  ሲፈፀም  በቂ የዋስ አይነት ማቅረብ የምትችሉ እና ከመንግስት መስራያ ቤት ዋስ/ተያዥ ማቅረብ  እችላለሁ የምትሉ  ብቻ   በዚህ ማስታወቂያ ማመልከት ትችላላችሁ፡፡

 

የስራ አድራሻ፡-

• አዲስ አበባ አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ጉርድ ሾላ - ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  በትራፊክ መብራት  አካባቢ፣  ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ ላይ እንገኛለን፡፡  ለዚህ ማስታወቂያ ከሐሙስ ቀን  26/03/2018 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ እስከ ሰኞ 29 /03/2018 ድረስ የምንቀበል ይሆናል፡፡

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description: Dodai Manufacturing PLC (Dodai) is seeking a highly skilled Senior Marketing Specialist to join our growing team and lead strategic marketing initiatives that elevate our brand and drive business growth. As a Senior Marketing Specialist, you will play a key role in executing marketing strategies to promote our brand, products, and services. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive marketing initiatives, increase brand awareness, generate leads, and support overall business objectives. This position requires a combination of strategic thinking, creativity, strong communication skills, and a solid understanding of digital marketing channels. Key Responsibilities: Implement comprehensive marketing plans to support business goals, including brand positioning, lead generation, and customer acquisition. Create and execute targeted campaigns across various channels, including digital, social media, email marketing, content marketing, and events. Conduct market research and analyze industry trends to identify market opportunities, competitive landscape, and customer insights. Create engaging and persuasive marketing collateral, such as brochures, presentations, website content, and sales materials. Manage and optimize digital marketing campaigns, including search engine marketing (SEM), search engine optimization (SEO), pay-per-click (PPC) advertising, and social media advertising. Plan and coordinate launch and marketing events, trade shows, and conferences Monitor and analyze marketing campaign performance, generate reports, and provide actionable insights to drive continuous improvement. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product development and others to ensure consistent messaging and alignment of marketing efforts. Maintain brand consistency and ensure adherence to brand guidelines across all marketing initiatives. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in marketing, and make recommendations for incorporating them into the company's marketing strategies. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field. 5 years of proven experience in marketing, preferably in a similar role within a fast paced industry Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques, tools, and platforms, including SEO, SEM, social media marketing, email marketing, and content marketing. Proficient in using marketing automation software, CRM systems, and analytics tools to track campaign performance and measure ROI. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling marketing content and present ideas effectively. Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a keen eye for detail. Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Familiarity with market research methodologies and tools. Demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive results.

title: AI Video Content Creator
description:

Tinova is a marketing agency that leverages AI to reduce marketing and operational costs, making
branding and marketing more accessible to startups and SMEs. We specialize in branding, digital
content, and below-the-line (BTL) brand activation, with a strong focus on startups and FMCG
industries.

Our vibrant remote team brings together diverse creative talent from different backgrounds,
working collaboratively to deliver affordable, measurable, and impactful solutions. By blending
creativity with AI-driven efficiency, we help businesses grow smarter and faster.

About the Role
We are seeking a part-time Video Content Creator with expertise in AI creative video content
ideation, editing, generative AI visual generation who has also audience physchology experience. This role is ideal for a creative professional who
can transform prompts into high-quality images and videos, while also driving ideation and
storytelling to elevate our clients’ brands.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop professional and human- ideated scripts and storyboards for short- and long-
form content.
• Edit, refine, and optimize content for various digital platforms.
• Generate high-quality video and image content using AI tools and platforms.
• Lead creative ideation, including mood board and concept visualization.
• Collaborate with the creative team to align visuals with campaign objectives.
• Ensure brand consistency across all visual outputs.
• Stay up to date with the latest AI tools, trends, and best practices in content creation.

Qualifications and Skills
• A degree in design, video production or any related field
• 2+ years of experience in video recording (actual professional camera-based video
shooting), editing and production, video content creation, or related field.
• A must expertise in AI-driven tools for image and video generation.
• Strong skills in professional and human ideated scriptwriting, mood board, and visual
storytelling.
• Proficiency in editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent).
• A strong, creative eye, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects.
• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a remote setup.
• Past work experience in creative agency is a must.

title: Faceless Content Creator (Video Editor)
description:
About the role

We are looking for Faceless Content Creators to join our team. As the first hires for our growth team, you will be responsible for filming faceless content, sourcing raw clips, and quickly and precisely editing videos quickly content, managing our accounts, and fostering a vibrant community across our social media channels.

The ideal candidate is a tasteful and efficient video editor and an enthusiastic team player, who is excited to help experiment and scale our growth channels. Great candidates will have the opportunity to grow into leadership positions in our growth team.

Please note: while faceless content creators are not expected to film content with their face, they will still need to film content without their face, e.g., holding up a post-it note in front of a screen, or filming themselves using a phone. If you're not camera-shy, check out our Content Creator.

 

Create content

Collaborate with our Head of Growth to film and edit multiple variations of content fast
Identify and jump on big trends immediately, to create content in a short time period
Analyse performance and iterate on content to improve our marketing strategy
Manage social media accounts

Warm up each account to train the algorithm
Represent our brand and build community through comment replies, direct messages, and engaging with the wider creator team online
Job Qualifications

Great communication skills: Strong written and spoken English to communicate with the team and our audience.
“Faceless video sense”:  You should have a sense of what content will perform well for a youthful (20s-30s), “Western” audience. You must know what memes and videos are performing well and trending, so that you can source raw clips to edit into these videos.
Video editing skills: Experience with (or willingness to learn) CapCut that enables you to quickly edit videos, and especially create fast variations of videos.
Nice to have, but not required

Viral sense: A deep understanding of social media trends and how to replicate content that appeals is key. If you do not have this skill, a willingness to learn is more than enough.
We offer

Remote work, autonomy and independence, and a competitive salary
Growth opportunities with a large impact to define the trajectory of a fast-growing startup
A dynamic role with a huge variety of exposure from tech to product to finance
P.S. Since we’re a global team, all communication is in English.

title: Project Bid Sales Supervisor (Technical Sales Engineer)
description:
Job Title: Project Bid Sales Supervisor (Technical Sales Engineer)

Reports To: Project Sales Manager

The Project Bid Sales Supervisor with an Electrical Engineering background to lead our project bid sales efforts. This role is crucial for ensuring the technical accuracy and competitiveness of our proposals for Romel's branded electrical products. The ideal candidate will supervise a team focused on technical sales engineering, bridging the gap between client requirements, our product capabilities, and effective bid submissions.

Key Responsibilities:

·       Technical Bid Management & Supervision:

o   Supervise and mentor a team of Technical Sales Engineers or Bid Coordinators, providing technical guidance and support in the preparation of project bids and proposals.

o   Oversee the entire technical aspect of the bid lifecycle, from initial requirement analysis to final proposal submission, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project specifications.

o   Ensure all project bids accurately reflect Romel's electrical product capabilities, technical specifications, and relevant industry standards.

·       Technical Sales Engineering & Solution Design:

o   Lead the technical analysis of client project requirements, working closely with the Project Sales Manager and Project Sales Representatives to understand their needs for electrical solutions.

o   Design and propose comprehensive technical solutions using Romel's electrical product portfolio, optimizing for performance, cost-effectiveness, and client satisfaction.

o   Prepare detailed technical specifications, schematics, and product configurations for inclusion in bid documents.

·       Cross-functional Technical Coordination:

o   Act as a key technical liaison between the project sales team and internal departments, including Engineering, Production, and R&D, to ensure feasible and innovative solutions are proposed.

o   Collaborate with Supply Chain Management to understand product availability and lead times for specialized electrical components required for projects.

o   Work closely with the Customer Service's technical team to ensure proposed solutions can be effectively supported post-sale.

·       Market & Product Expertise:

o   Maintain an in-depth understanding of Romel's full range of electrical products, including their technical advantages, applications, and certifications.

o   Monitor industry trends, competitor technical offerings, and new technologies in the electrical sector to inform bid strategies and product development.

o   Support the sales team in providing detailed product knowledge and technical explanations to project clients.

·       Documentation & Compliance:

o   Ensure all technical documentation, certifications, and compliance requirements for project bids are meticulously prepared and submitted.

o   Conduct technical reviews of proposals before submission to identify and rectify any discrepancies or potential issues.

Qualifications:

·       Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering is mandatory; Master’s degree preferred.

·       Minimum of 7 years of experience in technical sales, sales engineering, or bid management, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership role, specifically within the electrical products or related industries.

·       Proven expertise in designing and specifying electrical systems and components.

·       Strong understanding of project lifecycle management and bid processes for large-scale electrical projects.

·       Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·       Proficiency in relevant engineering software (e.g., CAD software, simulation tools) and CRM systems.

·       Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for technical detail and accuracy.

·       Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

·       Knowledge of relevant industry standards, codes, and regulations for electrical installations

title: Quality Control Officer
description:
Romel General Trading PLC is seeking a motivated and dedicated quality control officer who has an interest in the coffee sector and a strong desire to advance within the industry. This individual will support the Coffee Quality Manager in evaluating and ensuring the quality of all coffees that arrive at our laboratory. Furthermore, this person will aid our quality department in managing laboratory inventory, optimizing laboratory processes, preparing and dispatching samples to clients, and upholding cleanliness in the lab.

JOB SUMMARY: To document, organize, prepare, and support the analysis of coffee samples for the sales team and buying team.

JOB OBJECTIVES AND DIMENSIONS: Organize all aspects of coffee quality and sampling programs in the office, sample receiving, sample roasting, cupping, cleanup, sample inventory, documenting, and providing buying and selling teams with accurate and timely coffee quality information.

 

Duties and Responsibilities:

Ø    Support the company in improving coffee quality through cupping and client feedback.

Ø    Help gather coffee samples from clients and other sources.

Ø    Organize and manage the inventory of all coffee samples.

Ø    Milling received samples from producers, screening, and recording the weight result of the screened coffee

Ø    Prepare samples for cupping (hulling, roasting, weighing, grinding, etc.) daily;

Ø    Keep laboratory and cupping supplies clean and ready for use.

Ø    Maintain laboratory equipment and sample management in the laboratory

Ø    Prepare cupping reports in consultation with the company’s coffee quality control status.

Ø    Conduct cupping sessions and provide cupping notes.

Ø    Perform physical grading (defects, screen size, moisture).

Ø    Approve/reject coffee lots based on quality standards.

Ø    Inspect warehouse storage and processing quality.

Ø    Ensure samples match export quality requirements.

Ø    Maintain quality reports and documentation.

Ø    Work with suppliers/farmers to improve coffee quality.

Ø    Any other reasonable duty as may be assigned that is consistent with the nature of the job and its level of responsibility

 

Qualifications:

·       Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Food Science, Agronomy, or a related discipline.

•         2 to 3 years of experience in coffee quality control.

•         Proficiency in cupping and identifying coffee defects (training from ECX or the Coffee and Tea Authority in cupping is advantageous).

•         Familiarity with Ethiopian coffee varieties and export regulations.

•         Exceptional record-keeping, self-direction, and motivation for organizing, computer proficiency

● Knowledge of coffee tasting and brewing

·       Strong communication and reporting abilities

title: Junior Multimedia Designer
description:
Junior Multimedia Designer

Job Title: Junior Multimedia Designer

Department: Commercial

Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Type of Employment: Full-Time

Reports To: Marketing Specialist

About Dodai:
Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two-wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025. It’s thus looking to engage dynamic Ethiopian talent to ensure the achievement of its goals.

Purpose of the Position:
The Junior Multimedia Designer at Dodai supports the marketing team by creating engaging visual and multimedia content that strengthens the Dodai brand and boosts lead generation. This role contributes to the production of high-quality graphics, videos, animations, and digital assets that enhance brand visibility and support marketing campaigns. The Junior Multimedia Designer also collaborates with other departments to ensure consistent and impactful communication across all platforms, helping the company achieve its overall mission.

Responsibilities:

Assist in designing marketing materials, including posters, banners, social media posts, and  promotional assets.
Create and edit short-form videos, animations, and motion graphics for campaigns.
Support photo and video shoots, including setup, lighting assistance, and basic editing.
Help maintain brand consistency across all creative outputs.
Prepare production-ready files for print and digital use.
Collaborate with the marketing team to develop creative concepts and campaign visuals.
Update and adapt existing designs based on feedback.
Organize and manage multimedia files, assets, and project folders.
Research current design trends and bring new ideas to the team.
Design digital and print graphics including posters, banners, flyers, social media posts, and promotional materials.
Create visually appealing layouts, illustrations, and marketing graphics that align with the Dodai brand.
Assist in designing UI elements or simple product mockups when needed
Carry out any additional tasks or responsibilities as instructed by your supervisor or manager to support smooth operations.
Qualifications:

6 months - 1 year experience  in Multimedia Design, Graphic Design, Communication Design, or a related field.
Basic skills in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects).
Experience using Canva for quick design tasks and template-based content creation.
Familiarity with AI-powered design tools
Understanding of typography, layout, and visual composition.
Basic knowledge of video production and editing.
Ability to take feedback and work collaboratively in a team environment.
Strong attention to detail and time management skills.
English proficiency is a plus
A portfolio showcasing design or multimedia work (student projects acceptable).
Familiarity with motion graphics and simple animations.
Knowledge of photography or videography.
Experience creating content for social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).

title: ሞተረኛ
description:
የስራ መደቡ መጠሪያ : ሞተረኛ

የስራ ቦታ: አዲስ አበባ

የስራ ድርሻ/ሃላፊነት

መላክ እና መሰብሰብ ያለባቸውን እቃዎች እና ሰነዶች በሰአቱ እንዲሁም ደህንነታቸው በተጠበቀ ሁነታ ማድረስ/መሰብሰብ
በሎጂስቲክስ ቡድን የሚሰጡትን የእንቅስቃሴ እቅዶች መከተል
የማድረስ እንቅስቃሴዎችን በወረቀት እንዲሁም የስልክ መተግበሪያን በመጠቀም በአግባቡ መመዝገብ
የትራፊክ እንዲሁም የድርጅቱን ህጎች እና ደንቦች ማክበር
የሞተር ሳይክሉን ንጽህና ፣ ጉዞ ከመጀመር በፊት አጠቃላይ ጤንነቱን ማረጋገጥ፤ ችግር ካለም ለሚመለከተው ሰው ማሳወቅ
የእቃ ጭነት በሚኖርበት ጊዜ የሎጂስቲክስ እና የንብረት ክፍል ሰራተኞችን ማገዝ
የተለያዩ ሞተር ሳይክሎች የሙከራ እንቅስቃሴ በሚኖርበት ጊዜ የሙከራ ቡድኑን ማገዝ
ሌሎች ድርሻዎችም እንደ አስፈላጊነቱ
መስፈርት

10 ክፍል የጨረሰ (ቢሆን ይመረጣል)
ሞተረኛ በመሆን ቢያንስ 1 አመት የሰራ
ስማርት ሰልክ መጠቀም የሚችል
የታደሰ የሞተር መንጃ ፍቃድ
የአዲስ አበባ ዋና እና አቁዋራጭ መንገዶችን ማወቅ

Senior Cash Crop Production Manager
description:
EVERGREEN FARM - Jigjiga

Position: Senior Cash Crop Production Manager

Location: Dhagahle (30 minutes from Jigjiga)

Employment Type: Full-time

Deadline: 10Working Days

About Evergreen Farm

Evergreen Farm is a growing agricultural enterprise located 8 minutes from Dhagahle town, with easy access via Bajaj transport. We cultivate high-demand cash crops and maintain fruit trees, shade trees, and herbs using sustainable and organic farming practices.

A clean living room, kitchen, and restroom are available on-site for the successful candidate.

 

Job Purpose

The Senior Cash Crop Production Manager will lead and coordinate all field operations for onion, tomato, watermelon, and related crops—from land preparation to harvest. The role also includes managing natural compost production, maintaining fruit and shade trees, and ensuring high-yield, high-quality output.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

•⁠  ⁠Plan, organize, and supervise seasonal crop production cycles.

•⁠  ⁠Prepare organic compost using cow/goat manure and available green waste.

•⁠  ⁠Monitor crop performance, irrigation schedules, and water efficiency.

•⁠  ⁠Identify and manage pests and diseases using environmentally safe approaches.

•⁠  ⁠Oversee fruit trees, shade trees, and herb gardens.

•⁠  ⁠Lead, train, and supervise field workers; enforce work quality and safety standards.

•⁠  ⁠Maintain accurate production records and advise on improvements.

•⁠  ⁠Ensure proper handling and maintenance of farm tools and equipment.

•⁠  ⁠Promote soil regeneration and long-term fertility management.

Required Qualifications

•⁠  ⁠BSc/MSc in Plant Science, Horticulture, Agronomy, or related fields.

•⁠  ⁠5–7 years of hands-on experience in vegetable farming, preferably with onion, tomato, and watermelon.

•⁠  ⁠Demonstrated experience in organic composting and soil health management.

•⁠  ⁠Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

•⁠  ⁠Ability to work in rural farm environments and manage teams effectively.

•⁠  ⁠High level of integrity, responsibility, and reliability.

Competencies

•⁠  ⁠Solid agronomic knowledge and field planning skills.

•⁠  ⁠Ability to train and coordinate workers.

•⁠  ⁠Strong organizational and follow-up abilities.

•⁠  ⁠Proactive, disciplined, and detail-oriented.

Workplace & Benefits

•⁠  ⁠Location: Evergreen Farm, Dhagahle area (30 minutes from Jigjiga)

•⁠  ⁠On-site housing: Clean living room, kitchen, restroom, and a calm environment

•⁠  ⁠Salary: Negotiable, based on qualifications and experience

•⁠  ⁠Availability: Immediate

title: Data clerk Engineer
description:
The requirements for document controllers in project engineering usually include the following aspects:

Professional knowledge and skills

Basic engineering knowledge: Familiar with the basic concepts, construction techniques, quality standards and acceptance specifications in fields such as construction engineering, municipal engineering, and water conservancy; able to read construction drawings and understand engineering structures and construction processes.

File management knowledge: Master the basic principles, methods and processes of file management; be familiar with national and local laws, regulations, standards and specifications regarding engineering document management, such as "Code for Filing and Arrangement of Construction Engineering Documents" and "Regulations on Construction Engineering Document Management".

Computer skills: Proficient in using office software such as Word, Excel, and PDF for document editing, form creation and data processing; familiar with the operation of engineering document management software or file management systems, and able to input, store, retrieve and statistics documents.

Work ability and quality

Ability to collect and sort out documents: Able to collect various types of project documents in a timely and comprehensive manner, including design documents, construction records, inspection reports, meeting minutes, etc., and sort them out in accordance with the specified classification, numbering and filing requirements to ensure the completeness and accuracy of the documents.

Data analysis and processing ability: Analyze and sort out the collected data, extract key information to provide data support for project decision-making, quality control and schedule management; able to compile engineering statistical reports, progress reports and other documents to reflect the actual situation of the project.

Communication and coordination ability: Maintain close communication with project team members, design units, supervision units, construction units, etc., coordinate the transmission and sharing of documents; able to clearly express their own opinions and suggestions, and solve problems in the process of document management.

Carefulness and patience: Document management work is cumbersome and detailed, requiring a high sense of responsibility and patience to ensure that each document is accurate and free from omissions or errors.

Professionalism and attitude

Confidentiality awareness: Engineering documents may involve commercial secrets, technical secrets or sensitive information. Document controllers must strictly abide by the confidentiality system to ensure the security and confidentiality of the documents.

Teamwork spirit: As a member of the project team, document controllers need to work closely with others to complete project tasks; able to actively support and assist the work of other departments, contributing to the smooth progress of the project.

Learning ability: The engineering field is constantly developing, with new specifications, standards and technologies emerging. Document controllers need to have strong learning ability to update their knowledge in a timely manner and adapt to changes in work.

Work experience and certificates

Relevant work experience: Those with a certain number of years of experience in engineering document management are preferred; familiar with the document management processes and requirements of different types of engineering projects, and able to quickly adapt to new project environments.

Professional qualification certificates: Some projects may require document controllers to hold relevant professional qualification certificates, such as document controller post qualification certificates, file management certificates, etc., to prove their professional ability and qualifications.

title: Logistic specialist
description:
Vacancy Announcement: Logistics Specialist

Position: Logistics Specialist

Location: Addis Ababa, Bole Bulbula

Employment Type: Full-Time

Application Deadline: 15 December 2025

About the Position

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Logistics Specialist to manage and coordinate our end-to-end logistics activities. The ideal candidate will oversee procurement, transportation, warehousing, and distribution operations, ensuring timely, efficient, and cost-effective logistics performance. The candidate must also have strong Single Window System (customs automation) capability for seamless import/export processing.

Key Responsibilities

1. Logistics & Supply Chain Coordination

Plan, coordinate, and monitor all logistics operations including transportation, warehousing, and distribution.

Ensure timely movement of inbound and outbound shipments.

Optimize logistics processes to improve efficiency and reduce operational costs.

2. Procurement & Vendor Management

Coordinate with local and international suppliers, transporters, and service providers.

Ensure timely procurement of materials and equipment.

Negotiate and evaluate vendor performance for quality and reliability.

3. Inventory & Warehouse Management

Monitor inventory levels and ensure proper stock control.

Oversee storage, handling, and dispatch of goods.

Conduct regular stock checks and reconcile discrepancies.

4. Documentation & Single Window Processing

Prepare and manage shipping documents, invoices, and customs documentation.

Process import/export shipments efficiently using the Ethiopian Single Window System.

Ensure compliance with customs regulations, tax procedures, and company policies.

Maintain accurate logistics records and prepare weekly/monthly reports.

5. Cross-Functional Coordination

Collaborate closely with finance, procurement, project teams, and warehouse staff.

Support logistics planning for ongoing and upcoming projects.

Identify and resolve logistics challenges proactively.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Logistics & Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Management, or related fields.

Experience:

Minimum 3–5 years professional experience in logistics, supply chain, procurement, or warehouse operations.

Hands-on experience with Ethiopian Single Window System is mandatory.

Experience with import/export and customs clearance is a strong advantage.

Skills:

Strong knowledge of logistics processes, warehouse management, and transportation operations.

Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

ERP or logistics software experience is a plus.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.

Ability to multitask, work under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.

High attention to detail and strong organizational ability.

Additional Requirements:

High level of integrity and professionalism.

Strong teamwork and independent work capabilities.

Willingness to travel when required.

title: Odoo Developer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Odoo Developer with a strong background in customizing Odoo for manufacturing companies. You must have proven experience working with Odoo 13+, with a solid understanding of the Manufacturing (MRP), Inventory, Purchase, Quality, PLM, and Accounting modules.

Key Responsibilities

1. Odoo Customization & Development

Develop new Odoo modules or extend existing ones
Configure work centers, bill of materials (BOM), routings, and scrap management
Implement production planning, scheduling, and shop-floor automation features
Customize manufacturing reporting, dashboards, and KPIs
2. System Integration

Integrate Odoo with machines, IoT devices, barcode scanners, or third-party systems
Design APIs and connectors where required
3. Deployment & Testing
Perform system testing, performance testing, and ensure quality delivery
Migrate data from legacy systems
Deploy custom code on staging and production servers
4. Documentation & Training

Prepare technical documentation for code, modules, and workflows
Provide end-user training for production teams, store teams, and management
Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

Minimum 3 years of experience in Odoo (v13–v17) customization
Must have completed at least two (2) full Odoo manufacturing projects
Strong Python programming skills
Experience with PostgreSQL, XML, Odoo ORM, and QWeb
Good understanding of Linux environments and Odoo deployment
Manufacturing Expertise

Experience customizing:

Bill of Materials (Multi-level BOM)
Work Orders / Operations
Routing & Production Planning
Inventory & Warehouse operations
Quality Control & Approvals
Maintenance & Equipment Management
Ability to analyze complex manufacturing processes
Soft Skills

Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Must be able to meet deadlines and deliver high-quality work
Attention to detail
Preferred (Not Mandatory)

Experience with Odoo.sh, Docker, or cloud deployments
Experience in Ethiopian or East African manufacturing companies
Knowledge of accounting integration within manufacturing environments
How to Apply

https://forms.gle/qoWy2kXFRRmKuarB6

ዲዛይኖች የደንበኛ ፍላጎቶችን ማሰረት በማድረግ እውቀታቸውን እና የዲዛይን መመሪያዎችን በመጠቀም መስራት መቻል
የሚሰሩትን ዲዛይኖች ለ መቁረጥ እና ለማተም እንዲሆን ዝግጁ አድርጎ ማቅረብ መቻል
የጊዜ ገደቦችን በጠበቀ መልኩ ብዛት ያላቸው ፕሮጀክቶችን በ አንድ ጊዜ የማስተናገድ ብቃት ያለው

ብቃት
ሰርተፊኬት፣ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ዲግሪ በግራፊክስ ዲዛይን በስነ ጥበባት ወይም ተዛማች መስክ ማረጋገጫ ወረቀት ያለው/ያላት
የንድፍ ሶፍትዌር ብቃት ያለው ለምሳሌ (Corel Draw በዋነኘነት ሰርቶ የሚያውቅ፣ Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, ወዘተ)
ጠንካራ የፈጠራ ችሎታ ያለው
የ CNC ሂደቶችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን መለየት እና መስራት የሚችል
የፓትተርኖች እና ምልክቶችን ልዩነት መረዳት እና መተግበር የሚችል ፣ ጥሩ ግንዛቤ ያለው እና የቡድን ስራ ችሎታዎች ያላቸው።
ብዙ ፕሮጀክቶችን በአንድ ጊዘ የማስተናገድ ችሎታ ያለው።

title: Junior Business Content and Community Manager
description:
We are looking for a creative, business-oriented, and highly motivated Content & Community Manager to manage and grow our LinkedIn and Telegram platforms. This person will be responsible for sourcing trending business content, creating original posts, growing our audience, and building strong community engagement.

Key Responsibilities

- Source and research trending business, tech, finance, travel, and startup content
- Create high-quality LinkedIn & Telegram posts (educational, promotional & viral)
- Manage daily posting schedules and content calendar
- Grow and engage our Telegram community and LinkedIn audience
- Reply to comments, messages, and moderate discussions
- Track content performance and submit monthly reports
- Align all content with company brand and CEO vision

Requirements

- Proven experience managing LinkedIn & Telegram channels/pages
- Strong business content writing & copywriting skills
- Excellent English communication (Amharic is an advantage)
- Good understanding of business, startups, tech, and digital marketing
- Creative, disciplined, and self-driven
- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

Bonus Skills (Advantage)

- Canva or graphic design tools
- AI tools for content creation (ChatGPT, etc.)
- Social media scheduling tools
- Video captioning and short-form content experience

What We Offer

- Competitive salary / freelance pay
- Growth opportunity in a fast-growing business environment
- Personal brand development opportunity
- Performance-based incentives
- Flexible working condition

title: Video Editor (Short-Form Content)
description:
We are looking for a Remote Video Editor who can edit short-form videos in TikTok style. The ideal candidate is fast, creative, aware of current trends, and able to deliver high-quality edits on time. Basic graphic design skills are also required for creating simple visuals, overlays, and enhancements.

Responsibilities

Edit short-form videos in TikTok/Reels format.
Apply creative cuts, pacing, and modern editing styles.
Use basic graphic design skills to create simple graphics, overlays, captions, and visual enhancements.
Deliver polished videos within deadlines.
Communicate clearly with the team to understand direction.
Requirements

Ability to deliver strong, engaging short-form edits.
Awareness of current TikTok/Reels trends.
Basic graphic design skills (simple visuals, text overlays, layouts).
Creative editing style that keeps viewers engaged.
Reliable communication and responsiveness.
Must be able to work remotely.
Work Arrangement

Remote
Must meet deadlines and maintain high-quality output.
Ideal Candidate

Fast
Creative
Good communicator
Trend-aware
Has basic graphic design abilities
Reliable in delivering edits on time

title: Cargo Sales Team Leader
description:
Responsibilities
1.Team Leadership & Performance Management
2. Lead, supervise, and coach Sales Executives to achieve individual airline sales targets and the team’s overall sales goals.
3. Monitor daily performance, ensure effective use of working hours, and provide direction to maintain high productivity and professionalism.
4. Conduct regular evaluations, support skill development, and ensure timely completion of tasks and assignments.
5. Oversee the team’s promotion and selling of air cargo services for partner airlines, as well as air, sea, and road freight services.
6. Support the team in identifying new business opportunities, conducting sales visits, maintaining client relationships, and preparing quotations.
7. Drive revenue growth and ensure strong pipeline management across all products and airlines.
8. Ensure the team delivers consistent, high-quality customer service through timely follow-ups, accurate communication, and effective problem resolution.
9. Oversee coordination between sales, operations, customs, airlines, ports, and shipping lines to ensure smooth booking and shipment handling.
10. Ensure all client databases, reports, and records are maintained accurately and submitted on time.
11. Consolidate weekly and monthly sales reports for management, including performance against targets and capacity utilization.
12. Ensure the team adheres to company policies, maintains professionalism, and contributes to a collaborative work environment.
Qualifications
1. Minimum 5 years experience in air cargo sales, airline cargo, or freight forwarding.
2. Proven experience managing or leading a sales team.
3. Strong understanding of airlines cargo operation, air cargo sales, air cargo booking systems ( Cargospot or similar systems), processes, pricing, and customer handling.
4. Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.

title: Structural/Industrial Designer
description:
Structural/Industrial Designer for Prototype Housing (CAD Replication + Implementation)

I am seeking a freelance professional to design and replicate the physical structure of an existing product. The work involves taking accurate measurements of the current unit, creating a detailed CAD model based on those measurements, and designing the full structural layout for a new prototype. This project covers only the housing, frame, and static mechanical components—no electrical or electronic work is required.

Responsibilities

Take or work from precise measurements of the existing product.
Replicate the structure in CAD (2D and/or 3D).
Design the frame, enclosure, internal static supports, and access panels.
Recommend suitable materials for durability and manufacturability.
Provide fabrication-ready files for CNC, laser cutting, or 3D printing.
Assist with implementation, assembly guidance, or prototype build support.
Recommended Degrees / Background
A candidate may have experience or education in:

Industrial Design
Mechanical Engineering
Product Design
Manufacturing Engineering
Prototyping/Fabrication

title: Front-End Developer (Next.js & React)
description: Job Description: Front-End Developer (Next.js & React) We are looking for a skilled and motivated Front-End Developer to join our growing tech team. The ideal candidate should have strong experience with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS, along with a good eye for UI/UX design. You will be responsible for building modern, fast, and responsive web interfaces and collaborating closely with backend developers and designers. Key Responsibilities: Develop modern, high-performance user interfaces using Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS Build scalable, reusable, and clean UI components Integrate APIs using tRPC and/or REST Ensure applications are fully responsive, accessible, and optimized for speed Collaborate with the development team and participate in code reviews Continuously improve UI/UX quality and application performance Required Skills & Qualifications: Strong knowledge of Next.js, React, JavaScript, and TypeScript Proficiency in Tailwind CSS and modern frontend development practices Basic understanding of tRPC or willingness to learn Solid understanding of UI/UX principles and responsive design Experience with state management (Zustand preferred) Ability to write clean, maintainable, and performance-focused code Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Next.js App Router Familiarity with Shadcn UI, Radix UI, or similar libraries Knowledge of SSR, SSG, server components, and optimization techniques Experience using Git/GitHub and CI/CD workflows Learning & Growth: We welcome candidates who may not meet every requirement but are eager to learn new technologies and grow with the team.

title: አውቶ መካኒክ
description:
ግዮን ጋዝ ኃላ/የተ/የግ/ማህበር

ብዛት                   4(አራት)

description:

5.አዎንታዊ አመለካከት ያላት።

title: ግራፊክስ ዲዛይን
description:
ድርጅታችን ለደንበኞች የተለያዩ በCNC የሚሰሩ ደዛይኖችን፣ ማስታወቂያዎችን ለመሰራት የሚሆኑ ንድፎችን መፍጠር የሚችል፣ በአጭር ጊዜ ዉስጥ የመስራት ችሎታ ያለው፣ ከዚህ በፊት በማስታወቂያ ስራ፣ በCNC ዘርፍ እና ተያያዥ ሰራዎች ላይ የሰራ ወይም የሰራች መሆን እና የስራ ልምድ ማቅረብ የሚችል ሰው አወዳድሮ ለመቅጠር ይፈልጋል።

ዋና ሃላፊነቶች

እንደ Cutout design, ማስታወቂያ ቦርድ እና የመሳሰሉ ዲዛይኖችን መስራት
ዲዛይኖች የደንበኛ ፍላጎቶችን ማሰረት በማድረግ እውቀታቸውን እና የዲዛይን መመሪያዎችን በመጠቀም መስራት መቻል
የሚሰሩትን ዲዛይኖች ለ መቁረጥ እና ለማተም እንዲሆን ዝግጁ አድርጎ ማቅረብ መቻል
የጊዜ ገደቦችን በጠበቀ መልኩ ብዛት ያላቸው ፕሮጀክቶችን በ አንድ ጊዜ የማስተናገድ ብቃት ያለው

ብቃት
ሰርተፊኬት፣ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ዲግሪ በግራፊክስ ዲዛይን በስነ ጥበባት ወይም ተዛማች መስክ ማረጋገጫ ወረቀት ያለው/ያላት
የንድፍ ሶፍትዌር ብቃት ያለው ለምሳሌ (Corel Draw በዋነኘነት ሰርቶ የሚያውቅ፣ Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, ወዘተ)
ጠንካራ የፈጠራ ችሎታ ያለው
የ CNC ሂደቶችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን መለየት እና መስራት የሚችል
የፓትተርኖች እና ምልክቶችን ልዩነት መረዳት እና መተግበር የሚችል ፣ ጥሩ ግንዛቤ ያለው እና የቡድን ስራ ችሎታዎች ያላቸው።
ብዙ ፕሮጀክቶችን በአንድ ጊዘ የማስተናገድ ችሎታ ያለው።

title: Accountant
description:
Job Summary:

AddisFly is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Accountant to join our team. The ideal candidate will manage financial transactions, prepare reports, reconcile accounts, ensure compliance with accounting standards, and handle budgeting, expense tracking, and financial analysis to support the company’s financial health.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Management: Manage daily financial transactions, including accounts payable and receivable, maintain accurate financial records, and regularly reconcile bank statements and company accounts.
Bookkeeping & Reporting: Prepare financial reports, assist with budgets and forecasts, and monitor expenses, revenues, and financial trends to support decision-making.
Tax & Compliance: Ensure compliance with Ethiopian tax laws and financial regulations, prepare and file VAT and payroll taxes, and liaise with auditors and tax authorities.
Payroll & Expense Management: Process payroll accurately and on time, track business expenses and reimbursements, and implement cost-saving measures to optimize financial efficiency.
Collaboration & Advisory: Provide financial insights and recommendations to management, support teams with financial transactions, and assist in developing internal financial policies and controls.
Training: Stay updated on the latest travel industry trends, booking software updates, and company policies.
Skills and Qualifications:

Education: Diploma or degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
Experience: 2–3 years in accounting, preferably in travel or service industry.
Technical & Financial Skills: Proficient in accounting software (Peachtree, ERP systems), Microsoft Office, and familiar with Ethiopian tax laws. Strong bookkeeping and reporting skills.
Customer Service: Excellent customer service skills with a friendly and professional demeanor.
Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Amharic.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in handling bookings and customer information.
Sales Skills: Proven ability to meet sales targets and promote travel packages.
Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to troubleshoot booking issues and provide effective solutions.
Working Conditions:

Office Environment: Primarily office-based with potential for remote customer interactions.
Working Hours: Full-time position with standard working hours. Occasional weekend and evening work may be required.
AddisFly encourages applications from qualified female candidates

Company Overview:

AddisFly is a premier travel agency based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, specializing in aviation services, flight reservations, ticket bookings, visa assistance, and comprehensive travel packages. Our mission is to deliver seamless travel experiences and exceptional customer service to our clients.

description:

title: Video Editor
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Video Editor

Department: Creative Department

Reports to:  Creative Director

Job Summary: We are hiring a creative Video Editor to produce engaging social media videos. You will work with the marketing and content teams to create high-quality video content that reflects our brand and goals.

Key Responsibilities:

Edit and produce high-quality video content for social media (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) that aligns with brand guidelines and marketing strategies.
Collaborate with the content creation team to conceptualize and develop video ideas and storylines.
Optimize video content for various platforms, ensuring proper format, resolution, and length based on specific platform requirements.
Add appropriate graphics, subtitles, music, and special effects to enhance video quality.
Stay updated on the latest trends in social media video content and incorporate innovative editing techniques.
Manage video assets, organize footage, and maintain a library of video content for easy access and future use.
Ensure timely delivery of video projects in accordance with the content calendar.
Collaborate with the marketing team to align video content with advertising and promotional campaigns.
Required Qualifications:

Proven experience as a Video Editor, with a portfolio of social media content.
Proficiency in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve).
Strong understanding of social media platforms and their video content requirements.
Ability to create and edit short-form content quickly and efficiently.
Excellent attention to detail and a creative mindset.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Knowledge of graphic design and motion graphics is a plus.
Ability to work independently as well as in a team-oriented environment.
Working Conditions:

Work Environment: Primarily office-based with the possibility of remote interaction with clients.
Work Hours: Full-time position, standard office hours. Occasional work on weekends or evenings may be required.
Benefits of Working at OLY

Benefits of Joining Oly Technologies:
Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
Creative Freedom: Collaborate on innovative projects and enhance your portfolio.
Supportive Team: Work in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.
Flexible Work Options: Possibility of remote interaction and flexible hours.
Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary with performance-based incentives.
About OLY Technologies:

Oly Technologies is a multi-service company based in Addis Ababa and Mekelle. We provide branding and design, printing and packaging, import and export, and software development services. Our goal is to deliver innovative, high-quality solutions that help our clients grow and succeed.

title: Accountant
description:
Job Summary:

AddisFly is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Accountant to join our team. The ideal candidate will manage financial transactions, prepare reports, reconcile accounts, ensure compliance with accounting standards, and handle budgeting, expense tracking, and financial analysis to support the company’s financial health.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Management: Manage daily financial transactions, including accounts payable and receivable, maintain accurate financial records, and regularly reconcile bank statements and company accounts.
Bookkeeping & Reporting: Prepare financial reports, assist with budgets and forecasts, and monitor expenses, revenues, and financial trends to support decision-making.
Tax & Compliance: Ensure compliance with Ethiopian tax laws and financial regulations, prepare and file VAT and payroll taxes, and liaise with auditors and tax authorities.
Payroll & Expense Management: Process payroll accurately and on time, track business expenses and reimbursements, and implement cost-saving measures to optimize financial efficiency.
Collaboration & Advisory: Provide financial insights and recommendations to management, support teams with financial transactions, and assist in developing internal financial policies and controls.
Training: Stay updated on the latest travel industry trends, booking software updates, and company policies.
Skills and Qualifications:

Education: Diploma or degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
Experience: 2–3 years in accounting, preferably in travel or service industry.
Technical & Financial Skills: Proficient in accounting software (Peachtree, ERP systems), Microsoft Office, and familiar with Ethiopian tax laws. Strong bookkeeping and reporting skills.
Customer Service: Excellent customer service skills with a friendly and professional demeanor.
Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Amharic.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in handling bookings and customer information.
Sales Skills: Proven ability to meet sales targets and promote travel packages.
Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to troubleshoot booking issues and provide effective solutions.
Working Conditions:

Office Environment: Primarily office-based with potential for remote customer interactions.
Working Hours: Full-time position with standard working hours. Occasional weekend and evening work may be required.
AddisFly encourages applications from qualified female candidates

Company Overview:

AddisFly is a premier travel agency based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, specializing in aviation services, flight reservations, ticket bookings, visa assistance, and comprehensive travel packages. Our mission is to deliver seamless travel experiences and exceptional customer service to our clients.

title: Front-End Developer (Next.js & React)

title: Physiotherapist
description:
Glow Ethio-Turkiye Skin Care and Aesthetic Center is a leading and reputable establishment dedicated to providing comprehensive skincare and aesthetic services. We are currently seeking a highly skilled and compassionate professional on the following position to join our dynamic team.

Accountable To: Medical Director

 

1.      Educational Background:

Bachelor’s degree in Physiotherapy (BPT); Master’s degree is an advantage.
Valid professional license or registration
2.      Key Responsibilities:

Evaluate the client’s medical history, body composition, and medical history.
Identify contraindications (e.g., pregnancy, heart conditions, skin disorders).
Conduct initial assessments to determine suitability for machine-based weight loss treatments.
Safely operate advanced physiotherapy-based weight loss machines
Adjust machine settings based on individual client needs and treatment protocols.
Monitor progress and make necessary adjustments to optimize results.
Maintain strict hygiene standards and follow safety protocols during each session.
Identify and respond to any adverse reactions or contraindications.
Maintain accurate records of sessions, settings used, client progress and prepare progress reports and provide feedback to clients and management.

Minimum 2 years of clinical experience.
Experience in orthopedic, neurological, or sports physiotherapy.
Strong knowledge of human anatomy and musculoskeletal systems.
4.      Preferred Skills:

Ability to use physiotherapy equipment and technology effectively.
Compassionate, patient-focused approach.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
Bilingual abilities are an advantage.
Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Job Summary
The Senior Accountant will oversee the company’s accounting operations, ensure accurate financial reporting, and strengthen internal financial controls. This role requires strong experience in the transport, with the ability to manage cost analysis, fleet-related financial records, and compliance with tax and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities

Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Manage the day-to-day accounting activities, including general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, and bank reconciliations.
Monitor transport operational costs, including fuel, maintenance, driver payments, and fleet-related expenses.
Oversee tax declarations and ensure compliance with Ethiopian tax laws (VAT, Withholding, Payroll Tax, Income Tax).
Coordinate with internal departments to verify financial data and support operational decision-making.
Review and process payments, settlements, and supplier accounts.
Maintain proper documentation and ensure adherence to accounting standards.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
Lead junior finance staff and ensure accuracy and timeliness in reporting.
Participate in audits and provide necessary financial documents.
Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, preferably in the transport/logistics sector.
Strong knowledge of Ethiopian tax laws and financial reporting standards.
Experience with accounting software (e.g., Peachtree, ERP systems).
Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication abilities and attention to detail.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Personal Competencies
High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism.
Strong initiative and ability to work independently.
Good teamwork skills and willingness to support other departments.
Ability to adapt in a fast-moving transport operational environment.
How to Apply

Interested applicants who meet the requirements are invited to submit their application letter, CV, and relevant supporting documents to:
pavehr@pave-logistics.com

title: Structural Engineer
description:
The Structural Engineer at Dallol Consulting PLC will be responsible for designing and analyzing structural systems in various projects. Collaborate with architects and other engineers to develop integrated design solutions.
Conduct site visits to assess structural conditions and progress of construction.
Review and approve design drawings and specifications submitted by contractors.
Perform calculations and simulations to evaluate the performance of structures.
Assist in project management, including scheduling and resource allocation.
Prepare reports and documentation for project stakeholders.
Participate in team meetings to discuss project updates and challenges.
Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in structural engineering.
Required Skills:

Demonstrated expertise in structural design principles and practices.
Proficient in AutoCAD or Civil 3D for design and drafting.

Strong teamwork abilities, collaborating effectively with diverse teams.

Skilled in reviewing and interpreting engineering plans and specifications.
Capable of conducting thorough site assessments and evaluations.
Proficient in using structural analysis software and tools.
Strong problem-solving skills to address engineering challenges.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Proficient knowledge in SAP,ETABS and SAFE
