ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ

የአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ቡድናችንን ለመቀላቀል ፈጠራ እና ዝርዝር ተኮር ዲዛይነር እየፈለግን ነው።

ድርጅታችን  ለደንበኞች የለያዩ የማስታወቂያ ዓይነት ሥራዎችን፣  ለህትመት የማስታወቂያ ቁሳቁሶች ዓይን የሚስቡ ንድፎችን የመፍጠር ሃላፊነት መወጣት የሚችል።  ጠንካራ የንድፍ ክህሎትን፣ በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ የመስራት ችሎታ ያለው።  በማስታወቂያ ቤት የሰራ ተያያዥነት የሥራ ልምድ ማቅረብ የሚችል፡፡

ዋና ኃላፊነቶች፡-

• እንደ LED ምልክት፣ ኤምዲኤፍ ማሳያዎች፣ ቢልቦርዶች፣ ባነሮች፣ ፖስተሮች እና ዲጂታል ግራፊክስ ያሉ ዲዛይን እና የምርት ማስታዎቂያ ቁሳቁሶች።

• ዲዛይኖች የደንበኛ ፍላጎቶችን  መሠረት በማድረግ ዕውቀታቸውንና  የዲዛይን  መመሪያዎችን  በመጠቀም የሚያሟሉ  መሆን አለባቸው፡፡

•  የመጨረሻ ዲዛይኖች  ምስላዊ  ማራኪ ትክክለኛ እና ለህትመት  ወይም ለዲጂታል ህትመት ዝግጁ  አድርጎ ማቅረብ የሚችል።

• በንድፍ አዝማሚያዎች፣ በማስታወቂያ ቴክኒኮች እና በአዲስ  የሶፍትዌር መሳሪያዎች  ከጊዜ ጋር በአግባቡ መጠቀም የሚችሉ።

• የጊዜ ገደቦችን በሚያሟሉበት  ጊዜ በርካታ ፕሮጀክቶችን  ማስተናገድ ብቃት ያላቸው።

ብቃት፡

• ሰርቲፊኬት፣ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ዲግሪ በግራፊክስ ዲዛይን፣ በሥነ ጥበባት፣ ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ ወረቀት ያለው።

• የንድፍ ሶፍትዌር ብቃት (Adobe Illustrator፣ Photoshop፣ Core/DRAW፣ ወዘተ) ተጨማሪ መስራት የሚችል ነው።

• ጠንካራ የፈጠራ ችሎታያለው።

• የማተሚያ ሂደቶችን እና የማስታወቂያ ቁሳቁሶችን (LED, MDF, Banners, ወዘተ) ተጨማሪ እውቀት ያላቸው፡፡

የቀለማት ልዩነት መረዳት የሚችል፣ ጥሩ ግንዛቤ  ያለው። ጥሩ የሐሳብ ልውውጥ እና የቡድን ሥራ ችሎታዎች ያላቸው። ጥሩ የሐሳብ ልውውጥ እና የቡድን ሥራ ችሎታዎች ያለው።

• ብዙ ፕሮጀክቶችን በአንድ ጊዜ የማስተናገድ ችሎታ።

የሥራ ዓይነት: የሙሉ ጊዜ

ደመወዝ:  ወርሃዊ

የስራ አድራሻ

• አዲስ አበባ አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  በትራፊክ መብራት  አካባቢ፣  ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ ላይ ይገኛል፡፡

title: Graphics Designer
description:
Undertake core visual design work across multiple business lines, covering industrial equipment, environmental protection technology, fashion FMCG and other fields. Accurately present the professional and rigorous attributes of industrial and environmental protection products, while creating trendy and eye-catching visuals for FMCG products. Deliver brand and product design solutions aligned with business positioning (including but not limited to brand VI, product packaging, promotional materials, online promotion assets, etc.).

Conduct in-depth insights into international design trends. Combine visual preferences, cultural differences and consumer psychology of the Ethiopian, Chinese and European-American markets to optimize design strategies targeting specific needs. Ensure design works have high adaptability and communication power in different markets, supporting business expansion in target regions.
Lead the full-process management of design projects. From demand communication, creative conception, scheme delivery to implementation, fully control design quality and progress. Resolve design issues in projects in a timely manner to ensure outcomes meet the expectations of demand parties.
Establish and improve design specifications and visual systems for each business line. Promote standardization and efficiency of design work, and enhance the overall design output quality of the team. Regularly share design trends, industry cases and design experience to empower team growth.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product and operations. Precisely understand business needs and goals, and transform commercial demands into competitive visual solutions to help improve brand influence and product conversion rates.
Qualifications

(I) Core Competency Requirements

Possess diversified design thinking, capable of flexibly meeting design needs of different styles. Seamlessly switch between the professional and rigorous style of industrial/environmental protection fields and the trendy creative style of fashion FMCG. Candidates with relevant multi-field design cases are preferred.
Be familiar with cutting-edge international design trends. Have an in-depth understanding of the cultural background, visual preferences and consumption habits of the Ethiopian, Chinese and European-American markets. Accurately extract design adaptation key points for different markets to ensure the localized implementation effect of design works.
Have solid design skills, excellent creative conception ability, color matching ability and layout design ability. Be able to independently complete high-quality visual design solutions.
(II) Professional Skill Requirements

Proficiency in core design software such as Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign. Familiar with collaborative tools like Figma. Candidates with experience in motion/3D software such as C4D and AE are preferred.
Possess good aesthetic ability and attention to detail. Be able to continuously optimize design works to ensure output quality.
Understand printing processes, material characteristics and online asset specifications to ensure the smooth implementation of design solutions.
(III) Comprehensive Quality Requirements

Bachelor's degree or above in visual design, graphic design, illustration design or related majors. At least 1 year of professional design work experience. Candidates with experience in well-known enterprises or multi-business line design are preferred.
Have excellent communication and expression skills as well as cross-departmental collaboration capabilities. Be able to clearly convey design ideas and accurately connect with demands.
Be proactive in work, have strong pressure resistance, good sense of responsibility and team spirit. Be able to efficiently complete design work with multiple parallel tasks.
Possess a certain degree of business sensitivity.

title: የከባድ ተሽከርካሪዎችን ዋጋ የሚተምን
description:
የስራው አይነት፡- የከባድ ተሽከርካሪዎች ዋጋ የሚተምን ​​እና ሹፌሮችን ከደንበኞች ጋር የሚያገናኝ።

ኩባንያ: Chenet Logistics

የቅጥር አይነት: የሙሉ ጊዜ

የሥርዓተ-ፆታ መስፈርቶች: ወንድ

ተፈላጊ የስራ ልምድ፡ በትራንስፖርት/ሎጂስቲክስ ዘርፍ ቢያንስ 3 ዓመታት የሰራ

የሥራ ማጠቃለያ

Chenet Logistics የከባድ ተሽከርካሪዎችን የትራንስፖርት ዋጋ ለመገመት እና ደንበኞችን ከተገቢው የጭነት መኪናዎች እና አሽከርካሪዎች ጋር ለማገናኘት ከፍተኛ ችሎታ ያለው እና ልምድ ያለው ግለሰብ ይፈልጋል። በደላሎች፣ በተሽከርካሪ ባለንብረቶች እና በጭነት አሽከርካሪዎች መካከል ጠንካራ የግንኙነት አቅም ያለው እጩ በአዲስ አበባ እና በክልል ከተሞች የትራንስፖርት ዋጋ ላይ ጥልቅ እውቀት ያለው መሆን አለበት።

ቁልፍ ኃላፊነቶች

ለከባድ መኪኖች  ፍትሃዊ እና ተወዳዳሪ የትራንስፖርት ዋጋ ተምኖ ለሹፌሮች እና ለደምበኛ የሚያሳዉቅ

ለከተማ እና የረዥም ርቀት ጭነት አገልግሎት የገበያ ዋጋን ወቅታዊ ግንዛቤ የሚያስጨበጥ

ደንበኞችን ከተስማሚ አሽከርካሪዎች/ተሽከርካሪዎች ጋር በብቃት እና በሙያ የሚያገናኝ።

የተሻለውን ስምምነት ለማግኘት ከደላላዎች፣ የጭነት መኪና ባለቤቶች እና ሾፌሮች ጋር መነጋገር እና መደራደር የሚችል።

የደንበኞች እና ሹፌሮችን በማገናኝት እለታዊ ስራዎችን ማሳካት

ለክልል እና ከተማ የትራንስፖርት መስመሮች ትክክለኛ የዋጋ መረጃ በጥልቀት የሚያውቅ እና የሚያቀርብ

ጥሩ የደንበኞች ግንኙነት እንዲኖር እና ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው አገልግሎት አሰጣጥን ማረጋገጥ ሚችል

ጭነቱ ተጭኖ መዳረሻዉ ቦታ ላይ እስኪደርስ በደምብ ክትትል ማድረግ የሚችል

ክፍያዎችን ተከታትሎ መቀበል ሚችል

እለታዊ እና ሳምንታዊ ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀት እና ማቅረብ የሚችል

ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች

በትራንስፖርት/ሎጂስቲክስ ስራዎች ቢያንስ 3 ዓመት ልምድ ያለው

ስለ ከባድ የጭነት መኪና ትራንስፖርት ዋጋ (የከተማ +የክልል) ጥሩ እውቀት ሊኖረው ይገባል

ጠንካራ ግንኙነት፣ ድርድር እና የማስተባበር ችሎታ

title: Customer Service Officer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking enthusiastic, customer-focused, and detail-oriented individuals to join Our Company as Customer Service Officers. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer support through phone, chat, and online platforms. You will handle inquiries efficiently, assist with troubleshooting, and ensure customer satisfaction by providing timely and accurate responses.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, both in writing and speaking, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to type quickly and accurately. You must be organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. A solid understanding of customer service best practices is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries via phone, chat, or email.
Provide accurate information and effective solutions to customer issues.
Maintain a high level of written and verbal communication in both Amharic and English.
Record, track, and manage customer interactions using internal systems.
Collaborate with team members and supervisors to resolve complex issues.
Demonstrate empathy, patience, and professionalism in every interaction.
Identify recurring issues and share insights to improve service quality.
Uphold company policies, procedures, and service standards at all times.
Requirements

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Amharic and English.
Strong typing skills with high accuracy and speed.
Proven problem-solving and multitasking abilities.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable.
Basic proficiency in customer support tools or CRM systems.
Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
A strong sense of responsibility and teamwork.
Willingness to go above and beyond to ensure customer satisfaction.
Bachelor’s degree in any field.
Working Hours

Shift-based schedule:

07:00 AM – 03:00 PM
03:00 PM – 11:00 PM
11:00 PM – 06:30 AM (GMT+3)
Transportation provided for night shift staff.

title: Head Chef
description:
On behalf of our client, Lemi National Cement, we are looking for a qualified and motivated candidate for the following position:

Position: Head Chef
Employment Type: 6 months Contract, renewable
Number of Positions: 2
Place of Work: Ensaro Woreda – Lemi, Amhara Region
Salary: As per the company scale and based on negotiation
Application Email: info@ethiocv.com
Application Deadline: [December 15, 2025]

About the Role

Lemi National Cement is seeking an experienced and skilled Head Chef to oversee kitchen operations at its facility in Ensaro Woreda, Lemi. The Head Chef will be responsible for managing food preparation, supervising staff, ensuring hygiene compliance, planning menus, and delivering high-quality meals for employees on-site.

This is an excellent opportunity for a culinary professional with strong leadership and organizational ability, capable of running an efficient and cost-effective kitchen operation in an industrial setting.

Minimum Qualifications

Level 3 / Level 2 / Level 1 / 10th Grade with 2 / 4 / 6 years of relevant experience, respectively
Valid COC certification
Key Skills & Competencies

Leadership & Team Management:
Ability to recruit, train, supervise, and develop kitchen staff while fostering teamwork.
Communication Skills:
Clear and respectful communication with kitchen staff, front-of-house, and suppliers.
Time Management & Organization:
Ability to prioritize tasks, plan production schedules, and ensure timely meal service.
Financial Acumen:
Experience with budgeting, cost control, portion management, menu costing, and waste reduction strategies.
Creativity & Menu Development:
Ability to innovate, balance flavors, and design menus aligned with trends and seasonal ingredients.
Food Safety & Sanitation:
Strong knowledge of hygiene standards and compliance with food safety regulations.
How to Apply

Interested and qualified applicants are invited to send their CV, COC certificate, and relevant documents to:

info@ethiocv.com

Please use:
“Head Chef – Lemi National Cement” as the email subject line.

·        Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

የኪችን እና የቁምሳጥን ምርትን ለመቆጣጠር እና ለማቀናጀት ብቁ እና ለስራው አትኩሮት ያለው የምርት ሃላፊ እንፈልጋለን። የስራ ድርሻው ጥልቅ ቴክኒካዊ እውቀት፣ የተሻለ የልኬት ችሎታ እና ጠንካራ የሥራ ፍሰት መቆጣጠር ክህሎትን ይጠየቃል።

ዋና ኃላፊነቶች:

• Shop Drawing፣ CNC ፋይሎች፣ Cutting List እና የቁሳቁስ ዝርዝሮችን መገምገም

• የCNC፣ የEdge Banding፣ የገጠማ እና የFinishing ቡድኖች ማቀናጀት

• ለእያንዳንዱ ፕሮጀክት የእቃ ዝርዝር (Bill of Materials) ማዘጋጀት እና ማረጋገጥ

• በምርት ላይ የተለያዩ ደረጃዎች የጥራት መደበኛነት ማረጋገጥ

• የቀን ከቀን ምርት መከታተል እና የፕሮጀክቶች በጊዜ ገደብ መጠናቀቅን ማረጋገጥ

• ቴክኒካዊ ችግሮች እንዳይፈጠሩ ከንድፍ ባለሙያዎች እና ከገጠማ ቡድን ጋር አብሮ መስራት

• የጥሬ እቃዎች እና የምርት ግብአቶችን የተሻለ ሁኔታ አጠቃቀም ማረጋገጥ።

• የምርት መርሃ ግብር መከታተል እና ፍሰቱን ማጠናከር

• የደህንነት መመሪያዎች እና ንፁህነት በስራ ቦታ ላይ መጠበቅ

መስፈርቶች እና ብቃቶች:

• በWood Technology፣ Industrial Engineering፣ Architecture ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ዲግሪ።

• ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት በኪችን/ቁምሳጥን ወይም በfurniture ምርት ልምድ

• በPanel Processing፣ Hardware Systems እና Cabinet ገጠማ ጥልቅ እውቀት

• ቴክኒካዊ መስመሮችን ማንበብ ችሎታ (AutoCAD/SketchUp ተጨማሪ መብት ይሆናል)

• ጠንካራ መግባባት፣ የመምራት ክህሎት እና የተደራጀ የሥራ መንገድ

• ከፍተኛ አትኩሮት፣ ጠንካራ የስራ ባህል እና ስነምግባር

ለስራው ፍላጎት ያለው ሰው የትምህርት ማስረጃ እና የስራ ልምድ መላክ ይኖርበታል።

ጥቅሞች

• ብር 40,000 የተጣራ ደመወዝ

• በአፈጻጸም ላይ የተመረኮዘ ቦነስ

• የስራ እድገት እድሎች

• አበረታታች የስራ አካባቢ

title: Digital Marketing Officer
description:
Applicant please use the link below to apply: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdpXPUzAX8iC1AIqvckJy6i_P0nKJaYllIOGBDMiCvJKEshxA/viewform?usp=headerJob Title: Digital Marketing officer.
Gross Monthly Salary: Based on the organization’s scale.

Job Summary:

The Digital Marketing Officer at Haset IT is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing digital marketing strategies to enhance brand visibility, boost user engagement, and drive customer acquisition. This role blends creativity with analytical skills to deliver impactful campaigns across multiple online channels.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Strategy & Campaign Management
• Develop and implement comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with Haset IT’s goals.
• Manage digital advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn, etc.)
•Plan and execute SEO/SEM strategies to increase web traffic and search engine rankings.

Content Development & Brand Messaging

· Create high-quality content across blogs, social media, email, and websites.

· Write captions and hashtags aligned with brand voice

· Ensure consistent tone, branding, and messaging across all digital platforms.

· Develop content calendars, campaign assets, and promotional materials.

Social Media Management
• Manage daily activity across platforms (Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, Telegram).
• Build and engage online communities to promote brand loyalty.
• Design email marketing campaigns (product updates, promotions).

Web & Digital Analytics
• Use tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, and social media insights to measure performance.
• Provide regular reports with actionable recommendations to improve results.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
• 3–5 years of professional experience in digital marketing.
• Proven track record in managing digital campaigns and driving online engagement.
• Proficiency in Analytics Metrics tools, Meta Business Suite and email platforms.

Key Skills Required:

· Strategic planning & digital campaign execution.

· Proficiency in social media and analytics tools.

· Strong communication and storytelling ability.

· Creative with strong design sense.

title: የከባድ ተሽከርካሪዎችን ዋጋ የሚተምን
description:
የስራው አይነት፡- የከባድ ተሽከርካሪዎች ዋጋ የሚተምን ​​እና ሹፌሮችን ከደንበኞች ጋር የሚያገናኝ።

ኩባንያ: Chenet Logistics

የቅጥር አይነት: የሙሉ ጊዜ

የሥርዓተ-ፆታ መስፈርቶች: ወንድ

ተፈላጊ የስራ ልምድ፡ በትራንስፖርት/ሎጂስቲክስ ዘርፍ ቢያንስ 3 ዓመታት የሰራ

የሥራ ማጠቃለያ

Chenet Logistics የከባድ ተሽከርካሪዎችን የትራንስፖርት ዋጋ ለመገመት እና ደንበኞችን ከተገቢው የጭነት መኪናዎች እና አሽከርካሪዎች ጋር ለማገናኘት ከፍተኛ ችሎታ ያለው እና ልምድ ያለው ግለሰብ ይፈልጋል። በደላሎች፣ በተሽከርካሪ ባለንብረቶች እና በጭነት አሽከርካሪዎች መካከል ጠንካራ የግንኙነት አቅም ያለው እጩ በአዲስ አበባ እና በክልል ከተሞች የትራንስፖርት ዋጋ ላይ ጥልቅ እውቀት ያለው መሆን አለበት።

ቁልፍ ኃላፊነቶች

ለከባድ መኪኖች  ፍትሃዊ እና ተወዳዳሪ የትራንስፖርት ዋጋ ተምኖ ለሹፌሮች እና ለደምበኛ የሚያሳዉቅ

ለከተማ እና የረዥም ርቀት ጭነት አገልግሎት የገበያ ዋጋን ወቅታዊ ግንዛቤ የሚያስጨበጥ

ደንበኞችን ከተስማሚ አሽከርካሪዎች/ተሽከርካሪዎች ጋር በብቃት እና በሙያ የሚያገናኝ።

የተሻለውን ስምምነት ለማግኘት ከደላላዎች፣ የጭነት መኪና ባለቤቶች እና ሾፌሮች ጋር መነጋገር እና መደራደር የሚችል።

የደንበኞች እና ሹፌሮችን በማገናኝት እለታዊ ስራዎችን ማሳካት

ለክልል እና ከተማ የትራንስፖርት መስመሮች ትክክለኛ የዋጋ መረጃ በጥልቀት የሚያውቅ እና የሚያቀርብ

ጥሩ የደንበኞች ግንኙነት እንዲኖር እና ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው አገልግሎት አሰጣጥን ማረጋገጥ ሚችል

ጭነቱ ተጭኖ መዳረሻዉ ቦታ ላይ እስኪደርስ በደምብ ክትትል ማድረግ የሚችል

description:

ዋስትና መስጠት አለበት (አስገዳጅ).
የቀደመ ማጽጃ ልምድ ተመራጭ ነው.
የአካል ብቃት እንቅስቃሴ ተግባሮችን ለማከናወን የአካል ብቃት እንቅስቃሴ እና ችሎታ.
ሰዓት አክባሪ እና አስተማማኝ መሆን አለበት.
መመሪያዎችን የመከተል እና የባለሙያ ባህሪን የማቆየት ችሎታ.
ስቱዲዮ, ባለ 1-መኝታ ቤት, ባለ2-መኝታ ቤት, ባለ 3-መኝታ አፓርታማዎች.
ማንኛውንም ጉዳዮች ወይም ጉዳቶች ወዲያውኑ ሪፖርት ያድርጉ.

የጽዳት መርሃግብሮችን እና መመሪያዎችን ይከተሉ.

animations

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Bright Techno Tonic is building an advanced digital ecosystem of virtual cities delivering services in education, legal support, mental wellness, language learning, and more. As a fast-growing tech platform, we need forward-thinking leadership to drive innovation and scalability.

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will lead our overall technology strategy, guide the development of virtual city platforms, and ensure that our systems remain secure, efficient, and future ready. This role goes beyond traditional IT oversight—shaping the technological vision that powers our digital ecosystem.

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Technology Leadership:

1.1. Develop and implement a technology roadmap aligned with the company’s vision and business objectives.

1.2. Stay updated on emerging technologies, trends, and best practices in virtual environments, integrating them into the company's strategy.

1.3. Lead the design and development of virtual city platforms to ensure they are user-friendly, scalable, and feature-rich.

1.4. Drive innovation by incorporating advanced technologies such as AI, machine learning, and blockchain to enhance the virtual city experience.

2. Infrastructure Management:

2.1. Oversee the development and maintenance of the company’s IT infrastructure, ensuring its reliability, security, and efficiency.

2.2. Ensure the integration of robust cybersecurity measures to protect both company and client data.

3. Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement:

3.1. Work closely with the Chief Cities Officer (CCO) to receive updates on virtual city features, infrastructure, and operational requirements.

3.2. Implement system updates and technology solutions based on feedback from the CCO and other department heads.

3.3. Participate in executive decision-making meetings to align technology initiatives with company-wide strategies.

3.4. Collaborate with the Chief Marketing Officer and other executives to ensure that technology initiatives support business needs.

3.5. Act as a technical liaison with partners, investors, and stakeholders to communicate the company’s technological capabilities and goals.

4. Team Leadership and Development:

4.1. Build and manage a high-performing technology team, including software engineers, developers, and IT specialists.

4.2. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation within the technology department.

4.3. Plan and manage the technology budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources.

4.4. Evaluate and negotiate with technology vendors and service providers.

4.5. Ensure thorough testing and quality assurance processes for all technology solutions.

5. Administrative Actions:

5.1. Take appropriate administrative actions as needed to ensure efficiency, compliance, and smooth operation within the department.

5.2. Discuss contract terminations with the Legal and Administrative Services and the Chief Cities Officer.

Qualifications:

BA Degree and Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration or equivalent education or professional experience

3-5 years of relevant work experience in an IT company

Proven experience in technology leadership roles, ideally in software development or virtual technologies.

A strong track record of developing and implementing technology strategies that support business growth.

Expertise in virtual city platforms, cloud computing and emerging digital technologies.

Visionary leadership with a focus on innovation.

Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making skills.

Extensive technical knowledge of programming languages, system architecture, and software development methodologies.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills

Self-motivated and goal-oriented with a passion for sales and business development

Interested candidates who meet the requirements can send us their updated resume.

title: Customer Service and Reception
description:
Company Overview

Ruhama General Glass & Frame Work is a leading Ethiopian glass factory and service provider with over a decade of experience in the industry. Based in Addis Ababa, the company specializes in providing premium glass solutions for both residential and commercial sectors. Utilizing modern technology, Ruhama focuses on enhancing the aesthetics and functionality of environments through a comprehensive range of products and services, including precision cutting, and professional installation. Their unique offerings also extend to specialized areas like custom-designed modern and elegant mirrors, sophisticated shower boxes, and custom frame design with related artwork. The company's workshop is strategically located on Bole Ring Road, near St. Michael Church, ensuring accessibility for clients seeking high-quality, dependable glass and frame work.

Position Details

Job Summary

The Customer Service Representative will be the primary point of contact for our customers, handling inquiries related to our products, order status, technical issues, and post-sale support. This role is crucial in maintaining high customer satisfaction and supporting the company's production and sales goals.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Interaction: Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries via phone, email, and live chat, primarily focusing on product information, availability, and technical specifications.
Order Management: Process customer orders, modifications, and cancellations accurately. Crucially, liaise directly with the Production and Logistics teams to track order status and provide accurate delivery timelines to customers.
Issue Resolution: Investigate and resolve customer complaints, product issues, or shipping discrepancies, escalating complex problems to the relevant department (e.g., Quality Control, Technical Support) when necessary.
Product Knowledge: Maintain expert-level knowledge of the company's full product line, production capabilities, warranties, and return policies.
Documentation: Accurately document all customer interactions, feedback, and issue resolutions and improve service quality.
Sales Support: Identify potential sales opportunities or leads and pass them to the Sales team.
Process Improvement: Contribute ideas and feedback to improve customer service processes and efficiency.
Required Qualifications & Skills

Education: High School Diploma or equivalent; a degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field is a plus.
Experience: Minimum of [2] years of experience in a direct customer service role, preferably in a production, manufacturing.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional and empathetic telephone manner.
Technical Proficiency: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Problem-Solving: Proven ability to handle difficult situations and turn a negative customer experience into a positive one.
Product Acumen: A natural ability or desire to quickly learn and understand technical product details and manufacturing processes.
What We Offer

Competitive salary "Based on Experience"].
Paid time off and company holidays.
Opportunities for professional development and product training.
A collaborative and supportive work environment in a growing industry.
How to Apply

Address Bole Michael

title: Graphics Designer (ከማሽነሪ ኦፕሬሽን ፍላጎት ጋር)
description:
ልምድ ያለው የግራፊክስ ዲዛይነር Graphics Designer (ከማሽነሪ ኦፕሬሽን ፍላጎት ጋር)

ድርጅታችን በዋናነት በግራፊክስ ዲዛይን ሥራዎች ላይ አተኩሮ የሚሰራ፣ ነገር ግን በተጨማሪነት በድርጅቱ ውስጥ ባሉ ማሽነሪዎች አሰራር (Operation) ላይ ተባባሪ ሆኖ ወይም ቢታዘዝ መስራት የሚችል/ፍላጎት ያለው፣ ልምድ ያለው ባለሙያ ይፈልጋል።

ዋናው ሚና: ልምድ ያለው እና የፈጠራ ችሎታ ያለው ግራፊክስ ዲዛይነር።

ተጨማሪ ፍላጎት: ከተሰጠው የዲዛይን ሥራ በተጨማሪ፣ ድርጅቱ በሚፈልገው መሰረት በማሽነሪዎች አሰራር ላይ ተባባሪ ሆኖ ለመስራት ፍላጎት እና ፈቃደኝነት ያለው።

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች

1.     የግራፊክስ ዲዛይን ሥራዎች:

o    ለተለያዩ ምርቶች እና አገልግሎቶች ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያላቸውን ዲዛይኖች ማዘጋጀት

o    የደንበኞችን ፍላጎት ተረድቶ ወደ ምስላዊ ዲዛይን መተርጎም።

o    Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) ወይም ተመጣጣኝ ሶፍትዌሮችን በመጠቀም በብቃት መስራት።

o    የዲዛይን የጊዜ ገደቦችን ማሟላት።

2.     የማሽነሪ ኦፕሬሽን ድጋፍ:

o    በድርጅቱ በሚመደብለት መሰረት የተለያዩ ማሽነሪዎችን በአግባቡ ለማንቀሳቀስ (Operate) ወይም በመርዳት ላይ መሳተፍ።

o    የማሽነሪዎችን ጥራት እና የሥራ ፍሰት መከታተል።

o    አስፈላጊ ከሆነ አዲስ የማሽነሪ አሰራርን ለመማር ፈቃደኛ መሆን።

የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች

የትምህርት ደረጃ: በግራፊክስ ዲዛይን ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ዲግሪ ያለው።
የሥራ ልምድ: ቢያንስ 2 ዓመታት በግራፊክስ ዲዛይን ሙያ ውስጥ የሰራ።
ክህሎቶች: እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ የዲዛይን ፖርትፎሊዮ ማቅረብ የሚችል።
ፈቃደኝነት: ከግራፊክስ ዲዛይን ውጪ በሆነው የማሽነሪ ኦፕሬሽን ሥራ ላይ ለመሳተፍ ከፍተኛ ፍላጎትና ፈቃደኝነት ያለው።
ለተለያዩ የሥራ ዓይነቶች ፈጣን ምላሽ የሚሰጥ፣ ለዝርዝር ትኩረት የሚሰጥ እና የቡድን ሥራን የሚወድ።
ፍላጎት ያላቸው አመልካቾች የሚከተሉትን እንዲያቀርቡ እንገልፃለን፡

ዝርዝር የሥራ ልምድ ማህደር CV)

title: ረዳት ማሽነሪ ኦፕሬተር (Assistant Machinery Operator)
description:
1. የሥራ መረጃ እና የኩባንያው አጭር መግለጫ

የሥራው መጠሪያ

ረዳት ማሽነሪ ኦፕሬተር

ብዛት 10

2. ድርጅታችን

ሩሃማ ጄኔራል ግላስ ኤንድ ፍሬም ዎርክ በኢንዱስትሪው ውስጥ ከአስር ዓመት በላይ ልምድ ያለው ግንባር ቀደም የመስታወት እና ፍሬም አገልግሎት ስራ ድርጅት ነው። ዋና መቀመጫውን አዲስ አበባ ያደረገው ይህ ኩባንያ ለመኖሪያም ሆነ ለንግድ ተቋማት ዘርፎች የላቀ የመስታወትና ፍሬም ስራ መፍትሄዎችን በማቅረብ ላይ ያተኮረ ነው። ሩሃማ ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂን በመጠቀም፣ አጠቃላይ የምርት እና አገልግሎት በተለይም ትክክለኛ የመቁረጥ ሥራ እና ፕሮፌሽናል ገጠማ—የአካባቢዎችን ውበት እና ተግባራዊነት በማሳደግ ላይ ያተኩራል። ልዩ አቅርቦቶቻቸው ደግሞ  ዲዛይን የተደረጉ ዘመናዊ እና ውብ መስታወቶች፣ የተራቀቁ የሻወር ሳጥኖች እንዲሁም የፍሬም ዲዛይን ከተዛማጅ የዲዛይን ጥበብ ሥራዎች ጋር የመሳሰሉ ልዩ አገልግሎቶችን ያካትታሉ። የኩባንያው ወርክሾፕ በቦሌ ቀለበት መንገድ፣ ከቦሌ ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ቤተክርስቲያን አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው እና አስተማማኝ የመስታወት እና ፍሬም ሥራ የሚፈልጉ ደንበኞች በቀላሉ እንዲያገኙት ያስችላል።

3. የሥራው አጠቃላይ ማጠቃለያ (Position Summary)

ረዳት ማሽነሪ ኦፕሬተሩ የማምረቻ ማሽኖችን በዋናው ኦፕሬተር መሪነት ለመስራት፣ ለማዘጋጀት እና ለማጽዳት ኃላፊነት አለበት። ዋናው ትኩረት የምርት ጥራት ደረጃዎችን ጠብቆ ማሽኖቹ ያለ መቆራረጥ እንዲሰሩ መደገፍ እና የደህንነት ደንቦችን በጥብቅ መከተል ነው።

4. ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶችና ተግባራት

ከዋናው ኦፕሬተር ጋር በመሆን የማምረቻ ማሽኖችን ማስጀመር፣ መቆጣጠር እና ማቆም (Start, Monitor, Stop)

ለምርት የሚያስፈልጉ ጥሬ ዕቃዎችን ማሽኑ ውስጥ መመገብ (Loading/Feeding) እና የተጠናቀቁ ምርቶችን ማውጣት።
የምርት ሂደቱ በአግባቡ እየሄደ መሆኑን መከታተል እና ያልተለመዱ ድምፆች ወይም ስህተቶች ሲኖሩ ለኦፕሬተሩ ወዲያውኑ ሪፖርት ማድረግ።
ከምርት በኋላ ማሽኖችን ማጽዳት፣ ዘይት መቀባት (Lubrication) እና መሰረታዊ የጥገና ሥራዎችን ማከናወን።
የሥራ ቦታው ንጹህና ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ መሆኑን ማረጋገጥ።
የምርት መረጃዎችን (ለምሳሌ: ብዛት፣ የቆሻሻ መጠን) በትክክል መመዝገብ።
ሁሉንም የኩባንያውን እና የኢንዱስትሪውን የደህንነት እና የጤና ደንቦች በጥብቅ መከተል እና የግል መከላከያ መሳሪያዎች መጠቀም።
5. የሚፈለጉ መስፈርቶች

10ኛ/12ኛ ክፍል ያጠናቀቀ/ች፣ ቴክኒክና ሙያ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ሰርተፍኬት]።
በማኑፋክቸሪንግ ወይም ምርት ኩባንያ ውስጥ ቢያንስ 6 ወር - 1 ዓመት የማሽን አጠባበቅ ወይም የምርት ሥራ ልምድ ቢኖር ይመረጣል።
ለመማር እና አዲስ የምርት ቴክኒኮችን ለመቀበል ፍላጎት ያለው/ያላት።
የሰውነት ብቃት: ከባድ ዕቃዎችን ማንሳት እና ለረጅም ሰዓታት መቆም ወይም በእግር መሥራት የሚችል/የምትችል መሆን።
የደህንነት ንቃተ-ህሊና: የማሽነሪ ደህንነት አደጋዎችን መረዳት እና ሁል ጊዜ ጥንቃቄ ማድረግ።
ትኩረት እና ትክክለኛነት: የማሽን መለኪያዎችን በትክክል መከተል እና በጥራት ላይ ትኩረት ማድረግ።
የቡድን ሥራ: ከሌሎች ኦፕሬተሮች እና የቡድን አባላት ጋር ተባብሮ መሥራት።
የመሰረታዊ የሂሳብ ችሎታ: የቁጥር መለኪያዎችን እና መጠኖችን ለማስላት መሰረታዊ የሂሳብ እውቀት።
6.  ደመወዝ እና ጥቅማጥቅሞች

ደመወዝ: በኩባንያው የደመወዝ ስኬል መሰረት
ጥቅማጥቅሞች: የደንብ ልብስ፣ የደህንነት መጠበቂያ
ተጨማሪ: ለበለጠ የሥራ መደብ ወደ ዋና ኦፕሬተርነት የመሻሻል ዕድል አለው።
ፍላጎት ያላቸው አመልካቾች የሚከተሉትን እንዲያቀርቡ ተጋብዘዋል፡

title: Accountant
description:
Are you a detail-oriented and analytical professional ready to ensure the financial accuracy of a fast-growing consumer goods company? Join our team to help manage the financial health and reporting for our leading detergent brands.

Main Role & Responsibilities

The Accountant will be responsible for general ledger management, reconciliation, and financial reporting specific to the commercial operations of the detergent business.

• Financial Reporting: Prepare accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports .

• General Ledger & Reconciliations: Maintain the General Ledger, perform monthly bank and inter-company reconciliations, and ensure the accuracy of all transactional data.

• Cost & Inventory Control: Monitor and analyze product costing, inventory valuation, and variances, which are crucial in the manufacturing and FMCG sector.

• Accounts Payable/Receivable (A/P & A/R): Oversee timely processing of supplier invoices and payments, and ensure effective management and collection of customer accounts.

• Taxation & Compliance: Assist in the preparation of tax returns (VAT, corporate tax, etc.) and ensure adherence to all local financial regulations.

• Audit Support: Provide necessary documentation and support during internal and external audits.

Required Skills & Qualifications

We are seeking a candidate with a strong foundation in accounting principles and practical experience in a commercial setting.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Experience: Minimum 2 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably within the FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) or Manufacturing industry.

• Technical Skills:

• ERP Proficiency: Demonstrated hands-on experience with major ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) is essential.

• Advanced Excel Skills: High proficiency in data analysis, pivot tables, and financial modeling.

• Knowledge of [, IFRS/GAAP]: Deep understanding of financial reporting standards.

• Soft Skills: High level of accuracy and attention to detail, strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, and excellent communication skills.

title: Indoor Sales Representative
description:
Are you a results-driven sales professional looking to make a significant impact? Kiber Temesgen Import a specialized importer and distributor playing a crucial role in providing businesses across Ethiopia with premium-quality printing materials is looking for a professional Salesperson. With a strong emphasis on sales and retail service and a core value of customer-centric excellence, we are ambitious to be the leading printing materials supplier in the country. If you're ready to drive growth and contribute to a company with big goals, this opportunity is for you.

Required Skills & Qualifications

BA Degree in Marketing, Management, Business Administration or related field.
Minimum 1 year of experience in Sales.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Attention to detail and numeric accuracy
Honest, trustworthy, and reliable with cash handling
Basic computer, Microsoft office and excel and POS system proficiency
Proficiency in using sales software and tools
Experience in import and export industry is a plus
Key Responsibilities

Sales & Product Promotion
Greet customers warmly and assess their needs to provide suitable product recommendations
Demonstrate product knowledge and assist customers in making informed purchases
Upsell and cross-sell related items to increase overall revenue
Maintain attractive product displays and ensure stock is adequately organized

እንግዶችን ሲመጡ በደስታ መቀበል እና አዎንታዊ የመጀመሪያ ስሜት መፍጠር።

ምግብና መጠጦችን በትክክል እና በወቅቱ ማገልገል (ማድረስ)።
ስለግብአቶች እና የአዘገጃጀት ዘዴዎች ለሚነሱ ጥያቄዎች መልስ መስጠት።
ለእንግዶች ጥያቄዎች በፍጥነት ምላሽ መስጠት እና ማንኛውንም ችግር ወይም ቅሬታ በሙያዊ መንገድ መፍታት፣ አስፈላጊ ከሆነም ለኃላፊዎች ማሳወቅ።
ጠረጴዛዎች ንጹህ፣ በትክክል የተዘጋጁ እና በጥሩ ሁኔታ የተጠበቁ መሆናቸውን ማረጋገጥ።
አገልግሎቱ ያለምንም እንከን እንዲከናወን ከኩሽና እና ከባር ሰራተኞች ጋር በብቃት መተባበር።
የሥራ ቦታን እና የመመገቢያ ቦታን ንጹህ እና የተደራጀ ማድረግ።

ብቃቶች እና መስፈርቶች:

እንደ አስተናጋጅነት ወይም በተመሳሳይ የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ሚና ውስጥ የተረጋገጠ ልምድ መኖር።

title: App Tester
description:
We're Hiring Professional App Testers!

Exciting Opportunity: Earn 15,000 ETB Per App Testing Project

We are looking for experienced and professional testers to thoroughly evaluate a secure financial mobile/web application before its official launch. This is a critical role to ensure the app is ready for large-scale use, meets high standards, and complies with regulations – including submission of a detailed evaluation report to INSA (Information Network Security Agency) in Ethiopia.

What You'll Be Doing (Simple Overview of Responsibilities):

As a tester, you will follow comprehensive checklists to verify every aspect of the app. Your job is to check and provide clear evidence (screenshots, reports, logs) showing that the app meets these key requirements:
- Performance & Speed: Ensure the app loads quickly, runs smoothly even on slow networks or low-end devices, handles millions of users without slowing down, and uses efficient loading for images, videos, and features.
- Accessibility: Make sure the app is usable by everyone, including people with disabilities – proper support for screen readers, keyboard navigation, good color contrast, and works well when zoomed or on different devices.
- Real-Time Features: Test that live updates (like notifications or dynamic content) happen instantly and reliably, even with many users at once.
- Security & Privacy: Verify strong protection against hacks, secure data handling, user consent for data use, encryption, and full compliance with laws like Ethiopia's Proclamation No. 1321/2023 and international standards (no vulnerabilities allowed).
- Testing Quality: Run all types of tests (unit, integration, end-to-end, load, stress, security, usability, etc.) to confirm the app is bug-free, stable, and performs well under heavy use.
- International Support: Check that the app handles different languages, formats (dates, currency), and layouts (including right-to-left if needed).
- Backend & Infrastructure: Validate server-side reliability, scaling on AWS cloud, monitoring, backups, cost efficiency, and disaster recovery.
- AI Features (if present): Test model accuracy, fairness (no bias across users or languages like Amharic/Oromo/Tigrinya), ethical use, and user transparency/consent.
- Overall Readiness: Confirm everything is documented, maintainable, and ready for safe launch – including rollout plans and monitoring.

You will mark each checklist item as Pass/Fail/Not Applicable (with proof), attach evidence, and provide a final sign-off report confirming the app is fully ready and compliant.
Who We're Looking For:
- Professional testers with proven experience in evaluating financial applications.
- Familiarity with security standards, compliance requirements, and preparing reports for regulatory bodies like INSA.
- Strong attention to detail, ability to use testing tools (e.g., Lighthouse, JMeter, OWASP ZAP, etc.), and experience with mobile/web apps.
- Knowledge of performance, accessibility, security, and scalability testing is essential.
- Must be reliable, independent, and able to deliver high-quality evidence-based reports.
Compensation:
- 15,000 Ethiopian Birr (ETB) per completed app testing project (full checklist evaluation + final report for INSA submission).
If you are a skilled tester ready to take on this important role and help ensure a secure, high-quality financial app launch, please apply today!
How to Apply:
Send your CV, examples of past testing work (especially financial apps or compliance reports), and a brief note on your relevant experience to [firaoltilahun17@gmail.com].
We look forward to working with you!

title: IT Officer
description:
Job Summary

The IT Officer is responsible for providing first-line technical support, maintaining the company’s IT infrastructure, and ensuring the smooth operation of all hardware, software, and network systems. This role is crucial for minimizing downtime, safeguarding data, and enabling employees to work efficiently and securely. The ideal candidate is a problem-solver with strong technical skills, excellent communication, and a customer-service mindset.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Support & Help Desk:

·      Serve as the first point of contact for all internal IT support requests via ticketing system, email, phone, or in-person.

·      Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and peripheral issues for end-users (laptops, desktops, printers, mobile devices).

·      Install, configure, and update approved software applications and operating systems.

·      Set up and deploy new user workstations, accounts, and equipment (onboarding).

·      Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls in Active Directory, Microsoft 365, or other systems (onboarding/offboarding).

2. System & Network Administration:

·      Perform routine maintenance and monitoring of servers, network devices (switches, routers, firewalls), and critical systems.

·      Assist in managing and maintaining cloud services (e.g., Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS/Azure resources).

·      Ensure network security and connectivity, including VPN support for remote staff.

·      Perform regular data backups and verify data integrity and recovery procedures.

3. Security & Compliance:

·      Implement and enforce IT security policies, including antivirus management, patch deployment, and user security training.

·      Monitor systems for security threats and vulnerabilities; respond to security incidents under guidance.

·      Assist in ensuring IT practices comply with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, industry-specific standards).

4. IT Asset & Vendor Management:

·      Maintain an accurate inventory of all IT hardware, software, and licenses.

·      Procure IT equipment and manage relationships with vendors and service providers.

·      Manage software licensing and ensure compliance.

5. Documentation & Projects:

·      Create and update clear technical documentation, manuals, and IT policies.

·      Participate in IT projects such as system upgrades, migrations, or new technology implementations.

·      Provide basic training to staff on IT systems and best practices.

Qualifications & Skills

Essential:

·      Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional certification (e.g., CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft Fundamentals).

·      Experience: 2-3 years of proven experience in a similar IT support/technician role.

·      Technical Proficiency:

·      Strong knowledge of Windows and/or macOS operating systems.

·      Understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Wi-Fi).

·      Hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting and repair.

·      Familiarity with Active Directory and endpoint management tools.

·      Soft Skills:

·      Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

·      Outstanding communication and customer service skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.

·      Highly organized with the ability to prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment.

·      Proactive, self-motivated, and a strong team player.

Desirable (Nice-to-Have):

·      Knowledge of virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V).

Qualifications & Requirements

title: DevOps / Laravel Deployment Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced DevOps or server deployment specialist to set up a scalable and maintainable infrastructure for our Laravel-based application. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with load balancing, cloud servers, databases, Redis, queues, and object storage.

Responsibilities:

Set up a load balancer (Nginx) to distribute traffic across multiple Laravel API servers.
Deploy and configure at least two Laravel API servers for high availability.
Set up a dedicated server for backend services, including:

MySQL Database
Redis Server
Queue Workers
Integrate object storage using Hetzner S3 for storing files and assets.
Ensure the deployment is scalable, secure, and maintainable.
Configure server security, firewall rules, and access restrictions.
Document the deployment process and provide guidance for future maintenance.
Requirements:

Proven experience with Laravel application deployments.
Strong knowledge of Nginx, load balancing, and server scaling.
Experience with MySQL, Redis, and queue workers.
Familiarity with Hetzner S3 or other object storage services.
Understanding of server security and SSH configuration.
Ability to provide clear documentation and deployment scripts.
Preferred:

Experience with cloud infrastructure management (Hetzner).
Deliverables:

Fully deployed and functional scalable infrastructure for App.
Documentation of setup, including connection details, firewall rules, and deployment instructions.
Tested setup ensuring Laravel app, database, Redis, queue workers, and object storage are integrated properly.

Validate and verify music metadata, artist details, reports, and related records

Identify and report inconsistencies or missing information
Maintain confidentiality and data security at all times
Meet daily and weekly data entry targets
Collaborate with supervisors and system administrators

title: የሞባይል ቤት ሽያጭ ሰራተኛ
description:
ልምድ ያለው/ያላት የሞባይል ቤት ሽያጭ ሰራተኛ (ቦሌ አካባቢ)

በአስቸኳይ የሞባይል መደብር ሻጭ ሰራተኛ ይፈለጋል

ፆታ: አይለይም

ልምድ: ቦሌ አካባቢ ያሉ ሞባይል እና አክሰሰሪስ ቤቶች ሰርቶ የሚያቅ

ቦታ፡ ቦሌ አካባቢ፣ አዲስ አበባ

የሥራ ሰዓት: ከጠዋቱ 2 ሰዓት - እስከ ማታ 3 ሰዓት

የሽያጭ ሰራተኛው፦

1) ታማኝ፣ ደንበኛ መያዝ የሚችል ተግባቢ፣ መታወቂያ ያለው አና የአዲስ አበባ መታወቂያ ያለው ተያዥ ማቅረብ የሚችል፣

2)ስለ ሞባይል ቴክኖሎጂ፣ ሞዴሎች፣ መለዋወጫዎች እና አገልግሎቶች ጠንካራ እውቀት ያለው እና በደንበኞች ፍላጎት መሠረት መምከር የሚችል፣

3)ስለ ስራው እና ቦሌ ሰፈር ጥሩ እወቀት ያለው፣

4) የሱቁን ንፅህና እና አቃ አደራጅቶ በሃላፊነት የሚይዝ

6) ቦሌ አከባቢ ወይም ዋና የሞባይል ሽያጭ ቦታዎች ላይ ልምድ ያለው፣

7) ዕለታዊ ሽያጮችን አና ሂሳብ በሃላፊነት ለባለቤቱ በየቀኑ ሪፖርት ማድረግ የሚችል መሆን አለበት

ከላይ የተጠቀሱትን መስፈርቶች የሚያሟላ በ 0912156136 በመደወል ስራውን ማመልከት አና ልምዶን በማጋራት ለቅጥር መወያየት ይችላሉ።

title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer
description:
Job Title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer

Gross Monthly Salary: Based on the organization’s scale

Job Summary:

The Digital Accounting and Finance Officer is responsible for managing and optimizing the organization’s financial operations using advanced digital tools and systems. This role blends traditional accounting functions with modern digital finance practices, including automation, data analytics, ERP integration, and fintech transaction management. The officer will oversee electronic payment channels such as Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, and other wallet services, ensuring seamless, secure, and compliant transaction flows. This position is critical to Haset IT’s operations, as it safeguards financial compliance with Ethiopian laws while driving efficiency, innovation, and transparency in digital financial processes.

Key Responsibilities:

🔹 Digital Financial Operations

Maintain and manage financial data in ERP/accounting systems.
Oversee integrations with fintech platforms (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, banks’ digital wallets).
Automate routine accounting tasks and digital reconciliation processes.
🔹 Financial Reporting & Analysis

Generate real-time dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI/Excel.
Analyze transaction volumes from electronic channels and provide insights for decision-making.
Monitor KPIs for digital payment adoption, processing costs, and error/fraud detection.
🔹 Accounts & Transactions

Manage digital accounts payable/receivable workflows.
Reconcile multi-gateway transactions (mobile money, online payments, wallets, and bank transfers).
Ensure secure settlement and timely collection from digital platforms.
🔹 Tax & Compliance

Prepare and file e-tax reports (VAT, WHT, income tax, pensions) electronically.
Ensure compliance with ERCA’s digital tax systems and fintech regulatory directives.
Stay updated on National Bank of Ethiopia fintech guidelines and interoperability standards.
🔹 Cash Flow, Payroll & Digital Gateways

Monitor online banking and mobile money cash flows daily.
Manage payroll through digital payroll systems with automated statutory deductions.
Ensure multi-channel settlement (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr) is tracked, reconciled, and secured.
🔹 Audit & Internal Controls

Maintain digital audit trails for fintech and ERP transactions.
Coordinate audits with external auditors and regulators, ensuring fintech compliance.
Implement fraud prevention and digital transaction monitoring systems.
🔹 Cross-functional Collaboration

Work with IT teams to ensure payment API integrations are secure and efficient.
Partner with Operations and HR to align payment flows with organizational goals.
Communicate with banks, fintech providers, and vendors through digital platforms.
🔹 Policy Development & Innovation

Develop digital finance policies for transaction security, reconciliation, and fraud prevention.
Contribute to Haset IT’s digital economy transformation by adopting fintech best practices.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
3–5 years of professional experience in accounting/finance (preferably in fintech, transportation, or tech).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Peachtree/QuickBooks, and digital accounting systems.
Strong detail orientation and accuracy in digital record-keeping.
Preferred Qualifications (Optional):

Training or degree in Computer Science, IT, or Data Analytics.
Experience with ERP, mobile money reconciliation, or fintech platforms.
Exposure to digital tax filing and cloud-based financial systems.

Key Skills Required:

✅ Expertise in fintech payment systems (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, bank APIs)

✅ Strong communication and stakeholder management

✅ Analytical and data-driven mindset

✅ Digital literacy and adaptability

✅ Attention to detail and accuracy

✅ Teamwork and cross-functional collaboration

✅ Risk management & fraud detection skills

title: Social Media Videographer and Editor Specialist
description:
About EthAgora Digital Solutions

EthAgora Digital Solutions PLC is a purpose-driven digital communication and marketing company. We blend storytelling, behavior change insights, and data analytics to help brands grow, connect, and thrive in the digital space.

Role Overview

We are looking for a vibrant, creative, and trend-savvy Videographer & Editor Specialist who can translate ideas into visually compelling short-form videos and engaging social media content. You’ll be the creative engine behind our clients’ and EthAgora’s online presence—capturing, editing, and publishing high-quality videos, photos, and posts across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation & Video Production

Capture, edit, and produce high-quality short-form videos (15–60 seconds) optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Facebook. Capable of producing 4 short-form videos/day.
Design and create visually appealing social media posts, graphics, and motion content.
Repurpose long-form videos into engaging short clips for multiple platforms.
Manage time effectively to meet tight deadlines while maintaining quality.
Adapt quickly to shifting priorities, campaign changes, or emerging social trends.
Social Media Management

Plan, schedule, and publish content in line with EthAgora’s and clients’ brand guidelines.
Monitor engagement and respond to comments/messages to build community.
Collaborate with the marketing team to develop creative campaigns and trends-based content.
Creative Strategy & Trends

Conceptualize and execute content ideas that align with EthAgora’s and clients’ brand voices.
Research and apply trending sounds, hashtags, and formats relevant to target audiences.
Brainstorm and pitch creative video ideas for campaigns and promotions.
Ensure content is platform-optimized, culturally relevant, and on-brand.
Additional Responsibilities

Coordinate with influencers and user-generated content creators for collaborations.
Produce ad-ready creatives for Facebook Ads Manager and TikTok Ads.
Assist in managing social media crisis communications when needed.
Track content performance using analytics tools and recommend improvements.
Present weekly and monthly content performance reports.
Perform any other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.
Required Skills & Qualifications

Proven experience in social media videography and content creation.
Proficient in video editing tools (CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or similar).
Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube content trends.
Ability to shoot with a smartphone or camera, ensuring high-quality output.
Capable of producing 4 social media videos (45 seconds duration) every day.
Excellent storytelling, creativity, and attention to detail.
Basic graphic design skills (Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator).

What We Offer
Opportunity to work with a fast-growing digital marketing firm.
Creative freedom to experiment and bring ideas to life.
Collaborative and inspiring work environment.
Potential for long-term engagement and career growth.
Contract Duration

·         3 months contract, with a 45-days probation period, renewable based on the aforementioned performance indicators.

Salary

35,000 ETB/month
Additional benefits as per company policy.
Application Process

Interested candidates meeting the above criteria should submit:

• A cover letter highlighting your relevant experience, key achievements, and earliest possible start date. This is an urgent position, and we encourage only candidates who are readily available to apply.

• An updated CV.

• Contact details of at least two professional referees.

• Send your cover letter, CV, and sample work link via Telegram@berhanucom

High level of integrity and commitment to ethical procurement practices.

title: cashier
description: We are looking for a friendly, detail-oriented Cashier to be the welcoming face of our coffee shop. This role is essential in creating a positive and memorable customer experience, as the Cashier is often the first and last point of contact for our guests. The ideal candidate will combine excellent customer service with accurate transaction handling to ensure every visit is smooth, efficient, and enjoyable. Key Responsibilities Greet customers warmly and provide friendly, professional, and efficient service at all times. Accurately process cash, card, and digital payments and issue receipts for all transactions. Ensure proper cash handling and reconciliation at the beginning and end of each shift. Assist customers with menu inquiries, promotions, pricing, and general product information. Coordinate orders clearly with baristas and service staff to ensure accuracy and timely service. Maintain cleanliness and organization of the cashier station and front counter area. Follow company policies, financial control procedures, and service standards. Report any cash discrepancies, customer complaints, or operational issues to the supervisor or manager promptly. Work collaboratively with baristas and service staff to minimize errors and improve service flow. Required Qualifications 3 years Previous experience as a cashier. Basic math skills and the ability to handle transactions accurately. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Friendly, customer-oriented attitude with a professional appearance. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks efficiently. Honesty, reliability, and attention to detail.

title: part time sales man
description:
ኤም የማስታወቂያ ስራ በመስክ ሽያጭ አወዳድሮ መቀጠር ይፈልጋል። በመሆኑም ከዚህ በታች የተገለጸዉን መስፈርት የምታሟሉ ተወዳዳሪዎች መወዳደር የምትችሉ መሆኑን እናሳዉቃለን።

-ደንበኞችን በትህትና መቀበልና ስለ ምርቶች/አገልግሎቶች በቂ መረጃ መስጠት።

-አዳዲስ ደንበኞችን መፈለግና ከድርጅቱ ጋር ማስተዋወቅ።

-የሽያጭ ግቦችን ለማሳካት በንቃት መስራት።

-ለደንበኞች የሚቀርቡ ጥያቄዎችንና ቅሬታዎችን በአግባቡ ማስተናገድ።

የስራ ቦታ

በአዲስ አበባና በማንኛዉም የክልል ከተሞች ላይ የሚኖር በዛዉ በመኖሪያ ከተሞች አካባቢ መስራት የሚችል
ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች እና መስፈርቶች

-በሽያጭ ወይም በተቀራራቢ ዘርፍ ልምድ ያለው/ላት (ቢኖር ይመረጣል)።

-ጥሩ የመግባባት እና የማሳመን ችሎታ።

-በቡድን የመስራት ፍላጎትና ታታሪነት።

-መሰረታዊ የኮምፒውተር አጠቃቀም (እንደ አስፈላጊነቱ)።

እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል?

ለመወዳደር የሚፈልጉ አመልካቾች የትምህርት እና የሥራ ልምድ ማስረጃችሁን በመያዝ ጉርድ ሾላ ግብርና ሚኒስቴር ፊትለፊት በአካል በመገኘት ማመልከት ምችሉ መሆኑን እናሳውቃለን

ለበለጠ መረጃ በስልክ ቁጥር፦0986369893

title: የምሽት ፈረቃ አስተናጋጅ
description: • የሥራ ማጠቃለያ በድርጅታችን በምሽት ፈረቃ ወቅት ለቢሮ ሰራተኞቻችን ምግብ ለመመገብ በብልሃት እና በትክክለኛነት የሚሰራ አስተናጋጅ እንፈልጋለን። እጩው ከኩሽና ቡድናችን ጋር በቅርብ በመስራት ዕለታዊ የምግብ ዝግጅትን በጊዜው እንዲለቀቅ እና የእንግዶችን ተስፋ እንዲያሳካ ማረጋገጥ ይኖርበታል። እጩው በምግብ ዝግጅት ሂደት ውስጥ የሚሳተፍ፣ ንፁህነትን እና የምግብ ጤነኝነትን የሚጠብቅ እንዲሁም የእንግዳ አገልግሎትን በሙያዊነት የሚያቀርብ መሆን አለበት። ከኩሽና ቡድን ጋር በተያያዘ በአቅም ሁኔታ መስራት፣ ምግቦችን በጊዜ ማቅረብ፣ እንዲሁም ቦታውን ንፁህ እና ተዘጋጅቶ መጠበቅ ይኖርበታል። ኃላፊነቶች፡- የምግብ እና መጠጥ ትዕዛዞችን በትክክል መውሰድ እና ወደ ምግብ ቤት ወይም ባር መላክ። ምግብና መጠጥ በትክክል እና በጥራት ያለ መንገድ መስጠት፣ የእንግዶች ተስፋ እንዲሞላ መከታተል። 400 - 600 የኩባንያው ሰራተኛ መመገብ። የአገልግሎት ቦታዎችን እና የመመገቢያ ክፍሎችን ንፁህነትና ቅድመ ዝግጅት መጠበቅ ሁሉንም የደህንነት፣ የንፁህነት እና የጥራት መመሪያዎች መከተል። ከምግብ ዝግጅት በፊት እና በኋላ ያሉ አገልግሎቶች ላይ በስፋት መሳተፍ። በታቀደው መሰረት በተቀያያሪ ፈረቃ ውስጥ መስራት። መስፈርቶች፡- በሬስቶራንት ወይም በእንግዳ አገልግሎት ዘርፍ እንደ አስተናጋጅ ወይም አስተናጋጅት የተሞክሮ መኖር ይመረጣል። ጠንካራ የመገናኛ እና የደንበኛ አገልግሎት ችሎታ። በፈጣን ሁኔታ የሚሰራ አካባቢ ውስጥ በትክክል መስራት ችሎታ። በሙያዊነት መታየት እና አዎንታዊ ባህሪ እንዲሁም በቡድን መስራት ችሎታ። በሌሊት፣ በመንጋት፣ በቅዳሜ እና በበዓላት ቀን መስራት የሚችል ይሁን።

title: Reseption
description: • Job Summary We are looking for a friendly, organized, and professional Receptionist to join our team. The Receptionist will be the first point of contact for visitors and clients, responsible for welcoming guests, answering calls, and supporting day-to-day administrative tasks. Requirements Fluency in English (spoken and written) is required. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure. Good organizational skills and attention to detail. Proficiency in MS Office and basic knowledge of reservation systems is an advantage. Having a Proven work experience as a receptionist, front desk officer, or similar role is a Plus. Responsibilities Greet and welcome visitors in a professional manner. Answer, screen, and forward incoming phone calls. Maintain a tidy and presentable reception area. Receive, sort, and distribute mail and packages. Schedule and confirm appointments or meetings. Assist with basic administrative support such as filing, data entry, and document preparation. Provide information and direct inquiries to the appropriate department or staff. Support other office operations as needed

title: Commis II Chef - Day Shift
description:
Job Summary We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Commis II Chef to join our kitchen team during the day shift. The role involves assisting in food preparation, maintaining high-quality standards, and supporting senior chefs to ensure smooth kitchen operations. Responsibilities
  • Assist in preparing and cooking dishes according to recipes and menu guidelines.
  • Follow instructions from senior chefs to ensure consistent quality and presentation.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the kitchen and workstations.
  • Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items to minimize waste.
  • Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards at all times.
  • Assist in receiving, unpacking, and storing deliveries.
  • Support the kitchen team in various tasks during busy service periods.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Sous Chef or Head Chef.
Requirements
  • Previous experience as a Commis Chef or kitchen assistant preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of cooking techniques and food preparation.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and follow instructions accurately. Strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Flexibility to work overnight, weekends, and holidays.
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene practices.

title: የኮንቴንት ክሬተር እና ካስቲንግ ዳይሬክተር
description:
የኮንቴንት ክሬተር እና ካስቲንግ ዳይሬክተር

https://forms.gle/DjVEWpvzD7EdnbDM6

ከከፍተኛ የፈጠራ ባለሙያዎች ጋር በመሆን ስምዎን የሚገነቡበት ትልቅ እድል!
ድርጅታችን በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ፣ በኦንላይን ስልጠና እና በማማከር ስራ ላይ የተሰማራ ቀዳሚ ተቋም ነው። አሁን ደግሞ ስራዎቻችንን ወደ ላቀ ደረጃ ለማድረስ፣ በዘመናዊ የቴክኖሎጂ ውጤቶች በተሟላ የፕሮፌሽናል ፕሮዳክሽን ስቱዲዮ ውስጥ አብሮን የሚሰራ ብቁ ኮንቴንት ክሬተር እና ካስቲንግ ዳይሬክተር እንፈልጋለን።
በተለይም የተዋጣለት የፖድካስት (Podcast) ዝግጅት ልምድ ያላችሁ እና ራሳችሁን እንደ ብራንድ ማሳደግ የምትፈልጉ ባለሙያዎች ቅድሚያ እንሰጣለን።
እኛ የምናቀርባቸው ልዩ ጥቅሞች
• ዘመናዊ ስቱዲዮ፦ ሙሉ ጥራት ባላቸው የካሜራ፣ የድምፅ እና የብርሃን መሳሪያዎች የተደራጀ የቪዲዮ እና የፖድካስት ስቱዲዮ።
• የግል ብራንድ ግንባታ፦ ፕሮፌሽናል በሆነ መልኩ በቪዲዮዎች ላይ በመታየት ራስዎን ለገበያ የሚያስተዋውቁበት እድል።
• ምቹ የስራ አካባቢ፦ ስራን በስርአት እና በቴክኖሎጂ ለመስራት የሚያስችል የተደራጀ ቢሮ።
ዋና ዋና የስራ ኃላፊነቶች
• የፈጠራ ስራዎች፦ ለተለያዩ የሶሻል ሚዲያ ገጾች (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook) የሚሆኑ አዝናኝ እና አስተማሪ የሆኑ የቪዲዮ ሃሳቦችን ማመንጨት።
• ካስቲንግ እና ፖድካስት፦ ለቪዲዮ ቀረጻ የሚሆኑ ባለሙያዎችን መምረጥ (Casting) እና ልምድ ባለው መልኩ የፖድካስት/የቃለ-መጠይቅ ፕሮግራሞችን መምራት።
• የኮርስ ዝግጅት፦ ለኦንላይን ስልጠናዎች የሚሆኑ ማኑዋሎችን እና የትምህርት ይዘቶችን ማዘጋጀት።
• እቅድ ማውጣት፦ ሳምንታዊ እና ወርሃዊ የኮንቴንት ካላንደር ማዘጋጀት እና ስራዎችን መከታተል።
• ድምፅ እና ቪዲዮ፦ ፕሮፌሽናል የሆኑ የቮይስ ኦቨር (Voiceover) ስራዎችን መስራት እና በቪዲዮ ኤዲቲንግ ስራ ላይ መሳተፍ።
ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች እና ዝግጅት
• ትምህርት፦ በመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ በJournalism, Communication, Marketing ወይም ተዛማጅ መስኮች የተመረቀ/ች።

description:
ዋና አስተዳዳሪ / አጠቃላይ ተቆጣጣሪ

ለማመልከት እባክዎ ይህንን ሊንክ ይጠቀሙ (Use this link to APPLY)

https://forms.gle/GfVQx2teiW77Q2di7

ድርጅታችንን ወደ ከፍተኛ ስኬት ለመምራት በዲጂታል ዘርፍ ሰፊ እውቀት ያላቸውን፣ ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያላቸውን እና ልምድ ያላቸውን ባለሙያዎች ይፈልጋል። ይህ የሥራ መደብ የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ አስተዳደር፣ የሽያጭ ስራዎችን እና የፕሮዳክሽን ሂደቶችን በብቃት መምራት ለሚችሉ ባለሙያዎች የተዘጋጀ ነው።
ልዩ ማሳሰቢያ፦ ይህ የሥራ መደብ ሰልጣኞችን ወይም በቂ ልምድ የሌላቸውን አያካትትም። አመልካቾች የድርጅቱን ነባር ሥራዎች ተረክበው ወዲያውኑ ማስቀጠል የሚችሉ፣ በአስተዳደርና ሽያጭ ዘርፍ የካበተ ልምድ ያላቸው መሆን ይኖርባቸዋል።

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች
1. ስትራቴጂክ አመራር እና ማርኬቲንግ
•  የድርጅቱን ዋና አንቀሳቃሽ የሆነውን የማርኬቲንግ ዘርፍ ውጤታማ ማድረግ።
•  ድርጅቱን ትርፋማ የሚያደርጉ ፖሊሲዎችን እና ስትራቴጂዎችን ነድፎ መተግበር።
•  የድርጅቱን የአጭርና የረዥም ጊዜ ዕቅዶች ለማሳካት የሰው ኃይልንና የሥራ ሂደቶችን መምራት።
2. የፕሮዳክሽን እና የሥራ ሂደት ቁጥጥር
•  የፕሮዳክሽን ሥራዎች በታቀደላቸው ጥራትና ጊዜ መጠናቀቃቸውን ማረጋገጥ።
•  እያንዳንዱ የሥራ ሂደት ለድርጅቱ ግብ ስኬት የበኩሉን አስተዋጽኦ እያበረከተ መሆኑን መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማቅረብ።
•  የሠራተኞችን የሥራ ክንውን መገምገም እና የአሠራር ባህል እንዲጎለብት ማድረግ።
3. ፋይናንስ እና አስተዳደር
•  የበጀት አጠቃቀምን መከታተል፣ አላስፈላጊ ወጪዎችን መቀነስ እና ትርፋማነትን ማረጋገጥ።
•  ከፋይናንስ ባለሙያዎች ጋር በመተባበር የግብርና የቀረጥ ክፍያዎች በወቅቱ እንዲከናወኑ ማድረግ።
•  አዳዲስ ሠራተኞችን የመመልመል፣ የማሰልጠን እና የማስተዳደር ሥራዎችን ማከናወን።
የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች
•  ትምህርት፡ የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ (BA) በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ማኔጅመንት፣ ቢዝነስ አድሚኒስትሬሽን ወይም በተዛማጅ መስኮች።
•  የሥራ ልምድ፡ በአስተዳደር፣ በማርኬቲንግ በሽያጭ አስተዳደር እና በአመራር እና በድርጅት ዕቅድ ዝግጅት ቢያንስ 3 ዓመት እና ከዚያ በላይ የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ላት።

description: የሽያጭ ተቆጣጣሪ (Sales Supervisor ለማመልከት እባክዎ ይህንን ሊንክ ይጠቀሙ (Use this link to APPLY) https://forms.gle/gy7wstJMwPhVkp5q7 ድርጅታችን በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ፣ በኦንላይን ስልጠና እና በማማከር ዘርፍ ግንባር ቀደም ተመራጭ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት የሽያጭ ቡድናችንን በባለቤትነት መርቶ ወደ ላቀ ስኬት የሚያሸጋግር፣ ብቁ የሽያጭ ተወካዮችን መመልመልና ማሰልጠን የሚችል፣ እና የስፖንሰርሺፕ (Sponsorship) ዕድሎችን የመፍጠር ብቃት ያለው "ጀግና" የሽያጭ ተቆጣጣሪ እንፈልጋለን። 🔴 ልዩ ማሳሰቢያ፦ ድርጅታችን በሂደት ላይ ያሉ ሰፊ ሥራዎች ስላሉት፣ ሥራውን በቀጥታ ተረክቦ ያለምንም ተጨማሪ ስልጠና ወዲያውኑ ውጤት ማምጣት የሚችል ባለሙያ ብቻ እንፈልጋለን። ይህ መደብ አዲስ ሰልጣኞችን ወይም በቂ ልምድ የሌላቸውን በፍጹም አይመለከትም። እኛ የሽያጭን ጥበብ እናከብራለን! ለታታሪ ባለሙያዎች የሚከተሉትን ልዩ ጥቅሞች አዘጋጅተናል፦ •  ከፍተኛ የኮሚሽን ዕድል፡ ከቋሚ ደመወዙ በተጨማሪ፣ የሽያጭ ግቦችን በማሳካት እስከ 6% የሚደርስ እጅግ ማራኪ ኮሚሽን ያገኛሉ። በኮሚሽን አሠራር ላይ ትልቅ ፍላጎትና እምነት ላላቸው ባለሙያዎች የተዘጋጀ ዕድል ነው! •  የእውቀት ሽልማት፡ በገበያው ተወዳዳሪ ሆነው እንዲቀጥሉ የዘርፉን ስልጠናና ድጋፍ እንሰጣለን። •  የመሪነት ነፃነት፡ የራስዎን ቡድን የመገንባት፣ የማሰልጠን እና አዳዲስ ስልቶችን የመንደፍ ሙሉ ስልጣን ይኖርዎታል። የሥራው ዋና ኃላፊነቶች 1.  ቡድን መገንባትና መምራት፦ ብቁ የሽያጭ ተወካዮችን መመልመል፣ ማሰልጠን እና ውጤታማ የሽያጭ ቡድን መገንባት። 2.  ስፖንሰርሺፕ እና ሽያጭ፦ አዳዲስ የስፖንሰርሺፕ ዕድሎችን ማምጣት እና ከትልልቅ ደንበኞች ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት መፍጠር። 3.  የሽያጭ ስልቶች፦ Lead Generation፣ Cold Calling እና ፊት ለፊት (Face-to-Face) የሽያጭ ዘዴዎችን በመጠቀም የሽያጭ ግቦችን ማሳካት። 4.  ቁጥጥርና ድጋፍ፦ የቡድኑን የዕለት ተዕለት አፈጻጸም መከታተል፣ መገምገም እና አስፈላጊውን ሙያዊ ድጋፍ መስጠት። የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች •  ትምህርት፦ የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ በMarketing, Management, Psychology ወይም ተዛማጅ መስኮች። •  ልምድ፦ በሽያጭ ሱፐርቫይዘርነት ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት የተረጋገጠ የሥራ ልምድ። •  ክህሎት፦ * በ Lead Generation፣ Cold Calling እና ፊት ለፊት ሽያጭ ላይ ጥልቅ ልምድ ያለው/ላት። o  የዲጂታል እና ሶሻል ሚዲያ ማርኬቲንግ እውቀት ያለው/ላት። o  ስፖንሰርሺፕ የማምጣት እና የመደራደር ከፍተኛ ብቃት። •  ባህሪ፦ በኮሚሽን ላይ ተመስርቶ ለመስራት ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት እና የገቢ ዕድገትን የመፈለግ ትልቅ ፍላጎት (High Desire for Commission)። ደመወዝ እና ጥቅማጥቅሞች •  ቋሚ ደመወዝ: 8,500 ብር •  ኮሚሽን: እስከ 6% የሚደርስ (በአፈጻጸም ላይ የተመሰረተ) ማመልከቻው የሚያበቃበት ቀን: ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ቀን ጀምሮ ባሉት 10 ተከታታይ የሥራ ቀናት ውስጥ ብቻ። ቴሌግራም፦ @Supervacancy1 •  ስልክ፦ 0908 222223 / 0963 555553 •  አድራሻ፦ ከመካኒሳ ወደ ጀርመን በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ፣ የኪራይ ቤቶች ህንፃ፣ 2ኛ ፎቅ። ይህንን መረጃ ለሚመጥናቸው ባለሙያዎች በማጋራት ይተባበሩ!

title: ሲኒማቶግራፈር እና ቪዲዮ ኤዲተር (Cinematographer & Video Editor)
description: ሲኒማቶግራፈር እና ቪዲዮ ኤዲተር (Cinematographer & Video Editor) ለማመልከት እባክዎ ይህንን ሊንክ ይጠቀሙ (Use this link to APPLY) https://forms.gle/qvtUPHFjWziY72as7 ድርጅታችን በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ፣ በሶሻል ሚዲያ ማማከር እና በኦንላይን ስልጠና (LMS Platform) ዘርፍ በስፋት እየተንቀሳቀሰ የሚገኝ ተቋም ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት የድርጅታችንን እና የደንበኞቻችንን ራዕይ በምስል ወደ ሕይወት የሚቀይር፣ ከቀረጻ በፊት ዝግጅት (Pre-production) እስከ መጨረሻው ኤዲቲንግ (Post-production) ያለውን ሂደት በጥራት መምራት የሚችል "ፈጣሪ" ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን። 🔴 ልዩ ማሳሰቢያ፦ ይህ መደብ ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያለው እና የቪዲዮ ፕሮዳክሽንን ሙሉ ሂደት (End-to-End) በብቃት መወጣት የሚችል ባለሙያ ብቻ የሚፈልግ ነው። ሥራውን በቀጥታ ተረክቦ ጥራታቸውን የጠበቁ ኮርሶችን እና የማስታወቂያ ቪዲዮዎችን ማምረት የሚችል ብቃት ይጠበቃል። እኛ ለፈጠራ ባለሙያዎች የሚከተሉትን ዕድሎች እናመቻቻለን፦ • የፈጠራ ነፃነት፦ አዳዲስ አቀራረቦችን እና ቴክኖሎጂዎችን በመጠቀም የራስዎን አሻራ የሚያርፉበት የሥራ ድባብ። • ዘመናዊ መሣሪያዎች፦ ሥራዎን በጥራት ለማከናወን የሚያስፈልጉ የቴክኖሎጂ ግብዓቶች አቅርቦት። • የዕድገት ዕድል፦ ከተለያዩ ትልልቅ ተቋማት እና ፕሮጀክቶች ጋር በመስራት ሙያዊ ብቃትን የማሳደግ ዕድል። የሥራው ዋና ኃላፊነቶች 1. ሙሉ ፕሮዳክሽን፦ ከቀረጻ በፊት ያሉ ቅድመ ዝግጅቶችን ማከናወን፣ ጥራት ያለው ምስል መቅረጽ እና የድህረ-ቀረጻ (Post-production/Editing) ሥራዎችን መሥራት። 2. የይዘት ልማት፦ ለኦንላይን ትምህርቶች (LMS)፣ ለሶሻል ሚዲያ ማስታወቂያዎች እና ለድርጅታዊ ስልጠናዎች የሚሆኑ ቪዲዮዎችን ማዘጋጀት። 3. የመሣሪያዎች ቁጥጥር፦ የካሜራ፣ የድምፅ እና የብርሃን መሣሪያዎች ዝግጁነትን መከታተልና በአግባቡ መያዝ። 4. ቡድን መምራት፦ በሥራው ሂደት ውስጥ ሌሎች ረዳት ባለሙያዎችን ማስተባበር እና የሥራ ዕቅድ ማውጣት። የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች • ክህሎት፦ በካሜራ አጠቃቀም (Cinematography) እና በቪዲዮ ኤዲቲንግ (Premiere Pro, After Effects ወይም ተዛማጅ) ላይ ከፍተኛ ብቃት። • ተጨማሪ ሶፍትዌር፦ የAdobe Photoshop አጠቃቀም ላይ ጥልቅ እውቀት ያለው/ላት። • ልምድ፦ በዘርፉ በቂ የሥራ ልምድ ያለው እና ቀደም ሲል የሠራቸውን ሥራዎች (Portfolio) ማሳየት የሚችል/ምትችል። • ባህሪ፦ የደንበኞችን ፍላጎት ተረድቶ በፈጠራ የታጀበ ውጤት ማምጣት የሚችል/ምትችል። ጥቅማጥቅሞች • ደመወዝ፦ 12000 • ቴሌግራም፦ @Supervacancy1 • ፎርም ለመሙላት፦ እዚህ ይጫኑ • ስልክ፦ 0908 222223 / 0914 949494 • አድራሻ፦ ከመካኒሳ ወደ ጀርመን በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ፣ የኪራይ ቤቶች ህንፃ፣ 2ኛ ፎቅ።

title: የቢሮ ጽዳት እና መልዕክተኛ
description:
8ተኛ ክፍል ያጠናቀቀች አግባብ ከሆነ የስራ ልምድ ጋር

ዋና ዋና ተግባራት እና ኃላፊነቶች

- የቢሮዎችን፣ የመጸዳጃ ቤቶችን፣ የመተላለፊያ መንገዶችን እና የወለል ጽዳት በየቀኑ በሚገባ መጠበቅ።

- የቢሮ እቃዎችን (ጠረጴዛ፣ ወንበር፣ ቁምሳጥን) እና የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መሣሪያዎችን (ኮምፒውተር፣ ፕሪንተር) አቧራ ማጽዳት።

- የቆሻሻ መጣያ ባልዲዎችን በየቀኑ ባዶ ማድረግና አካባቢውን ንጹህ ማድረግ።

- ለሰራተኞችና ለደንበኞች/እንግዶች እንደ አስፈላጊነቱ ሻይ፣ ቡና እና ውሃ ማዘጋጀትና ማቅረብ።

- ደብዳቤዎችን፣ ሰነዶችንና ፓኬጆችን ከቢሮ ቢሮ ወይም ወደ ውጭ ተቋማት ማድረስና መቀበል።

title: የሕፃናት እንክብካቤ አሰልጣኝ
description:
የትምህርት ደረጃ፦ በነርሲንግ (Nursing) / በሚድዋይፈሪ (Midwifery) ወይም ተዛማጅ የትምህርት ዝግጅት

የሚፈለግ የቋንቋ ችሎታ

ማዕከላችን በሚከተሉት ቋንቋዎች ማስተማር የሚችሉ ሶስት (3) አሰልጣኞችን መቅጠር ይፈልጋል፦

• በእንግሊዝኛ ቋንቋ

• በአፋን ኦሮሞ ቋንቋ

• በትግርኛ ቋንቋ

ኃላፊነቶች

• በእፎይ ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የሕፃናት እንክብካቤ ሥልጠና መስጠት

• ለሠልጣኞች የተግባር እና የንድፈ-ሐሳብ ሥልጠናዎችን መስጠት

• የትምህርት ዕቅድ እና የሥልጠና ቁሳቁሶችን ማዘጋጀት

• የሠልጣኞችን ብቃት መመዘን እና ግብረ-መልስ መስጠት

• ሠልጣኞች የሕፃናት እንክብካቤ ኢንዱስትሪ ደረጃዎችን እንዲያሟሉ መደገፍ

• በሥልጠናው ወቅት የሕፃናት ደህንነት እና ጥበቃ መርሆዎች መከበራቸውን ማረጋገጥ

ክህሎቶች

• የተለያዩ የትምህርት ደረጃ ያላቸውን ሰልጣኞች የማስተማር ብቃት

• የሴቶች አቅም ግንባታ እና ጥራት ያለው የሕፃናት እንክብካቤ አገልግሎት ፍላጎት

• ጥሩ የግንኙነት እና የክፍል አመራር ክህሎት

title: ሹፌር
description:
ድርጅታችን ኮንቨርጀንስ አይቲ ሶሉሽን ብቃት ያለውን ሹፌር ከዚ በታች የተጠቀሱትን መስፈርቶች ማሟላት እሚችል አወዳድሮ መቅጠር ይፈልጋል።

ተፈላጊ የትምህርት ደረጃ

10+ እና ከዛ በላይ
የመንጃ ፍቃድ ደረጃ

አውቶ ወይም ህዝብ 1
የታደሰ መንጃ ፍቃድ
የስራ አይነት

እሚላኩ እና እሚሰበሰቡ እቃዎችን እና ሰነዶችን በሰአቱ መላክ እና መሰብሰብ እንዲሁም ደህንነታቸው በተጠበቀ ሁኔታ ማድረስ/መሰብሰብ
የመስሪያ ቤቱን ሰራተኞች እንዲሁም እንግዶች ወደ ተለያይዩ ቦታዎች ማድረስ እና መመለስ
ስለ መኪና በቂ የሚባል ቴክኒካል እና የተግባር እውቀት ያለው
ለድርጅቱ እንደ አስፈላጊነቱ ግዚዎችን መፈጸም
ከሰው ጋር ተግባቢ የሆነ እና በድርጅት ውስጥ በማንኛውም ቦታ ላይ ለመስራት ፈቃደኛ የሆነ
የመኖሪያ አድራሻው ለ 4ኪሎ ቅርብ የሆነ
የአዲስ አበባ ዋና መንገዶችን እንዲሁም አቋራች መንገዶችን ጠንቅቆ እሚያቅ
እንደአስፈላጊነቱ ወደ ክፍለሃገር ለመጓዝ ፈቃደኛ የሆነ

title: Master Trainer- Leadership & Personal Development Trainer
description:
Please apply using this Link:

https://app.globedocket.com/jobs/globedock_plc/Master-Trainer

(Note: Applications using the link will get priority.)

 

GlobeDock Academy is an Ethiopian EdTech organization that delivers scalable, inclusive learning solutions for youth, educators, and communities, particularly in low-resource and low-connectivity environments. We design mobile-first, offline-capable learning systems that prioritize educational integrity, learner safety, and measurable impact.

 

Role Summary

We are hiring a senior-level master trainer to lead the design, delivery, and quality assurance of leadership and personal development training programs.

This role is not for motivational speakers or entry-level trainers.

The master trainer will:

Translate leadership and personal development theory into practical, behavior-based learning.
Build the capacity of trainers and facilitators through Training-of-Trainers (ToT).
Own training quality, facilitation standards, and learner outcomes across programs.
This is a systems-oriented role focused on scalability, consistency, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Training Design & Delivery

Design and deliver leadership and personal development programs grounded in adult learning principles.
Ensure content is practical, culturally relevant, and adaptable to contexts.
Quality Assurance & Learning Outcomes

Monitor learner performance and behavioral outcomes.
Collect feedback and continuously improve curricula and delivery models.
Ensure training consistency across digital, blended, and offline formats.
Strategic Contribution

Advise leadership on adult learning innovation and leadership development strategy.
Collaborate with content, technology, and operations teams to align learning systems.
Uphold safeguarding, ethical training practices, data protection, and responsible AI use.
Required Qualifications

+5 years of proven experience delivering leadership and personal development training, and extensive senior-level training experience
Demonstrated experience as a lead trainer or master trainer
Deep mastery of adult learning and facilitation methodologies
Ability to translate theory into observable leadership behaviors
Strong coaching and mentoring capability
High emotional intelligence and cultural sensitivity
Experience with digital, blended, and offline learning tools
Strong ethical standards and a learner-centered mindset
Experience working with youth, educators, NGOs, CSOs, or education-focused institutions is strongly preferred.

title: TikTok Content creator
description: We are looking for a creative to own our brand’s voice on TikTok. You aren’t just posting videos; you are building a community. Your goal is to stop the scroll, spark conversations, and turn viewers into fans by mastering the intersection of entertainment and brand storytelling. Key Responsibilities Trend Harvesting: Daily "social listening" to identify emerging sounds, memes, and challenges before they peak. End-to-End Production: Concepting, scripting, filming, and editing 3–4 high-quality TikToks per week. Community Engagement: Managing the comments section with a distinct brand voice—replying to fans, sparking "duet" opportunities, and handling Q&As. Platform Strategy: Optimizing captions, hashtags, and posting schedules based on TikTok’s ever-changing algorithm. Data Analysis: Using TikTok Analytics to track views, watch time, and conversion rates to refine our content strategy. Collaborations: Identifying and reaching out to creators for potential partnerships or UGC (User Generated Content) campaigns. What You Bring to the Table Native TikTok Fluency: You spend more time on your FYP than you’d like to admit. You understand the nuances of "TikTok humor" and transitions. Editing Prowess: skills in CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or in-app editing tools. On-Camera Confidence: Whether you are the "face" of the brand or directing others, you know how to command attention in the first 2 seconds. Strategic Thinking: You don’t just want "viral" videos; you want videos that actually move the needle for the business. How to Apply Forget the boring CV or cover letter. Send us a link to your portfolio or, if you don't have one, a 30- 60-second Video explaining why you’re the perfect fit for this role. (you can use Amharic or English)

We are a dynamic young company based in Addis Ababa with a key partner in Berlin, Germany, specializing in digital strategy consulting and solution engineering. Our expertise spans custom software development, artificial intelligence, and blockchain technologies. While our primary customer base is in Europe, we serve clients globally. Our team reflects this global reach, consisting of carefully selected experts from around the world.

About the Role

We are seeking a mature and self-sufficient Senior Flutter Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have the technical skills of an experienced coder, but also possess the professionalism and maturity to manage their own work from start to finish. This is a crucial, high-impact role where you will be expected to work independently, ensuring all deliverables meet the high standards of our European clients. We need a professional who can deliver high-quality, well-documented, and well-tested work.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate directly with international clients to clarify, refine, and document project requirements.
Actively participate in architectural design discussions and provide input on technical solutions.
Manage and deliver assigned work packages with minimal supervision, ensuring projects are on track and meet all deadlines.
Develop, test, and maintain high-quality, cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
Write and execute unit tests to ensure the reliability and quality of your code.
Document your work thoroughly, including code, technical specifications, and project-related decisions.
Optimize app performance, security, and scalability.
Integrate APIs, third-party services, and native platform features.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently.
Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Proven professional experience as a Senior Flutter Developer (3+ years).
A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to deliver complete, high-quality projects.
In-depth knowledge of the Flutter framework and Dart, with a strong understanding of mobile design principles.
Expertise in state management solutions (e.g., Provider, Riverpod, Bloc, MobX).
Experience with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Firebase, or similar backend integrations.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and app deployment on the Play Store & App Store.
Strong debugging, problem-solving, and performance optimization skills.
Experience with Agile methodologies.
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work effectively with remote teams and international clients.
Demonstrated maturity and initiative, with the ability to manage your own workload and proactively solve problems.
Fluent English speaking and writing skills, with the ability to communicate clearly in meetings and async collaboration.
What We Offer

The opportunity to work on innovative, impactful projects for global clients.
A high degree of autonomy and the chance to directly influence project outcomes.
A competitive salary and benefits package.
Strong focus on career growth, mentorship, and professional development.
A collaborative and supportive work culture focused on quality and professionalism.
How to Apply

Your CV

title: Marketing Research & Development (R&D) Officer
description:
Position: Marketing Research & Development (R&D) Officer

Reports to: Marketing Director
Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (with periodic upcountry market visits)
Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent

1. Position Summary:
ROMEL seeks a curious, analytical, and strategic Marketing R&D Officer to serve as the central intelligence hub for our business. This role is designed to close the critical loop between the market, our product development & our marketing strategy. You will be responsible for gathering market intelligence, understanding customer needs, analyzing competitor actions & translating these insights into clear recommendations for new product development, product improvements, & targeted marketing campaigns.

2. Key Responsibilities & Duties:

A. Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis:

Establish & lead a weekly Competitor Intelligence Program, tracking key competitors on pricing, new product launches, promotional offers, credit terms & distribution tactics.
Conduct regular mystery shopping and trade audits at competitor and partner outlets to assess merchandising, stock availability, and sales practices.
Analyze import/export data and industry reports to identify macroeconomic trends affecting the electrical and lighting sectors in Ethiopia.
Maintain a live competitor database & provide actionable alerts to the Marketing Director and sales teams.
B. Customer & Market Research:

Design and execute quantitative and qualitative research projects, including customer surveys, focus group discussions, and in-depth interviews with B2B clients, electricians, architects, and end-consumers.
Systematically collect, categorize, and analyze customer complaints & feedback from showrooms & sales teams to identify recurring product or service issues.
Lead initiatives to uncover unmet needs & emerging trends in lighting, finishes, and electrical solutions.
Conduct outlet and channel surveys to map distribution gaps and identify potential new agent locations in Addis Ababa & key regional towns.
C. New Product Development (NPD) Support:

Work closely with the Factory Manager and Brand Manager to provide market-driven insights for the New Product Development pipeline.
Analyze the performance of newly launched products and recommend adjustments to marketing mix or product features.
D. Reporting & Strategic Input:

Synthesize findings into clear, concise, and visually engaging reports (e.g., Monthly Market Intelligence Report, Quarterly Consumer Insights Summary).
Present research findings & strategic recommendations to senior management.
Support the development of the annual marketing plan with data-driven insights on target segments, positioning, and growth opportunities.
·       Collect photographic and video evidence of competitor and ROMEL product placement, promotions, and shelf-share during all market visits for analysis.

Gather real-time, on-the-ground intelligence on unofficial pricing & discounting practices happening at the channel level.
3. Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Statistics, Economics, or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus.
Minimum of 3-5 years of professional experience in market research, business intelligence or product management. Experience in the manufacturing, retail, FMCG or electrical & lighting sectors is highly advantageous.
Proven expertise in designing research methodologies, writing questionnaires, conducting interviews, and analyzing both quantitative and qualitative data.
High proficiency in data analysis tools (Microsoft Excel is essential
Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Must be proactive, detail-oriented, and possess a deep curiosity about consumer behavior and market dynamics with the ability to tell a story with data.

title: Senior Front-End Developer
description:
Job Summary

As a Senior Front-End Developer, you will design, build, and sustain high-performance, accessible web applications using React and Next.js. You’ll own front-end architecture and patterns, raise the bar on Core Web Vitals and UX quality, and collaborate closely with product, design, and backend to deliver thin, testable slices that move key metrics.

Duties and Responsibilities

Architecture & Delivery: Design front-end architecture, build scalable UI with React/Next.js (SSR/SSG/ISR, Server & Client Components, caching, routing).
Performance: Improve LCP/INP/CLS via code-splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, and smart CDN/cache strategies.
Accessibility: Ship WCAG 2.1 AA–compliant experiences with semantic HTML, keyboard support, and a11y testing.
TypeScript First: Maintain strict typing, reusable patterns, and safe APIs.
Design System: Create/extend a component library with Storybook, design tokens, theming, and UI primitives.
Data & State: Integrate REST/GraphQL, use Redux Toolkit/RTK Query, React Query/SWR, or Zustand appropriately.
Testing: Ensure quality with Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright/Cypress, keep meaningful coverage and CI gates.
Styling: Build responsive UIs with Tailwind CSS and/or CSS Modules, and maintain scalable CSS architecture.
SEO & Analytics: Implement metadata, structured data, sitemaps; add event tracking and support i18n where needed.
DevEx & CI/CD: Improve pipelines (Vercel/GitHub Actions), lint/format (ESLint/Prettier), and preview environments.
Collaboration: Partner with PO/Design/Backend/QA to translate requirements into valuable increments mentor engineers and lead reviews.
4+ years building production web apps with React and/or Next.js.

Job Requirement
Strong TypeScript skills and modern React patterns (hooks, context, suspense, error boundaries).
Hands-on Next.js (SSR/SSG/ISR, App Router, Server Components) and deployments
Proven results improving Core Web Vitals and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.
Solid testing practice: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress.
API integration (REST/GraphQL), caching strategies, robust error handling.
Proficient with Git, CI/CD, and debugging (browser devtools, profiling).
Excellent communication, product sense, and teamwork;
Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
Nice to have: Tailwind CSS, Storybook/Radix UI/shadcn, Redux Toolkit/RTK Query, React Query/SWR, Zustand, monorepos (Turborepo/Nx), Docker, SEO/structured data;

title: Senior Full-Stack & Automation Engineer
description:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Task: Develop and test a low-latency arbitrage bot that executes trades between a fast feed and a retail broker.
Logic: Implement basic filters for Spread, Time-of-Day, and Slippage control.
Tech: Python or C++.
3. Environment Automation (Android Emulators)

Task: Write scripts to automate our Android Virtual Machines.
Logic: Create tools to automatically reset emulators, rotate Device IDs (IMEI/MAC spoofing), and pre-load broker apps.
Tech: Python scripting with ADB (Android Debug Bridge).
REQUIRED SKILLS

Coding: Strong experience in Python or JavaScript (Node.js).
Database: Good knowledge of SQL for managing user data and transaction logs.
Automation: Experience with ADB, Appium, or manipulating Android Emulators is essential.
Network: Understanding of how to inspect network traffic (Wireshark/Fiddler) is a big plus.
BONUS SKILLS
