title: Senior Front-End Developer
description: Job Summary As a Senior Front-End Developer, you will design, build, and sustain high-performance, accessible web applications using React and Next.js. You’ll own front-end architecture and patterns, raise the bar on Core Web Vitals and UX quality, and collaborate closely with product, design, and backend to deliver thin, testable slices that move key metrics. Duties and Responsibilities Architecture & Delivery: Design front-end architecture, build scalable UI with React/Next.js (SSR/SSG/ISR, Server & Client Components, caching, routing). Performance: Improve LCP/INP/CLS via code-splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, and smart CDN/cache strategies. Accessibility: Ship WCAG 2.1 AA–compliant experiences with semantic HTML, keyboard support, and a11y testing. TypeScript First: Maintain strict typing, reusable patterns, and safe APIs. Design System: Create/extend a component library with Storybook, design tokens, theming, and UI primitives. Data & State: Integrate REST/GraphQL, use Redux Toolkit/RTK Query, React Query/SWR, or Zustand appropriately. Testing: Ensure quality with Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright/Cypress, keep meaningful coverage and CI gates. Styling: Build responsive UIs with Tailwind CSS and/or CSS Modules, and maintain scalable CSS architecture. SEO & Analytics: Implement metadata, structured data, sitemaps; add event tracking and support i18n where needed. DevEx & CI/CD: Improve pipelines (Vercel/GitHub Actions), lint/format (ESLint/Prettier), and preview environments. Collaboration: Partner with PO/Design/Backend/QA to translate requirements into valuable increments mentor engineers and lead reviews. 4+ years building production web apps with React and/or Next.js. Job Requirement Strong TypeScript skills and modern React patterns (hooks, context, suspense, error boundaries). Hands-on Next.js (SSR/SSG/ISR, App Router, Server Components) and deployments Proven results improving Core Web Vitals and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility. Solid testing practice: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress. API integration (REST/GraphQL), caching strategies, robust error handling. Proficient with Git, CI/CD, and debugging (browser devtools, profiling). Excellent communication, product sense, and teamwork; Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. Nice to have: Tailwind CSS, Storybook/Radix UI/shadcn, Redux Toolkit/RTK Query, React Query/SWR, Zustand, monorepos (Turborepo/Nx), Docker, SEO/structured data;

title: Senior 3D Generalist / Artist (Blender)
description:
We are looking for a senior 3D generalist to take responsibility for delivering high-quality 3D work.

This role is suited to someone with strong technical judgment, good discipline, and a steady approach to work. Someone who follows through on commitments, communicates clearly, and works with a high degree of independence.

You will be given ownership of meaningful work and expected to carry it from brief to final delivery.

Compensation

Net: 40,000 ETB per month
Project-based bonuses tied to delivery and responsibility
What This Role Is About

Owning assigned 3D work from brief to final output
Turning open-ended or loosely defined requirements into finished, client-ready results
Making practical decisions around quality, trade-offs, and timelines
Communicating progress, risks, and decisions clearly
Operating with reliability and minimal oversight
This role assumes a professional level of trust and responsibility on both sides.

Responsibilities

Understand loose brief, join communication with clients.
Deliver 3D work across modeling, texturing, lighting, animation, and rendering
Create and refine 3D assets including products, props, environments, and occasionally characters
Do scoping/estimating complexity and timelines for new work
Set up scenes with strong composition, materials, lighting, and cameras
Apply a strong artistic eye, particularly in texturing and lighting
Manage time and commitments with consistency
Raise issues early when something requires discussion or adjustment
Incorporate feedback to improve the final outcome
Request for additional team support when the work exceeds capacity, giving feedback to team as needed
Requirements

Good understanding of English
Strong understanding of the full 3D production pipeline
Senior-level experience delivering finished, production-ready work
Sound judgment and ability to work without step-by-step direction
Strong artistic eye, with texturing and lighting as a clear strength
Clear, calm communication style
Reliable and consistent follow-through
Proficient in Blender
This role is a good fit for someone who works best with clear responsibility and trust.

Bonus

Experience mentoring or supporting junior artists
How to Apply

Submit a portfolio or reel showing work across the full 3D pipeline
Include at least one example of work you owned from start to finish
Briefly describe a project where you were responsible for delivery with minimal oversight
Interview Process:

After passing an initial in-person interview, there will be a 2 day test assignment for shortlisted candidates.

This position is offered as an internship. A transportation Stipend will be offerd.

title: Junior Battery Swapper
description:
Junior Battery Swapper

Type of Employment: Permanent

Location: Addis Ababa

Reports to: Battery Swapper team lead

About Dodai

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making urban e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025. It’s thus looking to engage dynamic Ethiopian talent to ensure the achievement of its goals.

Job Summary:

We are seeking enthusiastic and reliable Junior Battery Swappers to join our growing operations team in Addis Ababa. As a Junior Battery Swapper, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our electric two-wheeler riders have seamless access to fully charged batteries. Utilizing our user-friendly mobile application, you will support customers in need of a battery swap and efficiently exchange their depleted battery for a fully charged one. This role requires excellent time management, attention to detail, and a commitment to providing exceptional customer service.

Responsibilities:

Perform Battery Swaps: Execute battery swaps within 2 minutes per transaction, using the Dodai mobile app to record and verify each exchange.
Customer Support at Station: Greet every rider warmly and make them feel valued. Provide clear instructions, assist with any questions, and troubleshoot basic issues such as app errors or incorrect battery insertion. Your goal is to ensure every rider leaves with a positive impression of Dodai’s service and proudly recommends our brand to others.
Inventory Tracking: Monitor and record the number of charged, depleted, or faulty batteries at your station. Flag shortages or overstock to your supervisor.
Battery Charging & Handling: Place depleted batteries on the charging rack according to safety procedures. Disconnect and store fully charged batteries in their designated slots.
Daily Equipment Check: Inspect chargers, tools, and the battery rack for functionality. Immediately report any malfunctions or damage.
Safety Compliance: Wear gloves and follow safety procedures at all times. Ensure the station is clean and hazard-free.
Reporting: Log issues such as damaged batteries, misbehaving app functions, or customer complaints and share with your supervisor daily.
Flexible Tasks: Assist in minor repairs, restocking, or setting up new swapping stations as needed.
Other Duties as Assigned:
Carry out any additional tasks or responsibilities as instructed by your supervisor or manager to support smooth station operations.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (2025 Graduate only).
Proven ability to use mobile applications confidently and accurately in a work environment (e.g., for deliveries, ride-hailing, or logistics). This is a critical skill for operating the battery swapping system.
Must have android smart phone
Willing to work from 8 AM to 5 PM or 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Sunday, with one day off on a shifting schedule
Excellent time management and organizational skills.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
Ability to work independently and efficiently.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
A positive attitude and a customer-centric approach.
Ability to lift and carry batteries weighing up to 32 kilos (weight may vary).
Familiarity with electric vehicles or battery technology is a plus.
Other duties assigned by supervisor

description:
ወደ ሱቁ የሚመጡ ደንበኞችን በመቀበል፣ ስለ ምርቶች (ስለ ቀለሞች፣ የግንባታ መሣሪያዎችና መለዋወጫዎች) ተገቢውን መረጃ በመስጠት እና ደንበኞች የሚፈልጉትን ዕቃ እንዲገዙ በማገዝ የሽያጭ ሂደቱን ማከናወን ነው።

ዋና ዋና የሥራ ኃላፊነቶች

ደንበኞችን ማስተናገድ፦ ወደ ሱቁ የሚመጡ ደንበኞችን በትህትና መቀበል እና የሚፈልጉትን ዕቃ እንዲያገኙ መርዳት።
የምርት ማብራሪያ መስጠት፦ ስለ ዕቃዎቹ ጥራት፣ ዋጋ፣ እና አጠቃቀም ለደንበኞች በቂ ማብራሪያ መስጠት።
ሽያጭ ማከናወን፦ በደንበኛው የተመረጡትን ዕቃዎች ሽያጭ መመዝገብ፣ ደረሰኝ መቁረጥ እና ክፍያ መቀበል።
እቃ (Stock) መቆጣጠር፦ በሱቁ ውስጥ ያለቁ ወይም የተቀነሱ ዕቃዎችን ለሥራ ኃላፊው ማሳወቅ እና አዳዲስ ዕቃዎች ሲመጡ በሥርዓት ማደራጀት።
የሱቅ አደረጃጀት፦ ዕቃዎች በየዓይነታቸው ለደንበኛ በሚታይ መልኩ መደርደራቸውን እና ሱቁ ንጹሕ መሆኑን ማረጋገጥ።

የስራው መስፈርቶች

ትምህርት፦ በማርኬቲንግ የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ

ልምድ፦ ከሁለት አመት በላይ በኮንስትራክሽንና ፊኒሺንግ እቃዎች ዙሪያ በቂ እውቀትና ልምድ ያለው/ያላት

የስራ ሰዓት፦ ከሰኞ እስከ ቅዳሜ ከጠዋቱ 2፡30 እስክአመሻሽ 11፡30

ዋና የሥራ ኃላፊነቶች

የፀጉር ቆራጭና የጢም አገልግሎትን በከፍተኛ ጥራት መስጠት
ዘመናዊና ባህላዊ ስታይሎችን (Fade, Taper, Kunecho/ቁንጮ ወዘተ) በባለሙያነት መፈጸም
ከፍተኛ ደንበኞችን መያዝ እና ልዩ አገልግሎት መስጠት
Junior Barber መመሪያ፣ ስልጠና እና ክትትል ማድረግ
የሥራ መሳሪያዎችን ንፅህናና ደህንነት መቆጣጠር
የሱቅ የስራ ሂደት እና የአገልግሎት ጥራት መጠበቅ

title: የስፌት ባለሙያ
description:
ልምድ ያለው የሰለጠነ እና ዝርዝር ተኮር የጨርቃጨርቅ ስፌት ኦፕሬተሮችን እንፈልጋለን። ተመራጭ እጩዎች የኢንዱስትሪ የልብስ ስፌት ማሽኖችን በመስራት የተለማመዱ፣ ስለ ልብስ ግንባታ ጠንካራ ግንዛቤ እና ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያላቸውን ምርቶች ለማምረት ቁርጠኝነት ያላቸው እና የጨርቃጨርቅ ልብሶችን በጊዜ እና በትክክለኛ አሠራር መሰረት በማምረት ረገድ የሰለጠነ እና ልምድ ያላቸው የስፌት ኦፕሪተሮች።

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች

*  የኢንዱስትሪ የልብስ ስፌት ማሽኖችን በአስተማማኝ እና በብቃት መስራት የሚችል

*  በምርት መመሪያ እና በጥራት ደረጃዎች መሰረት ልብሶችን ወይም የጨርቃጨርቅ ክፍሎችን በትክክል መስፋት

*  የልብስ ስፌት ንድፎችን, ቴክኒካዊ ዝርዝሮችን እና የሱፐርቫይዘሮችን መመሪያዎችን ተከትሎ መስራት

* የተጠናቀቀውን ስራ ለጥራት፣ ወጥነት እና ከማምረት መስፈርቶች ጋር መጣጣምን መፈተሽና ማረጋገጥ

*  የተበላሹ ቁሳቁሶችን ወይም የልብስ ስፌት ማሽን ችግሮችን ወዲያውኑ ለተቆጣጣሪው ማሳወቅ

*  ንጹህ እና የተደራጀ የስራ ቦታን መጠበቅ እና ሁሉም የደህንነት ፕሮቶኮሎች መከበራቸውን ማረጋገጥ

*  እንደ አስፈላጊነቱ ሌሎች የምርት ሂደቶችን መደገፍ፣ መከርከም፣ መጫን ወይም ማጠናቀቅን ጨምሮ

*  ዕለታዊ ምርትን ለማሟላት ከስራ ባልደረቦች እና የቡድን መሪዎች ጋር በትብብር መስራት

አስፈላጊ መስፈርቶች

* በጨርቃ ጨርቅ ወይም የልብስ ስፌት አካባቢ ቢያንስ 1-10 ዓመት ልምድ ያለው

* የተለያዩ የኢንደስትሪ የልብስ ስፌት ማሽኖችን በትክክል የመስራት ችሎታ

* መሰረታዊ የልብስ ስፌት ቴክኒኮችን እና የልብስ ማቀነባበሪያ ሂደቶችን መረዳት

* ለዝርዝር ትኩረት እና ከፍተኛ የጥራት ደረጃዎችን ለመጠበቅ ቁርጠኝነት

* ጥሩ የእጅ አይን ቅንጅት እና የእጅ ቅልጥፍና

መመሪያዎችን የመከተል እና የቡድን አካል ሆኖ የመስራት ችሎታ

* ፍጥነት ባለው፣ በጊዜ ገደብ በሚመራ የምርት አካባቢ ለመስራት ፈቃደኛ መሆን

ደመወዝ፡- በድርጅቱ ስኬል (ነገር ግን በሚችሉት የስፌት ሙያ መሰረት ሆኖ በፈተና ይለያል)

ጥቅማጥቅም፡-ከደመወዝ በተጨማሪ አጥጋቢ ቦነስ፣  መኖሪያ ቤት በነፃ፣ ምግብ፡ ቁርስ፣ ምሳ እና እራት በነፃ፣

ፍላጎቱ ያላቸው አመልካቾች በቴሌግራም  https://t.me/Contact_me_fast  ወይንም requritshints@gmail.com

ሙሉ ስም ስልክ ቁጥርና የስራ ልምድ በመላክ መመዝገብ ትችላላቹህ፡፡

title: Documentary Script Writer
description:
We are looking to onboard a highly capable and creative Documentary Script Writer with a strong command of narrative development and a solid understanding of the end-to-end video production lifecycle.

 

Key Responsibilities

Conceptualize, structure, and write high-quality scripts for documentaries and other video formats, including short films, branded content, and social impact videos.
Translate research findings, interviews, and raw footage into clear, engaging, and audience-focused narratives.
Develop outlines, treatments, loglines, and final shooting scripts aligned with project objectives and target audiences.
Collaborate with directors, producers, editors, and researchers throughout pre-production, production, and post-production phases.
Review and refine scripts based on editorial and client feedbacks.
Prepare and manage shortlists of story angles, themes, and narrative approaches for approval.
Requirements

Proven professional experience in documentary scriptwriting
Strong creative writing skills with the ability to craft authentic, compelling, and structured narratives.
Solid understanding of video production workflows
Ability to work with research materials, transcripts, and briefs, and convert them into visual stories.
Strong time management skill
Experience working on development, social impact, cultural, or journalistic documentaries is required
How to Apply

Send your CV and portfolio of relevant documentary scripts to: info@lafto.partners

Email Subject: Documentary Script Writer – [Your First Name]

title: Senior Survey Trainer
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking highly experienced and results-oriented Senior Survey Trainers to support our research projects on a project basis. The ideal candidates will have strong hands-on experience working with research or survey firms and proven expertise in delivering high-quality training for field teams. The role requires advanced knowledge in livelihood and economic research, agricultural research, enterprise and market research, and qualitative research, with the ability to translate complex research tools into clear, practical training for enumerators and supervisors.

Key Responsibilities

Training & Capacity Building

Design and deliver comprehensive training programs for enumerators, supervisors, and field coordinators
Translate survey instruments into practical, easy-to-understand training modules
Lead classroom-based and field-based training sessions, including pilot testing and mock interviews
Ensure trainees fully understand questionnaires, skip patterns, and data collection protocols
Train teams on ethical research conduct, informed consent, and data quality standards

Research & Technical Support

Provide technical guidance on livelihood, economic, agricultural, enterprise, and market research tools
Support qualitative research methods, including FGDs, KIIs, case studies, and observation
Contribute to tool review, contextualization, and localization
Support field teams during initial deployment to ensure data quality
Identify data quality issues during training and early fieldwork and recommend corrective actions

Coordination & Reporting

Coordinate closely with research managers and field teams
Provide feedback on enumerator performance during and after training
Submit training reports, attendance sheets, and evaluation summaries
Support refresher trainings as required during project implementation
Required Qualifications & Experience

PhD or Master’s degree  with extensive experience in:

 

Economics
Development Studies
Agriculture / Agribusiness
Statistics
Sociology or related social science fields

Minimum of 7–10 years of experience working with research or survey firms
Proven experience as a lead or senior trainer for large-scale surveys
Strong expertise in one or more of the following areas:

 

Livelihood and economic research
Agricultural research
Enterprise and market research
Qualitative research
Demonstrated experience training field teams across multiple regions
Required Skills & Competencies

Excellent facilitation and adult-learning skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to explain complex research tools in a simple, practical manner
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work under tight timelines and in remote settings

title: የሹፌር ባለሙያ
description:
በድጋሚ የወጣ የሥራ ማስታወቂያ

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ ፡-

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን ቀልጣፋ፣ የሥራ ተነሳሽነት ያለውና በጥንቃቄ  በኃላፊነት የስራ ቁሳቁሶችን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ የሚያጓጉዝ ብቁ የሹፌር ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡

መስፈርቶች፡

* ሕጋዊ የሆነ እና የታደሰ /የሚሰራ/ መንጃ ፍቃድ ያለው።

*  መንጃ ፈቃዱ ከታደሰ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት  ያለው ከዚያ በላይ የሆነ፡፡

* ከዚህ በፊት ምንም ዓይነት የቅጣት ሬከርድ የሌለበት፡፡

* አዲስ አበባን እና አካቢዎቿን በሚገባ መንገድ የሚያውቅ  መሆን አለበት፡፡

* የትራፊክ ህጎች እና የከተማ መንገዶች የማሽከርከር እውቀት ያለው።

* ጥንቃቄ በተሞላበት በተሰጠው የመንገድ ህገ ደንብ የመንገድ ፍጥነት መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

* ከሰው ጋር ጥሩ መግባባትና  የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ችሎታ ያለው።

* ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው በራሱ የሚተማመን ፣ ደህንነቱን የጠበቀ አነዳድ የሚከተል፡፡

* ታማኝ፣ የድርጅቱን ሰዓት የሚያከብር።

* አመልካች ሰፈሩ  ጉርድ ሾላ፣ ገርጂ  አቅራቢያ ወይም ያልራቀ ቢሆን ይመረጣል፡፡

* እድሜው ከ25-30 ክልል ውስጥ የሆነ፡፡

* ማስታወቂያ ቤት የሰራ / የማስታወቂያ ሥራ በቂ ዕውቀት ያለው መሆን አለት፡፡

*  አውቶማቲክ ሆነ ማንዋልም  የመኪና /ማርሽ/  በሚገባ መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

የሥራ ዓይነት:- የሙሉ ጊዜ

ደመወዝ:-  ወርሃዊ

እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል፡-

*     አመልካቾች የት/ት ማስረጃ፣ የሥራ ልምድ እና የታደሰ መንጃ ፈቃድ ኮፒውን በአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን በአካል ም ሆነ በቴሌግራም ማቅረብም ሆነ መላክ ይችላሉ፡፡

*      እንዲሁም  ቅጥር  ሲፈፀም  በቂ የዋስ አይነት ማቅረብ የምትችሉ እና ከመንግስት መስራያ ቤት ዋስ/ተያዥ ማቅረብ  እችላለሁ የምትሉ  ብቻ   በዚህ ማስታወቂያ ማመልከት /መወዳደር/ ትችላላችሁ፡፡

የስራ አድራሻ፡-

• አዲስ አበባ አስናቀማስታወቂያጉርድ ሾላ - ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  በትራፊክመብራት  አካባቢ፣  ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ ላይ እንገኛለን፡፡  ለዚህ ማስታወቂያ ከሐሙስ ቀን  23/04/2018 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮእስከ አርብ 25 /04/2018 ድረስ የምንቀበል ይሆናል፡፡

title: Specialized Educational Translator (Afar, Somali, Oromo, or Tigrinya)
description:
Please apply using this link:

https://app.globedocket.com/jobs/globedock_plc/Language-Translator
(Note: Application using the link will get priority)

 

GlobeDock Academy is an e-learning platform based in Ethiopia, dedicated to delivering high-quality, inclusive, and accessible education. To ensure linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and effective knowledge transfer across diverse communities, GlobeDock Academy seeks qualified Language Translators & Speakers(Fluent) in either Af Afar, Af Somali, Tigrigna, and/or Afan Oromo to support the translation and localization of educational and training content on a project basis. Applicants must clearly state which language(s) they are applying for: Af Afar/Af Somali/Tigrigna/Afan Oromo.
We are building Base Translation, a high-stakes educational project. We are not looking for someone who "speaks the language." We are looking for a linguistic architect who understands pedagogy.

Key Responsibilities

Translate educational, training, and informational content accurately between Amharic and one or more target languages: Af Afar, Af Somali, Tigrigna, and Afan Oromo.
Ensure translations maintain the original meaning, intent, and quality of the source material.
Adapt and localize content to be culturally appropriate and contextually relevant for target audiences.
Provide oral interpretation and language support during training, workshops, meetings, and virtual learning sessions as required.
Review, proofread, and edit translated materials to ensure clarity, consistency, and accuracy.
Collaborate with instructional designers, trainers, and program teams to improve learning materials.
Handle all translated content with professionalism, confidentiality, and ethical responsibility.
Qualifications & General Criteria

Educational Background: Bachelor’s (BA) or Master’s (MA/MSC) degree in Journalism and Media, Political Science, Law, Human Rights, Civic Education, Educational Technology, or a closely related discipline.
Language Fluency: Native or professional fluency in at least one of the following: Af Afar,Af Somali, Tigrigna, or Afan Oromo. Strong proficiency in Amharic and/or English is required for source material comprehension.
Contextual Knowledge: Must demonstrate a strong understanding of the Ethiopian civic and social context.
Professional Experience: Proven experience in translation, interpretation, or content localization, preferably in education, training, legal, or development contexts and also have experience on educational project base Translation
Proven Track Record: Ability to provide evidence of successful completion of similar projects or relevant work samples.
Skills & Competencies

Precision: Excellent written and verbal translation skills with high attention to accuracy and clarity.
Complex Localization: Ability to translate complex educational, legal, or civic concepts into clear, context-appropriate language.
Cultural Awareness: Deep understanding of regional and linguistic nuances related to the target language(s).
Efficiency: Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and meet strict project deadlines.
Digital Literacy: Experience working with digital learning content or e-learning platforms is an added advantage.
Integrity: High ethical standards, including confidentiality and data protection.

title: logistic officer
description:
Logistics Officer Job Description – Lata Agro Export

Overview

The Logistics Officer will be responsible for managing the seamless and efficient flow of coffee from the warehouse or processing unit to the final customer destination across international markets. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of export procedures, international shipping, and documentation.

 

Key Responsibilities

1. Shipping and Export Operations

Coordinate and manage all aspects of coffee export logistics, including booking freight (container shipping, air cargo) and selecting optimal shipping lines/carriers based on cost and service.
Monitor and track shipments from origin to destination, proactively communicating any delays or issues to relevant internal and external stakeholders.
Ensure all coffee handling, storage, and transportation comply with international food safety standards and specific customer requirements.
2. Documentation and Compliance

Prepare, review, and process all necessary export documentation, including Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin (COO), Phytosanitary Certificates, Bills of Lading (B/L), and other customs/regulatory forms.
Ensure full compliance with destination country import regulations, customs procedures, and international trade laws (e.g., Incoterms, HS Codes).
Maintain an organized filing system for all shipping documents and records for auditing purposes.
3. Stakeholder Management

Act as the primary point of contact for freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, warehouse/port authorities, and inspection agents.
Coordinate with the Sales/Trading team to align shipping schedules with sales contracts and customer delivery deadlines.
Liaise with the Warehouse/Quality Control team to ensure the timely readiness and accurate loading of coffee containers.
4. Cost Management and Reporting

Assist in negotiating freight rates and logistics service contracts to optimize shipping costs.
Verify and process logistics-related invoices (freight, inspection, documentation, handling) to ensure accuracy and timely payment.
Prepare and maintain detailed reports on logistics activities, shipping status, costs, and performance metrics.
Required Qualifications

Experience: Minimum of 1 (one) year of professional experience in logistics, supply chain management, shipping, or an export/import coordination role. Experience in the coffee, commodity, or food export sector is a significant advantage.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field.
Skills:

Proficiency in preparing and handling international shipping documents (B/L, Commercial Invoice, COO, etc.).
Solid understanding of Incoterms (e.g., FOB, CIF, CFR, FCA) and international customs procedures.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong computer skills, especially in MS Excel and logistics/ERP software.
Competencies

Detail-Oriented: Exceptional attention to accuracy, particularly in documentation.
Problem-Solver: Ability to anticipate and quickly resolve logistics issues (e.g., port delays, documentation errors).
Organizational Skills: Proven ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously.
Negotiation: Basic negotiation skills for dealing with vendors and service providers.
“Interested applicants are invited to apply by email at HR@altacomputec.com.”

title: Hygiene Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Hygiene Specialist at Kaldi’s Coffee will be responsible for overall development, coordination and management of Hygiene programmes.  Setting, achieving and maintaining quality standards in the delivery of hygiene and behaviour change programmes.

Key Responsibilities

Oversee the quality and effectiveness of social, behavioral, and technological hygiene interventions and programmes.
Develop, plan, and manage hygiene programmes.
Monitor and report progress in implementing hygiene programmes.
Collaborate and network with others to learn and upscale hygiene approaches.
Protect the health, safety, and welfare of consumers, customers, clients, and employees.
Identify cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization requirements and select appropriate methodologies.
Analyse hygiene data, interpret results, identify trends, and implement corrective actions.
Plan, direct, supervise, monitor, and report on hygiene and sanitation activities.
Monitor cleanliness of equipment, personnel, and work areas.
Provide professional training on hygiene and sanitation to employees and monitor implementation.
Regularly review employees' health check-up cards.
Develop and implement hygiene and sanitation operating guidelines.
Identify and report hygiene gaps and ensure timely resolution.
Create hygiene and sanitation designs for new branches and monitor approved implementations.
Ensure safe disposal of products and raw materials.
Design systems to maintain product cleanliness and quality.
Monitor and address deficiencies highlighted by the Food, Drug, and Health Care Administration and Control Authority.

title: የሹፌር ባለሙያ
description:
በድጋሚ የወጣ የሥራ ማስታወቂያ

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ ፡-

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን ቀልጣፋ፣ የሥራ ተነሳሽነት ያለውና በጥንቃቄ  በኃላፊነት የስራ ቁሳቁሶችን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ የሚያጓጉዝ ብቁ የሹፌር ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡

መስፈርቶች፡

* ሕጋዊ የሆነ እና የታደሰ /የሚሰራ/ መንጃ ፍቃድ ያለው።

*  መንጃ ፈቃዱ ከታደሰ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት  ያለው ከዚያ በላይ የሆነ፡፡

* ከዚህ በፊት ምንም ዓይነት የቅጣት ሬከርድ የሌለበት፡፡

* አዲስ አበባን እና አካቢዎቿን በሚገባ መንገድ የሚያውቅ  መሆን አለበት፡፡

* የትራፊክ ህጎች እና የከተማ መንገዶች የማሽከርከር እውቀት ያለው።

* ጥንቃቄ በተሞላበት በተሰጠው የመንገድ ህገ ደንብ የመንገድ ፍጥነት መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

* ከሰው ጋር ጥሩ መግባባትና  የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ችሎታ ያለው።

* ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው በራሱ የሚተማመን ፣ ደህንነቱን የጠበቀ አነዳድ የሚከተል፡፡

* ታማኝ፣ የድርጅቱን ሰዓት የሚያከብር።

* አመልካች ሰፈሩ  ጉርድ ሾላ፣ ገርጂ  አቅራቢያ ወይም ያልራቀ ቢሆን ይመረጣል፡፡

* እድሜው ከ25-30 ክልል ውስጥ የሆነ፡፡

* ማስታወቂያ ቤት የሰራ / የማስታወቂያ ሥራ በቂ ዕውቀት ያለው መሆን አለት፡፡

*  አውቶማቲክ ሆነ ማንዋልም  የመኪና /ማርሽ/  በሚገባ መንዳት የሚችል መሆን አለበት፡፡

 

የሥራ ዓይነት:- የሙሉ ጊዜ

ደመወዝ:-  ወርሃዊ

እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል፡-

*     አመልካቾች የት/ት ማስረጃ፣ የሥራ ልምድ እና የታደሰ መንጃ ፈቃድ ኮፒውን በአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን በአካል ም ሆነ በቴሌግራም ማቅረብም ሆነ መላክ ይችላሉ፡፡

*      እንዲሁም  ቅጥር  ሲፈፀም  በቂ የዋስ አይነት ማቅረብ የምትችሉ እና ከመንግስት መስራያ ቤት ዋስ/ተያዥ ማቅረብ  እችላለሁ የምትሉ  ብቻ   በዚህ ማስታወቂያ ማመልከት /መወዳደር/ ትችላላችሁ፡፡

የስራ አድራሻ፡-

• አዲስ አበባ አስናቀማስታወቂያጉርድ ሾላ - ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  በትራፊክመብራት  አካባቢ፣  ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ ላይ እንገኛለን፡፡  ለዚህ ማስታወቂያ ከሐሙስ ቀን  23/04/2018 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮእስከ አርብ 25 /04/2018 ድረስ የምንቀበል ይሆናል፡፡

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Title: Project Coordinator (Full Time)

Job Summary

Responsible for effectively coordinating the company’s operations and projects and working on follow-up every activity to deliver projects in quality, on schedule, and with financial profitability.

Summary of job functions

Assist in planning, executing, and completing design, construction, and maintenance projects, ensuring all milestones are met.
Monitor project budgets and timelines, ensuring cost-effective allocation of resources and adherence to project schedules.
Maintain high performance and productivity and provide timely reports to Management on the operating conditions of the division.
Serve as the main point of contact for clients as necessary, providing regular updates and addressing any issues or concerns throughout the project lifecycle
Work closely with designers, contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers to ensure seamless execution of all tasks
Conduct regular site visits to ensure work is progressing according to plan and maintain quality control standards
Maintain accurate project records, including contracts, change orders, letters, certificates, and progress reports
Prepare payment requests, interim payments, and documentation

Develop work proposals and work on assigned tasks as needed
Experience/education requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
An additional degree in project management, business administration, or related fields.
A minimum of 5 years of related operations or project handling and coordination experience in the construction industry is preferable
We would want to see someone who

Strong organizational and multitasking abilities,
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills,
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google (Excel sheet, Word, and Project)
Knowledge of landscape design principles, construction techniques, and sustainability practices
Has a strong ability to comprehend the customer’s needs and promptly answer questions or concerns
Can forecast possible outcomes and next steps, and prepare beforehand
Can work well with all levels of management;
Has good English language communication, writing, and understanding skills;
Has good relational skills, is reliable, collaborative, creative, and respectful
How to apply

Interested and qualified applicants can send us their resume/CV via the form

https://forms.gle/cHQVVJVW9tNHeEwr5

title: Sales Engineer
description:
Company Description

Dorina Engineering | ዶሪና ኢንጅነሪንግ is a growing supplier of a wide range of water pumps, renewable energy, and related electromechanical products. The company is based in Addis Ababa and is committed to delivering innovative products and excellent service to its clients.

 

Role Description

Our Company is looking for a qualified and competent Sales Engineer with a background in water pumping and renewable energy.

 

Key Responsibilities

✓ Preparation of technical proposals for renewable energy solutions and water pumping solutions.

title: Market Research Officer
description:
CCECC Ethiopia Construction PLC

CCECC Ethiopia Construction PLC is a subsidiary of China Civil Engineering Construction Corporation (CCECC) responsible for market development and management in Northeast Africa. Established in June 2012 with headquarters in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, the company oversees business development and project management across six countries: Ethiopia, Kenya, Djibouti, South Sudan, Somalia, and Eritrea.

Since 2012, the company has continuously deepened its market presence, actively participating in local infrastructure investment, construction, and operation. It has undertaken and implemented over 100 projects, including the Addis Ababa-Djibouti Railway (427 km Mieso-Djibouti section), Djibouti's Doraleh Port, Somalia's Bosaso Airport, Awassa Industrial Park, Siemens Ethiopia Converter Station Project, and the African Union-African Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) Project. The company now holds Class I General Contractor and Class I Hydraulic Engineering Contractor qualifications in Ethiopia, establishing a diversified business portfolio centered on railways, highways, and building construction, while simultaneously advancing in industrial parks, municipal works, power, and hydraulic engineering.

Actively participating in the Belt and Road Initiative, CCECC Ethiopia Construction PLC prioritizes local development needs, fosters mutually beneficial partnerships with local communities, and builds recognition and support among local populations. Currently serving as the Chair of the China Chamber of Commerce in Africa, Vice Chair of the China Chamber of Commerce in Ethiopia, and Vice Chair of the China Chamber of Commerce in Djibouti, the company ranks among the most competitive international contractors in the East African market.

Position: Market Research Officer

Role Overview:

-       To provide accurate, timely, and well-documented market price data to the bidding/estimating team to support cost estimation and proposal development.

-       To Assess supplier capabilities, reliability, quality standards, and past performance to ensure sourcing integrity.

-       To Maintain clear, traceable documentation of all inquiry and quotation activities in accordance with company policies and tender compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

-          Conduct thorough market research and price inquiries from suppliers (market materials), subcontractors, and vendors to support accurate tender/bid pricing.

-          Collect, verify, and analyze current market rates for materials, equipment, labor, and services relevant to project bids.

-          Prepare and compile quotation summaries and cost breakdowns for inclusion in bid submissions.

-          Proficient in using office software and has experience in bidding and pricing.

-          Monitor market trends, price fluctuations, and supply chain risks that may impact bid competitiveness.

Qualifications and Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).

Experience: 3-5 years , must be in construction sector.

Soft Skills: Ms. Office, Ms. Project and Meeting software (Zoom & Google Meet)

Fluent in English

Can work with team
who can search and asses different Market Price
Presentation skill

title: Senior Project Manager / Senior Interior Architect
description: The Senior Project Manager (Architect) will lead the design and execution of complex interior architectural projects from concept through to final handover. This role requires a blend of high-level creative vision, technical architectural knowledge, and rigorous project management. You will be the primary liaison for clients, lead a team of junior and intermediate architects, and ensure all interior spaces are functional, compliant, and aesthetically exceptional. Key Responsibilities Conceptual Development: Lead the creation of interior design narratives, mood boards, and space-planning concepts. Architectural Integration: Ensure that interior designs are structurally sound and seamlessly integrated with the building’s architectural shell. FF&E Excellence: Oversee the selection and specification of Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E), ensuring high quality and brand alignment. Lifecycle Management: Own the project timeline from pre-design and bidding to construction administration and closeout. Budgeting: Prepare detailed cost estimates, manage project fees, and oversee invoicing to ensure the project remains profitable. Resource Allocation: Manage staffing plans and delegate tasks to ensure project milestones are met without burnout. Documentation: Review and approve full sets of construction documents, including floor plans, RCPs (Reflected Ceiling Plans), elevations, and bespoke joinery details. Compliance: Ensure all designs meet local building codes, fire safety regulations, and accessibility standards (e.g., ADA). Site Supervision: Conduct regular site inspections to ensure the contractor’s work matches the design intent and quality standards. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture or Interior Architecture. Age : Below 36 Experience: Minimum of 9 years in a professional design firm, with at least 4 years in a leadership or project management capacity. Portfolio: A proven track record of successfully delivered interior projects (High-end Residential, Hospitality, or Corporate). Licensure: Professional registration (RA) or NCIDQ certification is highly preferred. Client Management: Ability to present complex design ideas to non-technical stakeholders confidently.

title: Senior Accountant (Finance System Lead)
description: Job Description ARE YOU A BUILDER? Antenna Manufacturing & Business Consultancy PLC is not looking for a data-entry clerk. We are looking for a System Builder. We are a fast-growing industrial machinery manufacturer, and we are looking for a strong, energetic Senior Accountant to build our financial department from the ground up. If you are tired of just entering receipts and want to lead the financial setup of a growing factory, this is your chance. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (What you will build): 1. System Setup: Install, configure, and manage Peachtree (Sage 50). Create a Chart of Accounts specifically tailored for Manufacturing (Raw Material, WIP, Finished Goods). Digitize manual records and organize the filing system. 2. Manufacturing Cost Accounting (Crucial): Calculate the exact production cost for every machine we make (Steel + Motor + Labor + Electricity) to help management set profitable prices. Conduct monthly physical inventory counts of the warehouse and reconcile with the system. 3. Tax & Compliance: Handle ALL monthly tax declarations (VAT, Withholding, Income Tax, Pension) to ERCA without errors or penalties. Manage the annual audit process and profit tax declaration. 4. Payroll & Operations: Manage the Weekly (Factory) and Monthly (Office) payroll. Control Petty Cash and process payments for raw materials. JOB REQUIREMENTS: Education: BA Degree in Accounting & Finance. Experience: 3 to 5 Years of relevant experience. Mandatory: You MUST have experience in a Manufacturing or Import/Export company. (Candidates without Cost Accounting experience will not be considered). Technical Skills: Expert level in Peachtree and Excel. Attitude: Organized, Strict with money, and a Self-Starter (someone who doesn't wait for instructions).

description:
Job Description
ARE YOU A BUILDER?
Antenna Manufacturing & Business Consultancy PLC is not looking for a data-entry clerk. We are looking for a System Builder. We are a fast-growing industrial machinery manufacturer, and we are looking for a strong, energetic Senior Accountant to build our financial department from the ground up.

If you are tired of just entering receipts and want to lead the financial setup of a growing factory, this is your chance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (What you will build):

1. System Setup:

Install, configure, and manage Peachtree (Sage 50).
Create a Chart of Accounts specifically tailored for Manufacturing (Raw Material, WIP, Finished Goods).
Digitize manual records and organize the filing system.
2. Manufacturing Cost Accounting (Crucial):

Calculate the exact production cost for every machine we make (Steel + Motor + Labor + Electricity) to help management set profitable prices.
Conduct monthly physical inventory counts of the warehouse and reconcile with the system.
3. Tax & Compliance:

Handle ALL monthly tax declarations (VAT, Withholding, Income Tax, Pension) to ERCA without errors or penalties.
Manage the annual audit process and profit tax declaration.
4. Payroll & Operations:

Manage the Weekly (Factory) and Monthly (Office) payroll.
Control Petty Cash and process payments for raw materials.
JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Education: BA Degree in Accounting & Finance.
Experience: 3 to 5 Years of relevant experience.
Mandatory: You MUST have experience in a Manufacturing or Import/Export company. (Candidates without Cost Accounting experience will not be considered).
Technical Skills: Expert level in Peachtree and Excel.
Attitude: Organized, Strict with money, and a Self-Starter (someone who doesn't wait for instructions).

Updated CV

title: Customer Service Officer
description:

Handle customer inquiries, complaints, and requests through phone, email, and in person.
Provide accurate information about company products, services, pricing, and policies.
Ensure timely and courteous responses to all customer communications.

Ensure compliance with internal controls and customer service guidelines.

Work closely with sales, operations, finance, and logistics teams to address customer needs.
Communicate customer feedback to relevant departments for continuous improvement.
Support coordination between customers and internal teams.

description:

Prepare, review, and finalize monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Ensure accuracy and integrity of accounting records in compliance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
Analyze financial performance and provide timely management reports with insights and recommendations.
Oversee general ledger, trial balance, and financial reconciliations.
2. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cost Control

Develop annual budgets and periodic financial forecasts.
Monitor budget utilization and identify variances with corrective action plans.
Implement cost control measures to improve financial efficiency.
Support management in financial planning and decision-making.
3. Accounting Operations & Compliance

Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and cash management functions.
Ensure compliance with tax regulations, statutory filings, and government reporting requirements.
Coordinate external and internal audits and address audit findings promptly.
Maintain proper documentation and internal controls to prevent financial risk and fraud.
4. Cash Flow & Treasury Management

Manage cash flow planning, bank relationships, and fund utilization.
Monitor receivables and payables to ensure healthy liquidity.
Oversee bank reconciliations and financing arrangements.
Ensure timely collections and payments.
5. Leadership & Team Supervision

Lead, mentor, and evaluate accounting and finance staff.
Assign tasks, review work quality, and ensure deadlines are met.
Support staff development through training and performance feedback.
Promote accountability and ethical financial practices.
6. Internal Controls & Risk Management

Establish and monitor financial controls, policies, and procedures.
Identify financial risks and propose mitigation strategies.
Ensure segregation of duties and compliance with approval authority levels.
Safeguard company assets and financial information.
7. Strategic & Management Support

Advise management on financial implications of business decisions.
Support investment evaluation, pricing strategies, and contract reviews.
Participate in management meetings and contribute to business strategy.
Assist in business expansion, funding, and profitability improvement initiatives.
Fluent in English Speaking.

Prior experience in an import export company is a bonus.

title: Junior Legal Officer
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Junior Legal Officer to support our legal department. This is an entry-level position ideal for a fresh graduate with a strong passion for commercial law, technology, and compliance. The successful candidate will assist in drafting legal documents, conducting research, and acting as the company's representative before various judicial and administrative bodies to ensure operational continuity.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Liaison & Representation (Government & Courts)

Governmental Relations: Serve as the primary point of contact between the company and government regulatory bodies.
Court Registry Management: Represent the company at court registries to file pleadings, collect summons, follow up on case file statuses, and ensure hearing schedules are accurately tracked.
Process Facilitation: Manage the end-to-end processing of legal documentation, including notarization, authentication, and registration of documents at the appropriate bureaus.
Tax & Municipal Compliance: Facilitate the physical submission of tax clearance requests, business license renewals, and other compliance filings at Sub-City and Woreda offices.
2. Contract Management & Drafting

Assist in drafting, reviewing, and organizing commercial contracts, including Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs), Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), and supplier agreements.
Ensure all agreements are properly signed, witnessed, and archived.
3. Research & Legal Support

Conduct legal research on Ethiopian laws relevant to fintech and agri-tech, specifically the Commercial Code, electronic commerce proclamations, and data privacy regulations.
Prepare legal briefs and summaries for senior management.
4. Corporate Governance

Draft minutes of meetings and shareholder resolutions.
Maintain up-to-date corporate records and files.
Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor of Laws (LLB) degree from a recognized Ethiopian University.
Experience: 0 years (Fresh Graduate). However, prior internship experience involving court visits or processing documents at government bureaus is considered beneficial.
Legal Knowledge: Solid understanding of the Ethiopian Commercial Code, Civil Procedure Code, and administrative regulations.
Language: Excellent command of written and spoken Amharic and English.
Soft Skills:

Professional Resilience: Ability to navigate bureaucratic processes with patience, persistence, and diplomacy.
Time Management: Capable of prioritizing tasks when managing multiple filings across different locations in Addis Ababa.
Communication: Confident and articulate when interacting with public officials and court clerks.
What We Offer

Opportunity to work in one of Ethiopia’s most innovative sectors (Agri-tech/Fintech).
Mentorship and professional growth opportunities.

title: Pre-Sales (Tender Specialist)
description:
Job Summary:

The Pre-Sales (Tender Specialist) is responsible for managing the end-to-end tendering and proposal process, from opportunity identification to final submission. With four years of experience, the specialist brings proven expertise in preparing competitive technical and commercial bids, ensuring compliance with client requirements, and coordinating across cross-functional teams. The role involves analyzing tender documents, developing winning strategies, preparing high-quality proposals, and engaging with clients for clarifications. The Tender Specialist plays a key role in supporting the sales team by transforming complex customer requirements into tailored solutions that align with company capabilities, ultimately driving business growth and customer satisfaction.

 

Responsibility:

· Manage the full tendering process, from opportunity tracking and bid decision to preparation and submission.

· Review and analyze RFPs, RFQs, and tender documents to identify requirements, risks, and compliance criteria.

· Develop complete technical and commercial proposals in collaboration with sales, engineering, finance, procurement, and legal teams.

· Ensure all proposals are accurate, competitive, and submitted within deadlines.

· Prepare compliance matrices, bid summaries, and executive presentations for internal approvals.

· Conduct market and competitor analysis to enhance the competitiveness of bids.

· Maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, and partners to clarify requirements and strengthen proposals.

· Lead pre-bid meetings, clarifications, and negotiations in coordination with the sales team.

· Ensure adherence to company policies, procedures, and quality standards in all submissions.

· Support continuous improvement of the tendering process by documenting lessons learned and implementing best practices.

· Provide mentoring and guidance to junior tender officers or pre-sales staff when required.

 

Qualifications:

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or any related field from a recognized Ethiopian university is also acceptable. (Master’s degree is a plus).

· 4+ years of proven experience in pre-sales, tendering, or bid/proposal management within ICT, telecom, or technology-related industries.

Skills:

· Tender & Proposal Management: Skilled in preparing compliant, competitive, and well-structured bids.

· Technical & Commercial Understanding: Ability to translate customer requirements into tailored solutions.

· Document Preparation: Strong writing, formatting, and presentation skills for professional proposals.

· Market & Competitor Analysis: Skilled in analyzing industry trends and competitors to strengthen bids.

· Negotiation & Communication: Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication for client and vendor engagement.

· Project Coordination: Experienced in managing multiple tenders simultaneously and aligning with internal stakeholders.

· Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to assess tender requirements, risks, and compliance gaps.

· Time Management: Efficient in prioritizing tasks and meeting strict submission deadlines.

· Software Proficiency: Advanced in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with CRM, ERP, or tender management platforms.

· Team Collaboration & Leadership: Works well in cross-functional teams and able to mentor junior tender staff.

· IT Infrastructure (Datacenter Solutions, CCTV, Network & Cloud Compute)

· AutoCAD & 3D Rendering Tool

GlobeDock Academy is an e-learning platform based in Ethiopia, dedicated to delivering high-quality, inclusive, and accessible education. Educational Background: Bachelor’s (BA) or Master’s (MA/MSC) degree in Journalism and Media, Political Science, Law, Human Rights, Civic Education, Educational Technology, or a closely related discipline.

Professional Experience: Proven experience in translation, interpretation, or content localization, preferably in education, training, legal, or development contexts and also have experience on educational project base Translation

Precision: Excellent written and verbal translation skills with high attention to accuracy and clarity.

Integrity: High ethical standards, including confidentiality and data protection.

We are a dynamic young company based in Addis Ababa with a key partner in Berlin, Germany, specializing in digital strategy consulting and solution engineering. Our team reflects this global reach, consisting of carefully selected experts from around the world.

About the Role

We are seeking a mature and self-sufficient Senior Angular Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have the technical skills of an experienced coder, but also possess the professionalism and maturity to manage their own work from start to finish. This is a crucial, high-impact role where you will be expected to work independently, ensuring all deliverables meet the high standards of our European clients. We need a professional who can deliver high-quality, well-documented, and well-tested work.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate directly with international clients to clarify, refine, and document project requirements.
Actively participate in architectural design discussions and provide input on complex frontend technical solutions.
Manage and deliver assigned work packages with minimal supervision, ensuring projects are on track and meet all deadlines.
Develop, test, and maintain high-quality, scalable web applications using Angular (latest versions) and TypeScript.
Write and execute unit tests (using Jasmine/Karma or Jest) to ensure the reliability and quality of your code.
Document your work thoroughly, including code, technical specifications, and project-related decisions.
Optimize app performance, ensuring fast load times and smooth user experiences across different browsers and devices.
Integrate RESTful APIs, third-party services, and state management systems.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues and performance bottlenecks efficiently.
Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Proven professional experience as a Senior Angular Developer (3+ years).
Modern Workflow: We value efficiency and innovation. Comfortable working with modern AI-assisted tools and open to exploring Agentic AI workflows to help streamline your daily dev tasks.
A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to deliver complete, high-quality enterprise web applications.
In-depth knowledge of the Angular framework (Angular 16+), TypeScript, RxJS, and modern CSS (Tailwind, Angular Material, or SASS/SCSS).
Expertise in state management solutions (e.g., NgRx, NGXS, or Akita).
Experience with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, modern CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git).
Strong debugging, problem-solving, and performance optimization skills.
Experience with Agile methodologies and remote collaboration tools.
Exceptional communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively with remote teams and international clients.
Demonstrated maturity and initiative, with the ability to manage your own workload and proactively solve problems.
What We Offer

The opportunity to work on innovative, impactful projects for global clients.
A high degree of autonomy and the chance to directly influence project outcomes.
A competitive salary and benefits package.
Strong focus on career growth, mentorship, and professional development.
A collaborative and supportive work culture focused on quality and professionalism.
How to Apply

Please submit the following documents via email to hr@enkoy.tech with “Senior Angular Developer” in the subject line:

Your CV
Scan copies of your highest academic degrees/certificates, grades, and transcripts (if any)
A detailed portfolio with a description of your role and responsibilities for each project (if any)
Your earliest possible start date
Your expected salary range

title: Support Operations & Quality Specialist
description:
We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional to oversee our support operations for our web hosting. We currently have a technical team in place, but we need a "Closer"—someone to ensure no chat goes unanswered, no ticket is left messy, and every customer receives a polished, professional experience.

You aren't just answering chats; you are the safety net that ensures our brand stays professional and our response times stay lightning-fast.

Your Primary Responsibilities:

Inbox Management: Monitor chats and tickets to ensure 100% coverage. If a chat is sitting idle, you step in or nudge the team to action.
Quality Control: Audit the "sloppiness" of current support interactions. You will ensure technical answers are clear and accurate.
The "Clean-Up": Close out ghost tickets, follow up on pending items, and ensure every ticket is correctly tagged (Billing, Tech, Sales) before it is archived.
Documentation: Identify common questions that don't have a guide and create simple Knowledge Base articles to help customers self-serve.
Accountability: Keep a simple weekly log of team performance (response times and common mistakes) to help management improve the support department.
Requirements:

Native-level or Highly Proficient English: Your written communication must be flawless.
Hosting Experience: Familiarity with website design terms is a PLUS
The "Nudge" Factor: You must be comfortable holding other team members accountable and intervening when you see a drop in quality.
Obsessive Organization: You hate seeing an unorganized inbox or a ticket without a tag.

--------

Hiring Task Overview: To help us filter applicates faster, Below is a transcript of a support interaction between a customer and one of our agents. Your job is to identify the "sloppiness" and rewrite the final response to meet professional standards.

Review the interaction below and list at least 5 "Red Flags" and submit it with your CV

 

Interaction Transcript:

• Customer (10:00 AM): "My site is down! I'm getting a 500 error on my domain example.com. Help please."

• Agent (10:25 AM): "hello i check it and it works for me try clearing cache

• Customer (10:28 AM): "I cleared cache and it's still down for me. Also, I need to know how to add a new email account."

• Agent (10:45 AM): "ok i will ask my manager about the error. for email just go to cpanel."
• Customer (10:50 AM): "Where in cpanel? And any update on the error?"
• (Ticket left open/no response for 2 hours)

title: Intern Domain Expert (MD,HO)
description:
About the Company

Orbit Health (eHealth IT Services PLC) is a pioneering digital health company transforming and modernizing health systems in Ethiopia, with a vision to expand across Africa. Through our innovative products, we aim to bridge healthcare gaps and enhance patient outcomes. Committed to excellence and collaboration, Orbit Health is dedicated to making a lasting impact on healthcare across the continent.

Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic team player to join as an Intern Domain Expert, responsible for supporting the development of our EMR System. The Domain Expert brings clinical expertise to guide product development, advising on real-world healthcare practices, assessing current workflows, and providing solutions for enhanced EMR usability.

Key Responsibilities

Contribute clinicians’ perspectives in requirement studies and specifications.

Analyze and internalize requirements from a practitioner’s perspective.

Assist the project team in understanding actual healthcare practices.

Advise on practical usability of EMR systems.

Serve as a skilled clinical resource for non-health team members.

Act as the domain expert for clinical workflow-related activities.

Train end-users (physicians, nurses, midwives, laboratory professionals) on EMR use.

Assist in developing/revising training manuals, user guides, and cheat sheets.

Develop documentation such as literature reviews as needed.

Participate or lead focus groups to gather requirements and enhancements for EMR and related products.

Train non-health team members on basics of health and the Ethiopian Health System.

Serve as the main point of contact and application SME for health facilities during implementation and post-implementation phases.

Provide on-site go-live support, optimization, and continuous assistance.

Implement customized training curriculums for physician office staff.

Provide regular status updates to the Project Manager on all assigned tasks.

Required Educational Background

MD or Health Officer

Required Skill

Strong team player

Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds

Female candidates are highly encouraged to apply

Why Join Us

Be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven digital health company

Contribute directly to transforming healthcare delivery in Ethiopia

Work in a collaborative, innovative, and supportive environment

title: በሽያጭ እና እንግዳ ተቀባይ
description:
በድጋሚ የወጣ አስቸኳይ የሥራ ማስታወቂያ

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

ድርጅታችን አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ፤ በሽያጭ እና እንግዳ ተቀባይ ቀልጣፋ እና  ነቃ ያለች በጣም ተግባቢ ደንበኛን በደንብ የምታስተናግድ ተነሳሽነት ያላት የሽያጭ ሠራተኛ የኛን ድርጅት እንድትቀላቀል እንፈልጋለን፡፡

በመሆኑም ከዚህ በታች ያለውን መስፈርት የምታሟሉ ተወዳዳሪዎች መወዳደር ትችላላችሁ፡፡ አመልካቾች አፕሊኬሽን ሌተር ስትሞሉ 1. ስልካችሁን፣ 2. ሰፈራችሁን እና 3. የሥራ ልምዳችሁን 4. የሰራችሁበትን የሥራ ዘርፍ የሚገልጽ  ፕሮፋይል እንድታካትቱ፡፡ በሳሊተ ምሕረት፣ ገርጂ፣ ፊጋ ወይም ቅርብ አካባቢ ነዋሪ የሆኑ እጩዎች በጣም ተመራጭ ናቸው።

ተመራጭ ብቃቶች፡-

• ዋጋ ማውጣት የምትችልና ከደንበኞች ጋር ያላት የሥራ ጠንካራ የግንኙነት

በደንብ የተዋበ፣ ጨዋ፣ ፈጣን ችግር ፈቺ የሆነች

• በአካልም ሆነ በስልክ ጥሪ ከደንበኞች ትዕዛዝ በትክክል የምትቀበል

• የት/ት ደረጃ ፤ የሁለተኛ ደረጃ ፣ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ከፍተኛ ትምህርት በገበያ/በሽያጭ ሥራ፣ ንግድ ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ የሰራች ቢሆን፤

description:

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

የስራ መደቡ፡     የግራፊክስ ዲዛይነር  ባለሙያ- ማስታወቂያ

ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ

የአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ቡድናችንን ለመቀላቀል ፈጠራ እና ዝርዝር ተኮር ዲዛይነር እየፈለግን ነው።

ዋና ኃላፊነቶች፡-

• እንደ LED ምልክት፣ ኤምዲኤፍ ማሳያዎች፣ ቢልቦርዶች፣ ባነሮች፣ ፖስተሮች እና ዲጂታል ግራፊክስ ያሉ ዲዛይን እና የምርት ማስታዎቂያ ቁሳቁሶች።

• ዲዛይኖች የደንበኛ ፍላጎቶችን  መሠረት በማድረግ ዕውቀታቸውንና  የዲዛይን  መመሪያዎችን  በመጠቀም የሚያሟሉ  መሆን አለባቸው፡፡

•  የመጨረሻ ዲዛይኖች  ምስላዊ  ማራኪ ትክክለኛ እና ለህትመት  ወይም ለዲጂታል ህትመት ዝግጁ  አድርጎ ማቅረብ የሚችል።

• በንድፍ አዝማሚያዎች፣ በማስታወቂያ ቴክኒኮች እና በአዲስ  የሶፍትዌር መሳሪያዎች  ከጊዜ ጋር በአግባቡ መጠቀም የሚችሉ።

• የጊዜ ገደቦችን በሚያሟሉበት  ጊዜ በርካታ ፕሮጀክቶችን  ማስተናገድ ብቃት ያላቸው።

ብቃት፡

• ጠንካራ የፈጠራ ችሎታያለው።

• የማተሚያ ሂደቶችን እና የማስታወቂያ ቁሳቁሶችን (LED, MDF, Banners, ወዘተ) ተጨማሪ እውቀት ያላቸው፡፡

የቀለማት ልዩነት መረዳት የሚችል፣ ጥሩ ግንዛቤ  ያለው። ጥሩ የሐሳብ ልውውጥ እና የቡድን ሥራ ችሎታዎች ያላቸው። ጥሩ የሐሳብ ልውውጥ እና የቡድን ሥራ ችሎታዎች ያለው።

• ብዙ ፕሮጀክቶችን በአንድ ጊዜ የማስተናገድ ችሎታ።

description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Structural Engineer with at least 5 years of professional experience in the design, coordination, and implementation of structural systems for real estate and industrial projects. The successful candidate will have a strong command of multiple structural engineering software platforms and the ability to design practical solutions for on-site challenges. This role requires a balance of technical expertise, design precision, and on-site adaptability, with a focus on working across steel, concrete, and mixed-material structures.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and review structural designs, calculations, and models for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
Prepare, edit, and coordinate structural drawings using Revit for 3D modeling and multidisciplinary integration.
Provide quick and effective engineering solutions for on-site structural problems, ensuring compliance with codes and safety standards.
Collaborate with architects, MEP engineers, and contractors to ensure structural systems are fully integrated into overall project design.
Conduct on-site inspections to monitor construction progress, supervise implementation, and resolve technical issues.
Review contractor submittals, shop drawings, and material proposals for accuracy and compliance with specifications.
Prepare detailed structural reports, cost estimates, and technical documentation.

Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering (Master’s degree preferred).
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in structural design and implementation.
Strong knowledge of structural materials and systems including reinforced concrete, structural steel, precast, and composite structures.
Proficiency in the following software is required:

Revit Structure (BIM & 3D modeling)
ETABS (structural analysis & design)
SAFE (foundation and slab design)
SAP2000 (general structural analysis)
STAAD.Pro (structural analysis & design)
Tekla Structures (steel detailing & modeling)
AutoCAD (2D drafting & detailing)
Proficiency in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks) is highly desirable.
Thorough understanding of local building codes and international standards (ACI, AISC, Eurocode, BS, etc.).
Preferred Attributes:

Strong problem-solving abilities and ability to respond quickly to on-site structural challenges.
Excellent communication and coordination skills for interdisciplinary teamwork.
Highly detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
Prior experience in large-scale real estate, steel warehouses, and high-rise construction is a strong advantage.

You will be the face and voice of our brand on social media,primarily creating short-form videos (like Reels, Shorts, TikTok). The twist? Our content often explains or uses concepts related to coding and technology. You will be responsible for both presenting on camera and writing the scripts that make technical topics simple, relatable, and entertaining for a broad audience.

You are the perfect candidate if you:

· Are a woman based in Addis Ababa, comfortable and confident on camera.

· Have a proven familiarity with major social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, etc.).

· Can showcase at least 2 samples of video content you have helped create, whether in front of or behind the camera.

· Possess a minimum basic understanding of coding concepts (equivalent to about 5 months of learning).

· Are curious about technical topics like web development, software, or tech trends, even if you are not a professional developer.

· Have the ability to translate technical ideas (based on code or tech languages) into clear, catchy, and conversational video scripts.

· Are a creative storyteller who can hook an audience in 60 seconds or less.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Hosting: Present and film engaging short-form video content for our social media channels.

2. Script Writing: Research and write clear, compelling, and accurate video scripts based on provided code snippets or technical themes.

3. Content Ideation: Brainstorm fresh ideas for tech-explainer and trend-based videos.

4. Collaboration: Work with our content team to plan and execute a consistent posting calendar.

Requirements:

· Must be female and resident in Addis Ababa.

· Portfolio or links to at least 2 video projects you have worked on.

· Minimum foundational knowledge of code/technical concepts.

· Excellent Amharic and English communication skills (both written and spoken).

· A passion for social media trends and digital storytelling.

title: Import and Export Specialist
description:
Job description

Company Description

Kaldi's Coffee, located in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, aims to exceed competition by executing sustainable business practices. The company is dedicated to becoming 'The coffee brand of Ethiopia' by developing a passionate workforce that helps drive growth.

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Import and Export Specialist at Kaldi's. The specialist will be responsible for managing export and import processes, providing exceptional customer service, and facilitating international trade activities.

Responsibilities

Coordinate import/export activities, including customs clearance, documentation, and shipment tracking, ensuring timely and accurate processing of all related documents.
Monitor shipments proactively, addressing any delays or discrepancies.
Ensure compliance with local, national, and international regulations by working closely with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and regulatory agencies.
Keep updated on changes in customs and trade regulations, implementing adjustments as necessary.
Liaise with suppliers, customers, and logistics providers to ensure smooth order fulfillment and timely delivery.
Negotiate competitive shipping rates and terms with carriers and vendors to optimize costs and terms.
Collaborate with inventory and warehouse teams to track imported/exported goods accurately.
Monitor and manage import/export expenses, identifying opportunities to reduce costs and improve efficiency.
Maintain organized records of all import/export transactions and prepare reports on activities, costs, and compliance issues for management.
Ensure proper retention of customs documents according to company policies and legal requirements.
Update Import and export systems.
Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in International Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in import/export operations, logistics, or customs compliance.
Strong knowledge of international shipping regulations and import/export documentation requirements.
Please apply through Afriwork or through the applykaldis@gmail.com

Experience with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and secure data handling.

Problem-solving skills sharper than a Dart arrow.

Communication skills that make collaboration feel effortless.

Competitive salary with growth opportunities.

​በቀን ውስጥ እስከ 25 ለሚደርሱ ደንበኞች/ቦታዎች ዕቃዎችን ወይም መልዕክቶችን በፍጥነት እና በጥንቃቄ ማድረስ።
​የተሰጡ ትዕዛዞችን በወቅቱ እና በተቀመጠው የጊዜ ገደብ ማጠናቀቅ።
​የማድረሻ ቦታዎችን በቀላሉ ለማግኘት GPS (Google Maps) እና ሌሎች የቴክኖሎጂ አማራጮችን መጠቀም።
​ስለ አዲስ አበባ መንገዶች እና ሰፈሮች በቂ እውቀት መኖር እና አማራጭ መንገዶችን በመጠቀም ትራፊክን መሸሽ።
​ለደንበኞች መልካም አቀባበል እና ሙያዊ አገልግሎት መስጠት።
​የሥራው መስፈርቶች

​የመንጃ ፈቃድ፦ ህጋዊ የሞተር ብስክሌት መንጃ ፈቃድ ያለው።
​ልምድ፦ የአዲስ አበባን ሰፈሮች እና አቋራጭ መንገዶችን በደንብ የሚያውቅ።
​ቴክኖሎጂ፦ ስማርት ስልክ (Smartphone) መጠቀም የሚችል እና GPS የመጠቀም ከፍተኛ ክህሎት ያለው።
​ባህሪ፦ የታመነ፣ በሰዓት የሚከበር እና ለሥራው ቁርጠኛ የሆነ።
​የመግባባት ችሎታ፦ ከደንበኞች ጋር በመልካም ሁኔታ መገናኘት የሚችል።
​የክፍያ ሁኔታ እና ጥቅማጥቅሞች

​የሙከራ ጊዜ፦ የመጀመሪያው አንድ ወር የሙከራ ጊዜ ይሆናል።

title: Content Strategist
description:
PLEASE READ ALL THE REQUIREMENTS BEFORE APPLYING

WE ARE A SAFETY AND SECURITY COMPANY You are the brain behind the marketing content: you ideate, write scripts, direct execution, and manage the flow from idea to final cut

What You’ll Do:

Generate original content ideas across multiple narratives
Write complete short-form scripts with story beats, camera directions, dialogue, and editing instructions
Protect brand integrity and narrative quality — kill or revise any idea that doesn’t fit
Analyze performance in a nuanced way: attention, subtle engagement, and narrative execution, not just views
Decide which ideas to produce, iterate, or retire
What We’re Looking For:

Contrarian thinker with taste and restraint and sees what other misses
Calm, confident decision-makers who can kill ideas without hesitation
Storytellers who can see narrative in the ordinary
Able to handle full ownership: ideation → script → team direction → review → iteration
System-oriented minds who notice patterns and long-term brand impact
Understands subtle ways content can succeed or backfire
TO BE CONSIDERED ANSWER THIS QUESTIONS THEN ATTACH YOUR CV WITH IT:

Describe a successful marketing campaign you have worked on what was your role and what was the key outcomes and why do you consider it as successful & if you have to change something about it what would it be
Describe a short-form content idea in one sentence that almost no one would think of.
Name a content idea that would get engagements but should never exist for our brand and why.
(Answer in 30–120 words per question. Only candidates who demonstrate rare thinking will move forward.)
This is not a content writer role. It’s not a typical social media manager role.
This is the person who decides what exists, what doesn’t, and why every day.

If you’re not willing to think differently, make hard decisions, and execute with precision, this is not for you.

title: Coffee Export Manager
description:
job vacancy announcement
Company Name :
Location : Addis abeba
Employment :Full- time
Position Available:
1. Coffee export manager (1) position

Main Responsibilities:

I. Market and customer development

•  Responsible for the coffee market research of target countries/regions (demand, price, category, certification requirements, etc.)

•  Develop overseas customers: bakers, traders, brands, e-commerce channels

•  Participate in international coffee exhibitions (such as World of Coffee, SCA exhibition, etc.)

•  Establish and maintain customer relationships and promote long-term cooperation

II. Product and Quotation Management

•  Familiar with the structure of the company's coffee products: raw bean grade, production area, processing method, cup taste

•  Match the appropriate batch of coffee according to customer needs

•  Formulate export quotations (FOB/CIF/DDP, etc.) to control gross profit

•  Assist in sample delivery, cup test communication, and proofing confirmation

III. Order and contract management

•  Negotiate with customers and sign export contracts

•  Confirm specifications: grade, packaging, quantity, delivery date, payment method

•  Follow-up order execution: preparation, cabinet assembly, packing plan

•  Control risks: payment terms, credit audit, breach of contract clauses

IV. Export process coordination

•  Docking procurement, warehousing, quality inspection, processing (shelling, grading, packaging)

•  Coordinate with logistics companies, shipping agencies and customs declarations

•  Prepare export documents:

•  Commercial invoice, packing list

•  Certificate of origin, plant inspection certificate

•  B/L, insurance policy

•  Organic/Rainforest Alliance and other certification documents (if any)

V. Quality and customer satisfaction management

•  Make sure that the delivery batch is consistent with the sample

•  Handle customer feedback on flavor, moisture content, defect rate, etc.

•  Solve problems such as transportation losses, claims, delays, etc.

•  Improve the repurchase rate and brand reputation

VI. Internal management and strategic support

•  Formulate annual export targets and market plans

•  Statistics of sales data and analysis of market trends

•  Assist in the formulation of product structure and procurement strategy

•  Train sales staff on basic coffee knowledge

If you plan to lay out the coffee export business in Ethiopia, this position is especially important:

It should not only understand "coffee major", but also understand "foreign trade practice", and be able to communicate independently with European, American and Asian bakers. Ideal candidates usually have:

•  English/foreign business communication skills

•  Basic knowledge of coffee (raw bean grading, cup test, processing method)

title: Senior Import Expert
description:
Miseso Interior Design is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Import Expert to oversee and manage our international sourcing of finishing materials. The Senior Import Expert will lead and manage all import-related activities for finishing materials, ensuring timely, compliant, and cost-effective sourcing from international suppliers.

Key Responsibilities

Import Management

Manage the end-to-end import process for finishing materials, from supplier selection to final delivery.

Prepare, review, and validate all import documents (Proforma Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading/Airway Bill, Certificate of Origin, etc.).

Ensure full compliance with customs regulations, import laws, and government requirements.

Coordinate with clearing agents, shipping lines, freight forwarders, and banks for seamless import operations.

Supplier & Vendor Coordination

Identify, evaluate, and manage international suppliers of finishing materials.

Negotiate pricing, terms, delivery schedules, and quality standards.

Maintain strong relationships with suppliers to ensure continuous availability of required materials.

Conduct supplier performance assessments and market research to identify new sourcing opportunities.

Procurement & Materials Expertise

Provide technical input on finishing materials specifications and quality requirements.

Work closely with the procurement and engineering teams to align material specifications with project needs.

Monitor global market trends, pricing changes, and availability of finishing materials.

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, or related field.

Minimum 5 years of proven experience in import operations, preferably in finishing materials or construction industry.

Strong understanding of international procurement, INCOTERMS, customs regulations, and logistics procedures.

Excellent knowledge of finishing materials (tiles, paint, sanitary items, floors, fixtures, etc.).

Proficient in Microsoft Office.

Strong negotiation, communication, and supplier management skills.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple shipments simultaneously.

Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

title: Junior Multimedia Designer
description: Junior Multimedia Designer Job Title: Junior Multimedia Designer Department: Commercial Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Type of Employment: Full-Time Reports To: Marketing Specialist About Dodai: Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two-wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025. It’s thus looking to engage dynamic Ethiopian talent to ensure the achievement of its goals. Purpose of the Position: The Junior Multimedia Designer at Dodai supports the marketing team by creating engaging visual and multimedia content that strengthens the Dodai brand and boosts lead generation. This role contributes to the production of high-quality graphics, videos, animations, and digital assets that enhance brand visibility and support marketing campaigns. The Junior Multimedia Designer also collaborates with other departments to ensure consistent and impactful communication across all platforms, helping the company achieve its overall mission. Responsibilities: Assist in designing marketing materials, including posters, banners, social media posts, and  promotional assets. Create and edit short-form videos, animations, and motion graphics for campaigns. Support photo and video shoots, including setup, lighting assistance, and basic editing. Help maintain brand consistency across all creative outputs. Prepare production-ready files for print and digital use. Collaborate with the marketing team to develop creative concepts and campaign visuals. Update and adapt existing designs based on feedback. Organize and manage multimedia files, assets, and project folders. Research current design trends and bring new ideas to the team. Design digital and print graphics including posters, banners, flyers, social media posts, and promotional materials. Create visually appealing layouts, illustrations, and marketing graphics that align with the Dodai brand. Assist in designing UI elements or simple product mockups when needed Carry out any additional tasks or responsibilities as instructed by your supervisor or manager to support smooth operations. Qualifications: 6 months experience  in Multimedia Design, Graphic Design, Communication Design, or a related field. BA Degree in Computer Science, Architecture or related field. Basic skills in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects). Experience using Canva for quick design tasks and template-based content creation. Familiarity with AI-powered design tools Understanding of typography, layout, and visual composition. Basic knowledge of video production and editing. Ability to take feedback and work collaboratively in a team environment. Strong attention to detail and time management skills. English proficiency is a plus A portfolio showcasing design or multimedia work (student projects acceptable). Familiarity with motion graphics and simple animations. Knowledge of photography or videography. Experience creating content for social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).
