title: Senior Accountant
description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Senior Accounts Officer is responsible for managing the financial operations of the retail shop, ensuring accurate accounting records, preparing financial reports, and supporting management with timely financial insights for decision-making

Key Responsibilities

1. Cash Collection:

Receiving payments from customers or clients for services or goods rendered.

Methods of cash collection may include cash, check, or digital payments (e.g. via online banking, mobile apps).

Tracking the status of payments, ensuring amounts are correct, and documenting the receipts.

2. Receivables:

The amounts of money owed by customers or clients for goods or services provided on credit.

It involves managing and tracking outstanding invoices, ensuring timely collection, and addressing overdue payments.

Sometimes includes the use of aging reports, follow-up strategies, and coordination with collection teams.

3. Bank Reconciliation:

The process of comparing the company’s financial records (e.g., cash book) with the bank’s records (bank statements) to ensure accuracy.

It helps identify any discrepancies, such as unrecorded bank fees, errors in the company’s books, or pending transactions.

The goal is to reconcile the company’s bank account to match the correct balance by the end of the reconciliation period.

Oversee daily accounting activities (sales, purchases, expenses, cash, and bank).

Prepare monthly financial statements (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow).

Monitor accounts receivable and accounts payable.

Ensure accurate posting of transactions into the accounting system.

Reconcile Bank statements and cash accounts.

Review and verify invoices, receipts, and payment vouchers.

Manage payroll preparation and statutory payments.

Ensure compliance with tax laws (VAT, TIN, Withholding Tax, etc.).

Assist in budgeting, forecasting, and cost analysis.

Supervise junior accountants and provide guidance.

Conduct periodic inventory audits with the store team.

Support external audits and prepare necessary documentation.

 

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

4–6 years of accounting experience, preferably in retail.

Strong understanding of accounting principles and tax regulations.

Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., Peachtree, ERP systems).

Excellent analytical and reporting skills.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer
description:
Applicants please use the link below to apply: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1lkEs66Rq4exB52zLB0qiZ2mW_5_OUT_5K7YU6-tmzloXNg/viewform?usp=header

Job Title: Digital Accounting and Finance Officer

Gross Monthly Salary: Based on the organization’s scale

Job Summary:

The Digital Accounting and Finance Officer is responsible for managing and optimizing the organization’s financial operations using advanced digital tools and systems. This role blends traditional accounting functions with modern digital finance practices, including automation, data analytics, ERP integration, and fintech transaction management. The officer will oversee electronic payment channels such as Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, and other wallet services, ensuring seamless, secure, and compliant transaction flows. This position is critical to Haset IT’s operations, as it safeguards financial compliance with Ethiopian laws while driving efficiency, innovation, and transparency in digital financial processes.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Financial Operations

Maintain and manage financial data in ERP/accounting systems.

Oversee integrations with fintech platforms (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr, Amole, HelloCash, banks’ digital wallets).

Automate routine accounting tasks and digital reconciliation processes.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Generate real-time dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI/Excel.

Analyze transaction volumes from electronic channels and provide insights for decision-making.

Monitor KPIs for digital payment adoption, processing costs, and error/fraud detection.

Accounts & Transactions

Manage digital accounts payable/receivable workflows.

Reconcile multi-gateway transactions (mobile money, online payments, wallets, and bank transfers).

Ensure secure settlement and timely collection from digital platforms.

Tax & Compliance

Prepare and file e-tax reports (VAT, WHT, income tax, pensions) electronically.

Ensure compliance with ERCA’s digital tax systems and fintech regulatory directives.

Stay updated on National Bank of Ethiopia fintech guidelines and interoperability standards.

Cash Flow, Payroll & Digital Gateways

Monitor online banking and mobile money cash flows daily.

Manage payroll through digital payroll systems with automated statutory deductions.

Ensure multi-channel settlement (Chapa, SantimPay, TeleBirr) is tracked, reconciled, and secured.

Audit & Internal Controls

Maintain digital audit trails for fintech and ERP transactions.

Coordinate audits with external auditors and regulators, ensuring fintech compliance.

Implement fraud prevention and digital transaction monitoring systems.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Work with IT teams to ensure payment API integrations are secure and efficient.

Partner with Operations and HR to align payment flows with organizational goals.

Communicate with banks, fintech providers, and vendors through digital platforms.

Policy Development & Innovation

Develop digital finance policies for transaction security, reconciliation, and fraud prevention.

Contribute to Haset IT’s digital economy transformation by adopting fintech best practices.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

3–5 years of professional experience in accounting/finance (preferably in fintech, transportation, or tech).

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Peachtree/QuickBooks, and digital accounting systems.

Strong detail orientation and accuracy in digital record-keeping.

title: Bookkeeper QuickBooks Specialist
description:
Department: Accounting

Location: Remote

Schedule: Full-Time, 40 Hours Per Week

Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Exclusivity Requirement:

This is a full-time, exclusive position. Candidates may not hold other employment or ongoing obligations that conflict with this role’s schedule or performance expectations.

Application Deadline: 3 Days from Posting Date

Education Requirement: Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, or related preferred)

Experience Level: Experienced Bookkeeper

⸻

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly competent Bookkeeper with strong QuickBooks experience to manage day-to-day accounting operations accurately and independently.

This role is execution-focused and hands-on. The ideal candidate has significant experience working directly in QuickBooks, understands how transactions flow through the general ledger, and can maintain clean, well-documented, and reliable books with minimal oversight.

This position is not advisory or strategic in nature. Success in this role depends on accuracy, consistency, and ownership of the bookkeeping process.

⸻

Required Systems & Skills

•    QuickBooks Online (Required – Advanced Proficiency)

•    Bank and credit card reconciliations

•    General ledger maintenance

•    Accounts payable and accounts receivable

•    Payroll posting and reconciliation

•    Month-end close

•    Financial statement preparation

•    Strong Excel skills for reconciliations and schedules

⸻

Key Responsibilities

•    Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records in QuickBooks

•    Record and review daily financial transactions

•    Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations

•    Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, and adjustments

•    Maintain clean and well-supported general ledger accounts

•    Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes

•    Coordinate payroll postings and reconciliations

•    Prepare monthly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)

•    Identify and correct posting errors and discrepancies

•    Ensure books are consistently audit-ready and tax-ready

•    Support month-end and year-end close processes

•    Communicate clearly regarding issues, exceptions, and needed follow-ups

⸻

Qualifications

•    Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (preferred)

•    3–5+ years of hands-on bookkeeping experience

•    Strong proficiency in QuickBooks (mandatory)

•    Solid understanding of U.S. accounting principles at the bookkeeping level

•    Proven ability to manage full-cycle bookkeeping independently

•    Excellent attention to detail and organization

•    Strong written and verbal English communication skills

•    Ability to dedicate full-time hours exclusively to this role

·       የሠራተኞችን የሥራ አፈጻጸም ይገመግማል፣ ውጤታማ የሆኑ ሰራተኞችን ያበረታታል፣ የአቅም ክፍተት ያለባቸውን ሰራተኞች በመለየት ልዩ ድጋፍ እንዲያገኙ ያደርጋል፣

·       የድርጅቱን የአሰራር ችግሮች በመለየትና በማጥናት ምቹ የአሰራር ሂደት እንዲኖር ያደርጋል፣ተፈጻሚነቱን ያረጋግጣል፣

·   በግዢ አፈጻጸም ላይ ግብረ መልስ መቀበል፣መስጠትና የመፍትሄ እርምጃ መውሰድ፣

3.  የንብረትና ጠቅላላ አገልግሎት ስራዎችን መከታተል

Schedule and dispatch trips for NEMT passengers.
Comfortable working long hours in a fast-paced environment

Use dispatch software to manage rides and update trip status.
Confirm trip appointments and coordinate changes or cancellations

Requirements:

Work in a collaborative, innovative, and supportive environment

title: Translator
description:
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Translator proficient in Afan Oromo and Amharic with a strong preference for those with experience in legal translation. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of both languages, exceptional translation skills, and the ability to accurately convey complex legal and general information. Experience in translating other foreign languages is highly encouraged. This role requires a meticulous approach to translation, ensuring the highest quality standards are maintained across all documents.

Key Responsibilities:

Provide accurate, clear, and culturally appropriate translations from Amharic to Afan Oromo, English to Amharic, and vice versa as required.
Translate legal documents, contracts, and other specialized materials with a focus on legal terminology and compliance.
Proofread and edit translated texts to ensure accuracy, grammar, and context.
Ensure translations maintain the intended meaning and tone of the original content, adapting for regional dialects where necessary.
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure translations meet client or project specifications.
Handle confidential materials with discretion and ensure proper documentation and organization.
Stay updated on language and legal terminology to maintain high translation standards.
Preferred Qualifications:

title: Incident Response / DevOps Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for an Incident Response–focused DevOps Engineer to help keep production systems stable and recover them quickly when things break. This role is operational by nature. You will be on the front line when incidents happen.

* This is an operational, incident-driven role

* This is not a feature development or purely project-based job

* If you don’t like being on-call or reacting to real problems in real time, this role will be a bad fit

Responsibilities

* Respond to production incidents promptly, including nights and weekends

* Troubleshoot and stabilize Linux-based systems under pressure

* Investigate root causes and assist with post-incident analysis

* Perform basic operational tasks during incidents (service restarts, scaling, failovers, log analysis)

* Work closely with engineering and infrastructure teams during outages

* Maintain clear communication during incidents

Working Model

* Half-day in-person shift during regular working days

* On-call availability overnight and at any time when incidents occur

* Must be reachable and able to act remotely during incidents, regardless of location

Requirements

* Strong, hands-on experience with Linux systems

* Practical troubleshooting skills (processes, networking basics, disk, memory, logs)

* Some experience with AWS is preferred (EC2, basic networking, load balancers, etc.)

* Comfortable working under pressure and making decisions quickly

* Reliable, responsive, and disciplined with on-call responsibilities

Nice to Have

* Experience with monitoring and alerting tools

* Familiarity with DNS, networking, or cloud infrastructure

* Previous incident response or on-call experience

title: Business Development Associate
description:
About the Company

EHealth IT Service P.L.C (Orbit Health) is a digital health pioneer in Ethiopia, transforming healthcare through innovative solutions. With a vision to expand across Africa, we aim to bridge healthcare gaps, improve access, and enhance patient outcomes. At Orbit Health, you’ll be part of a mission-driven team shaping the future of healthcare.

Job Summary

The Business Development Associate (BDA) plays a key role in supporting Orbit Health’s growth initiatives. The BDA’s primary responsibilities fall into four key areas: Lead Generation, Sales Support, Market Intelligence, and Proposal & Partnership Management.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct market research to identify new clients, high-potential segments, and business opportunities

• Generate and quality leads through cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other channels

• Maintain accurate records of leads and opportunities in the CRM system

• Schedule meetings, demos, and introductory calls for the sales team

• Act as the first point of contact, building strong relationships with early-stage prospects

• Track tenders, RFPs, RFQs, and new project opportunities

• Support proposal, quotation, and tender preparation and submission

• Gather market intelligence, conduct competitor analysis, and produce actionable reports

• Assist in identifying and engaging potential strategic partners

Qualifications & Skills

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Management, Economics, or a Health-related field

• Experience: Minimum 2 years in business development, sales, lead generation, proposal development, or related roles

• Skills: Strong communication, research, analytical, CRM proficiency, time management, strategic thinking, Resilience and collaboration

N.B.: Candidates with a background in health sciences, IT, and an MBA or additional business qualifications, who have relevant experience working in the same or similar areas, are highly encouraged to apply

Why Join Us

• Be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company

• Gain exposure to high-impact projects and business strategies

• Work in a collaborative, innovative, and supportive environment

title: Product Manager
description: The Software Product Manager is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and feature definition of a software product. Translate customer needs into technical requirements and work closely with engineering and design teams to bring those solutions to life. Key Responsibilities ●   Define the long-term product vision and develop a roadmap that aligns with company goals. ●   Own and prioritize the product backlog, determining the sequence of features, bug fixes, and technical improvement. ●   Conduct usability testing, analyze user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience ●   Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the software development teams ●   Monitor competitors, industry trends, and emerging technologies to ensure the product remains a market leader. ●   Lead "Daily Stand-ups" with software development teams to resolve technical bottlenecks. ●   Writing Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) or defining "User Stories" for upcoming features. ●   Collaborating with UX/UI designers on wireframes and prototypes for future releases. ●   Define and track KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) to measure product health and feature performance. Qualifications & Requirements ●      A Bachelor’s (BSc) or Master’s (MSc) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, Information Systems, Electrical & Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical field. ●      Proven hands-on experience in Software Development is required to facilitate deep collaboration with the engineering team. ●      Minimum of 2+ years of experience in a Product Management role within a software development environment ●      Strong experience leading teams through the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies. ●      Experience with tools like Jira, Confluence, or Trello. ●      Strong presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. ●      Strong analytical and communication skills. ●      Commitment to timely delivery and process compliance. ●      Experience working with cross-functional teams and end-users.

title: Junior Architect with Elevated Design Skills
description:
Job Title: Junior Architect (1-3 years of experience)

About Us:

DELFE is a dynamic and innovative Architectural and Engineering firm dedicated to creating inspiring and sustainable designs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and our commitment to professional growth and development.

Job Description:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Junior Architect to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion and for architecture, excellent design skills, and the ability to work collaboratively on a variety of projects. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career professional to gain hands-on experience and grow within our firm.

Responsibilities:

· Assist in the development of design concepts and architectural plans.

· Prepare and modify architectural drawings, plans, and construction documents.

· Conduct site visits and assist in field measurements.

· Collaborate with senior architects, engineers, and other team members.

· Participate in project meetings and presentations.

· Research materials, products, and building codes.

· Support the project management team in coordinating project activities and timelines.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.

· 1-3 years of professional experience in an architectural firm.

· Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Lumion, D5 Render, and other relevant design software.

· Strong hand sketching, graphic and presentation skills.

· Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

· Knowledge of building codes, standards, and construction methods.

· Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.

· Must own a personal laptop capable of running architectural design and rendering software.

 

What We Offer:

· Competitive salary and benefits package.

· Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

· Collaborative and supportive work environment.

· Exposure to a variety of project types and scales.

How to Apply:

Interested candidates should submit a resume, cover letter, and portfolio of work to info@delfegroup.com with the subject line "Junior Architect Application – [Your Name]".

title: Moho Pro Character Rigger (2D Animation)
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and reliable Moho Pro character rigger to create clean, professional, and reusable human character rigs for a long-term 2D animated storytelling project.

This project focuses on story-driven animated fairy tales for a 13+ audience, published consistently on YouTube and other platforms. The rigs must be optimized for dialogue-heavy scenes, emotional acting, and efficient production.

This is not a beginner position. We are seeking someone with proven Moho rigging experience who understands deformation, smart bone logic, and animator-friendly workflows.

Responsibilities

Rig human 2D characters in Moho Pro (v13 or later)
Create smooth, clean bone deformations for arms, legs, spine, neck, and shoulders
Build Smart Bone actions for:

Head turns (minimum ¼ turn, ¾ turn preferred)
Arm and shoulder corrections
Hip and leg corrections
Set up facial rigs using switch layers and/or smart bones, including:

Mouth shapes for dialogue (A, E, O, M, etc.)
Eye blinks and eye direction controls
Eyebrow and basic emotion control
Ensure rigs are:

Stable
Reusable
Easy to animate
Deliver clean, well-organized Moho files with clear layer and bone naming
Required Skills & Experience (Mandatory)

Minimum 2+ years of experience using Moho Pro
Strong understanding of:

Bone rigging
Smart Bones
Switch layers
Deformation correction
Experience rigging human characters (animals only portfolios will not be considered)
Ability to create rigs suitable for dialogue-based animation
Strong attention to organization and file cleanliness
What We Do NOT Want (Important)

Please do not apply if:

You only use auto-rig tools
You are “learning Moho” or transitioning from another software
You cannot show actual Moho rig examples
Your rigs are stiff, rubbery, or poorly deformed
Portfolio Requirements (Required to Apply)

Applicants must provide:

At least 3 examples of Moho-rigged characters
Short demo videos showing:

Head turns
Arm and leg movement
Facial animation or dialogue test
Screenshots or previews of Moho bone structures (preferred)
Applications without relevant Moho examples will be ignored.

Deliverables

For each character, the rigger must provide:

Final .moho project file
One fully rigged character, ready for animation
A short 10–15 second test animation demonstrating the rig
Full commercial usage rights for the rig
Payment & Workflow

Payment will be per character
Budget depends on experience and rig quality
Payment structure:

Partial upfront payment
Remaining balance after rig preview approval
This is a long-term opportunity for the right candidate
Ideal Candidate

The ideal rigger:

Understands storytelling and acting needs
Builds rigs that save animation time
Communicates clearly and professionally
Can work independently and meet deadlines
How to Apply

Please include:

Your Moho rigging portfolio
Your experience level with Moho Pro
Your rate per character
Confirmation that you can deliver clean, reusable rigs
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Junior Multimedia Designer
description:
Junior Multimedia Designer

Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Type of Employment: Full-Time

About Dodai:

 

Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two-wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025. It’s thus looking to engage dynamic Ethiopian talent to ensure the achievement of its goals.

description:
የስራ መግለጫ

ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያላቸውን የልጆች ልብሶች ምርት ሂደት በአጠቃላይ የሚቆጣጠር፣ የስፌት ቡድንን የሚመራ፣ የስራ መመዘኛዎች (Quality, Time, Process) እንዲጠበቁ የሚያረጋግጥ የሙሉ ጊዜ የልብስ ስፌት ተቆጣጣሪ እንፈልጋለን።

ተቆጣጣሪው/ዋ የቀን ቀን ስራዎችን መከታተል፣ የሰራተኞችን አፈፃፀም መቆጣጠር፣ የምርት ጥራትን መረጋገጥ እና የስራ ሂደቶችን ማሻሻል ይኖርበታል።

እንዲሁም የፓተርን፣ መቁረጥ እና መስፋት ሂደቶች በተሰጡ መመሪያዎች መሠረት እንዲፈፀሙ መቆጣጠር፣ የጥራት ችግር ሲኖር በፍጥነት መፍታት፣ የስፌት ማሽኖችን አጠቃቀም መከታተል እና ማንኛውም የምርት መዘግየት እንዳይፈጠር መከላከል ይጠበቃል።

ተቆጣጣሪው/ዋ የሰራተኞችን ስልጠና መስጠት፣ አዲስ ሰራተኞችን ማስገባት፣ የስራ መመሪያዎችን (SOPs) ማስፈፀም፣ የቀን የምርት ሪፖርቶችን መዘጋጀት እና ለአስተዳደር መላክ ይኖርበታል።

በአጠቃላይ ቡድኑ በተደራጀ መንገድ እንዲሰራ፣ ንጹህ እና ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው አጨራረስ እንዲመጣ እና ስራዎች በጊዜ እንዲጠናቀቁ ሙሉ ኃላፊነት ይወስዳል/ታወስዳለች።

መስፈርት

በልብስ ስፌት ተቆጣጣሪ / አመራር ስራ ላይ ቢያንስ 2–5 ዓመት ልምድ ያላት

የልጅ ልብስ ምርት ላይ በቂ ልምድ ያላት

title: Office Assistant
description:
JOB PURPOSE

The Office Assistant provides general administrative, operational, and logistical support to all departments of the ATB Addis Ababa Office. The role requires flexibility to assist, support, and temporarily replace staff during holidays, sick leave, or peak workload periods across Accounting, Branch Operations, Administration, Purchasing, and Immigration/Labour-related activities.

KEY REPONSIBILITIES / MAJOR TASKS

1. General Office & Administrative Support

Provide day-to-day administrative support to all office areas (Accounting, Branch, Administration, etc.).
Replace and support office staff during holidays, sick leave, or absence as required.
Assist with document filing, scanning, photocopying, and record keeping.
Support internal coordination among departments.
Handle office errands and external follow-ups when needed.
2. Accounting & Branch Support

Assist the Accounting team with basic administrative tasks (document collection, filing, payment follow-ups, etc.).
Support Branch operations with routine office work as assigned.
Deliver and collect documents to/from banks, suppliers, or offices when required.
3. Purchasing & Providers Support

Assist with purchasing processes, including:

Collecting quotations
Coordinating with suppliers and service providers
Following up on deliveries and service completion
Support supplier communication and documentation.
4. Immigration & Labour Office Support

Assist with document preparation and follow-ups related to:

Immigration
Work permits
Labour Office requirements
Deliver and collect documents from Immigration, Labour Office, and other government institutions.
5. Employee Support & Hospital Assistance

Provide support to employees who become sick during working hours.
Assist in transporting and accompanying employees to Hospital when required.
Coordinate with office staff to ensure someone is available to assist sick employees, especially during busy periods (the less-busy staff member at that time will support as needed).

QUALIFICATIONS

title: Scrum Master
description: We are looking for a proactive and experienced Scrum Master to join our team. In this role, you will facilitate agile processes, support cross-functional teams, and ensure the effective delivery of projects through Scrum practices. You will work closely with product owners, developers, and stakeholders to foster collaboration, remove impediments, and continuously improve team performance. Key Responsibilities Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Support the Product Owner in backlog refinement, prioritization, and sprint readiness. Remove impediments and blockers that impact team productivity and delivery. Ensure transparency and visibility of progress through agile metrics, dashboards, and reporting. Promote continuous improvement by identifying process gaps and implementing actionable improvements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, and stakeholders. Protect the team from scope creep and external disruptions during sprints. Track sprint outcomes, and delivery timelines. Support agile adoption and maturity across teams and the broader organization. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 2+ years of experience working as a Scrum Master or in an agile project management role. Strong understanding of Scrum framework, agile methodologies, and software development lifecycle. Experience in supporting cross-functional agile teams. Ability to identify and resolve team blockers and improve delivery efficiency. Strong communication, facilitation, and conflict-resolution skills. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

title: Transaction and Administration Coordinator
description:
Job Summary

The Transaction, Administration & Administration Coordinator is responsible for coordinating sales transactions while ensuring efficient office administration. The role supports sales contract management, payment processing, documentation control, compliance with contractual and administrative requirements, commission follow-up, and day-to-day office operations. The position plays a key role in maintaining organized processes, smooth internal coordination, and a professional office environment.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

Sales Transaction & Contract Management

Support the coordination, and management of sales contracts and related agreements.
Ensure contracts are properly completed, signed, approved, and securely filed.
Track transaction progress and follow up on contract milestones and deadlines.
Payment Processing & Follow-up

Coordinate and monitor client payments in line with agreed contract terms.
Follow up on outstanding payments with clients and internal finance teams.
Maintain accurate records of payments, balances, and transaction status.
Sales Documentation & Records Management

Maintain organized and up-to-date sales files, including contracts, receipts, approvals, and correspondence.
Ensure proper documentation control, filing, and easy retrieval of records.
Prepare transaction summaries and periodic administrative reports.
Compliance & Administrative Control

Ensure sales transactions comply with internal procedures, contractual obligations, and relevant regulations.
Support audits and internal reviews by providing accurate documentation.
Identify gaps or discrepancies and escalate them for corrective action.
Commission Tracking & Follow-up

Track sales commissions in accordance with approved commission structures.
Coordinate commission payment processing and follow up on pending commissions.
Maintain commission records and provide reconciliation reports when required.
Office Administration & Operations

Manage day-to-day office administration activities to ensure smooth operations.
Coordinate office supplies, stationery, utilities, and basic office services.
Maintain office records, correspondence, and filing systems.
Support scheduling of meetings, appointments, and internal communications.
Assist in onboarding documentation for new sales agents and staff.
Ensure the office environment is organized, functional, and professional at all times.
Coordination & Communication

Act as a central point of contact between sales agents, management, finance, legal, and external stakeholders.
Handle inquiries related to transactions, documentation, and administrative matters.
Support the sales team with administrative assistance as required.
Skills and Competencies

Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping ability.
Good understanding of real estate transactions and administrative processes.
Strong communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Proficiency in MS Office and basic administrative systems.
Personal Skills:

·      Teamwork

·      Honesty

·      Tightness

·      Commitment

·      Relationship

title: E-commerce Operations Officer
description:
The E-commerce Operations Officer is responsible for managing the full operational process of products on local e-commerce platforms. title: Manager
description:
The Business Rental House Manager is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of rental properties to ensure profitability, legal compliance, and tenant satisfaction.

description:

•  ሪፖርት ማቅረብ፦ የእለቱን የጉብኝት ብዛት፣ የተገኘውን ትዕዛዝ እና ደንበኞች የሰጡትን አስተያየት ለባለቤቱ በጽሁፍ ማሳወቅ።

3. አስፈላጊ ችሎታዎች
•  አሳማኝነት፦ ሰዎችን የማሳመን እና የመሸጥ ተፈጥሯዊ ችሎታ።

4. ተመራጭ ብቃቶች

title: Sales Training Manager
description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced Sales Training Manager to lead the development and execution of our sales training programs. As the Sales Training Manager, you will be responsible for enhancing the sales team’s skills, knowledge, and performance through comprehensive training initiatives. Your role is crucial in ensuring that our sales representatives & sales promoters are equipped with the tools and expertise needed to meet and exceed sales targets while delivering exceptional customer experiences.

Responsibilities

• Identifying the training need for Promoters, Sales Representatives, and Retail

Sales Supervisors.

• Preparing training manuals and materials based on identified needs.

• Providing training to sales promoters and supervisors.

• Following up on the day-to-day activities of sales promoters, supervisors, and

other sales and marketing teams to support them.

• Developing, implementing, and continuously improving comprehensive training

programs for new and existing sales team members.

• Creating customized training materials, including presentations, manuals, and

role-playing scenarios, to enhance sales skills and product knowledge.

• Facilitating and conducting training sessions both in-person and virtually for

new hires, sales representatives, and sales managers.

• Analyzing sales performance metrics to identify skill gaps and areas of

improvement for individual team members and the sales team as a whole.

• Working with sales leadership to align training initiatives with business goals

and KPIs.

• Offering ongoing coaching, feedback, and mentoring to enhance the

performance of sales staff.

• Partnering with cross-functional teams (Marketing) to ensure alignment of

sales training with company initiatives and product updates.

• Acting as a liaison between sales leadership and training teams to ensure

continuous communication of sales challenges and training requirements.

• Developing dynamic and engaging training content based on the latest sales

techniques, trends, and tools.

• Ensuring that all training materials are up to date, relevant, and engaging,

leveraging various formats such as eLearning modules, videos, and in-person

workshops.

• Measuring the effectiveness of training programs through assessments,

feedback, and performance reviews.

• Regularly assessing sales team development needs and recommending

additional training or resources based on results.

• Collecting and analyzing weekly and monthly sales amounts of each sales

promoter to identify performance.

• Recommending and implementing improvement mechanisms based on

analyzed sales performance.

• Facilitating training & development programs.

• Generating reports to showcase the impact of training programs on sales

performance and providing recommendations for improvements.

• Performing any other duties assigned by the immediate supervisor or manager.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or MA/MBA in Business Administration, Marketing

Management, Management, or a related field.

• 5–8 years of experience as a Sales Training Specialist or Manager, with at least

2 years in a sales training role.

• Proven success in developing and delivering sales training programs.

• Strong knowledge of sales processes, tools, and strategies, including Customer

Relationship Management systems and sales enablement tools.

• Strong presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.

• Analytical skills to interpret sales data and identify performance gaps.

• Coaching & mentoring experience for one-on-one staff development.

• Problem-solving ability with practical solutions.

• Team collaboration with cross-functional departments.

title: HR officer
description:
As part of its outsourcing operations, R&D Group operates an HR Outsourcing function and serves as an Employer of Record (EoR) for third-party clients. In this capacity, R&D Group manages employment contract administration, payroll processing, and comprehensive HR service delivery on behalf of its clients. R&D Group is currently seeking two proactive and experienced HR Officers to join its HR Outsourcing Department. The selected candidates will play a key role in supporting and strengthening the HR Outsourcing wing by delivering end-to-end HR services, ensuring legal compliance, enhancing employee experience, and supporting both internal operations and client organizations.

interviews, onboarding, and hiring coordination

• Administer leave management, leave tracking, and attendance records

• Manage payroll processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance

• Maintain and update employee personnel files (physical and digital)

• Track employee performance and support performance management processes

• Prepare and manage employee appraisal documents and performance review cycles

• Support employee relations, disciplinary actions, and grievance handling

• Act as a liaison between R&D Group and client organizations

• Manage day-to-day HR service delivery for assigned clients

• Prepare HR reports and updates for the HR Outsourcing Lead

• Coordinate and support employee development and capacity-building training

• Ensure compliance with labor laws, HR policies, and client requirements

• Support continuous improvement of HR processes and service delivery standards

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in human resource management, Business Administration,

Management, or a related field

• Minimum of 2 years of relevant HR management or HR operations experience

• Strong knowledge of recruitment, payroll, performance management, and employee

relations

• Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and ethical conduct

• Experience in HR outsourcing or multi-client environments is an advantage

• Knowledge of local labor laws and HR compliance requirements is an advantage

title: Import Category Head
description:
On behalf of our client, Repi-Wilmar, we are inviting qualified and experienced professionals to apply for the position of Import Category Head.

 

About the Company

Repi-Wilmar is preparing to launch large-scale import operations for consumer goods, including edible oil, sugar, and related food items, sourced primarily from its parent company, Wilmar International, as well as other international suppliers. Wilmar International is Asia’s leading agribusiness group with global operations spanning tropical oils, oilseeds, grains, and sugar.

This role will play a strategic leadership function in establishing, managing, and scaling Repi-Wilmar’s import category across food and consumer products.

Position: Import Category Head

Location: Ayer Tena, Addis Ababa
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: Competitive and negotiable (based on experience and caliber)

Key Responsibilities

Lead and manage the company’s import category for consumer and food products
Develop and execute import strategies aligned with business objectives and market demand
Coordinate imports from Wilmar International and other international suppliers
Oversee end-to-end import operations including planning, documentation, logistics, and customs clearance
Ensure compliance with Ethiopian import regulations, customs requirements, and food safety standards
Manage relationships with suppliers, freight forwarders, banks, regulators, and inspection bodies
Monitor global market trends, pricing, and supply dynamics for food and consumer goods
Ensure cost efficiency, risk management, and timely availability of imported products
Prepare import plans, forecasts, and performance reports for senior management
Support internal coordination with sales, finance, quality, and supply chain teams
Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, International Trade, Supply Chain, Logistics, Economics, or related field (Master’s preferred)
Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive experience in import, international trade, or supply chain management
Proven experience handling food or FMCG imports (edible oil, sugar, grains, or similar products is a strong advantage)
Strong understanding of import regulations, customs procedures, trade finance, and Incoterms
Experience working with multinational suppliers or parent companies is highly preferred
Strong leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
Excellent communication and analytical abilities
How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to submit their CV and application letter, quoting the job title in the email subject line as:

Import Category Head | Repi-Wilmar

info@ethiocv.com
Application Deadline: January 26, 2026

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant – Pharmaceutical Importing Company

Key Responsibilities

Lead monthly and annual financial closing processes, including preparation of accruals, provisions, and adjusting journal entries.
Prepare and review monthly management accounts, including Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow statements; analyze variances and provide insights to management.
Ensure full compliance with ERCA tax regulations (VAT, withholding, customs-related taxes) and EFDA financial and documentation requirements applicable to pharmaceutical imports.
Support the Finance Manager in preparing the annual budget and periodic forecasts, and monitor actual performance against approved budgets.
Supervise junior accounting staff by reviewing postings, reconciliations, and supporting schedules; provide technical guidance and on-the-job coaching.
Act as a focal point for internal and external auditors; prepare audit schedules, supporting documents, and respond to audit queries in a timely manner.
Prepare cash flow forecasts and manage day-to-day treasury activities, including documentation and follow-up for Letters of Credit (LCs), foreign currency payments, and bank settlements.
Handle import and export costing, including freight, insurance, customs duties, and clearing charges; ensure accurate inventory valuation in line with accounting standards.
Record sales transactions accurately, perform regular reconciliations, and monitor receivables, credit controls, and collections.
Ensure proper recording, classification, and documentation of expenses in compliance with internal policies and statutory requirements.
Maintain complete and accurate financial documentation related to imports, suppliers, banks, and regulatory authorities, while strengthening internal controls.
Perform additional finance-related duties as assigned by management.
Requirements

Academic Qualifications

BA or MBA in Accounting, Financial Management, or a related field.
Additional Qualifications & Skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to prioritize tasks and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Proficient in MS Office applications and accounting software (Peachtree).
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
Strong teamwork and interpersonal communication skills.
Self-motivated, results-oriented, and well-organized with strong attention to detail.
Prior experience in preparing financial reports is highly preferred.
Proficiency in Oromic (Afaan Oromo) communication skills are an added advantage.
Work Experience

Minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience in accounting or finance, preferably in a senior-level role.
Submission:  Interested applicants fulfilling the above requirements can submit their CV and copy of their credentials through our email address administrator@sariaconsult.com

Note: - Don't forget to write the position you are applying for in the subject line!

title: የልብስ ስፌት ባለሙያ
description:
መስፈርት

ልምድ ያለው የሰለጠነ እና ዝርዝር ተኮር የጨርቃጨርቅ ስፌት ኦፕሬተሮችን እንፈልጋለን። ተመራጭ እጩዎች የኢንዱስትሪ የልብስ ስፌት ማሽኖችን በመስራት የተለማመዱ፣ ስለ ልብስ ግንባታ ጠንካራ ግንዛቤ እና ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያላቸውን ምርቶች ለማምረት ቁርጠኝነት ያላቸው እና የጨርቃጨርቅ ልብሶችን በጊዜ እና በትክክለኛ አሠራር መሰረት በማምረት ረገድ የሰለጠነ እና ልምድ ያላቸው የስፌት ኦፕሪተሮች።

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች

* የኢንዱስትሪ የልብስ ስፌት ማሽኖችን በአስተማማኝ እና በብቃት መስራት የሚችል

* በምርት መመሪያ እና በጥራት ደረጃዎች መሰረት ልብሶችን ወይም የጨርቃጨርቅ ክፍሎችን በትክክል መስፋት

* የልብስ ስፌት ንድፎችን, ቴክኒካዊ ዝርዝሮችን እና የሱፐርቫይዘሮችን መመሪያዎችን ተከትሎ መስራት

* የተጠናቀቀውን ስራ ለጥራት፣ ወጥነት እና ከማምረት መስፈርቶች ጋር መጣጣምን መፈተሽና ማረጋገጥ

* የተበላሹ ቁሳቁሶችን ወይም የልብስ ስፌት ማሽን ችግሮችን ወዲያውኑ ለተቆጣጣሪው ማሳወቅ

* ንጹህ እና የተደራጀ የስራ ቦታን መጠበቅ እና ሁሉም የደህንነት ፕሮቶኮሎች መከበራቸውን ማረጋገጥ

* እንደ አስፈላጊነቱ ሌሎች የምርት ሂደቶችን መደገፍ፣ መከርከም፣ መጫን ወይም ማጠናቀቅን ጨምሮ

* ዕለታዊ ምርትን ለማሟላት ከስራ ባልደረቦች እና የቡድን መሪዎች ጋር በትብብር መስራት

አስፈላጊ መስፈርቶች

* በጨርቃ ጨርቅ ወይም የልብስ ስፌት አካባቢ ቢያንስ 1-10 ዓመት ልምድ ያለው

* የተለያዩ የኢንደስትሪ የልብስ ስፌት ማሽኖችን በትክክል የመስራት ችሎታ

* መሰረታዊ የልብስ ስፌት ቴክኒኮችን እና የልብስ ማቀነባበሪያ ሂደቶችን መረዳት

* ለዝርዝር ትኩረት እና ከፍተኛ የጥራት ደረጃዎችን ለመጠበቅ ቁርጠኝነት

* ጥሩ የእጅ አይን ቅንጅት እና የእጅ ቅልጥፍና

መመሪያዎችን የመከተል እና የቡድን አካል ሆኖ የመስራት ችሎታ

* ፍጥነት ባለው፣ በጊዜ ገደብ በሚመራ የምርት አካባቢ ለመስራት ፈቃደኛ መሆን

ደመወዝ፡- በድርጅቱ ስኬል (ነገር ግን በሚችሉት የስፌት ሙያ መሰረት ሆኖ በፈተና ይለያል)

ጥቅማጥቅም፡-ከደመወዝ በተጨማሪ አጥጋቢ ቦነስ፣ መኖሪያ ቤት በነፃ፣ ምግብ፡ ቁርስ፣ ምሳ እና እራት በነፃ፣

ፍላጎቱ ያላቸው አመልካቾች

requritshints@gmail.com

Contact: 0920003278

title: Senior UI/UX Designer (Web & Mobile Products)
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced UI/UX Designer to help design and refine modern, user-centric digital products across web and mobile. You’ll work closely with product and engineering to turn complex workflows into intuitive, polished user experiences.

 

This role is ideal for someone who thinks beyond screens—you understand user behavior, product strategy, and how design impacts conversion, retention, and usability.

 

What You’ll Do

Design end-to-end user experiences for web and mobile products
Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs
Translate product requirements into clean, intuitive UX
Collaborate with product managers and developers to ensure designs are feasible and scalable
Iterate designs based on user feedback, data, and usability testing
Maintain and evolve design systems for consistency and speed
Ensure accessibility and usability best practices are met
What We’re Looking For

4+ years of experience in UI/UX design for digital products
Strong portfolio demonstrating UX thinking, not just visuals
Expertise in Figma (required)
Experience designing responsive web apps and mobile apps
Strong understanding of user research, usability principles, and interaction design
Ability to clearly explain design decisions to non-designers
Comfortable working in fast-moving, startup-style environments
Nice to Have

Experience working with product-led or SaaS platforms
Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
Experience collaborating with engineers using React / React Native
Experience designing conversion-driven or workflow-heavy products
Why Join

Work on real products with clear impact
High ownership and creative freedom
Direct collaboration with founders and product leadership
Opportunity for long-term work as the product scales

title: Head of Procurement
description:
We are looking for an experienced Head of Procurement to drive the strategic procurement operations of the organization. Reporting to the Procurement Manager, the role will lead the procurement team, enhance supplier partnerships, control costs, and ensure compliance with company policies and industry regulations while supporting overall business goals.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead and oversee the day-to-day procurement operations, ensuring alignment with the company’s strategic goals.
Support the Procurement Director in developing and executing procurement strategies that optimize cost, quality, and efficiency.
Manage and mentor the procurement team, fostering performance, accountability, and professional development.
Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers to secure favorable terms, ensuring compliance with company standards and legal requirements.
Oversee contract management, tender processes, and supplier performance evaluation.
Maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and internal stakeholders to enhance collaboration and business outcomes.
Monitor market trends, assess risks, and adjust procurement plans to mitigate supply chain disruptions.
Ensure procurement policies, procedures, and compliance requirements are consistently implemented across all activities.
Prepare and manage budgets, RFQs, purchase orders, and competitive bidding processes.
Support strategic decision-making by providing accurate procurement data, insights, and reports to management.
Perform other tasks and projects as assigned by the Procurement Manager.
Requirements:

Educational Qualification:

BA/MA in Procurement and Supply Management, Business Administration, or related fields.
Experience:

8+ years of progressive experience in procurement or supply chain management, with proven leadership experience.
Skills & Competencies:

Strong leadership and team management skills, able to oversee the entire procurement lifecycle.
Strategic thinking with the ability to develop and implement procurement policies and cost-saving strategies.
Excellent negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of procurement regulations, compliance requirements, and industry best practices.
Strong communication and reporting skills, with the ability to influence decision-making.

title: Internal Audit Expert
description:
Ashewa Technology Solutions S.C. is a leading Ethiopian technology company delivering ERP, digital transformation, cloud, and software solutions in support of the Digital Ethiopia 2030 vision. The role provides independent assurance and advisory support to the Board, strengthening governance, risk management, internal controls, compliance, and alignment with Ashewa’s strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Governance & Strategic Alignment Audit

Assess alignment of operations, investments, and performance with the approved strategy, long-term objectives, and Digital Ethiopia 2030. Evaluate consistency between strategy, budgets, KPIs, execution, and results, and provide strategic insights beyond financial compliance.

2. Financial & IFRS Compliance

Review compliance with IFRS, GAP, internal financial policies, and reporting standards. Assess accuracy, integrity, transparency of financial reports, budgeting, cost control, revenue recognition, and financial risks.

3. Operational & Performance Audit

Audit key operational areas including ERP projects, SDLC, cloud and managed services, procurement, vendor management, and contracts. Assess management performance against approved plans, budgets, timelines, and KPIs.

4. IT, ERP & Cybersecurity Audit

Evaluate controls over ERP systems, financial systems, cloud platforms, and IT infrastructure. Assess cybersecurity, access controls, data integrity, system availability, change management, and IT governance risks.

5. Data Privacy & Information Security Compliance

Assess compliance with national regulations and applicable international data protection standards. Review data privacy governance, confidentiality controls, and breach response mechanisms.

6. Risk-Based Internal Audit Planning

Develop and execute Board-approved annual and multi-year risk-based audit plans. Identify and prioritize financial, operational, technological, legal, and reputational risks.

7. Advisory Role to the Board

Provide independent risk-based advisory services to the Board and Audit Committee, supporting decision-making on major investments, technology transitions, new business models, partnerships, and expansions.

8. Fraud, Ethics & Culture Audit

Lead fraud prevention, detection, and investigations. Assess ethical standards, corporate culture, tone at the top, accountability, and compliance culture.

9. Reporting & Follow-Up

Prepare clear and actionable audit reports for the Board and Audit Committee, including quarterly internal audit reports and follow-up on management actions.

Requirements

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or Management

· Professional certifications such as CIA, CISA, or CFE are an advantage

· 3–5 years of relevant experience in internal or external auditing, accounting, or risk management

· Strong knowledge of internal controls, risk assessment, and auditing standards

· Excellent analytical, reporting, and communication skills

· High ethical standards and professional integrity

title: Production & Design Engineer (Workshop Lead)
description:
ARE YOU A DESIGNER WHO ISN'T AFRAID TO GET YOUR HANDS DIRTY?
This is not an office job. Antenna Manufacturing is looking for a hands-on engineer to lead our workshop floor. We need a leader who can take a customer order, create the 3D design, and then personally lead the fabrication, welding, and assembly to bring the machine to life.

If you are tired of being stuck at a desk or just following orders, this is your chance to own the entire production process and build a department your way.

WHAT YOU WILL DO (Your Daily Mission):

1. Design & Innovation:

·         Develop comprehensive machine designs from part modeling to assembly using SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and Fusion 360.

·         Program and operate our machinery to create precision parts.

2. Fabrication, Welding & Assembly (Hands-On):

·         Read technical drawings and lead the hands-on fabrication and welding of machine frames and components.

·         Personally assemble mechanical parts (gearboxes, motors, shafts, bearings).

·         Perform electrical wiring for control panels (Single & 3-Phase motors, VFDs).

3. Leadership & Problem Solving:

·         Lead the Workshop Team: Manage and train a small team of junior welders and helpers on the factory floor.

·         Be the Expert: When a machine has a problem, you are the one who diagnoses it and fixes it on the spot.

·         Manage Materials: You will be responsible for identifying and selecting the correct steel, angle iron, and parts needed for each job.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

·         Education: BSc Degree in Electro-Mechanical Engineering (Manufacturing Stream preferred). A TVET Diploma with extensive experience will also be considered.

·         Experience: 3-5 years of direct experience in a machinery manufacturing workshop.

·         Must-Have Practical Skills:

o    Expert in SolidWorks or a similar 3D design software.

o    Advanced Welding and Fabrication skills.

o    Proven ability to assemble and wire industrial machinery.

·         Leadership Potential: A desire to lead projects and a team.

WHAT WE OFFER:

·         The opportunity to be the leader of the workshop and a core part of the company's growth.

·         A professional, structured work environment that values work-life balance (standard 8-hour workday).

A highly competitive salary that rewards your practical skills and leadership.

title: ERP Project Manager
description:
Job description

Ashewa Technology is seeking a results-driven ERP Project Manager to lead and deliver strategic ERP projects. The ideal candidate will manage end-to-end project delivery, align stakeholders, and ensure timely execution within budget. Strong ERP implementation experience, agile expertise, and excellent leadership skills are required.

Job Title…........ ERP Project Manager

Work Unit/Team….. Technology & Engineering

Reporting to…........ Program Manager/Project Director/CTO

General Duties and Responsibilities:

As a Project Manager, you are accountable for end-to-end delivery of strategic projects, ensuring that business goals are achieved on time and within budget. You will lead cross-functional teams, manage risks, optimize resources, and drive project governance and stakeholder alignment. Strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills are critical to your role.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities:

· Develop comprehensive project plans and timelines.

· Coordinate internal teams and third-party resources.

· Monitor budget, scope, and risk to ensure project success.

· Manage stakeholder expectations and communication.

· Lead sprint reviews, retrospectives, and agile ceremonies.

· Ensure proper documentation, delivery readiness, and closure.

· Organize and setup the kick off meetings.

· Monitor progress, resolve issues, and ensure project milestones are meet.

· Plan and coordinate product launches, including internal readiness and go-to-market strategies.

· Analyze user behavior, KPIs, and customer feedback to improve product performance.

· Translate business and customer needs into user stories, use cases, and

acceptance criteria.

· Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and propose improvements or automation opportunities. Gather and document detailed functional and non-functional requirements.

· Coordinate with developers, sales teams, designers, QA engineers, and marketers to ensure smooth workflow.

· Facilitate agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning) with scrum masters or him/her self.

· Track and manage resource allocation and performance.

· Serve as the point of contact for internal teams and external stakeholders.

· Prepare and present project updates, risk reports, and timelines to senior leadership.

· Manage project documentation, including plans, status reports, and post-project reviews.

· Ensure deliverables meet defined quality standards, user expectations, and business goals.

· Assist with UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and ensure timely deployment.

· Recommend and implement improvements to project processes and workflows.

· Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

Requirment

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or related field

• PMP/PRINCE2 certification required

• 3–5 years’ experience delivering ERP or enterprise-level technology projects

• Strong command of project planning, scope control, budgeting, and execution

• Solid understanding of ERP modules (Finance, HR, Supply Chain, Procurement, CRM)

• Hands-on experience with requirement gathering, process mapping, UAT, data migration, and go-live readiness

• Ability to lead cross-functional teams including developers, functional consultants, QA, and DevOps

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to manage stakeholders and act as SPOC

• Proficient in Agile/Scrum and tools like Jira, Confluence, Git, and Google Workspace

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset; proactive risk and change management

• Knowledge of security, data integrity, and compliance best practices in ERP environments

title: Planning and Monitoring Expert
description:
The Planning and Monitoring Expert is the strategic architect and execution engine of Ashewa Technology Solution S.C. This role bridges the gap between high-level corporate vision and daily operational execution by institutionalizing the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) framework. With a primary mandate to drive target achievement in Sales and Marketing, the Expert ensures that all departments including Technology, HR, and Finance are scientifically aligned, equipped with ERP tools, and synchronized to support revenue generation, market expansion, and organizational efficiency.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

1. High-Priority Sales & Marketing Alignment

• Revenue-Focused Planning: Collaborate intensely with Sales and Marketing leads to translate annual revenue targets into monthly, actionable lead-generation and conversion plans.

• Funnel Monitoring: Design specific KPIs to track the health of the marketing-to-sales funnel, ensuring marketing spend is directly fueling sales output.

• Market-Driven Adjustments: Provide rapid, evidence-based evaluation of campaigns, enabling the company to pivot strategies based on real-time performance data.

2. Enterprise-Wide BSC Leadership & Strategic Alignment

• Holistic Strategy Translation: Lead the design and management of the company-wide Balanced Scorecard across all four perspectives (Financial, Customer, Internal Process, and Learning & Growth).

• Cascading Objectives: Ensure that Technology, HR, and Finance initiatives are directly synchronized with the growth targets of Sales and the roadmaps of the Technology team.

• Cross-Functional Synergy: Ensure even back-office roles have SMART KPIs that reflect their contribution to the company's strategic health.

3. ERP-Driven Monitoring & Reporting

• System Integration & Power Usage: Act as the primary expert for the ERP system, automating data collection to ensure performance monitoring is real-time and single-source-of-truth based.

• Standardized Reporting: Develop and maintain reporting templates for executive management.

• Scientific Evaluation: Conduct rigorous variance and root-cause analysis to identify execution gaps and recommend corrective actions.

4. Capacity Building: Training the End-Employee

• Democratizing Planning: Train employees to create their own work plans and track KPIs.

• Accountability Coaching: Equip staff and managers to move from passive reporting to active execution.

5. Cross-Departmental Oversight & Improvement

• Resource & Delivery Sync: Monitor Finance disbursements and HR recruitment to support Sales and Technology priorities.

• Continuous Learning: Facilitate quarterly strategy review meetings to provide data-driven insights.

Required Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Economics, or related field.

• Experience: 5–7 years of experience in strategic planning, monitoring, and evaluation.

• Sector Experience: Experience in a Technology company.

• ERP Expertise: Proven proficiency in ERP systems.

• Strategic Literacy: Strong understanding of sales cycles, marketing funnels, and growth metrics.

title: Senior Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
1.     Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Graphic Designer & Video Editor to lead the creation of high-quality visual assets across digital and print channels. This role requires strong design fundamentals, professional video editing capability, and disciplined production workflows to ensure consistent brand execution across all platforms. The ideal candidate combines creative excellence with technical accuracy and efficient delivery.

2.     Key Responsibilities

@ Design & Brand Execution

  Design high-fidelity visual assets for digital and print media, including social media graphics, web banners, sales collateral, presentations, and brand identity materials.

  Ensure all creative outputs strictly adhere to established brand guidelines, including typography, color systems, layout standards, and tone of voice.

  Develop design concepts, mood boards, and visual directions for complex projects and secure stakeholder approval prior to full production.

  Maintain visual consistency and quality across all customer-facing touchpoints.

@ Video Production & Post-Production

  Edit and produce professional video content by cutting, sequencing, and pacing footage to deliver polished outputs.

  Optimize videos for multiple platforms, including YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, and internal or broadcast use, ensuring correct formats and aspect ratios.

  Perform essential audio post-production, including noise reduction, dialogue leveling, and integration of licensed or royalty-free music and sound effects.

  Create and integrate animated titles, lower thirds, transitions, and simple motion graphics to enhance clarity and engagement.

@ Production Planning & Quality Control

  Conduct thorough pre-production planning, including shot lists, scripts, and visual references, to reduce revision cycles and prevent unnecessary re-shoots.

  Perform detailed technical quality checks on all deliverables, ensuring correct color grading, resolution, frame rates, and export settings per platform.

  Maintain a structured file management system for all raw assets and final exports to ensure long-term accessibility and efficient collaboration.

3.     Required Qualifications

  Proven professional experience in graphic design and video editing with a strong portfolio demonstrating both disciplines.

  Advanced proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, , Photoshop, Illustrator, or equivalent professional software.

  Strong understanding of visual design principles, including composition, typography, color theory, and motion.

  Ability to manage multiple projects independently while meeting deadlines and maintaining high quality standards.

  Strong attention to detail, organization, and production discipline.

4.     Nice to Have

  Experience working with brands, agencies, or marketing teams.

  Motion graphics or basic 2D/3D animation experience.

  Familiarity with platform-specific content optimization and digital media best practices.

title: Call Center Agent
description:
Job Description – Call Center Agent

Role Summary

The Call Center Agent is responsible for handling customer calls, managing orders, providing product information, and ensuring professional, timely, and accurate service.

Key Responsibilities

6 working hours from Monday to Sunday, 8:00 am–5:00 pm on a rotational shift
Handle inbound/outbound calls professionally with clear, polite communication.
Use product knowledge, order history, and customer data to guide conversations.
Log all customer interactions accurately in the CRM.
Coordinate dispatch tasks, follow up on unanswered calls, and manage group messages.
Manage objections calmly and provide appropriate solutions.
Confirm orders correctly, including product details, delivery information, and changes.
Document feedback, complaints, and issues; escalate recurring problems to the manager.
Work collaboratively with the team and support new members.
Take ownership of performance and adapt to operational needs.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·       Monthly Sales Target Achievement: Meet or exceed the minimum monthly sales target through outbound and inbound calls.

·       Product Sales Performance: Drive sales of slow-moving items, promotional products, and new product launches as directed by management.

·       Credit Access Promotion: Promote and facilitate credit access for eligible MSCs to encourage higher sales volume.

·       Call Handling Efficiency: Number of calls handled per shift and average call handling time.

·       Order Accuracy Rate: Percentage of error-free orders.

·       Conversion Rate: Ratio of successful orders to total calls.

·       Customer Satisfaction: Quality of customer feedback and complaint resolution.

·       Attendance & Punctuality: Adherence to schedule and reliability.

·       CRM Documentation Quality: Accuracy and completeness of recorded interactions.

·       Follow-Up Compliance: Timely updates on missed deliveries and pending cases.

·       Professional Conduct: Evaluation of communication, teamwork, and adherence to standards.

title: ሹፌር
description:
የስራ መደብ አጭር መግለጫ

ሹፌር የስራ መደብ ላይ የተመደበ ሰራተኛ የደንበኞችን ትዕዛዝ በሰዓቱ እና በጥሩ ሁኔታ ለደንበኞች ለማድረስ የተረከበውን ተሽከርካሪ በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ የማስኬድ ሃላፊነት አለበት። ሚናው መደበኛ የተሽከርካሪ ፍተሻዎችን ማካሄድ፣ ምርቶችን መጫን እና ማራገፍ፣  የመንገድ አጠቃቀም እና የነዳጅ መዝገቦችን መጠበቅን ያካትታል።  በተጨማሪም ሁሉንም የትራፊክ እና የኩባንያ ደህንነት ደንቦችን በመከተል ቀልጣፋ አገልግሎትን ከመጋዘን እና ሎጅስቲክስ ዲሊቨሪ ሽያጭ ሰራተኞች ቡድኖች ጋር በቅርበት ያስተባብራል። የስራ መደቦች ከታች የተዘረዘሩት በተጨማሪሌሎች በስራ ላይ ሂደት ላይ በቅርብ አለቃው የሚሰጠውን ህጋዊ ትዕዛዝ የሚፈጽም ይሆናል።

ቁልፍ የስራ መደብ ዝርዝር ሃላፊነቶች

1. በሰዓት መገኘት እና የስምሪት ስራ ዝግጅት

በስራ ሰዓት ከጠዋቱ 7፡00 ሰዓት ላይ በስራ መደብ ቦታ ላይ መገኘት።
በየቀኑ የቅድመ-ጉዞ እና የድህረ-ጉዞ ተሽከርካሪ ፍተሻዎችን (መብራቶች, ጎማዎች, ነዳጅ, ዘይት) ይመልከቱ ያጠናቀቁ።
ሹፌር እና ዲሊቨሪ ሽያጭ ሰራተኛ እንዳመጣጣቸው ወደ መጋዘን በተገባበት ቅደም ተከተል መሰረት ትዕዛዞችን መጫን እና የእቃ መረከቢያ ሰነድ መፈረም።
የተመደበውን ዕለታዊ የመንገድ ስምሪት ይገምግሙ ያረጋግጡ።.
2. የስምሪት አፈፃፀም

ሁሉንም የትራፊክ ህጎች እና የኩባንያ የማሽከርከር ፖሊሲዎችን በመከተል የማጓጓዣ መኪናዎችን በደህና ያንቀሳቅሱ።
ማንኛውንም ሜካኒካል ጉዳዮች ወዲያውኑ ለሎጂስቲክስ/ጥገና ቡድን ያሳውቁ።
ተሽከርካሪው ንፁህ፣ በደንብ የተጠበቀ እና በማንኛውም ጊዜ ለመንገድ ተስማሚ መሆኑን ያረጋግጡ።
በተቆጣጣሪው ካልፀደቀ በስተቀር የጸደቀውን የመንገድ ስምሪት በትክክል መከተል አለመቀየር።
ከተቀመጠላቸው የምሳ ሰዓት በስተቀር የስምሪት ሰዓት ፕሮግራም በመከተል ከጠዋቱ 1፡00 እስከ ቀኑ 10:00 ድረስ ቢያንስ አንድ ስሚሪት ከበዛ አራት ስምሪት ተመድቦ ይሰራል።
3. የምርት አያያዝ

ሰራተኛው መኪናው ላይ ተጫነውን ማጫውን ንብረት እና ምርቶችን በተገቢው መንገድ እና በጥንቃቄ መያዝ ይጠበቅበታል።

4. የደንበኛ አያያዝ

በአክብሮት የታገዘ ሙያዊ አገልግሎት የመስጠት ግዴታ
የደንበኞች አስተያየት፣ ስጋቶችን እና ማሻሻያ ምክሮችን ሰብስቦ ለተቆጣጣሪው ማሳወቅ
ለደንበኛው እንዳልተገኝ ሪፖርት ከማድረግ በፊት እቃዎችን ለማስረከብ በዲሊቨሪ ሽያጭ ሰራተኛ ምሪት መሰረት ቢያንስ ሁለት ጊዜ ሙከራ ማድረግ ጋር ይኖርበታል
5. እቃዎቸንን መመለስ እና ሪፖርት ማድረግ

የስምሪት የቀን ውሎ ስራን ሪፖርት ከዲሊቨሪ ሰራተኛ ጋር መነሆን ለተቆጣጣሪ ማቅረብ

የቀኑ ዲሊቨሪ ቦታዎች ወይም የደንበኞች ብዛት
የቀኑ የእቃዎች አጠቃላይ ክብደት
በቀኑ ስምሪት የተሸፈነው ከ.ሜ.
በቀን ውስጥ የነበሩ መዘግየቶች እና አጥጋቢ ምክንያቶታቸው ዝርዝር
የነዳጅ አጠቃቀምን ይመዝግቡ እና ተሽከርካሪ መግቢያ ማጠቃለል
6. ተገዢነት እና ደህንነት

ሁል ጊዜ የጂፒየስ ዳሰሳ እና ቅጽበታዊ መንገድ ማሻሻያ ይጠቀሙ
ያልተፈቀዱ የመንገድ ለውጦችን ወይም መዘግየቶችን ያስወግዱ
ቁልፍ የአፈጻጸም አመላካች ነጥቦች (KPIs)

የደንበኞች ሽፋን: ቢያንስ በእለታዊ ስምሪት 25 ደንበኞችን ማዳረስ
ስምሪት ማጠናቀቅ፡ የቀኑን ስምሪት በሰዓቱ ጠንቅቆ ማድረስ
የቀን ርቀት ሽፋን፡ በቀን ቢያንስ 25ኪ.ሜ መሸፈን
ክብደታቸው 10ኩንታል መጫን በታች ለሆኑ መኪኖች ላይ ለሚመደቡ ሰራተኞች ከመጋዘን መውጫ ሰዓት ጊዜ፡ ከጠዎቱ 1 ሰዓት እስከ 2 ሰዓት በፊት መነሳት
ቅልጥፍና፡ ምንም የዲሊቨሪ ስህቶቶችን እንያይኖሩ ፣ ትክክለኛ የትዕዛዝ አያያዝ እና ትክክለኛ የሂሳብ ደረሰኞችን እና ሰነዶችን መያዝ
ማበረቻቻ

ሹፌር ሰራተኛ በስራ አፈጻጸም ላይ የተመሰረቱ ማበረታቻ ይኖረዋል

·      የቀን ስምሪት የእቃዎችን ክብደት ወይም ሸክም የተቀመጡ ግቦችን ማሳካት

·      በስራ ሰዓት መገኝት ብሎም ጭኖ ቀድሞ መውጣት

·      በቀን ውስጥ ከ30 ደንበኞች በላይ በስምሪት ሽፋንን መስጠት

·      የተቀመጡ የቀን ኪ.ሜ ግብ መምታት

 

መስፈርቶች

1. የስራ ቀን ከሰኞ እስከ እሁድ ሲሆን በተመደበዉ የስራ መርሐግብር መሰረት በሳምንት ስድስት ቀን የሚሰራ ይሆናል።

2. ስራ ሚጀመረዉ ከጠዋቱ 12፡30 (6፡30 AM) ይሆናል።

3. የስራ ቦታ ቃሊቲ ሲሆን ለሰዓት ሲባል አመልካች በቅርብ ርቀት የሚኖር አለበት።

4. ደሞዝ እና ተጨማሪ ጥቅማጥቅሞች በድርጅቱ ስኬል (ደረጃ) መሰረት ይሆናል

5. አመልካች ዋስ ማቅረብ የሚችል መሆን አለበት። ከተች የተተቀሱትን በማሟላት ወደ ዋስ ማቅረብ ያስፈልጋል።

1. የአመልካች ፋይዳ መታወቂያ

2. የዋስ ፋይዳ መታወቂያ

3. የዋስ ደብዳቤ ከመንግስት ወይም ከግል ድርጅት መጻፍ ይኖርበታል። ከግል ድርጅት ከሆነ ዋስ የሚሆነዉ ግለሰብ በ30000 ብር እና በላይ የተቀጠረ መሆን አለበት።

4. ዋስ የሚሆነው ግለሰብ ያገባ/ያላገባ ምስክር ወረቀት ያስፈልጋል

5. ዋስ የሚሆነው ግለሰብ 300,000 ብር ድረስ ዋስ እንደሚሆን የሚጠቅስ ደብዳቤ በአካል ተገኝቶ መፈረም አለበት።

title: TikTok Host / Social Media Host
description:
Role Overview

YayeTech Technologies is seeking a confident and professional TikTok / Social Media Host to represent the company on camera. The role focuses on presenting company services, engaging audiences through short-form video content, and maintaining a strong brand presence across social media platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Appear on camera for TikTok and social media videos
Present and explain YayeTech Technologies’ services clearly and professionally
Participate in promotional and brand awareness content
Follow content scripts or guidance provided by the marketing team
Maintain a consistent and professional brand image
Attend scheduled recording sessions three (3) days per week
Qualifications & Skills

Strong on camera presence and communication skills
Confidence speaking in front of a camera
Basic understanding of TikTok and social media trends
Professional appearance and attitude
Reliability and punctuality
Employment Terms

Part-time engagement (3 days per week)
Performance and availability reviewed periodically
Application Process

Interested candidates should submit:

A short introduction video (preferred) to telegram @yayetech

title: Mechanical Support Engineer
description: Diagnosing issues with machinery and equipment, performing repairs, and ensuring optimal functioning. Assisting in the designing and modification of systems and components, including creating technical drawings, specifications, and machine parts. Troubleshooting, diagnostics, and resolving mechanical and electromechanical issues in our machinery and systems. Use diagnostic tools to analyze and troubleshoot problems Assist in the routine maintenance and inspection of equipment and machinery. Provide technical support to other team members or departments. Maintain records of maintenance activities, repairs, and modifications. Assist in updating technical manuals and operational procedures Participate in cross-functional teams for projects and improvements. Collaborate with technical and production teams to create smooth relations. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering. 0 - 4 years of experience in a similar role. Knowledge of mechanical drawings and industrial components Knowledge of workshop tools and mechanical machine elements Knowledge of MS Office, job-related software, and communication apps. Flexibility in working hours and availability for emergency calls. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills and proficiency in the English language. Understanding of hydraulic and pneumatic systems (advantageous). Experience with welding and lathe machine techniques (advantageous). Lives or willing to live in Bishoftu Salary: As per the company scale

title: Architect
description:
Mella Creatives is seeking for a talented and experienced Architect and Visual Expert to join

our growing team. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of architectural principles,

as well as a keen eye for detail and a passion for creating visually stunning designs.

የሥራ ማስታወቂያ፡ የሕፃን ተንከባካቢ (በቤት ውስጥ)

የሥራ መደቡ፦ የቤት ውስጥ ሕፃን ተንከባካቢ

የሥራ ሰዓት፦ ከሰኞ እስከ ቅዳሜ፣ ከጠዋቱ 1:00 ሰዓት እስከ ምሽቱ 12:00 ሰዓት

መስፈርቶች

• ትምህርት፦ ቢያንስ በጤና ነክ ዘርፎች (ነርሲንግ፣ ሚድዋይፈሪ ወዘተ) ወይም በቤት ውስጥ እንክብካቤ (Home Care) ዲፕሎማ ያለው/ላት።

• ልምድ፦ በሕፃናት እንክብካቤ ላይ በቂ የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ላት።

• ባህሪ፦ የታመነ/ች፣ ታጋሽ፣ ሕፃናትን የሚወድ/ምትወድ እና ሰዓት አክባሪ።

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች

• ጤና እና አመጋገብ፦ የልጁን የምግብ ሰዓት ማስተካከል፣ አልሚ ምግቦችን/ጡጦ ማዘጋጀት፣ እንዲሁም የልጁን ንጽህና እና አጠቃላይ ጤንነት መጠበቅ።

• የልጅ እድገት ማነቃቂያ ጨዋታዎች፦ የልጁን የማሰብ እና የአካል ብቃት እድገት ለማገዝ እንደ እድሜው የሚመጥኑ ትምህርታዊ ጨዋታዎችን መጫወት፣ መጽሐፍትን ማንበብ እና የውጭ እንቅስቃሴዎችን ማድረግ።

• ደህንነት እና ክትትል፦ ለልጁ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እና ንጹህ አካባቢ መፍጠር፤ እንዲሁም የልጁን የጤና ሁኔታ (እንደ የሰውነት ሙቀት፣ የምግብ መፈጨት ወዘተ) መከታተል።

• የዕለት ተዕለት መርሃ ግብር፦ የተቀመጡ የእንቅልፍ እና የሌሎች ተግባራት መርሃ ግብሮችን በትክክል መከተል።

title: Junior HR Officer /Trainee
description:
Our company is seeking a dedicated, energetic, and highly detail-oriented Junior / Trainee HR Officer to join our Human Resources team. This position is primarily focused on HR paperwork, documentation, and administrative support , the ideal candidates who are organized, committed, and able to work accurately under routine tasks.

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining employee records, ensuring data accuracy, and supporting daily HR operations through proper documentation and filing.

Key Responsibilities:

·         Handle HR paperwork, filing systems, and documentation with high accuracy

·         Maintain and update employee records (physical and digital)

·         Prepare HR letters, forms, reports, and internal documents

·         Support recruitment and onboarding documentation processes

·         Assist with attendance, leave records, and personnel files

·         Ensure confidentiality and proper organization of all HR documents

·         Support the HR team with general administrative tasks

Required Skills & Competencies:

·         Strong attention to detail and accuracy

·         High level of commitment, responsibility, and reliability

·         Energetic and willing to handle routine and repetitive paperwork

·         Good organizational and time-management skills

·         Basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, email)

·         Good communication and interpersonal skills

·        Able to learn independently as well as through guidance from senior staff

·      make bale able to write Amharic and English fully competent  level

Qualifications:

· Degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Management, or a related field

· Fresh graduates with a business background (class of 2024 or 2025) are welcome to apply

·  Non-fresh graduates must have prior experience in administrative or HR-related roles

·  Applicants from non-related fields must have relevant HR experience ( if they have basic HR exposure or short-term HR experience advantage )

Additional Information:

·         This role requires patience, discipline, and consistency

·        Female applicants are strongly encouraged to apply

description:
የአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ ፡-

አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን ቀልጣፋ፣ የሥራ ተነሳሽነት ያላት ኃላፊነት የሚሰማት የጽዳትና ተላላኪ ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡  ስለሆነም ከዚህ በታች የተጠቀሱትን መስፈርቶች ማሟላት የምትችሉ አመልካቾች በሙሉ ማመልከት ትችላላችሁ።

መስፈርቶች፡-

· ሕጋዊ የሆነ እና የታደሰ መታወቂያ /ፋይዳ ያላት።

·  በተመሳሳይ ስራ መስክ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት  እና ከዚያ በላይ የስራ ልምድ ያላት፡፡

· የት/ት ደረጃ 10ኛ ክፍል እና ከዚያ በላይ ያጠናቀቀ/ች

· ታታሪ፣ ታዛዥ እና የስራ ስነ-ምግባር ያላት

· መልካም ግንኙነት እና ታማኝ የሆነች

· በቡድን መስራት የምትችል

· ሰፈሯ ጉርድ ሾላ አካባቢ የሆነች

የስራ ሁኔታ፡-

·  የሙሉ ጊዜ

·  ደሞወዝ በስምምነት

አመልካቾች፡-

• አግባብነት ያለው የት/ት ማስረጃ፣ የሥራ ልምድ እና ዋናውንና ኮፒውን በመያዝ በአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን በአካል ማቅረብም ሆነ በቴሌግራም /በአፍሪ ዎርክ/ በኩል CV መላክ ይችላሉ፡፡

የስራ አድራሻ፡-

• አዲስ አበባ አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ጉርድ ሾላ - ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  የትራፊክ መብራት  አካባቢ /መስቀለኛ ቦታ ላይ / ወይም (ከሳሊተ ምህረት እና ከፊጋ ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ የትራፊክ መብራት ላይ እንገኛለን)፡፡
