title: Emergency and Critical Care Nurse
description:
Emergency vs. Critical Care Nursing Roles

 

Overlapping Core Responsibilities

Regardless of the unit, both roles require a high level of emotional intelligence and technical skill:

Patient Advocacy: Being the voice for patients who are often unconscious or unable to speak for themselves.
Family Education: Translating complex medical jargon into something a terrified family member can understand during a crisis.
Meticulous Documentation: In a legal and clinical sense, "if it wasn't charted, it wasn't done."
Ethical Decision-Making: Assisting in difficult conversations regarding end-of-life care or "Do Not Resuscitate" (DNR) orders.
Note: Both roles are physically and emotionally demanding. Burnout is a real risk, making "self-care" a professional responsibility as much as any clinical task.
Ethio Tebib Hospital

title: GI Nurse
description:
1. Procedure Support (The Core)

Endoscopy Assistance: Helping physicians during procedures like colonoscopies, EGDs (upper endoscopies), and ERCPs.
Sedation Monitoring: Administering and monitoring conscious sedation, ensuring the patient’s vitals and airway stay stable throughout the procedure.
Specimen Handling: Collecting and labeling biopsies or polyps for lab analysis.
2. Patient Care & Assessment

Pre-Op Prep: Verifying patient history, ensuring "NPO" (nothing by mouth) status, and confirming that bowel preps were completed correctly.
Recovery Monitoring: Managing patients post-procedure as they wake up from sedation, checking for complications like bleeding or perforation.
Specialized Intubation: Inserting and managing Nasogastric (NG) tubes or assisting with PEG tube (feeding tube) placements.
3. Education & Coordination

Patient Teaching: Explaining complex prep instructions (which, let's be honest, are the hardest part for the patient) and post-procedure dietary restrictions.
Discharge Planning: Providing clear instructions on what symptoms to watch for at home.
Chronic Disease Management: Assisting patients with long-term conditions like Crohn’s disease, Ulcerative Colitis, or GERD.
4. Technical Skills

Scope Maintenance: Ensuring high-tech endoscopes are properly cleaned, sterilized, and functioning.
Medication Administration: Giving GI-specific meds, such as those for GI bleeds or bowel motility.

title: Junior Multimedia Designer
description: Job Title: Junior Multimedia Designer Department: Commercial Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Type of Employment: Full-Time Reports To: Marketing Specialist About Dodai: Dodai Manufacturing Plc (Dodai), is a recently incorporated organization launched in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on August 01, 2023. Dodai is a fast growing organization with a mission of making e-mobility accessible to everyone in Africa through its innovative products and services. Dodai plans to provide brand new electric two-wheelers by assembling them here in Addis Ababa and plans to expand to major regional cities in Ethiopia by the end of 2025. It’s thus looking to engage dynamic Ethiopian talent to ensure the achievement of its goals. Purpose of the Position: The Junior Multimedia Designer at Dodai supports the marketing team by creating engaging visual and multimedia content that strengthens the Dodai brand and boosts lead generation. This role contributes to the production of high-quality graphics, videos, animations, and digital assets that enhance brand visibility and support marketing campaigns. Responsibilities: Design and produce visual content for social media, websites, campaigns, and internal communications. Support photo and video shoots (setup, basic shooting, file handling). Ensure all designs follow brand guidelines and visual standards. Collaborate closely with Marketing, Content, and Brand teams to execute creative ideas. Prepare creatives for different platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, print, digital screens). Edit and retouch photos; apply basic color correction to videos. Manage, organize, and archive multimedia files and assets properly. Implement feedback from stakeholders and revise designs efficiently. Assist in developing storyboards and creative concepts. Research trends, formats, and competitor content to inspire new ideas. Support campaign rollouts, activations, and events with creative materials. Maintain consistency, quality, and timely delivery of all assigned tasks.

title: GI Nurse
description:
Job Description

1. Procedure Support (The Core)

Endoscopy Assistance: Helping physicians during procedures like colonoscopies, EGDs (upper endoscopies), and ERCPs.
Sedation Monitoring: Administering and monitoring conscious sedation, ensuring the patient’s vitals and airway stay stable throughout the procedure.
Specimen Handling: Collecting and labeling biopsies or polyps for lab analysis.
2. Patient Care & Assessment

Pre-Op Prep: Verifying patient history, ensuring "NPO" (nothing by mouth) status, and confirming that bowel preps were completed correctly.
Recovery Monitoring: Managing patients post-procedure as they wake up from sedation, checking for complications like bleeding or perforation.
Specialized Intubation: Inserting and managing Nasogastric (NG) tubes or assisting with PEG tube (feeding tube) placements.
3. Education & Coordination

Patient Teaching: Explaining complex prep instructions (which, let's be honest, are the hardest part for the patient) and post-procedure dietary restrictions.
Discharge Planning: Providing clear instructions on what symptoms to watch for at home.
Chronic Disease Management: Assisting patients with long-term conditions like Crohn’s disease, Ulcerative Colitis, or GERD.
4. Technical Skills

Scope Maintenance: Ensuring high-tech endoscopes are properly cleaned, sterilized, and functioning.
Medication Administration: Giving GI-specific meds, such as those for GI bleeds or bowel motility.

tofnesmermoh@gmail.com

title: የኤልአዲ ስክሪን ጥገና ባለሞያ (LED SCREEN MAINTENANCE)
description:
ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች (Key Responsibilities)

የፒክሰል እና ሞጁል ጥገና (Pixel and Module Repair):
ስክሪኑ ላይ ያሉ የሞቱ ወይም የተቃጠሉ ኤልኢዲዎችን (Dead Pixels/LED Lamps) በጥንቃቄ ለይቶ ማውጣት እና በአዲስ መቀየር።
የጥቃቅን ኤሌክትሮኒክስ መበየጃ መሳሪያዎችን (Soldering Station and Hot Air Gun) በመጠቀም የተበላሹ SMD (Surface Mount Device) ኤልኢዲዎችን መቀየር።
በኤልኢዲ ሞጁሎች ላይ የሚገኙ የተበላሹ ወይም በትክክል የማይሰሩ IC (Integrated Circuits)ቺፖችን መመርመር እና መቀየር።
የሃርድዌር ፍተሻ እና ጥገና (Hardware Maintenance):
የተበላሹ Receiving Cards እና Power Supply Units መጠገን ወይም መቀየር።
የሪቦን ገመዶችን (Ribbon Cables) እና የኮኔክተሮችን (Connectors) ደህንነት ማረጋገጥ እና አስፈላጊ ሲሆን መቀየር።
የተጠገኑ ሞጁሎች ከሌሎቹ የስክሪኑ ክፍሎች ጋር እኩል የሆነ የብሩህነት (Brightness) እና የከለር ጥራት (Color Uniformity) እንዳላቸው ማረጋገጥ።
ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች እና መስፈርቶች (Requirements)

Micro-soldering: እጅግ በጣም ጥቃቅን የሆኑ ኤሌክትሮኒክስ ክፍሎችን (SMD LEDs & ICs) በመበየድ የመጠገን የላቀ ክህሎት።
የመለኪያ መሳሪያዎችን (Multimeter) በመጠቀም የኤሌክትሪክ ፍሰትን እና የክፍሎቹን (Components) ደህንነት የመለካት ችሎታ።
ስለ ኤሌክትሮኒክስ ሰርክዩት (Electronic Circuitry) ጥልቅ እውቀት ያለው
የስራ ልምድ:

በሞባይል ጥገና፣ በቲቪ ጥገና ወይም በተለየ መልኩ በኤልኢዲ ስክሪን ሞጁል ጥገና (Chip-level Repair) ላይ ከ 3 አመት በላይ የሰራ።
የስራ ሰዓት

ከሰኞ እስከ ቅዳሜ ከ 3:00-1:00

Working knowledge of SketchUp, Rhino, and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign). Solid understanding of BIM standards, workflows, and coordination processes. Experience in producing construction-ready drawings and documentation. Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and design intent. Strong communication, coordination, and time-management skills. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

title: Knitting machine technician(operator)
description: Key Responsibilities & Duties 1. Machine Operation & Production: Operate and monitor multiple industrial knitting machines (e.g., from brands like Stoll, Shima Seiki, Mayer & Cie., etc.) during production runs. Load correct yarns (cones, beams) according to the production order. Start machines, observe operation, and ensure fabric is being produced to the required quality standard (gauge, stitch structure, width, weight). Perform efficient yarn tying (splicing) to minimize downtime during creel changes. Conduct regular quality checks on the produced fabric for defects such as drops, holes, barre, contamination, or tension issues. Maintain accurate production records (lengths, weights, downtime, efficiency). 2. Machine Setup & Changeover: • Read and interpret technical knitting orders, machine diagrams, and pattern instructions. Execute machine changeovers from one style/order to another, which may involve: Changing needles, sinkers, or other machine parts. Installing new pattern chains, discs, or loading electronic design files. Adjusting machine settings (stitch length/ cams, tension, speed, take-down). Changing yarn guides and feed systems. 3. Troubleshooting & Basic Maintenance: Identify the root cause of common machine stoppages and faults (e.g., yarn breaks, needle breaks, fabric bunching). Perform immediate corrective actions such as replacing broken needles, clearing yarn jams, and re-threading yarn paths. Conduct routine preventive maintenance as per schedules (cleaning, oiling, lubrication). Diagnose more complex mechanical or electronic issues and escalate to senior technicians or engineers.

title: Sales and customer service
description:
Job Title: Sales & Customer Service

Department: Sales

Reports to: Sales Manager

Job Summary:

Vertex business Group is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented female candidate for the role of Sales. This role involves accurately recording sales data in our ERP system while handling customer service. The ideal candidate will have strong multitasking skills and will play a key role in identifying and developing new business opportunities as well as building and maintaining strong relationships with customers.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer Service Assistance: Support client inquiries and ensure excellent customer relations and ensure client satisfaction.
Business Development: Identify and develop new business opportunities in the printing and technology sector.
Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with potential and existing customers.
Customer Needs Assessment: Understand customer needs and provide tailored solutions using our products and services.
Product Presentations: Conduct product presentations and demonstrations to showcase the benefits of our solutions.
Sales Target Achievement: Achieve and exceed sales targets by implementing effective sales strategies.
Proposal & Contract Preparation: Prepare and present quotations, proposals, and contracts to clients.
Sales Data Entry: Accurately input and maintain sales records in Vertex’s ERP system.
Coordination: Serve as a point of contact between the sales, finance, and management teams.
Marketing Collaboration: Collaborate with the marketing team to generate leads and enhance brand visibility.
Industry Awareness: Keep up-to-date with industry trends and competitors to refine sales strategies.
Sales Reporting: Maintain accurate records of sales activities and report progress to management.

Education: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Marketing, or a related field.
Experience: Prior experience in sales, sales administration, office coordination, or data entry is preferred.
Technical Skills: Familiarity with ERP systems (training provided) and proficiency in Microsoft Office & google products.
Attention to Detail: Strong accuracy in data handling and record-keeping.
Communication & Organizational Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication with the ability to multitask.
Proactive & Growth-Oriented Mindset: Willingness to take initiative and advance within the company.
Working Conditions:

Work Environment: Office-based role with collaboration with internal teams.
Work Tools: Use Vertex’s ERP system to track sales data, reports, and customer interactions.
Work Hours: Full-time, standard office hours with occasional flexibility if needed.
Benefits of Joining Vertex Business Group:

Competitive Salary: Fixed salary with potential for performance-based incentives.
Training & Development: Access to resources and mentorship.
Supportive Work Environment: Work in a collaborative, team-oriented setting.
NB: Vertex encourages applications from qualified female candidates

About Vertex Business Group:

Vertetex Business Group is a leading multi-service company with operations in Addis Ababa. We specialize in branding, printing, packaging, import/export, marketing, providing innovative, high-impact solutions tailored to meet the diverse needs of our clients

title: Civil CAD Designer / Civil Engineering Technologist
description:
Civil CAD Designer / Civil Engineering Technologist (Remote – Contract/Freelance)

Location: Remote
Job Type: Contract / Freelance (Private Clients)
Schedule: Flexible, project-based

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Civil CAD Designer / Civil Engineering Technologist to support private civil engineering projects on a remote, project-by-project basis. This role involves preparing and revising detailed 2D and 3D civil drawings while collaborating closely with engineers and multidisciplinary teams.

Responsibilities
• Develop and revise 2D and 3D civil design drawings for infrastructure projects including roads, highways, tunnels, drainage, grading, and utilities.
• Ensure all drawings comply with municipal, provincial, and federal standards, as well as established drafting procedures.
• Collaborate with engineers to interpret design intent, technical markups, and field revisions.
• Assist with quantity take-offs, plan and profile drawings, and construction details.
• Maintain organized drawing files and documentation throughout all project phases.
• Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure accuracy and consistency across drawings.
• Perform civil design tasks as required by project scope.

Qualifications
• Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering Technology, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
• 2+ years of experience producing civil engineering drawings for infrastructure projects.
• Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D (AutoCAD required; MicroStation is an asset).
• Strong understanding of civil design standards and drafting practices.
• Ability to accurately interpret engineering drawings and technical markups.
• Experience with alignments, profiles, surfaces, grading, and utilities.
• Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Ability to work independently and remotely while meeting deadlines.
• Clear communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
• Must have access to a reliable laptop/desktop computer and licensed civil design software required to perform the work (e.g., AutoCAD Civil 3D).

What We Offer
• 100% remote work
• Flexible hours
• Opportunity to work with private clients on diverse civil projects
• Competitive, project-based compensation
• Long-term collaboration opportunities for the right candidate

How to Apply

Please send:
• A brief introduction
• Your resume
• Examples of relevant civil CAD work (if available)

Contact telegram: @basmane21

title: Logistics Officer
description:
Overview

The Logistics Officer will be responsible for managing the seamless and efficient flow of coffee from the warehouse or processing unit to the final customer destination across international markets. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of export procedures, international shipping, and documentation.

 

Key Responsibilities

1. Shipping and Export Operations

Coordinate and manage all aspects of coffee export logistics, including booking freight (container shipping, air cargo) and selecting optimal shipping lines/carriers based on cost and service.
Monitor and track shipments from origin to destination, proactively communicating any delays or issues to relevant internal and external stakeholders.
Ensure all coffee handling, storage, and transportation comply with international food safety standards and specific customer requirements.
2. Documentation and Compliance

Prepare, review, and process all necessary export documentation, including Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin (COO), Phytosanitary Certificates, Bills of Lading (B/L), and other customs/regulatory forms.
Ensure full compliance with destination country import regulations, customs procedures, and international trade laws (e.g., Incoterms, HS Codes).
Maintain an organized filing system for all shipping documents and records for auditing purposes.
3. Stakeholder Management

Act as the primary point of contact for freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, warehouse/port authorities, and inspection agents.
Coordinate with the Sales/Trading team to align shipping schedules with sales contracts and customer delivery deadlines.
Liaise with the Warehouse/Quality Control team to ensure the timely readiness and accurate loading of coffee containers.
4. Cost Management and Reporting

Assist in negotiating freight rates and logistics service contracts to optimize shipping costs.
Verify and process logistics-related invoices (freight, inspection, documentation, handling) to ensure accuracy and timely payment.
Prepare and maintain detailed reports on logistics activities, shipping status, costs, and performance metrics.
Required Qualifications

Experience:  o (zero) year of professional experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field.
Skills:

Proficiency in preparing and handling international shipping documents (B/L, Commercial Invoice, COO, etc.).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong computer skills, especially in MS Excel and logistics/ERP software.
Competencies

Detail-Oriented: Exceptional attention to accuracy, particularly in documentation.
Problem-Solver: Ability to anticipate and quickly resolve logistics issues (e.g., port delays, documentation errors).
Organizational Skills: Proven ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously.
Negotiation: Basic negotiation skills for dealing with vendors and service providers.
Address: ALTA Computec Head Office, ALTA Building Ground floor Mexico Square, opposite Philips Building on the road to Balcha Hospital.

title: Reception
description:
Here are the key job responsibilities for a receptionist in a general hospital:

1. Patient Interaction & Customer Service

Greeting and Triage: Welcoming patients and visitors. Critically, the receptionist must be able to identify "red flag" symptoms (e.g., chest pain, difficulty breathing) to immediately alert the nursing staff.
Patient Check-in/Check-out: Registering new patients, updating personal information, and processing them out after their consultation.
Inquiry Handling: Answering questions about hospital services, visiting hours, and department locations.
Managing the Waiting Area: Ensuring the waiting room remains organized and monitoring patients who may be waiting a long time to ensure they haven't worsened.
2. Administrative & Data Management

Appointment Scheduling: Managing complex calendars for various departments and specialists.
Medical Records Management: Organizing, filing, and retrieving patient charts. In modern hospitals, this involves heavy use of Electronic Health Records (EHR).
Phone Management: Handling high volumes of calls, routing them to the correct wards or doctors, and taking accurate messages.
Data Entry: Entering patient demographics, medical history forms, and diagnostic codes into the system with 100% accuracy.
3. Financial & Insurance Coordination

Insurance Verification: Confirming patient coverage with providers (like insurance companies) before treatment begins.
Billing & Payments: Collecting co-payments, issuing receipts, and explaining basic hospital charges to patients or their families.
Documentation: Ensuring all consent forms and financial responsibility documents are signed and scanned.
4. Communication & Coordination

Internal Liaison: Acting as the communication hub between patients, doctors, nurses, and laboratory/radiology departments.
Paging: Operating the hospital paging system to call for medical codes (e.g., Code Blue) or locating specific staff members.
Mail & Deliveries: Managing incoming and outgoing mail, including laboratory results and medical supplies.
5. Compliance & Safety

Confidentiality (HIPAA/Data Privacy): Strictly maintaining patient privacy. A hospital receptionist must never discuss patient details in public areas.
Emergency Protocols: Following hospital safety drills (fire, mass casualty, or security threats).
Visitor Control: Monitoring who enters the hospital to ensure the safety of patients and staff.

title: Cafe Supervisor
description:
የቅርንጫፍ ሱፐርቫይዘሩ በቅርንጫፉ ውስጥ የሚከናወኑ የዕለት ተዕለት ሥራዎችን ያቅዳል፣ ያስተባብራል፣ ይመራል እንዲሁም ይቆጣጠራል። የሽያጭ ሂደቱ ቀልጣፋ መሆኑን፣ የሰው ኃይል በአግባቡ መሰማራቱን እና የደንበኞች እርካታ መጠበቁን የማረጋገጥ ኃላፊነት አለበት።

የብቃት መመዘኛ (Qualification)

1. የትምህርት ዝግጅት (Education)

በሆቴል ማኔጅመንት (Hotel Management)፣ በማኔጅመንት (Management)፣ በአካውንቲንግ (Accounting)፣ በምግብ ዝግጅት (Food Preparation) ወይም በተመሳሳይ የትምህርት መስክ የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ (BA) ወይም ዲፕሎማ ያለው/ላት።

2. የሥራ ልምድ (Experience)

በተጠቀሱት የትምህርት መስኮች ከተመረቀ/ች በኋላ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት እና ከዚያ በላይ አግባብነት ያለው የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ላት።

በሱፐርቫይዘርነት ወይም በቡድን መሪነት የሠራ/ች ቢሆን ይመረጣል።

3. ልዩ ክህሎት (Special Skills)

ስለ ምግብ ዝግጅትና ጥራት ቁጥጥር በቂ እውቀት ያለው/ላት።

መሰረታዊ የሂሳብ አያያዝ (Accounting) እና የክምችት ቁጥጥር (Inventory Management) መረዳት ያለው/ላት።

የቡድን አመራር እና የሰዓት አጠቃቀም ችሎታ።

ዝርዝር ተግባራትና ኃላፊነቶች (Detailed Responsibilities)

1. የአስተዳደርና የሰው ኃይል አመራር

በቅርንጫፉ ያሉ ሠራተኞችን የሥራ ድርሻና ፕሮግራም (Schedule) ያወጣል፤ ያለፈቃድ የሥራ ሰዓት እንዳይለዋወጡ ይቆጣጠራል።

የሠራተኞችን አቴንዳንስ (የሥራ ሰዓት)፣ እርፍጅትና ቀሪዎችን በመከታተል በቅጽ መዝግቦ ሪፖርት ያደርጋል።

የሥራ ብዛት በሚኖርበት ወቅት (ቅዳሜ፣ እሁድና በዓላት) በቂ የሰው ኃይል እንዲኖር አስቀድሞ ያቅዳል።

አዲስ ሠራተኞች ሲቀጠሩ ገለፃ (Orientation) ይሰጣል፤ የሙከራ ጊዜ የሥራ አፈጻጸም ምዘናና የየስድስት ወሩን የሠራተኞች ውጤት ሞልቶ ለሰው ሀብት ክፍል ያቀርባል።

በሠራተኞች የሥነ-ምግባርና የንፅህና ጉድለቶች ላይ የእርምት እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ከአስተዳደር ክፍሉ ጋር ግንኙነት ያደርጋል።

2. የሽያጭና የክምችት (Stock) ቁጥጥር

ለሽያጭ የሚቀርቡ ኬኮች በቁጥርና በአይነት ዲስፕሌይ (Display) መሙላታቸውን ያረጋግጣል፤ እጥረት እንዳይኖር ይከታተላል።

በየዕለቱ ጠዋት መገልገያ መሣሪያዎች መቆጠራቸውንና መመዝገባቸውን ያረጋግጣል።

ከዕለት ሽያጭ በኋላ የቀሩ ጥሬ ዕቃዎችን፣ የበሰሉ ምርቶችንና ሌሎች መጠጦችን ቆጥሮ በመመዝገብ ለሚቀጥለው ተረኛ ያስረክባል።

ማንኛውንም የዲስፕሌይ ግድፈት ለኦፕሬሽን ኃላፊ በጽሁፍ ሪፖርት ያደርጋል።

3. የደንበኞች አገልግሎትና የትዕዛዝ አያያዝ

የ"ቴክ አዌይ" (Take away) ትዕዛዞችን በጥንቃቄ ይቀበላል፤ በወቅቱ መፈጸማቸውን ይከታተላል።

ትዕዛዞች በሰዓቱ ካልደረሱ ተጠያቂውን አካል ለይቶ ሪፖርት ያደርጋል።

የደንበኞችን ቅሬታ በመቀበል መፍትሄ ይሰጣል፤ ከአቅም በላይ ሲሆን ለሚመለከተው አካል ያስተላልፋል።

4. የጥራትና የንፅህና ቁጥጥር

የማምረቻ መሣሪያዎች በአግባቡ መያዛቸውንና በየጊዜው መጽዳታቸውን ይከታተላል።

ተመርቶ የሚወጣው ኬክ መጠን በትዕዛዙ መሠረት መሆኑን ያረጋግጣል።

በኬክ ማከማቻ (Inventory) ውስጥ የበረራ ተባይ መድኃኒት በየጊዜው መረጨቱን ይከታተላል።

5. የሪፖርትና የትርፍ ሰዓት ቁጥጥር

የሰው ኃይል እጥረት ሲያጋጥም ተተኪ እንዲዘጋጅ በአስቸኳይ ሪፖርት ያደርጋል።

የትርፍ ሰዓት ሥራ (Overtime) አስፈላጊ ሆኖ ሲገኝ ከኃላፊ ያስፈቅዳል፤ ተገቢውን ፎርም ሞልቶ በየሳምንቱ ለሰው ሀብት ክፍል ይልካል።

Strong knowledge of Ethiopian tax laws and ERA procedures

High level of integrity, accuracy, and confidentiality
Ability to work independently and handle external assignments

Strong attention to detail and accountability
Excellent time management and multitasking skills

Compliance-focused and organized mindset
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

description:
ስራ መደቡ፡ ቀለም ቀቢ (Painter)

የስራ መግለጫ

ድርጅታችን በማስታወቂያ እና/ወይም በእንጨት ስራ ዘርፍ የተሰማራ ሲሆን፣ በቀለም ቅብ ስራ ላይ ልምድ ያለው፣ በዋነኝነት ኮምፕሬሰር (Spray Gun) በመጠቀም ቀለም መቀባት የሚችል፣ ለጥራት ከፍተኛ ትኩረት የሚሰጥ እና በቡድን መስራት የሚችል ቀለም ቀቢ (painter) ለመቅጠር ይፈልጋል።
በተለይም ከዚህ በፊት በማስታወቂያ ድርጅት ወይም በእንጨት ስራ ድርጅት ውስጥ የሰራ እጩ ተመራጭ ይሆናል።

ዋና ተግባራት

የማስታወቂያ፣ የእንጨትና የብረት አወቃቀሮችን በኮምፕሬሰር (Spray Gun) በመጠቀም በጥራት መቀባት

የኮምፕሬሰርና የSpray Gun መሳሪያዎችን በአግባቡ መጠቀምና መጠበቅ

title: H.R Officer
description: Department: Human Resources Reports To: General Manager / HR Manager Job Summary The Human Resources Officer is responsible for managing and supporting all HR functions of the hotel, ensuring effective recruitment, employee relations, compliance with labor laws, staff development, and a positive workplace culture. The role supports hotel operations by ensuring the right people are hired, trained, motivated, and retained to deliver excellent guest service. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end recruitment, selection, and onboarding of hotel staff Maintain employee records, contracts, attendance, and personnel files Administer payroll inputs, leave management, and staff benefits Ensure compliance with labor laws, hotel policies, and internal procedures Handle employee relations issues, grievances, and disciplinary processes Coordinate staff training, orientation, and performance appraisal processes Support department heads with workforce planning and staffing needs Promote a positive work environment and high employee engagement Implement HR policies, procedures, and code of conduct Assist management with HR reports, audits, and inspections Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field Minimum 2–4 years HR experience, preferably in the hospitality industry Strong knowledge of labor law and HR best practices Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism Proficiency in HR systems, payroll processes, and MS Office Strong organizational and problem-solving skills Key Competencies Recruitment and talent management Employee relations and conflict resolution Training and staff development Compliance and policy implementation Time management and attention to detail

title: Treasury Head
description:
Roles & Responsibilities

The Treasury Head is responsible to assess, plan, monitor, manage and control the efficient utilization of cash and bank activities in a manner consistent with the objectives of the Company. Create continuous improvement environment for policies and procedures for maximum accuracy, efficiency and internal control.

Management & Cashflow planning

Managing day-to-day cash and treasury activities in line with the Delegation of Authority, treasury policy and manages appropriate procedures, processes and internal control environment around month-end and quarter-close activity.
Managing treasury operations and controls (cash pooling/sweeping, etc.)
Understand and manage appropriate accounting procedures and processes.
Managing relationship with Supply Chain to ensure that payments are made on schedule and on time.
Provide responses / reports and analytical information as requested by management, external auditors, internal auditors, or when issues are identified for further review.
Monitoring & Control

Reviewing funding needs, monthly reporting of all treasury activities to senior management
Monitor the interest and repayment of the borrowings, recording accruals for interest expense where required and perform reconciliation of interest from bank statement. Maintain interest calculation template to monitor the charges levied on the overdrafts daily.
Monitoring & control and follow-up supplier credit, letters of credit and guarantees/ deposit liability. And managing the margins and service fee on such facilities.
Ensure accuracy of data
Business Relation

Evaluate, develop, and monitor banking relationships and assist in actively building and developing strong strategic relationships with strategic banks and the group.
Promoting the organization’s banking relationships, liquidity management and other financial service providers.
Forex Sourcing and Tracking

Participating in different trade deals in sourcing FX
Responsible for all foreign currency requests applications and getting approval for the same.
Open and track the progress of LCs, CADs and TT payments.

Qualification
BA degree in Accounting or Finance
At least 8 years with a BA or MBA/ MA 6 years or ACCA with 4 years relevant experience of which at least 2 years as Treasury Head or equivalent capacity at manufacturing company or audit firm
Hands-on experience of SAP and in depth knowledge in International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRSs) and its application.
Expertise in SAP core treasury module (Money Market and Loans, Foreign Exchange, Interest Rate Swap, Reporting and Risk Management).
IFRS knowledge/expertise desirable.
Apply through Email - hana.seyum@et.wilmar-intl.com

description: የሥራ ማጠቃለያ ለጠቅላላ አገልግሎት ሚና ትጉ እና ታማኝ ግለሰብ እንፈልጋለን። ይህ አቀማመጥ በየክፍሉ ለስላሳ አገልግሎት እንዲሰጥ በሎጂስቲክስ እና በእጅ ስራዎች ወሳኝ ድጋፍ በመስጠት ለዕለታዊ ስራችን አስፈላጊ ነው። ጥሩው እጩ የቁሳቁሶችን ቀልጣፋ ፍሰት ለመጠበቅ እና ባልደረቦቹን በመደገፍ የሚኮራ ቡድን ተኮር አስተዋጽዖ አበርካች ይሆናል። ኃላፊነቶች የምግብ አቅርቦቶችን፣ ንጥረ ነገሮችን እና የአገልግሎት እቃዎችን በተለያዩ ፎቆች እና የስራ ቦታዎች መካከል ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ መጓጓዣን ጨምሮ የሎጂስቲክስ ተግባራትን ያከናውኑ። ቀልጣፋ የአገልግሎት አሰጣጥ እና የተግባር ቀጣይነት ለማረጋገጥ ተቆጣጣሪ እና ተጠባባቂ ሰራተኞችን ደጋፊ በሆኑ ተግባራት መርዳት። የማጠራቀሚያ ቦታዎችን ለመቀበል፣ ለማደራጀት እና ለማቆየት ያግዙ፣ አቅርቦቶች ተደራሽ እና በደንብ የተደረደሩ መሆናቸውን በማረጋገጥ። እቃዎችን በሚይዙበት ጊዜ እና በተለያዩ የስራ ዞኖች ውስጥ በሚሰሩበት ጊዜ ሁሉንም የጤና ፣ የደህንነት እና የንፅህና ደረጃዎችን ያክብሩ። የንግዱን ተለዋዋጭ ፍላጎቶች ለማሟላት በሱፐርቫይዘሮች የተመደበውን ተጨማሪ ደጋፊ ስራዎችን ያከናውኑ። መስፈርቶች የሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ማጠናቀቂያ የምስክር ወረቀት ወይም ተመጣጣኝ። ጥሩ የአካል ጥንካሬ እና የእጅ ሥራዎችን የማከናወን ችሎታ፣ ረጅም ጊዜ ማንሳት እና መቆምን ጨምሮ። ጠንካራ የሥራ ሥነ ምግባር፣ በሰዓቱ አክባሪነት እና አስተማማኝ ተፈጥሮ። መመሪያዎችን በጥንቃቄ የመከተል እና እንደ ቡድን አካል ውጤታማ በሆነ መልኩ የመስራት ችሎታ። እንደአስፈላጊነቱ በተለያዩ የሥራ ክንዋኔዎች ለመማር እና ለመርዳት ፈቃደኛነት። የደህንነት እና የንጽህና መርሆዎች መሰረታዊ ግንዛቤ ጠቃሚ ነው.

title: ወጥ ቤት Intern
description:
የሥራ ማጠቃለያ

ለተነሳሽ የኩሽና Intern በሙያዊ የምግብ አሰራር አካባቢ ልምድ እንዲያገኝ ጠቃሚ የመማር እድል እየሰጠን ነው። ይህ ሚና የወጥ

ቤታችንን ስራዎች ለመደገፍ የተነደፈው በምግብ ዝግጅት፣ አደረጃጀት እና መሰረታዊ የምግብ አሰራር ስራዎችን በመርዳት፣ የኩሽና የስራ

ሂደቶችን እና ደረጃዎችን መሰረታዊ ግንዛቤ በመስጠት ነው።

ኃላፊነቶች

ምግብ ሰሪዎችን እና ምግብ ሰሪዎችን በመሰረታዊ የምግብ ዝግጅት ተግባራት እንደ ማጠብ፣ መፋቅ፣ መቁረጥ እና የመለኪያ ንጥረ ነገሮችን መለካት።
ንፅህናን ለመጠበቅ እና አደረጃጀትን በሁሉም የኩሽና አካባቢዎች፣የስራ ቦታዎችን፣ እቃዎች እና የማከማቻ ቦታዎችን ጨምሮ ያግዙ።
በከፍተኛ የኩሽና ሰራተኞች እንደታዘዘው ለምግብ የሚሆኑ ክፍሎችን ለማዘጋጀት መመሪያዎችን በጥንቃቄ ይከተሉ።
ሁሉንም የምግብ ደህንነት፣ የአካባቢ ጽዳትና የግል ንፅህና አጠባበቅ ደንቦችን እና ፕሮቶኮሎችን ይማሩ እና ያክብሩ።
የምግብ አቅርቦቶችን በመቀበል እና በአግባቡ ለማከማቸት ያግዙ።
ቀልጣፋ እና ለስላሳ የሚሰራ ኩሽና ውስጥ አስተዋፅዖ ለማድረግ በተመደበው መሰረት ሌሎች ደጋፊ ተግባሮችን ያከናውኑ።

መስፈርቶች
የቅርብ ጊዜ ተመራቂ ወይም የአሁኑ ተማሪ በተገቢው መስክ (ለምሳሌ፣ የምግብ ዝግጅት፣ መስተንግዶ) ጠንካራ ፍላጎት እና ለመማር ፈቃደኛ መሆን አስፈላጊ ናቸው።
ምንም ቅድመ ሙያዊ ልምድ አያስፈልግም; ስልጠና ይሰጣል።
በፍጥነት በቡድን-ተኮር አካባቢ ውስጥ የመስራት ችሎታ።
ጠንካራ የስራ ባህሪ፣ የመማር ጉጉት እና አዎንታዊ አመለካከት።
ጥሩ የግንኙነት ችሎታዎች እና መመሪያዎችን በትክክል የመከተል ችሎታ።
ረዘም ላለ ጊዜ መቆም እና ቀላል አካላዊ ስራዎችን ማስተናገድ መቻል አለበት።

title: Excavator Operator Job
description:
Excavator Operator Job

Excavator operators or heavy equipment operators use heavy equipment to assist in construction work, surface mining or quarrying activities and handling large materials. They can help construct or maintain roads, bridges, airports, tunnels and buildings. An excavator operator can work for a public or private company and will use their expertise to assist in large projects.

Excavator Operator job duties and responsibilities

Excavator operators or heavy equipment operators should expect to perform many different duties, which can include:

Operate heavy equipment to move, load, and grade earth, rock, gravel or other materials during construction.
Operate heavy equipment to assist in the maintenance and repair of roadways.
Excavate rock, ore or other materials from open-pit mines, strip mines, quarries or construction pits.
Read and interpret blueprints or designs to understand the requirements of the job.
Conduct pre-operational checks on equipment and clean, lubricate and refuel equipment.
Interested applicants should submit in person or by mail their non-returnable application with CVs & relevant documents within ten working days from the date of this announcement, on first floor of Turkana Building at Lideta sub city woreda 08 Geja Sefer to Mola Maru road just next to CBE.

title: Video Editor
description:
Key Responsibilities:

-          Video Content Creation: Edit and produce videos that showcase the surgical center’s services, procedures, patient testimonials, and educational content related to ENT health.

-          Pre-production Planning: Collaborate with medical staff and marketing teams to conceptualize video projects. This may involve scripting, storyboarding, and planning the logistics of video shoots.

-          Filming: Capture high-quality video footage during surgeries (with appropriate permissions), patient interviews, educational sessions, and community events. Ensure adherence to safety and privacy regulations.

-          Post-production Editing: Use video editing software (such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar) to edit raw footage, add graphics, sound effects, music, and transitions to create polished final products.

-          Quality Control: Review and ensure that all video content meets the center's quality standards and aligns with its branding guidelines.

-          Educational Videos: Create instructional videos that explain common ENT procedures, conditions, and treatment options to help educate patients and demystify surgical processes.

-          Patient Testimonials: Edit and compile patient testimonials that highlight successful treatments and positive experiences at the surgical center to build trust and credibility.

-          Social Media Content: Produce short-form videos optimized for social media platforms to enhance engagement and reach a broader audience.

-          Collaboration: Work closely with healthcare professionals, marketing teams, and other stakeholders to gather necessary information and ensure accuracy in the content being produced.

-          Feedback Incorporation: Make revisions based on feedback from medical staff or marketing teams to ensure the final product meets their expectations and objectives.

-          Archiving Footage: Organize and maintain a library of video footage and assets for future use, ensuring easy access for ongoing projects.

-          Staying Current: Keep up-to-date with the latest video editing techniques, trends in healthcare communication, and advancements in video production technology.

-          Compliance Awareness: Ensure that all video content adheres to healthcare regulations and ethical standards regarding patient confidentiality and informed consent.

-          Performance Analysis: Analyze the performance of video content across various platforms (e.g., social media, website) to assess engagement levels and effectiveness, using insights to improve future productions.

-          Training and Development: If applicable, provide training or guidance to staff on how to create basic video content or utilize video equipment for internal projects.

Qualifications and skill :

-          Demonstrating strong leadership and management skills.

-          Commitment to patient-centered care, quality, and safety.

-          Flexibility to work variable hours

-          Proven track record of effectively leading and managing teams, promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

-          Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills.

-          Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment.

• Tempo/original Degree credential of completion from known institution

• Renewed work license

• 1 Year and above work experience

title: Food and Beverage Officer (FB)
description:
1. Nutritional Management

– Collaborating with healthcare professionals to develop patient-specific dietary plans that align with their medical needs and recovery processes.

– Ensuring that food offerings support healing and are appropriate for patients post-surgery, considering factors like texture, temperature, and nutritional content.

2. Menu Planning

– Designing menus that cater to the dietary restrictions and preferences of patients, including options for those with allergies or specific medical conditions.

– Regularly updating menus based on seasonal availability of ingredients and patient feedback.

3. Inventory Management

– Monitoring stock levels of food and beverage items to ensure adequate supplies for patient meals and staff needs.

– Conducting regular inventory audits to minimize waste and manage costs effectively.

4. Cost Control

– Analyzing food costs and implementing strategies to maintain budgetary constraints while ensuring quality.

– Reducing waste through efficient inventory practices and portion control.

5. Quality Assurance

– Ensuring all food served meets safety and hygiene standards, particularly important in a healthcare environment.

– Conducting regular checks on food quality and presentation to maintain high standards.

6. Supplier Management

– Establishing relationships with suppliers who can provide high-quality, safe food products suitable for a healthcare setting.

– Negotiating contracts to ensure competitive pricing while maintaining quality standards.

7. Patient Satisfaction

– Gathering feedback from patients regarding their dining experience to improve services.

– Making adjustments to menus and service based on patient preferences and dietary needs.

8. Staff Training

– Training kitchen and service staff on food safety practices, dietary restrictions, and customer service tailored to patients in a medical setting.

– Ensuring staff are knowledgeable about the nutritional aspects of food being served.

9. Compliance

– Adhering to health regulations and guidelines specific to food service in healthcare facilities.

– Ensuring that all practices comply with local health department regulations and accreditation standards.

10. Operational Efficiency

Streamlining food service operations to ensure timely delivery of meals to patients, especially in a surgical setting where timing may be critical.

Implementing best practices in food preparation, serving, and waste management.

11. Collaboration with Medical Staff

Working closely with dietitians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure that food service aligns with patients' medical treatments and recovery plans.

– Assist in training new staff members as needed.

– Occasionally interact with customers to take special requests or receive feedback on food quality.

– Maintain a positive attitude and contribute to a welcoming atmosphere in the dining area.

– Be prepared to handle unexpected situations, such as menu changes or high-volume service periods.

– Stay flexible and willing to assist in various kitchen tasks as needed.

- Follow company policies and procedures regarding food preparation, safety, and customer service.

- Participate in staff meetings and training sessions to stay updated on best practices

-          Have a certificate in food preparation

-          Zero and above year experience

Provide structured written feedback to our developed content to strengthen engagement and improve quality before final publishing.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Education, Linguistics, Applied Linguistics, Curriculum Studies, Language Teaching, or related fields.
+3 years of relevant professional experience in curriculum development, language education, or structured learning content development.
Demonstrated experience developing curricula for Amharic language learning.
Proven experience teaching Amharic to learners whose first language is English.
Ability to design curriculum for digital/mobile self-paced learning.

Required Skills and Competencies

Strong analytical review skills and attention to detail.
Ability to suggest improvement of content through clear, structured feedback and revisions.
Strong organization and ability to meet agreed deadlines

title: የዜና አዘጋጅ እና አቅራቢ
description:

ለማመልከት ማንኛውንም ዜና መርጠው በድምፅዎ በመቅዳት ይላኩ (ወይም ቀደም ብለው የሰሩት የድምፅ/ቪዲዮ ሊንክ ያያይዙ)።

ማሳሰቢያ፡ ማመልከት ከመጀመርዎ በፊት ይህንን ያንብቡ!

የድምፅ ቅጂ (Audio Demo) ያላካተተ ማንኛውም አመልካች በቀጥታ ውድቅ ይደረጋል።

ዋና ዋና የሥራ ድርሻዎች (Key Responsibilities)
ይዘት መፍጠር፦ ወቅታዊ ዜናዎችን መፈለግ፣ እውነተኝነታቸውን ማረጋገጥ እና ለዲጂታል ማህበረሰብ በሚመጥን መልኩ በአማርኛ መጻፍ።

ስክሪፕት ዝግጅት፦ ዜናዎችን ለዩቲዩብ በሚመች፣ ሳቢ በሆነ አጀማመር (Hooks) እና ታሪክን በሚተርክ መልኩ ወደ ስክሪፕት መቀየር።

የድምፅ አቀራረብ፦ የተዘጋጁ ስክሪፕቶችን ጥራት ባለው ድምፅ፣ ግልጽ በሆነ አነባበብ እና በከፍተኛ ጉልበት (Energy) መቅዳት።

ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች (Requirements)
የአማርኛ ቋንቋ ችሎታ፦ በአማርኛ ጽሁፍ እና ንግግር እጅግ በጣም የተካነ።

የጋዜጠኝነት ስነ-ምግባር፦ መረጃን የማጣራት እና ሚዛናዊ ዘገባ የማቅረብ ልምድ ያለው።

ለጊዜ ትኩረት መስጠት፦ ዜናዎች ሳይረፍዱ ለተመልካች እንዲደርሱ በፈጣን የጊዜ ገደብ ውስጥ የመሥራት ብቃት።

ልምድ (ይመረጣል)፦ በጋዜጠኝነት፣ በሬዲዮ ወይም በዩቲዩብ የይዘት ፈጠራ ላይ የሥራ ልምድ ያለው።

description:
Job Title: Python / PySpark Engineer with Machine Learning Experience

Location: [Remote / On-site ]

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Python / PySpark Engineer with a strong foundation in big data processing and machine learning model implementation. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in building scalable data pipelines and integrating ML models into production workflows. You’ll collaborate with data scientists and engineers to deploy data solutions that power intelligent decision-making across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

* Build and optimize large-scale ETL pipelines using PySpark for structured and unstructured data.

* Develop backend components and automation scripts using Python to support ML operations.

* Collaborate with data scientists to operationalize machine learning models, including model training, evaluation, and deployment.

* Monitor and tune performance of Spark jobs and ML pipelines.

* Create reusable data transformation modules and model inference services.

* Contribute to the full ML lifecycle—data preprocessing, feature engineering, model serving, and versioning.

* Design and implement unit tests, integration tests, and model validation strategies.

* Maintain documentation for data workflows, model behavior, and production incidents.

Required Qualifications:

* 3+ years of experience with Python and PySpark in large-scale data environments.

* Hands-on experience implementing and deploying machine learning models (classification, regression, clustering, etc.).

* Experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

* Strong knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation metrics.

* Experience working with Spark MLlib and distributed model training/inference workflows.

* Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Parquet, JSON, or Avro data formats.

* Proficiency in using Jupyter Notebooks, MLflow, or similar platforms for model tracking.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):

* Experience with streaming data frameworks (e.g., Kafka, Spark Streaming).

* Exposure to Databricks, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, or GCP Vertex AI.

* Understanding of MLOps practices, including model monitoring and CI/CD for ML.

* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or model containerization.

Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, or a related field.

title: የእቃ ግዥ ባለሙያ
description:
አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ስራ

የስራ መደቡ፡     የእቃ ግዥ ባለሙያ

ሥራ ዝርዝር መግለጫ

ድርጅታችን የአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ሥራ ልምድ ያለው ብቁ የሆነ የእቃ ግዥ ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን፡፡  በማስታወቂያ ስራዎች (LED ምልክቶች የሚሆኑ ግብዓት ማቴሪያሎች፣ Banner፣ Acrylic፣ Printing materials፣ የብረት እና የኤሌክትሪክ እቃዎች) … ላይ የሚሰራ ሲሆን፣ በእቃ ግዥና በአቅርቦት ሂደት ልምድ ያለው የግዥ ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን።

የስራ ኃላፊነቶች:-

· የድርጅቱን የእቃ ፍላጎት መለየት እና መግዛት

· የግዥ ሰነዶችን ትክክለኛ መያዝ እና መመዝገብ

የትምህርትና የሥራ ልምድ መስፈርቶች:-

· በንግድ፣ በሂሳብ፣ በማኔጅመንት ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ ዲፕሎማ/ዲግሪ

· 2 ዓመት እና ከዚያ በላይ የእቃ ግዥ / የግዥ ስራ ልምድ ያለው

· የኮምፒውተር ክህሎት (MS Excel, Word) ግዴታ ነው

·  ጥሩ የመግባባትና የውይይት ክህሎት ያለው

·  ታማኝነት ፣ ቀልጣፋና ቅን የሆነ

የስራ አይነት: ሙሉ ጊዜ

የማመልከቻ መንገድ

· አመልካቾች አግባብነት ያለው የት/ት ማስረጃ፣ የሥራ ልምድ እና ዋናውንና ኮፒውን በመያዝ በአስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ድርጅታችን በአካል ማቅረብም ሆነ በቴሌግራም /በAfriwork በኩል CV መላክ ይችላሉ፡፡

 

የስራ አድራሻ፡-

· አዲስ አበባ አስናቀ ማስታወቂያ ጉርድ ሾላ - ሳሊተ ምህረት ቤ/ክ  የትራፊክ መብራት  አካባቢ /መስቀለኛ ቦታ ላይ እንገኛለን/ ወይም (ከሳሊተ ምህረት እና ከፊጋ ወደ ጃክሮስ መታጠፊያ የትራፊክ መብራት ላይ እንገኛለን)፡፡  ስልክ ቁጥር 09-79-00-22-81

title: Sales and Agency Coordinator
description:
የት/ርት ዝግጅት በማርኬቲን ማኔጅመንት ወይም በቢዝነስ አድሚንስትሬሽን ወይንም በ ኮምኒኬሽን ጆርናሊዝም ዘርፍ ዲግሪና ከዛ በላይ ያለው።

ዋና ሀላፊነት:-

-የድርጅቱን ወኪሎች(Agents) ማፍራት፣ማሰልጠን እና ማበረታታት። ወኪሎች በንቃት እንዲሰሩ ድጋፍ ማድረግ እና የሽያጭ ግቦችን ማሳካት።

የሚጠበቅብዎ እሎታ:-

ጠንካራ የኮምኒኬሽን ችሎታ፣ሰዎችን የማሳመን ብቃት በሽያጭ ወይም በኔትወርክ ማርኬቲንግ ዘርፍ ሌሎችን የማሰልጠን መምህራዊ ብቃት።

title: ዳቦ ጋጋሪ
description: የሥራ ማጠቃለያ: የእኛ ኩባንያ ታማኝና ባለሙያ የሆነ የዳቦ ሰራተኛ በመፈለግ ላይ ነው። እንዲሁም ሰራተኛው ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያላቸው የቤከሪ ምርቶችን እንዲዘጋጁ፣ የምግብ ደህንነትን እንዲጠብቁና የዕለቱን የቤከሪ ሥራ በቀጥታ እንዲያስተካክሉ ይጠይቃል። ትክክለኛ ዝግጅት ማድረግ፣ ትክክለኛ ማስተዳደርና በቡድን ስራ ውስጥ መሥራት የሚችሉ ሰራተኞችን እንፈልጋለን። ዋና ተግባራት: በመደበኛ ስርዓት ምርቶችን እንዲዘጋጁ የዳቦና ፓስትሪዎችን ማቅረብ(ክሩሴንት፣ የሙዝ ኬኮች፣ የበርገር ዳቦ፣ ዳቦ እና ቦምቦሊኖዎች) የምርት ጥራት፣ ጣዕምና አቀማመጥን ማረጋገጥ እቃዎችን ትክክለኛ ለመጠን መመዘንና ማቀናበር የቤከሪ መሣሪያዎችን በደህንነት ማስተዳደር እና በትክክል መጠቀም የምግብ ደህንነትና ንፁህነት ስርዓቶችን መጠበቅ በማህደር እቃ ዝግጅት ላይ ማኅተም ማድረግ የእቃ እና ዕቃ አቅርቦትን መከታተል እና ችግር እንዳይፈጠር ማስታወቂያ ማድረግ አዳዲስ ተቀላቀለዎችን በማጠቃለያ መርምር ማገዝ የኩባንያ ፖሊሲዎችን እና የሥራ ቦታ ደህንነት ህጎችን መከተል መስፈርቶች: በቤከሪ ሥራ ልምድ ወይም በተመሳሳይ ሥራ ልምድ (መካከለኛ ደረጃ የሆነ) የዳቦና ፓስትሪ መስሪያዎች ስለሚከተሉ መረጃ እና መሣሪያዎችን መረዳት የምግብ ደህንነት እና ንፁህነት መሠረት ላይ የተመሠረተ እውቀት የጊዜ ማስተዳደር ችሎታ እና የሥራ ድጋፍን መስጠት ዝግጅት ላይ ዝርዝር አቀማመጥ ማድረግ እና ጥራትን ማረጋገጥ ረጅም ጊዜ ስራ ላይ መቆምና የቤከሪ መሣሪያዎችን ማንቀሳቀስ ችሎታ የተለዋዋጭ ሰዓት ስራ ላይ መስራት ፈቃድ ጥሩ የግንኙነት እና ቡድን ስራ ችሎታ ታማኝነት፣ ትክክለኛነትና የሙያ አመለካከት

title: PR officer
description:
The Public Relations Officer is responsible for representing the company before government offices and private organizations, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing official documentation, and handling licensing and administrative processes. The role requires strong communication skills, knowledge of regulatory procedures, and the ability to coordinate with internal and external stakeholders effectively.
Key Responsibilities
Government & External Relations
Licensing & Compliance
Immigration & Expatriate Support
Contracts & Documentation
Administrative & Utility Management
Qualifications & Requirements
•  Bachelor’s degree in Law, Public Administration, Business Administration, or related field.
•  Proven experience in public relations, government liaison, or regulatory compliance roles.
•  Strong knowledge of government procedures and licensing requirements.
•  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•  Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
•  Ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks efficiently.

title: ጉዳይ አስፈጻሚ
description:

title: Sales and Agency Coordinator
description:
የት/ርት ዝግጅት በማርኬቲን ማኔጅመንት ወይም በቢዝነስ አድሚንስትሬሽን ወይንም በ ኮምኒኬሽን ጆርናሊዝም ዘርፍ ዲግሪና ከዛ በላይ ያለው።

ዋና ሀላፊነት:-

-የድርጅቱን ወኪሎች(Agents) ማፍራት፣ማሰልጠን እና ማበረታታት። ወኪሎች በንቃት እንዲሰሩ ድጋፍ ማድረግ እና የሽያጭ ግቦችን ማሳካት።

የሚጠበቅብዎ እሎታ:-

ጠንካራ የኮምኒኬሽን ችሎታ፣ሰዎችን የማሳመን ብቃት በሽያጭ ወይም በኔትወርክ ማርኬቲንግ ዘርፍ ሌሎችን የማሰልጠን መምህራዊ ብቃት።

title: የፅዳት እና የቢሮ ረዳት ሰራተኛ
description:
የፅዳት እና የቢሮ ረዳት ሰራተኛ

ቦታ: አዲስ አበባ,CMC Michael

ትምህርት: ዲፕሎማ ቢያንስ

እድሜ ተሞክሮ: 1 ዓመት የሚመረጥ

 

ንፁህነት ባለሙያና የቢሮ ረዳት ቢሮውን ንፁህ፣ ተደራሽ እና ደስተኛ ሁኔታ ለመጠበቅ እንዲሁም ቀላል ስራዎችና የውጭ ተግባራትን ለመፈጸም ይመደባል።

 

ዋና የስራ ተግባሮች

* ቢሮውን እና አጠቃላይ ቦታዎችን ማጽዳትና መጠበቅ

* ዕለታዊ መቆረጥ፣ መታጠብ፣ መንጻት፣ ቆሻሻ መውሰድ

* የደረሰኞችን፣ የቢሮ ዕቃዎችን እና የስብሰባ ክፍሎችን ተደራሽ መጠበቅ

* ለሰራተኞችና ለእንግዶች ቡና፣ ሻይ እና ውሃ ማቅረብ

* ወደ ባንክ መሄድ እና ቀላል የውጭ ተግባራት መፈጸም

* መሰረታዊ የኮምፒውተር ችሎታዎች (ትይፒንግ፣ ፕሪንቲንግ፣ ስካኒንግ፣ ፋይል ማደራጀት)

* የጥገና ችግር በቅድሚያ ለሰራተኛ መሪ ወይም ለሀላፊ ማሳወቅ

* የቢሮ እቃዎችን ማስተካከልና የሰነዶች ማዘጋጀት ላይ ማገዝ የምትችል

 

ስልጣናት & ችሎታዎች

* የንፁህነትና የጤና መደበኛ መርሀ ግብር

* ጊዜ አስተዳደርና ታማኝነት

* በቡድን ወይም ብቻ መስራት የሚችል

* ከሰራተኞችና ከእንግዶች ጋር ተስማሚ ባህሪ

* ቀላል የኮምፒውተር ችሎታዎች

* የመጽዳት መሳሪያዎችና እቃዎች መረዳት

 

ብቁነት

* ዲፕሎማ ቢያንስ

* 1 ዓመት የቢሮ ወይም የማጽዳት ስራ ተሞክሮ ይመረጣል

title: production operations and development trainee
description:
What you’ll actually do here
This is not a “watch someone else work” internship. You will be on the floor, hands-on, from week one.
You will rotate through three areas over your first 6–12 months:

1. Assembly & Production

Learn how a piece of furniture goes from flat-pack to finished form.
Work with wood, metal, textiles, and hardware.
Understand why quality control matters—and how to spot a defect before it ships.

2. Process Development

Watch how we currently build things. Then help us do it better.
Time studies. Workflow mapping. Small experiments.
You don’t need to know Lean or Six Sigma yet. You just need to ask: “Why do we do it this way?”

3. Tools & Technology

Introduction to CNC machinery, edgebanders, and automated assembly aids.
No prior experience required. You will be trained by senior technicians who actually enjoy teaching.
By the end of the program, you will not be “the intern.” You will be a contributing member of the production team—and you will have a clear path to your next role.

You do need:
A high school diploma or equivalent (associate’s or bachelor’s is fine too, but not required).
To show up on time, every day.
To be comfortable using your hands and standing for periods of time.
To ask questions when you don’t understand.
To care about whether the thing you made is good.
Bonus points (but truly optional):
You’ve fixed something yourself—a bike, a piece of furniture, a phone screen.
You took a shop class, art class, or helped a parent with a project.
You have an opinion about what makes a chair comfortable.

title: Gemology trainers
description:
EGC GEMS is an Addis-based gemstone laboratory and vocational training center. We provide gemstone testing and professional training for miners, traders, lapidarists, jewellers, and public institutions. Our mission is to support value addition and long-term capacity building in Ethiopia’s gemstone sector.

THE ROLE

We are hiring a Gemology Vocational Trainer who will co-deliver practical, hands-on training to adult participants and grow into increasing technical and pedagogical responsibility over time.

Training is delivered in English to small groups and combines classroom instruction with workshop practice (e.g. gemstone cutting and polishing).

This role is suitable for candidates who want to develop into a senior professional vocational trainer, not just deliver occasional courses.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Co-deliver gemology and technical training to adult learners

Facilitate interactive sessions and Q&A

Guide participants during practical workshop activities

Use and adapt existing training materials
Support participants in developing self-learning skills
Work as part of a trainer team and contribute to shared outcomes

DEVELOPMENT PATH

Initial phase: Co-delivery of defined training modules, facilitation, learning adult training methods

Advanced phase: Independent module delivery, stronger technical explanations, material improvement

Senior phase: Curriculum development, mentoring of junior trainers, methodological leadership

Progression is based on demonstrated competence.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor / Masters Degree (or equivalent) in a technical or scientific field (e.g. chemistry, physics, materials science, geology, mineral-related engineering, medicine, pharmacology, or similar)

Early career to several years of professional experience

Strong spoken and written English is a must!

A "training mindset" is important. Training experience is welcome but not required. Training will be provided.

WHO SHOULD APPLY

Candidates with an engaging personality, comfortable speaking in front of adult groups

Technically curious and willing to learn continuously

Reliable, well-prepared, and respectful of participants

interested in building a long-term role in vocational training

Strong interest in and first experience of working with Artificial Intelligence !!!

We actively encourage women to apply.

APPLICATION

Please send a one-page motivation letter explaining
why this role and this kind of work interests you

title: Dynamics 365 CRM Developer

Responsibilities

title: Art Director
description: Position Description This is a full-time, on-site role at a leading advertising agency in Ethiopia We are seeking a talented and driven Art Director to lead our graphic design team within the Design Department. The ideal candidate will have a strong design background, a keen eye for visual storytelling, and a passion for inspiring and guiding creative teams to produce outstanding work. This role requires excellent leadership, collaboration, and communication skills, with a deep understanding of graphic design principles, visual branding, and multi-platform design execution. As the Art Director, you will work closely with the Creative Director, marketing teams, and other departments to ensure all visual outputs meet brand standards, campaign goals, and client expectations. Essential Duties and Responsibilities The Art Director will oversee the day-to-day operations of the Art Department team and ensure the quality, consistency, and creativity of all design projects. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 1. Visual Concept Development Lead the development of compelling visual concepts that align with campaign strategies and client objectives. Translate creative ideas into effective design assets for print, digital, social media, and other platforms. Guide designers in developing visual solutions that support the "big idea" of each campaign. 2. Team Supervision and Mentorship Manage and mentor a team of graphic designers, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and creative support. Encourage a collaborative and innovative environment that promotes growth and excellence. Review and approve design work, ensuring high standards of quality and consistency. 3. Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with the Creative Director, account managers, copywriters, and marketing teams to ensure cohesive campaign execution. Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute to the creative development process across departments. Ensure timely delivery of design assets in alignment with project timelines. 4. Client Communication and Presentations Support client-facing presentations by providing visuals that bring creative strategies to life. Interpret client feedback and translate it into actionable design improvements. Maintain a professional and collaborative relationship with clients throughout the design process. 5. Design Oversight and Brand Consistency Ensure all design outputs are visually engaging, on-brand, and aligned with the campaign’s message and target audience. Oversee the production process, from initial concepts to final artwork delivery. Maintain consistency in design elements, typography, color usage, and layout across all projects. 6. Industry Awareness and Innovation Stay up to date on design trends, tools, and technologies. Inspire the team to push creative boundaries and explore new visual approaches. Incorporate innovative techniques to keep the agency’s design work competitive and cutting-edge. 7. Resource and Timeline Management Manage project timelines and resources effectively to meet deadlines and budget constraints. Coordinate with production and finance teams to ensure efficient workflow and cost management. Track and optimize design processes for continuous improvement. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communication Design, or a related field. Minimum of 4 years of experience in a professional design environment, with at least 1–2 years in a supervisory or lead design role. Strong portfolio demonstrating creative leadership and high-quality design work across multiple platforms. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and other relevant design tools. Excellent visual, verbal, and written communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. Leadership skills with a passion for team development and creative excellence.

title: SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR WITH GRAPHICS PROFICIENCY
description:
We are looking for a professional video editor specializing in non-fiction, documentary and factual storytelling. This is not a make it look cool role. This is a structural storytelling and information design role.

You will work with interview-driven content, archival footage, and complex narrative structures. You must be equally comfortable cutting a ninety-minute documentary and building custom motion graphics to explain geopolitical, scientific or historical concepts.

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

EDITING AND STORYTELLING

Assemble rough cuts from interview transcripts, rushes and archival selects.

Structure long-form narratives between thirty and one hundred twenty minutes with clear act structure, pacing and emotional arc.

Execute J-cuts, L-cuts and eye-trace editing to create invisible, immersive storytelling.

Work with producers to implement notes quickly and without ego. First pass is not final pass.

GRAPHICS AND MOTION DESIGN

Design and animate custom lower thirds, title cards and end credits.

Build kinetic typography systems for quotes, dates, locations and statistical data.

Create animated maps, diagrams and data visualizations to explain complex topics visually.

Restore and animate still photographs and archival footage using parallax, masking and focus pulls.

No template dumping. You build, you customize, you own it.

TECHNICAL AND WORKFLOW

Manage proxy workflows, multi-cam sync and large-project timeline stability.

Deliver projects in multiple formats including broadcast, web, social cuts and trailer versions.

Export clean XML and AAF files for color and sound finishing.

Maintain three-two-one backup discipline. No lost projects. No excuses.

AUDIO FOUNDATION

Clean dialogue with iZotope RX or equivalent including hum, HVAC, traffic and mic rustle removal.

Balance levels with dialogue at minus twelve decibels and music and SFX supporting, not competing.

Output stereo stems including dialogue, music and effects when required.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Non-Linear Editing: Premiere Pro advanced or DaVinci Resolve advanced. Avid welcome.

Motion Graphics: After Effects with expressions, dynamic link, three-dimensional camera and tracking.

Audio: iZotope RX, dialogue repair, submixing and loudness normalization.

Color: Technical grading using scopes, matching footage from multiple cameras and Rec.709 delivery.

Archival: Upscaling, photo animation and source documentation.

title: ERP Payroll Support Analyst (Remote)
description: Case Triage (Critical): Monitor incoming support cases in Salesforce and assign appropriate SLA (Service Level Agreement). Identify urgent issues requiring immediate attention vs. those that can wait for senior analysts in the morning. Proper triage prevents critical issues from being missed. Case Investigation: Pick up unassigned cases, read what client reported, review screenshots/documents, log into internal or client environments to replicate the issue, research similar past cases in Salesforce, use technical manuals and AI tools to understand root cause, and document findings thoroughly in case notes. Solution Delivery: Test potential fixes in test environments, draft clear client responses explaining the issue and solution, update case notes with investigation steps and outcomes, and escalate complex issues to programming or senior analysts when needed. Team Collaboration: Work with internal team members (programming, product managers, senior analysts) to resolve complex cases. You'll need to communicate professionally and understand team dynamics and when to escalate vs. resolve independently. Continuous Documentation: Every investigation step must be documented in shared Drive as you work. This keeps the supervising analyst informed (who handles client meetings on your behalf) and creates knowledge base for future similar cases. Required Experience & Skills Must Have: Prior ERP system experience (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Workday, ADP, or similar) Brief understanding of US payroll concepts: tax withholdings (federal/state), FICA, overtime calculations, direct deposit, benefits/deductions, W-2/941 forms Strong technical troubleshooting ability – systematic problem-solving approach Excellent written English for case documentation and client communication drafts Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to quickly research technical documentation Extreme attention to detail – small errors cause major problems in support work Strongly Preferred: ServiceCloud or Salesforce experience (case management) Basic SQL/database understanding Canadian payroll knowledge (bonus, not required) Technical Requirements Hardware: Reliable computer: Windows 10/11, 8GB+ RAM (16GB preferred), i5/Ryzen 5+ processor, SSD storage Stable internet: 10+ Mbps download, 5+ Mbps upload UPS or laptop battery backup (for power outages) Second monitor strongly recommended Software & Access: VPN with Toronto IP address (required for security – NordVPN or similar) Microsoft Edge browser (primary) Remote desktop tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, etc.) Email and messaging tools Security: You'll handle confidential payroll data (SSNs, salaries, tax info). Strict confidentiality required. No public WiFi. Any breach = immediate termination. Work Arrangement Schedule: 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST, Monday-Friday (11:00 PM – 7:00 AM Ethiopia time). This is your shift coverage period when North American senior analysts are offline. Supervising analyst available most of this time for questions. Training: 2-4 weeks intensive onboarding including on Academy courses (US Payroll, International Payroll, E-Times, ESS, HCM modules), Salesforce procedures, shadowing cases, supervised practice cases with feedback. After Training: Work independently on cases with supervising analyst backup. Daily check-ins, screen sharing as needed (no camera), escalation for complex issues. You're expected to handle case volume independently once trained. Performance Metrics: Speed and accuracy of case resolution, documentation quality and completeness, proper SLA assignments, ability to identify similar past cases, professional communication in notes and drafts. Why This Role Works Good Fit If You: Enjoy investigating technical problems systematically Comfortable learning complex systems quickly with AI assistance Prefer independent work with clear documentation standards Want stable remote work with North American business exposure Like variety – every case is different

title: Laboratory experts
description: Job Description Laboratory Gemstone Expert (Junior/Mid-level) This is a hands-on laboratory position for someone at the early years of her/his professional career who wants to build real technical competence in gemstone testing. You will work directly with gemstones, instruments, SOPs, and senior staff. Over time, you will take on increasing responsibility for assessments, documentation, and process improvement. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Perform gemstone examinations to assess authenticity, identity, and key characteristics, following defined SOPs Work extremely carefully and consistently under time pressure and practical constraints Document observations, results, and uncertainties clearly and accurately Support the development, refinement, and documentation of laboratory SOPs Participate in routine care and maintenance of laboratory equipment and workspaces Contribute to building institutional knowledge through documentation, internal discussions, and learning from cases Engage actively in internal training and skill development THE IDEAL CANDIDATE is patient, observant, and can focus for long periods without losing accuracy is extraordinarily precise and enjoys working to strict international standards enjoys working with physical objects and instruments accepts that learning requires both in-depth study of detailed scientific texts as well as repetition, correction, and discipline is comfortable asking questions — and receiving correction takes responsibility for own work and for team results QUALIFICATIONS & BACKGROUND Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in a technical or scientific field (e.g. chemistry, physics, materials science, geology, medicine, pharmacology, or similar), MSc is an advantage Up to ~3 years of professional experience; prior laboratory exposure is an advantage but not required Comfortably communicate in written and spoken English Formal gemstone experience is not required. Training will be provided. HOW WE HIRE We hire for capacity, mindset, and learning ability — and we train for skills. We are looking for someone who is curious, reliable, and serious about building professional competence over years. You may want to use this position to enter into the gemstone sector, and later on become an entrepreneur in your own right. If possible, provide evidence of sustained initiative, discipline, and self-directed learning — academic, practical, or professional. We actively encourage women to apply. APPLICATION Please send a one-page motivation letter explaining why this role and this kind of work interest you, accompanied by your CV and other supporting documents. Send all documents wrapped into one PDF, do NOT send more than one file. Any reference or recommendation from an academic or technical supervisor who knows your work is welcome, but optional . title: ካሸር አካውንታት
description:
የፌም መንደር ጊዜያዊ አስተባባሪ ኮሚቴ ከዚህ በታች ለተጠቀሰው ከፍት የስራ መደብ እጩዎችን አወዳድሮ ለመቅጠር ይፈልጋል፡፡ በመሆኑም መስፈርቱን የምታሟሉ ተወዳዳሪዎች በተከታታይ 5 (አምስት) የስራ ቀናት ፊጋ አካባቢ ቲጂ አአፓርትመንት ወረድ ብሎ በሚገኘው ፌም የመኖሪያ መንደር የነዋሪዎች ቢሮ በአካል በመቅረብ የትምህርት እና የስራ ልምድ ማስረጃቸሁን ዋናውን እና የማይመለስ ከፒ በመያዝ መመዝገብ የምትችሉ መሆኑን እናሳውቃለን፡፡

የስራ መደቡ መጠሪያ ፡- ሂሳብ ሰራተኛ (cashier Accountant)

የቅጥር ጊዜ፡- በኮንትራክት (በስምምነት)

ተፈላጊ የትምርት ደረጃ፡- በአካውንቲንግ እና ፋይናንስ የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ ያለው/ያላት

የተለየ ቸሎታ፡- መሰረታዊ የኮምፒተር እውቀት እና በፕችትሪ አካውንቲንግ (Peachtree Accounting) የሰለጠነ/የሰለጠነች

የስራ ልምድ፡- አንድ አመት እና ከዛ በላይ

ደሞዝ፡- በስምምነት

ብዛት፡- አንድ

የስራ በታ፡ በፌም የመኖሪያ መንደር ውስጥ/ አዲስ አበባ

የስራ ሰዓት፡ ከሰኞ አስከ አርብ ከጠዋት 2፡30-6፡30 ከሰዓት ከ7፡30-11፡30፣ ቅዳሜ ከጠዋት 2፡30-6፡30

የስራ መደቡ ሃላፊነቶች፦ በዚህ መደብ የሚቀጠረዉ/የምትቀጠረው ሰራተኛ ዋና ዋና ተግባራት እና ሀላፊነቶች የሚከተሉት ይሆናሉ፡-

ሁሉንም የገንዘብ ገቢዎች እና ወጪዎች በየቀኑ መመዝገብ፣ ደረሰኞችን እና ደጋፊ ሰነዶችን በአግባቡ ማደራጀት፣

የሂሳብ እንቅስቃሴዎች በፋይናንስ ህግ መሰረት መከናወናቸውን ማረጋገጥ እና መመዝገብ፣

በስራ አመራር በሚሰጠው መመሪያ መሰረት ለታቀዱ ስራዎች በጀት እና የሥራ መርሀ ግብር ማዘጋጀት፣

ከነዋሪዎች የሚሰበሰቡትን የመብራት፣ የውሀ እና ወርሀዊ መዋጮ የነዋሪዎችን ድርሻ በማስላት ለአመራር አጸድቆ ክፍያን ማሳወቅ፤ የሚከፈሉትን ገንዘቦች መከታተል እና መመዝገብ፣

የሂሳብ መዝገብ እና የገንዘብ እንቅስቃሴ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት፣

በተጨማሪም ሂሳቡን ከባንክ ሒሳብ ማስታረቅ (Bank Reconciliation)፣

የደመወዝ ክፍያ ማዘጋጀት እና ለኦዲት ስራ የሚያስፈልጉ ሰነዶችን ማቅረብ፣

ለስራ ማስኬጃ የሚወጣን ፒቲ ካሽ በመረከብ በስራ አመራር ለጸደቁ ወጪዎች ወጪ በማድረግ የወጪ መረጃ መያዝ/መመዝገበ፣

የወጪና ገቢ ሰነዶችን መመዝገብ፣ ማደራጀት፤

ሳምንታዊ እና ወርሀዊ የስራ ሪፖርት በማዘጋጀት ለስራ አመራር ቦርዱ ማቅረብ፤

የተለያዩ የወጪ ደብዳቤዎችን ማዘጋጀት፤

ሳምንታዊ እና ወርሀዊ የሂሳብ ሪፖርት በማዘጋጀት ለስራ አመራር ቦርዱ ማቅረብ፤

ሌሎች በስራ አመራር ቦርዱ የሚታዘዙ ስራዎችን መስራት፡፡

መስፈርቱን የምታሟሉ ተወዳዳሪዎች ይህ ማስታወቂያ በወጣ በ5 (አምስት) ተከታታይ የስራ ቀናት በፌም የጋራ ህንፃ የቤት ባለቤቶች ማህበር ጽ/ቤት በአካል በመቅረብ የትምህርት እና የስራ ልምድ ማስረጃችሁን በማቅረብ መመዝገብ ትችላላችሁ።

በማህበራት ውስጥ የስራ ልምድ ላላቸው ቅድሚያ እንሰጣለን።ማሳሰቢያ፡ መስፈርቱን አሟልቶ ለሚቀጠር/ለምትቀጠር ሰራተኛ የ 20‚000.00 (ሃያ ሺ) ብር ዋስ ማቅረብ ይጠበቅበታል/ይጠበቅባታል፡፡

title: Senior Accountant (Bakery System Specialist)
description: About Blu Bakery and Pastry: Blu Bakery and Pastry operates two active production and retail branches under two distinct business licenses. Centralized Oversight: Reconcile daily branch sales reports with bank deposits and system logs. Expertise in Peachtree/Sage 50 and Excel. Must be comfortable working from our central office in Tafo.

Job Title:  Hub Supervisor

The project involves audiobook production services for a series of translated books.

title: Nurse Professional
description:
1. Clinical Assessment and Monitoring

The nurse is the "eyes and ears" of the medical team. They are usually the first to notice a change in a patient's condition.

Comprehensive Assessment: Performing head-to-toe physical exams and mental health assessments.
Vital Signs: Monitoring blood pressure, heart rate, oxygen saturation, and temperature to identify trends or emergencies.
Triaging: Prioritizing patients based on the severity of their condition, especially in Emergency or ICU settings.
2. Medication and Treatment Administration

This is one of the most high-risk responsibilities, requiring extreme precision.

The "Six Rights": Ensuring the right patient receives the right drug, right dose, right route, right time, right documentation, and for the right reason.
IV Management: Starting and maintaining intravenous lines and managing complex infusions (like chemotherapy or blood products).
Wound Care: Performing sterile dressing changes and monitoring the healing process of surgical sites or injuries.
3. The Nursing Process (ADPIE)

BSc nurses follow a scientific framework called ADPIE to ensure organized and effective care.

Assessment: Collecting data.
Diagnosis: Identifying the patient's nursing needs (e.g., "Risk for infection").
Planning: Setting goals for the patient's recovery.
Implementation: Carrying out the medical and nursing orders.
Evaluation: Checking if the patient has improved and adjusting the plan if they haven't.
4. Coordination and Advocacy

Nurses act as the bridge between the patient, their family, and the rest of the healthcare team.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Communicating with doctors, pharmacists, physiotherapists, and social workers to coordinate a unified care plan.
Patient Advocacy: Ensuring the patient's wishes are respected and that they understand their rights and treatment options.
Discharge Planning: Preparing the patient to go home by ensuring they have the right medications, follow-up appointments, and home-care knowledge.
5. Leadership and Education

Because of their degree-level training, BSc nurses often take on higher-level organizational tasks:

Supervision: Overseeing Nursing Assistants or Diploma Nurses and delegating tasks safely.
Patient Education: Teaching a diabetic patient how to administer insulin or explaining post-operative care to a family.
Evidence-Based Practice: Applying the latest medical research to hospital protocols to improve patient outcomes.
Summary of Skills Required

SkillWhy it mattersCritical ThinkingTo quickly decide what to do when a patient’s condition drops.CommunicationTo prevent medical errors during handovers between shifts.EmpathyTo provide emotional support during a patient's most vulnerable moments.Technical ProficiencyTo operate complex machinery like ventilators or dialysis .

Maximize consumer engagement with marketing content
Share insights on competitor marketing content

American standard English speaking skills

Experience with teaching English previously (preferred)

Outstanding copywriting, social media, or video production skills
Ability to work effectively without oversight
Confident written and verbal communication skills
Excellent organizational and time-management abilities
Preferred qualifications

Significant experience creating high-quality marketing content
Capable of managing multiple competing priorities
Comprehensive understanding of impactful marketing tactics
Salary: 15,000

title: Laboratory Technician
description:
Job Summary

The Laboratory Technician is responsible for conducting laboratory tests, maintaining laboratory equipment, recording accurate results, and ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards. The role supports operational excellence by providing reliable data for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

1. Perform routine laboratory tests and analyses according to standard operating procedures (SOPs).

2. Prepare samples, reagents, and laboratory equipment for testing.

3. Record, analyze, and report test results accurately and timely.

4. Maintain laboratory equipment and ensure proper calibration.

5. Follow health, safety, and environmental regulations at all times.

6. Maintain cleanliness and organization of the laboratory.

7. Assist in quality control procedures and audits.

8. Monitor inventory of laboratory supplies and request replenishment when needed.

9. Report any equipment malfunction or abnormal test results to the supervisor.

10. Support research, production, or quality assurance teams as required.

Qualifications & Requirements

•Bachelor’s degree in Laboratory Technology, Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, or related field.

• Minimum 1–3 years of laboratory experience (preferred).

• Knowledge of laboratory safety standards and procedures.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Good record-keeping and reporting skills.

• Basic computer skills (MS Office, lab software).

Key Competencies

• Analytical skills

• Attention to detail

• Time management

• Problem-solving ability

• Integrity and confidentiality

• Commitment to quality and operational excellence

title: የአማርኛ ቋንቋ መምህር
description:
​ዋና ዋና የሥራ ኃላፊነቶች

​የአማርኛ ቋንቋን (ሰዋስው፣ ስነ-ጽሁፍ እና ስነ-ቃል) በስርዓተ ትምህርቱ መሰረት ማስተማር።

​ተማሪዎች የማንበብ፣ የመጻፍ፣ የመናገር እና የማዳመጥ ብቃታቸው እንዲዳብር መርዳት።

​የተማሪዎችን የክፍል ስራ፣ የቤት ስራ እና ፈተናዎችን ማዘጋጀትና ማረም።

​የተማሪዎችን የባህሪ እና የትምህርት እድገት መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማቅረብ።

ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች እና መስፈርቶች

​የትምህርት ደረጃ፦ በአማርኛ ቋንቋ እና ስነ-ጽሁፍ (Amharic Language and Literature) የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ያለው/ላት።

​የሥራ ልምድ፦ ቢያንስ 1 ዓመት እና ከዚያ በላይ በማስተማር ስራ ላይ የቆየ/ች።

​ተጨማሪ ክህሎቶች፦

​ጥሩ የመግባባት ችሎታ እና ለሙያው ፍቅር ያለው/ላት።

​ዘመናዊ የመማር ማስተማር ዘዴዎችን መተግበር የሚችል/ትችል።

​የኮምፒውተር አጠቃቀም እውቀት (ለሪፖርት እና ለፈተና ዝግጅት)።

​ደመወዝ እና ጥቅማጥቅሞች

​በድርጅቱ ስኬል መሰረት (የተጣራ ደመዎዝ 13,000 ብር)

​እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል?

​መስፈርቱን የምታሟሉ አመልካቾች የትምህርት ማስረጃችሁን እና የሥራ ልምድ ማረጋገጫችሁን (CV) እስከ 13/06/2018ዓ/ም ድረስ፦

​ በኢሜል felegenewayac21@gmail.com/

የስራው ኃላፊነት፦

አዳዲስ ደንበኞችን መፈለግ እና ስለ አገልግሎታችን ማስተዋወቅ።
ከደንበኞች ለሚነሱ ጥያቄዎች በደስታ ምላሽ መስጠት እና ፍላጎት መፍጠር።
በጥሩ አቀራረብ እና ንግግር ደንበኞች አገልግሎታችንን እንዲጠቀሙ ማድረግ።
ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች፦

ከፍተኛ የተግባቦት ችሎታ፡ ከማንኛውም ሰው ጋር በቀላሉ መግባባት የሚችሉ።
የግብይት ተሰጥኦ፡ አንድን አገልግሎት ማራኪ አድርጎ የማቅረብ ጥበብ ያላቸው።
ተነሳሽነት፡ ያለ ተቆጣጣሪ ስራቸውን በጥራት የሚወጡ።
አዎንታዊ አስተሳሰብ፡ ተስፋ ሳይቆርጡ በደስታ መስራት የሚችሉ።
እኛ ምን እናቀርባለን?

ተወዳዳሪ ደመወዝ እና እንደ ስራዎ ውጤት የሚታሰብ ተጨማሪ ቦነስ (Commission)።
ምቹ እና ለስራ የሚያነሳሳ የቡድን ስራ አካባቢ።

description:
አስቸኳይ የሥራ ማስታወቂያ (Urgent Job Vacancy)

የሥራ መደብ፦ የኮል ሴንተር ባለሙያ (Call Center Agent) የሥራ ቅጥር ሁኔታ፦ በኮንትራት (Contract Based) የሥራ ሰዓት፦ በቀንም ሆነ በማታ በፈረቃ መስራት የምትችል (Flexible Shifts)

መስፈርቶች (Qualifications):

የትምህርት ደረጃ፦ በማንኛውም የትምህርት ዘርፍ ዲግሪ ወይም ዲፕሎማ ያላት።
የቋንቋ ችሎታ፦ አማርኛና እንግሊዝኛ ቋንቋን አቀላጥፋ መናገርና መጻፍ የምትችል።
የቴክኒክ ብቃት፦ መሠረታዊ የኮምፒውተር አጠቃቀም (Basic Computer Skills) ያላትና በቴሌግራም እንዲሁም በሌሎች ሶሻል ሚዲያዎች ፈጣን የሆነች።
ተግባቦት፦ ደንበኞችን በትዕግስት የማስተናገድና የማሳመን ክህሎት (Communication & Persuasion Skills) ያላት።
መኖሪያ አካባቢ፦ ሰፈሯ ለሃያት ቅርብ የሆነች (የማታ ፈረቃ ሲኖር ለትራንስፖርት አመቺነት)።
ልዩ ሁኔታ፦

ጫና የበዛባቸውን ስራዎች ተቋቁማ መስራት የምትችል።

title: ዳቦ ጋጋሪ
description:
የሥራ ማጠቃለያ:

የእኛ ኩባንያ ታማኝና ባለሙያ የሆነ የዳቦ ሰራተኛ በመፈለግ ላይ ነው። እንዲሁም ሰራተኛው ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያላቸው የቤከሪ ምርቶችን እንዲዘጋጁ፣ የምግብ ደህንነትን እንዲጠብቁና የዕለቱን የቤከሪ ሥራ በቀጥታ እንዲያስተካክሉ ይጠይቃል። ትክክለኛ ዝግጅት ማድረግ፣ ትክክለኛ ማስተዳደርና በቡድን ስራ ውስጥ መሥራት የሚችሉ ሰራተኞችን እንፈልጋለን።

ዋና ተግባራት:

በመደበኛ ስርዓት ምርቶችን እንዲዘጋጁ የዳቦና ፓስትሪዎችን ማቅረብ(ክሩሴንት፣ የሙዝ ኬኮች፣ የበርገር ዳቦ፣ ዳቦ
እና ቦምቦሊኖዎች)
የምርት ጥራት፣ ጣዕምና አቀማመጥን ማረጋገጥ
እቃዎችን ትክክለኛ ለመጠን መመዘንና ማቀናበር
የቤከሪ መሣሪያዎችን በደህንነት ማስተዳደር እና በትክክል መጠቀም
የምግብ ደህንነትና ንፁህነት ስርዓቶችን መጠበቅ
በማህደር እቃ ዝግጅት ላይ ማኅተም ማድረግ
የእቃ እና ዕቃ አቅርቦትን መከታተል እና ችግር እንዳይፈጠር ማስታወቂያ ማድረግ
አዳዲስ ተቀላቀለዎችን በማጠቃለያ መርምር ማገዝ
የኩባንያ ፖሊሲዎችን እና የሥራ ቦታ ደህንነት ህጎችን መከተል

መስፈርቶች:

 

በቤከሪ ሥራ ልምድ ወይም በተመሳሳይ ሥራ ልምድ (መካከለኛ ደረጃ የሆነ)
የዳቦና ፓስትሪ መስሪያዎች ስለሚከተሉ መረጃ እና መሣሪያዎችን መረዳት
የምግብ ደህንነት እና ንፁህነት መሠረት ላይ የተመሠረተ እውቀት
የጊዜ ማስተዳደር ችሎታ እና የሥራ ድጋፍን መስጠት
ዝግጅት ላይ ዝርዝር አቀማመጥ ማድረግ እና ጥራትን ማረጋገጥ
ረጅም ጊዜ ስራ ላይ መቆምና የቤከሪ መሣሪያዎችን ማንቀሳቀስ ችሎታ
የተለዋዋጭ ሰዓት ስራ ላይ መስራት ፈቃድ
ጥሩ የግንኙነት እና ቡድን ስራ ችሎታ
ታማኝነት፣ ትክክለኛነትና የሙያ አመለካከት

title: Technical lead projects
description:
.Key Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end technical development of solutions from architecture design to deployment and maintenance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and our technology partner, to define technical requirements and deliver high-quality features.

• Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance backend and frontend systems using modern frameworks and tools.

• Lead the localization and scaling of the platform’s core architecture, ensuring it is optimized for Ethiopia’s network conditions and device landscape.

• Ensure the platform adheres to best practices in data privacy, security, and compliance with local regulations.

• Mentor and coach a team of developers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Conduct code reviews, optimize system performance, and troubleshoot complex technical issues.

• Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, integrating relevant advancements into the platform.

• Manage project timelines, deliverables, and communication with stakeholders to ensure timely and successful project execution.

Qualifications and Competencies

Required:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in software development, as a technical a leadership or senior architectural role.

• Proficiency in modern backend technologies (e.g., Node.js, Python, Java, or Go) and frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js).

• Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and microservices architecture.

• Strong knowledge of database design and management (SQL and NoSQL databases).

• Familiarity with DevOps tools and practices (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.). Oversee the full CI/CD pipeline, ensuring that deployments are frequent, secure, and resilient

• Strong technical understanding grounded in the local infrastructure integration and act as the primary technical point of contact with partners, ensuring seamless integration of their core technology with localized payment gateways (Telebirr, CBE Birr, National ID).

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically under pressure.

• Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience managing distributed or cross-cultural teams.

Required Technical Competencies

• Backend & Cloud: Proficiency in Node.js, Go, or Python (FastAPI/Django) with deep experience in Microservices architecture and Cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

• Database Management: Expert knowledge of PostgreSQLand NoSQL solutions like MongoDB or Redis for high-speed matching.

• Frontend/Mobile: Familiarity with cross-platform frameworks—specifically Flutter or React Native—to ensure a premium UI/UX.

• Integration Expertise: Proven experience with RESTful/GraphQL APIs and integrating local Fintech/Payment gateways.

• Emerging Tech: Knowledge of AI/Machine Learning (for recommendation engines) and WebSockets (for real-time chat/notifications).

Preferred:

• Experience in building and scaling solutions and platforms.

• A deep understanding of the Ethiopian digital landscape, including connectivity challenges and user behavior.

• Knowledge of data privacy regulations and experience implementing secure authentication and authorization systems in Ethiopia.

• Experience with cross-border technical collaboration

• Understanding of the Ethiopian market and cultural nuances in digital product design.

• Visionary to lead a groundbreaking project with significant social impact.

• A collaborative and inclusive work environment that values innovation and creativity.

What We Offer

• Salary (As per the Company Scale)
