description: የሽያጭ ሰራተኛ ለማመልከት እባክዎ ይህንን ሊንክ ይጠቀሙ (Use this link to APPLY) https://forms.gle/MKQ79DBggfQyC6C68 አድማስዎን ያስፉ፣ ገቢዎን ያሳድጉ! የስራ መደቡ፡ ራሱን የቻለ ከፍተኛ የሽያጭ ባለሙያ (በኮሚሽን ላይ የተመሰረተ) የሕልም ሥራዎ የሚጀምረው እዚህ ነው! እርስዎ ገንዘብን በታታሪነትዎ እና ብልሃትዎ የመፍጠር ጥልቅ ፍላጎት አለዎት? በዲጂታል ዓለም ውስጥ ትልቅ አሻራ መጣል ይፈልጋሉ? ድርጅታችን ከ5 በላይ በሆኑ ዘመናዊ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ሰርቪሶች እና ምርቶች / አገልግሎቶች ላይ ተመስርቶ ያልተገደበ ገቢ የሚያስገኝልዎትን ዕድል ይዞ መጥቷል። ይህ ተራ የሽያጭ ሥራ አይደለም—ይህ የራስዎ የገቢ ንግድ ነው። ለምን ይህ ዕድል ለየት ያለ ነው? 1.💰 ያልተገደበ የኮሚሽን አቅም፡ በኩባንያችን ካሉት ከአምስት በላይ ትርፋማ ምርቶችና አገልግሎቶች የተነሳ፣ እያንዳንዱ ሽያጭዎ ትልቅ ኮሚሽን ይዞ ይመጣል! ገደብዎ የእርስዎ ጥረት ብቻ ነው! 2.🎯 ሙሉ የራስ ገዝ አስተዳደር፡ እኛ "እንመራዎታለን" አንልም—እኛ እንተማመንብዎታለን። እርስዎ ነዎት የገበያ ጥናት የሚያደርጉት፣ ሊድስ (የደንበኛ መረጃ) የሚሰበስቡት እና ሽያጩን ከጅምሩ እስከ መጨረሻው በብቃት የሚዘጉት። 3.🚀 በቴክኖሎጂ አፍላ ዘርፍ መሥራት፡ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት የወደፊቱ ዓለም ነው። በዚህ አስደሳችና ተፈላጊ ዘርፍ ውስጥ ቁልፍ ባለቤት ይሁኑ። የእርስዎ ዋና ኃላፊነቶች (የእርስዎ የኃይል ማመንጫ) እኛ የምንፈልገው በቂ ልምድ ያለው፣ ስልጠና የማይሻ እና ሥራውን በራሱ ተረድቶ በፍጥነት ሽያጭ የሚያስመዘግብ ባለሙያ ነው። የራስዎን የደንበኛ መረጃ (ሊድስ)(Lead Generation): የመፈለጊያ ዘዴዎች በመጠቀም ሽያጮችን በፍጥነት ማመንጨት እና ማጠናቀቅ። የምርት ሻምፒዮን መሆን፡ በተለይም የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) መድረካችንን ለደንበኞች በሚማርክ ሁኔታ መግለጽ እና መሸጥ። oበቅርቡ ለምናደርገው የኦንላይን ትምህርት መድረክ ምረቃ የሽያጭ ቅድመ ዝግጅት መሪ መሆን። oለፕሮጀክቱ ስኬት የሚያስፈልጉ ስፖንሰርሺፖችን መፈለግና ማምጣት። የስኬት አስተዳደር፡ የዕለታዊ የሽያጭ ጥረቶችዎን እና የሥራ እንቅስቃሴዎን ግልጽ በሆነ ሁኔታ ሪፖርት ማድረግ። መስፈርቶች (እርስዎ መሆን ያለብዎት) በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ማኔጅመንት፣ ቢዝነስ አስተዳደር ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ የመጀመሪያ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ከዛ በላይ። ስለ ዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ ጥልቅ እውቀት እና ሽያጭ በማምጣት የተረጋገጠ፣ ሰፊ የስራ ልምድ። ስራዎችን በግልጽ እና በብቃት የመግለጽ ችሎታ። ምርጥ የመግባባት፣ የግንኙነት መፍጠር እና የሪፖርት አቀራረብ ችሎታ። በራሱ ተነሳሽነት የመስራት እና ለሽያጭ ግቦች ከፍተኛ ኃላፊነት የመውሰድ ብቃት። ቀጣዩ እርምጃዎ (ሕይወትዎን ይቀይሩ) ይህንን አስደናቂ የኮሚሽን ዕድል ለመጠቀም ዝግጁ ከሆኑ፡- መስፈርቶቹን የምታሟሉ አመልካቾች የስራ ልምዳችሁን (CV) እና ተዛማጅ ሰነዶችን በሚከተለው አድራሻ እንድትልኩ እንጋብዛለን፡ ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ቀን ጀምሮ ባሉት 10 ተከታታይ የስራ ቀናት ውስጥ እንጠብቃለን። Super Boost-Up - ገቢዎን በሙሉ አቅሙ የሚያሳድጉበት ቦታ! ደሞዝ :6,000 6%ኮሚሽን ቴሌግራም፦ @Supervacancy1 • ፎርም ለመሙላት፦ እዚህ ይጫኑ • ስልክ፦ 0924908889 አድራሻ፡ ከመካኒሳ ወደ ጀርመን በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ የኪራይ ቤቶች ህንፃ ላይ 2ኛ ፎቅ።

title: የኮንቴንት ክሬተር እና ካስቲንግ ዳይሬክተር
description:
የኮንቴንት ክሬተር እና ካስቲንግ ዳይሬክተር

ለማመልከት እባክዎ ይህንን ሊንክ ይጠቀሙ (Use this link to APPLY)

https://forms.gle/MfsRZvQNK59zDkmu5

ከከፍተኛ የፈጠራ ባለሙያዎች ጋር በመሆን ስምዎን የሚገነቡበት ትልቅ እድል!
ድርጅታችን በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ፣ በኦንላይን ስልጠና እና በማማከር ስራ ላይ የተሰማራ ቀዳሚ ተቋም ነው። አሁን ደግሞ ስራዎቻችንን ወደ ላቀ ደረጃ ለማድረስ፣ በዘመናዊ የቴክኖሎጂ ውጤቶች በተሟላ የፕሮፌሽናል ፕሮዳክሽን ስቱዲዮ ውስጥ አብሮን የሚሰራ ብቁ ኮንቴንት ክሬተር እና ካስቲንግ ዳይሬክተር እንፈልጋለን።
በተለይም የተዋጣለት የፖድካስት (Podcast) ዝግጅት ልምድ ያላችሁ እና ራሳችሁን እንደ ብራንድ ማሳደግ የምትፈልጉ ባለሙያዎች ቅድሚያ እንሰጣለን።
እኛ የምናቀርባቸው ልዩ ጥቅሞች
• ዘመናዊ ስቱዲዮ፦ ሙሉ ጥራት ባላቸው የካሜራ፣ የድምፅ እና የብርሃን መሳሪያዎች የተደራጀ የቪዲዮ እና የፖድካስት ስቱዲዮ።
• የግል ብራንድ ግንባታ፦ ፕሮፌሽናል በሆነ መልኩ በቪዲዮዎች ላይ በመታየት ራስዎን ለገበያ የሚያስተዋውቁበት እድል።
• ምቹ የስራ አካባቢ፦ ስራን በስርአት እና በቴክኖሎጂ ለመስራት የሚያስችል የተደራጀ ቢሮ።
ዋና ዋና የስራ ኃላፊነቶች
• የፈጠራ ስራዎች፦ ለተለያዩ የሶሻል ሚዲያ ገጾች (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook) የሚሆኑ አዝናኝ እና አስተማሪ የሆኑ የቪዲዮ ሃሳቦችን ማመንጨት።
• ካስቲንግ እና ፖድካስት፦ ለቪዲዮ ቀረጻ የሚሆኑ ባለሙያዎችን መምረጥ (Casting) እና ልምድ ባለው መልኩ የፖድካስት/የቃለ-መጠይቅ ፕሮግራሞችን መምራት።
• የኮርስ ዝግጅት፦ ለኦንላይን ስልጠናዎች የሚሆኑ ማኑዋሎችን እና የትምህርት ይዘቶችን ማዘጋጀት።
• እቅድ ማውጣት፦ ሳምንታዊ እና ወርሃዊ የኮንቴንት ካላንደር ማዘጋጀት እና ስራዎችን መከታተል።
• ድምፅ እና ቪዲዮ፦ ፕሮፌሽናል የሆኑ የቮይስ ኦቨር (Voiceover) ስራዎችን መስራት እና በቪዲዮ ኤዲቲንግ ስራ ላይ መሳተፍ።
ተፈላጊ ችሎታዎች እና ዝግጅት
• ትምህርት፦ በመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ በJournalism, Communication, Marketing ወይም ተዛማጅ መስኮች የተመረቀ/ች።
• ልምድ፦ በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና በኮንቴንት ፈጠራ ቢያንስ የ2 ዓመት ልምድ ያለው/ላት።
• ተሰጥኦ፦ በካሜራ ፊት የመቅረብ ከፍተኛ በራስ መተማመን እና ተጫዋች ስብዕና (Sense of humor)።
• ቴክኒካዊ ችሎታ፦ በቪዲዮ ኤዲቲንግ (Premiere/CapCut) እና ግራፊክስ ዲዛይን (Photoshop/Canva) ላይ እውቀቱ ቢኖረው/ራት ይመረጣል።
እንዴት ማመልከት ይቻላል?

አድማስዎን ያስፉ፣ ገቢዎን ያሳድጉ!
የስራ መደቡ፡ ራሱን የቻለ ከፍተኛ የሽያጭ ባለሙያ (በኮሚሽን ላይ የተመሰረተ)
የሕልም ሥራዎ የሚጀምረው እዚህ ነው!
እርስዎ ገንዘብን በታታሪነትዎ እና ብልሃትዎ የመፍጠር ጥልቅ ፍላጎት አለዎት? በዲጂታል ዓለም ውስጥ ትልቅ አሻራ መጣል ይፈልጋሉ? ድርጅታችን ከ5 በላይ በሆኑ ዘመናዊ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ሰርቪሶች እና ምርቶች / አገልግሎቶች ላይ ተመስርቶ ያልተገደበ ገቢ የሚያስገኝልዎትን ዕድል ይዞ መጥቷል።
ይህ ተራ የሽያጭ ሥራ አይደለም—ይህ የራስዎ የገቢ ንግድ ነው።
ለምን ይህ ዕድል ለየት ያለ ነው?
1.💰 ያልተገደበ የኮሚሽን አቅም፡ በኩባንያችን ካሉት ከአምስት በላይ ትርፋማ ምርቶችና አገልግሎቶች የተነሳ፣ እያንዳንዱ ሽያጭዎ ትልቅ ኮሚሽን ይዞ ይመጣል! ገደብዎ የእርስዎ ጥረት ብቻ ነው!
2.🎯 ሙሉ የራስ ገዝ አስተዳደር፡ እኛ "እንመራዎታለን" አንልም—እኛ እንተማመንብዎታለን። እርስዎ ነዎት የገበያ ጥናት የሚያደርጉት፣ ሊድስ (የደንበኛ መረጃ) የሚሰበስቡት እና ሽያጩን ከጅምሩ እስከ መጨረሻው በብቃት የሚዘጉት።
3.🚀 በቴክኖሎጂ አፍላ ዘርፍ መሥራት፡ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት የወደፊቱ ዓለም ነው። በዚህ አስደሳችና ተፈላጊ ዘርፍ ውስጥ ቁልፍ ባለቤት ይሁኑ።

የእርስዎ ዋና ኃላፊነቶች (የእርስዎ የኃይል ማመንጫ)
እኛ የምንፈልገው በቂ ልምድ ያለው፣ ስልጠና የማይሻ እና ሥራውን በራሱ ተረድቶ በፍጥነት ሽያጭ የሚያስመዘግብ ባለሙያ ነው።
የራስዎን የደንበኛ መረጃ (ሊድስ)(Lead Generation): የመፈለጊያ ዘዴዎች በመጠቀም ሽያጮችን በፍጥነት ማመንጨት እና ማጠናቀቅ።
የምርት ሻምፒዮን መሆን፡ በተለይም የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) መድረካችንን ለደንበኞች በሚማርክ ሁኔታ መግለጽ እና መሸጥ።
oበቅርቡ ለምናደርገው የኦንላይን ትምህርት መድረክ ምረቃ የሽያጭ ቅድመ ዝግጅት መሪ መሆን።
oለፕሮጀክቱ ስኬት የሚያስፈልጉ ስፖንሰርሺፖችን መፈለግና ማምጣት።
የስኬት አስተዳደር፡ የዕለታዊ የሽያጭ ጥረቶችዎን እና የሥራ እንቅስቃሴዎን ግልጽ በሆነ ሁኔታ ሪፖርት ማድረግ።

መስፈርቶች (እርስዎ መሆን ያለብዎት)
በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ማኔጅመንት፣ ቢዝነስ አስተዳደር ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ የመጀመሪያ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ከዛ በላይ።
ስለ ዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ ጥልቅ እውቀት እና ሽያጭ በማምጣት የተረጋገጠ፣ ሰፊ የስራ ልምድ።
ስራዎችን በግልጽ እና በብቃት የመግለጽ ችሎታ።
ምርጥ የመግባባት፣ የግንኙነት መፍጠር እና የሪፖርት አቀራረብ ችሎታ።
በራሱ ተነሳሽነት የመስራት እና ለሽያጭ ግቦች ከፍተኛ ኃላፊነት የመውሰድ ብቃት።

ቀጣዩ እርምጃዎ (ሕይወትዎን ይቀይሩ)
ይህንን አስደናቂ የኮሚሽን ዕድል ለመጠቀም ዝግጁ ከሆኑ፡-

description:
የስራ መደቡ፡ የሽያጭ ሱፐርቫይዘር

Super Boost-Up በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና በኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) ዘርፍ የሚሰራ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ ነው።
ድርጅታችንን ወደ ስኬት ለመምራት የሚያስችል ከፍተኛ ልምድ እና ተነሳሽነት ያለውየሽያጭሰራተኛ ሱፐርቫይዘር እየፈለግን ነው። ተመራጩ እጩ በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ ላይ ጥልቅ ግንዛቤ ያለው እና ሽያጭ በማምጣት የተረጋገጠ የስራ ልምድ ያለው መሆን አለበት። እኛ ስልጠና የምንሰጠው ሳይሆን በቂ ልምድ ያለው እና ስራውን ተረድቶ በራሱ መስራት የሚችል፣ ለሽያጭ ግባችን አስተዋፅኦ ማድረግ የሚችል ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን። በተለይም የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) መድረካችንን የኦንላይን የስራ ቅጥር በቅርቡ ለምናደርገው ምረቃ ስኬታማነት የበላይነትን መውሰድ የሚችል ሰው እንፈልጋለን።

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች፡-

· ሽያጭ እና ገቢ ማመንጨት፡ የኩባንያውን ሽያጭ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ለመጨመር እና የገቢ ግቦችን ለማሳካት ስልቶችን ማዘጋጀት እና መተግበር። ይህ ዋና ኃላፊነት ሲሆን፣ ሱፐርቫይዘሩ አዳዲስ ስራዎችን ማመጣት ዋናው ስራ ነው፡፡

· የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) መድረክ ምረቃ እና አስተባባሪነት:

o የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) መድረክ ምረቃ ዝግጅቶችን ሙሉ በሙሉ ማስተባበር እና ስኬታማነቱን ማረጋገጥ።

o ስፖንሰርሺፖችን መፈለግ እና ማምጣት።

o ዩ እንግዶችን መጋበዝ እና ምረቃው በትክክል እንዲካሄድ ማመቻቸት።

o ይህንን ፕሮጀክት ከዲጂታል ስራዎቻችን ጋር በማጣመር ስኬታማነቱን ማረጋገጥ።

· ስትራቴጂያዊ እቅድ እና አፈጻጸም፡ የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ እንቅስቃሴ ማቀድ፣ ማደራጀት፣ አጠቃላይ የድርጅቱን ስራ ማቀድ፣ ማደራጀት፣ መምራት እና መቆጣጠር።

· የኤል.ኤም.ኤስ. ፕላትፎርም ይዘት ስራ መከታተል እና ጥራቱን ማረጋገጥ።

· ምልመላ እና አዲስ ሰራተኞችን ማቀናጀት (እንደ አስፈላጊነቱ)፡ አስፈላጊ በሚሆንበት ጊዜ አዳዲስ ሰራተኞችን በመመልመል፣ በማሰልጠን እና በመቅጠር ሂደት ውስጥ መሳተፍ።

መስፈርቶች፡-

· የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ማኔጅመንት፣ ቢዝነስ አስተዳደር፣ ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ።

· በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና በሽያጭ ማምጣት የተረጋገጠ ሰፊ ልምድ ያለው።

· የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) መድረኮችን የሚያውቅ እና የምረቃ ዝግጅቶችን የማስተባበር ችሎታ ያለው።

title: የሽያጭ ሰራተኛ
description:
አድማስዎን ያስፉ፣ ገቢዎን ያሳድጉ!
የስራ መደቡ፡ ራሱን የቻለ ከፍተኛ የሽያጭ ባለሙያ (በኮሚሽን ላይ የተመሰረተ)
የሕልም ሥራዎ የሚጀምረው እዚህ ነው!
እርስዎ ገንዘብን በታታሪነትዎ እና ብልሃትዎ የመፍጠር ጥልቅ ፍላጎት አለዎት? በዲጂታል ዓለም ውስጥ ትልቅ አሻራ መጣል ይፈልጋሉ? ድርጅታችን ከ5 በላይ በሆኑ ዘመናዊ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ሰርቪሶች እና ምርቶች / አገልግሎቶች ላይ ተመስርቶ ያልተገደበ ገቢ የሚያስገኝልዎትን ዕድል ይዞ መጥቷል።
ይህ ተራ የሽያጭ ሥራ አይደለም—ይህ የራስዎ የገቢ ንግድ ነው።
ለምን ይህ ዕድል ለየት ያለ ነው?
1.💰 ያልተገደበ የኮሚሽን አቅም፡ በኩባንያችን ካሉት ከአምስት በላይ ትርፋማ ምርቶችና አገልግሎቶች የተነሳ፣ እያንዳንዱ ሽያጭዎ ትልቅ ኮሚሽን ይዞ ይመጣል! ገደብዎ የእርስዎ ጥረት ብቻ ነው!
2.🎯 ሙሉ የራስ ገዝ አስተዳደር፡ እኛ "እንመራዎታለን" አንልም—እኛ እንተማመንብዎታለን። እርስዎ ነዎት የገበያ ጥናት የሚያደርጉት፣ ሊድስ (የደንበኛ መረጃ) የሚሰበስቡት እና ሽያጩን ከጅምሩ እስከ መጨረሻው በብቃት የሚዘጉት።
3.🚀 በቴክኖሎጂ አፍላ ዘርፍ መሥራት፡ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት የወደፊቱ ዓለም ነው። በዚህ አስደሳችና ተፈላጊ ዘርፍ ውስጥ ቁልፍ ባለቤት ይሁኑ።

የእርስዎ ዋና ኃላፊነቶች (የእርስዎ የኃይል ማመንጫ)
እኛ የምንፈልገው በቂ ልምድ ያለው፣ ስልጠና የማይሻ እና ሥራውን በራሱ ተረድቶ በፍጥነት ሽያጭ የሚያስመዘግብ ባለሙያ ነው።
የራስዎን የደንበኛ መረጃ (ሊድስ)(Lead Generation): የመፈለጊያ ዘዴዎች በመጠቀም ሽያጮችን በፍጥነት ማመንጨት እና ማጠናቀቅ።
የምርት ሻምፒዮን መሆን፡ በተለይም የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) መድረካችንን ለደንበኞች በሚማርክ ሁኔታ መግለጽ እና መሸጥ።
oበቅርቡ ለምናደርገው የኦንላይን ትምህርት መድረክ ምረቃ የሽያጭ ቅድመ ዝግጅት መሪ መሆን።
oለፕሮጀክቱ ስኬት የሚያስፈልጉ ስፖንሰርሺፖችን መፈለግና ማምጣት።
የስኬት አስተዳደር፡ የዕለታዊ የሽያጭ ጥረቶችዎን እና የሥራ እንቅስቃሴዎን ግልጽ በሆነ ሁኔታ ሪፖርት ማድረግ።

መስፈርቶች (እርስዎ መሆን ያለብዎት)
በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ማኔጅመንት፣ ቢዝነስ አስተዳደር ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ የመጀመሪያ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ከዛ በላይ።
ስለ ዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ ጥልቅ እውቀት እና ሽያጭ በማምጣት የተረጋገጠ፣ ሰፊ የስራ ልምድ።
ስራዎችን በግልጽ እና በብቃት የመግለጽ ችሎታ።
ምርጥ የመግባባት፣ የግንኙነት መፍጠር እና የሪፖርት አቀራረብ ችሎታ።
በራሱ ተነሳሽነት የመስራት እና ለሽያጭ ግቦች ከፍተኛ ኃላፊነት የመውሰድ ብቃት።

ቀጣዩ እርምጃዎ (ሕይወትዎን ይቀይሩ)

title: አርክቴክት እና ግራፊክ ዲዛይነር (Architect & Graphic Designer)
description:
ድርጅታችን በዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ፣ በማማከር እና በስልጠና ዘርፍ ግንባር ቀደም ተመራጭ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት በሥነ-ሕንጻ (Architecture) እና በውስጥ ዲዛይን (Interior Design) ዘርፍ ጥልቅ እውቀት ያለው፣ በተለይም በቤት ዕቃዎች (Furniture) እና በውስጥ ማስዋብ ሥራ ላይ ፍላጎትና ተሰጥኦ ያለው፣ እንዲሁም የግራፊክ ዲዛይን ክህሎቱን ለዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ ሥራዎቻችን ማዋል የሚችል ብቁ ባለሙያ እንፈልጋለን።

ልዩ ማሳሰቢያ፦ ይህ የሥራ መደብ በቢሮ ውስጥ የሚሰሩ የዲዛይን ሥራዎችን እና በሥራ ቦታ (On-site) የሚከናወኑ የክትትልና የቅየሳ ሥራዎችን ያካተተ ነው። ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት እና ከዚያ በላይ በተረጋገጠ የሥራ ልምድ ላይ ያላችሁ ባለሙያዎች ብቻ እንድታመለክቱ እናሳስባለን።

የሥራው ዋና ኃላፊነቶች

የሥነ-ሕንጻ እና የውስጥ ዲዛይን፦ ለመኖሪያ ቤቶች፣ ለንግድ ተቋማት እና ለተለያዩ ሕንፃዎች ፕላን ማዘጋጀት፣ የቤት ዕቃዎች (Furniture) እና የውስጥ ዲዛይን ሥራዎችን መሥራት።

የሳይት ክትትል እና ቅየሳ (Survey)፦ የግንባታ ቦታዎችን በመጎብኘት ልኬቶችን መውሰድ፣ ለጨረታ የሚሆኑ የዋጋ ግምቶችን (Estimation) ማዘጋጀት (ለምሳሌ፦ ለበሮች፣ ለኩሽና ካቢኔቶች እና ለፊኒሺንግ ሥራዎች)።

የግራፊክ ዲዛይን ሥራዎች፦ ለተለያዩ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ አማራጮች የሚሆኑ ጥራት ያላቸው የግራፊክስ ሥራዎችን እና የፕሮጀክት ማቅረቢያዎችን (Presentations) ማዘጋጀት።

የፕሮጀክት አስተዳደር፦ የፕሮጀክቶችን የጊዜ ሰሌዳ፣ በጀት እና ግብዓቶችን በአግባቡ መምራት።

የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች

ትምህርት፦ በመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ በሥነ-ሕንጻ (Architecture) የተመረቀ/ች።

ልምድ፦ በዘርፉ ቢያንስ 2 ዓመት የተረጋገጠ የሥራ ልምድ ያለው/ላት።

የሶፍትዌር ክህሎት፦ * በአርክቴክቸር ሶፍትዌሮች (AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit እና Rendering softwares) ላይ ከፍተኛ ብቃት።

በግራፊክ ዲዛይን ሶፍትዌሮች (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) ላይ ጥልቅ እውቀት።

ተጨማሪ ፍላጎት፦ በቤት ዕቃዎች ዲዛይን (Furniture Design) እና በውስጥ ዲዛይን (Interior Design) ላይ ልዩ ፍላጎትና ፈጠራ ያለው/ላት።

ጥቅማጥቅሞች

የሥራ ሁኔታ፦ በቢሮ እና በሥራ ቦታ (On-site) የሚከናወን።

ማመልከቻው የሚያበቃበት ቀን፦ ይህ ማስታወቂያ ከወጣበት ቀን ጀምሮ ባሉት ተከታታይ የሥራ ቀናት ውስጥ።

description:
Beleqet E-learning የግራፊክስ ዲዛይን እና የዩቲዩብ ይዘት ፈጠራን በኦንላይን የሚያስተምሩ ብቁ አስተማሪዎችን ይፈልጋል። በተጨማሪም

· ዩቲዩብ youtuber

· AI

· forex trade ፎሬክስ/ ክሪፕቶ

· Upwork

· ፕሮግራሚንግ

· ቋንቋ ቻይንኛ …..

o እና ሌሎች ተማሪዎች ገቢ ሊያስገኙ በሚችሉ ዘርፎች ልምድ ላላቸው ቅድሚያ እንሰጣለን።

የምንፈልጋቸው አስተማሪዎች:

· የተዘጋጀ የቪዲዮ ኮርስ ያላችሁ: አስቀድሞ የተዘጋጀ የቪዲዮ ትምህርት (በማንዋል የታገዘ) ላላችሁ ቅድሚያ እንሰጣለን።

· በራሳችሁ ቀረጻ መስራት የምትችሉ: የትምህርት ማንዋል ያላችሁ እና የቪዲዮ ቀረጻና ኤዲቲንግ በራሳችሁ መስራት የምትችሉ ከሆናችሁ።

· በእኛ ስቱዲዮ የሚሰሩ: የትምህርት ማንዋል ያላችሁ እና በእኛ ዘመናዊ ስቱዲዮ በመቅረጽ የኦንላይን ኮርስ ማዘጋጀት የምትችሉ ከሆናችሁ።

ከእኛ ጋር ሲሰሩ የሚያገኟቸው ጥቅሞች:

· ዘመናዊ የፕሮዳክሽን ድጋፍ: ትምህርቶን በጥራት ለመቅረጽ የሚያስችሉ ዘመናዊ መሳሪያዎች፣ ስቱዲዮ እና ባለሙያዎች ይቀርብልዎታል።

· የባለሙያዎች ጥምረት: ከልምድ ካላቸው ፕሮፌሽናል አስተማሪዎች ጋር በመስራት የማስተማር አቅምዎንና ልምድዎን ያሳድጋሉ።

· ዓለም አቀፍ ተደራሽነት: ትምህርቶን ከሀገር ውስጥ አልፎ በመላው ዓለም ለሚገኙ ተማሪዎች ማድረስ ይችላሉ።

· የራስዎን ብራንድ መገንባት: በእኛ ፕላትፎርም አማካኝነት እራስዎን እንደ ባለሙያ ብራንድ ያደርጋሉ።

· ቋሚ ገቢ (Passive Income): ለረጅም ጊዜ የሚቀጥል ገቢ ያገኛሉ።

መስፈርቶች:

· በግራፊክስ ዲዛይን/ዩቲዩብ ዘርፍ ቢያንስ የሶስት አመት የማስተማርና የማሰልጠን ልምድ።

· ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያለው ትምህርታዊ ይዘት የማዘጋጀትና የማቅረብ ክህሎት።

· ጠንካራ እራስን የመግለጽ (presentation) ክህሎት።

· የተማሪዎችን ፍላጎት ማሟላት የሚችል የማስተማር ዘዴ።

· በኦንላይን የማስተማር እውቀትና ልምድ ያለው/ያላት ቅድሚያ ያገኛል።

title: Finance / Accounting
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Finance Manager to lead our financial operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for safeguarding the organization’s financial health, ensuring that all resources are managed efficiently to support our mission-driven projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Financial Oversight: Direct all financial planning, including the management of cash flow, investments, and organizational assets to ensure long-term sustainability.
Budgetary Management: Lead the development, implementation, and monitoring of complex multi-million dollar budgets, ensuring departmental spending aligns with organizational goals.
Donor Compliance & Grants Management: Ensure strict adherence to international donor regulations (such as USAID, EU, and UN standards). Oversee grant tracking and ensure all expenditures are eligible and documented.
Financial Reporting: Prepare high-quality monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Deliver insightful financial analysis to the executive leadership team to aid in decision-making.
Audit & Internal Controls: Coordinate internal and external audit processes. Maintain and strengthen internal control systems to mitigate risk and ensure 100% transparency.
Team Leadership: Supervise and mentor the finance team, fostering a culture of professional growth, accuracy, and accountability

title: ሲኒየር አካውንታንት (Senior Accountant)
description:
ለፋብሪካችን የፋይናንስ እንቅስቃሴ ከፍተኛ አስተዋጽኦ የሚያበረክት፣ የሂሳብ መዝገቦችን በሰዓቱና በጥራት የሚይዝ እንዲሁም የመንግስትን የታክስ ህጎች ተከትሎ የሚሰራ ቁርጠኛ ሲኒየር አካውንታንት እንፈልጋለን።

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች፦

የፋይናንስ ሪፖርት ዝግጅት፦ ወርሃዊ እና ዓመታዊ የፋይናንስ መግለጫዎችን (Financial Statements) በጥራት ማዘጋጀትና ለበላይ ኃላፊዎች ማቅረብ።
የታክስ አስተዳደር፦ የድርጅቱን የቫት (VAT)፣ የገቢ ግብር እና ሌሎች የመንግስት ታክሶችን በሰዓቱ ማስላትና ማሳወቅ (Tax Filing)።
የመዝገብ አያያዝ፦ የፋብሪካውን የዕለት ተዕለት የገንዘብ እንቅስቃሴዎች በጠቅላላ መዝገብ (General Ledger) ላይ በትክክል መመዝገባቸውን ማረጋገጥ።
የውስጥ ኦዲት፦ በየጊዜው የውስጥ ኦዲት በማካሄድ የፋይናንስ ስህተቶች እንዳይፈጠሩ መከታተልና ማስተካከል።
የባንክ ሂሳብ ማስታረቅ፦ የድርጅቱን የባንክ እንቅስቃሴዎች ከሂሳብ መዝገቡ ጋር በየጊዜው ማስታረቅ (Reconciliation)።
የንብረት ቁጥጥር፦ የፋብሪካውን ቋሚ እና ተንቀሳቃሽ ንብረቶች የሂሳብ መዝገብ መቆጣጠር።
የሚፈለጉ መስፈርቶች፦

ትምህርት፦ በአካውንቲንግ ወይም በተመሳሳይ የትምህርት ዘርፍ የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ (BA Degree) ያለው/ላት።
ልምድ፦ ቢያንስ 4 ዓመት እና ከዚያ በላይ በተመሳሳይ የሥራ መደብ ላይ የሰራ/ች (በማኑፋክቸሪንግ ዘርፍ ቢሆን ይመረጣል)።
ቴክኒካዊ ችሎታ፦ በPeachtree ወይም በሌሎች የሂሳብ ሶፍትዌሮች እና በኤክሴል (Excel) ላይ ከፍተኛ ክህሎት ያለው/ላት።
እውቀት፦ ስለ ኢትዮጵያ የታክስ ህግ እና ስለ IFRS የሂሳብ አያያዝ ስታንዳርድ ጥልቅ እውቀት ያለው/ላት።

title: Relationship Manager (Corporate Banking)
description:
• ከትላልቅ የንግድ ድርጅቶች ጋር መልካም ግንኙነት መፍጠር፣ የባንኩን የብድርና ቁጠባ ምርቶች ማስተዋወቅ እና ደንበኞችን ማፍራት።
  • Build relationships with corporate clients, promote loan and deposit products, and expand the bank's client base.

title: Branch Manager (Grade I)
description:
•  የቅርንጫፉን የዕለት ተዕለት ስራዎች መምራት፣ የተቀማጭ ገንዘብ መጠንን ማሳደግ እና የደንበኞችን አገልግሎት ጥራት ማረጋገጥ።
  • Lead daily branch operations, drive deposit growth targets, and ensure excellence in customer service delivery.

title: IT Security Specialist
description:
• የባንኩን ዲጂታል መረጃዎች ደህንነት መጠበቅ፣ የሳይበር ጥቃቶችን መከላከል እና የደህንነት ሲስተሞችን ማዘመን።
  • Secure the bank's digital assets, prevent cyber threats, and maintain up-to-date security protocols and systems.

title: Senior Auditor
description:
• የባንኩን የውስጥ አሰራር እና ፋይናንስ መመርመር፣ የህግ ተገዥነትን ማረጋገጥ እና የአሰራር ግድፈቶችን ሪፖርት ማድረግ።
  • Audit internal operations and finances, ensure regulatory compliance, and report operational gaps to management

title: Health Coordinator
description:
• የጤና ፕሮግራሞችን በበላይነት መምራት፣ የቴክኒክ ድጋፍ መስጠት እና ከለጋሾች ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ማስተባበር።
  • Oversee health programs, provide technical guidance, and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure project success and quality healthcare delivery.

title: Grant Finance Manager
description:
• ከለጋሾች የሚገኝን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ በአግባቡ ማስተዳደር፣ የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት እና የፕሮጀክት በጀቶች ከድርጅቱ ህግ ጋር መጣጣማቸውን ማረጋገጥ።
  • Manage grant funds effectively, prepare financial reports, and ensure project budgets comply with donor regulations and organizational policies.

title: Senior MEAL Manager
description:
• የፕሮጀክቶችን ውጤታማነት መከታተል፣ ግምገማዎችን ማካሄድ እና የጥራት ቁጥጥር ስርአቶችን መዘርጋት።
  • Lead monitoring and evaluation frameworks, conduct impact assessments, and ensure organizational accountability standards across all programs.

title: Emergency Response Manager
description:
• የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ እርዳታ ፕሮጀክቶችን ማቀድ፣ መምራት እና ውጤታማነታቸውን ማረጋገጥ፤ እንዲሁም ከአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ጋር ቅንጅት መፍጠር።
  • Plan and lead emergency response projects, ensure operational efficiency, and coordinate with local authorities for effective humanitarian aid delivery.

title: Logistics Manager
description:
• የድርጅቱን የአቅርቦት ሰንሰለት (Supply Chain) በበላይነት መቆጣጠር፣ ግዢዎችን ማፋጠን እና መጋዘኖችን በስርአት ማስተዳደር።
  • Oversee the supply chain cycle, streamline procurement processes, and ensure efficient warehouse and asset management in the region.

title: Senior Project Officer - Agriculture
description:
• የግብርና እና የምግብ ዋስትና ፕሮጀክቶችን በቴክኒክ መደገፍ፣ አርሶ አደሮችን ማሰልጠን እና የመስክ ስራዎችን መከታተል።
  • Provide technical support for agriculture and food security projects, train smallholder farmers, and monitor field implementation quality.

title: WASH Coordinator (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene)
description:
• የንጹህ መጠጥ ውሃ እና የንጽህና መጠበቂያ ፕሮጀክቶችን በበላይነት ማስተባበር፣ ዲዛይኖችን መመርመር እና ግንባታዎችን መቆጣጠር።
  • Coordinate water and sanitation projects, review technical engineering designs, and supervise construction and hygiene promotion activities.

title: Women's Rights Policy Lead
description:
• የሴቶችን መብት የሚያስከብሩ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ጥናት ማድረግ፣ ተሟጋችነት (Advocacy) መስራት እና የግንዛቤ ማስጨበጫ ስራዎችን መምራት።
  • Conduct research on women's rights policies, lead advocacy campaigns, and influence national strategies for gender equality and empowerment.

title: Protection Team Leader
description:
• የተፈናቃዮችን መብት መጠበቅ፣ የስነ-ልቦና ድጋፍ ስራዎችን ማስተባበር እና ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል የሚሰሩ ቡድኖችን መምራት።
  • Lead protection monitoring activities, coordinate psychosocial support, and manage teams focused on preventing human rights violations in displacement sites.

title: Logistics Manager
description:
• የድርጅቱን የአቅርቦት ሰንሰለት (Supply Chain) በበላይነት መምራት፣ የግዢ ስርአቶችን ማስተባበር፣ የመጋዘንና የንብረት አስተዳደርን በብቃት መቆጣጠር እንዲሁም በመስክ ቢሮዎች ያለውን የሎጂስቲክስ እንቅስቃሴ ማሳለጥ።
  • Manage overall supply chain operations, oversee procurement processes, ensure efficient warehouse and asset management, and streamline logistics activities in field offices to support humanitarian programs.

title: Branch Manager (Grade-I)
description:
• የቅርንጫፉን አጠቃላይ የባንክ ኦፕሬሽን መምራት፣ ደንበኞችን ማፍራት እና የትርፍ ግቦችን ማሳካት።
  • Lead branch operations, drive business development, and ensure the achievement of financial targets while maintaining high customer service standards.

title: Senior IS Auditor
description:
• የባንኩን የኢንፎርሜሽን ሲስተም ደህንነት መመርመር፣ የቴክኖሎጂ አሰራር ስጋቶችን መለየት እና የማስተካከያ ሃሳቦችን ማቅረብ።
  • Audit the bank's information systems, identify technology risks, and provide recommendations to enhance system security and operational efficiency.
  • ደሞዝ፡ በባንኩ ስኬል መሰረት (ከፍተኛ)

title: Senior Credit Analyst
description:
• የብድር ጥያቄዎችን መመርመር፣ የደንበኞችን የፋይናንስ አቅም መገምገም እና የአደጋ ስጋቶችን መቀነስ።
  • Analyze loan applications, evaluate financial stability of clients, and mitigate credit risks for the bank.

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
• የባንኩን የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ጥራት ማሻሻል፣ ቅሬታዎችን መከታተል እና የአገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ስልቶችን መንደፍ።
  • Enhance customer service quality, monitor client feedback, and design service delivery strategies to improve satisfaction.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
• ከትላልቅ የኮርፖሬት ደንበኞች ጋር ግንኙነት መፍጠር፣ አዳዲስ ደንበኞችን መሳብ እና የባንኩን የንግድ ድርሻ ማሳደግ።
  • Build relationships with corporate clients, attract new business, and expand the bank's market share in the corporate sector.

title: Senior IT Security Officer
description:
• የባንኩን የዲጂታል ደህንነት መጠበቅ፣ የሳይበር ጥቃቶችን መከላከል እና የደህንነት ሲስተሞችን በየጊዜው መመርመር።
  • Protect the bank's digital infrastructure, prevent cyber threats, and regularly audit security systems for vulnerabilities.
  • ደሞዝ፡ በባንኩ ስኬል መሰረት (Premium Salary)

title: Principal Auditor (Engineering Audit)
description:
የባንኩን የግንባታ ፕሮጀክቶች እና የንብረት ግምገማዎች ትክክለኛነት መመርመር እና ቴክኒካዊ ኦዲት ማካሄድ።

Audit the bank’s construction projects, verify asset evaluations, and conduct technical audits of engineering-related activities.

title: Digital Finance Strategy Officer
description:
•  የዲጂታል ባንኪንግ ስልቶችን መንደፍ፣ አዳዲስ የቴክኖሎጂ ምርቶችን ማስተዋወቅ እና የደንበኞችን አጠቃቀም ማሳደግ።
  • Design digital finance strategies, introduce innovative fintech products, and drive digital banking adoption among customers.

title: Internal Control Officer
description:
• የቅርንጫፍ ስራዎች በባንኩ ህግና ደንብ መሰረት መከናወናቸውን ማረጋገጥ እና ስጋቶችን መከታተል።
  • Ensure branch operations comply with bank policies and regulations, and monitor operational risks.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Officer (HR)
description:
• ብቁ ሰራተኞችን መመልመል፣ የቅጥር ሂደቶችን ማስተባበር እና የሰው ኃይል እቅዶችን ማከናወን።
  • Recruit qualified talent, coordinate hiring processes, and implement human resource planning strategies for the bank.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
• የሽያጭ ስትራቴጂዎችን መንደፍ፣ የክልል ሽያጭ ቡድኖችን መምራት እና የገበያ ድርሻን ማሳደግ።
  • Develop regional sales strategies, lead field sales teams, and drive market share growth within the designated region.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
• የምርት ግብዓቶችን አቅርቦት ማስተባበር፣ ወጪ ቆጣቢ የሎጂስቲክስ ስርአት መዘርጋት እና ክምችትን መቆጣጠር።
  • Coordinate supply chain operations, implement cost-effective logistics strategies, and oversee inventory management for the brewery.

title: Manager Corporate Quality Assurance
description:
• የድርጅቱን የአገልግሎት ጥራት ደረጃ መጠበቅ፣ የኦዲት ስራዎችን መምራት እና የአሰራር ሂደቶች ከዓለም አቀፍ የአቪዬሽን ህግ ጋር መጣጣማቸውን ማረጋገጥ።
  • Ensure corporate service quality standards, lead audit activities, and guarantee compliance with international aviation regulations and internal policies.

title: Senior Procurement Officer
description:
• የውጭ እና የሀገር ውስጥ ግዢዎችን ማስተባበር፣ ከአቅራቢዎች ጋር መደራደር እና የጥሬ ዕቃ አቅርቦት ሰንሰለቱን ውጤታማ ማድረግ።
  • Coordinate foreign and local procurement, negotiate with suppliers, and optimize the raw material supply chain for manufacturing efficiency.

title: Unit Manager - Production
description:
• የምርት ክፍሉን በበላይነት መምራት፣ የምርት ግቦችን ማሳካት፣ እና የማሽኖችን ብቃት (OEE) ማሳደግ።
  • Lead the production unit, ensure targets are met, and maximize Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) while maintaining safety standards.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager
description:
• የፋይናንስ እቅድ እና ትንተና መስራት፣ በጀትን መቆጣጠር እና ለከፍተኛ አመራሮች ስትራቴጂካዊ የፋይናንስ ሪፖርት ማቅረብ።
  • Lead financial planning and analysis, oversee budget control, and provide strategic financial insights and reporting to executive management.

title: Brand Manager (FMCG)
description:
• አዳዲስ ምርቶችን ገበያ ላይ ማስተዋወቅ፣ የማስታወቂያ ስራዎችን መምራት እና የምርት ተፈላጊነትን (Market Share) ማሳደግ።
  • Execute product launches, lead marketing campaigns, and grow market share for designated consumer brands through creative strategies.

title: Cybersecurity Operations Lead
description:
• የድርጅቱን የቴክኖሎጂ መሠረተ-ልማት ከሳይበር ጥቃት መጠበቅ፣ የደህንነት ስጋቶችን መከታተል እና ፈጣን ምላሽ ሰጪ ቡድንን መምራት።
  • Protect organizational infrastructure from cyber threats, monitor security incidents, and lead the incident response team for digital asset safety.

title: Fleet Manager
description:
• የድርጅቱን ተሽከርካሪዎች ስምሪት እና ጥገና ማስተባበር፣ የነዳጅ ወጪን መቆጣጠር እና የትራንስፖርት ደህንነትን ማረጋገጥ።
  • Coordinate fleet operations and maintenance, control fuel efficiency, and ensure transportation safety and regulatory compliance for the organization.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
• የሰው ኃይል ስልቶችን ከድርጅቱ ግቦች ጋር ማቀናጀት፣ የሰራተኞች አፈጻጸምን መከታተል እና የአመራር ብቃት ስልጠናዎችን ማስተባበር።
  • Align HR strategies with business goals, manage employee performance, and coordinate leadership development programs within the organization.

title: Amharic to English Translator
description:
• የህግ እና የቴክኒክ ሰነዶችን ከአማርኛ ወደ እንግሊዝኛ መተርጎም እና ትርጉሙ ትክክለኛ መሆኑን ማረጋገጥ።
  • Translate legal and technical documents from Amharic to English, ensuring accuracy and maintaining the original context and tone.

title: Driver
description:
• የድርጅቱን ሰራተኞች እና እንግዶች በደህንነት ማጓጓዝ፣ ተሽከርካሪውን በንጽህና እና በቴክኒክ በጥሩ ሁኔታ መያዝ፣ እና የመኪናውን የጉዞ መዝገብ (Logbook) በአግባቡ መመዝገብ።
  • Drive WHO staff and authorized visitors safely, maintain the vehicle in clean and good technical condition, and accurately maintain the vehicle logbook.

title: Light Vehicle Driver
description:
• በመስክ ጉዞዎች ላይ ሰራተኞችን ማጓጓዝ፣ የመኪናውን ደህንነት በየቀኑ መፈተሽ እና የሬዲዮ ግንኙነት (VHF/HF) መጠቀም መቻል
  • Transport staff during field missions, perform daily vehicle checks, and be capable of using radio communication systems (VHF/HF).

title: Logistics Driver
description:
• የትምህርት ዝግጅት፡ 10ኛ/12ኛ ክፍል ያጠናቀቀ እና የህዝብ 1 ወይም ደረቅ 1 መንጃ ፍቃድ።
  • የረድኤት ቁሳቁሶችን እና ሰራተኞችን ወደ ገጠር መንደሮች ማድረስ፣ ቀላል ጥገናል ስራዎችን መረዳት እና የመንገድ ደህንነት ደንቦችን ማክበር።
  • Deliver humanitarian supplies and staff to remote project sites, understand basic vehicle maintenance, and strictly adhere to road safety regulations.

title: Senior Driver
description:
• ከፍተኛ የዲፕሎማቲክ እንግዶችን ማጓጓዝ፣ የከተማውን እና የክልሎችን መንገዶች ጠንቅቆ ማወቅ እና የቪአይፒ ፕሮቶኮሎችን ማክበር።
  • Provide transportation for high-level diplomatic officials, demonstrate extensive knowledge of city and regional routes, and adhere to VIP protocols.

title: Driver
description:
• ትላልቅ የጭነት መኪናዎችን በማሽከርከር እርዳታ ማጓጓዝ፣ የመኪና ብልሽቶችን አስቀድሞ መለየት እና ለሎጂስቲክስ ክፍሉ ሪፖርት ማድረግ።
  • Drive heavy vehicles to transport aid, identify vehicle malfunctions early, and report to the logistics department.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
• የምርት ጥራት ደረጃውን መጠበቁን ማረጋገጥ፣ ላቦራቶሪውን መምራት እና የአሰራር ጥራትን (ISO) ማስጠበቅ።
  • Ensure product quality standards, lead laboratory operations, and maintain ISO quality certifications.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
• የድርጅቱን የአቅርቦት ሰንሰለት፣ የግዢ ሂደቶችን እና የንብረት አስተዳደርን በበላይነት መምራት።
  • Oversee all supply chain activities, including procurement, logistics, warehouse management, and asset control.

title: Health Officer (NOB)
description:
• የጤና ፕሮግራሞችን ማቀድ፣ መተግበር እና ክትትል ማድረግ፤ በተለይም በእናቶችና ህጻናት ጤና ላይ መስራት።
  • Provide professional technical support in health program planning, implementation, and monitoring with a focus on maternal and child health.

title: Customer Service Manager
description:
• የቅርንጫፉን የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ስራ መምራት፣ የኦፕሬሽን ስራዎችን መቆጣጠር እና የደንበኞችን እርካታ ማረጋገጥ።
  • Lead and manage all customer service functions within the branch, ensuring operational excellence and service standards.

title: Department Head Graduate Studies
description:
• የድህረ-ምረቃ ትምህርት ክፍሉን በበላይነት መምራት፣ የትምህርት ጥራትን ማረጋገጥ እና ምርምሮችን ማስተባበር።
  • Lead the graduate studies department, ensure academic quality, and coordinate research activities within the aviation academy.

title: Software Engineer (Remote)
description:
• በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ለሚገኙ ትላልቅ ድርጅቶች የሶፍትዌር ልማት ስራዎችን ማከናወን።
  • Work as part of a global team to build high-quality software solutions for US-based enterprise clients.

title: Senior Education Project Manager
description:
• የትምህርት ፕሮጀክቶችን በበላይነት ማስተዳደር፣ ከለጋሾች ጋር ግንኙነት መፍጠር እና የፕሮጀክት ውጤታማነትን ማረጋገጥ።
  • Oversee the management of education projects, maintain donor relations, and ensure project effectiveness and compliance.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
• የድርጅቱን የሰው ኃይል አስተዳደር መምራት፣ የቅጥር ሂደቶችን ማሳለጥ እና የሰራተኞችን ደህንነት መጠበቅ።
  • Lead the organization's HR functions, streamline recruitment processes, and manage employee benefits and safety.

title: Senior IS Auditor (Information Systems)
description:
• የባንኩን የቴክኖሎጂ አሰራር መፈተሽ፣ የዲጂታል ስጋቶችን መለየት እና የኦዲት ሪፖርቶችን ማቅረብ።
  • Audit the bank's IT infrastructure, identify digital risks, and provide comprehensive audit reports to management.

title: Manager, Corporate Banking
description:
• የኮርፖሬት ደንበኞችን ማፍራት፣ ብድር ማመቻቸት እና የደንበኞችን የባንክ ፍላጎት ማሟላት።
  • Develop corporate client portfolios, facilitate high-value loans, and manage strategic corporate relationships.

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
• የዌብሳይት እና የአፕሊኬሽን ገጽታዎችን መንደፍ፣ የተጠቃሚዎችን ፍላጎት ያገናዘበ ዲዛይን መስራት።
  •  Design intuitive user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile applications for global clients.

title: Regional Sales Lead
description:
• በክልሉ የሽያጭ ግቦችን ማሳካት፣ ወኪሎችን ማስተባበር እና የገበያ ድርሻን ማሳደግ።
  • Drive regional sales targets, coordinate agent networks, and expand market share within the assigned region.

title: Maintenance Manager
description:
• የማምረቻ ማሽኖችን ደህንነት መጠበቅ፣ የጥገና ስራዎችን መምራት እና የምርት ሂደቱ እንዳይቋረጥ ማድረግ።
  • Manage factory maintenance operations, ensure equipment reliability, and lead the technical maintenance team.

title: Logistics Manager
description:
• የአቅርቦት ሰንሰለትን መምራት፣ የግዢ ስርአቶችን ማስተባበር እና የድርጅቱን ንብረት በብቃት ማስተዳደር።
  • Manage supply chain operations, oversee procurement processes, and ensure efficient asset management in field offices.

title: Emergency Response Manager
description:
• የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ እርዳታ ፕሮጀክቶችን ማቀድ እና መምራት፣ እንዲሁም ከአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ጋር ቅንጅት መፍጠር።
  • Lead emergency response projects, ensure operational efficiency, and coordinate with local stakeholders

title: WASH Coordinator
description:
• የውሃ እና የንጽህና መጠበቂያ ፕሮጀክቶችን ማስተባበር እና ቴክኒካዊ ድጋፍ መስጠት።
  • Coordinate water, sanitation, and hygiene projects, and provide technical engineering guidance.

title: Branch Manager (Grade-I)
description:
•  የቅርንጫፉን አጠቃላይ የባንክ ስራዎች መምራት እና ደንበኞችን ማፍራት።
  • Lead branch operations, drive business development, and ensure target achievement.

title: Relationship Manager (Corporate Banking)
description:
• ከትላልቅ ደንበኞች ጋር ግንኙነት መፍጠር እና የባንኩን የንግድ ድርሻ ማሳደግ።
  • Build relationships with corporate clients and expand the bank's market share.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
• የአቅርቦት ሰንሰለቱን ማስተባበር እና ወጪ ቆጣቢ የሎጂስቲክስ ስርአት መዘርጋት።
  • Coordinate supply chain operations and implement cost-effective logistics strategies.

title: Senior Procurement Officer
description:
• የውጭ እና የሀገር ውስጥ ግዢዎችን ማስተባበር እና ከአቅራቢዎች ጋር መደራደር።
  • Coordinate foreign and local procurement and negotiate with suppliers.

title: Amharic to English Translator
description:
• የቴክኒክ ሰነዶችን ከአማርኛ ወደ እንግሊዝኛ መተርጎም።
  • Translate technical documents from Amharic to English with accuracy.

title: Light Vehicle Driver
description:
• ሰራተኞችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን በደህንነት ማጓጓዝ፣ ተሽከርካሪውን በቴክኒክ በጥሩ ሁኔታ መያዝ እና የጉዞ መዝገብ መመዝገብ።
  • Transport staff and cargo safely, perform basic vehicle maintenance, and accurately maintain the vehicle logbook.

title: Driver
description:
• የረድኤት ሰራተኞችን ወደ መስክ ማጓጓዝ እና የመንገድ ደህንነት ደንቦችን በጥብቅ ማክበር።
  • Transport humanitarian workers to field sites and strictly adhere to road safety and security protocols.

title: Logistics and Fleet Officer
description:
• የተሽከርካሪዎችን ስምሪት መቆጣጠር፣ የነዳጅ አጠቃቀምን መከታተል እና የሎጂስቲክስ ስራዎችን ማሳለጥ።
  • Manage vehicle fleet operations, monitor fuel consumption, and streamline field logistics activities.

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
• የባንኩን የፋይናንስ እና የኦፕሬሽን ስራዎች ትክክለኛነት መመርመር እና የኦዲት ሪፖርት ማቅረብ።
  •  Audit financial and operational activities for compliance and provide detailed internal audit reports.

title: Customer Service Executive (Experienced)
description:
• የባንክ አገልግሎቶችን ለደንበኞች መስጠት፣ ሂሳብ መክፈት እና የደንበኞችን ጥያቄ መመለስ።
  • Provide frontline banking services, handle account openings, and resolve customer inquiries.

title: Program Manager (Economic Recovery)
description:
• የኢኮኖሚ ማገገሚያ ፕሮግራሞችን መምራት እና የአርብቶ አደሩን ገቢ የሚያሳድጉ ስራዎችን ማስተባበር
  • Lead economic recovery programs and coordinate interventions to enhance pastoralist livelihoods.

title: Finance Manager
description:
• የፕሮጀክት በጀቶችን መቆጣጠር፣ የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት እና የኦዲት ስራዎችን ማስተባበር።
  • Oversee project budgets, prepare financial reports, and coordinate internal and external audits.

title: Business Development Officer
description:
• የአነስተኛ እና መካከለኛ ኢንተርፕራይዞችን አቅም መገንባት እና የገበያ ትስስር መፍጠር።
  • Build capacity for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and facilitate market linkages.

title: MEAL Coordinator (Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning)
description:
• የፕሮጀክቶችን ውጤታማነት መከታተል፣ መረጃዎችን መተንተን እና የመማሪያ ስርአቶችን መዘርጋት።
  • Coordinate monitoring and evaluation activities, analyze project data, and ensure accountability standards.

title: ICT Officer
description:
• የድርጅቱን የቴክኖሎጂ መሠረተ-ልማት መጠገን፣ የኔትወርክ ደህንነትን መጠበቅ እና የቴክኒክ ድጋፍ መስጠት።
  •  Maintain IT infrastructure, ensure network security, and provide technical support to staff.

title: Senior Credit Analyst
description:
• የብድር ጥያቄዎችን መመርመር፣ የደንበኞችን የክፍያ አቅም መገምገም እና ምክረ-ሀሳብ ማቅረብ።
  • Analyze loan applications, assess borrower creditworthiness, and provide strategic credit recommendations.

title: Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) Manager
description:

title: HR & Office Administrator
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive HR & Office Administrator to support our daily office operations and human resources functions. The ideal candidate will handle administrative tasks, assist in HR processes, and ensure a smooth and efficient workplace.

Key Responsibilities

Human Resources Duties

Assist with recruitment processes (job postings, screening, scheduling interviews)

Maintain employee records and HR databases

Support onboarding and orientation of new employees

Help manage attendance, leave tracking, and payroll coordination

Ensure compliance with company policies and labor laws

Handle employee inquiries and provide HR support

Office Administration Duties

Manage office supplies and inventory

Coordinate office maintenance and service providers

Organize meetings, schedules, and company events

Maintain filing systems (physical and digital)

Handle correspondence, emails, and phone calls

Ensure a clean, organized, and efficient office environment

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, or related field

1–3 years of relevant experience in HR and/or office administration

Strong organizational and multitasking skills

Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

Knowledge of Ethiopian labor law is a plus

Skills & Competencies

Attention to detail

Time management

Problem-solving skills

Confidentiality and professionalism

Ability to work independently and in a team

title: የሽያጭ ሰራተኛ
description:
አድማስዎን ያስፉ፣ ገቢዎን ያሳድጉ!
የስራ መደቡ፡ ራሱን የቻለ ከፍተኛ የሽያጭ ባለሙያ (በኮሚሽን ላይ የተመሰረተ)
የሕልም ሥራዎ የሚጀምረው እዚህ ነው!
እርስዎ ገንዘብን በታታሪነትዎ እና ብልሃትዎ የመፍጠር ጥልቅ ፍላጎት አለዎት? በዲጂታል ዓለም ውስጥ ትልቅ አሻራ መጣል ይፈልጋሉ? ድርጅታችን ከ5 በላይ በሆኑ ዘመናዊ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ሰርቪሶች እና ምርቶች / አገልግሎቶች ላይ ተመስርቶ ያልተገደበ ገቢ የሚያስገኝልዎትን ዕድል ይዞ መጥቷል።
ይህ ተራ የሽያጭ ሥራ አይደለም—ይህ የራስዎ የገቢ ንግድ ነው።
ለምን ይህ ዕድል ለየት ያለ ነው?
1.💰 ያልተገደበ የኮሚሽን አቅም፡ በኩባንያችን ካሉት ከአምስት በላይ ትርፋማ ምርቶችና አገልግሎቶች የተነሳ፣ እያንዳንዱ ሽያጭዎ ትልቅ ኮሚሽን ይዞ ይመጣል! ገደብዎ የእርስዎ ጥረት ብቻ ነው!
2.🎯 ሙሉ የራስ ገዝ አስተዳደር፡ እኛ "እንመራዎታለን" አንልም—እኛ እንተማመንብዎታለን። እርስዎ ነዎት የገበያ ጥናት የሚያደርጉት፣ ሊድስ (የደንበኛ መረጃ) የሚሰበስቡት እና ሽያጩን ከጅምሩ እስከ መጨረሻው በብቃት የሚዘጉት።
3.🚀 በቴክኖሎጂ አፍላ ዘርፍ መሥራት፡ የዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት የወደፊቱ ዓለም ነው። በዚህ አስደሳችና ተፈላጊ ዘርፍ ውስጥ ቁልፍ ባለቤት ይሁኑ።

የእርስዎ ዋና ኃላፊነቶች (የእርስዎ የኃይል ማመንጫ)
እኛ የምንፈልገው በቂ ልምድ ያለው፣ ስልጠና የማይሻ እና ሥራውን በራሱ ተረድቶ በፍጥነት ሽያጭ የሚያስመዘግብ ባለሙያ ነው።
የራስዎን የደንበኛ መረጃ (ሊድስ)(Lead Generation): የመፈለጊያ ዘዴዎች በመጠቀም ሽያጮችን በፍጥነት ማመንጨት እና ማጠናቀቅ።
የምርት ሻምፒዮን መሆን፡ በተለይም የኦንላይን ትምህርት (LMS) መድረካችንን ለደንበኞች በሚማርክ ሁኔታ መግለጽ እና መሸጥ።
oበቅርቡ ለምናደርገው የኦንላይን ትምህርት መድረክ ምረቃ የሽያጭ ቅድመ ዝግጅት መሪ መሆን።
oለፕሮጀክቱ ስኬት የሚያስፈልጉ ስፖንሰርሺፖችን መፈለግና ማምጣት።
የስኬት አስተዳደር፡ የዕለታዊ የሽያጭ ጥረቶችዎን እና የሥራ እንቅስቃሴዎን ግልጽ በሆነ ሁኔታ ሪፖርት ማድረግ።

መስፈርቶች (እርስዎ መሆን ያለብዎት)
በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ማኔጅመንት፣ ቢዝነስ አስተዳደር ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ የመጀመሪያ ዲፕሎማ ወይም ከዛ በላይ።
ስለ ዲጂታል ማርኬቲንግ ጥልቅ እውቀት እና ሽያጭ በማምጣት የተረጋገጠ፣ ሰፊ የስራ ልምድ።
ስራዎችን በግልጽ እና በብቃት የመግለጽ ችሎታ።
ምርጥ የመግባባት፣ የግንኙነት መፍጠር እና የሪፖርት አቀራረብ ችሎታ።
በራሱ ተነሳሽነት የመስራት እና ለሽያጭ ግቦች ከፍተኛ ኃላፊነት የመውሰድ ብቃት።

ይህንን አስደናቂ የኮሚሽን ዕድል ለመጠቀም ዝግጁ ከሆኑ፡-
መስፈርቶቹን የምታሟሉ አመልካቾች የስራ ልምዳችሁን (CV) እና ተዛማጅ ሰነዶችን በሚከተለው አድራሻ እንድትልኩ እንጋብዛለን፡

title: Driver
description:
The driver will provide safe, transport services for MC program and support staff in the described AOR (Area of Responsibility). The driver will adhere to all traffic and MC safety rules and follow the transport guidelines required by the MC transport department.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Operate MC vehicles as assigned by supervisor.
Maintain vehicle log-sheets in accordance with MC policies/regulations.
Check the vehicle conditions after each trip/routinely – report needs and problems to transport management.
Adhere to all safety and communication protocols as advised by Mercy Corps and supervisor.
Responsible for the safekeeping of all vehicle equipment, tools, first aid kits, spares etc.
Keep the vehicle ready, clean and on standby – ready for use always.
Assist, as required, with logistics in the office and guesthouse daily workloads.
Cooperate and be of assistance to staff and visitors – assist in troubleshooting potential problems during daily business.
Report all maintenance needs of the vehicle to transport management on a regular basis.
Undertake field assignments as assigned.
Adherence to all MC policies and procedures as outlined in MC policies and procedure manuals.
Conduct himself/herself both professionally and personally in such a manner as to bring credit to Mercy Corps and to not jeopardize its humanitarian mission in country of operation.
Other duties as assigned.
Education and work experience

Completed grade 10 and above
Having at least five year experience, NGO’s experience is preferable
Fluency in Tigrigna is mandatory, and English and Amharic also preferable.

title: Temporary Driver (Casual)
description:
Generic responsibilities

Transport NRC staff, visitors, documents and goods/materials to designated destinations when officially approved
Ensure the safety and security of the passengers, the goods and the vehicle
Immediately report accidents, breakdowns and needs of repair and general maintenance/service
Respect the local traffic regulations and the NRC logistical/vehicle policies at all times
Maintain the logbook for all trips
Maintain the vehicle in proper operating condition at all times, including keeping the vehicle clean, ensuring enough fuel, checking the technical state etc.
In liaison with the line manager, arrange for repairs and servicing
Ensure the assigned vehicle has all the necessary documents and equipment
Provide logistical support during trainings and workshops
Specific responsibilities

Drive NRC Ethiopia vehicles to give service to NRC staff as required and given schedule .
Always carry out basic security checks on the vehicles that he/she uses before starting driving and at the end of the day. (battery water, fuel & oil levels, radiator water, Tyre pressure/condition, etc.)
Ensure the vehicle meets the maintenance schedule and should inform the supervisor of any faults as and they occur.
Maintain neat & accurate record of all journeys in the vehicle log book.
Carry out the daily vehicle check and inventory.
Report immediately any damage or accident to the immediate supervisor/Head of Office /Logistics Manager in Addis Ababa following correct procedures in the case of the accident, incident or complaints.
Ensure the vehicle is kept clean and tidy always.
Ensure that the vehicle is only used for NRC approved purposes.
Keep and respect NRC driver rule and conduct.
Respect traffic regulation as per the Road Transport and Traffic regulation.
Responsible for the collection, storage, transport and final delivery of all goods in his/her vehicle.
Ensure every passenger wears Safety Belt before start driving the vehicle.
No mobile phones are to be answered when driving
Driving style should suit local conditions, and should be careful and passive
As a representative of NRC the driver is expected to dress and behave in a respectable manner at all times
The driver should manage his/her time properly and report promptly to work. S/he should also ensure that s/he is adequately rested prior to long journeys
Drivers requiring prescription glasses must wear these at all times when driving
Drivers must carry out a weekly vehicle check, and submit the Weekly Vehicle Check form to the Logistics Officer
The driver should familiarize him/herself with the tools and equipment in the vehicle
The driver should familiarize him/herself with the local area and planned journey route prior to departure, particularly any security issues to be aware of
Undertake any other duties as requested by immediate supervisor.

Qualifications
Valid Grade  3 driver’s license
Diploma in Auto Mechanics or a related field
Experience from working as a Driver in three (3) years  a humanitarian/recovery context
Previous experience from working in complex and volatile contexts
Documented results related to the position’s responsibilities
Knowledge about own skills/profile
Some knowledge of English

title: Community and Home-Based Learning (CHBL) Model
description: Major responsibilities include: Conduct a participatory and intentional study of the Community and Home-Based Learning (CHBL) model in Amhara: Review of existing national/regional education policies, strategies and education sector plans to see if there is an enabling policy environment for the implementation of CHBL models in Amhara region. Review of other similar learning initiatives and materials the model uses (if any) in the region and draw lessons from the model and any existing resource materials. Technical in-depth interviews with experts from MoE, Amhara Regional State Education Bureau, the three Zonal Education Departments and three sample Woreda Education Offices (out of the eight Woredas targeted) to learn more about their perspectives, and technical views on the implementation of the model. Participatory assessment with teachers, caregivers, children, and community leaders (PSTAs) in three sample woredas of the three targeted Zones to identify aspirations, opportunities, protection risks, and potential barriers limiting the efficiency and effectiveness levels of CHBL implementation.  This exercise should enable the Project to identify responsive, contextually appropriate, play-based models for community/home-based foundational learning through assessment and client-driven approaches Mapping of available resources (e.g. safe spaces, community structures, community facilitators/ volunteers, local radio broadcasts, and other digital platforms (telegram/WhatsApp) and assessing their feasibility for content delivery. Development of national/regional CHBL guidelines: Rationale of the model, and its core implementation strategies Competencies and training requirements for facilitators and community volunteers Roles and responsibilities of facilitators/community volunteers, community structures and learners Inclusive strategies for girls, children with disabilities, IDPs, and marginalized groups. Supervision and quality assurance structure, including supervisory roles, and frequency Minimum operational standards for learning environment, safeguarding, facilitator selection, inclusion, learning time, and supervision A set of at least three sample locally relevant learning models (e.g. small group/village/community-based activities, home-based sessions, community events, listening circles) Expected Deliverables Develop and submit a draft inception report outlining the technical approach, work plan, schedule, and data collection methodology, including the required data collection tools for review and feedback. Revise and submit the final inception report, incorporating comments and inputs received from IRC, together with finalized data collection tools. Conduct a review of relevant materials and implement the data collection exercise in line with the agreed methodology. Prepare and submit a draft assessment report for review, incorporating findings from the data collection and analysis. Present the assessment findings at a validation workshop and incorporate feedback from stakeholders Develop a draft national/regional CHBL model guideline for review. Facilitate a validation workshop with key partners and stakeholders to refine the guideline. Revise and submit the final CHBL guideline document incorporating all feedback. Duration of the Consultancy: The consultancy is expected to be conducted between April and June 2026, in accordance with the agreed work plan. Safeguarding Responsibilities: - Promote and actively participate in initiatives and efforts to build team engagement, inclusion and cohesion in IRC [team/office] Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies Requirements: Educational Requirements: MA in Education and related fields Preferred Experience and Skills: Minimum work experience of 12 years in conducting participatory assessments in the education sector Demonstrated experience in reviewing education policies, strategy and sector plan documents; and adapting and producing high-quality teaching and learning materials for primary school-aged children in the education sector Proven track record of working closely with government stakeholders, community members, and target clients to ensure contextual relevance and ownership. Familiarity with the education sector, community structures in the target woredas of Amhara, with some knowledge of crisis affected contexts

description: Purpose of the Post: The Regional Immunization Officer position has been established to reinforce immunization efforts at the sub-national level. The position ensures that all activities are aligned with national priorities for routine immunization strengthening, the delivery of primary health care, and the objectives of the Immunization Agenda 2030, thereby advancing equitable access to life-saving vaccines across Ethiopia. Organizational Context Under the overall supervision of the Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) Officer at the Regional Health Bureau (RHB), and with strategic guidance from the Immunization Service Desk Lead at the Ministry of Health (MoH) and the World Health Organization (WHO) Country Office, the Immunization Officer will work as part of the WCO-Ethiopia DPC team.

title: AI Consulting (Property & Casualty Insurance)
description:
Client Relationship Management

Conduct discovery sessions and workshops to identify opportunities for AI-driven transformation across insurance value chains.
Translate client operational and regulatory challenges into compelling AI solutions involving data annotation, machine learning model development, and automation pipelines.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineering teams to ensure successful project execution.
Ensure timely delivery, scope, and client satisfaction throughout project lifecycles.
Thought Leadership and Industry Expertise

Contribute to external visibility through participation in industry events and client workshops, positioning the company as a trusted AI consulting partner.
Demonstrate expertise in the regulatory landscape shaping AI in insurance: state DOI guidelines, NAIC model bulletins, EU AI Act implications for European carriers, and model risk management frameworks.
Feed sector intelligence back into product and GTM strategy.

Lead cross-functional teams of consultants, data scientists, and engineers.

Support knowledge sharing and best practices in AI consulting engagements.

title: Advisor- Carbon Markets and Article 6
description:
Responsibilities and Duties
• Provide policy and technical advisory services to partner institutions in Ethiopia, particularly the Ministry of Planning and Development (MoPD), on the implementation of Article 6 of the Paris Agreement.
• Promote environmental integrity and sustainable development in carbon market activities by advising partner institutions on the application of robust safeguards, transparency standards, and sustainable development criteria, ensuring alignment with international best practices and Article 6 guidance.
• Support the establishment and operationalisation of national carbon market infrastructure, including a national carbon registry and its integration with the national greenhouse gas inventory and sectoral MRV systems.
• Coordinate technical guidance on Article 6 accounting frameworks, including the development of Corresponding Adjustment workflows, emissions balance logic, and metrics conversion rules.
• Support the development of national reporting workflows in line with the Enhanced Transparency Framework (ETF) and assist partner institutions in preparing Initial Reports, Annual Information submissions, and Biennial Transparency Reports (BTRs) to the UNFCCC.
• Contribute to design and implement a comprehensive capacity development strategy for key stakeholders—including government institutions, regional authorities, private sector actors, and civil society—covering Article 6 processes, MRV, carbon project development, and market operations.
• Deliver and coordinate targeted capacity-building activities, including trainings, workshops, and learning-by-doing formats for public and private sector actors involved in carbon market activities.
• Assist to enhance an ecosystem of national and regional validation and verification bodies (VVBs).
• Contribute to analytical work and strategic research on climate finance and carbon markets, including collaboration with academic institutions and international partners to generate policy-relevant insights.
• Support the transition of CDM mitigation activities to the Article 6.4 mechanism, the development of standardised baselines, and technical inputs with relevant international mechanisms such as CORSIA.
• Contribute to project implementation and coordination, including stakeholder engagement, knowledge management, supervision of consultants, monitoring and reporting to the commissioning partner (BMZ), and alignment with other GIZ programmes and development partners.

About You
Qualifications

• Advanced university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in climate policy, environmental economics, environmental science, international relations, or a related field relevant to carbon markets and climate finance.
• At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in carbon markets, climate finance, or market-based climate cooperation, including substantial experience with Article 6 of the Paris Agreement and/or the Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM).

Professional experience

Proven track-record in the design and implementation of carbon market activities, including policy advisory, institutional readiness support, and capacity development in developing or emerging economies.
Extensive experience advising government institutions and ministries on climate policy, NDC implementation, and carbon market governance.
Strong technical understanding of international carbon market architecture, including emission reduction accounting, corresponding adjustments, authorization procedures, MRV systems, and transparency requirements under Article 6 and the Enhanced Transparency Framework (ETF).
Familiarity with environmental integrity principles, including safeguards frameworks and sustainable development criteria relevant to Article 6 and voluntary carbon markets.
Experience in managing or coordinating technical assistance and research activities, including the supervision of consultants and quality assurance of analytical outputs
Excellent stakeholder engagement and networking skills, with experience working with government institutions, private sector actors, civil society, and international organizations.
Experience in developing and facilitating capacity-building activities, such as trainings, workshops, and peer-learning formats at national and international levels.
Other knowledge, additional competencies

Excellent command of English and Amharic (written and spoken); combined with strong intercultural competence and the ability to work effectively in international and multidisciplinary teams
Proficiency in standard IT applications (MS Office) and digital collaboration tools

title: Medical Referral Support Officer
description:
Key Responsibilities and Duties

1. Referral Coordination

Coordinate referrals for patients requiring specialized services, diagnostic tests, or consultations with external healthcare facilities or specialists.

Facilitate referrals to primary healthcare centers and specialized health services such as hospital admissions, psychiatric care, severe malnutrition treatment, emergency obstetric care, and other required medical services.

Support patients in scheduling appointments, obtaining diagnostic results, and addressing barriers to care.
Provide assistance to beneficiaries throughout the referral process while respecting confidentiality and patients’ rights.
3. Communication and Coordination

5. Patient Awareness and Health Education

6. Administrative and Logistics Support

title: UNEP Finance Initiative (UNEP FI) – Technical Specialist Capacity Building Consultant South Africa
description: The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is the leading global environmental authority that sets the global environmental agenda, promotes the coherent implementation of the environmental dimension of sustainable development within the United Nations system and serves as an authoritative advocate for the global environment. The overall objective of the UNEP’s Economy Division is to encourage decision makers in government, local authorities and industry to develop and adopt policies, strategies and practices and technologies that promote sustainable patterns of consumption and production, make efficient use of natural resources, ensure safe management of chemicals and contribute to making trade and environment policies mutually supportive. It promotes the development, use and transfer of policies, technologies, economic instruments, managerial practices and other tools that assist in environmentally sound decision making and the building of corresponding activities. The United Nations Environment Programme Finance Initiative (UNEP FI) is the strategic partnership between the United Nations and over 500 banks, insurers and investors. For over 32 years UNEP FI has been shaping and driving the international sustainable finance agenda, setting global standards and growing a global network of leading financial institutions.

Be responsible for the leadership, oversight and management of the delivery of expected results throughout the life of the project, consistent with the award objectives and donor compliance requirements.
Lead on project delivery, including strategic direction and performance management, component design and delivery, team management, and research and learning.
Provide and maintain a single programmatic and technical approach, ensuring a strong shared vision of the project, oversee robust coordination between DRC and partners, and ensure project teams access programmatic and technical resources to deliver quality programming interventions.
Serve as secretary to the Steering Committee, ensuring all consortium members are actively engaged to drive the strategic direction, problem solve implementation challenges and ensure robust results management of the programme.
Serve as the principal point of contact with the donor, overseeing all formal and informal communications and providing timely updates on delivery, including risks and challenges.
Responsible for active risk management of the project, fostering a culture of risk management at all levels and that the donor, DRC, and the Steering Committee are kept informed and engaged on project risks and management strategy, and that there is embedded and iterative business continuity planning.
Oversee and manage the project’s relationship with authorities and other stakeholders, including representing the project in local, national, and international meetings and events.
Ensure the Safety and Security Plans are being fully implemented and reviewed/adapted as conditions demand.
About You
Experience and technical competencies:

At least 7 years' experience working in international humanitarian and/or development aid with experience in a similar role (Consortium Manager, Chief of Party);
At least 3 years' experience with people management
Demonstrated experience managing and/ or supporting large multi-location programs in complex operating environments, preferably with experience coordinating multi-partner teams.
Technical expertise and experience in either inclusive systems, health and nutrition, protection and gender, peacebuilding or resilience programming in fragile contexts an advantage.
Demonstrable experience in project management, budget monitoring, financial forecasting, and risk management.
Ability to build and maintain relationships with host governments, donors, partners, local organizations, and other stakeholders
EDUCATION: (include certificates, licenses, etc.)

Degree in political science, international development, social work humanitarian law, migration or related field

title: Economics Affairs Officer (Health Economist), P4
description: Within delegated authority, the Economic Affairs Officer conducts health financing and macroeconomic analyses to inform evidence-based policy advice for Member States. The role provides technical support on health financing reforms, UHC strategies, and fiscal planning; develops policy briefs and analytical reports; delivers capacity-building activities; manages technical cooperation projects; and supports intergovernmental process and partnerships to strengthen sustainable, equitable health financing systems across Africa.   The duties of an Economic Affairs Officer falls under the functional areas identified below. Economic or sector analysis: •Assess trends in health expenditure, fiscal allocations, efficiency of spending and fiscal space in member States, identifying emerging policy concerns relevant to sustainable and equitable health financing. •Conduct analytical studies and econometric assessments of health financing reform options, including assessment of national health insurance models, results-based financing, subsidies, domestic resource mobilization strategies, purchasing and provider payment arrangements, and innovative financing instruments.

title: Data Privacy Lead
description:
As Safaricom Ethiopia, we are a purpose-led technology company dedicated to transforming lives through digital connectivity and inclusive financial services. In under four years, we have grown to serve over 10 million customers, with our network now reaching 55% of Ethiopia’s population – a testament to our bold vision and trusted partnerships.

Guided by core values such as customer obsession, innovation, integrity, and get it done together, we are building a workplace that is dynamic, inclusive, and empowering. We believe our greatest strength lies in our people. That’s why, for two consecutive years, we have proudly get earned the Top Employer Award – in recognition for our unwavering commitment to fostering a supportive, innovative, and inclusive environment to people.

Join Safaricom Ethiopia and be part of a team that is shaping the digital future of Ethiopia. Here, your work has meaning, your voice matters, and your growth is our priority. Together, we are transforming lives for a digital future

Job Description
The Data Privacy Lead will ensure compliance with data protection laws, lead regulator engagement, and foster a culture of data privacy across Safaricom Ethiopia

Role purpose:

Reporting to the EHOD – Compliance, the position holder will proactively engage regulators and other stakeholders to embed tailored, timely data privacy capabilities across Safaricom Ethiopia. Independently review and offer advice on data governance, processing activities and/or data breaches.

Monitor compliance with applicable national and international laws and regulations pertaining to data protection and privacy and work with teams to close gaps identified. Proactively support all efforts towards Regulator engagement, registration, breach notification and reporting. Provide appropriate policies and guidelines to establish and maintain data protection compliance. Contribute towards establishing a strong culture of data protection across stakeholders through appropriate training and awareness

Key Responsibilities

Enabling the company by creating tailored data privacy and protection training campaigns and awareness sessions,
Obtaining overall data/information process map/flow in products, assets, processes, services, and critical auxiliary systems,
Ensures the development and implementations of high-risk guiding frameworks i.e., Policy, Procedure and Processes to manage data subject information’s [Customer, Employee, Candidates, and Suppliers],
Execute customized implementation of Global Data Protection Regulation [GDPR] through Risk Control Matrix [RCM],
Enable the business to operate in a conducive environment by creating Compliance Risks Management Plan [CRMP] to capture regulatory requirements,
Consulting, assisting, and aligning with business unit needs and requirements regarding data processing activities when processing data subject information,
Applying a proactive mechanism to tackle high and medium privacy risks through effective Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPAI), Legitimate Impact Assessment (LIA), Human Impact Assessment (HIA) and Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA),
Enhance the first line business operation by developing and enforcing Data Subject Requests [DSRs],
Periodically reporting the overall program implementation to Executive Committee,
Create enabling environment to work closely with cybersecurity and technology standards i.e., ISO27001 Framework,
Embed data protection clauses in Master Procurement Agreements (MPA) with vendors to manage legal and regulatory risks,
Enforce Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) to control outsourcing risks when exporting data processing activities to third parties,
Conduct third-party risk assessment.

title: Project Officer
description:
The Project Officer is responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community-based health and polio eradication interventions. The role
focuses on strengthening community surveillance systems, increasing immunization coverage, and improving MNCH and overall community health
outcomes at the grassroots level. The officer supports the design and delivery of evidence-based and innovative interventions, ensuring alignment with
national health priorities and best practices. This includes building the capacity of field staff and partners to deliver quality, sustainable services. The
Project Officer also ensures effective coordination and integration of activities across target woredas (Bambasi and Homosha), promoting synergy and
efficient resource utilization. The role oversees timely and quality implementation, proper documentation, and compliance with donor and
organizational requirements. In addition, the officer contributes to monitoring, evaluation, and learning by supporting data collection, analysis, and
knowledge management to inform continuous improvement. The position actively engages with key stakeholders including government health offices,
UN agencies, NGOs, and community structures to strengthen collaboration and advocate for effective disease prevention and control strategies

Working Location: Bambasi,Abrahamo,Ura/Omosha

Program Planning and Implementation

Support planning processes by working closely with woreda health offices, health facilities, and community structures to develop annual, quarterly, and monthly activity plans aligned with CGPP objectives and national health strategies.
Support micro-planning for immunization and community outreach, including identifying zero-dose and under-immunized children, mapping hard-to-reach areas, and scheduling regular outreach sessions. Strengthen the capacity of health workers and community volunteers to effectively implement these plans.
Coordinate implementation of project activities at woreda and kebele levels, ensuring all planned interventions such as social mobilization, community dialogues, defaulter tracing, and service linkages are conducted on time and with quality.
Ensure integration with the primary health care system, working closely with health extension workers (HEWs), health development armies (HDAs), and health facility staff to strengthen routine immunization and other MNCH services.
Monitor progress of implementation through regular field visits, supportive supervision, and review meetings. Identify bottlenecks early and take corrective actions to improve performance.
Promote community engagement and ownership by involving local leaders, religious leaders, and community groups in planning and implementation to
increase acceptance and demand for immunization services.
Ensure efficient use of resources, including proper planning, allocation, and tracking of project inputs to maximize impact and avoid delays.
Prepare and submit regular implementation reports, documenting achievements, challenges, lessons learned, and recommendations for improvement Promote and Support Zero Doze and under immunized children

Required Professional Experience

 

Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Nursing, Health Officer, or a related field (Master’s degree is an added advantage).
At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in community-based health programs, preferably in immunization, polio eradication, or MNCH.
Strong knowledge of immunization systems, including routine immunization, SIAs, zero-dose and under-immunized strategies, and community-based surveillance.

title: GTM Assistant
description:
Job Purpose:
To support the efficient operation of the Go-To-Market (GTM) system by ensuring data accuracy, real-time monitoring of field activities, performance reporting, and operational coordination. The role ensures that the field force operates with updated information, synchronized devices, and adherence to route plans, while providing analytical insights to improve sales productivity and distribution performance.

2. Field Force Monitoring & Operational Support
Monitor daily field synchronization status and ensure all sales representatives start and end their day in the system.
Identify and resolve pending system requests such as outlet creation, route changes, and pricing updates.
Ensure field staff operate within assigned routes and follow planned journey cycles.
Support supervisors by flagging non-compliance and operational anomalies in real time.
3. Data Analytics & Power BI Monitoring
Use Power BI dashboards to track real-time sales and distribution KPIs such as:Strike rate
Drop size
Route compliance
Visited vs billed outlets
Identify underperforming territories, coverage gaps, and product availability issues.
Provide actionable insights to sales supervisors and regional managers for performance improvement.
4. Reporting & Performance Tracking
Prepare and distribute daily sales performance reports comparing actuals against targets.
Conduct weekly productivity analysis of the field force and highlight key trends.
Compile comprehensive monthly GTM performance reports including route efficiency, sales performance, and coverage metrics.
Maintain historical performance records for management review and decision-making.
5. GPS Tracking & Fleet Monitoring
Monitor vehicle movements using GPS platforms to ensure route adherence and field discipline.
Track and report driver behavior, including:Over-speeding
Excessive idling
Route deviations
Escalate irregularities to supervisors and fleet coordinators for corrective action.
6. FSMS & Product Recall Support
Support Food Safety Management System (FSMS) requirements by maintaining accurate traceability records within the GTM system.
Assist in executing rapid product recall procedures by identifying and tracking the distribution of specific batches to outlets.
7. Data Reconciliation & Compliance
Review daily working hours and activity logs of sales representatives to ensure compliance with company policies.
Ensure all field transactions are synchronized before end-of-day closure.
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between planned routes, actual visits, and sales records

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Field synchronization compliance rate
Data accuracy of outlets and pricing
Timeliness and accuracy of daily/weekly/monthly reports
Route adherence and reduction in out-of-route visits
Reduction in system-related field complaints
Response time to resolve GTM system issues

title: GBV case worker /Maternity Cover
description: Vacancy Announcement   Médecins du Monde (MdM) or Doctors of the World is an international humanitarian organization that provides medical care and support to vulnerable populations around the world. Founded in 1980, the organization's mission is to ensure access to healthcare for all, regardless of race, religion, or political affiliation. MdM operates in over 40 countries including Ethiopia, delivering medical aid in crisis zones, conflict-affected areas, and areas of extreme poverty. Our teams of healthcare professionals, including doctors, nurses, and support staff, work tirelessly to provide essential medical services, emergency relief, and long-term healthcare programs.MDM–France invites qualified candidates to apply for the following position   Position Title: GBV case worker /Female only Duty station: Tigray region ,Based in Chila Employment Term: 4 months (Maternity Cover) Reported to: Health Program Manager Required positions: 1 (One)   Job Summary The position holder will base at Tigray region: Chila Woreda. The overall responsibility of the position holder is to conduct GBV case management activities and strengthen GBV response referral pathway. She will be under the direct supervision of the Health Program Manager with technical links with the mission GBV Advisor. Essential duties and responsibilities. Case workers will provide case management services to survivors, including referrals to existing services at the woreda, will conduct follow up and update status of referral cases. She will support updating service mapping on their coverage area and coordinate with other GBV actors in the woreda. Prepare and compile weekly and monthly reports and share with relevant stakeholders and immediate supervisors. Develop and implement individual case management planning for GBV survivors Ensure regular follow-up of the implementation of the case plan for each clients Coordinate with other Protection actors to coordinate the implementation of international and national standards and consideration of protection issues. Identify additional needs of the survivor and collaborate with other internal and external sectors to meet the needs of the survivor. Provide confidential referral based on the best interest of the survivor to other service providers as part of case management; follow-up to ensure that all the cases adequately receiving needed support once referral has been made. Support the delivery of formal and on Job training and coaching for health and community workers Participate in the assessment, monitoring and auditing of mainstreaming activities Support the development of GBV prevention awareness messages and assist community volunteers in raising awareness about GBV.

title: Consultant on artisanal and small-scale mining in Africa
description: Background and Context Artisanal and Small-Scale Mining (ASM) is a critical component of Africa’s mineral economy and a major source of livelihoods across the continent. The sector encompasses a wide spectrum of mining activities ranging from informal subsistence mining carried out with minimal technology to small-scale commercial mining enterprises that supply minerals to national and international markets. Globally, ASM provides direct employment to approximately 45 million people across more than 80 countries, making it the largest employer in the mining sector worldwide. In addition, more than 150 million people depend indirectly on ASM for their livelihoods, underscoring its importance for rural employment and poverty reduction. Africa hosts one of the largest concentrations of ASM activity globally. Estimates suggest that approximately 9 million artisanal miners operate in Africa, supporting the livelihoods of more than 54 million dependants, making ASM the second-largest employer after agriculture in many mineral-rich African countries. The sector also contributes significantly to mineral supply and value chains and global markets. Artisanal miners produce a substantial share of several minerals, including gold, cobalt, tin, tantalum, gemstones, and other strategic minerals used in electronics and clean energy technologies. For example, artisanal mining contributes around 20% of global gold production and about 25% of global tantalum supply.

title: DIGITAL INNOVATIONS FOR AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION AND TRADE TO ENHANCE FOOD SECURITY UNDER AFCFTA
description: 1. BACKGROUND AND JUSTIFICATION In line with its mandate to support regional integration, the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (UNECA), through its Subregional Office for Eastern Africa (SRO-EA), is advancing work to accelerate progress on selected 2030 Sustainable Development Goals that are currently off track. This project focuses on the achievement of SDG 2 “Zero Hunger” by 2030, in a context where food insecurity persists due to constraints in agricultural systems, climate-related shocks, and fragmented markets. Digital innovations in food production and trade offer a practical pathway to strengthen food security by improving agricultural yields and production, enhancing market connectivity, reducing transaction costs, and enabling a more efficient allocation of food across the region. Agriculture remains an important pillar of African economies. It accounts for approximately 18% of GDP in Sub-Saharan Africa (2024), with significantly higher shares in several countries where the sector contributes over 30 to 40% of national GDP (World Bank, 2024). The sector is also the largest source of employment on the continent, with Africa recording the highest share of employment in agriculture globally, representing around 50% of total employment in 2023 (ILO, 2024). Despite its economic importance, food insecurity remains widespread across the continent. In 2022, approximately 282 million people in Africa i.e. around 20% of the population faced chronic undernourishment (FAO et al., 2023). This situation is further compounded by Africa’s significant dependence on food imports. The continent’s annual food import bill is estimated at US$110 billion by 2025, more than triple its 2015 level, highlighting a structural reliance on external food supplies (African Development Bank, 2023; UNECA, 2025).

title: Country Lead - RESIslands Initiative (Madagascar
description: 1. Context and Background UNECA is the Delivery Partner (DP) of the RESIslands Project––"Strengthening the institutional capacities of the African Island States Climate Commission (AISCC) member states to manage climate risks and bolster resilience"–– which is a multi-country Readiness initiative covering nine African Island States: Cabo Verde, Comoros, Equatorial Guinea, Guinea Bissau, Madagascar, Mauritius, São Tomé & Príncipe, Seychelles, and Tanzania (Zanzibar). The project is supported by the Green Climate Fund and implemented in close collaboration with the AISCC, the UN Resident Coordinator Offices and the National Designated Authorities (NDA) in the project countries. The project will strengthen AISCC and its member states’ institutional capacities and decision-making for climate resilience, by enhancing the delivery of multi-hazard risk assessments to natural disasters, particularly climate variability and change. The objectives are to build capacities in AISSC member states, support the strategic frameworks, develop a pipeline of projects, and promote knowledge sharing and learning. The main direct stakeholders are the government institutions of the AISCC member states involved in the project. These include key ministries such as Climate, Finance, Planning, Environment, Blue Economy, Health, DRR, Security, Energy, Infrastructure, Land development. The indirect beneficiaries are the African islands population as a whole, in particular vulnerable communities and those more exposed to climate change that need to be better protected to multi-hazard risks. 2. Organizational Setting and Reporting The Country Lead will be embedded within the NDA (or designated institution) of their respective country and will report directly to the Program Coordinator at UNECA CFND, with dotted-line communication to the national NDA and the AISCC NFP. They will work under UNECA’s Project Management Unit (PMU) supervision, and in close collaboration with the AISCC, EW4ALL partners, and international consultants, experts and service providers involved in each activity of the project. 3. Objectives and Purpose The Country Lead will: • Serve as the in-country focal point and local facilitator for all RESIslands activities implemented in their country of responsibility

title: Roving Community Feedback Mechanism (CFM) Coordinator
description:
Role and responsibilities

As a humanitarian organization, NRC is committed to accountability to affected people by ensuring meaningful engagement, safe and confidential feedback channels, and timely responses to community concerns. The Roving Community Feedback Mechanism (CFM) Coordinator is responsible for leading the implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of the CFM in NRC Ethiopia. The role ensures that feedback from project participants is systematically collected, recorded, analyzed, and used to improve the quality, safety, and relevance of programmes.

The coordinator acts as the country-level focal point for CFM, while providing direct, hands-on technical support to AOs through regular field travel. They ensure that feedback is handled in line with SOPs and NRC standards, that sensitive feedback is safely handled and escalated within 24 hours, and that communities have access to safe, accessible, and trusted feedback channels.

The role strengthens the capacity of AO teams, promotes consistency in CFM implementation, and ensures that feedback data is used to inform programme adaptation and decision-making. The position also contributes to strengthening a broader culture of Community Engagement and Accountability (CEA) across NRC Ethiopia.

Generic responsibilities

Ensure the CO CFM adheres with NRC policies, including the CEA Policy, CFM Handbook, safeguarding (PSEAH) Policy, and data protection standards

Support the rollout, implementation, and continuous improvement of CFM systems, tools, and guidance

Ensure all feedback is registered, triaged, assigned, referred and closed according to relevant SOPs.

Ensure integration of CFM into programme design, implementation, and monitoring

Promote the use of feedback data for learning, adaptation, and programme decision-making

Contribute to organizational learning through analysis, reporting, and lessons learned

Build capacity of staff and partners on CFM processes, safe handling of feedback, and accountability principles

Ensure communities are aware of and can access multiple CFM channels

Promote and uphold PSEAH and safeguarding principles in all CFM processes

Specific responsibilities

AO Support & Roving Role

Provide direct technical support to Area Office programme teams on CFM implementation through regular field visits

Mentor and coach AO CFM focal points and programme staff

Identify gaps and support AOs to improve quality, timeliness, and compliance with feedback handling as outlined in the CO CFM SOPs

Ensure consistency of CFM implementation across all AOs

CFM System Strengthening

Support rollout and operationalization of the CFM SOP across all Area and Field Offices.

Ensure CFM channels are functional, safe, confidential, accessible, and context-appropriate

Strengthen use of multiple channels (hotline, suggestion boxes, helpdesks, committees, face-to-face, etc.)

Support adaptation of CFM channels based on context and community preferences

Conduct regular field visits to monitor CFM functionality, risks, and accessibility Data Management

Feedback Handling & Compliance

Ensure all feedback is captured, categorized, and managed in line with SOP procedures

Ensure timely follow-up and response to non-sensitive feedback

Ensure immediate escalation (within 24 hours) of sensitive feedback (safeguarding, protection, misconduct, HSS)

Ensure confidentiality, informed consent, and do no harm principles are upheld

Data Management, Analysis & Reporting

Oversee the CFM database, ensuring accurate, timely, and secure data entry
Analyze feedback data to identify trends, risks, and programme improvement areas
Produce monthly CFM reports and dashboards
Support programme teams in using feedback data for decision-making and adaptation
