title: Security & Access Officer
description:
About the Job
About MAG:

MAG (Mines Advisory Group) is an international humanitarian organisation based in Manchester, UK, and working in 32 countries. We remove landmines and unexploded ordnance to release safe and productive land for communities, and work to reduce the threat of armed violence by supporting governments to safely manage weapons and ammunition. In 1997, MAG was a co-recipient of the Nobel Peace Prize for our work campaigning for the Anti-Personnel Mine Ban Convention.

MAG is registered and accredited as a humanitarian mine action NGO in Ethiopia and is in the process of establishing a country office and operations focused on responding to the threat posed by explosive ordnance contamination in northern Ethiopia. Initial planned programming will focus on the delivery of Explosive Ordnance Risk Education, working with local partners, and capacity support to national actors. Further scale-up and expansion of activities to encompass survey and clearance operations is anticipated over the coming months.

About the role:

The Security and access officer will be responsible for overseeing various Security and Access activities within the Ethiopia programme. Reporting directly to the Country Director, you will lead and manage all safety, security, and access functions for MAG’s programme in Ethiopia. The Security & Access Officer will ensure safe and sustained access to operational areas, maintain effective security risk management systems, and support informed decision-making through high-quality analysis and coordination.

About you:

The successful candidate will:

Previous experience in NGOs and humanitarian work.
Minimum of 2 years of demonstrated experience in Security & Access.
Demonstrable critical incident management experience.
Experience and ability to work effectively with multi-disciplinary and multicultural teams.
Self-organized, team player, and able to work under limited supervision.
Experience with Mine Action Organizations preferred.
Demonstrable political, security and conflict analysis skills (including open source and geospatial intelligence).
Demonstrable understanding of the PNG/Pacific Islands context.
Good literacy, numeracy, and IT skills (e.g., Word/Excel).
Skilled in the development of security risk assessments.
Security training experience (field security, security management, crisis management humanitarian principles).
Experienced in field communication devices (HF, VHF, UHF, SATCOM etc.) Reliable with good time-keeping skills.
Language requirements – English, Tigrinya & Amharic Mandatory.
MAG’s Vision is a safe future for women, men and children affected by violence, conflict, and insecurity. People will live in communities where their rights are upheld, with dignity and choice and free from fear from mines, explosive remnants of war (ERW) and the impact of small arms and light weapons and ammunition.

MAG’s Mission is to save lives and build safer futures. We will use our core skills and distinctive competence to save lives through the removal of mines and ERW, and reduce the impact of small arms, light weapons and ammunition on people and communities. How we do this is as important as what we do – we work primarily with and for communities, for us ‘it’s all about people’.

MAG’s Values. Our values come to life through our actions, every day. How we act has an impact on others. As someone who works at MAG, you can help to create a positive culture by demonstrating our values through your own behaviour and actions. Everyone has a role to play in shaping our culture. Everyone should understand our values and is encouraged to think how they are relevant to their individual role.

DETERMINED - we work with purpose

EXPERT - through excellence and expertise we build trust INTEGRITY - we strive to do the right thing
COMPASSION - people come first in everything we do INCLUSIVE - we are inclusive, and we value diversity
Overview of role:

The primary purpose of this role is to lead and manage all safety, security, and access functions for MAG’s programme in Ethiopia. The Security & Access Officer will ensure safe and sustained access to operational areas, maintain effective security risk management systems, and support informed decision-making through high-quality analysis and coordination.

Responsibilities:
Safety & Security & Management:
• Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the MAG Country Security Framework.
• Ensure full compliance with MAG global security policies, standards, and duty of care obligations.
• Develop, implement, and monitor security plans, procedures, and risk mitigation measures.
• Conduct regular security risk assessments and ensure findings are integrated into programme planning.
• Ensure preparedness for critical incidents and crisis response, including contingency planning.
• Advise the Country Director and SMT on security risks, trends, and mitigation strategies.
• Oversee and manage security personnel, including guards and any third-party security providers.
• Act as the primary HSE focal point, promoting a strong safety culture across the programme.
• Lead or support investigations into security incidents and ensure lessons learned are applied.

Access & Movement Management:
• Develop and implement humanitarian access strategies to support safe programme delivery.
• Establish and maintain effective communication, tracking, and movement control systems.
• Develop and enforce movement procedures for staff within Addis Ababa and other areas of operation.
• Maintain regular engagement with authorities and relevant stakeholders to facilitate safe access.
• Monitor routes, access constraints, and emerging risks, ensuring contingency measures are in place.
• Support safe travel planning, including entry/exit procedures and in-country movements.

Information Management & Context Analysis:
• Collect, analyze, and disseminate timely and accurate security information.
• Produce regular security updates, including weekly reports and incident analysis.
• Develop forward-looking risk scenarios and early warning indicators.
• Maintain strong formal and informal security information networks (INGOs, UN, local actors).
• Integrate community-level insights into security analysis and planning.
• Support evidence-based decision-making through mapping, briefings, and analytical products.

Stakeholder Engagement, Training & Physical Security:
• Build and maintain effective relationships with government authorities, security actors, local communities, and inter-agency networks to support safe and sustained access.
• Strengthen acceptance through regular engagement and representation in security coordination forums.
• Deliver security inductions, briefings, and training for staff and visitors, promoting awareness of security procedures and crisis response.
• Build staff capacity to understand and apply security protocols, supporting the development of national staff to manage security functions independently.
• Ensure appropriate physical security measures are in place across offices, residences, and programme sites, and monitor compliance with safety and security standards.
• Oversee the secure use and management of programme assets from a security perspective, including conducting regular checks and identifying improvements.

General Responsibilities:
• Work within the framework of MAG’s core values.
• Maintain professional conduct in line with MAG’s core values as actions represent MAG.
• Contribute to other fundraising initiatives where appropriate.
• Participate in meetings as relevant.
• Understand and uphold the standards outlined in MAG’s Safeguarding Framework, acting with due care and attention to safeguard the wellbeing of anyone that comes into contact with MAG’s work and reporting concerns if they do arise.
• Undertake and apply learning from appropriate training and development programs.
• Undertake any other duties as may be required.
About You
Essential requirements:
• Previous experience in NGOs and humanitarian work.
• Minimum of 2 years of demonstrated experience in Security & Access.
• Demonstrable critical incident management experience.
• Experience and ability to work effectively with multi-disciplinary and multicultural teams.
• Self-organized, team player, and able to work under limited supervision.
• Experience with Mine Action Organizations preferred.
• Demonstrable political, security and conflict analysis skills (including open source and geospatial intelligence).
• Demonstrable understanding of the PNG/Pacific Islands context.
• Good literacy, numeracy, and IT skills (e.g., Word/Excel).
• Skilled in the development of security risk assessments.
• Security training experience (field security, security management, crisis management humanitarian principles).
• Experienced in field communication devices (HF, VHF, UHF, SATCOM etc.) Reliable with good time-keeping skills.
• Language requirements – English, Tigrinya & Amharic Mandatory.

title: Impact Communications Specialist
description:
About Mercy Corps
Mercy Corps is a leading global organization powered by the belief that a better world is possible. In disaster, in hardship, in more than 40 countries around the world, we partner to put bold solutions into action — helping people triumph over adversity and build stronger communities from within. Now, and for the future.

Mercy Corps has been operating in Ethiopia since 2004. In partnership with civil society organizations, academic institutions, private sector, and the government, Mercy Corps Ethiopia has reached more than five million Ethiopians with interventions to save lives and build secure livelihoods. Our programs emphasize market-driven solutions, reinforce social bonds, and help communities build resilience to the impacts of climate change. Currently in six regional states (Afar, Amhara, Gambella, Oromia, Somali, Tigray and the capital city of Ethiopia, Addis Ababa) Mercy Corps Ethiopia is driven by the mission to contribute the emergence of a peaceful, resilient, and prosperous Ethiopia which is inclusive of youth and women.

Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Position Status: Full-time, Regular

Salary Level: (Refer to the relevant salary scale)

Risk Level: ☐ Level 3 ☐Level 2 ☐Level 1
Level 3: Frequent contact with participants, direct contact with children, access to sensitive data, and/or high level of accountability.

Level 2: Some contact with participants; unplanned non-direct contact with children.

Level 1: Likely to have no contact with participants or sensitive data)

The Program / Department / Summary
The Economic Recovery for Conflict-Affected Populations (ER-CAP) Program is a SIDA-funded, multi-partner initiative led by Mercy Corps in collaboration with DRC and First Consult, aimed at supporting resilient and inclusive economic recovery in conflict-affected regions of Tigray, Amhara and Afar in Ethiopia. Operating in a fragile context, the program focuses on strengthening livelihoods, market systems, and community resilience through evidence-based, adaptive, and conflict-sensitive approaches. It integrates learning, accountability, and stakeholder engagement to drive sustainable change, ensuring that recovery pathways, systems strengthening, and resilience-building processes are well-documented and communicated. By aligning program delivery with a strong Theory of Change, ER-CAP emphasizes collaboration across partners, promotes dignified and ethical engagement with communities, and contributes to broader sector learning and influence while meeting donor visibility and reporting requirements.

The Position (General Position Summary)
The Impact Communications Specialist will lead to the day-to-day implementation of the ER-CAP communications strategy, ensuring that program visibility, learning, accountability, and stakeholder engagement are delivered in a coherent, high-quality, and conflict-sensitive manner.

The role is responsible for transforming program evidence, field realities, and learning into clear, compelling, and ethically grounded communications outputs that support donor reporting, stakeholder engagement, and sector influence.

Working closely with program, MRM and MEL, and field teams across the consortium, the Impact Communications Specialist will ensure that communications is fully integrated into program delivery and adaptive learning processes.

Essential Responsibilities
STRATEGY, PLANNING AND COORDIANTION

Create and operationalize the ER-CAP Communications Plan across all program locations and partners
Translate communications strategy into actionable workplans and content pipelines
Coordinate communications activities across Mercy Corps, DRC, and First Consult teams
Ensure alignment between communications outputs, program priorities, and donor requirements
Contribute to development of program-wide impact narratives for donor and strategic reporting
Provide insights to inform adaptive management and program decision-making
CONTENT DEVELOPMENT AND STORY TELLING

Lead development of high-quality communications products including human-interest stories, success stories, case studies, and learning briefs
Document recovery pathways, systems change, and resilience-building processes
Produce multimedia content (photo, video, digital assets) in collaboration with field teams and partners
Ensuring storytelling reflects dignity, agency, and conflict sensitivity
LEARNING AND EVIDNECE COMMUNCATION

Work closely with MEL teams to translate evidence into accessible communications products
Support documentation of adaptive management, lessons learned, and program innovations
Contribute to learning briefs, technical notes, and annual learning reports
Ensure learning products are relevant for both operational and external audiences
Support synthesis and communication of program outcomes and impact-level results
Ensure alignment of communications with program Theory of Change
STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT AND VISIBILITY

Support donor visibility and reporting requirements, including SIDA communications needs
Develop content and messaging for government, donor, and sector engagement forums
Contribute to learning/evidence briefs, presentations, and external positioning materials
Support preparation of communications for events, workshops, and stakeholder dialogues
DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS

Manage and support program digital communications channels (websites, LinkedIn, etc.)
Develop digital content including posts, infographics, short videos, and evidence snapshots
Ensure consistent messaging and branding across consortium partners
Monitor digital engagement and adjust content strategy accordingly
Analyze communication performance to assess influence and uptake
WORKING RELATIONSHIP

The role works in close collaboration with MEL teams to ensure effective integration of evidence and learning into communications outputs. It engages regularly with field teams to identify relevant content and support meaningful community engagement. The position also coordinates with consortium partners to maintain alignment and coherence across program communications, while working with technical teams to ensure accuracy and contextual relevance of all materials. Additionally, the role liaises with external stakeholders, including donors and government counterparts, to support visibility, reporting, and strategic engagement.

KEY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

Success in this role will be measured by the consistent production of high-quality communications outputs that clearly reflect program impact. It includes effectively integrating learning and evidence into communications products to support informed decision-making and adaptive management. The role is expected to strengthen stakeholder engagement and enhance program visibility, while strictly adhering to safeguarding and conflict sensitivity standards. Additionally, performance will be assessed based on meaningful contributions to program learning processes and the timely delivery of donor-facing communications in line with requirements.

RISK AND QUALITY ASSURANCE
Ensure all communications comply with conflict sensitivity and Do No Harm principles
Manage informed consent processes for all human-centered storytelling
Review content for protection, privacy, and reputational risks
SAFEGUARDING RESPONSIBILITIES
Actively learns about safeguarding and integrates it into their work, including safeguarding risks and mitigations related to their area of work.
Practices the values of Mercy Corps including respecting the dignity and well-being of participants and fellow team members.
Encourages openness and communication in their team; encourages team members to submit reports if they have any concerns using reporting mechanisms e.g., Integrity Hotline and other options.
Support safeguarding review processes for sensitive content

title: supervisor
description:
SUPRVISER

ድርጅታችንን ወደ ከፍተኛ ስኬት ለመምራት በዲጂታል ዘርፍ ሰፊ እውቀት ያላቸውን፣ ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት ያላቸውን እና ልምድ ያላቸውን ባለሙያዎች ይፈልጋል። ይህ የሥራ መደብ የድርጅቱን አጠቃላይ አስተዳደር፣ የሽያጭ ስራዎችን እና የፕሮዳክሽን ሂደቶችን በብቃት መምራት ለሚችሉ ባለሙያዎች የተዘጋጀ ነው።
ልዩ ማሳሰቢያ፦ ይህ የሥራ መደብ ሰልጣኞችን ወይም በቂ ልምድ የሌላቸውን አያካትትም። አመልካቾች የድርጅቱን ነባር ሥራዎች ተረክበው ወዲያውኑ ማስቀጠል የሚችሉ፣ በአስተዳደርና ሽያጭ ዘርፍ የካበተ ልምድ ያላቸው መሆን ይኖርባቸዋል።

ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች
1. ስትራቴጂክ አመራር እና ማርኬቲንግ
• የድርጅቱን ዋና አንቀሳቃሽ የሆነውን የማርኬቲንግ ዘርፍ ውጤታማ ማድረግ።
• ድርጅቱን ትርፋማ የሚያደርጉ ፖሊሲዎችን እና ስትራቴጂዎችን ነድፎ መተግበር።
• የድርጅቱን የአጭርና የረዥም ጊዜ ዕቅዶች ለማሳካት የሰው ኃይልንና የሥራ ሂደቶችን መምራት።
2. የፕሮዳክሽን እና የሥራ ሂደት ቁጥጥር
• የፕሮዳክሽን ሥራዎች በታቀደላቸው ጥራትና ጊዜ መጠናቀቃቸውን ማረጋገጥ።
• እያንዳንዱ የሥራ ሂደት ለድርጅቱ ግብ ስኬት የበኩሉን አስተዋጽኦ እያበረከተ መሆኑን መከታተልና ሪፖርት ማቅረብ።
• የሠራተኞችን የሥራ ክንውን መገምገም እና የአሠራር ባህል እንዲጎለብት ማድረግ።
3. ፋይናንስ እና አስተዳደር
• የበጀት አጠቃቀምን መከታተል፣ አላስፈላጊ ወጪዎችን መቀነስ እና ትርፋማነትን ማረጋገጥ።
• ከፋይናንስ ባለሙያዎች ጋር በመተባበር የግብርና የቀረጥ ክፍያዎች በወቅቱ እንዲከናወኑ ማድረግ።
• አዳዲስ ሠራተኞችን የመመልመል፣ የማሰልጠን እና የማስተዳደር ሥራዎችን ማከናወን።
የሚያስፈልጉ መስፈርቶች
• ትምህርት፡ የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ (BA) በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ማርኬቲንግ፣ ማኔጅመንት፣ ቢዝነስ አድሚኒስትሬሽን ወይም በተዛማጅ መስኮች።

title: SAP ERP Support Team Leader for Addis Ababa
description:
SAP ERP Support Team Leader

Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Brief Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP ERP Support Team Leader to lead our SAP support team in Addis Ababa. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day activities of the SAP support team, ensuring timely and effective resolution of SAP-related issues, and driving process improvements to optimize SAP system performance. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in SAP, excellent leadership skills, and a proven track record of delivering high-quality support services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the SAP support team to provide timely and effective resolution of SAP-related issues
  • Develop and implement process improvements to optimize SAP system performance and efficiency
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize SAP-related projects and initiatives
  • Provide technical guidance and support to team members to ensure they have the necessary skills and knowledge to perform their duties effectively
  • Develop and manage the SAP support team's budget, including forecasting and tracking expenses
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and standards
  • Analyze and resolve complex SAP-related issues, including system errors, data inconsistencies, and integration problems

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field from a reputable Ethiopian university
  • At least 5 years of experience in SAP support, with a focus on ERP systems (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, etc.)
  • Proven experience in leading a support team, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality support services
  • Excellent knowledge of SAP modules, including FI, CO, MM, SD, HR, and PP
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and develop effective solutions
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Certification in SAP ERP support or a related field is an added advantage

title: SAP Interface Analyst for Addis Ababa
description:
SAP Interface Analyst

Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

Brief Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP Interface Analyst to join our team in Addis Ababa. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing SAP interfaces to ensure seamless integration with various systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP integration, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

title: Senior Procurement Manager (External Vacancy)
description:
About the Job
Role Summary

The Procurement Senior Manager will lead and oversee all procurement functions of MSIE to ensure efficient, transparent, compliant, and cost-effective procurement operations. The role will provide strategic leadership in procurement planning, supplier management, contract administration, and supply chain coordination to support uninterrupted programme and operational activities across the organization.

The successful candidate will work closely with programme, finance, warehouse, logistics, supply chain, and leadership teams to strengthen procurement systems, ensure compliance with donor and organizational requirements, and improve value for money.

Key Responsibilities

Lead procurement planning and oversee end-to-end procurement processes.
Ensure compliance with MSI policies, donor regulations, and Ethiopian legal requirements.
Manage supplier selection, negotiations, contracts, and performance monitoring.
Strengthen procurement systems, controls, and documentation practices.
Coordinate with supply chain and warehouse teams to support inventory and commodity availability.
Support procurement budgeting, expenditure monitoring, and cost control initiatives.
Lead and mentor procurement staff and support capacity-building initiatives.
Prepare procurement reports and support audit and compliance reviews.
Promote transparency, accountability, and ethical procurement practices.
About You
Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Procurement and Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, Management, or related field.
Professional certification in procurement or supply chain management is an advantage.
Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive procurement and supply chain management experience, including at least 4 years in a senior leadership or supervisory role.
Proven experience in strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiation, and compliance management.
Experience working in healthcare, NGO, business, or donor-funded environments is desirable.
Strong understanding of donor procurement regulations and procurement best practices.
Excellent leadership, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office and procurement systems.
Excellent written and spoken English skills.
Personal Attributes

The ideal candidate should be:

Strategic and results-oriented.
Ethical, accountable, and highly professional.
Resilient and able to work under pressure.
Collaborative with strong interpersonal skills.
Committed to diversity, safeguarding, and inclusion principles.

title: Cost Engineer
description:
Job Title: Cost Engineer

Brief Summary

We are seeking an experienced and skilled Cost Engineer to join our team. As a Cost Engineer, you will be responsible for analyzing and managing costs related to our projects, ensuring that they are completed within budget and on time. You will work closely with our project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to identify areas for cost savings and implement cost-effective solutions. If you have a strong background in cost engineering and are looking for a new challenge, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts, and cost reports to ensure that projects are completed within budget and on time.
  • Analyze costs and identify areas for cost savings, implementing cost-effective solutions where possible.
  • Conduct cost-benefit analyses to determine the feasibility of projects and make recommendations to management.
  • Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure that costs are accurately estimated and managed.
  • Develop and maintain cost databases, spreadsheets, and other tools to track and analyze costs.
  • Prepare and present cost reports and analyses to management and other stakeholders.

Requirements

  • BSc degree in Cost Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field from a recognized Ethiopian university.
  • At least 3 years of experience in cost engineering, preferably in a construction or engineering environment.
  • Professional certification in cost engineering, such as CCCE or CCE, is an advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of cost engineering principles, practices, and techniques, including cost estimation, cost control, and cost analysis.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proficiency in cost engineering software, such as Primavera, MS Project, or equivalent, and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • At least 5 years of experience in accounting, preferably in a senior role
  • Strong knowledge of Ethiopian accounting standards and tax laws
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with ability to work effectively with colleagues and stakeholders

  • Strong knowledge of Ethiopian tax laws and regulations, including the Ethiopian Income Tax Proclamation and the Value Added Tax Proclamation

title: Project Officers
description: About the Job Vacancy Announcement Position: Project Officers Organization: PETCO Ethiopia Community Organization Category: Program Department Report to: Field Office Coordination Program Officer Salary: Competitive salary and a range of additional benefits Employment Term: Annual contract, renewable based on available fund Closing Date: 23 May, 2026 Background About PETCO Ethiopia: PETCO Ethiopia Recycling Community Organization (PETCO Ethiopia) is a non-for-profit board led local organization incorporated in 2019. PETCO Ethiopia promotes a circular economy system to assure products and materials are kept in circulation through Circular designating, maintenance, reuse, refurbishment, remanufacture, recycling, and Composting. PETCO Ethiopia seeks to minimize the environmental impact of post-consumer waste through accelerating the manufacturing sector shift from Linier to a Circular Economy production system; supporting existing and creating green jobs for women, youth, and marginalized people; as well as promoting exercise of self-regulation for sustainable business in industries and institutions. PETCO Ethiopia operates throughout Ethiopia and has its head office in Addis Ababa. Moreover, PETCO Ethiopia is fostering access to finance, and capacity building, to foster enterprise development in Ethiopia across agro-processing & food, handcraft, textile and garment, solid waste, and leather sectors. Program Background PETCO Ethiopia is implementing 5-years of consortium project joint with Center of Accelerated Women Economic Empowerment (CAWEE) and Ethiopia Enterprise Development. The program is funded by the Mastercard Foundation contract to Mabqat project Enable Young Women and Men to Find Dignified and Fulfilling Work in Manufacturing in Ethiopia by capacitating existing SMEs. The program aims to: Build SME capacity to sustainably create new jobs and improve existing ones through offering tailored business capacity building and mentorship; enhancing access to markets and raw materials flow; and improving SMEs’ human resources capacity to create safe and inclusive working conditions for young women and men. Improve Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) offerings to better prepare women and youth to enter the workforce (facilitate school-to-work transition). Facilitate a robust financial ecosystem to help SMEs access tailored financial services that allow them to grow and increase employment opportunities for young women in particular, and to invest in infrastructure that can improve young women and men's working conditions. Strengthen the enablers (ecosystem) to foster private sector engagement, stakeholder coordination synergy, and policy development for sustainable and scalable job growth. Job Description and Key Responsibilities: Work closely with the project management team and other staff members to organize events, prepare reports, maintain project documentation, and liaise with stakeholders. Provide administrative and logistical support to ensure the smooth implementation of project activities under the Mabqat project. Supporting project coordination, monitoring, and reporting activities, contributing to the overall success and impact of the project. Provide administrative support for project activities, including scheduling meetings, organizing workshops and events, and making travel arrangements for project staff and partners. Liaise with project stakeholders, including government agencies, civil society organizations, and community groups, to coordinate project activities and facilitate information sharing and collaboration. Contribute to the identification and documentation of project best practices, lessons learned, and success stories, and support knowledge sharing and learning initiatives within the project team and with external stakeholders. Assist in conducting periodic project reviews, assessments, and evaluations to identify lessons learned and areas for improvement Support effective project management, coordination and provide support to partners on the project implementation procedure, data management and effective financial management. Provide support as needed, the preparation and timely submission of detailed reports by the partners on project activities on a quarterly and annual basis in compliance with project requirements. Support the development of annual, quarterly donor and government report writing including management and updates. Perform other duties as assigned by the program director to support the overall success and impact of the project. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with the capacity to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. The Enterprise strives to create a balance between social impact, operational excellence, and financial sustainability while supporting the national healthcare system.

The Enterprise operates with a strong commitment to transparency, accountability, professionalism, customer satisfaction, and institutional growth.

Job Summary

The Finance & Administration Officer is responsible for managing and coordinating the financial, administrative, and operational support activities of the Enterprise. The position plays a key role in ensuring efficient financial management, regulatory compliance, proper utilization of organizational resources, and smooth day-to-day administrative operations.

The Officer supports Enterprise Management in budget administration, financial reporting, procurement follow-up, asset management, human resource coordination, office administration, and operational compliance. The role also contributes to strengthening internal control systems and ensuring proper documentation and accountability across Enterprise activities.

Key Responsibilities

A. Financial Management Responsibilities

Prepare, review, and maintain accurate financial records, reports, and supporting documents.
Assist in preparing annual budgets, quarterly plans, and financial forecasts.
Monitor budget utilization and report budget variances to management.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for Enterprise Management.
Ensure all payments, receipts, and financial transactions are properly documented and authorized.
Verify payment requests before approval and ensure compliance with Enterprise financial procedures.
Follow up bank transactions, bank reconciliations, and cash flow management activities.
Ensure payroll preparation is accurate and government taxes, pension, and statutory deductions are properly processed and paid on time.
Maintain accurate records of revenues, expenditures, advances, and settlements.
Monitor collection and recording of revenues generated from Enterprise activities and projects.
Ensure proper filing and archiving of financial documents and records.
Support internal and external audit activities by preparing required documents and schedules.
Ensure compliance with Ethiopian tax laws, accounting standards, and financial regulations.
Follow up procurement payments, contracts, and supplier settlement processes.
Participate in financial risk assessment and internal control improvement activities.
B. Administrative Responsibilities

Coordinate daily administrative and office operations of the Enterprise.
Monitor office resource utilization and ensure efficient administrative support services.
Facilitate procurement requests, logistics coordination, and inventory management.
Maintain records of fixed assets, office equipment, and property administration.
Coordinate maintenance and operational support for office facilities and utilities.
Ensure proper management of office supplies and administrative materials.
Support management in organizing meetings, workshops, trainings, and official events.
Prepare official letters, memos, administrative reports, and correspondences.
Ensure proper documentation and filing of organizational records and legal documents.
Coordinate transportation, travel arrangements, and vehicle administration activities when necessary.
Assist in monitoring compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and operational guidelines.
Support implementation of administrative systems and process improvement initiatives.
C. Human Resource & Operational Support Responsibilities

Assist in coordinating staff attendance, leave management, and personnel documentation.
Support recruitment, onboarding, and employee documentation processes.
Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.
Assist in monitoring staff contract administration and performance documentation.
Coordinate communication between management and operational units.
Provide operational and administrative support during projects, partnership activities, and Enterprise initiatives.
Support implementation of institutional accountability and reporting systems.
Duties Related to Governance & Accountability

Ensure compliance with Enterprise policies, financial procedures, and administrative regulations.
Promote transparency, accountability, and ethical financial practices.
Report financial or administrative irregularities to Enterprise Management.
Maintain confidentiality and integrity in handling organizational information.
Participate in institutional planning, monitoring, and evaluation activities.
Support development and implementation of internal control systems.
About You
Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Management, or related fields.
Master’s Degree is advantageous.
Experience

Minimum of 4–6 years of relevant experience in finance, administration, accounting, or operational management.
Experience in healthcare institutions, enterprises, NGOs, hospitals, or private organizations is advantageous.
Experience in financial reporting, procurement coordination, and administrative management is preferred.
Experience with ERP systems or accounting software is an asset.
Required Skills and Competencies

Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial management systems.
Knowledge of Ethiopian tax regulations, labor laws, and financial procedures.
Strong administrative and organizational management skills.
Excellent analytical, reporting, and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and Word.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and under pressure.
High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
Good planning, coordination, and time management skills.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive organizational information.
Salary and Benefits

Salary: Negotiable and attractive based on qualification and experience.
Other benefits shall be provided according to Enterprise policy and applicable regulations.

title: Operations Director(Urgent)
description:
About the Job
The Operations Director at Flipper International School (FIS) is responsible for the physical integrity, safety, and operational continuity of all FIS campuses. This role is not desk-bound; it requires a hands-on leader to manage distributed teams of security and cleaning staff, oversee technical building maintenance, and ensure 100% compliance with Ethiopian OHS regulations. The Operations Manager will be the responsible for our procurement and maintenance schedules.

Key Responsibilities

1. Multi-Site Security & Hygiene Management

Security Oversight: Direct management of the security teams across all sites. Implement standardized SOPs for access control, emergency response, and student safeguarding.
Sanitation & Cleaning: Oversee cleaning crews and vendors across various sites to maintain high levels of hygiene.
Vendor Performance: Manage external service providers, negotiating contracts that optimize service delivery while controlling costs.
2. Technical Maintenance & Asset Integrity

Maintenance Scheduling: Draft and execute comprehensive preventative maintenance schedules (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and structural) for all rented and owned properties.
Technical Knowledge: Provide expert oversight on building repairs and renovations, ensuring all campuses meet FIS brand specifications.
Infrastructure Projects: Manage small-to-midscale construction or "fit-out" projects as we expand or relocate branches.
3. Compliance & OHS (Occupational Health & Safety)

Regulatory Alignment: Ensure every FIS site is fully compliant with Ethiopian OHS regulations and Ministry of Education facility standards.
Risk Audits: Conduct regular safety audits, fire drills, and hazard assessments across all sites.
Training: Lead OHS training for all support staff to ensure a culture of safety.
4. Procurement & Financial Control

Strategic Procurement: Centralize and oversee the procurement of all operational supplies (cleaning chemicals, security tech, maintenance materials) to leverage economies of scale.
Budgetary Oversight: Draft the annual operational budget. Implement rigorous budget monitoring to identify variances and execute corrective actions.
Asset Management: Maintain a meticulous fixed-asset register across all locations.

About You
Experience & Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Management, or a related technical field.
Senior Leadership: Minimum 8–12 years of experience, with at least 5 years managing multi-site operations (e.g., hospitality, retail chains, or large-scale education).
Technical Proficiency: Demonstrated experience in drafting maintenance blueprints and managing technical teams (electricians, plumbers, etc.).
Local Context: Deep knowledge of the Ethiopian Labor Law and OHS regulatory framework.
Required Skills

Strategic Budgeting: Ability to translate operational needs into a lean, defensible financial model.
Negotiation: Proven track record in vendor management and contract negotiation in the Ethiopian market.
Crisis Management: Calm and decisive under pressure (e.g., campus relocations or emergency repairs).
Communication: Report monthly to the General Manager.

title: TERMS OF REFERENCE (TOR) For Consultancy Services to Conduct a Comprehensive Baseline Assessment for the AMPLIFY Project
description:
About the Job
Background

The Ethiopian Center for Disability and Development (ECDD) is an Ethiopian Development Organization established in 2005 and re‑registered under Proclamation № 1113/2019. ECDD works to promote and facilitate the inclusion of persons with disabilities in mainstream service delivery and development programs, envisioning an inclusive Ethiopia where persons with disabilities enjoy equal rights and opportunities.

With funding from the Finnish Evangelical Lutheran Mission (FELM), ECDD is implementing the AMPLIFY Project (2026–2029). The project aims to empower persons with disabilities and their representative organizations (OPDs), enhance social inclusion, and strengthen government duty bearers to adopt disability‑inclusive policies and practices.

As a preliminary activity, ECDD intends to conduct a baseline assessment in the six target areas including Addis Ababa, Dire Dawa, Gondar/Bahir Dar (Amhara), Jimma (Oromia), Hosaena (Central Ethiopia), and Mekelle (Tigray) , to generate reliable evidence on participation, leadership, access to services, stigma reduction, and institutional capacity for disability inclusion. This assessment will guide project implementation, set benchmarks, and measure progress throughout the project cycle.

General Objective

To generate baseline data through a comprehensive survey on participation, leadership, access to mainstream services, and key factors affecting inclusion of persons with disabilities in the six target areas.

Specific Objectives

Assess the current status of OPDs’ organizational capacity, leadership, and advocacy initiatives.
Identify barriers and enablers to social inclusion and community attitudes toward persons with disabilities.
Assess government duty bearers’ and service providers’ capacity to adopt disability‑inclusive policies and practices.
Provide reliable quantitative and qualitative data to inform project targets, indicators, and monitoring frameworks.
Recommend strategies to address identified challenges and strengthen disability inclusion.
Methodology

The baseline assessment will adopt a mixed‑methods approach, combining both quantitative and qualitative data collection and analysis to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the situation of persons with disabilities in the six target areas (Addis Ababa, Dire Dawa, Gondar/Bahir Dar, Jimma, Hosaena, and Mekelle), as well as at the federal level.

Quantitative Methods

Household Surveys: Structured questionnaires administered to a representative sample of persons with disabilities from both host communities and urban/peri‑urban settings to gather data on demographics, participation, leadership, access to services (health, education, livelihoods, justice), and social inclusion.
Institutional Surveys: Data collected from OPDs, government offices, service providers, and educational institutions to quantify service coverage, accessibility, and inclusion gaps.
Policy and Strategy Review: Collection and analysis of existing federal‑level disability inclusion policies, strategies, and frameworks (e.g., National Social Protection Policy, Education Sector Development Program, CRPD commitments, National Plan of Action for Persons with Disabilities).
Secondary Data Review: Existing data from government offices, OPDs, health facilities, schools, and prior studies will be reviewed to complement primary data.
Data Analysis: Statistical software will be used to analyze quantitative data, identify trends, gaps, and correlations, and establish baseline indicators for project monitoring.
Qualitative Methods

Key Informant Interviews (KIIs): Conducted with government officials (both federal and regional), The Federation of Ethiopian Associations of Persons with Disabilities (FEAPD), regional OPD leaders, service providers, and community actors to explore perceptions, policies, and practices related to disability inclusion.
Focus Group Discussions (FGDs): Organized with persons with disabilities (segmented by gender, age, and disability type) to capture lived experiences, challenges, and recommendations.
Observation and Site Visits: Visits to health centers, schools, OPDs, workplaces, and community facilities to assess physical accessibility, inclusive practices, and service delivery.
Policy Dialogue Interviews: Engagement with federal ministries (MoWSA, MoE, MoJ, EDRMC, EMA, NEBE, etc.) to assess their current disability inclusion strategies, institutional capacity, and alignment with CRPD and SDGs.
Thematic Analysis: Qualitative data will be systematically analyzed to extract insights on barriers, enablers, and stakeholder perspectives, and triangulated against quantitative findings.
Sources of Data

Primary Data: Surveys, interviews, FGDs, and observations with persons with disabilities, OPDs, government stakeholders, and service providers.
Secondary Data: Federal policies, national strategies, OPD records, government reports, published research, and other relevant sources.
Sample Size

Determined scientifically to ensure representativeness across the six target areas.
Must include persons with disabilities, OPDs, government duty bearers, and service providers.
Sampling will consider gender, age, type of disability, and displacement status where relevant.
The consultant is expected to use scientific sampling techniques and tools to determine the total sample size, ensuring accuracy and reliability of findings.
Data Analysis

Quantitative Data: Analyzed using statistical software to identify trends, gaps, and correlations.
Qualitative Data: Thematically analyzed to extract insights on barriers, enablers, and stakeholder perspectives.
Triangulation: Findings from quantitative and qualitative data will be crosschecked to ensure validity and reliability.
Analytical Models: The consultant may apply frameworks to identify major barriers faced by persons with disabilities in accessing services.
Ethical Considerations

Informed consent from all participants.
Data confidentiality and sensitivity to disability‑related issues.
Inclusive and accessible communication methods (sign language, braille, plain text, easy‑to‑read formats).
The consultant is expected to propose participatory, accessible, and inclusive data collection approaches in consideration of the types of impairments of persons with disabilities.
Key Deliverables

Inception Report: Outlining the proposed methodology, including research methods, sampling framework, data sources, procedures for data collection and analysis, and a draft table of contents.
Research Tools: All proposed data collection tools will be reviewed and approved by ECDD and its partners prior to fieldwork.
Draft Assessment Report: A preliminary version of the baseline report submitted for review and feedback.
Revised Draft: A second round of revisions may be requested by ECDD before final approval.
Final Report: A comprehensive final baseline report incorporating all comments, submitted in soft (both PDF and editable Word formats) and in hard copies not later than 5 calendar days after receiving comments on the first draft from ECDD.
Supporting Materials: An electronic copy of all approved data collection tools and the complete study dataset.

title: Senior Personnel Officer
description:
Senior Personnel Officer

Brief Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Personnel Officer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the personnel function, providing strategic and operational support to the organization, and ensuring compliance with relevant laws and regulations. This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned HR professional to make a significant impact and contribute to the growth and success of our organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement effective personnel management strategies and policies to support the organization's goals and objectives
  • Lead and manage the personnel team, providing guidance, coaching, and development opportunities to ensure high performance and exceptional service delivery
  • Oversee the recruitment and selection process, ensuring that all hires are made in accordance with organizational policies and procedures
  • Manage employee relations, including disciplinary actions, grievances, and conflict resolution
  • Develop and maintain effective communication channels with employees, management, and other stakeholders
  • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and standards, including labor laws, employment equity, and occupational health and safety
  • Analyze and report on personnel metrics, including turnover, absenteeism, and training and development initiatives

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field from a recognized Ethiopian university
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a personnel or HR role, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or management position
  • Professional certification in HR, such as a Certified Human Resource Professional (CHRP) or a Certified Personnel Officer (CPO), is an advantage
  • Proven knowledge of Ethiopian labor laws and regulations, including the Labor Proclamation and the Civil Service Proclamation
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with employees, management, and external stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions
  • Proficiency in MS Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and experience with HR information systems (HRIS)
  • Fluency in Amharic and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: System & Network Administrator
description:
System & Network Administrator

Brief Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced System & Network Administrator to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day administration and maintenance of our computer systems and network infrastructure. This includes ensuring the stability, security, and performance of our systems, as well as providing technical support to our users. If you have a strong background in system and network administration and are looking for a new challenge, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and maintain computer systems, networks, and related equipment
  • Monitor system performance, identify and resolve issues, and implement upgrades and patches as necessary
  • Ensure the security and integrity of our systems and data, including implementing backup and disaster recovery procedures
  • Provide technical support and training to users, including troubleshooting and resolving hardware and software issues
  • Develop and implement network and system security policies and procedures
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure seamless integration of systems and services
  • Stay up-to-date with new technologies and trends in system and network administration, and make recommendations for improvements

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field from a recognized Ethiopian university
  • At least 3 years of experience in system and network administration, preferably in a similar industry or environment
  • Strong knowledge of operating systems, including Windows and Linux
  • Experience with network protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP
  • Knowledge of security best practices and experience with security technologies, including firewalls and intrusion detection systems
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide technical support and training to users
  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Cisco CCNA are an asset
  • Fluency in Amharic and English is required, with the ability to communicate effectively in a multicultural environment

title: Midwife-Korem Project - Alamata Intervention
description:
Job Title: Midwife-Korem Project - Alamata Intervention

Brief Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Midwife to join our team for the Korem Project - Alamata Intervention. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing high-quality maternal and newborn care to mothers and babies in the project area. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of women and children in Ethiopia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide antenatal, intrapartum, and postpartum care to mothers and babies, including conducting deliveries and providing emergency obstetric care
  • Conduct community outreach and education on maternal and newborn health, including promoting healthy behaviors and providing information on available health services
  • Collaborate with other healthcare professionals, including doctors, nurses, and community health workers, to provide comprehensive care to mothers and babies
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of patient care, including maternal and newborn health data
  • Participate in training and capacity-building activities to improve midwifery skills and knowledge

Requirements

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Midwifery from a recognized Ethiopian university
  • Registration with the Ethiopian Midwives Association
  • At least 2 years of experience working as a midwife, preferably in a similar setting
  • Strong knowledge of maternal and newborn health, including current guidelines and protocols
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with ability to work effectively with patients, families, and other healthcare professionals
  • Ability to work in a resource-limited setting and adapt to changing circumstances
  • Fluency in Amharic and/or Tigrinya, with ability to communicate in English
  • Willingness to work in a rural area and travel to remote locations as needed

title: Project Sales Representative
description:
Project Sales Representative

Brief Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Project Sales Representative to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities, building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, and driving revenue growth. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in sales, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and pursue new sales opportunities through networking, lead generation, and cold calling
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored solutions
  • Conduct needs assessments and provide presentations to clients on our products and services
  • Negotiate and close deals, ensuring that sales targets are met or exceeded
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing and product development, to stay up-to-date on new products and services
  • Provide feedback and insights to management on market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field from a recognized Ethiopian university
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in sales, preferably in a project-based sales environment
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Strong knowledge of the Ethiopian market and industry trends
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Fluency in Amharic and English, with knowledge of other local languages an added advantage

title: KG Teachers
description:
KG Teachers

Brief Summary

We are seeking experienced and enthusiastic KG Teachers to join our esteemed educational institution. The successful candidates will be responsible for creating a nurturing and stimulating learning environment that fosters the cognitive, social, and emotional development of our kindergarten students. If you have a passion for teaching and a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement engaging lesson plans that cater to the diverse needs of kindergarten students
  • Create a positive and inclusive classroom environment that promotes social, emotional, and academic growth
  • Establish and maintain effective relationships with students, parents, and colleagues to ensure a collaborative approach to education
  • Assess and evaluate student progress, providing constructive feedback and support to ensure students meet their full potential
  • Stay up-to-date with best practices in kindergarten education, attending professional development workshops and conferences as required

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Education or a related field from a recognized Ethiopian university
  • Teacher's certificate from the Ethiopian Ministry of Education or a relevant professional certification
  • At least 2 years of experience in teaching kindergarten or a related field

  • Strong knowledge of the Ethiopian curriculum and education system

title: Senior Tendering & Estimation (Vacancy Code- Commercial 005/2026)
description:
Senior Tendering & Estimation (Vacancy Code- Commercial 005/2026)

Brief Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced and skilled Senior Tendering & Estimation professional to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the tendering and estimation process, ensuring that all tenders are submitted on time, and that the company's commercial interests are protected and enhanced. This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned professional to make a significant impact on our business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the tendering process, including reviewing and analyzing tender documents, identifying risks and opportunities, and developing winning strategies.
  • Prepare and submit tenders, including estimating costs, preparing technical and commercial proposals, and ensuring compliance with tender requirements.
  • Build and maintain relationships with clients, consultants, and other stakeholders to gather market intelligence and stay informed about upcoming tender opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including operations, finance, and technical teams, to ensure that tenders are properly resourced and aligned with company capabilities and goals.
  • Analyze and evaluate tender results, identifying areas for improvement and implementing changes to the tendering process as needed.
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of the company's products and services, as well as industry trends and competitor activity.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Engineering, Construction Management, or Quantity Surveying, from a recognized Ethiopian university.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in tendering and estimation, preferably in the construction or engineering industry.
  • Proven track record of success in winning tenders and negotiating contracts.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Fluency in English and Amharic, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Familiarity with Ethiopian construction laws, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, and experience with tendering software and systems.
  • Professional certification, such as a chartered engineer or certified estimator, is an advantage.

title: Call for Consultants on Life Skills and Employability Skills Refresher Training of Trainers (TOT) Under the STEP A.A Project
description:
Call for Consultants on Life Skills and Employability Skills Refresher Training of Trainers (TOT) Under the STEP A.A Project

Brief Summary

We are seeking experienced consultants to provide refresher training of trainers (TOT) on life skills and employability skills under the Support to the Ethiopian Private Sector (STEP) Addis Ababa project. The successful candidates will be responsible for delivering high-quality training to build the capacity of trainers and enhance the employability skills of youth in Ethiopia.

  • Prepare and submit a detailed report on the training program, including outcomes and recommendations

Requirements

  • Master's degree in Education, Psychology, Sociology, or a related field from a recognized Ethiopian university
  • At least 5 years of experience in training and development, with a focus on life skills and employability skills
  • Proven expertise in designing and delivering training programs for trainers, with a strong understanding of adult learning principles
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to work with diverse groups of trainers and stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess training needs and develop effective training programs
  • Familiarity with the Ethiopian education system and labor market, with a strong understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing youth in Ethiopia
  • Fluency in English and Amharic, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: Project Cashier (Gacho Baba)
description:
Job Title: Project Cashier (Gacho Baba)

Brief Summary

We are seeking an experienced and skilled Project Cashier to join our team in Gacho Baba. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing financial transactions, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures. The Project Cashier will play a key role in supporting the financial management of our projects, providing timely and accurate financial information to stakeholders.

  • Manage and process financial transactions, including receipts, payments, and reconciliations

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

  • Fluency in Amharic and English, with knowledge of local languages an advantage
  • Ability to work in a team environment, with a strong commitment to integrity, transparency, and accountability

title: Primary School Teachers (Grade 1–8)
description:
Job Title: Primary School Teachers (Grade 1–8)

title: Purchaser
description:
Purchaser

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Purchaser to join our procurement team. The successful candidate will be responsible for purchasing goods, materials, and services from reputable suppliers, ensuring that all purchases are made at the best possible price and quality. The Purchaser will also be responsible for maintaining good relationships with suppliers and ensuring that all purchases are made in accordance with company policies and procedures.

  • Negotiate prices and terms with suppliers to ensure the best possible value for the company

title: Light Vehicles Driver
description:
Job Title: Light Vehicles Driver

title: Grant Finance Manager
description:
About the Job
Purpose of the Role

The Grant Finance Manager is responsible for managing financial operations, budgeting & accounting. The role ensures accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting to the Ministry of Finance, EPHI management, and donors, and safeguards the proper use of public and donor funds in accordance with applicable financial laws, regulations, and manuals.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Financial Management and IFMIS

Oversee the efficient and effective utilization of approved budgets through IFMIS in line with annual plans and approved allocations.
Monitor expenditures against approved budgets to identify under- or over-utilization and take timely corrective actions within financial mandates.
Review, verify, and submit payment transactions for approval in accordance with approved financial procedures and authorization limits.
Ensure that all financial transactions are properly authorized, recorded, and documented within IFMIS.
Maintain the integrity, accuracy, and completeness of financial records and accounting data in IFMIS.
Compile list of VAT expenditure and the submit VAT reimbursement request to MoF.
Compliance and Internal Control

Ensure full compliance with national financial proclamations, regulations, directives, and donor finance manuals.
Establish, implement, and regularly review internal control systems to promote transparency, accountability, and effective financial management.
Ensure compliance with local tax laws, including accurate calculation, deduction, and timely remittance of employee and statutory taxes.
Budget Management

Support budget formulation, revision, and execution processes in accordance with approved financial frameworks.
Monitor budget utilization and prepare monthly budget utilization summaries.
Prepare Budget-versus-Actual (BVA) reports on a monthly and quarterly basis.
Ensure budget availability prior to approving financial commitments, payments, or procurement-related expenditures.
Financial Reporting

Prepare and review monthly financial reports generated through IFMIS and Peachtree to submit them to the Ministry of Finance & Donor in a timely manner.
Review general ledger balances, supporting schedules, and bank reconciliation statements to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Prepare internal financial management reports for EPHI management.
Prepare donor financial reports in line with approved budgets and reporting requirements.
Prepare year-end financial statements and statutory accounts with supporting schedules for audit purposes.
Audit and Assurance

Facilitate internal and external audits by providing complete and accurate financial records and explanations.
Coordinate responses to audit findings and ensure timely implementation of audit recommendations.
Professional Support

Provide technical guidance and advisory support on financial management, risk management, and internal control matters within the finance function.
Support continuous improvement of financial systems, reporting quality, and compliance standards.
About You
Job Requirements

Educational Qualification

PhD/MSc / MA / MBA / BA degree in Accounting and Finance, Management, Business Administration, or related fields.
Work Experience

Minimum of 14 years of relevant experience for first-degree holders or 12 years for postgraduate degree holders.
At least 5 years of hands-on experience with IFMIS or equivalent government financial management systems.
Proven experience in public sector financial management and donor-funded projects is highly desirable.
Skills and Competencies

Strong analytical and financial reporting skills.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and under pressure.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong computer skills, particularly in Microsoft Office applications.

description:
About the Job
Company’s and Role’s Overview

ABYS Trading PLC is one of the leading Manufacturing Companies of Ethiopia which manufactures agriculture products both for local and international markets. It has been active since 2012 and exports over 40 high quality value added agricultural products which meet world relevant standards to three main destination countries such as America, Canada and Australia and other locations. Moreover, it distributed such products to local market. Nowadays, in line with government trade, marketing and development strategies, it strives to produce world class products of having high demand across the world. This effort has allowed it to start to generate foreign currency and create job opportunity for 500 Ethiopian youths.

Now it is seeking a dynamic and experienced Assistant Supply Chain Director (Purchasing) to oversee procurement. Overall, s/he processes, manages supply side relationships, and ensures the smooth flow of raw materials and goods throughout the factories supply chain system. The ideal candidate is expected to l have a strong background in procurement raw materials mainly agricultural products, logistics, and inventory management, with the ability to develop and implement strategies that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve overall supply chain performance. S/he directly reported to ABYS Trading PLC General Manager and more than five procurement staff.

Key Responsibilities:

Procurement & Purchasing:

Having Ethiopia’s supply chain trend and practice, develop and manage purchasing strategies to meet the organization’s operational requirements
Identify, negotiate with, and establish partnerships with reliable suppliers and vendors,
Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and evaluate new sourcing opportunities,
Ensure timely procurement of raw materials, equipment, and services, aligning with production and
operational needs,
Optimize cost savings through effective vendor selection, volume purchases, and contract Negotiations,
Supply Chain Management:

Coordinating other departments, oversee end-to-end supply chain operations, including planning, reporting and on time financial settlements,
Coordinate with internal departments (such as production, finance, and sales) to align procurement activities with business goals,
Develop and implement strategies to improve supply chain (procurement) efficiency and reduce lead times
Monitor inventory levels and establish controls to prevent stock outs or excess inventory,
Implement risk management strategies to mitigate supply chain disruptions.
Planning and Reporting

Prepare activity, procurement and spending actives in line with Ethiopia’s agricultural seasons and submit their reactive reports on time
Plan bulk purchase and collect ideas from concerned
Coordinate with warehouse, fleet transport and other departments and prepare joint planning of supplies
Ensure weekly/monthly/ quarter/ biannual and annual plans and reports of supplies are done on time
Coordinate with export team to priories supply activities
Make sure that vehicle plans are in place
Ensure that Annual Leave Plans are prepared and submitted to HD/Admin at the beginning of the fiscal year
Plan sector meetings and deliver their reports with minutes
Determine buffer stock and revise planning accordingly
Conduct assessment with potential suppliers (farmers unions and vendors) and ensure smooth supply of raw materials
Performance Monitoring & Reporting:

Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as delivery timelines, cost savings, and supplier quality,
Prepare and present regular reports on supply chain activities and purchasing metrics to management,
Use data analytics to identify trends and areas for improvement within the supply chain (procurement),
Compliance & Sustainability:

Ensure compliance with company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements,
Promote sustainable procurement practices and support initiatives to minimize the environmental
impact of the supply chain,
Adapt local culture and maintain uninterrupted supply of agricultural products,
Ensure that S/he’s staff manage and settle financial documents in compliance with ABYS Trading PLC financial and procurement policies/rules/procedures
Proactively engage in country’s financial, procurement and tax policies/rules/procedures
Partnership Management:

Keep smooth communication with external stockholders (Unions, farmers, vendors etc)
Exercise effective communication with staff both vertical and horizontal
Organize stockholders for mutual benefit
Benefits Package:

Competitive salary and benefits package,
Opportunities for career growth/development
A dynamic and collaborative work environment,
About You
Qualifications:

Educational Background:

MA/BA degree in Procurement related fields of studies; Supply Chain management; Marketing; Accounting and Finance; and Business Administration and/or Management or equivalent

Experience:

Respectively, MA/BA 3/5 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, and supply chain management (Agricultural input consuming factories and the environment is a plus)
Strong knowledge of supply chain principles, sourcing strategies, and logistics operations,
Experience working with ERP systems and supply chain management software,
Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills,
Strong problem-solving abilities and a data-driven approach to decision-making,
Ability to work under pressure, to manage multiple priorities, and meet tight deadlines,
Knowledge and understanding of Ethiopian production seasons is preferred,
Knowhow and sensitivity to ISOs are a plus

title: Child Protection Information Management System (CPIMS) Officer
description:
About the Job

Project Planning, Implementation and Monitoring

Review the quality of the data, identify any inconsistency and report the project team members and line manager for corrective and follow-up actions
Make sure each step of the case management process is maintained properly, and Support the data collection process to ensure data quality.
Responsible for ensuring all data protection and information sharing protocols are observed while managing information

Perform Data harmonization with key stakeholders such as Ministry and Bureau of Women and Social Affairs, RRS, UNHCR, UNICEF (CPIMS+).
Work closely with the Emergency Project Coordinator, CPiE officers and case management team on the roll out of the CPIMS+ at West Gondar and East Gojjam Zones.
Perform any other activities as delegated by line manager.
Ensures that Plan International’s global policies for Child Protection (CPP) and Gender Equality and Inclusion (GEI) are fully embedded in accordance with the principles and requirements of the policy including relevant Implementation Standards and Guidelines as applicable to their area of responsibility. This includes, but is not limited to, ensuring staff and associates are aware of and understand their responsibilities under these policies and Plan International’s Code of Conduct (CoC), their relevance to their area of work, and that concerns are reported and managed in accordance with the appropriate procedures.
