title: Senior Finance Coordinator
description:
About the Job
TEAM/PROGRAMME: Finance

LOCATION: Area Office based in Addis Ababa

POST TYPE: National

Child Safeguarding:

Level 2 - the responsibilities of the post may require the post holder to have regular contact with or access to children or young people.

Risk and Compliance:

The role holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with the SCI Fraud, Bribery, and Corruption policy and code of conduct. The key responsibilities include understanding and complying with the SCI policies and procedures, not committing any act of fraud, bribery, or corruption, understanding risks in their area/role, and implementing mitigation measures, report any suspected fraud, bribery, or corruption immediately, declare conflicts of interest in accordance with internal procedures and complete mandatory training related to ethics and anti-fraud measures

ROLE PURPOSE:

The job holder has overall responsibility on financial management and supporting of the field office program operations. The role holder will be accountable for coordinating the financial and operational aspects of the annual and strategic business plans. In addition, he/she is expected to support the Area Office Leadership in managing and reporting of risk across their Area Offices and ensures that appropriate mitigating controls are in place.

SCOPE OF ROLE:

Reports to: Area Manager, and dotted line with Head of Financial Controls and Compliance.

Staff directly reporting to this post: dotted line with Field Offices’ Finance Officers.

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:

Business partnering

Becomes a valued business partner to the Area Office and field operation program leaders and finance staff and help them to achieve their objectives.

Communicates monthly & year-end spending plans for each FOs.

Works closely with FO finance staff to track spending and monitor operational KPIs.
Monitors financial gap and control spending on NTC of the field office under the area office management.
Attends BvA meetings & hold a meeting with field office & Area office managers to discuss field offices performances.
Assists field offices in preparation of their master budgets & work closely with the FO manager and budget holders when phasing budgets.
Supports the decentralization effort of the Country Office and provide advice to the Area Manager on financial matters.
Provides budget holder and other training to build the capacity of the operational team.
Financial control & compiance

Supports, monitors and tests field-based finance team adherence to accounting and internal control and reporting requirements, policies and procedures of the organization and various donor and statutory requirements.
Ensures that field offices meet accounting timetables and schedules.
Ensures that field offices submit good quality and on-time monthly summary accounts, including cash flow and other information as defined to the country office.
Champions accuracy in coding and assists managers in becoming effective budget holders.
Manages and monitors the work of Senior finance officers through mentoring and providing guidance.
Identifies capacity gaps and training needs at Area Offices and Field Offices and facilitates provision of relevant training.
Facilitates and supports during audit processes and closure of audit findings.
Supports the Country Office in the preparation and closure of year-end accounts.
Assesses capacity and propose online access to Agresso FMS for off-line field offices.
Generates and shares monthly BVA with AO, FO and Budget Holders (BHs)and track performance.
Supports the Financial Reporting Team in compiling donor financial reports.
Ensures smooth cash flow management and maintains very minimum month-end cash balances at field offices.
Ensures monthly payroll, pension and withholding tax payable settled on time.
Monitors posting status on weekly bases to maintain standards of posting transactions.
Monitors weekly and monthly spending of AO/FO and projects and track with BHs to address finance related actions.
Participates in budget development for new opportunities in particular for NTC staff and none staff costs
BEHAVIOURS (Values in Practice)

Accountability:

holds self accountable for making decisions, managing resources efficiently, achieving and role modelling Save the Children values.
holds the team and partners accountable to deliver on their responsibilities - giving them the freedom to deliver in the best way they see fit, providing the necessary development to improve performance and applying appropriate consequences when results are not achieved.
Ambition:

sets ambitious and challenging goals for themselves and their team, takes responsibility for their own personal development and encourages their team to do the same.
widely shares their personal vision for Save the Children, engages and motivates others.
future orientated, thinks strategically and on a global scale.
Collaboration:

builds and maintains effective relationships, with their team, colleagues, Members and external partners and supporters.
values diversity, sees it as a source of competitive strength.
approachable, good listener, easy to talk to.
Creativity:

develops and encourages new and innovative solutions.
willing to take disciplined risks.
Integrity:

honest, encourages openness and transparency; demonstrates highest levels of integrity.

About You
BA Degree in Finance and Accounting, Business Administration, or other relevant discipline from a recognised University.
EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Essential

A minimum of 8 years work experience; out of which, 5 years’ experience directly related to financial management.
Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale operational and procedural changes from proposal development to program operations.
Experience of statutory accounting management.
Experience in building capacity of staff in INGO setting.
Evidence of working across a range of field offices with different range of portfolio and capacity to achieve significant changes.
Experience of strategic financial planning and development.
Excellent leadership & influencing skills with professional finance credibility.
Self-starter” capable of generating & delivering innovative solutions.
Generate and critically analyze business cases and other financial plans in relation to SCI objectives.
Good proficiency with MS Office & range of software packages relating to financial management.
Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills including influencing, negotiation and coaching.
Ability and willingness to dramatically change work practices and hours.
Fluency in English, both verbal and written, preferred.

Job Title: Accountant

Brief Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Accountant to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and maintaining the financial records of our organization, ensuring compliance with relevant laws and regulations, and providing financial guidance and support to management. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated and detail-oriented individual to join a dynamic team and contribute to the financial success of our organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements
  • Manage and maintain general ledger accounts, ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial data
  • Develop and implement financial policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with relevant laws and regulations
  • Analyze financial data and provide insights and recommendations to management
  • Coordinate and manage the annual budgeting process, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives
  • Develop and maintain relationships with external auditors, ensuring successful audit outcomes

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related field from a recognized Ethiopian university
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting, preferably in a similar industry or organization
  • Professional certification in accounting, such as CPA or ACCA, is an advantage
  • Strong knowledge of Ethiopian tax laws and regulations, as well as international financial reporting standards
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Proficiency in accounting software, such as Peachtree or QuickBooks, and Microsoft Office applications
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines

title: Senior, Architect
description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Architect to join our team in Ethiopia. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading architectural projects from conception to completion, ensuring that they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. The Senior Architect will play a key role in shaping the built environment in Ethiopia, working on a wide range of projects, including residential, commercial, and industrial developments.

  • Conduct site visits and inspections to monitor progress and ensure that projects are being constructed to the required standards
  • Prepare and present project reports, designs, and proposals to clients and stakeholders
  • Mentor and guide junior architects and other team members to help them develop their skills and expertise

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture from a recognized Ethiopian university, such as Addis Ababa University or Bahir Dar University

title: SHEQ Manager
description:
About the Job
An exciting vacant position has arisen at East Africa Bottling Share Company – Ethiopia for the role of SHEQ Manager.

East Africa Bottling Share Company (EABSC) works with the world's most cherished trademark, invests in one of the most sophisticated production systems in the world, and employs people who are prepared to work with passion and focus.

Why Join Us?

At Coca-Cola Beverages Africa, our Employee Value Proposition is built on four pillars:

Unparalleled Professional Development - We invest in our people through continuous learning, coaching, mentoring, leadership development, and career growth opportunities.
Market Success-The Beloved Coca-Cola Brand - Join a winning, high-performing organization that continues to lead and grow across Africa's dynamic beverage market. Take pride in working with one of the world's most iconic and trusted brands, loved by consumers across generations.
Passionate and Caring People - Work alongside talented colleagues who support one another, embrace diversity, and are committed to making a positive impact in our communities.
Key Purpose Statement

To lead and drive the implementation of Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHEQ) standards and systems across the Bahir Dar plant, ensuring compliance with The Coca-Cola Management System (TCCMS), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), legal requirements, and company policies while promoting a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and sustainable business performance.
About You
SHEQ Leadership & Governance

Provide leadership and expert guidance on Safety, Health, Environment, and Quality (SHEQ) matters within the plant.
Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of SHEQ systems in line with CCBA standards, TCCMS, GMP, and regulatory requirements.
Support plant management in integrating SHEQ objectives into daily operations and strategic priorities.
Promote a culture of compliance, accountability, and operational excellence across all plant functions.
SHEQ Strategy Execution & Compliance

Develop and execute plant SHEQ plans and initiatives aligned with company standards and business objectives.
Ensure compliance with legal, food safety, environmental, and occupational health and safety requirements.
Lead SHEQ audits, inspections, and compliance reviews, ensuring timely closure of corrective actions.
Maintain effective management systems and ensure adherence to TCCMS and GMP requirements.
Risk Management & Safety Excellence

Drive a safety-first culture through employee engagement, behavioral safety programs, and targeted interventions.
Identify, assess, and mitigate SHEQ risks that could impact employees, consumers, operations, or the environment.
Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor plant safety performance and ensure effective implementation of risk reduction initiatives.
Quality Assurance & Product Integrity

Ensure effective implementation and maintenance of food safety and quality management systems.
Monitor quality performance indicators and drive initiatives that improve product quality and process capability.
Lead continuous improvement projects aimed at enhancing product consistency and customer satisfaction.
Ensure timely resolution of quality deviations, customer complaints, and non-conformance issues.
Environmental Sustainability & Resource Management

Drive environmental compliance and sustainability initiatives within the plant.
Lead programs focused on water conservation, energy efficiency, waste reduction, and environmental stewardship.
Monitor environmental performance and ensure compliance with relevant environmental regulations and company requirements.
Promote responsible resource utilization and continuous improvement in environmental performance.
Incident & Crisis Management

Lead plant-level incident management and crisis response processes related to safety, quality, and environmental events.
Ensure timely reporting, investigation, and resolution of incidents.
Coordinate cross-functional teams during incident response and recovery activities.
Implement preventive measures to minimize recurrence and strengthen operational resilience.
Capability Development & Continuous Improvement

Develop and strengthen SHEQ capabilities through coaching, mentoring, and training programs.
Promote continuous improvement through trend analysis, root cause analysis, and implementation of best practices.
Stakeholder Management & Reporting

Engage with regulatory authorities, certification bodies, and internal stakeholders on plant SHEQ matters.
Prepare and present SHEQ performance reports to plant leadership.
Support external audits and regulatory inspections.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve SHEQ objectives and business targets.
Skills, Experience & Education
Education

Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, or a related field.
Experience

Minimum of 7 years' Quality Control experience in the beverage industry.
At least 3 years' experience in a Supervisory or Managerial capacity.
Proven experience in implementing and managing SHEQ systems within a manufacturing environment.
Skills & Competencies

Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHEQ) Management Systems.
Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
Knowledge of local legal and regulatory requirements.
Continuous Improvement methodologies and implementation.
Root Cause Analysis and corrective action management.
Trend Analysis and performance monitoring.
Budgeting and Cost Management.
Capability Development, Coaching and Mentoring.
People Management and Team Leadership.
Systems Thinking and strategic problem-solving.
Results and Action Orientation.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.

title: ADP Manager
description:
About the Job
Job Description Summary:

To provide leadership and management all World Visions interventions (Sponsorship, PNS & Grant) within a defined geographic area (normally AP) according to organizational policies, donor regulations and community expectations for the improvement in child wellbeing.

Must develop or maintain to be a visionary leader, able to impart his/her vision to others and manage the change.
Must also observe vision, mission and core values of World Vision and demonstrate a quality of spiritual life that is an example to others.
Major responsibilities:

Programming standards:

Assure that the ADPs projects are implemented in line with IPF/FRS standards and processes
Ensure that SOP and child protection standards are adhered to and adequately integrated into programming both at design/redesign stage and annual operation plan for community transformation.
Prepare quality and timely detailed Implementation Plan (DIP) for program/projects of all funding streams.
Prepare quality and timely monthly, quarterly, bi –annual and annual projects/programs report together with annual budget and facilitate program/project monthly funding and review financial reports.
Ensure that both Evaluation and Audit (Finance and Risk Based) recommendations are timely responded to, fully implemented and progress is reported quarterly.
Ensure that all systems and approaches such as iMPAQ, FRS, Hope, Sun6, etc., are adhered to for program effectiveness.
Assure that all projects meet the government of Ethiopia standards and approvals are in place before implementation.
Program Execution and Financial Accountability:

Ensure that communities and staff are empowered to plan, implement, monitor and evaluate the program activities for quality and sustainable development.
Ensure that all the ADPs funding streams are implemented within 95%-100% of plans. (Annual spending vs budget, Activity plan vs realized)
Assure that the ADPs activities are monitored in relation to their ITTs and that lessons are discussed, shared and acted on.
Coordinate the proper implementation of programs/projects of all funding streams as per Detail Implementation Plan (DIP) or other planning documents.
Enforce stewardship and accountability by ensuring that resources are efficiently and effectively utilized within the program/project for the intended purpose and to minimize risks.
Sponsorship Operation Program:

Build capacity of community, frontline staff and sponsorship staff on SOP and child protection.
Empower all the frontline staff (Development officers) to integrate SOP and child protection in their project planning and implementation.
Assure all new initiatives are implemented to strengthen sponsors’ communication to attract new and maintain existing sponsors.
Ensure all the key performance indicators (KPI) are kept at green for at least 11 months per year as per the required standard.
Transformational Development:

Assure the ADP facilitates transformed/biblical world view and translate it into community mind set for sustainably improving child wellbeing.
Assure the ADPs actions empower community to change the mindset towards development.
Assure the ADPs actions build awareness, and action on issues in relation to child protection including violence, neglect, abuse and violence.
Sustainability:

Facilitate integration of transition plans and disaster preparedness plans into design/redesign and annual plan document and ensure implementation for sustainable development.
Assure the AP develops and works to strengthen of local institutions (CBOs, CCCs, FBFs, and Commercial Village, etc).
Monitor performance of the ADP in relation to community empowerment approach.
About You
Required Professional Experience

A minimum of 10 years’ experience with regards to the designing, planning, implementation, supervising and reporting on integrated development, emergency and advocacy projects and at least 5 years’ experience in managing complex grants and programs/projects with significant experience in overseeing large multi-year program.
Required Education, training, license, registration, and certification

BA/BSc Degree in Development Studies, Economics, Social Sciences. An advanced degree in Social Sciences related to development work is preferred. Master’s degree is an advantage Preferred Knowledge and Qualifications
Working experience in community development

Computer skills and digital technology utilization

Demonstrated ability in supervision.

Able to contextualize development models in an innovative way.

Be rooted and able to form a connection to the community – and must demonstrate passion for living and working in the ADP area.

title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
About the Job
The Mechanical Supervisor leads the maintenance team to ensure maximum reliability and efficiency of all food processing and packaging equipment. This role coordinates daily preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities while strictly adhering to food safety, hygiene, and occupational health standards.

Detailed Responsibilities

1. Daily Operations & Maintenance Management

Maintenance Planning: Schedule and assign daily, weekly, and monthly mechanical maintenance tasks via the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System).
Emergency Breakdown Response: Lead rapid troubleshooting and repair of critical plant failures to minimize production downtime.
Predictive Maintenance: Monitor equipment health using vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis to predict failures before they happen.
Equipment Modification: Oversee small-scale engineering modifications and machinery upgrades to boost line speeds and output.
2. Specialized Food Safety & Hygiene Compliance

Sanitary Maintenance: Ensure all tools and replacement parts are cleaned and sanitized before and after contact with food-zone machinery.
GMP & HACCP Enforcement: Enforce Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) rules within the maintenance team.
Lubrication Management: Audit the exclusive use of food-grade lubricants and grease on processing lines to prevent chemical contamination.
Audit Preparation: Maintain meticulous documentation of machine calibrations, repairs, and deep cleans for internal and external regulatory food audits (e.g., BRCGS, FSSC 22000, FDA).
3. Equipment & Utilities Expertise

Processing Lines: Oversee repairs on high-speed industrial mixers, blenders, homogenizers, ovens, fryers, pasteurizers, and extruders.
Material Handling: Maintain complex conveyor networks (modular, belt, roller, screw, pneumatic transport systems) and sorting systems.
Packaging Automation: Manage technical uptime for high-speed filling lines, capping machines, vertical form-fill-seal (VFFS) systems, and labeling systems.
Plant Utilities: Supervise secondary maintenance on ammonia refrigeration units, steam boilers, industrial air compressors, and water treatment systems.
4. Team Leadership & Safety Culture

Supervision: Manage, coach, and evaluate a team of 5–15 mechanical technicians and fitters across rotating shifts.
Safety Protocols: Implement and strictly enforce Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), Confined Space Entry, and Hot Work permits.
Skill Development: Identify technical skill gaps in technicians and coordinate targeted training on advanced pneumatics, hydraulics, and welding.
5. Spare Parts & Vendor Management

Inventory Control: Audit the spare parts store to ensure critical wear-and-tear items (bearings, seals, belts, gaskets) are always in stock.
Contractor Supervision: Manage third-party service engineers and contractors during major overhauls or annual plant shutdowns.
Technical Proficiencies

Blueprints: Expert ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, P&IDs (Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams), and pneumatic/hydraulic schematics.
Tools: High proficiency with precision alignment tools, laser shaft aligners, and machine shop equipment (lathes, milling machines, TIG/MIG welding).
Software: Hands-on experience working with industrial maintenance software (e.g., SAP PM, Maximo, or Emaint).
Physical Demands & Work Environment

Ability to work in extreme temperatures (cold storage units down to -20°C or hot baking areas up to 45°C).
Ability to lift up to 25 kg and work at heights or in confined spaces when necessary.
Flexibility to work rotating shifts, weekends, and remain on-call for emergency breakdowns.

About You
Degree/Diploma: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering OR a Technical Diploma/TVET Level IV in Industrial Mechanics.
Experience: Minimum 5 years of mechanical maintenance experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment. At least 2 years must be in a direct supervisory capacity.

title: Protection Officer
description:
About the Job
Medical Teams Calling

Daring to love like Jesus, we boldly break barriers to health and restore wholeness in a hurting world.

Medical Teams International holds strict child and vulnerable adult safeguarding principles and a zero-tolerance policy for misconduct related to sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse in the workplace and other places where the organization’s activities are rendered. Parallel to technical competence, recruitment & selection, hiring decisions will give due emphasis to assessing candidates' eligibility thorough background checks, police clearance, and professional reference check processes.

JOB SUMMARY

Protection Officer Response contributes to the calling of Medical Teams by implementing response activities which include case management, psychosocial support, safe space activity, and another related project. The position holder will train and supervise social workers and community activists in Refugee camps & host Communities to prevent and respond to GBV issues. This includes providing ongoing training and mentorship for community workers, and community activists, developing a weekly, monthly, and quarterly work plan, and utilizing monitoring and evaluation systems to ensure high-quality services, smooth communication, collaboration, and coordination among partners from the protection, health, legal, and psychosocial sectors committed to reducing the incidence of violence against women.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Prepare and develop weekly and monthly work plans for GBV-related prevention activities, ensuring alignment with the overall program objectives.
Implement GBV prevention and response activities, including fieldwork and community-based programs, ensuring that activities are in line with GBV IASC guidelines and best practices.
Process and maintain accurate case documentation, including case histories, assessments, interventions, and progress reports, ensuring all information complies with confidentiality standards.
Apply protection principles such as confidentiality, safety, and non-discrimination in all program activities, ensuring that GBV survivors are treated with respect and dignity.
Prepare outreach materials and awareness campaigns tailored to local communities, ensuring that the information is relevant and culturally appropriate.
Implement community-based interventions in partnership with relevant stakeholders such as women and children’s affairs, teachers, medical providers, and law enforcement.
Process referrals to appropriate service providers for GBV survivors, ensuring that their needs are met, and all required documentation is provided.
Apply the necessary legal frameworks to all protection activities, ensuring that the rights of survivors are upheld in accordance with national laws and international standards.
Prepare regular reports, including weekly updates, case progress reports, and activity summaries for submission to the Protection Manager and field coordinator.
Implement and support the delivery of capacity-building initiatives for community workers and partners, ensuring effective coordination in response to GBV incidents.
Process requests for protection of supplies and services, ensuring adherence to the logistical and financial policies of the organization.
Apply best practices in the integration of GBV response activities into health, education, and legal services to ensure holistic support for survivors.
Prepare documentation and reports for submission to relevant authorities as required, ensuring that the information complies with legal standards and confidentiality of policies.
Implement any other duties assigned by the Protection Manager or senior leadership to support the effective delivery of the GBV program.
Support the integration of accountability practices into program activities by following established procedures during planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting. Help ensure that accountability is reflected in day-to-day tasks, team interactions, and when working with partners or communities.
Support safeguarding of program participants and employees through promoting an environment of awareness and upholding the code of conduct provisions of Medical Teams Protection from Sexual Exploitation & Abuse, Child & Vulnerable Adult protection, and harassment-free workplace policies. Incumbents will remain alert and responsive to any child and adult safeguarding risks, acquire relevant knowledge and skills which will enable you to promote strong safeguarding practices, understand the child and adult safeguarding policy and procedures, and conduct yourself in a manner consistent with the Safeguarding.
Other Duties

Maintain a clean and safe working environment, disposing of waste and sharps appropriately.
Other duties as assigned
Utilize volunteers when appropriate.

Vacancy Announcement

The Hunger Project Ethiopia (THP-E)

 

The Hunger Project (THP) is a global, non-profit, strategic organization committed to the sustainable end of world hunger. THP believes in a world where every woman, man and child can lead a healthy, fulfilling life of self-reliance and dignity; and works towards that goal by pioneering sustainable strategies for gender-focused and Integrated Community Led Development, which is the process of working together to create and achieve locally owned visions and goals. THP-E is implementing projects in rural areas of Ethiopia since 2004 and currently seeking qualified candidates for an internship position:

For the duration of this internship assignment the intern will receive:

Working Station
All required office supplies
Transport Allowance
Per Diem and lodging coverage during field visit
Coverage of Transportation expenses during field visit

Gained practical experience in financial operations, accounting processes, and day-to-day financial management activities.

title: Supervising Engineer -for Doyogena Town Water Supply and Sanitation Project
description:
About the Job
LonAdd HR Consultancy Plc (www.lonadd.com) is a Recruitment & Outsourcing Company based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, with branch offices in Dukem, Hawassa and Bahir Dar. We are looking to recruit a qualified candidate on behalf of our client.

Location Oromia

No. Required – 1 (One)

Contract duration:- 6 months

Start date – as soon as possible

Context

Doyogena Town, located in the Central Ethiopia Region, has experienced increasing demand for safe and reliable water services due to population growth, urban expansion, and rising service requirements. Existing water supply infrastructure has been unable to adequately meet current demand, resulting in intermittent water supply and limited-service coverage.

To address these challenges, Client is supporting the implementation of the Doyogena Town Water Supply and Sanitation Project. The project includes the construction and installation of key water supply infrastructure components such as production facilities, transmission pipelines, storage reservoirs, distribution systems, and associated electromechanical works.

Given the technical complexity and significant investment involved, continuous supervision is required to ensure compliance with approved designs, contractual specifications, quality standards, environmental and social safeguards, and project implementation schedules. Effective supervision will help ensure timely project completion and successful delivery of sustainable water services to the population of Doyogena Town.

Client is expected to commence implementing the KOICA-funded WASH project in the Central Ethiopia Region (CER) soon. Successful implementation will require regular coordination with government stakeholders, including the health and education sectors, as well as woreda administrations. The position will also provide technical support, as needed, to other regions covered by the Client Field Office. This role is particularly important given the limited WASH staffing capacity, which makes it challenging to adequately oversee and support and interventions across the three regions.

Client is recruiting a Supervising Engineer (Individual Consultant) through a third-party arrangement to provide oversight for the WASH projects with a focus on Doyogena and Bule water supply and sanitation Projects. The consultant will supervise the construction and installation of critical water supply and sanitation infrastructure, ensuring that all work is completed to the required standards and that the system is successfully tested and commissioned. The role includes providing effective coordination, implementation support, and quality assurance to facilitate timely project delivery. Additionally, the consultant

will ensure adherence to approved designs, technical specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards, environmental and social safeguards, and agreed project schedules.

Justification

The Doyogena Town Water Supply and Sanitation Project represent a major investment by Client and is a key initiative for improving access to safe and sustainable water and sanitation services. Alongside this, Client is implementing the Bule Water Supply Project in the Southern Ethiopia Region and will soon commence the KOICA-funded WASH Project in the Central Ethiopia Region (CER). Given the scale, complexity, and strategic importance of these projects, dedicated technical oversight is essential to ensure quality implementation, safeguard investments, ensure value for money, mitigate risks, and support the timely and sustainable delivery of project outcomes.

To facilitate successful implementation, Client requires a dedicated and experienced supervising engineer to provide full- time on-site oversight of construction activities, monitor adherence to quality standards, and accelerate the completion of remaining works, including testing and commissioning of the system.

Acting as Client’s technical representative, the consultant will ensure that all works are executed in accordance with approved engineering designs, technical specifications, contractual requirements, Client guidelines, and applicable Ethiopian standards. The consultant will also monitor contractor performance, verify completed works, review payment requests, identify implementation challenges, and recommend corrective actions when necessary. In addition, the assignment will strengthen coordination among Client with all related government stakeholders including contractors, consultants, and community stakeholders to support efficient project delivery and successful outcomes.

Objectives, Purpose& ExpectedResults

Deliverable
Description
Construction Supervision & Quality Assurance
Supervise all operations on behalf of Client to ensure that the work of the contractorsis carried outprofessionally and in atimely manner and in accordance with the contract documents;

Conduct qualityassurance of construction works, installation of electromechanical equipment, and materials;
Weekly ProgressMeetings
Organize and conduct weeklyplanning and progress meetings with Contractor, and Doyogena Town Water service.
Weekly Supervision Reports
Siteprogress reports,weekly achievementsand plans,photos, qualitychecks, QA/QC, contractor performance, challenges.
Monthly ProgressReports
Status ofwork, monthlyachievements andplans, challenges, and mitigation measures.
Final Assignment Report
Summary of achievements.
Description ofthe Assignment

. Construction Supervision & Quality Assurance: -

Supervise all operations on behalf of Client to ensure that the work of the contractors is carried out professionally and in a timely manner and in accordance with the contract documents;
Conduct quality assurance of construction works, installation of electromechanical
equipment, and materials;

Review and submit written certifications for payment requests to the RWB/ Client based on preliminary acceptance of works. Confirmation of works completed should be reviewed with the Construction Coordinator in Shire unless otherwise instructed by him/her. Certifications for payment must be approved by the Construction Coordinator prior to submission to the RWB for Client to effect direct payments;
Conduct physical inspection and testing of material and equipment at the project site and before installation;Approve commissioning procedures and inspection of completed works;
Certify provisional handover of assets and works;
Complete monthly reporting to Client as per formats provided; and other assignments not limited to those above.
Contract & Project Management Support:-

Flag delays, risks, and compliance gaps to Client early.
Participate in contractual meetings, joint site supervisions and monitoring, and draft, share and document meeting minutes and other records.
Monitoring, Data Collection & Reporting:-

Develop and update a monitoring plan for construction supervision considering the
timeframe set for the duration of the work;

Establish and ensure a regular data recording, keeping, and reporting mechanism for the installation, pressure line, and distribution testing.

Submit bi-weekly updates, monthly progress reports, quarterly summaries, and a final completion report.

title: ToR Translation of the National Financial Education Module, Trainers’ Manual, and Delivery of Training of Trainers (ToT)
description:
About the Job
Readvertisement

Terms of Reference

Translation of the National Financial Education Module, Trainers’ Manual, and Delivery of Training of Trainers (ToT)

ABOUT FC AFRICA

Founded in Ethiopia and operating across the continent, FC Africa is a pan-African organization delivering complex economic development programmes at scale. Established in 2006, FC Africa has grown into a trusted partner for governments, development partners, financial institutions, and private sector actors, known for execution discipline, institutional credibility, and results that endure. Our multidisciplinary teams combine a capacity to execute with clarity of the local context. As a result, we have delivered at-scale real impact in terms of job creation, business formation, business growth, and investment attraction and mobilization.

MESMER PROGRAM

MESMER is a 5-year programme launched in October 2022 to support 72,200 MSMEs and 410,800 jobs by creating access to finance for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) to realize their growth prospects and resilience. MESMER works to provide support to MSMEs through business development support, psychosocial services, and technical assistance to financial institutions. MESMER is a countrywide programme implemented by Mastercard Foundation in partnership with FC Africa as part of the Foundation’s Young Africa Works strategy and aiming to create dignified and fulfilling work for the youth, the majority of them women.

The Programme has the following four-pillar/components driving to meet its objectives: a) Grants and soft loans to MSMEs through a risk-sharing liquidity fund arrangement, b) Technical assistance to financial institutions, c) Business development services and life skills, and d) Psychosocial support. The FDRE Ministry of Labour and Skills is the main government counterpart for the program. Other partners include financial institutions (microfinance institutions, banks, and digital financial service providers), BDS, and psychosocial support providers.

BACKGROUND OF THE ASSIGNMENT

Improving the financial capability of MSMEs remains central to expanding inclusive finance and strengthening the effective use of financial services. The National Financial Education Module, developed by the National Bank of Ethiopia in collaboration with Mastercard Foundation and FC Africa, provides a standardized and nationally endorsed framework to guide financial education delivery across the country. However, its outreach and practical application are constrained by language barriers and the limited availability of certified trainers at regional and local levels who are able to deliver the content in a consistent and contextually appropriate manner.

In order to ensure that financial education reaches MSMEs and youths in a format that is accessible, practical, and aligned with local realities, there is a need to translate the core training material into major regional languages and to produce simplified information, education, and communication material that can be used for awareness creation and training purposes. In parallel, a structured Training of Trainers (ToT) program is required to build the capacity of involved stakeholders' ability to deliver the National Financial Education Module using standardized methodologies.

This assignment is therefore intended to support the translation of the National Financial Education Module and the Trainers’ Manual into Afaan Oromo and Sidama, the development and printing of multilingual promotional materials, and the delivery of Training of Trainers in selected regions and cities.

Given the technical nature of the National Financial Education Module, the assignment requires more than linguistic translation. The successful service provider must ensure that financial sector concepts, banking terminology, financial literacy messages, regulatory terminology, and adult learning methodologies are accurately translated while preserving the technical meaning, instructional intent, and consistency of terminology across all language versions.

OBJECTIVE OF THE ASSIGNMENT

The overall objective of the assignment is to enhance the accessibility, quality, and consistency of financial education delivery by making the National Financial Education Module available in major local languages and by establishing a certified pool of trainers at the regional level. The assignment is also expected to support the development of user-friendly and context-appropriate promotion materials that can be used for awareness creation and training support.

Specific Objective

·         Translation of the National Financial Education Module into the Afaan Oromo and Sidama languages while maintaining the technical accuracy, clarity, and integrity of the original document.

·         Translation of the National Financial Education Module Trainers’ Manual into Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Sidama languages while maintaining the technical accuracy, clarity, and integrity of the original document.

·         Producing practical and visually accessible promotion materials such as brochures and leaflets in English, Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Sidama languages.

·         Delivering a structured and tailored Training of Trainers (ToT) program in selected 3 regions (Amhara, Oromia, and Sidama) and in three to five cities (Such as Bahir Dar, Hawassa, and Adama). Leading to the training and certification of 125-150 participants (25-30 participants per session) from relevant stakeholder institutions.

·         Establish a standardized financial terminology across all translated versions to ensure consistency with the National Financial Education Framework and terminology used by the National Bank of Ethiopia.

SCOPE OF WORK

This is a technical translation assignment rather than a general language translation assignment. The successful service provider must demonstrate proven experience in translating and reviewing financial sector, banking, financial literacy, financial inclusion, or regulatory documents. Accuracy of financial terminology and preservation of the technical meaning of the original content will be considered more important than literal linguistic translation.

title: Strategic Assistant
description:
About the Job
Terms of Reference (ToR): Printing and Publication of the Digital Literacy Toolkit/Manual

1. Background

The Center for Advancement of Rights and Democracy (CARD) is a board-led civil society organization registered under the Civil Societies Organizations Proclamation No. 1113/2019 (Registry No. 4307). CARD envisions an Ethiopia where human rights are respected and democratic culture flourishes. The organization works to advance conducive civic, media, and digital spaces for the protection of human rights and the promotion of democratic values.

With support from Access Now, CARD is implementing the project "Equitable Access to the Internet, Online Safety, and Digital Literacy." The project aims to enhance digital literacy, strengthen online safety, and promote responsible and rights-based digital engagement among youth, women, journalists, and human rights defenders.

As part of the project, CARD has developed a Digital Literacy Toolkit/Manual to serve as a practical resource during digital literacy and online safety training sessions and as a reference material for participants after the training. To facilitate its distribution and use, CARD seeks to engage a qualified printing service provider to print and publish the toolkit/manual.

2. Objective of the Assignment

The objective of this assignment is to print and publish 200 high-quality copies of the finalized Digital Literacy Toolkit/Manual in accordance with CARD's technical specifications and quality standards, ensuring that the manuals are durable, professionally produced, and ready for distribution during project activities.

3. Scope of Work

The selected service provider shall:

●     Print 200 copies of the finalized Digital Literacy Toolkit/Manual using the print-ready files provided by CARD.

●     Ensure high-quality color printing, accurate reproduction of text, graphics, and illustrations.

●     Produce professionally bound manuals that are durable and suitable for repeated use during training sessions.

●     Ensure consistency in printing quality across all copies.

●     Package the printed manuals securely to prevent damage during transportation.

●     Deliver all printed manuals to CARD's office within the agreed timeframe.

4. Technical Specifications

The service provider shall print the toolkit/manual according to the following specifications:

●     Quantity: 200 copies

●     Language: Amharic and English

●     Print Type: Full color

●     Size: A6

●     Cover Printing: Full color

●     Artwork: Final print-ready files will be provided by CARD.

5. Deliverables

The service provider shall deliver:

●     Two hundred (200) professionally printed copies of the Digital Literacy Toolkit/Manual in accordance with the agreed specifications.

●     Printed manuals free from printing defects, missing pages, binding defects, color inconsistencies, or formatting errors.

●     Delivery of all printed copies to CARD's designated office.

6. Duration of the Assignment

The assignment shall commence upon signing of the agreement.

The service provider shall complete printing and deliver all manuals within a week after receiving the final print-ready files from CARD.
About You
Required Qualifications

Interested printing companies or service providers should demonstrate:

●     Proven experience in printing books, manuals, reports, or similar publications.

●     Availability of modern printing equipment capable of producing high-quality publications.

●     Experience producing full-color printed materials.

●     Ability to meet agreed timelines.

●     Capacity to deliver the required quantity while maintaining consistent quality.

8. Application Requirements

Interested service providers shall submit:

●     Valid business license.

●     Tax Identification Number (TIN) certificate.

●     Samples or photographs of similar printed publications (if available).

Brief Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale projects. The successful candidate will have a strong background in project management, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to work with cross-functional teams to achieve project goals and objectives. The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement project plans, resource allocation plans, and project schedules
  • Lead and manage high-performing project teams, including setting goals, providing coaching, and evaluating performance
  • Coordinate and facilitate communication among project stakeholders, including project team members, customers, and executives
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, and develop contingency plans as needed
  • Manage project budgets, track expenses, and ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards
  • Monitor and control project progress, identify and address deviations from plans, and take corrective action as needed
  • Ensure that all project deliverables meet the required quality standards, and that projects are completed to the satisfaction of stakeholders

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (such as Business Administration, Engineering, or Computer Science) from a recognized Ethiopian university
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in project management, with at least 3 years in a senior project management role
  • Professional certification in project management (such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile) is an advantage
  • Proven track record of successfully managing large-scale projects, with experience in managing project teams, budgets, and stakeholders
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to think strategically and tactically
  • Proficiency in project management tools and software, such as MS Project, Asana, or Trello
  • Fluency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

description: በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ የብሮድባንድ ኢንተርኔት ተዳራሽነትን፣ የቴሌኮም ገበያ ነፃነት ደንቦችን እና የዲጂታል መታወቂያ ትግበራዎችን የተመለከቱ የቴክኒክ ምክረ ሀሳቦችን ይሰጣል።

title: Senior Legal Advisor Consultancy – Renewable Energy Policies
description: በታዳሽ ኃይል (ፀሐይና የእሳተ ገሞራ ኃይል) የግል ዘርፍ ኢንቨስትመንት ህግጋትና የኃይል ግዢ ስምምነቶች (PPA) ዙሪያ ለሚመለከታቸው ሚኒስቴሮች የህግ ምክር ድጋፍ ይሰጣል።

title: Partnerships and Grants Manager
description: የሽርክና እና ግራንት ማናጀር የሀብት ማሰባሰብ ስራዎችን ይመራል፣ ከለጋሾች ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ይቆጣጠራል፣ እንዲሁም በኢትዮጵያን ጨምሮ በአፍሪካ በሚገኙ የሀገር ቢሮዎች ውስጥ የግራንት ደንቦች መከበራቸውን ያረጋግጣል።

title: Front Desk and Admin Coordinator
description: የፌንት ዴስክ እና አስተዳደር አስተባባሪ የቢሮ ግንኙነቶችን፣ የእንግዳ አቀባበልን እና አጠቃላይ የጽህፈት ቤት ድጋፍ ሰጪ ስራዎችን ይመራል።

title: Branch Manager 1
description: የቅርንጫፍ ሥራ አስኪያጅ የቅርንጫፍ ቢሮውን የባንክ እንቅስቃሴዎች እያቀደ፣ እያስተባበረ እና እየተቆጣጠረ የተቋሙን ግቦች ያሳካል።

title: Branch Manager 1
description: የቅርንጫፍ ሥራ አስኪያጅ የቅርንጫፍ ቢሮውን የባንክ እንቅስቃሴዎች እያቀደ፣ እያስተባበረ እና እየተቆጣጠረ የተቋሙን ግቦች ያሳካል።

title: Regional Compliance Manager
description: የክልል ተገዢነት አስተዳዳሪው በክልሉ ውስጥ ባሉ የድርጅቱ የሀገር ውስጥ ቢሮዎች ውስጥ የተገዢነት ፖሊሲዎችን፣ የስጋት አስተዳደርን እና የውስጥ ቁጥጥሮችን የመቆጣጠር፣ የለጋሾችን መስፈርቶች እና የአካባቢ ሕጎች መከበራቸውን የማረጋገጥ ኃላፊነት አለበት።

title: Regional Communications Manager
description: የክልል ኮሙዩኒኬሽን አስተዳዳሪው የድርጅቱን ታይነት እና የតምጽ ማعረግ ግቦች ለማሳካት በምስራቅ እና መካከለኛው አፍሪካ መርሃ ግብሮች ውስጥ ስልታዊ ኮሙዩኒኬሽንን፣ የሚዲያ ግንኙነቶችን እና የዲጂታል ይዘት ስርጭትን ይመራል።

title: Partnerships and Grants Manager
description: የሽርክና እና የድጋፍ አስተዳዳሪው ሃብቶችን ያንቀሳቅሳል፣ ተቋማዊ የለጋሽ ግንኙነቶችን ያስተዳድራል፣ እንዲሁም በሀገር አቀፍ መርሃ ግብሮች ውስጥ የድጋፍ ሪፖርት አቀራረብ ተገዢነትን ይቆጣጠራል።

title: Country Director
description: የሀገር ዳይሬክተሩ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ለሚገኙ የድርጅቱ ድንገተኛ አደጋ እና የልማት መርሃ ግብሮች አጠቃላይ ስልታዊ፣ ፕሮግራማዊ እና ስራአተ-ምህዳራዊ አመራር ይሰጣል።

title: Health Officer
description: የጤና ሰራተኛው ተጋላጭ በሆኑ አዛውንቶች ላይ በማተኮር የማህበረሰብ ጤና ጣልቃገብነቶችን ያስተባብራል፣ እና በተመረጡ አካባቢዎች ተስማሚ የጤና አገልግሎት አሰጣጥን ያረጋግጣል።

title: Cybersecurity Officer
description: የሳይበር ሴኪዩሪቲ ባለሙያው የአውታረ መረብ እንቅስቃሴን ይከታተላል፣ የደህንነት ጉድለቶችን ይለያል፣ እና የባንኩን ዲጂታል መሠረተ ልማት ለመጠበቅ የመከላከያ ፕሮቶኮሎችን ይተገብራል።

title: Cybersecurity Officer
description: የሳይበር ሴኪዩሪቲ ባለሙያው የአውታረ መረብ እንቅስቃሴን ይከታተላል፣ የደህንነት ጉድለቶችን ይለያል፣ እና የባንኩን ዲጂታል መሠረተ ልማት ለመጠበቅ የመከላከያ ፕሮቶኮሎችን ይተገብራል።

title: Cybersecurity Officer
description: የሳይበር ሴኪዩሪቲ ባለሙያው የአውታረ መረብ እንቅስቃሴን ይከታተላል፣ የደህንነት ጉድለቶችን ይለያል፣ እና የባንኩን ዲጂታል መሠረተ ልማት ለመጠበቅ የመከላከያ ፕሮቶኮሎችን ይተገብራል።

title: Digital Banking Officer
description: የዲጂታል ባንኪንግ ኦፊሰር የባንኩን ዲጂታል ቻናሎች፣ የሞባይል መተግበሪያዎች እና የኤሌክትሮኒክስ ክፍያ መግቢያዎችን ማስተዋወቅ፣ ማስፋፋት እና የአሰራር አስተዳደርን ይመራል።

title: Digital Product Development Expert
description: የዲጂታል ምርት ልማት ኤክስፐርቱ የደንበኞችን ተሞክሮ ለማሻሻል አዳዲስ የችርቻሮ እና ኤምኤስኤምኢ የዲጂታል ፋይናንስ ምርቶችን ይመረምራል፣ ዲዛይን ያደርጋል እንዲሁም ያስጀምራል።

title: Strategy and Planning Officer
description: የስትራቴጂ እና እቅድ ኦፊሰር የድርጅታዊ ስስትራቴጂን በመቅረጽ፣ ቁልፍ የአፈጻጸም መለኪያዎችን (KPIs) በመከተተል እና የንግድ አፈጻጸም ትንተናዎችን በማካሄድ ይሳተፋል።

title: Construction Project Engineer
description: የሲቪል ኢንጂነሪንግ ባለሙያው የአርክቴክቸር ዲዛይኖችን ይቆጣጠራል፣ የኮንስትራክሽን ठेራጣሪዎችን ያስተዳድራል፣ እና የባንክ ቅርንጫፍ ግንባታ ፕሮጀክቶች የደህንነት እና ጥራት ደረጃዎችን ማሟላታቸውን ያረጋግጣል።

title: Sales and Marketing Manager
description: የሽያጭ እና ማርኬቲንግ ማናጀሩ የሆቴሉን የገበያ መሪነት ለማስቀጠል ስልታዊ የገቢ ማመንጨት ስራዎችን፣ የድርጅት ደንበኛ ግንኙነቶችን እና የማስተዋወቂያ ዘመቻዎችን ይመራል።

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description: የጥራት ቁጥጥር ማናጀሩ ከእርሻ እስከ ማሸጊያ እቃዎች ድረስ ላሉት ሁሉም የወተት ማምረቻ መስመሮች የላብራቶሪ ምርመራዎችን፣ የንጽህና ተገዢነትን እና የጥራት ቁጥጥር ማዕቀፎችን ይቆጣጠራል።

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: ሲኒየር ሶፍትዌር መሐንዲሱ ጠንካራ የፋይናንስ ግብይት መድረኮችን፣ የማይክሮ ሰርቪስ አወቃቀሮችን እና ከፍተኛ መጠን ያላቸውን የክፍያ ማቀናበሪያ ሞተሮችን ዲዛይን ያደርጋል፣ ያበለጽጋል እንዲሁም ሚዛናቸውን ያስጠብቃል።

title: Senior Digital Agriculture Specialist
description: የዲጂታል ግብርና ከፍተኛ ባለሙያው የጥቃቅን አርሶ አደሮችን አሰራር ዘመናዊ ለማድረግ የዲጂታል መሳሪያዎችን፣ የሞባይል አማካሪ መድረኮችን እና የውሂብ ትንታኔዎችን ስራዎች ይመራል።

title: Human Resources Manager
description: የሰው ሃብት ማስተዳደር ማናጀሩ በሆቴል ማረፊያ ቦታዎች ውስጥ የሰራተኞችን ቅጥር፣ የአፈጻጸም አስተዳደር፣ የሰራተኞች ግንኙነት እና የድርጅታዊ ልማት ስልት ስራዎችን ይመራል።

title: Individual Legal Advisor - Consultancy
description: የግል ህጋዊ አማካሪው ውስብስብ በሆኑ የፋይናንስ ግብይቶች፣ የብድር ማግኛ ክርክሮች እና ተቋማዊ ህጋዊ ማዕቀፎች ላይ የባለሙያ ምክር ይሰጣል።

title: Government Digital Payments Analyst - Consultant
description: የመንግስት ዲጂታል ክፍያዎች ባለሙያው በፌዴራል ህዝባዊ ተቋማት ውስጥ የዲጂታል ክፍያ አወቃቀሮችን ለማቀናጀት እና ደህንነታቸውን ለመጠበቅ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያለው የቴክኒክ አማካሪ አገልግሎት ይሰጣል።

title: Cultural Awareness Training Consultant
description: የባህል ግንዛቤ ማሰልጠኛ አማካሪው በኢትዮጵያ የተለያዩ ቀጠናዊ የባህል አውዶች ውስጥ ለሚሰሩ ሰራተኞች እና አጋሮች የሚስማሙ የስልጠና ሞጁሎችን ዲዛይን ያደርጋል እንዲሁም ይሰጣል።

title: Enterprise Advisor - NOA
description: የኢንተርፕራይዝ አማካሪው የምርታማነት እና የስራ ቦታ ተገዢነት ደረጃዎችን ለማሻሻል ለአካባቢው የማኑፋክቸሪንግ ኢንተርፕራይዞች የምክር አገልግሎት እና የቴክኒክ ግምገማዎችን ይሰጣል።

title: Research Expert Roster Member
description: በዚህ የአማካሪዎች ዝርዝር ውስጥ የተመረጡ ባለሙያዎች በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ የተለዩ ማህበራዊ-ኢኮኖሚያዊ መሰረታዊ ጥናቶችን፣ ግምገማዎችን እና የፖሊሲ ምርምር ስራዎችን ያከናውናሉ።

title: Health Information Systems
description: የብሔራዊ ፕሮፌሽናል ኦፊሰሩ የጤና ሚኒስቴርን የጤና መረጃ ስርዓት፣ የጤና መረጃ ትንተና እና የዲጂታል ጤና እንቅስቃሴዎችን የማጠናከር ስራዎችን ይደግፋል። ዋና ዋና ሀላፊነቶችም የጤና ሁኔታዎችን መከታተል፣ የመረጃ ጥራት ደረጃዎችን ማረጋገጥ፣ መደበኛ የጤና መረጃ አስተዳደር ስርዓቶችን (HMIS) ማቀናጀት፣ የበሽታዎች ቅኝት የመረጃ መሠረተ ልማትን መደገፍ እና በመላ ኢትዮጵያ ለሚገኙ አጋር ድርጅቶች የቴክኒክ አቅም ግንባታ መስጠትን ያካትታል።

title: Senior Child Protection Officer
description: ከፍተኛ የህጻናት ጥበቃ ኦፊሰሩ በስደተኞች ጣቢያዎችና በአስተናጋጅ ማህበረሰቦች ውስጥ የሚከናወኑ የህጻናት ጥበቃ አስቸኳይ ጊዜ ምላሽ ፕሮግራሞችን የመምራት፣ የመተግበርና የመከታተል ሀላፊነት አለበት። ዋና ዋና ተግባራት ለተጋላጭ ህጻናት የኬዝ ማኔጅመንት ስራዎችን ማከናወን፣ የስነ-ልቦና ድጋፍ እንቅስቃሴዎችን ማደራጀት፣ በማህበረሰብ አቀፍ የህጻናት ጥበቃ አሰራሮችን ማመቻቸት እና ከተባበሩት መንግስታት ስደተኞች ኮሚሽን (UNHCR) እና ከአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ጋር በመቀናጀት ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ አሰራር ማረጋገጥ ናቸው።

title: Fleet & Supply Chain
description: የሎጅስቲክስ ኦፊሰሩ በምስራቅ የሀገሪቱ ክፍል የሰብአዊ እርዳታ አቅርቦት ሰንሰለት ስራዎችን፣ የተሽከርካሪዎች እንቅስቃሴን እና የመጋዘን ክፍፍል ስርዓቶችን ያስተዳድራል። ሀላፊነቶች የእርዳታ እቃዎችን እንቅስቃሴ መከታተል፣ የትራንስፖርት መስመሮችን ማሻሻል፣ ከዓለም አቀፍ የሎጅስቲክስ መስፈርቶች ጋር መጣጣምን ማረጋገጥ፣ የአቅርቦት ስጋቶችን መቀነስ እና የእርዳታ ቁሳቁሶችን በፍጥነት ለማዳረስ ከአካባቢው የትራንስፖርት ባለስልጣናትና አጋሮች ጋር በትብብር መስራትን ያካትታሉ።

title: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Manager
description: የMEAL ማኔጀሩ በአስቸኳይ ጊዜና ልማት ፕሮጀክቶች ዙሪያ ሁሉን አቀፍ የክትትልና ግምገማ ማዕቀፎችን የመቅረጽና የመተግበር ስራዎችን የበላይነት ይመራል:: ተግባራቱም የመስክ መረጃ ሰብሰባ ስርዓቶችን ማስተዳደር፣ አሃዛዊና ጥራት ነክ የመረጃ ትንተናዎችን ማካሄድ፣ ለተጠቃሚዎች የተመልሶ መልስና ተጠያቂነት አሰራሮችን መዘርጋት እና ለዓለም አቀፍ ለጋሾች ከፍተኛ ጥራት ያላቸውን የትንተና ሪፖርቶች ማቅረብ ናቸው::

title: Education Specialist
description: የትምህርት ስፔሻሊስቱ ለNRC የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ትምህርት ፕሮግራሞች የቴክኒክ ስትራቴጂን፣ የጥራት ደረጃዎችን እና የቴክኒክ ቁጥጥር ስራዎችን ይወስናል። ዋና ዋና ተግባራት መደበኛ ያልሆኑ የትምህርት ማዕቀፎችን መቅረጽ፣ የመደበኛ ትምህርት ቤት መምህራንን ማሰልጠን፣ ከትምህርት ሚኒስቴርና ከተባበሩት መንግስታት አካላት ጋር መተባበር እና ለህጻናት ትምህርት ፕሮግራሞች የሀብት ማሰባሰብ ስራን መምራት ናቸው።

title: Senior Database Administrator
description: ከፍተኛ የዳታቤዝ አስተዳዳሪው የኦራክል እና የSQL ኮር ባንኪንግ ዳታቤዞችን የመጠበቅ፣ የመጠበቅና የማሻሻል ስራዎችን ያከናውናል:: ዋና ዋና ተግባራት ከፍተኛ ዝግጁነት ያላቸውን የዳታቤዝ መዋቅሮች ማስተዳደር፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ መረጃ መልሶ ማግኛ (Disaster Recovery) ልምምዶችን ማካሄድ፣ የመረጃ ፍለጋ አፈጻጸምን ማሻሻል፣ አውቶሜትድ ባክአፖችን መተግበር፣ ጥብቅ የሳይበር ደህንነት ደንቦችን ማክበር እና የካርድና ሂሳብ ግብይቶችን መከታተል ናቸው::

title: Senior Database Administrator
description: ከፍተኛ የዳታቤዝ አስተዳዳሪው የኦራክል እና የSQL ኮር ባንኪንግ ዳታቤዞችን የመጠበቅ፣ የመጠበቅና የማሻሻል ስራዎችን ያከናውናል:: ዋና ዋና ተግባራት ከፍተኛ ዝግጁነት ያላቸውን የዳታቤዝ መዋቅሮች ማስተዳደር፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ መረጃ መልሶ ማግኛ (Disaster Recovery) ልምምዶችን ማካሄድ፣ የመረጃ ፍለጋ አፈጻጸምን ማሻሻል፣ አውቶሜትድ ባክአፖችን መተግበር፣ ጥብቅ የሳይበር ደህንነት ደንቦችን ማክበር እና የካርድና ሂሳብ ግብይቶችን መከታተል ናቸው::

title: Regional Compliance Manager
description: : የክልል ተገዢነት አስተዳዳሪ በክልሉ ውስጥ በሚገኙ የሀገር ውስጥ ቢሮዎች ውስጥ የቁጥጥር ማዕቀፎችን፣ የአደጋ አስተዳደርን እና የውስጥ ቁጥጥሮችን የመቆጣጠር ሃላፊነት አለበት።

title: Country Director
description: የሀገሪቱ ዳይሬክተር በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ለሚገኙ ሁሉም የልማት እና ሰብአዊ ድጋፍ መርሃ ግብሮች አጠቃላይ መሪነትን፣ ስልታዊ እይታን እና የአሰራር ክትትልን ይሰጣል።

title: Partnerships and Grants Manager
description: ተቋማዊ የገንዘብ ድጋፎችን ለማግኘት፣ ከለጋሾች ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለመምራት እና ከገንዘብ ድጋፍ ስምምነቶች ጋር መጣጣምን ለማረጋገጥ ሃላፊነት ይወስዳል።

title: Protection and Inclusion Manager
description: በሰብአዊ ድጋፍ መስኮች ውስጥ ለአረጋውያን እና ህዳሴ ላይ ለወደቁ ህብረተሰብ ክፍሎች ልዩ ትኩረት በመስጠት የማህበራዊ ጥበቃ ስራዎችን ያስተዳደራል።

title: Ethiopia Procurement Coordinator
description: የድርጅቱን ሀገራዊ መርሃ ግብር አጠቃላይ የግዥ ስራዎች፣ የአቅራቢዎች ድርድር እና የሎጅስቲክስ ዝግጅቶች ይቆጣጠራል።

title: Protection and Inclusion Manager
description: በሰብአዊ ድጋፍ መስኮች ውስጥ ለአረጋውያን እና ህዳሴ ላይ ለወደቁ ህብረተሰብ ክፍሎች ልዩ ትኩረት በመስጠት የማህበራዊ ጥበቃ ስራዎችን ያስተዳደራል።

title: Ethiopia Procurement Coordinator
description: የድርጅቱን ሀገራዊ መርሃ ግብር አጠቃላይ የግዥ ስራዎች፣ የአቅራቢዎች ድርድር እና የሎጅስቲክስ ዝግጅቶች ይቆጣጠራል።

title: Branch Business Relationship Manager - IFB
description: ለወለድ አልባ ባንኪንግ አገልግሎት (IFB) ጠንካራ የደንበኛ ፖርትፎሊዮዎችን የመገንባት እና የቅርንጫፉን የገቢ ግቦች የማሳካት ሃላፊነት አለበት።

title: Branch Business Relationship Manager - IFB
description: ለወለድ አልባ ባንኪንግ አገልግሎት (IFB) ጠንካራ የደንበኛ ፖርትፎሊዮዎችን የመገንባት እና የቅርንጫፉን የገቢ ግቦች የማሳካት ሃላፊነት አለበት።

title: Branch Business Relationship Manager - IFB
description: ለወለድ አልባ ባንኪንግ አገልግሎት (IFB) ጠንካራ የደንበኛ ፖርትፎሊዮዎችን የመገንባት እና የቅርንጫፉን የገቢ ግቦች የማሳካት ሃላፊነት አለበት።

title: Senior Officer, POS Services
description: እንከን የለሽ የዲጂታል ግብይቶችን ለማረጋገጥ የPOS ማሽኖችን ስርጭት፣ የነጋዴዎች ውህደት እና የኤሌክትሮኒክስ ክፍያ ድጋፍ አገልግሎቶችን ያስተዳድራል።

title: Digital Customer Acquisition & FinTech Partnership Officer
description: የዲጂታል ተጠቃሚዎችን መሰረት በማስፋት፣ ስልታዊ የፊንቴክ አጋርነቶችን በመፍጠር እና የባንክ ኤሌክትሮኒክ አገልግሎቶችን ተደራሽነት የማሳደግ ስራዎችን ይሰራል።

title: Branch Manager
description: የተቋሙን ግቦች ለማሳካት የቅርንጫፍ ቢሮውን አጠቃላይ የስራ እና የንግድ ልማት እንቅስቃሴዎች ይመራል፣ ያስተባብራል እንዲሁም ይቆጣጠራል።

title: Cybersecurity Officer
description: የደህንነት ፕሮቶኮሎችን ተግባራዊ ያደርጋል፣ የኔትዎርክ ትራፊክን ይከታተላል እንዲሁም ዋና ዋና የባንክ ስርዓቶችን ከሳይበር አደጋዎች ይጠብቃል።

title: Sales and Marketing Engineer
description: የድርጅቱን ቅባት እና ነዳጅ አካውንቶች ያስተዳድራል፣ የኢንዱስትሪ ደንበኛ መፍትሄዎችን ያስተባብራል እንዲሁም የክልል ሽያጭ እድገትን ያፋጥናል።

title: International Trade and Export Manager
description: ዓለም አቀፍ ገዢዎች ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ይመራል፣ የቡና ኤክስፖርት ሰነዶችን፣ ሎጅስቲክስን እና ዓለም አቀፍ የውል ድርድሮችን ይቆጣጠራል።

title: Senior Human Resource Business Partner
description: የሰው ሃብት ስልቶችን ከኮርፖሬት የንግድ ግቦች ጋር ያስተካክላል፣ የችሎታ ፍለጋን፣ የሰራተኛ ግንኙነቶችን እና የአፈጻጸም አስተዳደርን ይቆጣጠራል።

title: Corporate Finance Manager
description: የፊናንስ እቅድ ማውጣትን ይመራል፣ የካፒታል ኢንቨስትመንቶችን ያስተዳድራል፣ እና በኩባንያው ቅርንጫፎች ውስጥ ጥብቅ የፊናንስ ሪፖርት ማድረጉን ያረጋግጣል።

title: Hospitality Operations Director
description: : የቅንጦት ሪዞርቱን የዕለት ተዕለት ስራዎች፣ የደንበኛ እንክብካቤ ፕሮቶኮሎችን እና የሰራተኞችን ስልጠና መርሃ ግብሮች ይቆጣጠራል።

title: National Infrastructure Civil Engineer
description: ለሀገራዊ የልማት ፕሮጀክቶች ቴክኒካዊ የሲቪል ኢንጂነሪንግ አማካሪነትን፣ የቦታ ምርመራዎችን እና የግንባታ ጥራት ግምገማዎችን ያቀርባል።

title: Media Research Consultant
description: ለብሮድካስት መርሃ ግብሮች የሚዲያ ታዳሚ ጥናቶችን፣ የተፅዕኖ ግምገማዎችን እና የጥራት ምርምሮችን ነድፎ ይተገብራል።

title: Renewable Energy Project Evaluator
description: የታዳሽ ሃይል ስራዎችን ቴክኒካዊ አፈፃፀም፣ ቀጣይነት እና ማህበራዊ-ኢኮኖሚያዊ ተፅዕኖ በመገምገም ገለልተኛ ግምገማዎችን ያካሂዳል።

title: External Consultant – Climate, Conflict and Gender Equality
description: በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ፣ በአካባቢያዊ ግጭቶች እና በሥርዓተ ጾታ እኩልነት መካከል ያለውን ውስብስብ ግንኙነት የሚመረምር ልዩ ጥናት ያካሂዳል።

title: Temporary Afar and Somali Languages Reviewer - ChatBot Project (Freelance/Contract)
description: ለኦፊሴላዊ የAI ቻትቦት ፕሮጀክት ልማት የአፋርኛ እና ሶማልኛ ቋንቋ መረጃዎችን ይገመግማል፣ ያስተካክላል እንዲሁም ትክክለኛነታቸውን ያረጋግጣል።

title: Program Officer
description: ፕሮግራም ኦፊሰሩ ውስብስብ የምግብ ዋስትና እና የመቋቋም አቅም ግንባታ ፕሮግራሞችን አፈፃፀም ያስተባብራል፣ ይመራል እንዲሁም ይደግፋል። ኃላፊነቶች የፕሮጀክት ስራዎችን መከታተል፣ ከመንግስት አጋሮች ጋር መስራት፣ የመስክ መረጃዎችን መተንተን እና አጠቃላይ ለለጋሾች የሚሆን ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀትን ያካትታሉ። እጩው በሁሉም የስራ ክልሎች ውስጥ የ WFP የጥራት ደረጃዎችን እና ስልታዊ ግቦችን መከበራቸውን ያረጋግጣል።

title: Health Specialist
description: የጤና ባለሙያው የጤና እና ስነ-ምግብ ዘርፍ ስልቶችን በመንደፍ፣ በማዘጋጀት እና በመተግበር ረገድ ቴክኒካዊ መሪነትን ይሰጣል። ኃላፊነቶች ከጤና ሚኒስቴር ጋር የቅርብ ትብብር ማድረግ፣ የአቅም ግንባታ ስራዎች፣ የሀብት ማሰባሰብ እና አጠቃላይ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የእናትና ህፃናት ሞትን ለመቀነስ የተሰሩ ስራዎችን መከታተልን ያካትታል።

title: Finance Coordinator
description: የፋይናንስ አስተባባሪው በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ የሚገኙ የ IRC ስራዎችን አጠቃላይ የፋይናንስ አስተዳደር፣ በጀት ዝግጅት፣ የሂሳብ አያያዝ ስርዓቶች እና የውስጥ ቁጥጥር ይመራል። ዋና ዋና ስራዎች ከለጋሾች ህጎች ጋር መጣጣምን ማረጋገጥ፣ የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት፣ የገንዘብ ዝውውርን መቆጣጠር እና የፕሮጀክት ወጪዎችን መመርመርን ያካትታል።

title: Education Project Coordinator
description: የትምህርት ፕሮጀክት አስተባባሪው ተጋላጭ ለሆኑ ህፃናት አስቸኳይ እና የረጅም ጊዜ የትምህርት ፕሮግራሞች አፈፃፀምን ይመራል። ሚናው የመምህራን ማሰልጠኛ አውደ-ጥናቶችን መንደፍ፣ የትምህርት ቤት ተቋማትን መከታተል፣ ከአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ ጋር መሰራትን እና ህፃናት ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ የመማሪያ አካባቢ ማግኘታቸውን ማረጋገጥን ይጠይቃል።

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description: የሰንሰለት አስተዳደር ተንታኙ በህዝብ ጤና ተቋማት ውስጥ የህክምና እቃዎች ስርጭት ስርዓትን ለማሻሻል የትንታኔ ድጋፍ ይሰጣል። ዋና ዋና ኃላፊነቶች የምርት ፍላጎትን መተንበይ፣ የአቅርቦት መሰናክሎችን መከታተል እና የፋርማሲዩቲካል አቅርቦት ሰንሰለቶችን ለማቀላጠፍ ከመንግስት ባለድርሻ አካላት ጋር መስራት ናቸው።

title: Cyber Attack Analyst
description: የሳይበር ጥቃት ተንታኙ የኔትወርክ ዝውውርን የመከታተል፣ የደህንነት ጉድለቶችን የመለየት፣ ውስብስብ የሳይበር ስጋቶችን የመተንተን እና ዋና ዋና የባንክ መድረኮችን እና ሚስጥራዊ የውሂብ ጎታዎችን ለመጠበቅ የአደጋ ጊዜ ምላሽ እርምጃዎችን የመውሰድ ሃላፊነት አለበት።

title: Branch Business Relationship Manager - IFB
description: የቅርንጫፍ ቢዝነስ ግንኙነት ስራ አስኪያጅ (IFB) የኢስላሚክ ባንክ የደንበኞች ፖርትፎሊዮ እንዲያድግ ያደርጋል፣ ከፍተኛ ባለሀብት የሆኑ ደንበኞችን አካውንቶች ያስተዳድራል፣ ከሸሪአ ህግ ጋር የሚጣጣሙ የፋይናንስ ምርቶችን ያስተዋውቃል እንዲሁም ከባንኩ ስልታዊ ግቦች ጋር የተጣጣሙ አላማዎችን ማሳካቱን ያረጋግጣል።

title: Senior Network Administrator
description: ሲኒየር የኔትወርክ አስተዳዳሪው የድርጅት ደረጃ የውሂብ ኔትወርኮችን የማዋቀር፣ የማስተካከል እና የመጠበቅ ሃላፊነት አለበት። ስራው ውስብስብ የመስመር ላይ ችግሮችን መፍታት፣ የኢንተርኔት ፍጥነት አፈፃፀምን ማሻሻል እና የቅርንጫፎች ትስስር ስርዓቶች ሁልጊዜ ሰራተኛ መሆናቸውን ማረጋገጥን ይጠይቃል።

title: Senior Network Administrator
description: ሲኒየር የኔትወርክ አስተዳዳሪው የድርጅት ደረጃ የውሂብ ኔትወርኮችን የማዋቀር፣ የማስተካከል እና የመጠበቅ ሃላፊነት አለበት። ስራው ውስብስብ የመስመር ላይ ችግሮችን መፍታት፣ የኢንተርኔት ፍጥነት አፈፃፀምን ማሻሻል እና የቅርንጫፎች ትስስር ስርዓቶች ሁልጊዜ ሰራተኛ መሆናቸውን ማረጋገጥን ይጠይቃል።

title: Senior Network Administrator
description: ሲኒየር የኔትወርክ አስተዳዳሪው የድርጅት ደረጃ የውሂብ ኔትወርኮችን የማዋቀር፣ የማስተካከል እና የመጠበቅ ሃላፊነት አለበት። ስራው ውስብስብ የመስመር ላይ ችግሮችን መፍታት፣ የኢንተርኔት ፍጥነት አፈፃፀምን ማሻሻል እና የቅርንጫፎች ትስስር ስርዓቶች ሁልጊዜ ሰራተኛ መሆናቸውን ማረጋገጥን ይጠይቃል።

title: Senior Network Administrator
description: ሲኒየር የኔትወርክ አስተዳዳሪው የድርጅት ደረጃ የውሂብ ኔትወርኮችን የማዋቀር፣ የማስተካከል እና የመጠበቅ ሃላፊነት አለበት። ስራው ውስብስብ የመስመር ላይ ችግሮችን መፍታት፣ የኢንተርኔት ፍጥነት አፈፃፀምን ማሻሻል እና የቅርንጫፎች ትስስር ስርዓቶች ሁልጊዜ ሰራተኛ መሆናቸውን ማረጋገጥን ይጠይቃል።

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description: ሲኒየር የውስጥ ኦዲተሩ በባንክ ቅርንጫፎች እና ክፍሎች ውስጥ የስራ፣ የፋይናንስ እና ህግ ተገዢነት ኦዲቶችን ያቅዳል እንዲሁም ይፈፅማል። ኃላፊነቶች የውስጥ ቁጥጥር ውጤታማነትን መገምገም፣ የፋይናንስ አደጋዎችን መለየት እና አጠቃላይ የኦዲት ግኝት ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀትን ያካትታሉ።

title: Credit Analyst
description: የብድር ተንታኙ የብድር ማመልከቻዎችን ይገመግማል፣ የፋይናንስ መግለጫ ትንታኔዎችን ያካሂዳል፣ የተበዳሪዎችን አደጋ ሁኔታ ይመረምራል እና ሁሉም የብድር ሀሳቦች ከባንኩ የብድር ፖሊሲዎች እና የቁጥጥር ማዕቀፎች ጋር መጣጣማቸውን ያረጋግጣል።

title: Trainee Aircraft Mechanic - ET-Sponsored
description: የአውሮፕላን መካኒክ ሰልጣኙ በአውሮፕላን ጥገና ሂደቶች፣ መዋቅራዊ ጥገናዎች እና ሜካኒካል ስርዓቶች ላይ ጥልቅ ንድፈ-ሃሳባዊ እና ተግባራዊ ስልጠና ይወስዳል። ስልጠናውን በအောင်ነት ያጠናቀቁ ሰልጣኞች የአየር መንገዱን ቴክኒክ ቡድን ይቀላቀላሉ።

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description: ዋናው የግራፊክ ዲዛይነር ለመጽክቶች፣ መጽሄቶች፣ ማሸጊያዎች እና ለድርጅታዊ የንግድ ምልክት እቃዎች ማራኪ የሆኑ ዲዛይኖችን ያዘጋጃል። በ Adobe Creative Suite መሣሪያዎች ላይ ልምድ እና ለፊደል ቀረጻ እና ለቀለም ቅንጅት ትኩረት መስጠት ይገባል።

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description: የደንበኛ ልምድ መኮንኑ የተወሳሰቡ የደንበኛ ጥያቄዎችን ይመለሰል፣ የአስተያየት አዝማሚያዎችን ይመረምራል፣ የአገልግሎት ችግሮችን ለመፍታት ከቴክኒክ ድጋፍ ቡድኖች ጋር ይሰራል እና በዲጂታል እና በአካል መገናኛ ቦታዎች የደንበኞችን እርካታ ደረጃ ከፍ ያደርጋል።

title: Sales and Marketing Manager
description: የሽያጭ እና ማርኬቲንግ ስራ አስኪያጁ ስልታዊ የማርኬቲንግ ዘመቻዎችን ነድፎ ይተገብራል፣ የድርጅት ሆቴል የቦታ ማስያዣዎችን ይጠብቃል፣ የብራንድ ታዋቂነትን ይቆጣጠራል እና የሆቴሉን የገቢ መጠኖች ከፍ ለማድረግ የሽያጭ ቡድኑን ይመራል።

title: Video Production Consultant
description: የቪዲዮ ፕሮዳክሽን አማካሪው ከፍተኛ ተፅዕኖ ያላቸውን ዶክመንተሪዎች፣ የማስተዋወቂያ ቪዲዮ ቅንብሮችን እና የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ይዘቶችን Adobe Premiere Pro እና After Effects በመጠቀም ያርትዕል፣ የደንበኞችን የብራንድ ደረጃዎች መጠበቁንም ያረጋግጣል።

title: Disability Specialist
description: የካቴጎሪው ባለሙያ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ በሚካሄዱ የዩኒሴፍ ፕሮግራሞች ሁሉ አካል ጉዳተኞችን ያካተተ አሰራር እንዲሰፍን ቴክኒካዊ ድጋፍ ይሰጣል። ዋና ተግባራቱ አካል ጉዳተኛ ህፃናትን የሚያቀፉ የመብትና የትምህርት ፕሮግራሞችን መምራት፣ ከመንግስት አካላት ጋር የመብት አከባበር ፖሊሲዎች ላይ መስራት፣ እና ለተባባሪ ድርጅቶች የአቅም ግንባታ ስልጠና መስጠትን ያካትታል።

title: Health Cluster Coordinator
description: የጤና ክላስተር አስተባባሪው በኢትዮጵያ ያለውን የጤና ዘርፍ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ምላሽ ይከታተላል፣ ይመራልም። ዋና ሀላፊነቶቹ መንግስታዊ ያልሆኑ ድርጅቶችን ስራ ማስተባበር፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ የጤና ፍላጎቶችን መገምገም፣ የጋራ የጤና ምላሽ እቅዶችን ማዘጋጀት፣ እና ለሚመለከታቸው አካላት የጤና ሁኔታ መረጃ ማቅረብ ናቸው።

title: Protection Officer – Protection Case Management
description: የጥበቃ ኦፊሰሩ ተጋላጭ ለሆኑ ተፈናቃዮች እና ስደተኞች የጥበቃ አገልግሎት ይሰጣል። ተግባራቱ የግል ሁኔታ ግምገማ ማድረግ፣ የምክርና የስነ-ልቦና ድጋፍ ማመቻቸት፣ ማህበረሰብ አቀፍ የድጋፍ አውታሮችን መዘርጋት እና አፈፃፀሙን የሚገልጹ ሪፖርቶችን ማቅረብ ናቸው።

title: Operations Officer
description: የኦፕሬሽንስ ኦፊሰሩ የዓለም ባንክ በኢትዮጵያ የሚያካሂዳቸውን የልማት ፕሮግራሞች ይከታተላል። ተግባራቱ ፕሮጀክቶች የታቀደላቸውን ግብ ማካሄዳቸውን መከታተል፣ የፕሮግራሞች አፈፃፀም ሪፖርት ማዘጋጀት እና ከመንግስት የልማት አካላት ጋር የጋራ ስብሰባዎችን ማስተባበር ያካትታል።

title: National Project Officer
description: በኢትዮጵያ የሚከናወኑ የስደተኞች እና ስደት አስተዳደር ፕሮጀክቶችን የማቀድ፣ የማስፈጸም እና የመገምገም ሀላፊነት አለበት። የፕሮጀክቶችን ሂደት መከታተል፣ ከሚመለከታቸው የመንግስት አካላት ጋር መስራት፣ ስልጠናዎችን ማደራጀት እና የስራ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት ዋና ተግባራቱ ናቸው።
